༅kar ba(012)phaza1 bka1tshe ༅7ka' chu)ba—4bza zang bo41 2001 3ba 5ka1ci2༅7—105—02992—71 1pyo ku ༅ ྈ ④ 1 ka—bza༅ya ༅14 2bza4bka tshe012༅rje(98)zo02640—zang ma lo ni1kar mabo3bzad sogs ba'i14zu tshe5za100013zang po'i dang tshe'i nga nga ba te / / 6khyablosgom mo yod bkajo1985jo10༅zo1lo 2001jo3shā4bzo zo4tsho6kablozo4 85071168ba 1732 6bka : 175rngob 11001—14000 tshog1780za ma mi lha bza6ka ba—1za 4dag tshomatshophyu zaba'i za 6421279( zod pob za64211734
ngag sgronaXrtsaX'agrelaXdang de'i yang 'grel/dpal khang lo tsā bas rtsa ba mdzad/bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis 'grel pa mdzad/kun bzang rnam rgyal gyis yang 'grel brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dpe skrun gsam bshad/〈dag yig ngag sgron〉zhes ba 'di ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang brtsams pa zhig yin zhing / de ni dag yig gi dpe rgyun skur tshogs kyi dbus su rgyu skar rgyal po ji bzhin rang mdang su lhag par bkra pa zhig yin stabs mchog dman kun gyis khungs dag tshad mar bzung nas lta klog byed kyi yod/ der dpe rgyun gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dge mtshan nam legs cha mang dag zhig mchis pa ste/ rnam dbye so so'i phrad kyi sgra sbyor byed lugs dang / ming gzhi gang la 'phul mtha' gang zhig thob min sogs dmigs su bkar nas dpe bton tshigs su bcad yod pa de dag la mkhas dbang bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor 'grel pa cung rgyas tsam zhig byas 'dug kyang der dus skabs dang / khrid yul sogs gang spud kyis rkyen pas tshig don rtogs par dka' zhing / lhag par du ming tshig tshang ma gcig tu 'brel nas 'grel bshad byas par brten shes tshad cung dma' ba'i gzhon skyes gsar bu ba tshos slob gnyer byed skabs tshig don yas mas gcod sgyu tshams ma shes pa bcas kyis go don log nyen che ba dang / chos tshig dang / sman gyi tha snyad sogs mang dag zhig ming tsam las de'i khyad chos dang / ngo bor 'grel bshad kha gsal zhig med stabs yul lung cha rkyen zhan pa'i dmangs btsugs slob grwa dang /gzhung btsugs slob grwa tha na slob grwa 'bring ba sogs kyi dge rgan mang po zhig la'ang dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs dkon pa'i rkyen gyis slob khrid byed skabs dka' 1

ngal mi nyung ba 'phrad kyi yod pas slob ma rnams ni de bas smos ci dgos/ der brten/ bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan kun bzang rnam rgyal lags kyis lo ngo kha shas ring dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs gang mang dpyad bsdur byas te〈ngag sgron rtsa 'grel dang de'i yang 'grel〉zhes pa 'di brtsams pa red/ bod kyi tha snyad brda dag gtsigs cher 'dzin mkhan rgya che'i klog pa po rnams la phan pa'i ched du nga tshos deb 'di dpe skrun byas pa yin/rtsom sgrig byed mkhan gyi shes tshad bam 'a ba dang / nyams myong dben pa'i rkyen gyis chad lhag dang yig nor yod nges lags na rgya che'i glog pa po rnams kyis dgongs 'char lhug por stsol ba'i re ba zhu/jig pa pos/—

rtsom pa po'i gtam/dbal khang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i dag yig ngag sgron gyi rtsa ba〉'di ni da phan dag yig kun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin pa dang / de la sngon 'grel pa gzhan 'ga' zhig yod par grags na'ang da lam 'dren byed kyi spyod yul du khyab che bar gyur pa ni khu nu ba bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i 'grel pa 8ga gsal zhes pa 'di kho nar zad cing / 'grel pa 'dir dge mtshan mang po ldan yod pa dang / de sngon nus pa'ang mi chung ba zhig thon yod pa red/ 'on te deng skabs slob grwa khag gi slob rim mi 'dra ba dang /slob sbyong byed mkhan gyi lo na mi 'dra ba/ de bzhin du slob sbyong gi cha rkyen mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis ngag sgron gyi 'grel pa 'dir sbyangs brtson byed skabs dka' ngal chen po 'phrad pa ni gcig nas 'grel pa 'di'i nang du ming tshig la la rtsa ba las 'grel pa go dka' ba dang / gnyis nas chu tshad cung mtho tsam zhig ldan med tshe tshig mtshams bde blag tu gcod mi nus par brten la la go ba log skrub kyi gnad du 'gro nyen che ba/ gsum nas chos lugs dang / grub mtha' dang / tshad ma la sogs pa'i ming da grangs kyi rnam grangs mang po zhig gcig sdud byas pa'am yang na phyogs re tsam las ston med rkyen dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs mang po zhig la brten nas rtogs thabs byed dgos pa'i gnad don mchis stabs/ cha rkyen cung zhan pa'i slob grwa sogs la gnad don de dag spug gcod byed dka' ba sogs dngos su mthong thos byung bas dag yig ngag sgron gyi 1

'grel par cung lha bde ba dang / rtogasu sla ba'i yang 'grel zhig byung na slob gnyer byed mkhan gang cir phan pa cung che'o snyam pa'i skul slong bzang pos skul te kho bos slob khrid kyi bar gseng du‘dag yig ngag sgron gyi yang 'grel byis pa'i dga' byed〉ces pa 'di rtsom 'bri byas pa yin lags/dpal khang lo tsā ba ni spyi lo 1466me byi lor bod ljongs gtsang gi bzhad shar phyogs dpal khang zhes pa'i khyim du 'khrungs/ mtshan dngos ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i sder 'bod pa yin/ mtshan gzhan du dpal khang lo tsā ba dang / dpal khang chos mtshud dang —/ karma 'phrin las phyogs las rnam rgyal yang zer/ dpal khang zer ba bod kyi rigs rus shig dang khyim ming yin par grags/ khong ni skyogs ston karma lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis blo gros ngo mtshar bye ba'i gter mdzod kyi dngos slob yin zhing / phyis su mkhas pa'i phul du phyin nas mtshan gyi snyan pa ring du grags pa dang — sku tshe gang po'i ring rtsom pa gnang ba'i grags can bstan bcos mang dag cig yod pa'i khungs gtogs〈bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshigs le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba〉'di ni spyi lo 1638sa khyi lor brtsams shing / bstan bcos 'di la phyis su 'grel pa gzhan byung yod kyang da lam mthong chos su gyur pa'i〈bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos ngag sgron gyi 'grel pa tshig gsal〉bya ba 'di ni rgya gar nub phyogs su byung ba'i khu nu ba bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis spyi lo 1937me glang lor brtsams gnang ba yin no/ / kun bzang rnam rgyal gyis brtsams/2
)ga ldig dka sgron gyi rtsa da/dpal khang lo tsā bas brtsams/

nga / /na mo ba ba ya/ bod kyi brda'i bye zag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos migs le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i bag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ yang dag bar gsung ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan ba ba'i gzi byin gser gyi ri 'dra'i sku/ /brgyad khri bzhi stob chos ja chen po'i gsung / /ye shes rgya mtsho gtib mtha' med ba'i thugs/ /thub chen 'gro ba'i bla ma phyag gi gnas/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i phung po cig car du/ /shal bzab yid mkhar 'gog pa med pa'i gzugs/ /phan bde'i 'od dkar legs bshad bsil zer can/ /'jam mgon spru ba'i zla ba mchog der 'dud/ /me shes ji 'phrul mdzes sku'i 'jo sgeg dang / /za dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rgyud mang snyan 'gyur gyis/ /snying la zag med bde snyer lhag pa'i lha/ /dbyangs can lha mos blo yi mchog sbyin mdzod/ /sngom med yi ge'i ngo mtshar snang ba sogs/ /legs bzad 'od brgyas byang phyogs mun gling 'dir/ thub bstan gsal ma dzad ba ṭa la sogs/ /rgya pod mkhas pa dmas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros zul zhing sbyangs ba 'i mthu chung yang //tshad ldan mkhas pa'i legs bshad la brten nas/ /'khyel ba'i mun chen drungs 'byin brda rngo da kyi/ /bstan bcos mkhas pa'i ngag sgro na rab gsal bya/ 1brjod don kā li sum cu la/ /rkyang pa 1

'phul dang mgo can dang / dbyangs lnga ya ra la ba'i 'dogs//rjes 'jug dpe sogs rim pas bstan/ /(ka) kun mkhyen shākya karma pa/ /ka ra ka nyan ba/ shi ka /nags klung chu klung dba' klob glu/ /ka dag klob yangs klong du gyur/ /ka ku lha ya ka da za/ /ka sha ku sha ka ma la/ /kud ku mud ke skyo ka /ka ra smi ra ke ta ka /shing kun ya krong dar ya kan/ /ka ped ku ba kem pa'i 'bras/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri g.ya' kyi ma/ /na dī ke la ka ko la/ /ke la sha dang ka lid/ /ko ba dab ko sa la/ /ka ma ta dang ko'u shi ka /ka sgyu ya na ka'i nu/ /ke'u tshang du ko kad dang / /yubs kar ka ru thod le kor/ /ku shu gur kum ka ca kun/ /bsags kyang 'thab krol phung krol gyu/ /kye ma kyi byud kye ho kwa/ /kye kye kyong klong kong kob du/ /krog krog krab krab mgo klog ba klog /krong krong kog gis ker langs nas/ /ku res do ker ko sko 'degs/ /ku rtso kul ka klan ka'i rgyu/ /'on kub lan man nyen kor du/ /ka lan ta ka co ka dang / /ka la bka'i kyur kyur skad/ /ke'u kun dong kag ke kang / /stod kor klad kor zad don dang / /ke sha zhabs kyu lhags kyus btab/ /kar kar zug langs bad kan chu'i/ /ku ya kan 'og rtsa kyal kyal/ /rus krang krang re skyil kung bcas/ /'byams klas mtha' klas klog kyang klag /ston ka dpyid ka gnyis ka'i dus/ /glab chen thal kar ber kas brdungs/ /ka lu ba yis kla klo bcom/ /ka ba ka tsa li das klubs/ /kar+ṣa pa ṇa ke ke ru/ /kang ka 'di ko klag chor che//keng rus ka li'i klad pa za/ /kun nas kun tu pags kab kob//2

—ku byu'i mgrin sogs ka rkyab ngo / /dkar zag ma dkugs dkor mjod dkrogs/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil du dkrob bskyed dka'/ /dka' thub dka' spyad dkon rtsog dkon/ /mdog dkar dkyel che spyan dbyus ring 1 /dkyus ma'i dkor pas dri ma dku/ /dkos bag kun dkris gos kyis dkris/ /dku skabs dku spum dku ma stobs/ /jin dkrigs zho dkrogs rol mo dkrol/ /dkar yol zag dkum dbyu sar dbyus/ /dka' 'grel dkrigs phrag dkan gzar po1 /phan tshun dkugs sogs das 'phul ka'o/ /bkra shis bkrag mdangs chon bkra bkram/ /bka' bsgos khral khal zad bu bkal/ /pho nya ston mo 'od sprul bkye/ /dgobs pa khral bkral dgongs bcings bkrol/ /dri ma bku bkus bkren cib bkres/ 1bkar nas bkyigs te spog bkums bkrobs/ /bkad sar smod bkar thugs dam bkang / /bsnyen bkur bkur stelagong du bkur/ /bkod legs bder bkod zur bkol dang / /shing bkug bkas shing g.yog nu bkol1 /gnang bkag sman bku bkus te bor/ /kos bkab gzhu bkab rtsa ba bkod /bka' drin bka' btags bka' blo bde/ /bka' btsun brgyad bkag 'khon du bkon/ /lam bkag spa bkong rgyal pos bkrabs/ /lus bkan lag bkan bkros nas bkri/ /mdo bzas mgo bkad thags kyi bkad/ /bkyal ba'i ngag sogs bas 'phul ka'o/ /rgang lag rka zhing rkab rkan rkub/ /chom rkun rkyan dang phye rkyal ku/ /rkong pa chig rkyang sa rko skos/ /gan rkyal rked rgyob rkon pa 'jugs/ /rka mgo'i rkyal rtsed ri dwags rkyab / /rgyu rkyen la 3

sogs rar btags ka'o/ /lkog byur lkog ma skog shal dang / /bag skugs la sogs lar btags ka'o/ /ska rtsog skal ldan rgar ma skag /sku skem stum skud skud ba skyol/ /skyo ma'i skrag pa skung kas skud/ /ska rags skyer skya sku ru ra/ /skyes bu skyems kyi skom jir skol/ /gos skon skyen yab skyur bas skyo/ /skom byed skul byed skor ba byed/ /sku rum sku gang skugs pas skyengs/ /zan dang skyigs bu sku sbab zabs/ /ri skyegs chu skyar skya ga'i skad/ /skun bu skam pa skya ba skyogs/ /dge skos bro bob ḍa ru skyog /skud po skyo sngogs snyan skyos bog /rgya skyegs skyed tshal skyer ba'i skas/ /ske dang yog skor chu skyegs skyes/ /skyi g.ya'i skyon skyob skyabs 'gro skyor/ /'tsho skyong re skong skyin gor skogs/ /srab skyogs skyes bzab rgyal gyi skugs/ /bya skyibs skar khung skor tsher skyid/ /skyel ma skyes chen skyos ma skyod/ /chu skyom zho skyog rtsis kyi skyeg /ji skad 'ji skad kha skong skabs/ /sa skyong skyab nul skam re skan/ /ska cig bo skyes shing spus pa/ /sbas skungs mtha' skor skobs su chud/ /rab skal skye mched thugs dam skong / /bya skon skyi dkar skye tshe'i 'dru/ /skyo ma snga btsan skyil kub skyod/ /skya rebs zhal skyin sar btags ka'o/ /'dod la brkam pas bku bya brkus/ /sra brkyab lag brkyab brko bya bdas/ /ngas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ka'o/ /byug pa bsku bskus lag bskum bskums/ /'dzin 'gan dbang bskur chos la bskul/ /nor bskyi bskyis dang bskyin ba bskyal/ /rgos bskor rtar bskyon bskyar nas bzad/ /gcom bskungs zas bskru bskyed cing bkar/ /bskal mes mtsho 4

bskams chu bskyil bskyams/ /bskal don skungs shing 'jigs bskyabs bskyangs/ /'pho bskyas rgyang bskyur bya ba ba byungs/ /mi bskyod bskor ba rgyal sar bskos/ /ro bska kha skang thugs dam bskabs/ /sems bskyed rgya bskyed brjed pa'i bskyud/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ka'o/ /(kha) go khrab khri phrag khrag khrig khur/ /khong rtsa khon 'dzin khro bo khros/ /khro dang khrol tshags khrud khus khyes/ /khong khug khrag khyeg khyeng khyeng byu/ /tshul khrims khris 'jags khrims kyi khral/ /khru gang khrun ring khram kha khra/ /khrom khrod khri steng khang khyim khyams/ /bya khra khyis khyer khror ba'i khre/ /kho ra khor yug khron chu khrems/ /sil khrol khams gsum zam pas khrel/ /dur khrod sna khrid khyems stod zad/ /rngo gnyer khu da kha rkyang ngo / /mkhan pos sa mkhar mkhrab mkhregs mkhyen/ /mchud spyad dpe mkhud zhu mkhan mkho//ma mkhal mkhal ma mkhur 'dzum mkhas/ /mkhan khrod mkhos phab snga mkho bzhin/ /mkha' mnyam mkhris nad med par mkhyen//chu mkhris mkhrig ma mas 'phul kha'o/ /blo 'khums zhe 'khon 'khang zhing 'khu/ /'khrags nas mtha' 'khob 'khyar zhing 'khrams/ /rgas 'khogs 'khos chung rkang 'khum 'khrog /'khror 'khrom 'khar bar 'khril 'khris 'khud/ /'khrig tshig ngag 'khral 'bab 'khrug 'khrul/ /'khri ba 'khye 'khrud 'khri shing 'khungs/ /gdugs 'khyir bro 'khrab 'khar za 'khrol/ /sems 'khol sems /po /zi/'o /byi'akhrugs 'khyeg ra 'khyus/ /kur 'khur khral 'a da 'a mas 'khyil/ /'khor bar 'khren pa 'khras shing 'khar/ ‘ /ma 'khrig ma 6

'khyer rtsam 'khur 'khur/ /ma 'byur bred 'khrims 'kha sa shing 'khun/ /'khor lo 'khod kyang 'khor bcas 'khobs/ /g.yog rtu 'khul 'khol srad bu 'khal/ /'khra sar ma 'khrol 'khrid par 'khums/ thas kyi 'khon sogs 'as 'phul kha'o/ /(gshe grub ma 'a grub thob grangs med grol/ /ral gri gro gas gril zhes zags/ /grul lum grang nad grum lus grobs/ /mon gru nam gru gre gro bzhin/ /chos grwa'i gral du rim gro'i grabs//yul gru gru bzhi gru kha'i grob / /gra ma spu gri gru 'dzin ri/ /mon lug ma lgang gro'i sbang glum/ /gra phub gro ma mon sran gre'u/ /grod pa gron can grub zhing grims/ /gram pa'i chu grog gre ba'i grogs/ /grib mar gros speng re gron med/ /gla rtsi za zan glud lhar glen/ /'dzam glib chegs bam gling bu'i glu/ /pho glang glab shu blog pa'i nad/ /blo ba'i blo dgog leb mor spebs/ /glang chen klos phab blod ras rmal/ /blo 'bur blo bur blo rdeg blog /glags snyed lan glan lhan ba glan/ /sgo chegs chos gos spegs bu'i grwa/ /gla gror zho sha mdun ma speng / /bya glag grog ma grib grib gnon/ /grog por gru mo zag grum grubs/ /dngos grub gru char 'bebs par grags/ /sha ba'i tsā dor ga rkyang ngo / /dge bsnyen dge tshul dga' dgyes dgod/ /dgung sngon dgu tshigs dge zhing dgu/ /nyin dgung dge bshes yod dgu dgug /dge rgyung dge blong dge 'dun dgus/ /dgra bcom dgongs dgrol yi ger dgod/ /dgag sgrub snod dgang dgon par dgar/ /dgo bas pha ba dgo dgo dgas/ /khal dgal lhan pa dgab 6

dang dgog /skye dgus dge legs dge spub dgos/ /dgobs mo thob dgram me tog dgram/ /dgun dung can du dgun ka sdod/ /dgub lo la sogs das 'phul ga'o/ /bka' bgro bgro cheb bgyi bgyid bgyis/ /go bgos bgegs kyis bgrod lam bgags/ /dus bgyangs tshod bgam bgo ba bgos/ /bgres pos mig bgrad bgrang preb bgrangs/ /bgrus pa'i 'bras bgos gad mo bgad/ /gom pa bkoms shing cog ma bgrungs/ /bgo skal la sogs bas 'phul ga'o/ /mgo mgur mgul mgrin mgar mgon mgu/ /mgal dum mgal me gtor mgron ma rgyas/ /ya mgal ma mgal mas 'phul ga'o/ /'gro 'greng 'grim 'grul 'gyib 'gros 'gran/ /'grangs 'gengs 'gag 'gog 'gags 'gas 'grig /'gyangs 'gor 'gyes 'grogs dgongs 'grel 'grol/ /'gyel 'gril 'grongs 'gums 'gal 'gras 'thod/ /'gol sar 'gram 'gul nor 'gye 'gyed/ /'gan 'khur 'gob po'i 'go nad 'gos/ /'phel 'grib 'gyur 'gyus mi 'gong dab / /lam 'gron 'ga' 'gugs rtsig 'gram 'god/ /brtson 'grus 'go ma'i chu 'grems 'grub/ /mgo 'gems rigs 'gre tshos kyi 'grib/ /'bab mo 'gyed sogs 'as 'phul ga'o/ /rgod po rgya mtshor rgal pyir rgyu/ /gtam rgyud preng rgyud rgyud mang rgyan//bya nod rgan po rga shi'i thud/ /phas nol rgyab 'phen mgo la rgyob//rgod ma'i rgyab rgyas rgyab ring gyug /rgya po dmu rgod phyag rgyar rgyo/ /rgya tsha rgyam tsha rgyags phye'i rgyugs/ /rgyu mtshan lo gyus bying rgod rgyu//rgyal ba'i rgyud rgyal rgyu mar rgyal/ /shes zud rgyas btab ba rgyal 7

rgyags/ /rgya gram rgyan po rgyan dang rgyal/ /grun 'brum rgya shug nya rgyar rgyu/ /rgyus pa rgyu ma lu gu rgyud1 /gru rgyongs rgyangs shing smig rgyu'i rgyun/ /rgya yul rgya che lto rgyab skyid/ /rgyal mtshan rgyal sogs rar btags ga'o/ /la lnga lgang ba gcig lur nges/ /sgom chen blo lgam sgrin por sprun/ /lcags sgrog sgor mor sgrim zhing sgril/ /sgyid skyur sprud lug sprud bu byel/ /spru rtsal g.yo sgyu spru ma sprung / /sgam sgom sgo ba skye sgye'u / /jig mos sgo ba sgog zos sgrebs/ /sdig smrib chu sgrol chos sgra sgogs/ /bya sgro bshad sgros mchu sgros sgogs/ /sgal tshigs sgal spyod sgra sge'u gsher/ /sgren mor sgo drung speg rma skub /thrud par los lgab sgo gus sgrog /dbang sprur 'khor lo jir sgrur byed/ /lag sgreng zas sgong bu ram sgor/ /lgar du rta sgas sgon me sgrib/ /srid sprub klu glub sgol ma sprub/ /mna' sgog sgogs rdos sga do gcog /da sgos sgos su rtsig ba sgron/ /sga stegs sgang gshongs tsha sgo can/ /sgrob dang sgrom sogs sar btags ga'o/ /brgal brtag brgal lan brgyad cu brgyad/ /phreng ba brgya phrag brgyus pas brgyan/ /chu brgal 'o brgyal dran med brgyal/ /brgyud pa lam brgyags spru ba'i brgyad/ /le brgan gad brgyangs smra ba'i brgya/ /brgyugs shing brgyungs par brgyud bar brgyab/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ga'o/ /bu ram bshar zhing bsgrangs nas bsgongs/ /chos ba mdog bsgyur bka' bsgo bsgos/ /chu bsgral chos bsgrags teng 'dzin bsgoms/ /mgo bsgres rigs bsgres rgyal mtshan bsgrebs/ /mna' bdags lam bskugs seng ge bzangs/ /bag chags bsgo 8

bsgos phyogs gcig bsgrigs/ /'od bsgribs blo bsgroms zad bu bsgrims/ /bka ba ba bya ba mi nus/ /bsgrin mi phod dang bya ba'i bsgang / /bsnyel zhib za bsgrags rtsis kyi bsgyur/ /gzhan kyis mi bskul nor gyis bsnab /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan ba'i ga'o/ /(nga) snyan dngags zil dngar tshar du dbar/ /gser dngul dngom che dngos dngos med/ /dngos grub dngos gzhi dngos bshams dngos/ /dbangs zag dban 'then 'bab chu'i dngo / /gri yi ba ngo sogs das 'phul nga'o/ /mnga' ris mnga' zhabs mar 'a thab mnga'/ /mnga' mtshad mnga' bdag mngag gzhug mngags/ /mngon sum mngon gyur mngon mtshan mar la/ /mngon smyod mar 'a bsnyes mngan mi bgrab / /chos mngon mngon shes mngar ba'i ro/ /thugs la mnga' sogs mas 'phul ba'o/ /rngon pa'i za mab za je'u chub / /zam ba'i bkres zab za mo je'u/ /jom ba'i da zam 'jigs rngo bag can/ /dbugs zub zug zus jod mkhan jul/ /jos khyer dre'u jog rma zan dang / /za jog mthug zam jo mi thogs/ /jan zan rtswa za zu ma dang / /rus kyi jog sogs rar btags ba'o/ /zhal snga spyan snga snga sor sngon/ /gsang sngags sngags pa mdog sngon jo/ /snga dro sngas la spur ba che/ /snga dus skyo sngogs mon sran rje'u/ /snga pyi spun du sngo bar byed/ /mtshang nas sngog sogs sar btags nga'o/ /bzam yang bzams nas btsas ma bzas/ /bud med badz+ra da dang jon bas bzod/ /zab bzubs bas 'phul rar btags nga'o/ /rtsag mi

bsngal bstod bsngags bsngo bas bsngos/ /dam bar bsngos dab bdag pa sogs/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan ba'i nga'o/ /(ca3 ci spad ci pyir ldan ba'i can/ /bdag cag sbyi cerasum cu dab / /drug cu nga na cu brgyad cu dmas/ /lhan cig thabs cig skad cig tsam/ /khyed cag sems can yod do chog /can cer cab cob zang rtso re/ /ha cab cas cus bab col mang / /ci ste cung zad pyin ci log /cang shes cig thos ci nas kyang / /zu to'i thor chog chod ban dab / /rgya cab be con lha zasmos/ /ca rtso'i cal col sku cor dang / /cho 'dri cig car cam gyis 'jog /rtsog lur car re mig ce re/ /lan cig cis kung cir mi rtog /kha cig cang mi shes kyang cong / /cang dang cang te'u ci yang bzung / /cu gang cung zhi cur das za/ /ce sprung zag cas ci zhig bya/ /rtsog rtser tho rtsos cub seng za/ /ci ga la sogs ca rkyab ngo / /gros gcom gcong nad gcad bya gcod/ /khon gcugs yid gcugs gcen dab bcub / /gcud bor lag gcus gcur zhing gcun/ /dam gcod yongs gcod zhal lce gcod/ /gcong rong gcong skad gcin gci ba/ /gcod bshin gces med gcig gis gcig /gcam bu kha gcang bcugs med gces/ /tshar gcod gcu gal yid la gcags/ /sgra gcan gcan gzan la gcan pa/ /gcig rtu gcal bkram grangs kyi gcig /ro gcig zas gcig gcer bu gcog /gci'u'i sman sogs gas 'phul ca'o/ /bcom ldan dgra bcom bcas pas bcags/ /dam bca' khrims bca' bcing bas bcings/ /shing 10

bcad blan bcir bca' yos bcem/ /tshigs bcad bca' gzhi bstan ba chos bcab / /logs bcar bca' sha bza' bca'i bcud/ /mig bcar pyir bcil chu bcur bcug /nor bcal lag bcangs zags bcag brtsol/ /bcar ba'i rtar bcibs zhal lce bcad/ /tshar bcad blos bcal bcas rab bcabs/ /rdo bcag shing bcer gros bcam bcum/ /bcu dab bzhi bcu lnga bcu dab / /dgu bcu brtso lnga brtso brgyad brtsos/ /brtsos bu'i ras sogs bas 'phul ca'o/ /mnyen snag lhag zan lhab ma'i lhag /mgo rtsogs ches lci blo yis rtsogs /gnam lhags rgyuda'abab me lcer lceb/ /lcab lo can gyi lhags ri'i rtsog /nya gyibs zal rtsob lhang ka'i lce/ /re'u lhag lha ba lcam ba spyam/ /lag gyibs tsha lcibs sgo lcibs dang / /spyan lcibs lcam dram za'i lcang lo/ /lci ba lhag pod spus lhag lcig /mig 'byu gyibs sogs lar btags ca'o/ /(bka chem chem zal chil chos chu'i zar/ /zags zal chog shes cho ga'i ched/ /go za mtshon za'i cha lugs chos1 /byab chub bar zad zam la phob/ /rin chen chun po zabs cig chur/ /chu zheb za mnyam chem me ba/ /mibs ba za de mibs la chogs1 /srog zags zag zag zal mar bdal/ /cho los che ge'i za rkyen bad/ /zad pas chod la chung ma chol/ /zab chems che chub thugs su chud/ /ma bar zags zags chogs mir gyis chir/ /zab 'oshachom rkun ches cher chun/ /choms shig mings kag zab sgo chog tshar chod thag chod zab 'og chug 1za cho ma chod med sa/ /11

zan zab 'bras zan zab nas chus/ /za lang mal za che zhe'i zas/ /cho rigs chud zas cham pa'i nad/ /zab shog kha chems zig rkyang chong / /bag zag cho 'phrul cho re 'don/ /cha ga pa sogs za rkyang ngo / /mchog rtu skyabs mchi dkon mchog mchod/ /mchis mal mchil lham mchig mchig gu/ /sku mched mtshan gyi mchis zab mchor/ /mchi ma mchil ma mcher ba mchin/ /zhal mchur kha mchu'i bsa' mchid mtshis/ /skye mched mchib bu rgya mtsho'i mchib / /rtsa mchog me mched mchil pa'i mchobs/ /gzhu mchog sgyu ma'i mtshan bu mtshan/ /mchil pa mchims sogs mas 'phul cha'o/ /chos 'chad khrims 'am 'a 'chag sar 'chag /tshul 'chos gar 'am mas spog 'chad 'chi/ 'chums pa'i gnas 'am 'a 'chel sar 'chun/ /'chal ba'i 'am ra sgo mi 'chags 'chab/ /nyi 'char chu 'chor las 'chol 'chun/ /gros 'choms khas 'che 'ching zhags 'am ba / /'chol dab 'chus sogs 'as 'phul cha'o/ /(ja) ji lha ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs/ /ji ltar ji srid ji skad smra1 /jo jo'i jo mo rngo bo'i ja/ /rje zhig zag pa nu po 'phangs/ /ja hob ja ril je mthor song / /je dang je sogs za rkyab ngo / /mar la 'phrad mjing pa mjug ma mje/ /mi mjed zhing sogs mas 'phul za'o/ /'jag ma 'ji ba 'jim pa 'jags/ /'jig rten 'jig pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms/ /'jus nas sha 'jog 'jar nas 'jabs/ /'ja' zhing 'jungs pa'i skyon 'jil 'jem/ /'ju ba khrag 'jib zas 'ju 'jab / /12

'dud mthun 'jol 'jol 'jo sgog 'jog /'jor bu dbyibs 'dang 'jur zhing 'jun/ /lus 'jam 'jog po mtsho 'jib 'jug /'jam dbyabs snyan 'jebs mnyam par 'jog /blos 'jal tshad 'jal 'dod pa 'jo/ /khrims 'jags 'ja' sa 'ja' mo dang / /'ja' bdeg 'ja' tshon srad bu'i 'jur/ /spod 'jing sha 'jums rtsa 'jing gnyen/ /thob kyis 'jal sogs 'as 'phul za'o/ /rje btsun rjes 'jug rdo rje'i rjes/ /rje dpon lha rje rjed pa'i 'os/ /sa rjen sha rjen rje ngar spud/ /tshud byed snying rje lag rjes dab / /thugs rjes rjes bskyangs rje'u'i rigs/ /nyal gyi ji nga sogs rar btags ja'o/ /brjed bas brjed byed gzi brjod brjid/ /brje brjes ma brjed brjod bya brngod/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ja'o/ /yul ljongs ljang bu'i ljan ldin khrod/ /ljon shib ldid lci sman smongs ljang / /ro 'dzin ldag sogs lar btags za'o/ /(nya) nyams rtogs nying khu nyag gcig nyab/ /nya ma nyag mo nyes 'gyur nyung / /spu nyag nyal nyil nya lto pa/ /nyam nyes nyon mongs nyam ngar nye/ /nying sha'i nyod pa nyes 'byub nyen/ /nyam chung nyam thag nyin mtshan nyal/ /nyams dga'i nying dgos nye bar nyon/ /spos nyug lag nyas nyan thos nyams/ /pho nya nyi ma'i nyen kor du/ /nya sha nya ga nyi shu nyos/ /nying tor chu nyog nye reg nyab / /nye gnas nyug rum nyan da nyid/ /nyag phran nya rgyas nya rkyang ngo / /dngu ba gnyen bshes gnyen gnyis kyi gnyen/ /gnya' shing gnyer pa khro gnyer dab / /bka' gnyan gnyan nad 13

dud snyed gro gnyan/ /gnya' bo don gnyer ba nyan gnyags gnyos/ /gnyid kyi gnyen por gnya' lhag gnyul/ /gnyi gzer gnyig tu lus gnyong chung / /gnya' rengs gnye ma nyag por gnyeg /gnyug ma'i don sogs gas 'phul nya'o/ /mnyan pa thugs mnyes da bas mnyan/ /mnyed mnyes 'ing mnyen mnyan yod gnas/ /mnyam gzhag mnyam med mtshungs pa'i ba mnyam/ /ra mnye mnyes gshin mas 'phul nya'o/ /'dam stog rnyed bkur gsar rnyib snyed/ /so rnyil rnyang ma rnyob dang rnyi/ /lcang rnyid ma stog ba rnyil/ /kang pa snyob sogs rar btags nya'o/ /go snyod snying po snyid mo'i snying / /spu stol zang sgol snye phung snyil/ /tha snyad ji snyed de snyed snyam/ /snyems dang snun med snyan shal snyi/ /stom 'jug btang stoms snyom las dang / /bsod snyoms sprugs thrangs snyeg sar stob/sa/ /snying rje'i snyim pa stobs la snyes/ /snyon mobs snyad 'dogs rgyal mtshan sgol/ /gtam snyan snyigs dus skud pa sgod/ /snyab sgogs sems snyoms sar btaṭa nya'o/ /gzugs brnyan sgra brnyan gzhan la bsnyas/ /mnga' brnyes phyag brnyan brnyan po'i brnyas/ /go/sa brnyings kha bsnyogs snab brnyan brnyang / /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i nya'o/ /dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas bsnyen rjogs bsten/ /bsgon can bsgon dor bsnyor hol dang / /bsnyen bzab bsnyen bkur phre mar bsnyil/ /gtam bsnyad bsnyams nas lag pa ba'i la/ /phyir bsnyil mal bsnyal ci ba bzed bsnyigs/ /lag bsnyabs ba'i ba gzhis ba'i na bas bsnyengs/ /bsnyel med nas bsgor yo byad 14

ba'i bas/ /bsnyen sprung zas bsnyod ji gab ba'i ga /bsnyems pa'i rjes bsnyegs khro gnyer bsnyer/ /bas 'phul sa mgro ldan pa'i nya'o/ /(ta) te por te ser tal mar sob / /dz+wa ti rtang kun tig ta til/ /tug tug tong tong tog tog sgra/ /tel pa tog rtse dbyug to dab / /gtsug tor thor tor sbyi tor tog /mu teg me tog ba la/ /lo tog rtsi tog za ma tog /ting 'dzin dkon mchog ta la la/ /nyab lo tal tsam teg tig med/ /yon tan zhabs tog nan tan dang / /nan tur gal te go'u ta ma/ /kha ton zhal ta nan tar bzang / /ta zig ta mib ta'i si nu/ /ti zi ta dben ta byub dar / /tā ra ṇa dab te'u shang khri/ /tam bya ra dab nyang tib shag /nyo nya ta la tres sam dang / /shang shang te'u te te brdung / /'on tang ling tog ta rkyab ngo / / gtan gyi bsam ga rtan gtan tshigs gtam/ /gnun bu lag gtad gtun shib gtubs/ /brdub gtag gtong dang gtang rag gtang / /gter mdzod yongs gtams gtor zan gtor/ /nor gyi gta' ma gteng pa gta'/ /gtan pa med pa'i sbyin gtong gtab / /gtum po'i zhabs gtugs zad pa'i gtugs/ /lha chen gtogs 'dod gzhan la gtod/ /'bem la gtod dab dmigs pa gtod/ /gti mug gtol med mtshang nas gtol/ /khrag gtar chu gtigs se gol gtogs/ /bcol ba'i gtams dang grangs kyi gtams/ /sgo gtan gting zab mun pa gtibs//gnur bu spos gtul ri bo'i gtos/ /mgo gtums mtha' gtu ṭa 16

khongs su gtogs/ /gtan la 'babs sogs gas 'phul ta'o/ /sgro btags ming btags kha btags btags/ /spyir btang blos btang sngags btu bcus/ /prol bstod gdan bting sa pon btab/ /btang bzung klus bteg gsol btab btud/ /btags so rgyas btab bza' btung bcub/ /spu btogs rtsa bston btags shing btul/ /mgrin pa bteg sogs bas 'phul ta'o/ /mi rtag rtab rtab dngang rtul rtags/ /mi hog yid rton rtog ldan rtogs/ /rtag tu rta la rte'u skyes rting / /rtol gog rting pa rtod pas bcings/ /ru rtas nyams chus gnas su stol/ /mong rtul rtul phod rten rter 'brel/ /mchod rten rta babs bya ma rta/ /rta thul rta dbyangs rtog ge pa/ /mi gtsang rtug sogs rar btags ta'o/ /ltos 'gro'i ltag pa de lta bu/ /lto 'phye'i lte bar lhad mo lha/ /lto ba rtso yis lter gyis bkab / /bur ltang 'grang ltogs da lta ltos/ ltar snang lhag chod lha log gi /rtsang bas lhas ban lha ci smos/ /lteng rgyas steb ka ltem gyis gang / /re ltos lha zhog mda' yi ltong / /lhar lhar ltem rkyang lar btags ta'o/ /ston pa'i bzhugs stangs bkur ste stobs/ /stes dbang mu stegs byad stems kyis/ /mi sto lha stangs me stag stegs/ /sta gon stong grogs sha stag byed/ /gzhogs stegs stangs stabs sta zur ston/ /shing stag skug khrod stobs can stag /dgra sta sta re ste'u stor/ /star zhun star ga'i ston mo ster/ /stod la stan dab sku ma ston/ /ston dpyid gar stobs ya stags stong / /stim byed so stor stor khung dab / /stang zil stabs gcig star brgyus 16

steb / /stob pa stong nyid sar brtags ta'o/ /brtag dpyad gnas brtan kun brtags brtags/ /yid brtan brtad pa brtul zhugs brtan/ /sprubs brtol brtun nga sbyi brtol brtabs//yongs 'du sa brtol brtag pa brtul/ /brten pa la brten phur bus brtod/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /bltos sa bltos chos bltar rub ba lhas/ /bsta bya sku bltams gos bltab sogs/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan ba'i ta'o/ /bsti stang bskud ba'i bsti gnas bstar/ /thub bstan dang bskun bstod 'os bsten/ /bstang bas ma bzung bstan brtsos bstan/ /thag bstungs sna bstad 'gro zas bstad/ /bsting tshig bstims pas mi bstongs kyang / /bster med mngon bstod byin len bstabs//bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /(ba) thun mong thu za ba gru che/ /thu mi thor rtsog thor tshugs dang / /tha ma tha na jig jig sgra/ /thur dang tha mal tha rkyang ngo //mtho ris mab 'a dag mtha' klas mthong / /mas bar thug nus mthu mthun mi mthun/ /lag mthil mthe bong mthe'u chung / /mthon ga mthon mthing mthang gos mthug /mthar gyis rta mthur mtho gab mthud/ /mtho 'tshams mthol bshags mtho yor mtho/ /mthon po'i rgya mthongs mtha' 'khob mtha'/ /mthing ril mthing kha mas 'phul tha'o/ /'thab mor 'thon yang grogs su 'thams//sprin 'jibs chu 'thor 'thor 'thung dang / /blo 'thums mgo 'thoms du ba 'thul/ /sra 'thas 'thems nan nan rtan 'ban//chu 'thubs sha nas 'then zhib 'thog /smod tshig 'thing sgad 17

'then pa 'thad/ /zas la 'bu 'thus phye mar 'thag /zha 'pheb mal gos 'beb kyis 'thum/ /dum bur 'thub sogs 'as 'phul tha'o/ /(dke gzhan drang mi 'jog bka' drin dran/ /dril bu dri mchog dra dra phyed/ /snga dro phyi dro'i dri dris lan/ /drang don g.yung drung drang song drug /khrims dral lcam dral zas drangs drongs/ /drang po'i shing drub drel dre'u nog /mon dre smin drug ma dros mtsho/ /dreg nad dreg pa dre ma dang / /kha drag drag shul sa la drud1 /drod dang dro ba zan dron dril/ /dred lngags dras drubs dres mas drags/ /dred po dru bu'i dra bar drangs/ /dril bsgrags dra ma'i gnas su drongs/ /dregs pa drung pyung kha yi drog /mad drab dwa phrug dwa ba'i 'bru/ /thal ba'i drags sogs da rkyab ngo / /gdugs med gdong pa gdugs kyis gdungs/ /gdon ltang gdug pa'i gdol pa gdul/ /gdams bka gsal gdab gdang ba gdan/ /gdu bu gdang dang gdung mar gdas//gdung rus skab gdangs skas kyi gdang / /gdung brgyud gdung 'dzin gsol gdab gdon/ /gnyer gdams bcol gdams rnyed la gdu/ /mib gdags blun gdangs sa zan gdab/ /kha gdangs mtshon gdengs gdor mi za/ /da gdod sos gdal gdeb thob gda'/ /gdos pa thud bdar srang la gdeg /gdags pa'i bstan brtsas gdam nga byed/ /gdengs can gdul bya dam la gdags/ /khyab gdal gdod nas gdags gzhi zal//gdangs car kun ra gas 'phul da'o/ /bdag bden bdud 16

bdun mdun du bdar/ /bde bdo zas bda' bdug spos bdug/bda' ded bdag pos bda' zhing bdas/ /bde gshegs bde legs bden pa bdar/ /ga'u bdungs bdog ba'i skyel bdar bdog /bden gnyis bdud rtsi bye mar bdar/ /phyag bdar phyi bdar bas 'phul da'o/ /mda' mdung mde'u lam mdo'i mdos/ /mdun mdongs mdog mdangs mdor bsdus mdo/ /mdangs sang mdongs sol ra da' dang / /mdud pa la sogs mas 'phul da'o/ /spru ngan 'da' 'das 'dun pas 'dud/ /'dam khrod 'dur 'dur 'dong zhing 'dug /'dom dus rjes 'ded gsol 'debs 'don/ /lha 'dre shing 'drud khung bu 'dru/ /'du byed 'dus byas 'dres ma 'dra/ /'drul pa'i gtam 'dre yi ge 'dri/ /'drid cing khrims 'dral srog 'dor 'dar/ /'degs pa 'di 'dod 'dul bas 'dul/ /'dam bu'i 'dab mar 'dab zags 'du/ /ri 'dabs 'dol sar 'dag gu 'dag /blo 'drog zhabs 'dred 'drad cing 'drud/ /'drer pas chos 'doms dge 'dun 'dus/ /'do med 'doms su 'dom gang 'dogs/ /'dod zags 'du shes 'du 'dzir 'dres/ /'dreg mkhan 'deng pyir 'do rta 'dam/ /'das po'i 'dab kyis 'khor 'dabs 'dums/ /mib 'dogs chu 'dal skyo ma 'dal/ /'dag zal ko 'dun de ma 'drog /dri ma 'dag sogs 'as 'phul da'o/ /grong ral thog jib rdo rje'i rdul/ /rdo rde'u rdog po rdeg kyang zugs/ /nung 'tshog pheg rdob za lang rdob/ /blo deg rdab 'tshal lus rdos che/ /lag rdum blo rdol dbu ba rdos/ /gri rdor rdol chos rar 1mi

btags da'o/ /mkha' lding 'brug ldir ldab ldib skad/ /lda ldi lde mig yod pa'i ldan/ /mgo sgog lto ldir lngur ldur ldugs/ /seng ldeng ldem ldem lder bza'i ldebs/ /spyong ros ngad ldang lde gu byug/'jug sgog sgobs skyem phyer mi lhob /skom ldud me sde ming gi lde/ /sprum ra'i ldum bu ldab lhob dang / /bcom lda na ldem dgongs dres lan sdon/ /bskyar ldab nyis ldab lhag ma ldas/ /ldan ba'i so ldeb mig kung sgongs/ /ne'u ldab sgom bu stan sas ldab / /lngang tshad la sogs lar btags da'o/ /zhe sbang ldab mig ji gas mdzub rdzig /sdar ma bde ldus dge khyeg sgo ma/ /dngas kyi sdob po sgob bu'i sde/ /spog dang sdo zhing sde tshan sdeb/ /srog zags sgo ma sdig sder mo sna/ /sdom pa bsrung sgom sdod gnas sdod /sdeb sbyor mdzes spug nor sogs sdud/ /spum par mchod sdong sdom bus bskor/ /sder ma ri thug sgor lag pas sgom/ /bka' sgo da sde sgod sar btags da'i/ /gri brdar brdeg 'chos brtung bya brdungs/ /kha brdar bla brdol zal brdab bzabs/ /za brdung dza brdung gro byed brda/ /zal mar brdal nas brdul zhing brjeg /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i da'o/ /bldabs nas bldag pa bldeg cib bldad/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i da'o/ /brtsa bya bsdu bsdus bkar nas bsdad/ /nyes bsdams bsdoms nas srog dang bsdos//'og bsdogs nyer bsgogs gzhan la bsdigs/ /grogs dang bsdongs bsdebs sna thag bsdogs /'gal brtsam bas 'phul sar btags da'o/ /(na3 phan gnod gnas shabs gnang bkag gnad/ /20

gnod sbyin gnag phyugs gnam lhar gnag /gnas brtan nyer gnas gnas khang gnas/ /gnod byed zil gnon gna' mi gnubs/ /zhi gnas gnas 'gyur gnas lugs rtogs/ /gnabs gzhes gnam ru rkar pas gnon/ /zhe gnong gnad gcod gnas ngan men/ /gnod gnas la sogs gas 'phul na'o/ /mnal gzims mna' ma 'og byu mnan/ /mnab rtsal dri mnam mnar med mnar/ nar sems zas mnog mdag chung ba/ /mnol rigs mna' bang na bza' mnabs/ /mno nga ma mnos sogs mas 'phu' na'o/ /rnam sheg non po'i dal 'byor nams/ /rnam rtob dam grangs rnam pa mang / /da ga thog rtse rdo dal ma'i don/ /khug rda rdag khrag zhing dab ma/ /tshig zad dam par rar btags na'o/ /snar ma sbon sprubs snag tsha snur/ /snang ba sna tshogs sna yi snabs/ /snam bu'i snam sbyar snal ma'i sne/ /bar snang snang gsal snum dri smom/ /lam smar sna lo'i snag dpon snang / /ltar snang sna mang sprel zhi sbod/ /yug snam snam phran sna ma sne'u/ /sna da yar ser sna'i sbon mar sboms/ /rgyab kyi snam logs sar btags na'o/ /brnab sems lto la bzan yang brnabs/ /brnag dka'i brnab pas mdun du bzur/ /zas pa'i bdags dang res bzung brnan/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i na'o/ /gnad bsdun mtshon bsnan nu ma bstan/ /srol bsnubs gong 'og bsnor zhing bsnol/ /mtshon bsnams dus bsnur zhib mor bsnur//mjug bsnar dri bsnams nem nem bsnems/ /mab du bsnan nas 'dres par bsnos/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i na'o/ /21

(bke pab par par bu ba wab 'dzin/ /gcig pur bar gyis pa tra bris/ /lu shu'i lu shud pur gyis lur/ /puṇ+ḍa bhā ka spu bra lib / /pa ba pad+ma pa la sha/ /lus btsugs pog por ga lur 'thul/ /par ma'i po ti bsna ta/ /ze prog prog 'u 'og pag dang //lur khab ba ra tab po ṭa la/ /lu sa la dang pu shel rtse/ /ba sabs za phab spru bskya /pags pa lag pod po zos kyang / /par gyis 'phar sogs pa rkyang ngo / /dpag tshad rjes dpab dpag bya dpog /rgyal po'i dpya khral dpyang bag dpyangs/ /dpag med dmag dpub dpung bu chub / /dber na dpe byed dpe bya dpem/ /dam dpyod rtog dpyod brtag dpyad dab / /rje dpon blob dpon sems dang 'a che/ /dpyid dus dpral ba dpyi mgo dbyungs/ /shing nga da lung bcad da lung rgyan dang / /dar da zangs dpangs mtho dpag bsam shib / /dpa' bo dpa' ba'i dbab pos dpod/ /gso dpyad dpyis pyin dpyas mi 'dogs/ /dpal ldan dpang lo das 'phul pa'o/ /pha spad spun zla zang bya zangs/ /zang po'i spar mor za dbyug zad/ /spos rgyun spro spros longs spyod spyod/ /spang sngos spar spor spen spyil spro/ /spen hog spug gis spud pas spa/ /gnas zar bya spun gzhan du spags/ /mgo spu sprug sprugs zabs kyi sprun/ /spe'u'i gces spras spyad dngos spel/ /spa ma spru ma spra ba sprungs/ /spra zal spod dab zho thris zas/ /'thab mo sprad sprod spyos nas sprugs/ /sbyi sgos spel mar 'phrin sprub sprengs/ /sprun sprul spob ba spongs spyod pa/ tshur spyon dka' sprud chos spyod spor/ /spros zal spul pa gza' spen pa/ /gos spo 22

chur sbyibs za tshil sbyin/ /khe spogs spyab gi spra spre'u/ /spyab po'i spobs pas dge mi spyoms/ /spyi blugs kha spub rgyan gyis zas/ /sbyi bo rdul sprugs rdul gyi spabs/ /spyod pa za bkong ri yi spo/ /mig gi spyan sogs sar btags pa'o/ /stag lngags la sogs lar btags ba'o/ /(pha) phang par phun tshogs phun tshugs shing / /zug gu dab phrad zul phrar phra/ /brgya phrag phyab phrul phyal phyab nge / /phyug po'i phyir du phyogs bcur pyin/ /phyag dar pyi sa'i phye ma pye/ /phywa mkhan phongs pas pying rul phyar/ /phyi bdar gyis pyis phyags mas phyaṭa//nam byed byen gtong pyi rdo phang / /dbang phyug dbugs phyub sgo bye nas/ /phyags lham phran tshegs phreng ba phrogs/ /phra men thran las sa phyod che/ /phyugs kyi phru ma phye ma leb/ /phru ba'i phyir phyung phyag gis phyor/ /smin zag phyag 'tshal nyin mtshan phyad/ /phra ma phrag dog phrag pa phral/ /pyin zad yid phyung sun ci phyin/ /phyi 'brang pyir phyogs phyin ci log /mi pham tshib phrad rdam dbye pyed/ /phru ma phyar g.yeng pha rkyang ngo / /gzhan la 'phya 'phyas 'od 'phro 6'phros/ /pe ba 'phye bo dus 'dzi 'phyis/ /rda ma 'phrul ji 'drul mda' 'phen 'phangs/ /nam 'phang khri 'phang go 'phang 'phrog mtsho 'phyur dung 'phyur lam 'phyug 'phyugs /snyib 'phyo'i 'a ston mas ka' bar 'a phabs/ /'phongs kyi 'phag 'phag mgo zum 'phur/ /'phong gis gzhan 'pham 'phal ka 'grig /'phyan zhing 'phyo lding dar 'phyar 'phral/ /'khri na 'phrod 'chi 'phras sems la 'phreng / /'phral ba skra 'byungs phyag dar 'phyag /'phyang dang 'phye ba 'as ba

'phul pha'o/ /(bke za ma'i bla na bla pre bres/ /byams pas byad zur byabs pas byer/ /zer bye mas zabs pas byang / /zan g.yog byes byon byug pa byin/ /byis pas bya ra'i bya ba byos/ /bram ze zag ri'i byang du byol/ /bya byi'u byi ba byi la'i byad/ /byol song zang 'gro'i zang byil byil/ /bla gab bla gos blus kyang bla/ /blun po 'ang ma bying blo blong blob / /phro nad babs zal bro por bros/ /bya na mo'i byi bor rang byan chud/ /byag mkhan thra gar bye bas rjal/ /sos blad chu blud zas brims ba/ /bya na'i yo byad byur bur blugs/ /da byid ro thra za ba'i brun/ /dib brubs chu brug bru ba tsha/ /gos byed brtso blag gos kyis byibs/ /bla tshe byang bur ba bla zugs/ /khas blangs bla thabs sa blas khyer/ /blo bred bla dwags yi ger bris/ /spu byi za byad gzi byin bri/ /byi bzhin za nyer za bye byol/ /byug ris bya ba'i bye zag la/ /rgyal blon blo mig bde blag byed/ /blang dor blon 'debs bla bo la/ /rab byung za bregs da ba zags/ /lto gos zang breng bya dgar byin/ /sman bla byang chub bla na med/ /byin rlabs zu ru ba rkyang ngo / /dbyen dang dbye zal chos dbyings dbyibs/ /dbyer med dbu ma dbung dang dbus/ /ba gu dbyig pa da zug pa dbyugs/ /rdzing dpol chu dpo skar ma dbo/ /pyir dbyung sun dbyub mtshon gyis dbug /dbul pos dbugs dbyung nor mi dbrog /tshon dbyi dbyig mor dbyig dbyib dbur//dbon pos dbyangs dbul sma mi dbab/ /dbyig gnyen dbu la gdugs kyang dbub/ /dbab tre byin dbab gtan la dbab—1ྈ

lung dbog khur dbog dpen sar dbral/ /dbab phyug dbab ldanaXdabang zang dbyar/ /dbang po dbyig mang dprel dbyes che/ /dba' zlabs dbu ba skyon gyis dbags/ /dbre btsug kha dbri zhe sa'i dba'/ /dbal ni sha nyam rtse drod tog /zha nye'i dbyar 'dab das 'phul ba'o/ /rab 'byams 'byams zas 'byung bzhi 'drug /'bral med dang 'brel 'bras bu 'dru/ /'brib po 'dam 'bying 'drum nad 'byang / /'brog gi 'bri 'brong rus kyi 'brom//'byung 'gyur tshe 'byid 'drid pa'i 'byid/ /za 'bal 'bel gtam sgo 'bye 'byed/ /'bras zan lces 'byog chang 'a byo 'byabs//'brom ston 'byon dus 'bros shing 'brang / /'grub khung kha 'byed 'byol zhib 'byer/ /mtshang 'gru'i tshig 'byin tshon 'byug 'byobs/ /kha dbri chu 'drub sprur ba'i 'byar/ /'byung po'i 'byor ba 'as 'phul ba'o/ /khyi zad zab sgril kha zad che/ /nad kyi skya zab za zad zod/ /jod ma skyel sogs rar brtags ba'o/ /spu ba lnga ba 'a ra btags ba'o/ /nor sbyin gnod sbyin sbyin bdag thron//spun pa sbangs dang sbang mas sbabs/ /spru ga nu nor sba zas spos sped/ /nyis zag za 'bubs sprul nas sbyar/ /sbres nas spur mar me sbar zor/ /chus sprus zas spru sa lhogs gcig sboms/ /sprum ma lto spos srog zags sbre/ /zag sbal grog spur sbal pa sprul/ /grogs zan srungs sped sprud pa'i spubs/ /sbyig mor sbyig cing spe ga spyor//sbyag tshe lus sprud za 'bar zo ma/ /sha sbrang zang ma sgang dang sbrags//nga nga ma ma /smyo dang /zo 'byesbad byad gsar zam sa la sbram/ / ra ba sbyang bya 4nga da sprubs/ /dge rjob gso spyong gtsang za sbyor/ /'doms kyi sba ba 26

sar btags ba'o/ / /da bka /rdo /spru 'jim myags chu ga ga nags chu la byur/ /nyams nga khyu ku'i ro myang rbos / /myab 'das myang myang chu ga myug dang / mya ngan mya ngam ma rkyang ngo / /dmag bo nyes dmigs dmangs rigs dman/ /dme po dmus lob dmigs bu med/ /dmu rgod dmu chu 'dre srin dmu/ /blo dmun dkus byung bu ga'i dmig /gtsang dme 'dzum dmul dmigs pa gtod/ /lag dmar kha dmar kha dog dmar/ /nyams dmas dmod btsugs dmod pa 'dor/ /da myal ba gnas dma' dmig ba/ bas la dab / /sprug byu ga dmyugs sogs das 'phu' ma'o/ /rmad zung tshugs 'dzin rki lam rmis/ /rmang nas rmo mos zon dor dang / /rmongs rmugs khyis rmur tshugs pa'i rma/ /rmen pa rta rmig sga yi rmed/ /zongs bu rmeg med sun pa'i rmus/ /ser rme bsris rme ja mtshar rmad/ /rmo mo bas rmel dris pa'i rmas/ /rma bya khams rmya za rngung byed/ /rjag dang dbu zog rar btags ma'o/ /sman dang sman pa'i gtam spra sbos/ /smig rgyu smag rum zang min smar/ /sman ljobs sug smel spug shad dab / /sprug ma thru gu thrug ma smin/ /tshe smad sma phab smad ras smod/ /mgo sprub smrang dang smre sngabs spras/ /bu zad mi nga smos spun ka byed/ /ngur smrib dam smin smos ci dgos/ /sprung gnas dus sprur stson pa smyo/ /smon 'drin dre med smon lam sman/ /khrin drug smal po smin drug bu/ /sbe ba sprug rtsi ba dog sprug /sma ra thin ma sme sha can/ /cis kyi sme ba sar btags ma'o/ /(bka tsab tsob mi bya tsog cog pu/ /tsan dan byu ta tsam pa 26

lo /tsa ko ra dang byu ti mo/ /ne rtso de tsam de tsug lags/ /rtse je rtse re tsa ri ba/ /tsā ru'i bza' ba tsa na ka /tsug tsug sgra sogs tsa rkyang ngo / /gtsug hor spyi gtsug gtsang khang gtsab / /mi gtsigs spyod pa gtsug lag khang / /ga rtsod rus gces shing brtser bas gces/ /mche gcigs gtsub shing ga tsub gtan gtsubs/ /ga tsho bo gsags tshe gtsag bus gtsag /gtsab phyogs gtsang chu gas 'phul tsa'o/ /btsan po bka' btsan rdzong btsan dang / /btsun mor bu btsas gru btsas btsal/ /btsun pa mig btsums ba tshon rar brtsod/ /brtsong btsugs btsags brtsongs brtsod btso brtsos/ /gos brtsems btsag dang brtsod kyis bzas/ /btsan dug tshags kyis btsabs shing bcir/ /btsas khyer 'bags btsog bza blab mkhan/ /mtho btsams rdeg btsog btsog po jeg/btsan rgod btsan thabs gser brtso ma/ /da la brtsogs shing brtsogs sgog bzab bzangs/ /btsad po btsas ma bas 'phul tsa'o/ /rtsa lag rtsa rtse tshon rtsi rtsing / /rtsi mar rtse shing rtsi thog rtsa/ /'thang rtsod rtsed mo rtse rtses rtsen/ /lngas rtsen sum rtsen rtsis rtsis mkhan/ /rtsib ma'i rtsa rgyus rtsid pa rtsab/ /kha rtsang rtse rgod rtsam rin rtseg /rtsabs gcod rtsad gcod tsher ma'i rtsab / /stobs rtsal 'bad rtsol rtsom pa rtsom/ /zho rtsabs rtsab mo ser— za'i gos/ /rtsig pa rtsig mkhan 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /rtsangs pa srog rtsol rar btaṭa ‘tsa'o/ /bka' rgyol dngos grub stsal dab rtsol/ /sbyin pa srul bgyi bgyid du stsal/ /srul du gsol sogs sar btags tsa'o/ /brtson 'grus snying brtse brtse ba can/ /brtsad cing dres nas brtsam bya 37

brtsams/ /bab brtsegs brtsigs shib brtsi bya brtses /so brtse ba cang brtsengs pa'i gos/ /bas 'phul ra mgro ldan pa'i tsa bo1 /(tshad nags tshal skyed tshal tshi gu'i migs/ /chos sa pa'i sde tshan lus lang tsho/ /tshon zu phra chom tshar du dngar/ /be chom tsham zams 'ju byed tshwa/ /lang pa'i tshoms sogs tsha rkyang ngo / /ngo mtshaྈ mtshan dpe mtsho dang mtshe'u/ /mtshe ma mtshams bcad ma na bzhi dang / /mtshan nyid mtshon bya mtshan ma ba mtshan/ /phyogs mtshams skyon mtshang mtshan mo mtshon/ /ma chur ston ba mtshul mtshal dang mtshungs/ /rgyal mtshan mtsha' mes rta ma tsha' lu/ /mtshar sprug khyem mtshes mtshe dang mtshan/ /mtsham sa med 'a mtsher dur mtshed mtshun/ /mtshon cha'i phyag mtshan mtshog mar 'phyar /mib gi mtshan sogs mas 'phul tsha'o/ /blo 'tshabs chu 'tshag nang du 'tshangs/ /til 'tshir mes 'tshig du ba 'chubs/ /zas 'tshed lus 6da tsho 'tsho byed 'tshengs/ /'tshe med 'tshag bzang 'tshal ma 'tshal/ /nor 'tshol phyugs 'tsho 'tshog chas 'tshong / /brdeg 'tshog bal 'tsho 'od 'tsher 'ib / /blo dang 'tsham par skyin pa 'tshab/ gdung 'tshob 'tshang rgya lobs pa'i 'tshar/ /phyag 'tshal shes dang chog pa'i 'tshal/ /'dzom pa'i 'tshag pogs 'as 'a phul tsha'o/ /(dzad dza rag dza lang dza bo shing / /dza ya can sags dza rkyab ngo / /dpa' mdzangs mdza' po'i bang mdzod mdzes/ /gnod mdzes nga ba mo mjid spu dkar/ /mdzo rta'i mdzer ba mdze nad dang / /mjol bu bsrung ba'i nga da ba mdzod/ /ya rab ba/ 28

mdzabs sogs mas 'phul za'o/ /'dzibs pas rgas 'dzar lag pas 'dzin/ /'dzag dang 'dzir ba'i snod 'dzed 'dzem/ /'dzur zhing sgor 'dzul 'tsheg skas 'dzugs/ /bzhin 'dzum 'dzin pa smyod du 'dzud/ /'dzam glib du 'dzom nor 'dzangs 'dzad/ /'dzab bzlas skad 'dzer nor ba'i 'dzol/ /'du 'dzi chud 'dza' rdo yi 'dzeng / /'khyegs pa'i 'dzag 'dzog 'as 'phur dza'o/ /kun rjob rdzun gyi job rdzub dang / /phyugs dzi'i rjongs su ji'u byin/ /rjing bur rdzus skyes 'dam rdzang rdzogs/ /ji sbogs jo ma'i bu rdzi dang / /rdzi med rdzi ma zin ba'i jogs/ /mkhar rtsong nor zas rdzu 'phrul dang / /rtsogs sangs rgyas sogs rar btags dza'o/ /gzhan pyis mi brdzi khro bor brdzus/ /ral pa gyen brjes spog zags brdzis/ /zan brdzis yul gzhan brdzangs pa sogs/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i dza'o/ /(bka wa skyes pha wang chu'i wa kha/ /'gi'u wab po wang 'dzum wang zang / /yid la wal le wang long dang 1 /wa ta yug sogs wa rkyang ngo / /(zha) zha po'i zhwa mo zha rkyab ngo / mnyam gzhag gzhal bya gzhal med khang / /kun gzhi rnam gzhag mam gzhag gtan/ /gzhon nu gzhung bzang gzha' tshon ga'u/ /gzhogs slo nga bdud gzhom spo gzhogs kung / /gnas gzhi gzhong pa ga yang gzhi gzhan/ /mngag gzhug khu ba gzhib la gzhol/ /gzha' gsab gzhongs su lhag gis gzhu/ /gzhi grub gzhung lugs brtag gzhig gzhug /gzhogs kyi nad gzhi gzhang 'drum bzhil/ /gzhar yab 29

gzhom med yid gzhungs gzhob/ /gzhis ka za gzhas 'tsho zhingasnye—gzhes/ /dram ba nyer gzhag bsgri gas pa'i gzhibs/ /bgen bskul nab gzhug gas 'phul zha'o/ /bzhag zin bzhad bad bzhad bkar ba'i// /bzhabs ras bo bzhar bzhams bsgo byed/ /gso la bzhi'i dgongs bzheb de bzhin nyid/ /bzhengs bzhugs 'byon bkud bzhon pa zhon/ /ba sho ma ma bzho bzhos brlan bzha' bzhogs/ /gzag bkun mar bzhu bkar nas bzhes/ /bzhin ras me bzhe gro byi bcin/ /'ji/bzhin khur bzhes dpang che bzhi//bzhi mnyam bzab/ sog sa bas 'phul zha'o/ /(zad zwa tshod mi zad gzhan la blo//sngags blos zlos gar zla ba zum/ /zla gam zlas da bye zlo ga pa dang / /zla grogs lo zla mya ngan blo/ /bskyar ba'i blos kags za nyid do/ /gcan gzan gzig gi gzugs brnyan ga zigs/ /gza' skar 'od bzer gzi brjid gzi/ /rdul gzan phrag par gzed cing gzar/ /ga thong gis gzer la gzer tsa gzugs/ /gzegs ma gzegs zan gzir bar gzas/ /da ga thod dren gzo chud mi gzon/ /gzu lums gzung 'dzin gzeg za chub / /zug gzer la gzem gzim mal gzud/ /gza ma tsher ma gzang rib gzan/ /gru gzings sha gzug zas kyi gzan/ /pying gzar gzar bu dgang drugs gzar/ /gzengs bsto da gze dngas gzad ma'i dus/ /ri gzar gzuṭa med byi dur gzugs/ /gzar thag gzungs zag gzabs kyang gzags/ /gzungs spobs gzungs sngags thugs gzu bo/ /bsgo ba da gzon gas 'phul za'o/ /bza' ba bza' bzas bud med

bza'/ /bza' mi bzi zhing ma ba'i gas kyang / /na bza'i kyi bzang po lag pas bzung / /bzo bos lha nga bzed bzed zhal bzed/ 1bze chub mi bzad las la bzur/ /bzod ba chogs bzums sngags bzla bzlas/ /mi bzlog g.yul bzlog chubang da bzla1 /gcig byu brtsams sogs bas 'phul za'o/ /(ya) yi rang yi zad yi dwags dang / /dma' yab ba yang ya rkyab ngo / /g.yor mo g.yo g.yos g.ya ba mo g.yabs/ /g.yong po g.yur za g.yan pa dgab/ /g.yang sa mi g.yo gsung drub bsab //g.yel med g.yur za zas g.yo g.yos/ /g.yang gzhi gdag gsoṭa ba yer mas g.yigs/ /g.yi zag ba g.yar nas g.yab g.yug g.yob/ /g.yon ma log g.ye ma g.yong bas g.yengs/ /g.ya' thog skyi g.ya' lhags g.ya' g.yu/ /g.yub mo ga'o sgyu gnas bag ba ya ga/g.yas g.yon g.yul sprod g.yul las g.yog /mig g.yor kha g.yal g.yar ngo tsha/ /g.yar khral ga yar dam g.yar khams dang / /snang g.yel g.yer kha gas 'phul ya'o/ /(raka ra lug rwa co rdul du blog /mngon blom blom sems byin blabs chobs/ /blon pa rlag byed 'doms kyi drig /rlabs chen dba' zabs rlabs pa rlub / /rlam khyer khrag rlangs zan blon zab / /rlag mo drugs pa khung bu'i drubs/ /dud 'gro'i rmid bu bas 'phul med/ /bcom brlag tshig bzang brlag bya brlag/brla sha chus bzan ya ma brla/ /blo bzag brtan ba'i ba byin kyis brlabs/ /gdon gyis brlams sogs bas 'phul—bla'o/ /(la) lu no gos kyi bye zag yin/ /31

(shad shar gyi shib khar shang shang 'i//shul du shid zan stel rgya shubs/ /shed bu shed bdag shed las skyes/ /shun lpags sham thabs shur bus bcibs/ shes ldan shin tu shub bur smra/ /shan pa shwa 'od sha rkyang ngo / /bde gshegs gshis lugs de bzhin gzhegs/ /gshin po'i gshags 'byed gshin rje gshed/ /gshen rabs gshang dkrol dbu bo gshor/ /gshis ngan ba/yu la gcom gshung dang gshe/ /mo gsham gsha' ma yin du gsha'/ /gshor gyis chu gsho shing gshog gshags/ /thong gshol gsheg cing 'dab gshog gshibs/ /brlan gsher bres gshor 'phrang la gshor/ /gsham gyi spang gshongs zhing sa gshin/ /gshong bu la sogs gas 'phul sha'o/ /mdza' bshes dge bshes lha bcos bshams/ /sdig bshags phyi bshol bshul lam bshar / /btsam bshums bshal drud bshud nas bshags/ /bsha' tshe btsun bza/'a ri dwabs bshar/ /rgyab bshul pags bshus bshan pas bshas/ mer bshur chus bsal bshang gci bsho/ /mkhar bshig pres bshar 'phrab la bshar/ /spubs bshangs dpe bshad bas 'phul shad/ /nga 〈pe cad dab khrod so tshul cad nga nga —sa sangs rgyas ra san //sal lhan sal sal sa mo do/ /tshe spog srung zhing 'od srung sras/ /thrad par drang srong srol tshugs bri da/ /spod dus sa spos gre nag srab/ /srin po lus srul sa srung bu/ /spubs kyi lam srang thrad du phibs /yid spubs kyis sreg sring mor sred/ /sru mo'i gri 'u sri'u'i sri/ /sre mo greg pa thran bya sram/ /srin bu sro ma sra da bu sra/ /ji srid de srid sran ma 32

spus/ /bsten sring speg byed speg glugs dab / /rgyal bridaXskun sribs rta yi srab/ /srub shib spub bag 'ar la byed srab / /blob dpon blob ma blob gnyer za/ /spob ba blo mar spong mo blob / /spe ba gyen blong blog kyab speb/ /spe tres spu ku'i chu spa mo/ /kun slong spe yon bsad pa'i blo/ /spar zhing spar mang spu med spad/ /spe'u blog pa pyi nang slog /sla ba'i spad rol phyogs su blon/ /spad mar spad nas dug ro blob / /sra brkyang btib sogs sa nyid do/ /gsar bu gsar nas 'khar gsil gsor/ /kha gsag gsog gsob gsad bya gsod/ /gsang sngags snyan gsan gsub rab gsungs/ /gsong po'i tshig gsol gsol 'debs gson/ /gser mdog je'u gsib gseg ma'i gseb/ /gse dab gsa' yis gsag gsir te/ /shing gsom gsor gyis gsil zhing gses/ /gsas mo gsog 'jog gsab gtam gsob / /gso ras spu gsed gseng gi gsur/ /gsus pa gso phyir gsol mab gsud/ /so gsod lus gsig dril gsil7gsum/ /skad gsang gseg gshang gseg ka li/ /gson po snyan gsab chud ma gson/ /'od gsal nang gses dri chu ga'i la/ /gsal shib chud gsan gas 'phul sa'o/ /sngo bsangs 'bags bsabs tshogs bsag bsags/ /dmigs bsal skyon bsal bsam bya bsams/ /bse khrab bsod nams bsod stoms bsogs/ /tshe bsrib bsam blo drin bsab bsabs/ /yo bsrang nor ba sridang bkar bzibs/ /dri bsung gis bsus bse ru bsad/ /bgrubs pa bzang bya bgreg bya brjags/ /bzod bsran bgro khab zho bsrubs bsres/ /33

bzad pa'i zas bsrel rib bgrel bzangs/ /bya ba'i bsral dang sgrib pa bsra bas/ /bsel ba'i bso za ngal bsos bu/ /kha bsum rjes bsubs bser bu bsil/ /lha bsangs me bsangs skyo bsangs dang / /blo bsrun bsam bse'u sba bgris med / /bsab gtor zhabs bsil zhal bsil badz+ra/ /bzad bya bzad nas bslu bya bslus/ /bzang bya'i nor bzangs phyogs su bslan/ /bslab bya bslab pa gyen du bzangs/ /'dod pa'i bsod nyams bas 'phul sa'o/ /(ha) hral hral grul grul mig hrog grig /hwa shab hwabs dang phos kyi hwa/ /rtsab hral la sogs ha nyid do/ /(a) ya ka ru dang ya ru ra//yu ba ra ub la/ /o rgyan u ma bza rnyil//shib thog ya za ye la'i 'dab//e n+ya yan ya nyid do//pod kyi brda'i bye zag gsal bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes za ba las/ /sngon 'jug sogs yi ge'i spyor ba rgyas par bshad ba ste le'u dang po'o// //da ji dam dbye phrad la sogs/ /bces bsdus sil bur bstan pa las/ /thog mar rdam dbye drug pa yi/ /kyi sga gyi 'i yi dmas ni/ /da ba sa dang ra drag dag /thob mthar yidang ga ba gi /na ma ra la bzhi po gyi/ /mtha' rten med mthar 'i thob cing / /rkang pa skong tshe yi ste dper/ /khrod kyi rgyab kyi bams kyi zar/ /grur gyi zag gi byang gi phyogs/ /dpon gyi lam gyi bar gyi sar/ /gzhol gyi sa gzhi'i bdag je ji/ /'o 'u 'am gyi tsheg khyim yang / /tshe/nga pa skob mi skong gis dbye/ /bde 'o la sogs rdzogs tshig la/ 'o nyid sbyi 34

za 'a sogs pa'i/ /ming la ba gyed pha nyid do/ /mtha' cher can dang brtsegs pa dab / /gug kyed can mthar 'a mab 'a spab / /tshig phrad ga da ba'i rjes su/ /cing ces ce'o ce na cig /nga na ma 'a ra la dang / /mtha' rten med pa'i rjes dag tu/ /zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig /sa mthar kang she'o she ma dzig /na ra la gsum rjes su dzi/ /da drag thob phyir de gsum gyi/ /rjes su zhib sogs lnga thob kyang / /da drag res par thob pa der/ /cib sobs lnga po legs te dper/ /rtag cib rtog ces lhag ce'o/ /su 'dug ce na khrod 'dug cig /zud cib zad ches med ce'o/ /ci 'chad ce na chos shod cig /zab cing thob ces nub ce'o/ /gang rgyab ce na gri rgyob cig /byab zhing drang zhes 'byung zhe'o/ /gang bzung zhe na sems gzung zhig /snyan zhing 'dzin zhes dkon zhe'o/ /lha yin zhe na don zhig gnyer/ /'jam zhib ngoms zhes 'dzom zhe'o1 /dben nam zhe na nam zhig dben/ /dga' zhing bza' zhes gda' zhe'o//du gda' zhe na 'ga' zhig go /dar zhing 'phyur zhes 'gyur zhe'o/ /ci 'phyar zhe na dar phyor zhig /'tshol zhib 'am la zhes 'khyel zhe'o/ /gab chol zhe na chos tshol 'il /za zhing bde zhes spro zhe'o/ /ye smra zhe na ma spru zhig /'dus shib 'bral bar res she'o/ /ci res zhe na gtam sbos shig /mkhyen cing 'phral ces brgyan ce'o/ /cis grol ce na grol gyur cig /dri dang rdzogs tshig skabs su ni/ /mtha' rter med dang 'a mthar 'a/ /mtha' rten gzhan mthar rang rab la'o/ /da drag can mthar ta ste dper/ /bde 'am bde'o dga' 'am dga'o/ /gyurd tam gyurd to lta bu'o/ /lhag ma can 36

spyo rte ste de/ /na ra la sa da drag gi /rjes su te rkyang da mthar de/ zheb ba ba ma 'a dab ji/ /mtha' rten med mthar sa ste dper/ /byon che bskor te nor btsal te/ /skyengs te grur rte don med de/ 1hog ste gtsang ste lhun grub ste/ /'dzom ste dga' ste sems bde ste/ /rnam dbye bdun ba la don gyi/ /nu du ru su'i 'bas kyu sna/ /ba ba da drag car mthar tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ sdis su mtha' rtem med pa dang / /'a mtha' ru ste dpe rim ba'i ba /rtag— tu rab rtse 'in tu dab / /steng du zod du rgyur du tho/ /lam du myur du 'jal du song / /rjes su 'di ru dga' ru chub /mtshams sgo sha kyang 'ang yang rdams ni/ /ga da ba sa nyid dang ni/ sa drag zab pa'i rje sa su kyang / /nga na ma 'a ra la yang / /mtha ba sna rten ba med mthar 'dza dang ji/ /rkab pa skob tshe yang ste da per/ bdab kyang 'bad kyang don grub kyab / /byas kung 'on kyang ma blung yang /byon yang nam yang 'ga' yab ni/ /slar yab mjal ba ba blo'ang bde yang / /mib ma ba'i pa ba'i dbye ba no/ /ga dman ba ma sa dang / /da drag can ma bar pa dang no/ /nga 'a ra 'a mtha' med mtha'i/ /ba phyed war 'bod rnams la ba/ /gzhan la pa nyeb sbyar rte dper/ /zag pa mer pa phan ba mchob /thob pa dam pa mabs pa ru/ /grur ba dang ba la dga' ba/ /myur bar mja(sha bar spro ba las/ /lub pa mda' pa'i 'byor pa yis/ /yul pa phu pa tshim sogs dpyad/ /gcod mtshams mtha' cen ga yi mthar/ /tshig shad ba yig ma gtogs pa'i/ /bad rgong rdams sga phyi cheg zang / /don mang bgrangs pa'i ming gi ni/ /mtshams dab don 'bring 36

'byed pa dang / /don nyub rdzogs tshig mtshams chig shad/ /tshibs su bcad pa'i rkab mtha' dang //lhag ba'i sne tshan rtsogs mtshams kyi/ /sna ru can ma bar nyis shad bya/ /sde tsham chen po rjogs mtshams dang / /me'u mtshams lha bur bshi shad thob/ /bod kyi bda'i ‘bye zag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i bag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba las/ /dam dbye dang phrad soṭa gces pa sna bka thun mong du bshad pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o/ /da ni 'phul dab mtha' rten mgo /med la spyor dab yod la spong / /gdam nga can la mtha' gcig sgyu/ /'dzin pa'i 'khrul spong cung zad bshad/ /za yab ge sar sil snyan dang / /mngon sum phun sum tshogs sogs la/ /gas 'phul nor ro gsha' ma dang / /gshags 'byed sogs la med na nor/ /sar ba lta lur gang yang rub / /skyil kung sogs la das 'phul med/ /dgung lo ma tshan dgub lob khrid kyi/ /dmigs bu sogs la med na nor/ /snyan dngags sogs la gang yang rung / /phyag dar lag dar gad mo dab / /bo shad sogs la bas 'phu spang / /bser bu skyo bsangs rgya mo bza'/ /pyi bdar sogs la med na nor/ /sngo sangs sta bur gab yang rung / /za gru tha ma tshar du dngar/ /tshon rtsi sogs la mas 'phul zang / /mthe po mtshe ma sngo zan mtshe/ /khrim mtshis sobs la med na nor/ /thun mob sogs la gang yang rung / /tshong dus khams dang tshogs pa tshoms/ /phra ma khon 'dzin khro po zos/ /rim gro za mo phongs pa dang / /phyug po sogs la 'as 'phul zang / /mtha' 'khob 'khri shing 'khur ba dab / /tshul 37

'chos sogs la mer na nor1 /zan las phreng sogs gang ya ba rung / /yi ge spru gu lu gu rgyud/ /ka kya zags la ga mtha' spab / /zag dog spug kur med na nor/ /ngu sa mo'i lha nga sba nga dang / /sgo nga sogs la nga mtha' rmur/ /yi dam yi rang li dwags dang / /thra khye sogs la da mtha' nor/ /rga cig lta bur gang yang rung / /se mo do la na mthab zang / /byan mo sta bur med na mor/ /lha btsun bza' bdung gdu bu dang / /le brgan sogs la ba mthar nor/ /rgya 'dre kha mchu ra mda' dab / /ra mnye na bza' rtsa mchog grong / /rgya mtsho sogs la ma mtha' nor/ /lha rje mdo rgyud nga rgyal can/ /bya jod rdo rje mtha' rten dang / /lha rten sogs la ra mtha' med/ /dur khrod mdor bsdus la med nor/ /bder gshegs sogs la gang yang rung / /slun gyi gsos sman kha dro dang / /grwa lnga sobs la la mtha' nor1 /rig sngags gsung rab mkhyen rab dang / /nam mkha' rgo 'phang khri 'phang mchog /bskyed rim rjogs rir 'du shes dang / /mkha' spyod sa spyod do shal 'phreng / /nyam chung nyam bag nyam ba ba/ /log rtog som nyi chom kun dab / /cho ga sogs 'a sa ba nor/ /lhas pyin klus byin gdams ngag sogs/ /mang po zhig la med na nor/ /dri bzangs rgyud mangs go rims dang / /'a/ ba los sgyur sogs gang lang rung / /klad sor stod kor gdub 'or dang / /pad kor ban sor 'od kor phreng / / 4 za sogs la sa ma bo/ med/ /dur smrib smig sprur med na nor / /yi ge 'al nya da lha dang / /la zags ba dad ces dmas la/ /bar cheg mi byed zun po'i lugs/ /de lhar mdo tsam bshad ba 'dis//38

mtshon nas shin nu rgya che'i gnas/ /rang rab dam dpyod rig pas dpyad/ /mtha' dag yi ger brjod mi lang / /bod kyi brda'i bye zag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan brtsos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba las/ /yi ge'i spyor ba la 'khyel pa spob ba bshad pa ste le'u gsum pa'o//deb sang byis pa'i skye bo rams/ /brda dab 'di ko lung riṭa kyis/ /dpyad gzhi chub zhib tshegs med du/ /shes snyam 'khyel pas mgo po mongs/ /kye ma zhes bya pha mtha' yas/ /de dag re re'i mib gi yang / /rgyu mtshan res tshig mi shes na/ /brda dag thrur ba ji lhar 'byub / /so so rig bzhi sa dgu pa/ /ma thob de srid chos kun gyi//res tshig zhes min de yi pyir/ /mtha' dag sdeb spyor su yis shes//'om kyang phyogs re'i brda dag kung / /'bad pa༄ mas btsal bar bya/ /yi ge'i spyor ba la 'khrul na/ /don dmas 'khrul ba smos ci dgos/ /'di no gsub rab ma lus ba 'i/ /pyi mor shes pas mkhas mang gi /ba la brten nas bdag gis kyab / /'di nyid kho nar nan tan byas/ /mkhas pa du mab mdzad pa yi/ /brda yi bstan brtsos grangs mang yang / /'ga' zhig tshig rgyas dgos don nyung / /'ga' zhig gnyis ka ha cang bsdus/ /'ga' zhig yig rnying dang mi mthun/ /'ga' zhib sum rtags sogs dab 'gal/ /de phyir tshig nyub dom rgyas pa'i/ /legs bshad 'di ba bdag gis byas/ /'di la rang bzo ma mchis te/ /tshad ldan gzhung la yab dag brten/ /gsar rnying brda dab rgya bod mad/ /la sogs zhib mor dpyad de bkod/ /stegs ma'i mi rdams ram 39

dbyod mig /phyogs lhang ling hog gis bsgribs nas/ /gzu bo'i blo lis regs bshad la /mi hog grabs pa'i rjes su 'a zang /mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma 'di ko legs bshad 'od zer sngong ldan mod/ /blo nor ldan yang rigs gzub/sa 'o ngas spyo da nyam chub bdag gis sprur ba'i pyir/ /rab rib blo ngan rnams kyis(spangs nas blun po 'khor mang 'byor ldan gyi/ /nyes bshad sri na bu'i kha yi 'od la mongs pa'i sprun pa sel phyir rgyug /bdag bos 'dir 'bad bsod nams dab / /bzur gnas blo sal don gnye ra pa/ /'ga' la 'di yis phan srid na/ /de yi dge ba byab chub bsngo/ /pod kyi brda'i bye zab/ gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/sdom brtson mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag byang pa 'tsho mdzad bza 'od zer ba'i gsung gis bskul te/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i snge zhes bya bas/ rdam 'phyang gi lo ba skar zla ba'i gral tshes ba lnga la sprun ras gzigs karma pa'i sgar chen du grub par bgyis pa'o/ /ma dka/ /40
sdusdo5 ma

dab/ /chos don nges tshig spobs pa'i gter/ /kun mkhyem sabs rgyas la btud nas/ /bsu nga rab 'jig rte na tshul la yab / /yi ge'i spyor bas 'jug pyir da bye/ /'dir bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos ngag sgron bshad pa la 'jug go /na sna sdod chu ya sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs zang da kyi brda sprod pa'i bye zag gsung rab las 'byung ba'i yi ge'i sbyor ba gsal zhing go bar byed pa mkhas pa'i gsung gi bsta na bcos tshigs su bcang nas tshig le'ur byas pa shes bya la mkhas pa'i ngag gi rang bzhin sgron ma lta bu zhes bya ba'am sgrog pa/ /yang dag pa phyin ci ma log bar bsung ba po gnyid sad pa ltar ma rig pa sangs shing pad+ma'i 'dab ma bye ba ltar shes bya ma lus par mkhyen pa'i ye shes khyab nas rgyas pa la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthong na skyes bu dam ngar mtshon pa mtshan bzab so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bzi byin gab/ka nga gser gyi ri bo 'dra ba'i sku long / /chod kyi phung po brgyad zi bzhi sto nga rtsol rto sha med par 'doms po chos kyi sdom bzhi sgrog byed lha 'i za chen po lta bu'i — gsung dang / /dza lta ji snyed kyi ye tre/sa rgya mtsho lha bu gting dang ma bar med pa ldan pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /thub pa yin la chen po ba pa nga yi na za lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bla ma de ba'i na gshegs ba ni tshang3/ pa la sogs pas kyang phyag mi bya ba 'jug ba 'i gnas yi ma no/ /dus gsu/ma gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa kun gyi mkhyen pa dang thub/sa brtse ba chen 'i gcig tu 43

spung ba pa'i lub po cig car dus mnyam du/ /skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa mtha' yas pa'i yid kyi na nu mkhar 'gog pa'am sgrib pa rmed par gsal ba'i gzugs can sgyu ma lta bu/ /'jig rten gyi phan pa dang bde ba'i 'od dkar po kun tu spro ba legs par bshad pa'i bsil zer mnga' ba can/ /'jam dbyangs 'gro ba'i mgon po spra ba'i zla ba mtshog tu gyur pa der gus pas 'dud de/ /ye shes kyi bdag nyid spru ma 'i mig 'phrul lta bu mdzes shing sdag pa'i sku la brten pa'i rnam 'gyur ༄yid 'jo khring sgog pa'i nyams dang / /rna ba'i yul gyi sgra dang dbyangs dpag tu med pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'byung gnas rgyud mang bsdun pa las byung ba'i sgra snyan cing 'gyur bag dang ldan pa'i khyad par gyis/ dag dul bya'i lhar la zag pa nyon mongs pa rme da pa'i bde ba ster ba mo lhag pa'i lhar gyur ba/ /dbyangs las byung ba can ma lha'i bu mos rab tu rnam dbyed kyi blo yi mchog dam pa sbyin par mjod cib/ /srong btsan sgam po'i sngon du med pa bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs brtsa mas shā1'i ngo mtshar du snang ba brda sprod rnam brgyad mdzad pa gsung rab bsgur ba la sogs pa'i/ /pa legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer brgya phrag gis rdo rje gdan gyi byab phyogs bod du grags pa chos med mun pa'i gling lta bu 'dir/ /shā kya thub pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che bsal bar ma zad pa po ba sbyod ṭa ste bod bzang po ba zad ba/ba pa/ /rgyud dang bdang da kyi da ba ba ba da che sa ba bka' drin dran nas rgyu ga ma ra la 'od/ /dpal khang pa bdag ni skyes thob kyi blo gros me no bar rtul zhing rig pa la sprungs pa'i ma bu chung bas rtsom pa'i rgyu dman pa ltar snang yang / /tshad ma dang lda na pa khungs ldan gyi mabs pa thu mi la sogs pa'i legs bshad ye ge'i sbyor ba 44

la brten nas/ /ngag gi 'khrul ba'i mun pa chen po drung rtsad nas 'byin pa go brda sprod byed kyi/ /bstan brtsos mkhas ba 'i ngag gi sgron ma rab tu gsal bar byed pa brtsam par bya'o/ /'dir brjod par bya ba'i don sdom du byed na tsā li ka phreng sum cu tham pal/ /rkyang pa 'phul dang mgo gsum med pa dang 'phul byed ga da ba ma 'a lnga gang rung can dang mgo la ra las gsum yod pa na dang / /dgrubs ba ro'i rnam po.a i u ye yo lnga can dang ma par la ba bzhi'i smad 'dogs nun dang / 1‘rjes su 'jug pa ga nga da na za ma 'a ra la sa bcu yang 'jug bcas ji ltar 'thob pa'i dpe dang sogs pa phrad rnam dbye'i sbyor ba dang 'khrul ba sgong tshul te rim pas bstan par bya'o/ /na/shes bya'i rnam pa kun mkhyen pa thams cad mkhyen pa shākya shing shā kar gnas pa'am phod pa nus ldan te ston pa'i rigs yin la mang bkur lpi rgyud ma che las sam 'phrin las ba / /ma/ zad mngar cha'i khyad pab ma tam da ras dkar zhig ka shi ka gsal ldan te yul dang de'i ras/ /nags klung shing nags mthug po chu klung gtsang po dang rgyug chu dba' klob chu rlabs sam glong 'khor sgro rje dud 'gro'i bye brag /ma/ bdod ma nas dab/ pa stong nyid blo ba yangs khong yangs pa'am rgya che ba klob du grur par don rtogs pa dang dbang du gyur pa/ /ka ku lha ya phyogs khyab ste shing zheb/ ka dpo tshogs can te chu skyar dang ming zhig /ka sha gsal byed de rtswa zhig dang rdeg pa ku na sar nyal te rtswa mchog ma/ che ba chu'i rgyan te pad+ma/ /bsnyed byim zhig gi me 46

tob/ dkar po ku mud sa mos sam sa dga' ste zla bas kha phye ba'i me tog dkar po ke za la ka shu ka rgya skyed ba shing yin zhe rtsa'am ci zhes pa'i don/ /ka ra spru ra lag pa'am so/ra bzhad de re lcag dang mya ngan gyi me tog dmar po ke ta ka shing dang nor bu ste gnyis kas chu rnyeg dwangs nus/ /rlung sman shib kun dang a grong sngo sman dar ya man zhang zhung gi skad de bdud rtsi'am sman yin so so'i gsang sman dang grangs brtsi rgyu'ang yod/ /ka ped bi lnga pho ku ba ba lnga mo sdong ring gzar bu sogs byed btub kim pa dug shing de'i 'bras bu ma bar la zos na 'chi ba/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri tsher ma can sman starwatsher g.ya' kyi ma sngo sman 'khor lo rtseg pa 'dra ba yod/ / na bhā ke la mi mo rtsen te be ta'i 'bras bu ka ko la pho rog dang sman zla ba'i bye ma dang dug rigs dgu'i bye brag /tshe la ba/ gangs ri dang ka lid ka liṅka yul ci mtshan/ /ko bza mdzod ldan nam rtswa ku sha dang a ka 'dus pa can te grong khyer zhig dang ko sa 'a yul dge ba can/ /yul ka ma ta ste 'di bzhi rgya gar gye yul ming dang ko'u shi ka rgya skad la rka shi ka yod pa sgra zur phyin pa'i ched sna ru gcig ge dod 'u sbyar ba sngags kyi glog thabs dang bod skad nyid la 'ang mi chung la mi'u thung dang 'dab chags chung ba la byi'u sogs chung ba'i don lta bu la 'jug pa yod pas khyad par shes par bya ste don/ /dbang chen gu gul 'ug pa dang / /sbrul 'dzin rnams la ko shi ka /zhes sogs la 'jug /ka khyu ya na ka ti'i bu ste 'phags pa kaṇ+ḍa n+ya thab ldan ma'i bu ste lnga sde'i ya gyal/ /be'u tshang brag phug gi ming du go glang la sogs pa'i ko ba pags pa dang lha ma kyi krad pa rdog pa dab / /yungs kar 'bru'i khyad par ka ru kha dog dkar po thod 'e kor ha shig ste ri mo dod pa'i rdo dkar/ /ku shu shing tog gi khyad par gur kum ku rtum kha che sha skam lta bu ka ca 46

spyod dngos rgyu nor kun thams cad/ /bsags mod kyang rgyan sdud kyi ji 'bab krol 'thab mo phub krol phung byed rlag byed kyi rgyu/ /kye ma zhum pa mya ngan snying rje'i brda kyi byud mya ngan gyi brda kye ho rab bam ngo mtshar bod pa'i brda ka dang ka ye bod tshig /kye kye bod tshig lan gnyis smos pa klob klob dang kob kong gnyis gshong gshong du go /sgra dang mi sogs grog krog mig sogs krab krab 'khrub tshul mgo klog klog krog po 'khyog po/ /krong krob tsog rtsa gdag gis myur bas ker ke re langs nas/ —/ku re rtsed mos do ker thor tshugs ko sko ma mchu'i 'og gi cha 'degs pa/ /ku rtso skad che ba kyal ka rtsed mo klan ka rtsod pa'i rgyu/ /'on kyang yin na yang lan kan pu shu mda' yab chu skyor nyen kor nye 'khor du go /ma/ ba na ta ma/ bya mchil ba zad ma/ byi'u zhig dang / /bya ma ba ba/zad la sogs bsnyed kyu/zad kyu/zad ni da/bad 'byin tshul/ /da/ (1 sgog pa bsnyed kyi bdang brtsang kag lo'i bar chad da kab sa bdag gi khyad par/ /sku stod spud kyi 'od kor dang yi ge'i steng zad kyi thig kor ram rjes su nga ro rmad gong ngam steng ngam thog ma'i don dang / /ke sha 'greng bu dang rna ru nyis rtseg 'ab ba spru u yig lcags spru mchil pa'am kro bas btab pa/ /ma/ra kar ni zug langs tshul bad kan nyes pa gsum gyi gcig ste spug po lta bu chu'i1 /ku ya sprin 'dra ba sogs mthug srab las tsha grang gi nad 'byed kan gung mdzub kyi 'og tu rtsa kyal kyal 'phar tshul/ /rus krab sha med rus rkyang krang re krong nge rdo rje skyil kung 'dug tshul zhig bcas pa bzos pa/ /ma byams klas dang mtham/ kas gnyis bsam gyis mi khyab mthas klas pa mthas gtugs pa yang yin klog 'don byed kyab yi ge klag pa klog pa'i ming tsam/ /ston ka zla ba gsum dpyid ka zla gsum nyin mtshan gnyis ka 47

gnyi ga'i dus/ /glab chen gnyis 'thung lag lda na thal kar mdog skya bo dkar shas che ba beྈ ka dbyug pas bzungs pa/ /tshogs dang mdongs sgro gser ska dang / /rgyan dang dong bar ka lha pa sgra dang ba la'i pho brang yang yin pa yis za klo ta zig sogs bcom pa/ /ka ba gdung 'degs ka tsa ba lha'i gos kyis klubs g.yogs pa dang skul tshig /kad pa ṇa kad pa ṇa zho yi dong rtse be ke ru nor bu ser po/ /dur bya kang ka ste rgyab dkar 'di ko 'di ni'am 'di tsho grag cor ku rtsa che ba/ /keng rus sha med rus pa cha tshang ka ‘ li ka pā la ste bde skyong thod pa'i nang gi klad sa kha la za/ /kun nas thams cad nas kun byu thams cad du'am yang dag par pags pa kab kob gyong po mkhregs pa/ /ku byu khu byug dpyid kyi pho nya'i mgrin pa la da/gas pa kong bo pu ka ra ṇa ma thos ka med de ka shes na ka lnga bu ka rkyang pa 'thob par snang ngo / /(dka) dkar zag tho yig 'thems byang gong 'og ma dkugs pa ma 'khrugs pa dkor nor gyi spyi ming mdzod sgo phye nas dkrogs pa mchod sbyin byed pa'am 'jug pa/ /lha'i dkyil snying po 'khor len pa zla dkyil sogs kyang dkyil dbus thad du lha dkrong skad cig gis bskyed pa dka' ba khag po dka' las/ /chos sogs la dka' las bub pa dka' ba spyad pa dkon chog dkon mchog dkon pa dkon myo/ /mdog kha dog dkar bo dkyel che pa khong yangs pa spyan mig dkyus srid du rib ba/ /dkyus ma phal pa'am rang bzhin pa'i ming dkor ni dad jos bang nor spyi dri ma dku dri nga ba mchi ma dku mchi ma 'dzag pa/ /dkos thag nyam thag ༄ kun nas dgris pa nyon mongs pa gos kyis lus dgris pa dgri ba/ /dku gsus pa'i skabs mtshams te sta zur dku grod pa sprum po ril ril dku ma 48

snyongs ked pa ring thung 'tsham pa/ /mkha' la jin dang rdul dkrigs pa 'khrigs pa zhe dkrogs pa srub pa rol mo sil snyan lta bu dkrol ba 'khrol ba/ /dkar po'i yol go ste btung sgod dang gas zag dkum pa bcag pa dbyu ba'i sar rta dkyus pa ste rgyug sar rgyug pa/ /go dka' ba'i don 'grel pa 'grol bdakags phrag grangs gnas shig dkan gyen gzar po/ /phan tshun phra mas dkugs pa mi mthun par byed pa dang dkyus mo dkre sogs sngon 'jug das 'phul ba'i ka'o/ /(bka) bkra shis dge legs bkrag ni mdabs yin tshon rtsi bkra ba khra bo ngo mtshar mdzes pa bsam mi khyab bkram pa 'grems pa/ 1bka' gsung sogs bsgos pa gnang ba khral dpya bkal ba khal khur bkal ba srad bu skud pa bkal ba 'gel ba'am 'kha' ba/ /pho nya bang mi bkye ba ston mo zas sogs bkye ba 'od bkye ba sprul pa bkye ba gtong ba'am spro ba/ /dgongs pa bsam pa'i don bkral ba 'grel ba dang dpya khral bkral ba so sor bgos pa'am phye pa dgobs pa bkrol ba dgrol ba bcings pa mdud pa sogs bkrol ba bshig pa/ /dri ma chus bku ba dang bkus pa gnyis 'khrud pa bkren ser sna dang dbul ba la 'jug cing pho ba bkres pa stogs pa/ /logs su bkar ba bton pha'am bkol na sa thag pas bkyigs pa 'khyig pa bcings te tshe srog bkums pa 'gums pa gsod pa bkrobs pa bsad pa'i zhe sa/ /bkad sa g.yos khang gral zas za ba'i khang par go sdod spyad bkang ba dgang ba thugs dgongs dam pa bkab ba dgyes par byas pa/ /bsnyen bkur zhabs tog bkur sto rim gro'am mchod pas gral gong du'am gtsug tu bkur ba 'khur ba rtsi ba/ /khang pa ngo gas kyi bzo bkod dang bka' bkod megs pa bde ba'i sar bkod pa 49

bzhag bzur du bkol ba bton pa dab / /shing sogs bkug pa 'gu ṭa pa bsas pa dgas pa dum bur gses shib g.yog tu las su bkol ba spyod pa 'khol ba/ /gnab ba bya rung ba bkag pa bya mi rung ba ste 'dul ba'i brda sman gyi khu ba bku ba 'byin pa bkus pa byung ba'am bton te bor ba dor pa sman snyi gas kyang / /gos dang thog sogs bkab pa g.yogs pa ga'u la mda' sbyar nas bkang ba 'then pa dang shing gi rtsa ba dang shog bu sogs bkog pa dgog pa bton pa/ /bka' drin phan btags pa bka' btags pa khrims bsgrags pa bka' la blo sems bde ba ste chos ston gyi tshig la dga' ba/ /bka' btsun dang brgyad bkag gnyis spyo ba khon du bkon pa 'khon pa 'dzin pa/ /'gro lam sogs bkag pa 'gegs pa spa bkong pha rol po zhum par byas pa rgyal po sogs kyis bkrabs pa mang po'i dkyil nas gdams pa/ /lus gan rkyal du bkan pa bstan pa lag pa bkan pa lag mthil gyen du bstan pa sogs bkros pa 'dams pa'am gdams pa nas bgri ba 'khrid pa/ /mdo sde bklags pa glog pa dang yi ge'i mgo bkad dam skra lhas ma yin snyam mgo 'dzugs zhes kyang snang dpyad zags kyi bkad sgyur ba dang 'ur rdo lhas pa'i bkad lta bu/ /bkyal ba'i ngag ngag 'khyal dang bkyed pa bkrum pa sogs bas 'phul ka'o/ /(gshe mi sogs kyi rkang pa dang lag pa rka yur ba ldan pa'i zhing ngam rkab bzhi yod pa ltar na dud 'gro rkan dkan yang rung ste ya rkan dang rkyab tshos te 'phongs/ /chom rkun rku mkhan dang zangs sogs kyi ༄rkyan sdod dang phye rkyal rtsam rkyal sman rkyal sogs rku ba ma byin par len pa /rkong pa pags nad chig rkyang gcig rkyang pa sa dang par sogs rko ba da' rkos skul chig /gan rkyal gan kyal yang rung ste kha spub min pa shed pa nu ma dang 60

dpyi gnyis kyi bar lta bu dang lag sogs rgyong ba brkyang ba rkon pa rnyi 'jigs pa/ /rka yur ba'am chu lam gyi mgo'i chu 'phel rtsed pa rgyab pa ri dwags kyi bye brag rkyang drel 'dra ba/ /nyer len gyi rgyu dang lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen dang rang rkya thub pa rkom la sogs par ra brtags pa'i ka'o/ /(lka) lkog phag tu gyur pa mngon gyur min pa lkog ma sog ma sog shal sko nas sha leb 'phyang pa dang / /ngag skugs pa kha skugs pa la sags pal ra btags pa'i ka'o/ /(gshe sha ba dpal brtsegs dang rtsog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis skal pa dang lda na pa las 'phro can dang nam mkha'i shar ma spyi ming mag skar ma'i khyad par dang rgya tshos/ /chos sogs kyi sku lus sam phung po ste/ma pa skam pa'i ma rtsi lus la skud pa 'byug pa dang bal gyi skud pa srad bu skyol skyel ba'i skul tshig dang sgrim pa/ /skyo ma lde gu mig skyag phra ma'i don skug pa phyi sa dang bya jing ka lhung kas jid pa mi dran par rjed pa/ /ska rags ked chings skyer kha ser po skya bo dkar shas che ba sogs skyu ru ra sman/ /skyes bu gang zag dang zhal sogs skyems btung ba nyid kyi don la 'jug skom rlan rlon dang ro bro skyur mo dang me la chu skol ba/ /gos skon gyon du bcug pa g.yog pa skyen yang ldang ba yang ba'am rtsal che ba dang chu la spur ba 'phen pa 'dor bas sems skyo ba nges 'byung yid 'byung / /skom byed zhem pa po dang gdon zhig skul byed dge sogs la skul pa po skor ba byed pa gnas skor mtha' skor mgo skor sogs/ /ji rum zas kyi ro gsal byed tshod ma sku mtshon nam zan gab dang kha nas mi gtsang ba'i zas skyugs pas kha skyengs pa ngo tsha ba/ /bon nad kyi khyad par dab skyigs bu g.yig pa'i ming tsam mam de 'i nad dang bad kan skya zab nad dang skrangs pa sbos pa/ /ri che1

skyegs ri rtegs kyang rung ste bya dang glang chen chu skyar mthing ril skra ga mdog nag cing glo dkar po nun gyi bya'i ming skad sgra/ /skun bu kong bu dang slo ma sham ba 'dzin spyad dang gru'i skya ba lung rigs kyi skya bar nas bton zhes pa lta bu sogs dang sdod skyogs zhu skyogs sogs/ /dge skos sam yang na dge bar sko ba pos pro bo pa 'khrung pa ḍa ma ru skyo ga ‘ rdung ba/ /skud po chung ma'i ming po dang sring mo'i bdag po skyo sngogs 'khrug long rtsod pa zhi zin pa slar slong ba snya na skyo skyo ma phra mas sam ba nga na skyos pa nyams pa zag pa 'jigs pa bred pa/ /rgya skyegs rgya tshos skag skyed mos tshal ba shing ra ba skyer pa zhes pa'i shing zhig skas ka them skas/ /lus kyi ske mgul pa dang yog skor yog ma chu skyegs kha la skyugs pa'i sngon du byung ba'i chu skyur dang shing dang bu sogs skyes pa skye ba/ /skyi g.ya'i don skrag pa skyon nyes pa mtshang dang ngan song las skyob pa srung ba dang rten nam skubs su 'gro ba re stos 'cha' ba dang tshig yang yang skyor ba ldab pa/ /mas bu 'tsho zhing skyong ba bskyang ba re ba skong ba bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa skyin gor dbyid de stobs skyed sman gangs sbal sogs dang mar gyi skogs pa 'thums byed dam shun pa/ /srab skyogs rta srab bam srab kyis skyogs shing sgyur ba skyes rten nam rigs bzab po rgyal gyi don la 'jug pa'i skugs rgyal 'gugs byed/ /bya skyibs char mi 'bab pa'i brag skyibs sogs skar ma mthong ba'i thog khung rab gsal yang skor tsher skabs rer bde zhing skyid pa spro ba skyid po/ /skyel ma skyel mkhan skyes bu chen po skyes mchog skyos ma rten nam skyes skyod pa gegs sogs mthar skrod btang ba snyel ba/ /rgyud sogs sgro1da pa g.yo bar byed pa zho skrog pa spub pa rtsis kyi skyeg bar chad/ /ji da da ji lta ba lung 'dren pa'i tshig 'ad skad 'di ltar dang yin skad zer skad sogs kha skong pa kha da2

tshang bar byed pa tshe skabs go skabs skabs rnyed gnas skabs sogs/ /sa gzhi skyob ba sa skyong pa rgyal po skyang nul—zhal ba sko ma pa rlon pa min pa re skan mna' skyel ba/ /yun thung ba'i ska cig ma skad cig ma mgo'i glu mgor nyal skyes pa skye bshing sogs sprus pa kong kong 'dru ba'am gcod pa/ /zas pa'i don can gyi skubs shig dbus kyi mtha' nas skor ba khor yug skobs su chud pa gnas sam bar du tshud pa ste bya dka'i skobs su chud bya dka'i gnas su tshud lta bu/ /rang gi skal ba bgo skal sogs dang shes pa skye zhing mched par byed pa ste mig sogs bcu gnyis thugs dam skong ba dgongs pa rdzogs par byed pa'am mnyes par byed pa/ /bya 'dzin byed skom pa rnyi skyi ko ba'i phyi dkar po ko ba mnyes ma skye tshe'i don ni 'dru zhig / sngo ma snga btsan phra ma bcug pa skyil kung 'dug stangs kyi khyad par skyod pa g.yo ba 'gro ba/ /skya rengs skya mda' zhal skyin zhal ras dang skyes pa rtsig skyabs rtsig skyor skum pa skyi ba skye bo skyas 'degs pa sgog skya re sko na sigs sar btags ka'o/ / (brka) 'dod pa'i yon tan la bzam pa brkams pa chags pas brku bya brku ba ma byin par blang bya gser sogs brkus pa ma byin par blangs pa ste brku rku brkus rkus lta bu byed 'brel bdag gzhan dus gsum dang ma 'brel ba'i dus gsum skul tshig dang bcas pa'ang rtags 'jug las shes dgos tshul 'di gong 'og gi bya tshig gzugs 'gyur mi 'gyuྈ thams cad la jir —bar bya'o/ /'dul ba'i gzhi bcu bdun las bag yangs dang 'brel ba za brkyang gi gzhi ste gtan pa yang zer lag pa brkyang ba spyong ba brko spru par dang sa sogs brkos pa no ba/ /brkyangs pa brkams pa sogs ba bsnye 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ka'o/ / ‘53

(bska) byug pa snum sogs bsku ba dang bskus pa skud pa 'byug pa lag pa sogs bskum pa dang bskums pa tshur skum pa sdud pa/ /'dzin cha bskur ba 'gan khag bskur ba dbang mnga' bskur ba skur ba sbod pa chos sogs la bskul ba skul ba byed du bcug pa/ /nor gser sogs bskyi ba dang bskyis pa skyi ba g.yar ba dang bskyin pa skyin tshab bskyal ba skyel ba 'phen pa/ /gos la sogs pa bskon pa skon pa g.yogs pa rta dang spub la sogs par bskyon pa skyon pa 'jog pa'am 'jug pa'am rgyab pa bskyar ba skyor ba ldab pa bzlas nas phyir bzad pa skod pa 'don pa/ /gcom bskungs nga rgyal bcag pa'am sgra chung ngur byas pa sgyung ba 'dor ba zas ka bslong ba bskyed pa skyed pa spel ba'i don la 'jug cing dge rtsa dang par sogs bkun pa skrun pa skyed pa gsog pa bzhengs pa bzo ba/ /dus kyi bskal pa bar bskal sogs kyi mes mtsho dang shing sogs bshams pa skem pa chu sogs kyi sna ma btang bar bskyil ba skyil ba 'khyil ba bskyams pa skyom pa g.yo bar byed pa/ yul dus rang bzhin gyis bskal ba skog gyur ram bar chod pa'i don dang bskungs pa skung ba sbas shing 'jigs pa las bskyabs bskyob pa bskyangs pa skyong ba 'tsho ba/ /gnas gzha na du 'pho zhing bskyas pa bskya ba spo ba rgyab ba bskyur ba skyur ba 'dor ba bya ba bskyungs pa skyung ba bshol ba/ /mi dgag tshig bskyod pa skyod pa g.yo ba bskor ba mtha' nas skor ba dang tshig sko rwa ba rgyal po'i sar bskos pa bsko ba bzhag pa byed du bcug pa/ /zas kyi ro bska ba a ru ra'i ro lta bu dang bska sla'i bska ba ste gar ma kha bskang ba skong ba tshang bar byed pa thuṭa dgongs dam pa bskabs pa skong ba rdzogs par byas pa/ /gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa lta bu'i sems bskyed pa skyed brgya khyon bskyed pa cher 64
