btang ba dang dran pa ched por brjed pa'i don can gyi bskyud po skyud pa dang / /bskyang ba bskyang ba sogs bas 'phul ba'i sa mgo ldan pa'i ka 'thob pa'o/ /khad/ khrab go cha ste/ phrag stong phrag btsu khug khrig grangs gnas shig gi ming khur ni 'khur ba ste 'das pa dang skul tshig yin/ /khob nas khro ba zhe ldang khon du 'dzin pa gnod sems 'chang ba khro po khro ba po khros pa khro ba'i 'das skul/ /khro dab khrol ma'am tshags ma 'tshag byed khyed pa 'khrud pa'i ming khu bas khyes 'khru ba'i ming dang skul tshig dang 'das pa/ /khong pa tsho dang khong du chud pa dang khong nas sam zhe nas khro ba sdang ba khom du 'dzin pa mi mthun par 'dzin pa gnod sems mi gtong ba khro po zhi ba min pa'i khro ba po khros shig pa'am 'das pa/ /khob ba'i zungs khrag sogs khrag khyeg khrab nad dam 'khrugs pa khyeng khyeng bya'i bye brag byu rigs mthun pa'i tshogs/ /nyes spyod sdo ma pa sogs kyi tshul dang mthun pa'i khrims bsil ba 'thob pa khris 'jags chings byas pa ltar gnas pa khrims lugs kyi ming khral dpya sogs/ /'jal byed khye gab sor nyer bzhi'i tshad sogs khrun dkyus rib po khram kha ri mo'i khyad par khra bo kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /khrom tshogs pa khrod gseb bam dkyil gdan khri'i steng gtsug lag khang sogs mi khyim sgo dang 'khor gyi khyams/ /phug ron sogs gsod byed bya'i khyad par khra dang khyi yis khyer zin dang khyer cig bsnyim pa gang la khror ba do'i tshad byed pa lta bu khre 'bru'i bye brag /za ra khor yu ga mtha' skor khron pa'i chu 66

khyems thim pa dang 'grems pa'i skul tshig /sil khrol lcags kyi rol mo 'dod gzugs gzugs med kyi khams tshom pa gsum po khum ba ham pas zhe pheb ba gzhan la 'dzem pa/ /dur khrod ro bzhi shā na skyel sa lam gyi sna khrid pa lam mkhan khrums stod dang khrums smad gnyis rgyu skar zhig /khong khro ba'i gnyer ma khu ta 'dab chags shig dang khams khong rnam pa khyed khyod khud ba khong du chud kha khris ma khegs khal sogs kha rkyang ngo / /(ma gshe rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang las kyi mkhan pos sa las byas pa'i mkhar rdzong mkhrang ba gyong bo grims pa mkhrebs pa sra ba mkhyen pa shes pa/ /mchud pa'am sbas nas spyad pa gsang ba'i man ngag dpe cha mkhyud pa ser snas tshos kyi gnad mi ston pa zhu mkhan 'dri mkhan nam tshos gdan nye bar ma/ro ba dgos pa/ /ma mkhal ma mgal mkhal ma nang khrol zhig bzhin gyi mkhur tshos 'dzum pa dmul ba shes bya la mkhas pa dran dbang / / sngo mkhan pa'i khrod mkhos phab pa bde bar gnas pa snga mtsha sngar bzhin srur ltar/ /nam mkha' rgyu skar gyi lam dang ma nyam pa ma khris pa'i nad med par mkhyen pa shes pa/ /chu mkhris rta gdang gi me lag pa'i mkhrig ma dang mkhur ba sgo ba sogs mas 'phul ba'i kha'o/ /('gashe blo 'khums pa sems zhum pa zhe nas 'khon pa bkon pa 'dzin pa 'khang ba sdong ba'i don yin zhib 'khu ba sdang ba dang ser sna/ /'khyabs pa 'khyag pa'am grang nas yul mtha' 'khob chos med pa'i gnas ma khyar ba 'khyams pa'am zhig pa'am 'chi snyed ra ma khrams pa 'phyan pa/ /rgas pa la go ba'i kar dgas pa lon song ba 'khos ka chung ba nus pa chung ba rkang ba 'khyam rang bzhin gyis skum pa 'du ba 'khrob pa drang po min pa/ /gom pa 'khror ba me brtan pa 'khrom pa ba/yo ba 'khar ba lag rten 66

dang chu btung sgod dang sgod kyi mthil du zas tshig pa lha bu go bar byed cing yab yum 'khril ba sbyor ba shing la 'khris pa sbyor ba dang chags zin pa lus —la 'khyud ‘ sbyor ba/ /'khrig pa 'dod pa'i dga' ston gyi tshig sprin 'khrig sogs ngab gam gtam da khul ba bkyal 'chal ba 'bab pa dang 'a/khrug pa don gcig cing gong 'og 'khyug pa sogs kyang go 'khyel pa nor ba g.yo ba/ /shing jo gas la 'khri ba 'am chags zhen 'khru ba bkru ba dang bshal ba chus 'khrud pa gzhan la 'khri zhing skyor bar byed pa'i shing 'grubs pa skyes pa/ /nyi gdugs sogs 'khyir ba 'khor ba zhabs thra 'khrab pa rdung ba'am skrab pa' khar ba'i za 'khrol ba dkrol ba/ /sem sa chu snar 'khol ba rnal du mi gnas pa sems sogs 'khyegs pa 'dzings pa 'khug po mgyogs po dang mig sngar 'bab pa mthun par go 'khyes pa 'bros pa rgyug pa/ /khur po 'khur ba bkur ba dpya khral 'khri ba phog pa nyi 'od 'khyims pa 'od skor ba chu sogs 'khyil ba skyil ba/ 'khor ba rang nyid skor mkhan med par 'khor ba ste srid pa sogs mang po la 'jug par mthong zhing 'khren pa chags shing zhen pa 'khras pa chags shing 'khar ba zhe na pa 'di gsum don 'dra/ /thag pas ma 'khyig po ma 'ching ba dang skul tshig ma 'khyer ba ma 'khur ba snum du brtsas pa'i 'khur ba bzhes spro 'khur ba 'khyer ba/ /las sne sogs ma 'khrar ba ma bskyur pa'am ma brjes pa bred pa'i 'khrims pa 'jigs pa 'khams pa brgyal bar go dgos theng nad sogs kyi sa ngab/'khun pa'am 'khun bu'i sgra thon pa/ gser sogs kyi 'khor tsha 'khod pa bkod pa'am gnas kyab ga rtsa bo g.yog bkar dang bcas pa'akhongs pa khyab pa rgya che ba/ g.yob nu ma khu ba ma bskul bar g.yog las byed pa ga mag tu 'khol ba bkol ba zad 'u skud pa 'khal 67

ba bkal ba/ /'khra ba chabs pa'i sar ma ma brjeb ba ma bskyal ba'am ma son pa'akhrid pa bkri bar 'jug 'khyams pa go ba'am shes pa thos pa/ /rus kyi bye brag sa skya'i gdung la 'chon ces pa'ang mi mthun pa'i don yin 'khob pa la gong du 'khur 'khor sa sogs 'as 'phul kha'o/ 1ba/grub pa'i mtha' dpyad pa'i mtha' ste chos lugs grub pa thob pa mthong lam sogs la reg pa grangs ka med pa grangs gnas shig dang grangs su thebs mi nus pa grol ba thar ba mdud pa zhig pa yal ba/ /ral gri mtshon cha'i khyad par gro ga shing stag pa'i shun pas shog bu dang rbab sogs rang bzhin gyes gril ba zhes grag lo grag zer gsum gyi grag /grul bum gdon zhig grang ba'i nad bad kan sogs grum bu nad cig gis grongs shi ba dang skal tshig /mon gru dang nam gru dang gre dang gro bzhin 'di bzhi ༄rgyu skar gyi bye brag /chos kyi grwa chos ra bla'i grwa bzo grwa chos gos kyi grwa grwa pa'i gral rim du rim gro bkur sti dang zhabs brtan nam sku rim la sogs pa'i rdo ming grab ba sta gon/ /lnga / ba gru yul khyon nam yul byu1 zur ba chen gru gzings kyi kha na yod pa'i grong khang pa'am khang pa'i tshogs/ gra ma shing zhig spu gcod pa'i gri spu gra ltar yang 'dug gru 'jin pa'i ri ste po ta la'i ri/ /mon lug gla lgang sngo sman zhig gro 'bru'i bye brag sbab ma'i glum glum sbang / /snye ma'i gra ma dang sog ma'i phub ma rgya gro ma sogs mon sran gre'u khre'u/ /grod pa gsus pa gron 'gro can thugs gron snag shog gron du zad lta bu 'gro song ngam chud zos grub po spung po dang sa bon grung po'i don yin zhing sku dang rig pa sogs grims pa mi lhod pa'i don skul ba kyang 68

yin/ 1gram pa zhes pa'i don chu rgyug shu' gyis chu grog chu grang la bye brtab pa'i sman gre ba mgur ram mid pa'i don grogs po rogs sam zla bo/ /shing gi grib ma la sogs par bya ba legs nyes kyi gros byed pa gleng ba bshad pa re bgron du med pa re ba chud mi za ba/ /ri dwags za ba'i ste bar yo5 bka sman ma mas byas pa'i zan pa glud tshab lhar glen pa blang dor mi shes pa/ /ba zur chag pa'i 'dzam bu'i shing yod pa'i glib chu'i bar du chud pa'i gle bar glegs ma'i bam po snye po ti glib bu rgya glib la sogs pa'i ming glu rdo rje'i glu sogs/ /nad pho ba glang thabs dang pags nad glang ku bas bldag blog ba zhes pa'i nad/ /klo ba nang khrol zhig dang glo ba dga' zhes pa yid dga' ba'i don blo lud pa dgog pa bkog pa dbyibs meb mor spebs leb leb byed pa mnan pa/ glang po chen po lag ldan klo yis phab pa gzhogs phab pa bde bar gnas pa kha blod pa stod po byed pa bkrol ba'am btang nab seng ge glab ba seng ge rnam bsnyungs dang kha g.yam ba/ /rtsig pa'i klo logs 'bur ba klo bur nges med dam 'bral du rung ba blo jeg mgyogs pa glo bur nam mkha'i blog rnam gsam/ /glags skabs snyed pa thob pa bzang ngan gyi lan glan pa 'jal ba gos kyi lhan ba man pa dgab pa/ khang pa'i sgo glegs sgo 'phar chos gos kyi spegs bu tshal bu dang pod chung dang spring yig la sogs pa'i don grwa zur dang sde sogs/ /za gor zho sha shing sman zhig gtan gyi mdun ma sogs speng ba gros byed pa bshad pa/ /bya'i khyad par zag ces pa lu gu sogs gsod mkhan grog ma srog chags mig med grib mi gtsang ba grib gnon gdon zhig /grog po ri'i sul la sogs par go lag pa'i gru mo dkar yol zag cing grum pa dkrum pa grubs zhes snang yang dpyad don grub yin nas med/ /thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub grub pa gru char char pa'abebs par 'jig rten na 69

grags pa/ /ri dwags sha ba'i khrag rwa sogs la 'jug pa'i ka dor dang gru gu tha gru bya gag gya nom gyi na gang bu sogs ga rkyang ngo / /(dag3 sna gcig spyod pa sogs kyi dge bsnyen pha ma spang bya bcu spong ba'i dge tshul pha ma sems dga' ba thugs dgyes pa mnyes pa dkod pa gad mo shor ba/ /dgung gnam sngon po dgu tshigs gnam gyi ska rags lus rgyab tu phyir dgye ba'i don yin zhing mdun du dgu ba gug pa/ /nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i dgung dkyil lam phyed dge ba'i bzhes gnyen dge gro ṭa yod dgu yod do cog gam yod tshad dgug pa bkug pa/ /dge smyong sangs rgyas lta bu dge blong pha ma spang bya thams cad spangs pa dge 'dun dge slong bzhi las mi nyung ba'i tshogs grangs dgu yis/ /nyon mongs sogs gnod byed kyi dgra bo bcom pa dang dgongs pa bzhed pa'am bsam pa dgro' ba bkrol ba'am bkral ba yi ger dgod pa bkod pa/ /mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa sun 'byin pa 'thad pa'i cha sprub pa snod dgang ba bkang ba dgon pa dben par go dgar ba bkar ba/ /ri dwags dgo ba yis pha ba dko dko me med du ba ste khrug gcod kyi sman dgas pa bkas pa/ /khal dgal ba bkal ba gos kyi lhan pa dgab pa bkab pa dab dgog pa bkog pa/ /skye dgu skye bos dge ba legs pa'i don bde ba 'byin byed kyi dge ba sprub pa dgos pa nyer mkho yod med sogs/ /dgongs mo phyi dro sogs thong brtsang bya'i dngos po smar min dgram pa bkram pa rme tokathang ga sogs dgram pa bkam pa/ /dgun dung can chu med pa'i gnas nyid du dus dgun ka sdod/ /dgung gnam lo dang dgam pa dgrung ba la sogs das 'phul ga'o/ /(bag)bka' bgro ba gros bya ba bgro bya'i gtam speb pa 'chad pa bgyi ba bya ba bgyid pa byed pa bgyis pa byas pa gyis shig byos shig/ go cha 60

spus la bgos pa spyon pa bgegs bar chad gegs kyis bgrod pa 'gro ba'i lam bgags pa bkag pa/ /dus tshod bgyangs pa phyis pa tshod bgam pa nyams tshod len pa bgo bar bya ba'i gos bkos pa gyon zin pa/ /sku bgres po bgres pa rgan pas mig gnyis bgrad pa bsgrad pa gdangs pa bgrang bya brtsi bya'i zeng ba bgrabs pa brtsis pa/ /bgrus pa shun pa'am spun pa phud ba'i ming 'bras sgyu lu bkos ba bgo bsha' byas pa gad mo ga zha bkad pa dgod pa/ /rkang pa'i gom ba bgoms pa 'gom pa gom pa spos pa dang steng nas bgoms shing chu stog ma bgrungs pa dwangs bar byas pa/ bgo bya'i skal ba rang skal bgrod pa bgor ba la sogs bas 'phul ga'o/ /(ma gshe lus sogs kyi mgo bo yan lag mchog gtso bo mgur ba mgrin pa dang gsung mgur mgul ba sko mgrin bgre ba mgar ba lcags bzo dang blon po mgar lta bu rus ming mgon po skyob byed sems mgu ba dga' ba/ /mgam dum shing tshig dum mgal me'i 'khor lo gtor ma sogs kyi mgron du bos pa mgron po'am gsar 'ongs kyang mthogs pa myur ba/ /ma mgal ya le ma mgal ma le sogs mas 'phul ga'o/ /('ag) gzhan du 'gro ba phyin pa 'greb ba langs pa rgya' khams 'grim pa'agro ba myul ba 'grul ba 'gro ba 'grul pa yang 'byung pa gying pa 'gying bag rnam 'gyur 'gros 'gro tshul rta 'gros kyang 'gran pa bsdur ba/ /zas kyis sto ba 'grabs pa gang ba 'gengs pa bkang ba 'gag pa bkag pa 'grog pa bkag pa 'gog bden nyan thos 'gog pa lta bu 'gags pa bkag pa dum bur 'gas pa bkas pa'am yang na 'ga' zhig gis zhes pa'i don 'grib pa mi snang ba sgrib pa/ /dus 'gyangs pa phyis pa 'gor ba yun ring 61

thogs pa so sor 'gyes pa 'bral ba grol ba bshes gnyen dang lhan cig 'grogs pa sdeb bsnyen pa dgongs pa 'grel pa bkra' ba snye bstan bcos 'grol ba bkrol ba/ /'gyel ba skyes ba 'grel bsgril ba 'grobs pa'achi ba 'gum pa'achi ba 'gal ba mi mthun pa zhe 'gras pa zhe sdang ba mi dga' ba sngar byas la 'grod bgyis gdung / /'gol dben pa'i sar gdong mi'agram pa ldan pa'agul ba g.yo ba nor rdzas ba ba dang 'gyed pa bkye ba gtong ba/ /'gan khag 'khur ba 'gong po'i gdon gzhan la 'go ba'i nad cham pa sogs 'gos pa sbags pa'am 'byar ba lta bu/ /gong du 'phel ba dang 'grib pa nyams pa rgud pa'agyur ba mi brtan pa dngaX skad 'gyur ba sogs 'gyus pa rgyas pa dang sems 'gyu ba mi 'gob ba mi skrag mi zhum zil gyis mi gnon pa dang / /lam gyi 'gron po 'grul pa 'ga' zhig kha cig 'gugs pa bkug pa rtsig pa'i 'gram gzhi'am rmang 'gram chu 'gram nye 'gram sogs kyang 'god pa bkod pa 'bri ba dang 'jog pa/ /brtson cing 'grus pa' bad pa'agro ma thog ma'i chu 'grems pa bkam pa don sogs 'grub pa grub pa/ /mgo bo 'gems pa 'joms pa bkas pa gzhan la rigs 'gre ba kha spo ba tshos kyi 'grib pa tshos nyes pa/ /'bab mo 'gyed pa 'khrug pa byed pa dang 'gel ba rigs 'gres pa 'gyu ba 'gang ba 'gums pa la sogs pa' sa 'phul ba'i ga'o/ /(rga) blo rgod po sna tshogs dran nus sam grung po sogs rgya che ba'i mtsho chu'i phung por go chu dang la sogs rgal ba'i phyir rgyu ba 'gro ba/ /gna' gtam gcig nas gcig tu rgyud pa sngon gyi lo rgyus preng ba'i rgyud phreng thag gam phreng ba rgyud pa yang rgyud mang po can sgra snyan mdzes byed kyi rgyan soṭa/ /bya rgyal rgod po rgan po rgas pa dang bslab pa rgan pa rga ba na 62

tshod yol ba sogs shi ba lta bu'i rgud pa nyams pa/ /phas kyi no' ba pha rol gyi rgol ba gnod byed rgol phyir rgol sogs rtsod byed rgyang 'phen pa phyi rol pa thams cad dang chad smra'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa mgo bo la rgyob cig stun cig /rgod ma rta mo'i ming rgyab lus kyi rgyab sogs rgyas pa rgya che ba 'phel ba bye ba spros pa rgyas par bshad pa sogs rgyang thag ring po rgyug pa mgyogs por 'gro ba dang rgyug che ba sogs/ /rgya ngo gdong la rgya yod pa dmu rgo da mi spun pa phyag rgya phyag dam dang phyag rgya bzhir go rgyo 'khrig pa'i dngos ming / /rgya tsha tshwa'i khyad par rgyam tsha tshwa'i khyad par rgyags sto phogs kyi spru'i rgyugs dpe rgyugs ja rgyugs sogs/ /rgyu mtshan sgrub byed dam go byed rgyu lo rgyus gtam rgyus byib ba rig pa gsal cha med pa rgod pa sems mi gnas par 'phro ba rgyu skyed byed dang 'jog byed kyi rgyu/ /bdud bzhi las rgyal ba ka thob pa bcom ldan bla ma'i rgyud rgyun chags te rgyud sde bzhi sogs rgyal po gtso bo mi bdag lta bu rgyu ba'i skar ma rgyal stod dang rgyal smad de sgar ma'i bye brag/shes pa sems kyi rgyud rgyun rgya yis btab pa mi 'da' ba'i rtags bkod pa nga rgyal dregs pa zas dang rigs sogs kyis rgyags pa mtho bar sems pa/ /rdo rje rgya gram bsgol ba rgyan po sho sogs rgyan dang rgyal gnyis skugs/ /rgun gyi 'drum pa rgun shing gi 'bras bu rgya shug shing gi khyad par nya rgya dol lam rkon par go rgyu ba 'gro ba/ /lus kyi rgyus ba rtsa rgyus dang rgyus skud lta bu rgyu ma nang khrol lu gu rgyud bar ma chad pa/ /ko gru rgyongs shig pa ste grur spyad dngos sogs bkang ba'am gru nyid cher btang ba'i skul tshig rgyang byed kyi shing cher gtong byed kyi shing yin la rgyang sheng zhes pa ltar na rgyang bar byed pa'i don khrig rgyu bye ma nyi 'od rlung gsum tshogs pa las chur snang yang don la ma grub pa chu la sob/sa pa'i rgyun bar ma chad pa/ /rgya gar rgya nag gi lul rgya 63

khyon che ba lto rgyab zas gos skyid/ /dgra las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma g.yul las rgyal ba rgyal kha thob pa dang rgya ma rgyang shel rgyus shig chu rgol cig rgyag pa gad rgyangs rgyab pa mi rgod rgod pa la sogs pa rar btags pa'i ga'o/ /(lga) la mgo can gyi lga ni lgang ba gcin sgod la 'jug pa gcig lur res so/ / (sga3 sgom pa 'dris pa goms pa bsams don yang yang yid la byed pa chen po blo gros dam po zab pa sgrin po mkhas pa dang 'gran por go sprun pa sdur ba 'gran pa/ /lhags kyi sgrog chings lcags thag sgor mo dbyibs gor gor te phyi sgor rgya sgor lta bur go skud pa dang rig pa sogs zim pa mi lhod par byed pa'i don yin zhing rbab dang shog bu sogs sgril ba lta ba dril byed pa/ /sprud pa skur ba stom las byed pa skyid pa lug pa don gyi le lo ste bya ba rlabs chen la zhum par byed pa dang rkang pa'i sgyid khug sogs kyang snyed bu spub snyed sa la sprel ba stol ba/ /sgyu rtsal drug cu re bzhi g.yo slu bsku sems gya gyu'am thabs kyis rang yon sgrog pa sgyu ma mig 'phrul snang la rang bzhin med pa sgrub gna' gtam sogs/ /lgam dang sgrom shing sogs kyi sgod yin chung ba la sgam chung dang sgrom bu zer sgro ba pags sgod rta sgro lta bu dang rleg pa snye mo ras sogs kyi sdod tre'u bye mo chung ba/ /jig mo chung ma'i ma'am zla bo'i mas sgo nga bya sgong ri'i sgog pa gi ru zos nas rgyags pas sgregs pa kha nas gsung pa/ /sdig pa mi dge ba de kho na nyid la sgrib par byed pa nyon shes kyi sgrib pa lta bu chu bo las sgrol ba rgal bar byed pa chos dang chu sogs kyi za rna yul sgrogs pa 'byin pa'am klog pa sgrogs shig pa yang / /bya yi sgo gshog pa sogs la yod pa spu lta bu bshad pa'i sgos tshul mchu sgros kha mchu gral sogs sgrigs shig pa ste mthun par byed pa/ rgyab kyi 64

rgal ba'i tshigs pa nul ba ni skyod cing g.yo bar byed pa lga sprug sga skya sma ser sgo'u gsher sman sga rlon/ /sped mo gcer bur go khang pa'i sgo rnam thar sgo gsum smra ba'i sgo thabs tshul sogs kyi drub du zheg pa mdzes pa mo skug pa ma yong bar du mi 'gro bar sdod pa phebs thug zhu lta bu/ /kang pa'i jid par gos sogs rgab pa'age bas pa sgro ku dru bus sgrog pa 'ching ba//dbang du sgyur ba gzhan ༷phrul dbang byed kyi rgyal po dkar phyogs la dga' ba 'khor lo sgyur ba gling gcig gnyis sogs kyi rgyal po sgyur byed sgyur ba po/ /lag pa rgyal mtshan sogs speb bgyen du slong ba zas zan sgong ba ril mor byed pa bu ram dang bzhes spro sogs sgor ba brtsas pa'am bskol nas sra bar byed pa'i don yin nam snyam sgor cig pa yang / /da ra gur tshogs stod sgar chos sgar dmag sgar sogs kyi nang du rta sogs la bstad rgyu'i gser dang ko ba sogs kyi sga yis sgron ma'i me snang byed sgrib pa mi mthong bar byed pa/ /srid spub skya bseng bu lnga'i ya gyal brgya byin gyi bu 'phags pa glu spub zab mo lta ba'i srol 'byed kyi slob dpon sgrol bam rje btsun tre pa sbob byed sprub thabs sogs/ /mna' sgog pa mna' skyel ba skyogs rdo 'phrul 'khor gyis 'phen pa'i rdo dang 'ur rdo me skyogs sogs kyis spu do lus smad 'ur rdo yod tshad ga chog pa bcag pa/ /da sgos da cha sgos su sger du rtsib pa sgron pa kha gso ba rgyan sgron zhib sgron sogs/ /sku stegs stegs bu dang sgeg chos sgang pa mtho ba mdo khams sgang drug lta bu gdangs sa dma' ba tsha sgo ba tsha can/ 1sgrob 'gying tshugs/ sam dregs pa'am mi chen gyi tshus byed pa dang sgrom gsob dang khog gam tshugs sgrom chen mgo sgrom lta bu dang sgrog sgobs sgrig sgrims sgrubs sgongs sgoms sgod sgre bo sgro 'dogs sgros gtsang rigs skre smres la sogs pas ra btags ga'o/ /66

(bdaka bshad ma ba rgo la ba brtsad cing brtag rngo4 dpyad ba brga' ba brtsad pa'i bsnan rtsod lan bgrud cu dang ba rgyad grangs ka /phreng ba grangs brgya phrag gam tham pa skud par brgyus pa brgyu bas brgyan pa spras pa'am mtshan pa/ chu brgal ba rgal ba da brgyal ba dka' lab sam nga 4 dub dran pa med par brgyal ba 'khams pa rmongs pa/ /lung sogs brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'am gcig nas gcig tu 'brel ba sta bu lam gyi rgyags lte brgyags pa rgyags pa sprud pa spyo ba'i don gyi brgyad bkag ste brgyad rwa1 dang rgyad pa3nga 'thad snyam/ /le brgan dar dmar gur kum tshos gad mo brkyang ba sgyur skad bton pa 51 ba / rdo re gtam ba kyi sbyo 1 ba rdzun smra ba zhal brgya byab ku ba rbas zhes zhal shob gsungs pa/ /brgyugs pa chu sob/sa rgyug rwa'i 1 —na ba dan zab༄ rtogs theng brgyungs ba gzhungs pa sgal ba'i kad par go brgyud ma bar ma chad pam tho ba ba sbyod ba pa rgyab pa/ /brgyag brgyags brgyang ba rju/ba1 she pargyab sogs bas 'phul ra mgro ldam pa'i ga'o/ /(bar she bu ram sogs brga ra ba sgor kang bzab ba1 pa grangs su bcug nas bsgongs pa sgong ba/ /rgya cho sa bod du badz+ra pa ༄ ba sprur ba mdog dkar po dmar por bsgyur ba spru ra ba ba1kar gsu nga bzo / ba dang bsgos pa gnang ba bslab ston byed pa/ /chu sogs las ba5shā la ba spro — ba chos sogs bsgrags pa sgrog pa 'i sti ba/ gi hong 'ji na bsad che/ ba/tan tre / ku bsgoms pa sgom pa/ /mgo bsgre sa ba ma ko bya tshungs byab pa ri gas brjes pa rigs 'gre byas pa rgyal mtsham ba dan bsgo ba pa ༄ pa sgreng ba1 /ma mad bsgags pa sgog pa lam sogs su ba tshigs nga— sprub/ pa se ba pe ba bgyib ba pa 'gying tshugs bstan pa/ /gnyes snang so gas kyi ba po ma ba ra bsgo ba dang bsgos pa bzhag pa rje re kyi 4 'ape /sa pa phyogs gcig tu bza ba 66

pa sgrig pa/ /sgron ma'i 'od sogs bsgribs pa sgrib pa blo rig sogs bsgrims pa sgrim pa sra da bu skud pa bsgrims pa sgrim pa/ /bsgrub ba dang bzab bya gnyis sprub byed kyi yu/'a bzan pa sprun par mi nus/ /bsgrin pa sgrin pa 'gran par mi za1 da pa dang zu ba la 'jug pa'i bsnang bya ba'i dkyil lam byed bzhin pa/ /ba sgro — sha ba sgrol byung sgra skad bsgrags pa sgrog pa skar rtsis sogs su gnyis kyis gsum bsgyur bas drug lta bu sgyur ba/ /gzhan nam pha rol lpis mi bgyi la ba mi ga yo ba mi sgul ba mi brji ba nor bsgang sa~Xdī gsa~Xrdo ༵༵༵ ༵ ༵go/ lda/rdo dī hūṃ ga ༵/skug/ bsgrag bskrubs nga(dang3 snyan pa'i dbags ni snyan ngag ste dpag 'khri sogs dang tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos kyang zil dngar bdud rtsi'am sbrang rtsi tshar du dngar ba gral du lgig pa/ /gser rin chen dang po dang dngul rin ched gnyis pa dngom che rtsa chen rin spung che ba sogs dngos po 'dus byas soṭa dngos po med pa 'dus byas su ma grub pa/ /mchog thun gyi dngos grub dngos gzhi ma gzhi'am rtsa ba mchod pa sogs dngos su bshams pa dngos ngom rgyu dngos dngos btags dngos shugs dngos ming sogs/ /dngangs pa sngangs pa bog pa dang na 'then gzhan gyi nor khyer ba phyir mi sprod pa ma bab chu'i dngo chu ngogs sam chu kha/ /gcod byed gri yi dngo rdo so dang ro dngar dngang ba sogs das ma phul nga'o/ / (mang) mnga' ris mnga' ris skor gsum dang 'bangs mnga' 67

snyen bas mngab bog chab 'bangs mnga' thab dbang thang mnga' ba yod pa'am gsa'— ba1 /mnga' mdzad dang mnga' bdag dpang po'am gtso bo che ba ba/ ba/thub/ bun g.yog gam pho nya 'phrin ba nga ba/ba pa btang ba sog ra// /dbang po sogs kyi mngon sum tshad ma dang mngon sum du mthong dngo 3/ su mthong so/ba ma mngon kyur ༄nga mtshan dang yon tan rngo gas mngon du kyur pa mngon mtshan mjon gsal che ba bun skyed sogs mngal bu sdod/ /mngon spyod drag lab/ mnga' brnyes pa dbang thob pa mngan mi bgrab ba skyon mi brjod pa/ /dam chos mchon pa'i sde snad lha'i mig sogs kyi mngon par shes pa lnga'am drug mngar ba'i ro dngar ba yang 'thad/ /thugs 'a ma ba 'a ba ldan pa yod pa gsal ba 'dzin pa mngar cha shing mngar yin par mngon mngag pa sobs mas 'phul nga'o/ /(za she ri dwags jon pa po khyi ra ba'i ming za ma las byas pa'i bsil 'a ba brdung bya'i za chen sogs rje'u rnga chung / /zam pa zhes pa'i don ba kres pa chags pa zab pa stogs pa chags pa za mo tsher mar dga' ba'i dud 'gro zhig je'u rnga mo chung ba'am rnga phrug /rngom brjod gzi brjid che ba'am ngo mtshar jam pa khro ba'am 'di jigs tshul pags nad jo bag can za 'phrug can/ /dbubs dang chang sogs jub pa 'then pa zug zu zug gzer dang ma dbus jod mkhan sha sogs rngod pa po lus zul ba dang rngul gzan rngul nag sog sa/ /jo yis khyer ba ham pas khyer ba dre'u rngog grum tse las kyi zab byis pa'i za zad pa gsol ras lta bu bdab / /za ma mjug ma jog ma ze mthug po'i don can gyi zam ste rngams kyang snang zo mi thogs pa mi nus pa mi phan pa ngo mi tsha ba/ /za spyad za zad brnyas thabs sam mi rtsi ba dka sngon dang btsas ma za ba gcod pa rgyu za/ mig skyo'am mig skyag ba ba / zad ba —68

kyi bye brag la 'jug pa'i rngog ste rngog lo chen po sogs dang rngom bag can rngos jib rwa rngam po sogs rar btags nga'o/ /(snga she zhal snga spyan snga'am klu'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad ces sam zhal nyid spyan snga mig snga'am drung snga so mdun nam snga mar snga sor yang snang sngon ma snga ma sngon dus sngon 'gro/ /gsang ba'i sngags yid skyob pa'i don sngags pa sngags 'chang mdog mkha' ltar sngon po sngo ba sngon po'am sngon por byed pa/ /snga dro nyin phyed tshun sngas mgo gzhan sa la spur ba gnyid ka che ba/ /snga ma'i dus sngon dus skyo sngogs 'khrug long mon gyi sran ma rje'u zan chung zhig /snga mdang pyi ma sngon rjes spun sngon nam mdun du go sngo ba spel ba'am sbyin pa'am sgyur bar byed pa/ /mtshang skyon nas sngog pa'abru ba kha sngog pa dang gzungs sngags smre sngags rnam par sngos shig sngogs shig sobs sar btags nga'o/ /(bza) bzan pa mchod ba'am rngan pa ster yang bzams pa brngab pa ste stogs pa'am chags nas btsas ma lo tog bzas pa rnga ba/ /bud med sogs bzod pa 'drid pa'am slu ba dang rngon pa gshor ba'am ri dwags gsod byed kyis badz+ra na pa ri dgas bshar ba/ /zang sogs bzubs pa rngub pa dang brngo brngos brnga ༄brngam brngub sogs bas 'phul rar btags nga'o/ /(bsnga) lus sems kyi spug bsngal ba mi bde ba bstod pa'i don can gyi bsngags pa yon tan brjod pa bsngo bya'i dge bas bsngos pa sngo ba//ram par bsngos bsngon por gyur bdang mtshang nas bsngog pa sngog pa dang bsngogs mdog bsngo sogs/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nga'o/169

cargyu mtshan nam dgos pa ci'i spad dang ci'i phyir gnyis gang gi byer ldan pa'i don ston byed kyi can te mig can rgyan can rgyu can lta bu dang khyed can khyod drung sogs/ /bdag cag nga cag kho bo cag nga tsho'am rang cag 'o skol sbyi cer skra med spyi ther sum cu dang / /drug cu dang bdun cu dang brgyad cu dmas grangs kyi khyad par/ /lhan cig dang babs cig gnyis chabs cig mnyam po bya rdzogs kyi da bad brjeb ma sogs dus kyi tshad tsad / 1khyed cag khyed tsho khyod cag sems can sems ldan yod do cog yod tshad shes so cog yin no cog sogs dang 'dra cog kyang / /can ce can zhe'am phor par go cab chob za ba'i sgra zang sogs co re rngub pa'i sgra'am blug pa'i sgra/ /ha cang shin tu'am thal che ba cas cus tshugs shor ba mi brtan pa mi drang ba bab rtsol ma brtags pa'am byung rgyal mang / /ci ste gal te'am ci phyir cub zad nyung zad phyin ci log pa yang dag min pa'am nor ba/cang ci yang shes pa ste mngon shes cig shos gcig po'am ngos bzung ba'i ya ste mkhas pa'i cig shos mi mkhas pa legs pa'i cig shos mi legs pa lta bu ci nas kyang gang nas kyang ngam nges par/ /co ho dang co ni skra'i ming thor chog thor tshugs chod pan dbu rgyan dang / /rgya cang ska rags kyi bye brag be chon dbyug pa de lha ci blos ci bshad dam bshad ci dgos/ /ca co sgra'i tshogs sam ku co cal chol bab col lam mi brtan pa'am gtam nyog mu chor don dang mi 'brel ba'i gtam mam rgyu mtshan ltar snang dang / /co 'dri ba gnod pa'am 'gran pa cig car dus mnyam cam dal gyis 'jog pa/70

rtsog pu gur chung bar go car re bcar ba'i tshul mig rtse re lta tshul dang ce re long lta bu/ /lan cig lan ma gcig tshar cig cis kyab gang gis kyang ngam ci nas kyang yul ci ru yang ma grub pas blos cir yang mi rtog gang du yang mi sems/ /kha cig 'ga' zhig cab gang yang mi zhes kyab rtsob rol mo/ /cang gshang dang cang te'u ṭa ru chung ba ci phab gang yang brdung / /smyug cu gang sogs sman zhig cung zhi cong zhu snye rdo sman zhig cur jis phye ma kaṇ+ḍa'i zur chag yin snyam kha la za/ /rtse spyang gcan gzan khye spyang zad ga ca sgra brnyan gyib rgyud snyed ba/ dra/ gang zhig bya dgos med dam mi nus/ /cog rtse mdun cog la sogs par go tho cho rtsing po ste tho co'i spyod pa spyod pa rtsing po lta bus cung beng changs bu cung peng ltar na thug pa kha la za/ /ci ga ci zhig gam ci yin nam ji ltar dang kag cor ku co cag cag cing ces ce'o ce na cig 'dra cog la sob/sa pa ca rkyab ngo / /(gcad gros gcom pa gros byed pa gcong nad nad rnying gcad bya shing lta bu gcod pa 'thub pa 'dreg pa 'gog pa sel ba/ /khon gcubs pa yid mi mthun pa yid gcugs pa mdza' ba yid mthun pa gcen spun che ba sngon skyes dang gcung spun chung ba rjes skyes/ /gcud la por ba gtan la phab pa 'dul ba lag pa yon por gcus pa sgril ba lta bu phug tu gcur ba 'jur ba 'dul ba'i don yin zhing gcun pa 'jun pa 'dul ba/ /mi ldan sogs rgam par gcod pa dgag pa yongs su gachod pa sgrub pa ste rnam gcod du byel yin pa bkag na yongs gcod du thag khru sgrub pa lta bu zhal lce khrims dang chad pa sogs gcod bzhin pa/ /gtsang rob ngam grog gzung skad gcong nad can gyi skad dam gcong rong gi skad dam skad nga gcin pa dri chu gci ba dri chu'am dri chu gtong ba lta bu/ /the tshom sogs gcod 71

bzhin pa da lta ba 'a jal bzhin pa yang gces 'dzin med pa gceb1 spras dang gal che'am dgos lta bur yang gces 'jug phan tshun gcig gis gcig la bshad sogs/ /bcam bu bcos ma'i ngag gam bcos bstod dam bcos ma kha gcang kha rnya na nam kha gsag bcugs pa mthun pa med pa gces dgos/ /tshar gcod pa 'pham par byed pa 'joms pa gcu gal do gal lam khag yid la gcags pa yid la 'jags pa/ /za gcan gza' zhig gcam gzan stag gzigs sogs la gcan pa la tshugs pa'am la'i smo gam pa/ /stsogs gcig mtha' gcig gam logs shig byu gcal du bkram ‘ chal mar brdal ba grabs kyi khyad par gcig gnyis/ /bu ram dang snang sems sogs ro bcig ba khyad med pa rdzas dngos po'am rang bzhin gcig pa tha mi dad pa gcer bu sgren mo ga chog pa bcag pa/ /gci'u ni chu sogs 'then gtong byed pa'i sprug sbubs lta bu yin la des bshang lam du gtong ba'i sman dang gcag gcom skyung kha tshon gcod nad gcod thag gcod sogs gas 'phul ca'o/ /(bcad bdud bzhi bcom pa 'joms shing yon tan drug dang ldam 4sangs rgyas nyon mongs sogs kyi dgra bcom pa 'khor dang bcas pa yod pa'am ldan pab zhabs kyis 'chag sar bsgyur gab pa mnan pa'am phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas pa/ dam bca' ba khas len pa bsgrub bya khrims / ba bca' ba bzo ba bcas pa bcing ba 'ching bas bcibs pa bkyigs pa/ / shib sogs bcad pa gcod pa rlan gsher bcir ba btsir ba bcar yang snang bca' bya'i nas kyi yos sogs sos bcem pa bcag pa'am blad pa1 1tshigs sru bcad pa tshig rkang bzhi sogs bca' ba bzo ba'i gzhi bka' yi zlas bye ba'i bstan bcos mkhas pa'i gsung ngam 'chos skyob kyi cha nas 73

bka' ka'ang 'jug bcang ba lag tu 'chang ba/ (logs sam zur du ba ra ba nye bar phyin pa sku bcar ram bcar sogs bca' sga sman sga bza' ba lnga dang bca' ba lnga'i ro bcud bcud len dang bcud can lta bu/ /mig dang sgong sogs bcar ba ba mir ba sta bu phyir phyi rol tu bcilab bton pa'am spang4pa'am bsal ba chu bcu ba chu 'dren pa'am len par go ba ga pa las la sbyar ba nang du bcug pa'ang / /nor dab bu lon sog4bcal ba 'jal ba lag pa bcangs pa bzung ba 'chang ba 'dod spyod kyi lag bcangs gyang zabs bcag pa snam bu chu nang du mnyes pa las bcol ba las byed du bcug pa dang gtams pa'i bcol yang / /bcar ba rta ra'i ming rtar bcibs pa 'chib pa zhon bzhal lce dang chad pa sogs bcad pa gcod pa/ /rgol ba tshar bcad pa gcod pa blos bcal ba 'jal ba shes pa'am rtogs pa bslab pa ba cab pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang zadang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba bcabs pa gsangs pa 'chab pa/ /rdo sogs bcag pa gcog pa kang sogs bcer ba spungs pa gros brtsom pa grol byas pa bcam yang snang bcum pa chung ngur btang ba/ /bcu dang bzhi bcu dang lnga bcu dang / /dku bcu dang bco lnga dang brtso brgyad rnams grangs kyi khyad par brtsos pa bzos pa phyir bcos nad bcos sogs/ /brtsos bu bcos ma'i ras dang bcas bcos bcun bcur bcus bcab bco bcib sogs bas 'phul zad da/ / (lha) mnyen cing lhag pa mi gyong ba lhag phran yal ga gsar pa byu1dpa che shing rgya lcang la sogs bka ) byu1ba/ skul byed de thal lcag rta lcag skul lcag sogs/ /me tog sogs kyi mgo lhogs dud pa dang dog pa yin nam dpyad ches cher lci ba yang ba min pa blo yis sprugs pa khom pa'am nus pa/ /13

'khos chung ngam stobs chung nyin mo nyi ldan gyi dus mtshan mo zla ldan gyi dus nyal ba gnyid log pa'am gnas pa/ /nyams su dga'i ba yid dga' ba'i ngon nyib dgos dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'am dgos pa'i dgos pa'am dgos pa'i da bo'am ched du bya ba ste gnas skabs dpa mthar thug gi nying dgos nye ba thag mi ring ba'am legs par go nyon cig ste rna bas nyon kha la nyon lta bu/ /spos dri'i byug pa nyug pa 'byug pa lag nya ster mkhan med par len pas chos sangs rgyas las nyan cing gzhan la thos par byed pa nyams pa mi mthong ba rgud pa lhung ba mnar ba mi nus pa/ /pho nya bang chen nam pho mo'i bar du 'gro 'ong byed mkhan pho nya mo sogs nyi ma nyin byed dang nyi spu'i gnyen dang nyi 'od la sogs pa'i don nyen kor nye 'khor du go /nya ser mig me 'dzum pa'i sha zhes nya ga 'jal byed dam tshad nyi shu grangs ka nyos pa rin spyis nyo ba dang nyos shig kyang / /nying hor nges par mtha' gcig chu sogs (1ga pa mi dwangs pa mi gsal ba nye bar ze rdog pa ste khrus kyi khyad par nyang rus shig dang yul zhig dang ro myong la yang bshad/ /nye ba'am drung na gnas pa ste slob ma sogs nyug rum btsun mo'i 'khor cheg phyung nyan cing da gtod pa pho nya sogs nyid kho na nges gzung gi sgra'am tshig phrad de gzhan ldan sogs gcod pa'i sgra/ /nyag phran mda' nya rgyas zla ba nya gang ba dang nyar ma nyag phra bka' nyes byas nyes nyes stung bag nyal nyungs sogs nya rkyab ngo / /(gnya ) rgya bdapung gi gnyen pa rtsa lag ste mgon skyabs dge ba'i bshes grogs kyi gnyen pa nye ba ste bla ma sogs gnyis grangs kyi khyad par gnyen pa phan byed nye du rtsa lag /gnya' bar dgal ba'i shing rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing gnya3 shing gang tsam lta bu gnyer pa don nam rdzas gnyer mkhan khro ba'i gnyer ma dang rgas pa'i gnyer ma sogs dang / bka' snye3

gnyan/ ji1'am po bka' btsan pa'am po ba/nyan bur sogs kyi mad dang gnyan kha yang dud 'gro'i bye brag gnyan zhes pa ri dwags shig —gnya' bo dpang po don du gter ba 'dun cing 'jug pa'am len pa gnyan dang gnyags dang gcos 'di gsum rtses ming ste gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab gnyags two na ku mā ra ba/nyos kha rag sgom chung lta bu/ /gnyid dbang po nang du sdud pa gnyid mthug lta bu dang nya' ba gnyis kyi ming ga snyen po spong byed dam 'joms byed zhi byed gnon byed la sogs par 'jug gnya' ba sko'i rgyab cha stab/ pa rke rgyab kyi steng cha dang dzi ltag ltag chu ma/ṭa/ba ba 'tshol ba'am so bcu gas pa'am bya ra byed pa/ /gnyi ma nyi ma'i bzar zer gnyig gcig tra lus sogs gnyong ka stobs sam sran chung / gnya' ba rengs pa 'a/nga shor ram dred pa'am spyong za gnye ma nang khrol rgyu ma zhig nyag dzo / tham 'a mor gnyag pa dam 'a bar byed pa'am za ba'i ldan ba4nyeg dzi ra na dab/'a ba nyid/ /ba/ṭa/bka che ma bcos pa so ma rang bzhin snal ka/ gnas lugs ba3g sems gnyug gnas la sogs pa'i don dang gnyig gnyis ka sogs ga sa 'phul nyam da/ 1(mnya) nyan pa gru pa'am skya ba 'dzin pa thugs se mas mnyes pa dgyes ba 'ad/ dga' ba da bas sgra mnyan pa nyan pa/ mnyed pa dab mnyes pa ba/nyis 'phur ba 'dzom ba— pa rdub ba sprus pa mnyen pa1ra byeng/ pa sgab sogs mnyen pa snyi bkyi 'jam pa dul ba mnyan du yod pa bzas kyi khyad mar zhib/ ste 'dir ston pa lo nyer bzhi bzhugs/ /ting 'dzin la mnyam ba mtshungs par gzhag pa 'jog pa mnyam pa 'dra ba'am zla med pa mtshungs pa'i don can gyi mnyam pa skyon yon ring thung lci mang sogs ma'i ma pa/ /ra mnye sman rtsa ba lnga'i gcig yid mnyes pa'am snyi zhing ga'i na pa ste mdza' ba'am grob/sa dang zhan ‘4'i mnyam pa mnyem ba sogs ba ba ma bsnyeb nyam da/ /84

(snyad 'dam dang chu sogs kyi stog ma nyog ma mi dwangs pa mi gsal ba dang 'dam gyis rnyag pa snyed pa nor rdzas dang 'thob pa bkur sti rjed pa'am mchod pa'am dam par byed pa'i don gsar pa'am so ma rnying pa'am —ma yun lon pa'i dngos po rnyed pa 'thob pa/ /so yi rnyil so'i sha rnyang ma mi gtsang ba'am rlag mo snyob 'khru ba dang gal dang rlag mo dang rnyi ri dwags 'dzin byed kyi rgya/ /lhang lo sogs tsha bas rnyid pa rnyis pa rlon rkyang min par skam shas ldan pa ma snyob pa lag pas ma stob pa ma rnyil rin chen dbang sngon te i dre dī la'i zur chag /rkang ba pa dang lag pa snyob pa krong ba dang dku ma rnyengs rnyegs sogs rar btags nya'o/ /(bsta) da/ sgru1bad sngo sman zhig :snyim zad sra ba brtan pa gtso bo sba ba rnam ga leng rang bzhin snyid mo pha'i sring mo'am zhang po'i chung ma'i don snying nang khro ka lgeg kam sems/ /ba/ rtse stob ba khro ba skyung ba zad ba pa myos 'gyur bka'i kyib nyal du 'ju / ྾ 'am bsnyal ba dang stol cig snye ma 'bru dang 'bras bu'i dog pa 'bru phung dang re rtse snyil ba 'joms pa bshig pa zhig pa skrod pa dang snyil cig /tha snyad ming ngam shes brjod 'jug pa'i yul lam kun rdzob ji snyed tsa tsam de rnye da de tsam snya ma pa sems pa'am rtog pa'am ltar/ /stems pa nga rgyal dang skru'/ chig dang lhan pa nad dman pa dang skul tshig med dgag chig snyan kun ba rna rgyan nam rna shal lam snyan dar dkab 'jam pa'am rgya'am dwags po'i rus/ /cha sgom ba par ma rgyud pa/ pa dgu sogs mnyam par gzhol ba'o chags sdang bde sdug 'du byed mi byed btang ba spangs nas stoms pa mnyam par byed pa ste bar ma'am sgang blang med pa'am nyon mongs med pa so bkas stom las le lo'i bye brag bde bar zhen nas brtson mi nus pa dang / mchog dman bar ma'i bsod nams sgoms pa mnyam ba ra byed pa sdod bu'am slong rma lhags yun 86

nam rgyun srings ring ba'am byos shig dang snyugs tsha snyugs grang yang rjes su snyeg pa 'jug pa'am 'gro ba'am 'brang ba'i sar snyogs shig snyeg pa'i skul tshig gam grub mtha' stogs pa yang / /snyib rje thugs rje'am cung zad da ma snying sdug lta bu'i ming snyim pa khyor ba do'i tshad dam spul mo snyobs shig lag pas stob pa'i skul tshig stoms la 'jub min dpyad snyes pa sngas sogs la nyal 'phres byed pa/ /snyon mongs nyon mongs sam nyon mongs par byed pa snyad ka skyon nam khag 'dogs pa btags pa rgyal mtshan sogs rtsol ba bsnyal ba'am skyel ba/ /gnyam rna bar snyan pa 'jebs pa'am rna ba snyigs ma tshigs ma'am stog ma'i dus dang snyigs shig skud pa gtam zas snyod pa ring du gtong ba 'chad pa zas kha nas khar 'jug pa'am blad pa lta bu/ /snyang snyogs byed pa nyag nyag byed pa'am rmugs pa lta bu yin nam sems sgoms pa mnyam par byed pa'am 'bring ngam bde bar gnas pa dang stom gcin snyi snyul snyung snyig stob snyen snyer snyug stor sogs sar btags nya'o 1 /(ba me long gi gzugs brnyan pa'am po g.yar ba 'a/ po dang tshab sgra brnyan yang de bzhin te brag ca gzhan la bsnyas pa rngan chan byas pa dang brnyas thabs /mnga' dbang brnyes pa thob pa phyag brnyan lag g.yar ram tshab ste g.yog 'khor brtan po g.yar bo'i don bsnyas pa g.yas pa'am g.yar ba/ /gos sogs brnyibs pa rnying ba kha bstogs pa kha 'dris pa'am lang shor dang chu rnyag snab brtan sku 'dra'am 'dra cog bsnyan pa g.yar ba brnyang ltar na rnyeng ba dang brnying btog brnya sogs/ /bas 'phul ra mgro ldan pa'i nya'o/ /(bsnya) dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas dang bsten rdzogs te spang bya lnga brgyad thar sa cad slong bar mnos pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa yin bsnyen pa 86

nye ba phye ma ba rdzogs bsnyen du yang 'gyur bston pa bsten pa nye bar byas pa 'grogs pa/ /bsgon can bston mkhan bsgon dor ming tsam dang bston btsubs pa ba bsten da ba ming tsam ste bston pa yin pa la min pa'am min pa la yin par brjod pa dang / /bste na pa dang nye ba'i bsnyen pa bsgrub pa dang sprub pa chen po'i yan lag bzhi lta bu bste/na cing bkra kar ba zhabs tog sog phye ma zhib mor bsnyil ba snyil ba 'thag pa/ /gtam bsnyad pa stod ma bshad pa bkyi brten ba pa stoms pa mnyam par byas zad ba ba ba ba ba stu1ba ba bsnyul yang snang ste bgrub pa'i don/ /phyir phyi rol du bsnyil pa bskrad pa'am bton pa mal du bu sogs bsnyal ba stol ba lha nga bzed bsnyigs pa snyig pa snyigs mar byas pa'am lhung bzed gdams pa'i lhag mar byas pa/ /ba ga pas bsnyabs pa stob pa reg pa ba'i ba ba na ba'am nad kyi gzhi yis bslun pa snyun pa na bar 'gyur ba'am na zin pas bsnyengs pa 'jigs pa/ /bsnyel pa brjed pa rme da pa nas dang nyes can bsgor ba stor ba rdung ba'am bshig pa yo byad byod dngos ba'i bas pa snyung du btang ba/ /bsnyen pa nye ba'am nye bar byed pa sring ba reng ba'am ring bar byed pa zas bstod pa stod pa kha nas khar 'jug pa'am blad pa lta bu dang byin pa'am gso ba skyu gang mtshon gang ba'i ga pa skyugs pa'am 'byug pa/ /bsnyems pa snyems pas rjes su bsnyegs pa snyeg pa khro ba'i gnyer ma bsnyer ba bsdus pa'am bstan pa dang bsnyeg bsnyig pa bsnyung bsnyugs bsnyam bsnyab rjes bsnyags kyang snang bsnyem sogs/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nya ro/ //stete por sra ba dka/ pa drag pa shin tu legs par te se gangs ri ra go 87

nyal ma de ma spug pa'am ma thob shes par go sob bzhud/ /dzā lha sman gyi khyad par sna ma tang kun sngo go stod 'dra zhing dri zhim can tig ta ti ka'i zu ra chag ste sum teb/ so/gas til dkar nag ti la snyu ma lta bu/ /twag sgyub dang cong tong dang tog tog ces pa'i sga byung na de dang de zer/ /tel pa ste'u dang me tel tob rtse 'jor spru dbyug to dbyug ba 'am phyab— mtshan zhig dang / /dbu yi ba/tsub hor spyi tor thor to kar tshugs spyi hor gtsug tor hog dpal te rtse mo phud mchog dang skra khrib/ kyang / 1spra rteg rin chen —zhig mu ka'i sgra nyams pa ched rta ma/ pad+ma sol she sam bsod stoms sam zla mtshan ta(1 ba zas shig gamaḥso—rtsi/ /'od sta ba/ lo thog da rta bka rtswa thog bza ba rdo ba/ rin chen gyi sgod dam mngar cha'i stsod dam ga'u/ /cing nge 'dzin ma1 mnyam par 'dzin pa rdo rje lha bu sogs mdo bkon mtshog ta la la sgron me'i don yin/ /tib za zan kong tal cung zad dam yid tsam jig tig nges nges med da/ /dge zad nyam da skyon min dge ba legs pa khe dang lci mang sogs 'bas hog bsnyen bkur ram drin can 'a phan pa nar nyan do gal lam nan tar ram brtson pa dang / /man tur khrims kyi chad pa'am chad lab 'dim te gal sbod brtag pa 64tha' gzung—ka'/ te na bod(1 ta ba rngo ༄ gas rgyub kyi khyad par ram thub pa/ /kha ton kha 'don gyi ming tsam tsam ta— ba ta'am bran g.yog nar tar ni bzang po dang na—zhe tan/ /ta zig kla klo'i yul zhig ta ming rgya nag gong che/ ta ming lta bu ta zhes pa rgya nag gi skad de chen po'i don te ka'ang snang ta'i si tu dang / /te dzi dang ta dben dang ta hub bzhi rgya na/ rga go sa'i ming dang phyi ma dar dmar la'ang 'jug pa bdang / /tā ra ṇa rta babs te gzhal yas khang gi sgo'i phyi na yod pa'i la ba rgyan can sogs dab te'u shang shang shang gis bteg ba'i khri/ /tam lu ra sgra snyan nam rgyud 88

mang dang ting yon chab kyi sgod ting shag rol mo zhig teng dkags kyang snang / /nyo nyi dang nya la gnyis shing gi bye brag tres sam phye ma'i ming zhang zhung gi skad dang / /shang bang te'u bya shang shang chung ngu'am phrug gu te te brdung bya'i rnga brdub / /'on tang 'on kyang yi na mod lib tog mig sgrib byed dang 'on te ta spru ga ta gal ta su ga ta tur gyis dran lhag bcas kyi te sogs ta rkyang zad / /(gnya) gtar nam gzhag rgyun gyi don bsam pa dmigs yul (ka gtan du bar gnas pa btan du gnas pa las mi 'da' bar byed pa'i mi rdo snags mtshams su gyur pa sprub byed dam rtags sogs gtam brjod pa gtam pa bshad pa/ /gtun bu mas gtun lag pa la sogs par gtad pa gtod pa byin pa bkal—ba phog pa gzir ba mthu gtsun shing yas gtun gcubs pa dum bur 'thub pa/ /bzung gtag rdung 'tshog gtong ba rgyab pa'am sbyin pa dang gtang rag legs 'bul gnyang pa sbyin pa/ /gter 'byung gnas sam nges par 'dzin pa mjod nor khang bongs su gtams pa gang ba bcol ba gtad pa bshad pa gtor ma 'byung gtor sogs zam dang chu me tog gtor ba 'thor ba bkam pa kha 'thor du 'jug pa/ /bu lon len pa'i nor gyi gta' ma dang gteng pa dang gnya' gsum bu lon gyi tshab lta bur bzhag pa'i dngos po/ /gtar nga sgo gtan nam sgo glegs kyis bkag pa med pa'i spyo na pa bar ma chad pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba dang gtang ba gnyis ster ba 'dor ba glob pa rgyab pa/ /gtum po khro rngam can nam gdol ba'i don zhabs rkang pa la spyi bos gnugs pa reg pa'am thug par byed pa'am bsten pa zad pa'i don can gyi bdugs ba 'dzangs pa klas pa thub/ rwa bsgyu nga / /lha chen pha go ba'i gtogs 'dod dbang sdi ga gzhan la rdzas so bas gtod 89

pa gtad pa/ /'bem mda'i dmigs yul lta bu la gtod pa gtad ji/ gzir ba dang bsgom byar dmigs pa bsam pa gtod pa gtad pa rtse gcig tu sems pa dang gtod cig kyang / /gti sprug ma rigs pa rtso/ngas pa ga31la cha rgyub/ gdeng nges shā thabs med mtshang skyon nas gtol ba 'bru ba/ /khug gtar ba gtsag pa 'don pa chu dang snyum gnyags pa thigs pa 3bab tu 'jug ba se gol ka togs pa rgyab pa/ /nor bco' ba'i don la 'jug pa'i gnyams pa gdams pa dang grangs kyi khyad par gtams ba/krigs/ /spo'i gtan pa gdan bu'am sgo 'phar gting dbus kyi mtha' 'am dkyil zab mo dpag dka' ba bsnyed da ba dang sprin sogs bdakar ba pa bgrigs pa tshogs pa/gtur bu snam sbyar sogs kyi sgod spos reng sogs btul ba sbar ba'am bdug pa ri po la sogs pa'i gtos che chung gi tshad da ma bong / /mgro bo sogs btums pa g.yogs pa mab6'a la gtugs pa zad pa thug pa bkab/ pa bkar ba khobs spyogs su gcom gas pa 'the ba 'dus pa brlan pa /gtan du gnas pa la 'bebs pa don gnas dang mthun par byeb pa dang gtum mo gtar kha gti thub/ gtong ba sogs gas 'phul ta'o/ /(btad bya sgro mda' la don du med kyang sbyar ba ltar red pa la yod ji/ra btags pa sprar ba bzhag pa 'dogs pa ming btags pa brda'am tha snyad sbyar ba 'dogs pa kha btags lha reg ba/ma dar dang pham ‘4ra byas pa btags pa g.yob/ sa pa bcings pa brgyan pa 'dogs pa/ /spyir btang ba dmig ba kyis ma bsal ba'am thun mong du btang ba'am thun mong blo sogs kyis btang ba gtong ba dor ba sngabs me tog btu ba dang tshad ma ca ngon ba4 bslab pa mdo kun las btus pa gnyis / 'thu ba sdad ba/ /spol bcod pa b.lugs ka dod du 'jug pa'am 'dzugs/ pa gdan dang gzhi bcing ba 90

'dir ba/ pa 'grems pa rkyong ba 'dzugs pa sa ngon skyed byed kyi rgyu btab pa 'debs pa rgyab pa/ /btang bzung ni klu zhig dang ri btang bzung gis don gnyis ka go bteg pa 'debs pa gyen du slong ba 'jam ba 'gro ba gso' ba zhu ba btab pa phum ba 'debs pa btud pa 'dud pa dgu ba'am phyag 'chal ba/ /btab/ba bsgyu tha ga pa'i 'thag sprad kyi bye brag byu1ba ba btab ba pa rtags kyes mtshan pa bza' bya'am bza' ba zas ba byung bya'am btung ba shom btub ba bla'am rung ba dang gtubs pa/ /me tog dang spu btogs pa 'thog pa 'then nas tha dad du byed pa rtsa ba sogs bton pa 'don pa 'byin pa bkob/ pa bkol ba ba btag ba pa phye dang thag 'thag par shes dgos shim btu' ba bkod ba'am las su rung ba dang pham par byas pa 'dul ba/ /mgrid ba gye na du bteg pa sgeng ba 'degs pa dang btog btag btang stoms bye na btang bya btang sogs bas 'phul ta'i / / /(rta she mi dgag tshig rtag pa brtan pa 'gyur med rgyun pa mi nyams pa rang bzhin zad me da rgyun mi 'chad mnyam nyid rtab rtang brel brel tshabs tshabs skrag chu'/ rtab rtab po yang sbyar bdab ba po nub ba mi no ba brtul ba dang rtul po zad ba/ba skyos ma mtshan ma rgya sprub byed mtshon byed shes byed/ /ci/ che/ma/ nga me shes dang gnyid kyi shes pa dang dbang shes sogs te mi sems pa'i don yid stod da pa cha 'jog pa'am yid ches pa yid brtan pa rtob/ pa dpyod pa dang lda na pa jegs pa shes pa dang nges pa/ 1dus rtag tu rtag par rta chu gyogs 'a gro la rte'u rta phrug gam chung ngu skyes pa rting ma rjes ma phyi ma/ /stol gog glang dang ma dzo mo 'dus pa'i bu rtol pho'am mo rting pa rkang ba'i phyi rteng rtod pa 'ching bas bcing ba pa rtod thag rtod phur sogs kung / /ru rta thes pas sman bye brag pa zhig go bar byed nyan ba shed mo rtab pa rgyas pa ba/nas 91

su rtol ba preb pa'am 'byor ba dang rnag rtol ba/ /mong rtul blan po rtul — da rngod da snying stobs che ba'am pha ro la gnon pa rten gzhi yan lag can gnas pa skyos ma skyabs sags rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba stong nyid yod pa dngos po ltas/ /mchod pa'i rten brgyad lta bu rta babs tā ra ṇa bya ma rta bya rta min pa'i sprur 'gro ste pho nya'am bang chen/ /rta thul lnga sde'i gcig rta dbyangs slob dpon dpa' bo rtog ge pa rtog pa po'am dpyod mkhan te so skye lta bu dang rtog ge sde lnga'am 'bar ba yang / /mi gtsang ba la grags pa'i rtug pa skyag pa dang rtug dri dang rton pa bzhi lha rten rnam rtog so so ra rtog pa rtogs pa brtan pa'am dbang du bya ba rtal ba sdud pa 'jam pa 'dul ba dpa' ba zhan pa mi no ba rtul cig rten cig sogs rar btags ta 'o/ /(lha de sto bas ba gro ba brang 'gro sprul lho ( re gro'i sgra yang 'thab ltag pa ske rgyab kyi steng cha de lha bu mtshungs pa/ /lho bas 'phye ba 'gro bas bdag ji/ khyad par la go ba'i da sgra byed nga lus kyi dbus cha sa sogs kyi dkyil che/ gzhi ngo mar go ltad ched gzegs mo lta ba blta ba'am grub mtha'i lta ba/ da sto ba grod pa pho ba mngal dkyil lto zas sam bza' bya yis snyir gyis stem gye te bkang ba'i tshul/ /bur bu ram mar tshos sogs kyi ltang che rkyar pa'am sgod 'di grang pa rgyags pa stod ba/ba pa bkres pa bad lha dus kyi khyad par ram sprur ba ltos shig lta bar byos dang ltos pa zhu ba dang gcig la gcig sto ba rwa / /dngos lhar du snang ba mngon pa yang dag—min pa ltag chod spran 'byin ster snang grub mtha'i lha ba phyin ci log gi/ /sgyub ba lhung bar byed pa ste ltung ba sde lnga sogs kyib bstan / mtshan ma bas zad pa mi legs pa bsta chos lta sgog spud kyang mi shes zhes pa'i lta lta bu ci smos / /lteng rgyas 'ed spungs kyi ba brag gam steng ka rgyas pa lteng shā/ char chu 'khyel bad gshong bu ltem gyis rte ra gyis 92

gang pa/ /re ba'am ltos pa blo gtad byed pa dang ming tsam ja sta phar zhog chu yang med mda' yi ltong ka gzhu rgyud dang sbyar rgyu'i kha/ /lhar lhar dbyibs sam mngal gyi gnas skabs shig stem rkyang ngam ltem kyang mi brtan pa'am mtho dma' dang lteb ltab ltos grub ltar da ltar ltag gong steng yan la 'jug pa sogs lar btags ta'o/ /(stag bstan bya ston pa bstan pa dang ston po'i don bzhugs pa'i stangs ka 'dug tshul bkur ba'i yul du ste ba gnas par byed pa ste mchod pa stobs shig byin cig rol cig byos shig /stes sam ste sa dbang stabs legs mu steb/sa byed dam pa byi ror pa byad stems mthu gtad kyis/ /mi sto mi skyon lha stangs lta tshul me stag me'i tsha tsha'am lo stegs bu gtor stegs zhogs/ /sta zad da 'og grabs stod ba ba pon pa'i 11ba/ba rogs ldan da bad (re ba 'a zhig gam kho na byed/ /gzhogs stegs zur mig 'jo sgeg mdzes pa'i zhem 'gyur stangs stabs gom pa 'dor tshul sta zur dku'am dpyi ston ba bstan pa1/ /'ing— stag pa gro ga'i shun can gyi shing rdzug po mthug po sra ba gar ma'i 11 spyod bas nus pa'am ye shes car stab/ gcan gzan zhig /dgra bo 'jo6sa byed kyi sta re mchon sta re shing gcod byed ste'u sta re chung ba'am tel pa lhor ba 'bor ba'am rlag pa/ /shing star bu'i zhun ma sman star thog gi khaṇ+ḍa star ga'am ka bam spru zhig la go ba'i ming stson mo dga' ston shing ston sigs ste/ra ba sbyin ji// /lus sogs kyi stod bad dkyil yan chad 6pa grags stan gdan ngang ṭu mo mcha na ma dgag tshig ston pa bsten ba'i rten pa'i bye dri ga gam 3gro1ma/sa pa dang sten cig sdon yang snang / /ston ka dang dpyid ka dus kyi bad pa ra gang ba 'phe ba4 ba 'che4 gtams pa dang stong pa 'grib pa'am 3pre ma ya ste yi/sa mad4 mab/ dang stags grong chig stong phrag brgya tsho bcu / /93

stem pa thim du 'jug par byed pa so sto so zing so thags mi bzang bar go stor khung mi gtsang ba khrus chu sogs 'bab pa'i khung bu dang / /stang zil dngul rdo stabs gcig gom 'gros gcig lhan cig gi stabs cig la yang 'thad snyam stabs 'bul stabs ka sogs star phreng brgyus pa brgyu ba steng ma thog ka gong bla/ /stob ba zom stong khang stong lta bu sdod nang du dngos po gzhan med pa'i don sogs stong pa nyid rang bzhin med pa rten 'byung sogs dang star ba sprig pa rgyud pa phyi dor byed pa nyams su len pa gzabs ‘ dang cha sta steg chos 'phang stod stongs stangs ka stud stims sogs sar btags ta'o/ /(brta ) brtag pa dang dpyad pa gnyis rtog dpyod de 'jal ba'i don yul dang bslab pa'i gnas su brtan pa gnas pa mi ldog pa kun tu brtags pa blos bzhag pa gnyis snang lta bu ngo bo nyid gsum gyi gcig rtags pa rtog pa dpyad pa/ /yid brtan yid rton nam yid brtan po brtad pa glo bur pa brtul ba bsdus pa spangs pa 'ugs pa 'jug pa len pa ste spyod pa brtan pa'am po rtag pa byang sems sam 'gyur ldog med pa/ /sgo nga'i spubs sogs brtol ba rtol ba bshangs pa brtun ba brtson pa rtun pa byi bstol phod pa'am ngo tsha med pa brtabs pa 'jigs ba rtab ma/ /yongs 'du sa bstol dpag bsam shing sa brtol ba phug ste shing brtag pa rgyud kyi dum bu brtag pa gnyis pa dang so gnyis pa sogs dang brtag pa brgyad brtul ba rtul ba/ /brten pa rten gyi cig shos la go brten pa rten pa gnas pa stos pa 'grogs pa sogs phur bu phur bas brtod pa rtod pa bcings pa/ /brtas brta brtab rtog byed kyi brtag bya sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /pyi4

(bsta) bltos pa ltos pa'i sa thub dbang dang pha sogs bltos pa stos pa'i chos slob ma dang bu sogs ba lha bar rung ba 'os pa mig gis bstas pa lta ba/ /ba bya mig yul sogs sku dang rjing bu bltams pa skyes pa dang gang ba gos gdan gzan bltab pa lteb pa ltab pa nyis ltab sum ltab byed pa dang bltabs blta mtshan ma de 'di la bltas zhes sogs/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /(bsta)bste stang mchod pa dang gnas ba'i da pa mthud pa'am 'dud du 'jug pa'am brgyud pa bar chad du ma bcug pa bstud ma brgyud ma zhes pa'i don bsti ba ngal gso ba'i gnas gnas chen sogs bstar ba star ba/ /bub dbang gi bstan pa chos dang bstan pa stun pa mthun par byed pa bstod pa bsngags pa dang 'phang stod pa la 'jug par 'os bsten pa sten pa/ /bstang ba phan pa'am mgon grogs dang bcas pas ma bzub ba don med kyi bstan bcos sogs dgu lta bu bstan pa ston pa bshad pa/ /thag dang gos sogs kyi ring po bstubs pa nye ba'am thung du btang ba blo'am gdong sna bstad pa kha phyogs pa'am gtad pa sogs 'gro zas 'gro ba'i grabs bstad pa gshom pa sga bstad pa sga rgyag pa/ /bsting ba'i tshig 'phya chig bstem pa stim pas mi bstongs pa me phan mi stong mod kyang / /bsti ba ngal gsor med pa mnar med mngon par bstod pa bsngags pa'am mngon par dag3 ba byin len dang yo byad bstabs ḍa4 stob pa dang bstis pa bstab pa bstims pa bstung ba sogs/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /96

dpethun mong spyi thun thu bo rgan ‘/'am ga rtsa bo phu bo tha gru hūṃ 'a gru'am ste khyon che ba/ /thu mi sa sto ṭa'i ru‘ sa thon rnyi4 zheb pa thon yul gyi thu mi bsdus pa 'dra thor cob dang thor tshubs gnyis do ker dang / /tha rtsa shā da man pa phyi ma chung ngu tha ma na chung ngun jig jig lham gyi sgra 1 /thur kyen min ba 'a ma thur ma dab tha ma' phal pa rang bzhin dpa thul thar thang theg mab/ku thum1po thig le thug thugs thon thub pa thu ba thal 'gyur shod pa thal ba mab sa thab ba ba zhe ngo /(ma bshe mtho ba mthon tho 'i ris phyogs sam rigs che) tha' dag pa thams cad ba bsgyu blo sgyub pa mtha' yas sam mtha' gtugs pa ba 'dab mig gib rig pa mthong lam sogs/ /ba tha'i char (1ba pa mtha' la reg ‘4 rgyud ba pa'i don can gyi mthu ste stobs dang ngan sngags mthun pa mtshungs ku kun zugs pa 'byor ba mi mthur pa snga ma ) ldog phyogs/ /lag pa sgod sogs kyi mthil lto ba(rem 'og gi cha'am dkyil lam gzhi lta bu mthe bong ngam bo sor mo sbo3/ shos mthe'u chung sor mo phra shos/ /mthon ga dang mthon ka dang mthing ga sngon po'am sngo ba ste ming mtha' ci rigs drang zhing ma thing kha lta bu la mthing gi kha dog bsdus kyang 'gal ba med la tshu' 'di regs mthun kun ka sbyor mthang smad bos spyon pa mthug ba pa'am bo stug po srab mi/na/ /ma thar6gyis rim gyis te mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba lta bu rta'i mthur mgo mthur thag mtho sor bcu gnyi'i tshad sogs gang ba kha tshang ba ma bud 4 bar bye ḍa/ ba me 'chad bar bye da pa/ /da 21 brdo chub ba pa dgran pa'am gnod pa byed ma mtho btsams 96

ba mtshul ba mi gsang bar smra ba ste sdig pa bshab/sa pa mtho yor mi 'greng lta bu'i rdo rtseg sogs mtho ba mi dma' ba mchog /mthon ngo mtho ba'i ming tsam la go ba'i sgra rgya mthobs rgya cher mthong ba'i ba/nas sam dkyil khang pa'i rgya mthong sa sogs yur dbus kyi da 'dib la bdab pa khyab pa'am gnas pa mtha' don drug la 'jug rtag chad kyi mtha' sogs/ /mthib ril chu bya zhig che 21ba kha sngon po dang mthon ka chen po mthos mthong ga mthas mis pa mthu bo che mtheb mthar chags sogs mas 'phul tha'o/ /('tha3 'thab mo 'khrug par go zhing 'thab pa yang 'thon pa bton pa'am 'gro ba mgo 'thon 'thon phyag lta bu dang 'byung pa'i don yab yin grobs dang rta sogs su 'thams pa 'khyud pa 'dzin pa bdag byed pa spyo ba shi spar 'thams pa lta bu/ /bzad dang rig pa ma thing kyib pa 'khrigs pa mi gsal ba chu dang nor 'thor ba gtor ba 'bor ba kha 'thor ba 'thor zhing 'thung ba khrus shig dang / /blo dang lus 'thums pa gtums pa mi gsal ba mgo 'thoms pa 'khor ba mi shes pa du ba dud pa 'thul ba 'phyur ba gtul ba tshos pa/ /sra ba'i don can gyi 'thas pa mkhregs pa shin tu zhen pa 'thems ran zhes pa nan nyan gyi don 'thems pa mi 'phyug pa chad lhag spong ba kha tshang ba mnan pa 'ban po brtan po nan po/ /chu sbrang rtsi ja 'thungs pa btung ba 'thung yang 'thad sha spu nas 'ben pa tshur 'dren pa tshan gyis 'khrid pa lta bu'i don yin zhing me tog spru 'thog pa btogs pa/ /smod pa'i tshig dang 'jing spad gnyis don ga cig 'ben pa rngub pa 'thung ba 'jog pa phyir 'then pa 'thad pa rigs pa 'os pa rung ba 'dod pa/ /skyid zas sogs la 6'thu ba dang 'thus pa 'du cha rgyab pa btu ba 'grig pa tshogs pa 'the ba bye ba zhib mos da ma thab ba/ pa btags pa 'joms pa thag 'thag rang 'thag /zhen ba 97

yan lag nyams pa 'theb po gyol po rkang pa ring thung mi mnyam pas 'theng nas 'gro mkhan te zha zhing 'theng ba yang mal rgas nyal chas ma theb pa lhag po lhag pa nyid kyis 'thum pa gtums pa g.yogs pa/ /dum bu tshal bar 'thub pa gtubs pa dang 'thabs pa nan chags 'thems 'than pa nan tan byed pa'am brtan pa sogs 'as 'phul tha'o1 /pa/gang zag gzhan gyi dring zhes pa tshul lam 'dren pa'am lugs la re stos mi 'jog pa ste gzhun la rag ma las pa bka' drin sku drin zhes pa phan btags pa'am byas pa dran pa mi rje da pa'i sems pa/ /dril4bu dril chen dril chung dri stsa'i yul mchog bzang po ste kha che skyes lta bu dra ba dra phyed skya/chod jis kyi khyad par/ /snga dro zhogs pa pyi dro dgongs ka'i don dri ba zhu ba gtam 'dri ba'i ming tsam drib pa'i lan zhus lan dri ba byas pad lan/ /gdul bya 'ga' zhig zab don nam bstan pa la kha drab bar bya ba'i don can gyi gsung ste nges rdan min pa g.yung drub 'gyur med rtag pa dang bgra shis pa'i mtshan ris drab por srong ba thub pa sogs da ga grangs ka zhig /khrims ngo tsha chu dral ba 'jig pa 'joms pa ral ba lcam mo dang dral po ming sring zas thug sogs drangs pa drang ba 'brim pa drobs shig ces pa drang ba'i skal tshig nges pa drongs pa nges pa rnyed pa/ /drab po bshan po mi 'khyog pa pa bden pa'i don shing dang zhabs kyi drung rtsa ba nye ba zhe sa'i brda drung 'khor drung yig spun drung drel dud 'gro dre'am dre'u dre'u rdog stan khru bo par tang grum tse don gcib /mor dre dang smin drug gnyis rgyu skar gyi bye brag ma 98

zas pa mi dro ba'am bsil ba ste klu rgyal zhig yin de gnas pa'i mtsho/ /dreg ni nad kyi khyad par dreg ba nag po chags pa'i dri ma'am ljan ljin dri ma dreg pa dri nag dang nyon mongs sam skyon dab / /kha drag pa kha mkhas pa'am kha btsan pa drag zhan sku drag drag po'i shul lngan pa khro ba'i rnam 'gyur lus ngag tu dod pa sa dang mo mtshan sogs la gzan dang pho mtshan drud pa 'drud pa sbyar nas 'then pa'am 'phul ba lta bu drud cig kyang / /drod dron mo bsil drod dang dro ba tsha ba dros pa zan zas dron mo dro po g.yos zan dril ba sgong ba spril ba sdeb pa ltab pa/ /dred mo gcan gzan zhig zags pa pags pa gos ming dras pa gri sog gis 'dra ba'am gshags 'dra ba drubs pa 'tshem pa'am rma kha gso ba dres ma thag pa sogs bya rung ba'i rtswa zhig spug pas drags pa sdom pa drogs shig sdoms shig /dred po gyong po ma dul ba chos dred zhabs dred dru bu sgro gu'i don dra ba skud pa 'brel ba'i sgod nya rgya lta bu dra phad spru dra dra mig rtog pa'i dra bar go drangs pa 'dren pa/ /dril chen bzab/ba pa khrims bsgrags pa sogs rjod ba mkhas pa ya rabs phul phyin leṭa pa'i don gnas su drongs 'dren pa'i skul tshig gam tshogs pa/ /rbegs pa rgyags pa khengs pa drung pa rtsa ba'am rtsad nas phyung ba bton pa sun phyung yid phyung kha yi drog kha skyid pa 'tshengs pa tshim pa/ /nad drag nad las grol ba dwa phrug pha ma med pa'i bu dwa ba sman dang rgya gro ma lta bu zhig la go bsnyed 'bru 'bras bu/ /thal cha che ba'i don can gyi drags pa ste bshad drags pa che drags pa chung drags pa dang dred drus tshem drub dor do gal drang ba drag pa mkhas pa btsan pa shugs che ba mtho ba mchog 'grig pa dris shig sogs bad rkyang ngo / /(gad) gdugs nyi char grib byed med pa gdong ba bzhin ras kha 99

mdun gdubs nyin par ram nyi ma'am nyin byed kyis gdungs pa gdung ba tsha bar byed pa'am mnar ba/ /gdon mi min gyi gnod byed ltar dpe sgra gdug pa ma rungs pa mi bzad ba'i don gdol pa dmangs rigs kyi bye brag gdul ba btul ba/ /gdams bya'i ngag phan pa'i ngab gsal gdab pa btab pa brjed du mi 'jug pa gdang ba dge tshul slong na yo byad cig dang mal gding dang bting ba gdan stan gdan bu gdan 'dren gdan sa/ /'a/ba/ rkang dpung pa 'i ba/(1 bsnye mdzes rgyan ma/bdab gos sogs 'gel sa dpyang spug dang dre gdang sogs dang gdung ma ka ba'i gdeg byar lo sna gdags pa btags pa/ /gdung ni rus sam 'phel gdung wad sgra'i gdangs dbyangs 'dzeg pa'i skas kyi gdab bu skas rim mam skas them/ /gdung rus pa'i zhe sa brgyud pa bar ma chad rwa bdung rus sam rigs ma dzin pa po 'tshob pa po gsol ba gdab pa bdag cag ka dgong rje sha su gsol bar zhu ba gdon pa bton pa/ /gnyer ba dang bdam sa pa gnyis gnyer ba/tad sprud pa yang za gnyer bar gad mas pa bcol ba dang bar mas pa gnyis gta che/sa pa rnyed pa nor la gdu ba zhen cing chags ji1 thub ba gdu ba gar po byed pa/ /mi nga tha snyad gdags pa btab/sa pa sbyar lnga1 blun rngod ma/dam pa/ pa drag pa ba rngod na skyed byed ba/bdang pa btab pa— kha sogs gdangs pa phye ba bgrad pa mtshon cha gdengs pa 'phyar ba ga za sa pa gdon mi za ba the tshom med pa nges pa/ —da gdod da gzod de da lta lta bu'i rnges kyi dus sos bdal bde bar gnas pa'am stom las gdeb nges ba sgobs pa tshad yid brtan rgyu mtshan rtsis thong pa rnyed pa ma/da' 'dug gam mngon/ 1gdos pa gru'i rna ba'am rlung g.yo/ra te gru'i dar po che thud gdar mar chur bsres pa'i thud gru bzhi lta bu mar gdar yang sra nga 'jar byed bsgyu ka 100

gdeg ba bteg pa 'jal ba/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mngon pa sde bdun gyi gcig ste mo'u 'a /shā gyi bus brtsams pa'am bsdus pa gdam nga 'dam ka byed pa/ /gdengs ka yo/da pa can klu rgyal sogs gdul bya sems can nam rta lta bu dam ba ba/bdab/'a pa btags pa gzhag pa/ /bkab gdal gnas lugs dang yongs grags gdod ma thog ma nas ming gdags bya'i gzhi gnas te bdag gi phung lnga lta bu zal med pa/ /khyim bdag gdangs can thub pa'i sbyin bdag yin la des phul pa'i kun dga' ra ba dang lag gdub sor gdub gdub kor gdab pa gdal ba gdas pa sogs gas 'phul da'o/ /(bad3 bdab nga'am nged tha mi dad kyi gcig rang bzhin da bang ba bden pa kal ma ngo ma mi slu za drang po bdud 'chi byed gno8 byed bar chad bdun grangs shig mdun gyi phyogs nyid du bdar ba gral sgrig pa/ /bde ba skyid pa dga' ba sim pa bdo ba dar ba 'phel ba zas thug sogs ba da' ba ro—zhim pa me la bdug rgyu'i za sa bdug pa bdug bya dang bdug byed pa//bda' ba dang ded pa gnyis rjes su 'ded pa'am ming tsam bdag pa po dbang ba po ga rtsa pos bu lon phyugs sogs bda' ba 'ded pa'am dbang me ba pa'i don yin zhing bdas pa ded zin pa/ /bde ba legs pa'am bzang bar bshegs pa song ba'am rtogs pa ste rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa bde zhing legs pa dge legs bden pa mi skru ba bdar ba bshad pa/ /ga'u mda' stan bdung ba pa bkug pa'am bkang ba bad/ pa yod ‘4 dang nor rdzas la sogs pa'i ming skyel ba dar skyel gla phebs skyel byas pa'i rngan pa bdar ba sbyi na pa dog pa yod pa'am 'dug pa/ /kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa yod pa gnyis dang bden brde sogs bdud 'chi ba rtsi 'joms byed kyi 101

rdzas rte mi 'chi ba'am 'chi med kyang zer byed ma zhib mor tsan na sogs bdar ba brdar nas phye mar byed pa/ /zag bdar 'phyag pa'i ming ngam phyag cing bdar ba sbyi bdar phyi ba'i ming ngam phyi zhing bdar ba dang bdugs bdag nyid bdag gi ba bdag lta sogs bas 'phul da'o/ //༷mad) mda' nyag phran nam lung pa'i mtha' me mda' mda' tshad ma skar mda' mdung mtshon cha zhig༄phang mdung sogs mde'u mda' chung ba me mda' sogs kyi mder lam bzhi dang sum mdo 'dzoms 'gag gnad ka'i don mdos yas stags/ /mdun drung stun nye ba mdongs sgro thig gam dpral ba'i thig le ba zad ba/ kha dog gam bkrag che bdangs ba tshon sogs kyi bkrag gam gza byin mdo nyung ngur bsdus sdud pa mdo sdom pa dkri ba mdo sde mdo phyogs mdo sngags/ /mdabs kha sang mdangs dgongs dang ma dang zhes kyang 'thad sab nyin mdong gsol ngo dga' bstod pa 'dun pa ra da' robs sam dpung dang / mdud ba bcings pa gos mdud mdud pa bor ba dang mdag ma mig mdongs mdan pa la zag ba mas ba phul da/da/ /ka'ad) mya ngan sdug bsngal 'da' ba dang 'das pa gnyis rgal ba 'chi ba zad pa dang phyi ma 'di dus gsum gyi gcig 'dun pa don gnyer 'dod pa gus pas 'dud pa btud pa/ /'dam pa 'jim pa 'ad skyes khrod nang 'dur 'dur 'gro tshul 'dob ba 'gro ba'i ming yin zhing 'dug mi pa sdod pa gnas pa yod pa mngon pa/ /sgra dang bya ba sogs nang 'dom pa dus sam phyogs gcig tu tshogs pa 'dzom pa rjes su 'jed pa bda' ba skul ba gsol ba 'debs pa gdab pa zhu 'bul byed pa 'don pa bton pa lag nas 'don pa sogs/ /lha 'dre mi ma yin 'byung po shing 'drud pa drud pa khub bu bu ga 'dru ba drus pa rko ba sngog pa rtol ba/ /'du 102

byed las sam rtsol ba dang dngos po sogs 'dus shing byas pa mi rtag pa dngos po rgyu 'bras 'dres ma 'dres pa'i ming tsam 'dre ba chu 'o mnyam du 'dus pa 'dra snyam pa mtshungs pa dras pa/ /'drul pa ngul ba'i don gtam gleng mo 'dri ba dris pa dri ba byed pa yi ge 'dri ba 'bri ba/ /'drid pa slu ba mgo skor ba'i don la 'jug cib khrims dang chu ngo tsha 'dral ba dral ba spog sogs 'dor ba gtong ba spong ba 'bor ba dor ba 'dar ba 'gul ba 'phrig pa/ /'degs pa bteg pa 'di thag nye ba bang da lta ba chos 'di pa 'dod pa khas len pa chags pa dga' ba mos pa 'dul ba 'dul byed dam 'dul po dang sde sdod gsum gyi gcig dang 'dul sbyong gis 'dul ba btul ba gdul ba/ /'dam bu 'dam rtswa'i ming 'dab ma lo ma gshog par go 'dab ma gshog pa zags pa ldan pa ste bya 'du ba 'dus pa tshogs pa nor/ri bo'i 'dabs ri ngogs sam logs 'dab kyang 'thad 'dol sa sa gshin po'am legs par go 'dag gu skyo ma'am spags 'dag pa lces ldag pa dang 'dam/ /blo dang rta sogs 'drog pa dogs nas 'dzur ba dkrogs pa khur drags pa zhabs rkang pa 'dre da pa dred pa rdog stabs shor ba lta bu 'drad pa drad po brdar ba sen mos 'drud pa la thob cing 'drud pa drud pa/ /'dren pa po thub pa lta bus drang bya drangs chos bslab bya 'doms pa gdams pa ston pa 'chad pa slob pa dge ba la 'dun pa don du gnyer ba'am tshogs pa yang na dge ba'i tshogs 'dus pa 'du ba'am tshogs pa/ /'do med bzo med dam gnad mi shes pa glen pa lta bu 'doms gsang gnas su go 'dom pa khru bzhi'i tshad gzhu 'dom gang ba kha tshang ba 'dogs pa btags pa gdags pa/ /'dod bzags pa'i yul dang yul can 'du sha sa bsam pa'am mtshan mar 'dzin pa 'du 'dzi g.yeng yul lam chung ma la sogs par 103

go 'dris rnga/ goms shā/ rgyun du 'grag4/ pa1 /skra 'dreg pa gcon ji1 bzhar ba'i ra khan po'am byed po 'deb ba 'gro ba'am gzhan du gtong ba'i phyir ched 'ja ba rta'i 'dam pa 'dam/ ka byed ma 1/ /'di las 'bas pa po gshin po 'chi pod ngon 'dad pa sems la 'phreng ba'am chags sems sogs kyis 'khor 'dab 'khor nye du bcas 'dum sa pa mthun pa tshogs pa 'grig pa sdom pa 'dun ya/nga snang / ming bla dwags 'dobs pa btab/sa pa chu sogs 'dab ba dal ba dal po'i bya tshig ba ma dang snag tsha 'dab ba khyab pa dal gyis 'gro ba/ /kun dag zal khrus rdza sa sam 'dag byed kyi rdzas ba byang go 'dun sna tshogs pa de ma 'drog de na/ thag gam de blo 'drog ma so nga /dre ma sogs 'dag pa dag pa sbyong ba dang bdun sa 'dren—ma 'dri ba 'dum pa bo rje ba/ba dab ma bsnyeb bdam/ /(rda ka grong rdal grong gis khyab pa'am grong khyer mthar grong thar thor ram sbo ngas thog dang mthil jib pa phyi nas nang du 'bur ba'am hūm̐ nga ba sta bu rdo ba'i rje bo pha lam la sogs ba / 'i ming rngul sprabs zla mtshan skyon gangs can pa'i yon ta na jigasum gyi gcig rdo rje'i rdub4 gnam lcags/ /jo bo sbo da byed rde'u rdeb rdo chung ngu dang nad kyi lha/ da par dang rtsis rdel rdog po rdob ma rel bu'am gong bu nyeg ma 'bru rdog po gcig lta bu rdeg ḍa rdung ba bcug pa 'dres pa sob/sa kyam go rdub ba po thogs pa thab ba/ rdug po lta bu/ /sgyu nga ma zad ba rdung rdeg dang rdung ba dkrol ba snun pa gtubs pa 'khrub pa mnyed pa rgyab pa pheg rdob rol mo zhig dang ba4ga pa rdeb pa'i ming tsam pheb rdob kyang snab za bang rol mo zhig jeb pa brdab pa dkrol ba spru ga pa rgyab pa/ 1blo jeg mgyogs pa sogs zadang / cing snam ba ba gtad med du 'gyel ba'am 'gag rdab pa kun ba po da/ba gtos sam bongs tshod che ba/ /ba da/ pa dang mjug ma sogs 104

zum pa med pa'am chad pa blo lto ba rdol ba rtol ba 'thon pa brdol ba dbu ba spu ba rdos pa thon pa thogs pa/ /gri sogs rdor ba no 'don pa bkan nas 'drud pa brdar ba rdor cig kyang rdol chos rtsing chos sam spyod rtsing dang rdab pa rdul phra rab rdul phran rdal ba rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin sogs rar brtags da'o/ /(lha she nam mkha' la lding ba 'phyo ba g.yo ba bya spyi dang khyung 'drug skra brgya ldir ba sgra 'byin pa ldir skad sgrog pa ldab ldib mi gsal ba gsang po med pa'i skad/ /lda ldi mchod rdzas shig lde mig sgo lcags 'byed byed yod pa'i don can gyi ldan pa bcas pa mthun pa 'grogs pa/ /mgo ljob mgo mjug log pa'am phyin ci log pa lto ba grod pa ldir ba 'bur ba lhug pa rgya che ba ldu ra spur shin tu tshos pa sil bur gyur ba sprugs pa blug pa bcug pa/ /seng ldeng shing ngam sman zhig ldem ldem mnyen lhug gam g.yo tshul lder ba 'jim bzo'i don ldebs logs dang leb ma shog ldebs sogs/ /ldong ros tshon nam sman zhig ngad dri sogs kyi shugs sam nus pa ldang ba 'thul ba lang ba lde gu sman sogs ldir ba'i skyo ma'am bag zan sla ba lta bu byug pa 'byug pa/ /rjes su 'jug pa 'gro ba'am len pa ljog pa 'dor ba mi mthun pa log pa'am med pa sgob pa'am ldobs pa ni slob pa skyem pa myur ba ste shes par sla ba pyir slar mi lhog pa mi log pa brtan pa/ /skom btung ldud pa blud pa sbyin pa me dang nyi ma lde ba sro ba'am tsha bar byed pa ming gi don can gyi lde dpal lde skyid lde 'od lde khri srong lde'u btsan sogs/ /gru ma bu sngo'am chal gyi ra ba tshal zhing dang skyed tshal lta bu'i ming lcam bu rtswa sngon nam sne 'u ldab snab mnyen pa'am snyi ba dang / /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas ldem po 'khyog por dgongs pa bsam pa mtha' drug gi gcig dris pa'i lam sdon 105

ba 'jal ba 'debs pa/ /bskyar ba dang ldab pa gnyis yang yang dang zlos pa nyis ldab nyis 'gyur sum ldab ldab log sogs lhag ma lhag po ldas pa lab/ pa'am lus pa/ /ldan pa kha'i 'gram pa mdan pa'i sdeb kyang rung so tshems ldeg pa g.yo ba blad pa za ba mig lta byed kyang ljobs pa long ba mdongs kyang rung / /ne'u na tshod chung ngu'am na tshod ldab mnyam pa ste na mnyam na zla sngom bu bsod stoms ldom bu ba ba sod stoms ba stan gdan las ldang ba lang ba/ /bstan bcos dang gos sogs kyi ldab ba kha tshang ba'i tshad dang ldag pa ldem pa sding thag ldad pa lde'u mig lder so rjes su 'gro ldog gzhan sel gyi ldog pa la sogs lar btags da'o/ /(sna) zhe gting nas sdang ba khro ba gnod pa sngang ba'i mi ga mig log jigs mo byed pa'i mdzub mo sor mo zheg jig pa gshe nga 'ji gas su 'jug pa 'ben la gzir ba/ /ldar ma dpa' min nam snying stobs chung ba bde ba dge 'bras spug bsngal mi dge ba'i 'bras bu dang skyib sdug dge ba legs sprud bcu lta—bu sdeb pa mi dge ba bcu sogs dang ngan pa sgom pa sgong ba sdud pa sre ba 'ching ba sdom tshig lta bu/ /jings gting ngam zhe dang dkyi'/ dbus soṭa spyod don sgob zad yal ga gyes pa'i rten nam ljon pa'am rtsa ba sgob bu sdong po chung ba'i don sde mang po'i tshogs sam tshoms ra nga sde gzhan sde sde bzhe lta bu/ /tshe spog dab sgo ba brje ba sdur ba srog gtong ba'i don yin zhib snge tshan dum bu bam po tsho sdeb pa sbyor ba sdom pa 'grogs pa sgrig pa/ /phrog zabs sem/sa ldan chung ba'i bye brag sdom pa'am ba rgya byed mkhan sdig pa dngos dang sdig srin ka rdo zad spyod gcan gzan sogs kyi sen mo byed ba non po/ 1so byang sngaṭa kyi sdom pa sping ba spyod pa ni 'da' ba bsrung bya'i sngom pa dge bsnyen sogs sdod gnas 3dug gnas sgod pa bsdad pa gnas pa sdod cib /sngeb thrur 10 6

rig gnas chung ba lnga'i gcig dang rig byed kyi yan lag drug gi sdeb sbyor rnam dbye dang yi ge'i sbyor ba sogs mdzes pa'i don can gyi spug pa yid du 'ong ba sdug gu yang nor dang chos sogs phyogs gcig tu spud pa bsdu ba gsog pa sdom pa tshogs par byed ba/ /spum ba khyim mam khang par 'jug mchod sdong mchod pa'i rten dang mchod sbyin gyi phyugs 'dogs pa'i ka ba sdom bu kang chung gis bskor ba/ /sder ma sgod spyad kyi khyad par rag sder la sogs pa'i sgra thug pa skyo tsha la gdab rgyu'i sgor sha tshil sogs lag ba sor mo lnga bas sdom pa 'dzin pa/ /rgya' ba'i bka' gsung la sdod pa gnas pa chos skyong sogs sde smod gsum ste bre bo che'i don ltar bshad dgos sdong ba sdos ba pa sdus sdur ba sdoms sdug po sdigs sdig to can sdang po sogs sar btags da'o/ /(brda) gri mtshon brdar brdor ba bdeg cing 'chos pa brdung zhing bcos pa sogs bzung bya nyes can lta bu bzungs pa rdung ba/ /kha brdar ba ga5ma mang bshad pa bla bo gtam brdol ba byung rgyal du thon pa ste bab col lam gnyid gtam chal mar ram cha lang brdab pa dang bdabs pa gnyis rdeb pa'am rdab pa/ /ja brdub ba rdung ba snun pa bro bzung ba rdung ba 'khrub ba go byed la 'jug pa'i brda lag brda go brda/ zal ma thang mar brdal ba rdal ba bkram pa khyab nas g.yab mo sogs brdul ba g.yob pa dang btul ba'i don yin zhing bgeg pa rdeg pa/ /chu brdol sgod brdol brdung ba sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i da'o/ /(blda)bldabs pa bskyar ba ldab pa bzlas nas bldag ba ldag pa lces 'byog pa bldeg pa ldeg pa la thob cing bldad pa ldad pa zhib mor blad pa'am rmu ra ba/ /bldab pa sogs bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i da'o/ /107

(bsdad ba spu bya nor sobs bsngu ba btu ba bsdus pa btus pa sdud pa bsrung ba sdur ba mnyam par byed pa 'a༅na pa bskrun nas ba'i za da pa sdo ba 'dug pa/ /nyes spyod sogs bsdams pa sdom pa srungs ka bsngo ma sa pa sdon1 pa bsdus nas spob/ dang bsdos pa sdo ba/ /'og bsgos ba 'og grabs sam sta gon nye 0ra bsdogs pa nye par brtsa ) 1sa rngo4 sta rgan ba sna zu gzu gas zhe kyisngon 'gro gzhan nyes can dang 'phen lta bu —pa bsdigs pa sdib 11 ba/she ba sog ba/ /bkab/ba rogs dab bsgyurdo ba ba po 'grogs pa mnyam—— (bgro ba sdod ba bsdebs pa sdeb pa sbyor ba sogs sna ya bta sa 'i4'i zag ma 'ang gru ku — bsdogs pa bsdus pa dri'/ ba brtsams pa sdog pa/ /'ga' pa me mthun bo brtsam ba sdum pa mthun par byed pa chings kag pa sngos byer ba dam ——bsdi ba/ za bsdeb pa mdor bsdus so gas bas 'phu 'a ji dar btags ba'o /cad(gan she phan pa bde bar byed pa badz+ra ba pa mi bde bar gen pa man༄ ba gnas pa yod pa 'dug ḍa4'i skabs go'am ka' 'i—ma thab mu che/ dus te gnas tshul dang—'phral ma'am mthar thug min pa dang 1 kunas thab3snye bkanas dus gnang ba ster ba'am sprub pa'am byed du rung ba bkag pa dbal pa byed du mirung ba ste 'di gnyis 'dul ba'i brda gnad gsang ngam mdog pam rtsa ba gnad ka don gnad lus gnad sogs/ /ba/nod sbyin ga ngon nam lha'i bye brag bar ga nor rad/ 'bri g.yag sog sgyu phyugs dud 'gro rta ྅ba sogs kung go gnam rgyu ska ra gyi lam ltar dpe sgra gnag pa nag po'am mag po'i bya ba/gnas brtan bcu drug gam 'od srungs chen po sogs nye bar gnas pa 108

gam du sdod pa thag nyer yod pa gnas kyi slob ma gnas pa 'dus sa'i khab pa khyim gnas pa sdod pa yod pa brten pa mi 'gyur ba 'os pa/ /gnod byed 'tshe byed rlag byed zil gzi brjid kyis 'og tu gnon pa mnan pa zhum par byed pa gna' sngon nam snga ma'i mi smra zhing don go ba'i gang zag gnubs rus shig ste sangs rgyas ye shes sogs/ /bying rgod zhi nas dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu gan pa ste bsam gtan sogs sngar gyi gnas sgabs dor nas gzhan du 'gyur ba ste chu rnyab ma dwangs pa lta bu yin la gnas yongs gyur pa yang zer don la gnas pa'i lugs ka gshis lugs ngo ma gnas tshul stong nyid rtogs pa shes pa/ /gnangs sang gi phyi nyin gzhes gnangs kyi phyi nyin gnam ru gzhu mda' stan rkang pa zhabs kyis gnon pa mnan pa kha gnon log gnon rnam gnon/ /zhe gting gnong ba nongs pa ste skyon gyis zhum pa'am 'gyod pa'am nongs 'khur ba gnad gcod 'chi nad lta bu gnas ngan pa len pa skye gnas mi legs par skye ba'am yang na sgo gsum gyi gnas ngan len las su mi rung ba'am bag chags lta bu/ /gnod pa'i gnas yul lam ba la dang gnas gnas min gnos shig bka' gnang gna' bo gnod bya la sogs pa gas 'phul na11/ /(man she mnal gnyid log pa gnyid 'chi ba gzims pa gnyid log pa mna' ma bu'i chung ma bag ma 'og tu mnan pa gnon pa mi mtho bar byed pa/ /mnab rtsal kha zas dre sna'i yul mnam pa sgom pa'am bro ba dang dku ba mnar ba gzir ba de las lhag po med pa ste dmyal ba zhig mnar ba gzir ba gnod pa nyen pa/ /kun nas mnar ba 'tshe ba gnod pa'i sems bsam pa zab sogs mnog pa zhim pa mang ba gya nom pa mnog khe'am sgogs dang phan chung ba phran bu/ /mnol ba grib bam mi gtsang ba'i 109

rigs rgyud dam gras mnol ri ltar na ri rtseg mna' bro bskyal ba bor bab ma sgog pa na bza' gos mnabs pa mnab pa kyen pa gon ba bsol ba/ /mno ba dang bsam pa gnyi sa bsam blo gtong ba'am bsam blo mchos pa mno ba bsams rwa/ thob pa len pa dang mna' chu mnol cig sobs mas 'phul zad da/ /(dka chom par ches pa sems sam shes pa rdon ngo hūṃ ka min nam mchog gam no ba'i ming tsam dal ma gnyug mar 'byor ba sbyor ba sgom pa ting nge 'dzin thabs shes zung 'jug rdams mang tshig ste sangs rgyas rnam ba/ lha bu / /rnam par rtog pa ku/na rtog sems kyi 'char tshul dpe dbye rtog pa sgon mong ba/ rom grangs dbye ba 'cha/ rnam pa ming don gyi rnam grang da dpa/sa rnam pa rnam grangs mdzes pa rnam 'gyur rang bzhin mi rtag pa'i rnam pa sol ba1 mab ba nyung min/ /rna ba sgra 'dzin nam nyan byed kyi gshog pa 'dab ma ste 'bab/ so ṭa kyi rna chas gshog pa lta bu'am snyan gshog rje mo dang po zad ba non cho 'i spru ba rdal ma gnyug ma bden pa ngo ma 'i dom brjod bya sogs/ /rdul dang ཿba rma lho bur ram du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu zhig rnag ces pa khrag rā(ra das dkar por song ba zheng ka tog skye ba'i sa gzhi'i rnang ma chus khyab pa'i cheng du nu/'am sa sgang 'then pa ste don zhing chu ma/ /tshig phrad kyi bye brab zam par ni yong— su zhes pa lta bu ste rnam par dag rnam ji/ra bshad pa sogs ra la dom dang rjam mkhyen dam 'gre'/ rnam pa'i phra mo rnam kun rna dbang ka chas zhe —dgab4 rna rgyan sogs rar btags bsgyu/ /(sna she snar ma dang snrom dang sprubs gsum rgyu skar gyi bye bug rjag zad yi ge 'bri byed kyi rdzas dang snag gi tsha bo ste gnyen zhig bsgyur pa ba 'du1ka ba sbrur sbrur byed pa khrib mor 'thag pa/ /snab ba gsal ba sprub pa mngon ba yul 110

mthong ba cha sna kha tha dad dam dbye ba'am du ma tshogs pa 'dus pa sna sgom byed 4ga ma rtse mo yi don snabs sna'i lud pa'am zag chu/ /snam bu zheng chung la chu ring ba bal gyi gos sogs dang 'dod pa'i snam bu'i don snam phran sprur ba'i gos te chos gos gsum gyi gcig snal ma gos rgyu'am snam bu'i spun nam skad pa'i do na sne mo rtse mo 'go ma thog ma zur/ /gnam sa'i bar gyi cho snang ba mthong ba bar snang du 'phur ba lta bu snang ba dang gsal ba gnyi sa mun pa med ba'am 'od chags pa sgron ma snum 'bru mar rtsi mar sogs dang snuche pa snrum po mdog mi skya ba'am sang seng med pa dre dang mtshon sbom pa tshor ba dang thogs pa/ /ba ma sna lam ston nam sna 'khrid par go sna za gco bo thog mar dpon po'i don snag nye du zhig dpor po spun nam tsha bo snab yod dam mngon/ / mang dag pa lta bur snang ba mthong ba ste dngos min pa 6 nga dag min pa mngon rjes sprub pa sun 'byin ltar snang lta bu sna kha rigs mi 'dra ba mang po sprel zhi 'tshol ba'am go rims su mi gnas pa dang 'phred sbo da sgod spyad dang sdod du rung mi rung sogs/ /yug snam btsag gam rdo zhig dang yug tshang ba'i snam bu snam phran snam sbyar gyi snam phran nam snam bu chung ba sna ma dzā ti'am dzā ti'i spe tog dang srin shing sme'u sngo'am sngo dri 'gags ser ba dang rtse chung / /smad yar rmas pa'am skyon zhugs pa snad pa'i ming tsam ser sna dam du 'dzin pa'am 'jungs pa'i din sgon ma kha skong sgon khar go sgoms shig sgom pa'i thu la tshig sgol ltar na bsgol ba/ /rgyab kyi don la go ba'i snam logs rgyab bam ngos sam zur dang snyun pa sgon pa snar ba sdor ba snur cig snang byed snub pa snad pa ngogs sar btags na'o/ /(bad) brnab pa chags pa'am gzhan nor bdag gir 'do da pa'i sems bas ma pa sto zas sogs la bdan pa nan dī na byed pa'am do gal byed 11

pa'i don yang yin brnangs pa chu rtsam sogs gre bar 'gags pa/ /bzab pa bzod pa'am bsam par dka' ba mi nus pa'i don brnag pa bzod pa'am bsam pas mdun gas du bzur ba 'then pa'am tshur 'dren pa/ /sa la sbas pa'i don can gyi brdogs pa gab pa dab nges gzung la 'jug pa'i bdan pa dmigs su gzung ba'am bkar ba ni sgra'i 'jug yul lta bu/ /bdang brdog sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i na'o/ /(bsna) gnad gsang du brtsan pa snun pa rdeg pa mtshon cha lag cha bstun pa snun pa rgyab pa nu ma 'o 'dzin nam nu zho ba pa snun pa nu ru 'jug pa'am blud pa/ /srol ka ba'i bas pa snub pa nyams pa'am nub par byas pa kong 'og ltag 'og bsgor ba sgor ba nor du 'jug pa dkrugs pa brje ba lta bu'i don yin zhing bsdol ba sdol ba brje ba dang phan tshun nam bla 'og rim min du sbyor ba'am ceg pa seng ge mjing bsnal dang rdo rje rgya gram lta bu sdol mar byas pa/ /mtshon cha bsnams pa thogs pa khyer ba bzung ba sgom pa dus phyi bsnar phyi bshol sdur ba 'then pa'am nye ru btang ba zhib mo zhib par bskur ba snag tsha sogs snur ba/ /mjug ma rnga ma bsnar ba snar ba brkyang ba dri sna'i gzung bya bsnams pa sdom pa bro bar byas pa bsnams kyang mthong nem nem snem pa'i tshul bsnems pa snem pa mnan pa'am nem zhem byas pa/ /mang po dang yang yang du kha bsnan pa sgon pa sgon ma bcug nas 'dres pa bsres pa'am legs par go bsnos pa sgo ba brjis pa mnyed pa 'phur ba sbrus pa/ /bsnam bsgom bsgo bsnad pa sogs ba ba ma bsnyeb ba mad / ldan ba'i na'o/ /112
