ba pang ba pang pa'am thu ba ma pang bu 'jug lta bur go bar bu sgod kyi bye brag mar par zhag par sogs pi wang sgra snyan nam rgyud mangs 'dzin pa 'chang ba/ /bcig lu grogs med pa rkyang pa reng bur go thar ri mo 'bri byed dam tshon 'byug byed la go ba'i don can gyis ngos lab tra shing lo'am ri mo bris pa 'bri ba/ /bu ku mda' yab lan kan spen rgya'i don lu shud 'dab chags shig pur rgyas 'phur tshul lur ba 'phur ba mkha' la 'gro ba/ /kun rī ka gdugs dkar chu skyes dkar po stag dang phyogs kyi glang po dang bur shing gsum gyi bye brag dpe dpe rmedang pi spa lī zur chag pa ste grog ma dang dbyibs mdog 'dra ba'i sman zhig yin pas grog sman yang grags/ /ba sgo/ bod kyi btsun pa rgya nag tu phyin pa'i ming pad+ma 'phyo ba 'dam skyes pa la sha rgya skyegs kyi shing bal sha yang zer/ /lus mo sgyid khug gi mdun cha pus tshigs pus lhang btsugs pa 'dzugs pa pog sbos por pa phor pa blug sgod ga lur gzur zur chag pa ste nus can yin ga pur yang zer ba sman zhig 'thul ba dri ngad ldang ba du ba 'phyur ba/ /par ma spar zin pa'i dngos po dang par zhes pa 'dra ba dang spar ba'i ming tsam mtshon pa'i sgra po ti glegs bam ste pusta ka zur chag pa ba'i ta blo gros dang 'grogs pa mkhas pa lnga rig pa/ /ze prog sgo lcags kyi ze ma'i rtse dang ze ba'i rtse yin snyam prob zhu dbu rgyan dang rtse zhwa prog ces pa rtse la grags 'og pab ska rags kyi rgyan nam ked pa la 'phyang ba'i tshar tshar dab / /pur ro'am gdung de'i khab pa ro khang gdung khang sreg khang par hab dre'u jog gam stan khra po ṭa la gru 'dzin te sgra nyams nas po 113

ta la sgrol ma'i gnas ri zhig dang dmar po ri/ /lu sa la sman 'o su dang lu zhel rtse sman zhig ste bya zas dang khru nga yang byed rung ba'i rtswa/ /pa sangs pa wa sangs gza' bdun gyi gcig za phab pa pu se na 'bebs ba sngags soṭa la brten nas lkog gyur gsal bar ston pa mo btab pa zi bdu sngo gling 'bru gsum gyi bye brag la 'jug /ba ma/ba ba shun pa skogs pa gzig gi pags pa sogs ba ba/ rngo / ji da lag tshab lag pa g.yar ba phan tshun las ka'i rogs re mos byed pa'i ming tsam po zos pa ji ltar thogs pa re ltar thogs pa ji tsam 'gor bar gyur kub ni sdud sgra ste re ltaྈ thogs kyang lan bdun pa lta bu/ /bar gyis 'phar tshu ka 'phaྈ ba 'phag pa dang cod pan pa na sa ut+pal te por pub sku par sogs pa rkyang ngo / /(dpa she dpag shā1 'jal ba'i tshad de rgyang grags brgyad sogs dang rtags mthong 'brel ba nges pa'i rjes su lkog gyur dpag pa 'jal ba nges pa rtob/sa par byed pa dpag bya lkob gyur gyi bzhal bya dam bca' rtags kyi yu la pa sgrab bya rtobs bya dang gzhal bya tsam bdape ga pa 'jal ba nges pa rtogs par ༄ byed pa/ /rgyal po sa gzhi skyong ba 'a sogs pa'i ming dpya zhes pa khral yin la lag dpyar yang 'gyur snang dpyang pa 'phyang ba thur du dpyongs byed kyi thab pa gdang thag sogs dpyangs pa 'phyang ba thur du btang ba/ /dpab pa tshad dam gzhal du med pa ma mchis pa dmag ba/yul gyi da lung tshogs sam rgya' byed da lung bu chung kang thang gi dmag rkang dmag /don—nam dpe can gyi dpe'am dper brjod dam bkod na nges bzung ngam dmig ba kyi mu/ 'byed pa dpe dang phal cher 'brel ba'i byad gzugs yin nam snyam ste dpyad don sen mo zangs mdog sogs brgyad cu dpe za glegs bam yig cha dpen pa mkho ba yid du 'ong ba phang da pa/ /spyad ba par bad rje / ba pa khyad 'phags kyi shes 114

rab dang rnam par dpyad pa rtob pa dang dpyod pa gnyis blos 'jal ba tsam mam rtsing zhib kyi khyad kyang yad brtag pa dang dpyad pa gnyis gzhal ba dang rtog dpyod kyi yul lam bya las dang gcig tu sprel na ming tsam yin pa 'di gong 'og la bsgre dgos pa dang / /rje bo ga rtsa bo gzhon nu gdong drug dpon po dbang byed po blob pa'am klog pa'i dpon po bla ma sems pa bsam pa dpa' ba mi ldog pa snying stobs brtan pa che ba chen po rgyal sras soṭa/ dpyid thig le'am dpal dang dus kyi dbye ba dpyid ka dpral ba smin ma'i steng gi ngos sam thod par go dpyi mgo sta zur ram dku dpyi dang nu ma'i bar zer ba snya bu da sbongs pa dpyang ba dang dpyongs shig kyang / /shing nga da lung bcad dge slong ma'i nu sgrib kyi gos phu bcad lus kyi dpung pa mdzes byed kyi rgyan dpung gdub dang / /dar gos thur du dpyangs pa rgyan zhig dbangs zhes pa mtho dman gyi tshad dam 'phang ngam mtho tshad dpab bsam gyi shib lha'i ljon shing sogs/ /dpa' po snying stobs can sdar ma min bdapa' ba spro nga 'phel ba snying stobs brtan pa'i don dpang po che bzhi'am gnya' bos yi ge sogs dpod pa gzhan la 'brir bcug nas rang gis smos pa lta bu/ /sman khong du btang nas nad gso bar byed pa dang dpyad thur ma sogs kyis nad phyi nas 'dren pa'am phyir 'don pa'am 'byin par byed pa ste gso rig dpyis mtha'am gting phyin pa son pa thon pa dbyas pa 'phya ba'am dpya ba'am skyon mi 'dogs pa sbyor ba/ /dpal ji skad du/ /dpal mo dbyangs can blo dang sde gsum gyi/ /phun sum tshogs dang 'byor pa mdzes pa/ dang / /'tshog chas 'jigs med tshal dang 'phags pa dang /bdud rtsi rnams la dpal zhes rab tu grags/ /zhes pa'i don dang ldan pa bcas pa dbang rus shig lo rtswa ba blo gros brtan pa dang dpyal dpung gnyen 116

dpag yas dpag gzhi dpags dpa' mo sogs das 'phul pa'o/ /(zad pha srad pha bu'am pha khu spun zla sku mched nye du srang bya dor bya gzhom bya sbyang bya sgong byed kyi yul spabs pa dor ba sogs 'das pa/ /zab po dbul po med po'i ming zar mo lag pa'i spyor ba changs pa lta bu dang sbar mo'i don za shing gi bye brag sba yang zer spa dbyub spa 'khar sgrud pa sprod pa ster ba gtad pa 'phrod pa/ /bdug pa byug pa sogs kyi spros lta bu sprun pa chu 'dzin spro ba da lta ma 'ongs dang spros 'das skul te don 'od soṭa 'phro ba gtong ba rgyas par byed pa lobs pa tshang bar spyod pa spyad pa 'dod yon nam 'byor ba'i ming nga yin spyod pa spyad pa 'jug pa nyams su myong ba brtul zhugs bya ba byed tshul bslab pa ya rabs kyi spyod pa sogs/ /spang spos bdug sgos ral ba can zhig spar ba dang spor ba me sogs 'bar du 'jug pa snga ma 'das ma 'ongs phyi ma da lta ba skul tshig ste 'di rigs ka rtags 'jug nas dus gsum 'byed tshul dngos su ma bstan kyang 'di ltar lag len nyer spyod dang bstun nas rigs bsgre spen ma rtsi shing zhig spyol bo rtswa sogs kyi khang ba spyil bu khang chung spro ba dga' ba skyed pa dro ba'am tsha ba brtson pa/ /spen hog rgyan zhig spug rin chen zhig ste chab rom lo stong won na spug tu 'gyur bar bshad snyam rin chen mchog gis spud pa brgyan pa spras pas spa ba mdzes pa brjid chags pa/ /go gnas dang gong sogs mtho bar spar ba sgor ba 'phar du 'jug pa bteg pa 'dren pa par rgyab pa spel ba bya 'dab chags dang shog bu spur ba 'phur du 'jug pa ldeng bar byed pa spur bya spur byed spur zin spur cig ces pa lta bu bya tshig dus gsum gzugs mi 'gyur ba kun la byi ra gnas gzhan du spags pa 'phag tu 'jug pa btang ba song ba 'bur ba/ /mgo las skyes pa'i spru skra dang ba spu sogs sprug spru ga rdu' sogs sprug tshul 116

'am ming tsam spug pa'i bags su bran pa nyid kyi rgyu la sbyar rgyu'i spun snal ma/ /spe'u mkhar ram khang chung ngam sdong po'i ming gces zas gces po rtsis chen snying sdug spyad bya'i dngos po ka ca nor gyi spyi ming spel ba 'phel du 'jug pa skyed pa sbyar ba sre ba/ /spa ma shug pa lta bu'i shing zhig spru nag ma sngo sman zhig spra ba me len gyi rdzas mgo spra ba'i me tog star dkar zer ba lta bu spungs pa spung ba du ma gcig tu phung por byas pa sdom pa bcer ba/ /za zal 'do med dam gtad med lang shor rgan po spra chal lang ba lta bu spod zas kyi bro ba skyed byed sga pi sogs dang zho 'o ma chu sogs kyi jis ma kha'i zhag lta bu spags pa bsres pa bsgos pa spags ma dang spags gnyis spags nas za lta bu/ /phan tshun 'bab mo 'khrug 'dzing sprad pa dang sprod pa gnyis sbyor ba thug pa'am rgyab tu 'jug pa spyos pa spyo ba gshe ba bsdigs nas sprugs pa gzhan du bdangs pa'am bskrad pa/ /sbyi thun mong ga rtsa bo ldog pa rigs sgos bye brag gam sger spel ma re mos sam 'dres ma lta bu ra go 'phrin cha jing ba dang springs pa gnyis skur ba sring ba 'bri ba 'gro ba/ /rmongs mun gyis spul pa bskyed pa ste rang bzo lta bu spong ba pa spong ba po'am sgom pa po spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo lta bu spobs shig spong ba'i skul chig smyod pa pa mu stegs kyi bye brag /tshur spyon byon nam 'byon dus gsum gzugs gcig snyam dka' ba'i mas spyad pa spyod pa chos spyod yi ge 'bri ba dang sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang sems bskyed sogs bcu tshan gsum lta bu spor ba mang du spel ba/ /spros pa 'gag pa sogs dang mtshan ma dang rtog pa sogs dang zal ba spangs pa sprul ba sbyin pa'am stob pa bskyed pa 'phrul du 'jug pa mchog sprul sogs gza' bdun gyi gcig la spen ba zer/ /gos gyon pa gnas rigs pa spo ba sgos pa brje ba sgyur ba bzu ba chu bor gru shan sogs sbyibs pa spying 117

ba bying du bcug pa spra tshil sprung rtsi'i ro ma'am snyigs ma lhung bzed glon byed dang lcags g.ya' len byed spyin 'byor byed kyi rdzas shig kha spyin lta bu/ /khe la 'jug pa'i spogs rgyal kha skyed bogs 'don pa spyang ki gcan gzan zhig spra sprel che spre'u spre g.yo byed1 /spyang po grung po sprin po'i ming spobs pa gdeng mi 'jigs pa sngon ma thos pa'i chos don rtogs nas bad la bar bshad kyang mi zad par byed pas dge ba legs spyad mi dgag tshig spyom pa ngom pa'am bdag nyid sgrog pa spyoms pa/ /thru blugs chab bum ril ba kha spub kha 'og tu bstan pa lhung bzed kha spub pa spub pa rgyan dang dpal gyis lus la zas pa mtshan pa brgyan pa spud pa/ /sbyi bo sbyi gtsug mgo bo rtse mo rdul can gyi gos sprugs pa sprug sprug byas pa rdul gyi don la thob pa'i spabs rdul chags pa rna spabs sogs/ /sgo gsum gyi spyod pa byed lugs za bkob ba zhum par byas pa ri bo yi spo rtse mo'am mtho ba'am rtse'i thang ngam rmang 'gram yang yin snyam/ /mig gi don la 'jug pa'i spyan 'dren byed spyan pa lta rtog mkhan nam gnyer pa lta bu dang sbos pa sgong ba spu la bab pa sprug pa spyi mtshan spang sbongs spun pa bsres pa'am thung ba sogs sar btags pa'o/ /(zad stab lngags stag gi pags pa ste 'dir gzhi dang ma 'brel ba dang drug sgra yod na pa rkyang dang drug sgra med na la mgo can te ma 'brel ba ni pags pa lta bu dang mi lngags snying lngags la sogs lar btags pa'o/ /ba phang pa pang ba'am ngos dang thu bar go phun sum tshogs pa dpal legs pa dge tshogs phun tshogs kyi gzhi tshugs zug pa'am chags shing chi ga 1 18

phrad dam rkang 'thung phun zhes pa tshad kyi khyad par te phun gang phun re sdud lta bu/ sprug gu na phra ba'i byis pa dang phrad pa mjal ba thug pa sprad pa 'phrad brdul zan rdul phra rab bdun lta bu phran bu chung ba gyi na cung zad phra ba zab pa zhib pa phra mo chung ngu / /brgya stong khri phrag tsho phyang ba 'phyang ba'i ming phyal pa 'phrul ba'i ming ngam yang na thur du phyang zhing phrul ba'i rgyan phyal grod pa'i zhe sa phyab re ba 'phyang tshul 'jol le ba/ /phyug pa po nor can 'byor ldan 'byor pa yod pa'i don pyir ched don slad du phyogs chos dang chos can dang de tshogs pa'i bsgrub bya'am dam bca' dang rgyab rten dang ris dang mthun dang shar sogs mtshams bcas bcur rgo pyin pa 'gro ba son pa song ba thob pa/ /phyag dar phyags snyigs phyag dar khrod sogs pyi sa dri chen bshang ba'i ming byed da zhib tu btags pa'i sman sogs byed rtsam pa phye ma/ /da/ ga rtsa bo mo dpal—lam g.yang mkhan po byed po phongs pa dbul ba nyam thag pa des pying ba ma btags pa'i gos phying zhwa phying dmar rul pa 'drul ba'am rnying ba phyar ba gdengs pa gzas pa brtsams pa 'phyar ba/ /pyi bdar phyi zhing phan tshun bdar ba'am ming tsam mam phyi ba'i ras dum gyis cog tse dang ri mo pyis pa dag par byas pa dbyi ba phyis shig kya byu1ba/ba ma rdul 'phyag byed kyib phyags pa 'phyag pa gad rgyag pa/ 1mam mtshan phyed dgung byed ka phyed ma byen 'og rlung rtug dri gtob ba btang ba phyi rdo 'phongs phyi ba'i rdo dang phyi rgyab kyi rdo phang ba 'phen pa'i ming / /dbang gis phyug pa lha chen rgyal po gtso bo mgon po dbugs phyung ba sems gso btang ba gnas spar ba dbugs bton pa tsam phyung ba 'byin pa bton pa sgo la srol phye ba 'byed pa btod pa brtsams pa phral ba bkrol nas/ /phyags lham rkang pa la gyon rgyu'i lham mchil lham sogs phran tshegs chung ngu'am nyung ngu dang 'dul lung sde 119

bzhi'i gcig phreb ba go rims su bstar ba'i gral lta bu phrogs pa 'phrog pa len pa tshar gcod pa phrogs shig /phra men lha'i g.yog 'khor ram gdon thran las las ka mdzad pa bya ba bya byed kyi las sa thos bsam sogs phyod che ba tshegs chung gis don chen skrub pa'i ming ngam sleb che ba/ phyugs dud 'gro'i bye brag rta sogs kyi ming phru ma mngal gyi bu sgod dam sha ma bye ma leb me lcer lcebs pa'i srog chags shig /phru ba sgod ji ma'am ji'u khog ma'i ming pyir phyi ru'am phyi rol tu phyung ba 'byin pa bton pa bkar ba bkol ba bskyed pa phyag lag pa'am sor mo lnga pa dag gis dar sogs phyor cig 'phyar ba'i skul tshig /smin ma mche ba'i zag par mtshams phyag 'tshal ba 'dud pa phyag byed pa nyid mo dang mtshan mo'i dus phyad pa rgyun pa rtag pa phyad par rgyun du'am rtag tu/ /phra ma dbyen nam skyo ma mi mthun par byed pa'i chi ga phrag dog gzhan gyi phun tshogs la mi dga' ba'i sems phrag ba dpung mtshams kyi cha phrag par khur lengs phrag gong lta bu zal ba 'phral ba phye ba bral ba tha dad du byed pa/ /phyin zad phan chad slad kyi cha yid sems phyung ba mi dga' ba'am skyo ba bskyed pa yid byung ba sun ci pyin pa rang gis rang sun 'byin pa dang gzhan la sun ci nus 'byin pa/ /pyi rjes 'brang ba snyeg pa pyir phyi ru'am rgyab tu dang yang ngam slar phyogs pa kha bstan pa gzhol ba 'jug pa pyin ci log pa nor ba go log pa mi bden pa/ /mi pham pa ma pham pa rgyal ba rgyal tshab byams pa tshig phan tshun phrad pa sbyo ba ste slar bsdu sogs yin tshig dang don dam par dbye ba 'byed pa lda dad par byed pa dang po sogs byed pa khyad par shes pa ma 'dres par rtogs pa ngos 'dzin pa/ /za ma dmag sgar dang pho brang phyar ba 'phyar ba rgod cing g.yeng ba ste rnam g.yeng dang phru dang zhabs phyi zhe sa'i phyag snga phyi phyi nang phyi mig rgyu mtshan gyi phyir pha bu pha lam 120

phu nu phar phyin pho ba pho long sogs ba rkyab ngo / /('pha)gzhan skyon can la 'phya bdang 'byas pa gnyis smod pa skyon brjod pa dpya ba 'od dang sem 'phro ba dang 'phros pa 'gyed pa 'cher ba g.yeng ba spro ba/ /'phyi ba sa khung gi srog chags shig 'bye bo rkang med sto ba sogs kyis 'gro mkhan dus tshod 'dzi ba dang 'byis pa 'gyangs pa 'gor ba/ /ram par 'phrul ba sprul pa g.yo ba 'gyur ba sgyu ma'i mig 'phyal rnam 'gyur snang cha sprul pa sgyu dra sogs mda' sgro ldan 'phen pa dang 'phangs ba skyel ba skrur ba rdeg pa rgyab pa 'phang ba rlag pa/ /nam mkha'i 'phab mthon po khri gdan 'phab mthon po'am steng go 'phang go gnas sam go sa mthon po 'phrog pa phrogs pa dang 'phrog byed/ /mtsho dang dud pa'am du ba spu ba 'phyur ba blud pa 'thul ba thon pa 'tshubs pa dung 'phyur grangs gnas shig lam 'jug ngogs 'phyug pa dang 'jigs pa gnyis nor ba 'dzol ba 'chugs kyang 'thad/ /snyib don gyi rgyal po'am sems 'phyo ba g.yo ba mi bde ba'i don 'phyon ma smad 'tshong ma 'jug mthun mas bye rtsam sogs spun pa 'phyar ba phyar ba rlung la bstan pa bkag pa'am brkyang ba lta bu 'phabs pa 'phen pa chud zos pa 'phangs bstod smad kyang / /'phongs tshos rkub tshos tshang ra rkub kyi ming 'phag 'phag gyen du 'phag tshul lam yang yang 'phag pa mgo bo dang thum po 'phur ba mnyed pa dang mkha' la 'gro ba/ /'phob mda'am mda' rig 'phong dpyad 'phong skyen sna lnga dag gis gzhan pha rol 'pham pa pham pa glags rnyed pa thub pa 'phal ka ri mo'am shing sogs sbyor mtshams kyi kha 'grig bsgrig pa/ /'phyan pa dbang med du 'khyam pa'am yan pa'i don yin zhing 'phyo ba g.yo ba'am lding blding sding byed pa dar bo che sogs 'phyar ba phyar bslong ba 'phral ma myur ba de ma thag glo bur te 121

'phral du song lta bu/ /'dzin gzhan la bskur ba'i gtam mam rwa na te 'phrin yig 'phrin pa lta bu 'phro da pa sprod pa mthun pa phan pa'ang 'phrod pa 'chi 'phras shi sdug ga ma mya ngan sems snying la 'phreng ba ni 'dzin ba ma brjed par dran pa chags pa dang bgrang 'phreng / /'phral ba gdong gi dprar ba dang so dor phral ba za dang bal 'phyings pa dam du 'brel ba'am phyir rwa/ ltar gyur pa phyab dar phyag rdo snyigs 'phyab/ pa4 phyags pa byi dor byas pa/ /'phyang ba thur du dpyang ba mchu 'phyang rna 'phyang lta bu dang 'phye ba 'gro ba༅ma brang sogs kyis 'gro ba dang bgrad kyang yin snyam 'phang 'phres 'phral 'phags 'phul rdzu 'phrul cho 'phrul 'phar 'phya ngas 'pho 'phos 'phan 'phel sogs 'dib kar bsnyem ba /da/ babla ma ni gong ma steng ma phyo ma dam pa slob dpon lci ba'i don bla na gong na'am gong ma na pogs za bre mchod rdzas sam thog yol bre ba nang bres pa phan tshum threl ba sbras ba / /byams pa bde ba dang ldan 'dob phan 'dod mdza' ba ma pham pas byad ma thu gnod pa mya ngan byur mya ngan ka sa nga na gang tshu la byabs pa thu ra du 'then ba 'ad/ 'og tu 'dren pa dang sel ba rdar bas byer ba bros pa 'thor ba song ba khyab pa/ /bre 'jal byed bre bo che bre kha sa sogs pa yi don bye ma phye 6/ ga lha'i bye ma sogs kyis zabs shā 'brab ba gtor ba ba pa rgyab ba 'ju bas byang ba sru ngas pa sbyangs pa mkhas pa 'byongs ba pag pa/ /zan pho mo ba yo ga pho mo byeb gzhis min pa phyogs byes ba so gas byom pa 'byon pa phebs pa byung ba byug pa snum sogs 'byug rdzas byer 123

pa sbyin pa ster za gnang ba/ /byis ba shed ma bye ba skye 'phags mkhas blun rgan gzhon gyi zlas phye ba'i byis pas bya ra lta rtog spyan pa mel tshe'i ming bya ba dgos pa las ka mdzad pa bya ba'i las byos shig gyis shig blugs shig /zam ze bza ṇa zur chag pa ste tshangs pa'i bu rgyud rigs bzhi'i gcig zag gi ri bo dang brag zhun brag skyibs lta bu'i don byang phyogs bzhi'i ya gya' du grags byol ba 'dzur ba'am yol ba 'byol ba byol cig kung / /bya 'dab chags dang rus shig dang bgyi byi'u bya chung ngam bya phrug byi ba lo skor bcu gnyis kyi dang po byi la byi ba'i dgra byad bzhin dbyibs tshugs dgra/ /byol song dud 'gro dang thogs med du 'gro ba zab gis 'gro ba sbrul la sogs pa'i ming zang lus kyi mthong ga dang bla brang pho brang byil byil bshud pa'am bshad pa'i tshul lam dbyibs lta bu/ /za gab steng ngam thog g.yogs bla bos steng ngam stod gos blus pa blu ba rin gyis nyos pa blus shig kyang go bla rung bzod chog /blun pa sems med lta bu'am rmongs pa po can nam bdag sgra yin snyad/ 'dam dang chur bying ba nub pa spyings pa blo gros rig pa shes rab blong blob po rtab rtab po tshabs tshabs po mi bde ba rig pa mi gsal ba/ /pro zhes pa nad kyi ming bro 'tshal ba na ba thabs sprub byed dang zal ba 'bral ba 'phral ba sgangs pa bro bor ba mna' bskyal ba'am sgog pa bros pa 'bros pa 'khyus pa bros shig /byan mo g.yog mo'am byeg tshod ma'i don byi bo byi byed po gzhan gyi chung ma spyod mkhan nam 'chal po dang byi mo byi phrug kung mtshon par byed rang byan chud pa rang dbang thob pa'am gyur pa/ /byag mkhan mda' skya khan nam gar mkhan thra zhabs bro gar zlos gar lta bu bye ba grangs shig dang rgyas pa dang bral bas brel ba da 'khom med pa/ /kha'i so yis blad pa ldad pa 'cha' ba bcem pa chu chang blud pa ldud pa ster ba zas thug brims 123

pa 'brim pa ster ba 'dren pa brims shig thrad pa dga' ba dang rtse ba brod po rtsed mo'am dga' po/ /bya na bya kun zur chag thug pa'am tshod ma ste spags ma'am ro gsal ba'i don yo byad spyad dngos byur bu gang tshul lam phyur bur go zags pa blug pa bcug pa ldugs pa blugs shig kyang / /da byid stobs skyed sman skyin gor ro rgod dri pro ba myong ba tshor ba za ba byi ba lta bu'i sems can zun lud skyag bya brun lha bu/ /dong khung sogs su drubs pa 'brub pa nang du bcug pa mi thar bar byed pa brubs shig chu bo drug pa rgyas pa gang ba gru ba tsha ba dang bru ba ni stogs pa bkres pa/ /gos gyon gos sogs byer ba dman pa zhan pa ngan pa yin snyam gos byed ltar na tshem bu pa btsa 51ga tshos sam khrus brtsa blag mkhan lta bu gos sogs spyod ba byibs pa g.yo ṭa pa bkab pa/ /za gnyan po gnad rten rtsa ba yin snyam tshe bla'i don nam srog byab bu brjed byang chung ba kha ming mdzad 'gyur shing byang lta bur go ba bla tshon ser po zhig byugs pa bskus pa 'byug pa byugs shib/ /kha dang lag pa yis blabs pa len pa blang ba sprub pa 'jug pa za thabs brjod bde'am rung thabs bde blag sla ba glo bur sa bla sa steng ngam sa las 'phags pa'i steng gis khyer ba khur ba/ /blo rig brid pa 'brid pa bslus pa za dwags ming gi rnam grangs sam ming btags pa'am thogs pa yi ge ri mor bris pa bkod pa bri ba bris shig kyang / /spu skra byi ba ma btogs kyang med par gyur pa dang ri mo byi ba yang za byad cha lugs gzi byin gzi brjid zil nus pa bri ba 'bri ba nyams pa 'grib pa 'brid pa/ /byi ba'i / da dang za nye gnyis skar ma tha dad par go za bo 'bru'i khyad par rgya bra sogs phye rtsam chang byo ba 'byo ba blug pa//byug ris gral lam go rims bya ba bgyi ba'am zer bdaka ming bye zag nang gses khyad par gsal ba ba / /rgyud ba po sa skyong gi blo / ji kyi po gros byed po mdun 124

na 'don blo gros kyi mig spyan bde blag bya sla ba dka' tshegs med pa nges par byed pa bgyid pa byed las/ /zang ba len pa dor ba 'dor ba blon 'debs pa zur nas gros 'debs pa'am ston pa bla bo gtam mam brjod pa la1 /khyim nas khyim med par rab tu zub ba 'byung ba phyung ba'am phul byung za kha spu zebs pa 'breg pa gcod pa rna ba nyan byed blags pa rna ba gtod pa nyan pa blogs shig nyon cig /lto gos zas gos zab zeng ngan ngon nam gyi na bya dga' gnang sbyin nam zho shar go byin pa ster ba sbyin pa/ /zan gyi bla ma sman rgyal zab ba spangs pa chub pa rtogs pa'am byang nas shes pa'am goms cha che ba bla na gong na med pam mchis pa/ /gzi byin gyis tshubs pa rlob pa'i ming tsam nus pa'i don 'dra byu ru dang byi ru rin chen dmar po dang brang skyes kha brag byings gtong bra ba byung ba byin rten bong bab rtsam bum ba babs pa bu ga brus brang nge sogs ba rkyab ngo / /(da bsnyed byed pa mi mthun pa phra ma dbye ba'i ming dab dbye ba phye ba bye brag khyad par zal ba spangs pa chos rnams kyi dbyibs rang bzhin khams 'dzin byed 'byung gnas sgra'i skabs byings kyang zer dbyibs gzugs kyi khyad par ring thung sogs/ /dbye ba byar med pa spu mi dad pa gcig pa dbu ma dang dbubaXdang dbus ma gsum dkyil ma bar pa mtha' bral gyi don gcig kyang tshig sbyor legs tshul grags pa bzhin byed dbus na mo yang / /dbyu gu chu tshod dang shing bu dang dbyug pa chung ba dbyig pa dang dbyug pa gnyis ber ka'i ming snga ma brda rnying dbyugs pa dbyug pa skyur ba 'phen pa sdun pa dor ba yang 'jug med pa 'di da lta ba dang ma 'ongs par 'thad dbyugs shig kyang / /jib bu'i chu dbol ba btang ba 'chor ba rtol ba chu dang 'bru dpob pho ba 'bo ba bshos pa skar ma'i khyad par la 'jug pa'i dpo dang dbo zla/ /phyir 126

dbyung ba phyir phyung ba 'byin pa bton pa sun dbyung ba 'byin pa phyung ba bton pa mtshor dang lcags gzer gyis dbug pa phug pa 'bugs pa rtol ba/ /dbul ba za bkren po med po sprung pos dbugs kha sna'i rlung lta bu dbyung ba phyung ba 'byin pa bton pa nor spyad dngos mi dgag chig dbrog pa 'phrog pa 'joms pa/ /tshon rtsi kyi ge dbyi ba 'byid pa phyis pa 'dag par byed pa'am sub pa dbyig mo 'jam po la sogs par go dbyig dbyig dbur tshul 'jam 'jam byil byil sgra'i khyad par yang yin snyam dbur ba (ba jam por byed pa 'khrud pa/ /dbon po tsha bo sku mched rtsis pas dbyangs gdangs nga ro 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can ma dbul ba 'bul ba phul ba skur ba sbyin pa mchod pa sma dma' ba'i don yin 'dra mi dgag tshig dbab pa 'bebs pa 'bab tu 'jug pa bab pa sbrel na sma 'bebs mi byed pa'i don/ /dbyig gnyen kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbu mgo rtse mo gong ma ga rtsa bo gzhung bya ba lus kyi dbu zhabs lta bu la go bdugs gur sgog kyang dbub pa 'bubs pa phub pa bkab pa lta bu/ /dbang bskur ba byed rung ba'i ba bang sprang pa gtong ba dang blug ba 'i don byin rlabs sogs dbab pa 'bebs ba phab pa gtan la dbab pa do na la gnas par byed pa 'bebs pa phab pa /bar ma chab pa'i lung dbog pa 'bogs pa phog ba mnod pa len pa sbyon pa nor khur dbog pa 'bogs pa phog pa bzhag pa gted pa sbyin pa dben pa bas mtha' mi g.yo ba stong pa ste dben sar dben gnas su dbral ba 'phral ba phral ba ral du 'jug pa 3/nga / /dbang byug u ma'i bar ba/ po za/bas/ dbang ba che ba 'a za pang lnga ra pa byang shar ram dbang can ba bang thang mnga' thang kha rje dbya dz+wa ka dus shig dbyar gnab/ dbyar rnga/ 1dbang bya ra dbab ba po nyi ku dru gnyis sam re'i dbang po so gab dbyig nor ram 126

rin po che mang po dpral ba sogs dbyes khyon nam rgya che ba/ /dba' rlabs rba rlabs dbu ba phru ba byon dang mar gyis dbags pa 'bags pa bsgos pa bsre sa pa 'das pa la dbags 'thad dam dpyad/ /dbre ba dang btsog pa gnyis dme ba mi gtsang ba ngan pa gyong po kha dbri ba 'brid pa phri ba dma' bar byed pa zhe sa gus pa'i don can gyi dba' ste lags so lta bu/ /dbal zhes pa ni sha nyams she da mo dang rtse mo'am zur dang drob dang hog la 'jug ste rim bzhin rta'i dbal phur ba'i dbal me'i dbal rgyal mtshan gyi dbal lta bu dang shugs kyang yin snyam/ /zha nye las byas pa'i dbyar 'dab sgod steg ba/ sam dge blong ma'i lhung bzed kyi stegs bu dang dbyig dug 'byig 'dzin yid dbyung phong sa pa'i dbul ba dbad pa dbyings mnga' sogs das 'phul ba'o/ /('baka rab tu 'byam sa pa dang 'byams klas pa gnyis mtha' klas pa'am mang po snga ma bsdus na lha rams lta bu kun(1dpa ba chen po sa chu me rlung bzhi grangs 'drug dbyar rnga'am sprin sgra/ /'bral ba bral ba meb pa dgag chib dang 'brel pa 'am ba sbrel ba phan tshun sbyor ba mthun pa nye 'brel 'gal 'brel 'bras bu bskyed bya gzhag bya don dgos pa dngos po 'bru nas gro sogs dang 'bru ma rdog ma dang tshugs/ /'bring po bar ma dkyil 'dam chur 'bying ba bying ba nub pa 'drum pa ni nad kyi khyad par 'brum dkar nag 'byang ba byang ba sbyong ba sto ba 'khru ba dag pa/ /'brog dben pa dgon pa yul 'breg gi ming 'bri mo gnag gi khyad par 'brong ri dwags g.yag rgod rus kyi bye brag gcig la 'brom du grags/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba ma 'ongs pa'am skye 'gyur tshe 'byid pa phyid pa 'tsho ba tshe mgo 'thon pa'ad/ skyel ba 'drid pa'i ngon la 'byid pa 'thob cing dbyi ba'i don mang yin/ /121

ma sobs 'bal ba 'dzings pa gcod pa bshig pa'abel ba legs pa yang dag pa chos mthun gyi brtam mchid sgo srol me tog 'bye ba bye ba rgyas pa bral ba 'byed pa phye ba dbye ba 'joms pa 'phral ba rgyas pa/ /'bras char brtsas pa'i 'bras lce ro 'dzin pa yis 'byob pa ldag pa 'dag pa zang phye 'byo ba byo ba sgod gcig das gcib/ tu blug pa byos pa' byangs pa dag pa lho ba 'khru ba chu la sbangs pa'ang yin snyam/ /'brom gyi rus 'dzin dge bshes ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'byon pa byon pa phebs pa 'byung ba'i dus tshe skabs 'bros pa bros pa 'khyus kang rjes su 'a zang ba 'brangs pa 'gro ba snyeg pa 'jug pa/ /'drub pa brubs pa bcug pa'i khung bu kha 'byed pa kha dbye ba phye ba 'byol ba byol ba 'jur zhing 'byer ba byer ba nyams pa 'bros pa 'gro ba/ /mtshang skyon 'dru ba 'dru ba sngog pa brus pa'i ming tshig drungs 'byin pa 'don pa phyung ba tshon snum 'byug pa skud pa byugs pa 'byongs pa byang ba 'byang ba 'byangs pa sbyong ba spangs pa goms pa dag pa 'khru ba 'byongs shig kyang / /mtsho kha 'bri ba bri ba 'grib pa dman pa dang yi ge 'dri ba chu 'drub pa 'phel ba rgyas pa 'khol ba brubs kyang 'thad snyam sprur ba'i don ston pa la 'byar ba 'jug mod byed po dang dngos su 'brel ma 'brel gyi khyad par yod tshul 'di kho bos kyang bsres nas bkod pa rnams phyed dgos rtags 'byar 'byar ma lta bu dang 'byor ba'i sbyor yang / /'byub ba po sems yod dang khyad par bdon gyi rigs dang skye ba po'i don 'byor ba longs spyod son pa 'thob pa mthun pa dang 'byung 'gyur 'byung ba rus kyi 'bal zhabs 'brid 'bre 'bred pa nad kyi 'brag 'bags pa 'brongs sogs 'as 'phul ba'o/ /(za3 khyi sogs zad ba chod pa 'gyed pa gtong ba skul ba mngag pa zad ba ri nas bgrib ba'i rdo sgrib ba 'gril ba kha zad kha 'bras sam kha bshad 128

dam kha sgrom che ba/ /za dba' rlabs klong 'khor skya zab bdag na gyi dbye ba zhig za dang ba la zad rngod 'phyings pa'i tshul lam phying ba sgyur gyur pa dang / /rngod ma mthu byad dam than skyel ba gtob ba bang na ma dgag tshig sngo lo ma phyar yang yin 'dra rbad bya rbod byed bad rngod cig dang rngod gtong rbad gcod sogs rar btags ba'o/ 1(lnga) gru ba chu'i dbu ba lda ba zhe sogs kyi sha lhag g.yang lnga byur lnga sogs lar btags ba stan/ /(sba3 nor sogs sbyin pa byin pa ster ba gnod pa sbyin pa gdon zhig sbyin pa'i bdag po yon bdag thron pa grogs 'bod pa bcol ba 'gu ṭa bsgon cig dang / /spun pa 'bru sogs kyi shun pa'am skogs snying po med pa zabs rta skya gag ma lud dang sbang ma sbang glum mam thum gyi bcud phyung ba'i snyigs mas zangs pa sbang ba rlon pa byas pa/ /sbug phug gam nang sbug ma nang ma khang pa sogs kyi sbug byu go nor gter sba bya sbas zin pa spras shig sped byed de bzhi po'i rdon skung ba gsang ba srung ba/ nyis sbrag nyis sprel sum sbrag rkyang pa dang sbrag ma lta bu za nag tshang ngam gur 'bubs pa phub pa sprel ba sbyor ba sdeb pa 'brel nas sbyar ba sbyor ba sdeb pa/ /sbres pa 'khyags pa'am grang nas spur ma rtsi shing chang chung ngam rdul lta bur go me sgron sbar ba dang spor ba gnyis spor ba 'a par ba sgor cig kyang / /chu sog4 kyis sprus pa bsgos pa bkrus pa zas zan sprus pa brjis pa g.yos pa phyogs gcig logs shig tu sngoms zhes pa sbom dang sbams 'byang ba ltar na skal tshig ta ༄ ༄ ༄gzung la don sngom pa sdud pa sre ba/ /sprum ma mngal ldan ma she spyo ra ma lto ba mgo spos pa skrangs pa gang ba spog zags kyi khyad par zhig la spre zer/ /phyag sbal brtsan khang ngam brtsan dong grog ma dang sprur ba 'bu zhig sbal 129

pa sbyo ce— nga zi 'a ri ga thos / /grog ba/ ra mda' sbran rngo/ sgon za sbubs ji/ grib sa pab rdo bsgyu re bad rwa1 skyed 1ka spe' ba phrud pa 'bud byed me chas la sogs pa'i ma— pa bribs nang nga ma /pho ka stong rgya bu ga pad sbubs smyug sbu bas / /sbyig mo kar/ za 'a tshug ba/cer bur go thrug pa 'dred pa 'byid pa la 'jug cib spe ba/ shed tshad da pa'am dbyug res byed pa'i ming sbyong ba sbyang ba spyor ltar na sbyar ba / /sngug rwa1 dab/ skam pa'am ri—da pa rdzud pa'i tshe dus kyi don yin snyam ste dpyad tsho lu sa kang sbi da pa ste kang pa sprid na 'ja(re jib 'gro mi nus pa lta bu sba shing gi 3ra/bar ba sba dbyug sba lcag dpyod ‘ phra hūṃ— na rags pa sdom pa / /ldan 'a/ 'khor rngo 'i za nga bu dang zang ma ra mig gnyis pa sbrang ma 'i rtsi me tes bcud ba/ra sbrags ba rja ga za ka' ba / /sprur byed rdo ba gor ma ba/ser so gas kyi za ched bu gru bki1 lta ngu1rem lhad rmeb dang lce ba'am bzang ba tsa3 le sbram bka1nga ri na chad dang rngo/ dang pa par rngon re sprad/ 6 nga / /stsor ba sngo na 'bro ra gab pa— ka pes rna' —dkar lhar ba sgo pyo pa tre ba ba (re khri1 pa rdzu ba —khyo ba/nga bya (red zu ḍa 13 — ba bya sbyor byed sgong bye— bdag byed glo ba bye da drung ba6 pa spangs dab / ba1pe zab pa / / bge pyob 1 ngar1 rgya1she — ba/ sa gso thrur 3 —ka ga brgyad pa sog 4 bzang —shā bdung 6/ dag ba zlor za sprur ba sbyor cib — nga 1 /snye bdo chub ba/ kun ba nga ba/na mu/ kyi lnga ba ṭu zu rtse 1rngo rtags dang sdib sbribs ṭā/ ba spreb ba/ mi8 ma—4 ba'i spyod lnge —shā stad dbyed— lhags ka ma ba / hūṃ nga sbyong ba chu 'a bye /ngas byed sbongs kyi sheb/ pahūṃng 'a kad sta༅ ( sbyi sa kyi pre dang/sa sar btags ba'o/ /'amaba'i du khu 6 —tsha6ka sre sha bra3 za 'i lus drugs da pa rul rngo/ ro myag 1red ma 1 rdeb—

sogs phyag ba ljan ljin nam mi gsal ba nags tshal sogs su byul ba gnyul ba 'tshol ba rgyu pa byur ba mgyogs pa la/ /nyams ro myong ba mung ba tshor ba myong cha myu gu gsar skyes ljang pa'i ming nas myug sogs ro mngar ba sogs myang ba myong ba bro ba rjos pa bzi ba'am dga' ba/ /mub 'das zu ngan las 'das pa thar pa nges par song ba sprung sprub gug gug gam 'gro tshul sprug byug khyag khyug gam 'tshol tshul lam dmyugs tshul dang / /rtsa ngan sems kyi sdug bsngal lam mi bde ba mya ngam dkun dung ngam chu med pa mya ngam thang lta bu dang myos 'gyur myangs myongs shig mog mog mad pa mal spul mes po ma rkyang ngo 1 / (dam) dmag g.yul lam tshogs dag gi ming nyes dmigs nyes pa'am mi dge ba'i 'bras bu dmangs ni rigs bzhi'i ya gyal dman pa tha ma spu shal dma' ba phri ba'am med pa/ /dme po rus gcig pa gsod mkhan da skus long mig med pa ldongs pa dmigs bu long khrid pa long sna 'khrid mkhan med pa/ /dmya rgod spyong po gtum pa da sku chu dmu jing ste chu nad 'dre da na gyi khyad par la 'jug pa'i dmu gdon zhig chu nad kyi bdag po/ /blo rig dmur pa blun pa mi gsal ba dmus zung tshi chad pa spro shi ba yi 1—chad pa bu ga'i don can gyi dmig khung bu/ /gtsang ma dag pa dme ba dbreb brtsag pa 'dzum dmul ba cung zad rgod pu rgod pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dzum dmul dmul yang dmigs ba dmigs bya dmigs byed mthong ba bsam pa sgom pa gnad myong ba gtod pa gtad pa/ /ba ba dmar lag pas khag stu/ ra ba dang bshad pa kha dmar khas khag khur ba 'gan dang kha gsal dang kha dmar gdags pa thag gcad pa lta bu kha dog mdog dmar ba'am po mtshal mdog lta bu/ /nyams shing dmas pa rgud pa 'grib pa nyag phra ba dmod pa btsuṭa 131

pa dang bzad pa 'dor ba gnyis smon lam ngan pa 'debs pa dmod mo byed pa bden pa bdar ba lta bu/ /dmyal ba chags pa'am dga' ba med pa tsha dmyal sogs gnas go sa dam rjed ba dmas pa dma' mo'i bya ba dman pa dmigs kyis bsal ba spyir btang ma yin pa logs su bkar ba nges gzung dmib/ba/ kyis bye ba dang/ /byug byug byas te dbyugs pa bcug pa 'dzul ba 'thon pa 'tshol ba sprug myug gi bya ba yin 'dra dmar khrid dmar ser mod mi dma' dmigs bcas dmigs med dmigs rnam dmag dpon mi dpung lha min dmya la theg blo skye dman sogs das 'phul ma'o/ /(rma3 rmad du zung ba phul byung ngo mtshar 'phel ba dam pa sprugs 'dzin rmyags ldan gnod sbyin gyi bye brag dzam+bha la zi lam gnyid kyi 'khrul snang ste gnas skabs bzhi'i gcig rmang lam yang zer jis pa rmi ba gzim lam 'byung ba rmi lam mthong ba/ rmab rtsa ba'am 3gram gzhi nas mo ba dang zlas pa gnyis rmod pa zhing gi phru slog pa'am rmon pa rgyab pa spyod na pa rmo ba'i ming dor cha zung 'dra ba dang / /zlabs pa gti mug ma rig pa bdag lta mi shes pa sprugs pa gdon zhig dang rig pa mi gsal ba bying ba'i rnam grangs kyang yin khyi yis rus pa ril bu rmur ba sos bcem pa'am bcag nas ba lngad pa 'cha' ba mur ba kyu gas pa so 'debs pa'am rgyab pa dang gnod pa'i ming rma lhan skyes dang gsar byung gi rma dang bu ga dang skyon dang rus shig /rmen pa tshil la yod pa'i sha nag dang rma shul rmin bu yang zer rta mig rta sogs kyi rkang lag gi rā rmig pa dang rgya dngul rta rmig ma sga yi chas rmed rnga mar bskon bya/ /chongs bu blun po gsang gnas kyi spu rmeg re da gtan nas med pa gtan med ming med sun pa'i don can gyi zus pa skyo ba mtsher ba yi chad pa/ /ser rme ser sna 'jungs pa bzas rme sri ba phri ba ser sna byed pa lta bu ngo mtshar 132

la go ba'i rmad rmad byung rmad po che lta bu/ /mo mo a phyi dang ma phyi dang rgan mo bal sogs rmel ba gsed pa dang 'khal ba yang yin snyam dris pa'i don can gyi rmas pa rmed pa rmad pa gtam 'dri ba zhu ba/ /rma bya mdongs mtha' can khams zu ba khams nyog pa rid pa nyams pa bya rgyung gar ram rkyong shad byed pa bgyid pa/ /smog mgo rmog dang go cha spyi mtshon las skyob byed ngang dbu mog mgo rmog dang dbu 'phang dang ya lad kyang rmas pa rmas ma rmod pa rmed pa rma dang rmig bu sogs rar btabs ma'o/ /(za) sman nad gso byed kyi rdzas dang spod sogs dang sman pa lha rje 'tsho byed gso ba po'i ming gtam mchid smra ba smras pa bshad pa spros snyed ga smra ba'i skul tshig /smig rgyu ri dwags sred chu ltar snang ba smag rum mun rum smag mun pa dang sman zhig zang ma min pa la go ba'i smar gces pa gser dngul lta bu/ /sman skye ba'i ljongs yul sug spel snyu ka la zur chag pa e la phra mo ste sman zhig sprug shad shing gi khyad par dang / /sprug ma shing zhig smyug rtsi tsu gang dong rto bu sbi gu smyu gu ste 'bri byed dam smyug chung thrug ma shing snyug ma smin kyi pa tshos pa thul ba spyad rung gzags rung / /che khog sku lam grong smad smad cha stod min pa sma phab pa sma 'bebs pa'am skyon brjod pa smad ra bstod ra min pa'am smod pa'i ming tsam dang brnyas thabs kyis smod pa smad pa 'phya ba dma' bar byed pa/ /ba go sogs sprub ba ring po'am dbyibs 'jong mo sprung ba smra ba'am gas nga ba dar smre sngabs sdug skad dam 'i dod spras pa smra ba bshad pa/ /lu smad ma bu gnyis ka'i spyo ming ming mtsha na nas blo sa pa brjod pa bshad pa spyan ka gnyen ka bag ma gtong len gye thabs byed pa bgyid pa lhag ltung zhig kyang / /ngur spyog za hong dang da3/ra se ra dam ngar smin pa 'bras bu spyi tsam dang 3bra lnga'i gcig dang byed par yang go smos pa 133

ci zhig dgos te bshad mi dgos ga / /sprub bar gzas ba tshas kyi da711'a thub byed pa'am stogs sko ma du gan sa pa bdub da tshod byung zad sprur ba—3ma spu ra btsug pa zang na pa smyo mkhan tro ba sprus za se che1sa rnal du rmi gnas ba'i3da 'a snge ka ba / /smon 'drir grogs po blo brlug dre me da dag pa dri spred lhar na ga1—)ma 'dri ba'i don du bshad kyang de la dri rmed 'thad snyam ste dpyad smon — 4ma 'dod don sha smon cing 'dun ḍa 4'i mi nga tsa 4 sma na pa ba na pa sman sprur rwa rte— phan gyur cib/ ste 1 kyu 1 /spyo 1na drug dang smal po dang smin drug gi tsa ga tu ma snar ma'i khyad ji1ra / /'u/sa kyi sgo pa'i 'a thi shā/ sprub po'i rtsi1 ba bri mo tsa/ ga(1/ ri tshos la jog— mdob sbra ka po thu sprug lta bu / /mi ra kha spu stsom ma ba mig spu sprin (re khyodaka sta bu sme ka/6can pre ca na 1/ ma rib / kad dngan / 1 nag rtses kye sme ba bad ga dkar jo bas dka dang slon pa smad ma hūṃ shā bka smin lce da sprung smred pa smad bzang smab/ pa ra smreg smre za sogs sar btagar gi ma 'o/ /tsatsab tsub ba tshab ྅ba mi/ brtan pa mi bya mi bgyi rtsag tsog pu tsog pu 'a dub1 rte pab/ shig 1tsan ban 6 rde na zur cha pha ba tshim byed dam 1dbar byed de shing theb lha ta a ka'i khyad par ro kar snyo /bad can lci shing tsam ba ka me tog dang dzong kye ༄ khrig tsaka 1ka zu༄ cha ga /tsa tsha ra sta dong ma preb1 gam mig che/nges rnyi4nga che4 ba ༄ — —dud rtsib/—da tsho ba 'i bya bar skru rnyi mo bye'u 'che— spru chung 4/la / /rtse rtsa—'a pab 1 —sa— lte —pa//nyis pa je rtsam za de sted pa tsa 6/ ba ) pa tshad 'ji dang nge ༄ —zang za dzi de cug de ༅ 5'a 64 de t+ta 'a dī lags cho na nam reng ba di sngeb co 1ba / / /ce ne ce re 'ad / 'dub/ skru—shā ce re skad tse ra tser tsa ri / 3 1

ba gnas tsa rir sdod mkhan/ tsā ru zhes pa'i don bzab ba'am lha bshos dang mdzes pa tsa na ka sran chung zhig /tsug tsug kha nas tsug tsug zer ba'i sgra dang tsan+d+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsog pu ni tsu la ma gas tsa rkyang ngo / /(gtsa ) gtsug tor spyo tor spyo bo dang gtsug gnyis mgo bo'am rtse mo gtsang khab dri gtsang khang ngam 'du khang gi spug khang gtsang ba dag pa btsog pa med pa/ /mi gcigs pa mi rigs pa'am mi 'os pa'i spyod pa byed tshus btsug lag sde sgod dam gsung rab kyi khang pa gnas/ ga rtsod ri dgas shig rus rus pa'am ru'am rwas gces pa 'tshe ba gzir bar byas 'ing gzur ba mi rigs byed pa'am 'tshe byed kye sa gces pa sun par byas pa'am gtses shig /mche ba gcigs ba sgrig pa sbyor ba rtseg pa gtsub byed kyi shib dang gtsub bya'i gtan gyi shing gtsubs pa gtsub pa brdar ba 'drud pa skyod ba/ /gtso za rang bzhin bye khyab rje po gnad mgon po snying po gtsegs gces spras sam rtsa ba che ba chen po btsag bu gtsag byed kyi mtshon chung ngam gtar sprud kyis gtsags pa gshags pa gtar ba bab1sa pa bton pa gtsas pa/ /gtsang chu chen nam dbus kyi cig shos sam dag pa'i phyogs ngos kyi don gtsang chu yang de bzhin du sbyar ga rtsa ba gtse ba gtsang ma mi gtsang ba gtsub pa gtsag pa sogs bas 3phul tsa'o/ /(btsaka btsan pa sdog pa med pa 'da' bar mi byed pa 'gyur mi nus pa dbang ba gnyan pa btsan zad btsan pa po'am btsan pa'i ming gnya' khri btsan po srong btsan sogs bka' gsung btsan po 'da' mi nus pa'am gnyan pa rjob mkhar btsan po bgrod dam/ḍa (ma 'gyur mi nus pa dang / /btsun mo rje mo rgyal po'i 1 zung mar go bu phrug btsas pa btsa' ba skyes pa 'khrungs pa gru gzings ko btsas gla bhe gru phud ji/ri rngan pa'am yon btsal ba re tshol ba 136

gnyul ba brtag pa/ /btsun pa gtso bo khrims ldan grwa pa spyi dang bye brag la zhe sa'i brda mig kha btsums—pa 'dzu mas pa zum du 'jug pa bcon gyi ra ba brtsan khang la sogs par go btsud pa 'dzud pa nang du bcug pa/ /gos gyon pa brtsems pa 'tshem pa drubs pa btsem pa btsag sa tshos sam sa tshon dmar po sogs dang bcod dmar tshos shing tshos kyis snam bu sha gser brtsos pa mdog sgyur ba smin pa bzhus pa 'tshed pa/ /btsan dug bong nag sogs tshags 'tshag byed kyis btsags pa 'tshag pa dwangs snyigs phye bar shes dgos shing brtsir ba 'tshir ba phyung ba bar du ba'i ra ba/ /lcags btsa' g.ya' yis khyer ba ste g.ya' rgyab pa 'bags pa la go ba'i btsag pa mi gtsang ba dbre ba brtso zag tshos sam khrus mkhan byed po/ /mtho btsams pa mtho 'tshams pa co 'dri ba ka dgran pa gnod pa jeb pa la go ba'i ba tshog pa 'tshog pa rdung ba bcog po rdo ba skyug bro bo ngan pa'am mi legs pa pho btsog pho rgod jeg pa rdung ba/ /btsan 'dre'i khyad par rgod po btsan babs spubs btsan pa glo bur gser rin chen dang po brtso ma bzhu btul byas pa'am lhad med kyi zhun ma ste brtsa ma'i gser sogs/ /spom ka btsugs pa 'dzugs pa btod pa phye ba kang kang 'thung btsugs pa 'dzugs pa bskyed pa btab pa bsnyun pa slong ba btod pa sgog pa ke'u brtsong kun dong ngam 'tshong ba brtsongs pa btsong ba 'tshong ba rdzas brje ba/ /btsad po rgyal po btsas ma lo tog brnga bya ste 'tsho skyong byas pa'i don 'dra btsa' ba brtsa ba la btsas btsun ma btsem pa mtho btsam pa sogs bas 'phul tsa'o/ /(rtsa)rtsa lag gnyen nam nye 'brel rtsa ba gzhi ma drung sdong po'i 'og cha shod skyed byed gtsigs gnad sdom rtse mo mchog ma mgo steng ma gong ma phul byung rab tshon rtsi mdog sgyur byed dam ri mo 'bri byed kyi rdzas rtsing ba zhib min 136

rags pa sbom pa rtsi nga po rtsing ge /rtsi mar 'o zho rtsi tog gi mar rtsi shib gzhi mthun gyi sgra'am rtsi dang shing rtsi thog ka'am sngo 'i 'bras bu rtswa sngo gzan pa sogs/ /'ab rtsod 'khrub rtsod rtsod pa 'thab pa mi mthun par smra ba rgol ba rtsed mo rtsed 'jo rol rtsed rtse ba dang rtses pa'am rtses shig dang rtsen pa dmas rol ba rtsed mo rtse ba/ /lngas rtsen pa mi spyi'am lha'i dbye ba sum rtsen pa skabs gsum pa lha rtsis grang ba/ sam rtsis rig rtsis mkhan rtsis pa rtsi po/ /rtsing ma glo g.yas g.yon pri rus thur lta bu'i ming rtsa dbu rkyang ro gsum sogs spubs can rgyus pa chu ba ji bad ba g.yag gi spu lta bu rgyudang ba pa mi 'jam pa gdung ba skya ba gyong ba yid du mi 'ong ba rtsub mo/ /kha rtsang grong tshig la kha sang ngam khar sang yod rtse nod rtse zhing rgod pa lha 'bangs ga ro ga po rtsam pa phye rin pa gong rtseg pa sgar ba rtseg rtseg byed pa/ /rtsabs ni gcod pa'am cob rtse sogs mi 'gul bar byed pa'i shing lta bu yin snyam rtsad gcod rtsad rtsa ba nas gcod pa dang rtsa ba'am rjes gcod pa tsher ma la go ba'i rtsang ste mdos rtsang rtsang phur yang / /ste/bab ba la go ba'i zab pha rol gnon pa'i bya ba 'bad pa dang rtsol ba brtson pa dang 'du byed dang brtsal ba rtsom pa bya ba'am mgo 'dzugs pa'am gsung rtsom rjod ba pa brtsa che pa sbyor ba/ /snyed sogs ba ji rtsabs rtsi'am ru rtsi rtsab mo chang 'dra ba'i skom mam btung ba zhig ser po'i mdog 'dzin gyi rgyu ba lcum lta bus btsos pa dka da/ba gyon pa sogs/ /rtsib/ pa rtsig skyabs ba/ma rtsig bzhin pa rtsig mkhan rtsig pa po rdo bzo lta bu 'khor lo gdub/sa la so gas pa'i rtsibs rkang ngam thur ma lta bu ste rtsibs mur khyud//kun ba ba ba skyen pe/ra gyi bye brag rmig pa'am yan lag gi rlung lnga'i gcig bsnyeb/ rtsol rlung ste tha dad du phral ba yang snang rtsoms shig rtseg rtsegs shig rtseg rtseg bdud sra gla zhag rtsi gzhi rtsa ma rtsa rtsad chod sogs rar btags tsa'o/ /137

(rtsa she bkar gsung zab / ba gnang ba da11sa grub thun mchog gi grub ba stsal pa sbyin pa' che/ gnang ba dang stsol byi na cig gam sbyi na pa/ /sbyen pa stsal ba sbyin pa'am gtad bar ba lpi bya bgyid du stsal ba byeng du bcug pa las la sbyar ba/ /stsa' du gso' gnang ba—jim sbyin nga/ra mdzod dam zhu zhes pa'i don yin la dus gnu/che/ gyi tshe pha' cher stsal zhes 'byung zhing sngon 'jug sbyar na 'das ma 'ongs go bar myo4 zad rwa1sal ba'i don yang rto na bya bar—stsal ba sogs sar btags tsa'o/ /(brtsad brtson pa ni 'grus pa 'bad pa lhang brtse ba snying po ltar brtse nga ste snying rje brtse ba can ba rtse ldan lhong rje can/ /brtsad pa cod shā4 brga4 ba rtsad bcad pa la 'jug cing jis ma1 che/sa nas brtsam bu bstan bco4 bshem bya ba lha bu brtsam sa pa rtson/ pa sbya༄ nga byar—/ pa/ —bab bu 'i ye brtseb/sa pa rtseg pa gcib/ steng du ba/cib ba3ga pa rte bu brtsis/po rnga1 rtsig pa steng nas steng du sgrig pa lha bur go 'grob shing brtsi bya ba gra nga dī bku ra ba yon tan so sas brtsis pa rtsi ba baji— ngab/ —4 rtses pa rter ba bku pa rngo / /ya/ 'i so robs —brtse za1 mi bzod pa ste sprul ba— dad 5da thub da pa 1rwa/sa si ba — ba rte 1 bu ta cang 'in tu brtsengs pa bsnang ba/ pa' che1 'jol ba rnyi—/na pa'i rdod bas bgo bya / / brtseb brtseg 0rtsal ba sogs bas 'phu ya ra mgo lda na ba'i ca'o/ /badz+rashing nags kyi zab ba / nags myo/ skyer mo sa da snyer dga' tsha1rwa myo1 ba1ma dang 1dbub shing ge ra ja dang shing nab /sa tsan/ ba nga tshe gu 'brab/ spru'i nang 3 ྅sa ‘4 ba che1 1 1'i chi gu lta bud re mi nga chos gas ni myo— tshan/sa sam bar mtsham ba gcob byed 138

dang dī gas ma ste tshigs pa tshigs ma lta bu/ /tshogs pa 'dus pa phung po sde ba'i don sde le don chos las tsha na dum bu tsho khag tshan pa drod kyi tshan dang shed kyi tshan dang yang lus kyi lang cho na tshod lon/ /tshon rtsi tshon nam mdog sgur byed kyi rdzas rin po che'i phra 'bru lha'i tshom bu chog da4 chung ngam tshan pa ༄tshar gral du dngar ba 'grig pa1 /the tshom blo rtse gnyis som nyi tsham zams 'jigs tshul lam 'jigs pa 'ju byed la go ba'i tshwa zas kyi ro bro byed sogs te tshwa zhes tshig grogs med pa'i rkyang pa la smad 'dogs yod cing rgya tsha zhes pa lta bu'i tshig grogs sbyar na med par phyag len mdzad la 'on kyang lan tshwa la yod pa mang ngo / /khang pa spyi dang bye brag la go ba'i tshoms te sde tshan yang 'jug ched du brjod pa'i tshoms sogs dang tsha tsho tshe tshems tshus tshir tshig tshogs tshes tshar tshal tshul tshil tshi tshong pa zad ba ba zad bzab zad / /(mtshad ngo mtshar rmad byung khyad mtshar mtshan ma mtshon byed so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cu mtsho chu gter rgya mtsho sogs dang mtshe'u mtsho chung ba jing bu lta bu/ /mtshe ma mngal gcig nas dus mnyam du skyes pa'i bu mtshams tshigs 'brel lam bar bcad pa phye ba gcod pa mtshams che chung sbyor lta bu mtshan nyid rten pa'am 'brel ba'i gzhi ste mtshan nyid kyi bye brag gam mtshon bya'i khyad par ram dpe dang mtshon byar yang 'jug pa dang / /mtshan nyid mtshon byed go byed mtshan ma rtags rgyu ston byed tshon bya go bya rtogs bya bstan bya mtshan ma mi nor ba'i rtags rgyu rang bzhin ltas spros pas mtshan byed rtogs byed ston byed dam dpe'am cung zad mtshan ltar na spras pa/ /phyo gas dus kyi mtshams shar lho dang nyin mtshan gyi bar lta bu skyon la go ba'i mtshang nyes pa bcab bya nongs pa mtshan mo mtshan bya bral lam mtshar ba sgyu dzes pa ya mtshan rtsed tshu/ /mtshur rus kyi khyad par te mar pa'i 139

bzag ba pa dris pa rmas pa zhus pa blugs bkab go snyam/ /na dzo/za'adagos ra )ma bgo ba bzab zad legs/ pa dge ba phan pa bzang ba ba ba/ pa da zheg pas bzung ba 'dzin rwa/ 'chang ba/ /bzo po bzo rig shes mal/ na rtsa0 she bzo byed da che ‘bzo pas lha nga brjad yo byad bcu gsum gye gcig slong phor 45nga zer bzeྈ zhal zhag blug gam mchil sgod bzed pa 'dzeng pa gzeb rwa / /bze re mi bzod rwa/3ma sran med pa chung ba ste bzod sran che ba dang gnyod chung bdang mi bzad pa ma rungs rwa/ ha cang drag shul tshabs che ba'i lab/ bha ba la bzur ba 'jur ba gzur ba/ /bzod pa bsran pa nus pa khro ba sgong ba tshogs gnyis bzams pa bsdus pa 'dums pa dril pa mthun par shis pa ldang bar byas pa ston pas skar rgyal la tshigs bcad kyis bstod pas bsgal pa mang po'i tshobs bzlums ba lta bu sngags ba/zungs bzla ba dang bzlas ba gnyis bskyar ba blo4/ pa/ /mi bgag tshig bzlog pa sgyur ba phyir ldos tu 'jug pa blog pa ba/(1ba dmag ba bza ba/ pa zlog pa bkag pa ldog tu 'jug pa(—che/ lo ga ji/ra sprus pa mya ngan las bzla ba zlo ba bzlas pa/ /phyogs bcig/ tu du ma bzlums pa bsdoms pa bsdus pa dang bzlum pa lad mo dang la bzla bzlab bsgo bzos ba blug pa bzabs pa bzang ba sob/sa ba sa kun phub zad rdo/ /zhena'ongs 'ong 'o skol 'on pa 'ug pa 'on cig 'os pa 'ol kha 'ud po che 'og ma 'on tang khro ka/ lo pas 'od zer 'o dod so gas 'a nyid do/ /150

yayi rang gzhan gyis byas pa la dga' ba'am dga' ba tsam yi chad pa tshi chad pa yi thug pa yi dwags ngan song gsum gyi gcig dang / /mda' yab khang pa'i pu shu za ma'i yab ste rlung yab bsil yab sogs dang ya ma zung ya meb yur ba yungs kar yol go gam yo yan ba ya ra ba yal ba yu ba yol ba yos sogs ya rkyang zad / /(g.ya ) g.yor mo gdos pa gru gzings kyi dar po che rlung g.yor g.yo ba dang ba yos pa gnyis 'grul bskyod pa 'gyur ba 'khyog pa brji ba phyi ma g.yos shig kyang g.yab mo g.yab g.yug gam g.yob ba 'i ming tsam g.yabs pa g.yob pa g.yab pa ba—skyod pa 'gugs pa'i brda sogs byas pa/ /g.yor po yul gyi bye brag g.yub ba 'dris pa'am mi 'drog pa'am brling ba dang zhan pa dman pa za ba 'phrug pa longs spyod pa sogs g.yan pa g.ya' nad dab/ za phrug gi nad dgab pa 'gebs pa'i gos lta bu ste yo byad bcu gsum gyi g.yan dgab sogs/ /g.yang sa lhung sa'am sa gzar po mi g.yo ba mi skyod pa mi ba ji ba g.yub drung rtag pa 'gyur med dang bkra shis pa'i ri mo zhig g.yang dpal lam phun tshogs sa che/ phywa/5 /g.yel ba bsnyel ba stom las brtson med brjed pa g.yeng ba med pa dgag tshig g.yur du za ba lo 'bras rgyas nas thur du 'phyang ba dang smin pa zas dang rgyu ma g.yo ba dang g.yos pa gtes sbrus pa btsos pa sbyar ba sogs te g.yos zas sbyar zas sta bu/ /g.yang gi gzhi ma na lag lngan pa'i pags pa sogs g.yog pa dang g.yogs pa gnyis bkab pa gtums pa bskon pa snyi ma skul tshig kung g.yer ma sped dam sman zhig rgya 161

g.yer lta bus ba 'i gsad 5ba pyeb/rdo bu byed nga ga 'ig pa/ /g.yi 1ka can gzan zhig lngags shun gsar ba pa/yas pa brnyas nas g.yab ga mug ga yab rma'am ga yab cing ga yug pa ga yob pa g.yabs rngo3 kab kab byed ba 1 /ba yo na ma g.yon can ma 'phyon ma dang ga yan mig ma mdzes ma rgag za ra g.yem pa 'dod pa ste 'dod log dang g.yem ma sogs g.yeng ba rgod pa 'phro ba skyod pa le lo 'phen pa rnam g.yeng ges g.ye ngas pa g.yeng ba dang g.yeng ba/ shig /ba/ba ma chub reg nas gad mo slong ba'am ga tsa/ tshil byed pa dang ga 'a she' ri las skye sa pa'i sgog pa skyi g.ya' ba 'jigs pa skrag za3ma ba spu'i bu ga za ba lcaṭa sogs kyi g.ya' btsa' glo bur dri ma lta bu g.yu rin chen drug da che/ra drug dkar/ /g.yub mo rigs ngan ma sogs dang g.yung po'ang g.yo ji ba/yo spubs sam slu ba dang gya gyu g.yer bag rgod bag g.yeng bag snang g.yel g.yab dud 'gro 'i khyad par/ /g.yas pa phyogs dang brnyas pa g.yon pa phyogs dang me brtan pa 'khyog pa g.yu rdo' dam po/ gam 'khrug ba sprod pa 'thab tu 'jug pa 'gyed pa ba/yub ba sa dmag las sam thob las po/yob las ka'am spru ba dang g.yog rgyug bka dang pran khob / /mib g.yor zla ba gnyis snang lta bu'am grib ma ste sgra ma'i dpe kha g.yal ba glal ba gdang ba ga mar tsha ba ༄ni zad za ba skyengs pa zhal ngo tsha ba/ /gzu ra ba'i / kha khral lam khral bam ra bdab dam bca' zhal bzhes ba/ba ra khad ba ska khams sam khams g.yar zhes bapa kha gdong mdun sogs kyi the sa'i chig dang zhe sa'i tshig tsam yang yod pas skabs phyeng/ dgos pa dang / /yul gyi snab ba la g.yel ba g.yeng ba ngang g.yer bab dang sa 6 ngas pa ga re ra kha dril chung sogan dang g.ye 8 ba g.ya' ba ga ma' ri po/yob/ 'khor g.yung ba rus kyi g.yung g.ya' kyi ma sob/rngo/ ba/ba kun(1ba ma ched/ /15 2

rar dud 'gro'i khyad par lug bal ldan ra rtso mgo skyes kyi ru nu la phran du rlog pa brlag pa 'joms pa 'thag pa/ /mngon par blom pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal lam nga rgyal ba'am sems pa 11na pa chags pa'am nga rgyal ba'am ma yin po la yin par 'dzin pa'i de/ba ba te mkhas rlom lta bu bla ma sogs kyi byin rlabs rlob pa'i ming tsam ste lhag gnas sam nus pa'i ngon yin snyam blobs shig byin gyis rlob pa'i skrul chig /rlon pa gsher ba brlan ba blag byed gnod byed 'joms byed dang stor byed 'doms gsang gnab kyi cheg pa sgro ba 'bras bu/ /rlabs chen bya ba rgya chen thabs chen phyod chen dba' rlabs chu rlabs mtsho rlabs lta bu rlabs pa drod skyes sa rlangs ba/ rlangs sogs rlung g.yo byed skyod byed 'byung bzhi'i gcig /rlam khyer ham pas khyer ba khrag rlangs khrug gi drod rlangs sam khrug rdog rlan blon ga zher ba'am skom mam btung ba zang sogs te rlan pa rlon pa'i don 'dra/ pa/zlag mo rnyang ma'am skyag sla (1ba/ba ba zas ma zhu bar 'og nab/ 'thon pa ste bshal ba lta bu khung bu'i don can gyi rlubs bu ga dang dong dang dma' ba/ /dud 'gro re'u la sogs pa'i pags pa sbubs bshus sprus pa la sprud lu zer zhing grod chung ngam pags khug la yang 'jug par mngon rlob pa rlom pa rlan ba rlung po rlung nad sogs rkyang pa yin pas bas 'phub med ces pa bshad zin spyi ming rkyang la yin no/ /(brlab brtsom brlag slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi yul tshig sobs brlab po rtsub po gyong po bzag bya dgra dang nor lta bu gzhom bya dang stor 1 che3

phya brlag rwa/ rla ba pa'am rlog pa/ —lnga sa —zhe brla li pha chu thing rtse kun brla da shegs chu dang mchi'/ mas brlan pa rlon pa rjod rwa ba shing bar byas shā ya ra bza snying po med rngo1'che4 mi bden pa 1 /grogs la blo bzag shā/ 'ing—gcugs pa dang grogs po 44nga brtan ‘4 'a/ go ba'i bzang ba 'gyur med su ka— lci ba tshugs pa dul ba zab—pa byin hrus brla bas pa rlob pa bskyed pa lhag par gnas pa sogs/ /bzan 'dod pa 'jigs ba mya ngan gyis brla mas pa bskyod nga/ smyo ba brla da rwa4 zhub/sa nga brlam pa brla ba pa bzang po sogs bas kun phul zad/ /kalu ba zhes pa ni bos kyi bye zag bal gos sab dkar sogs dang lug lugs lang langs rong long ba 'a/ga lags dog logs lta bu rkyang pa las med kyang yang 'jug yod me ‘da kyi khyad par sogs shes dgos pa yin/ /zhedamar nyi ma shar ba'i phyogs dang 'char ba'i don gyi ming byung kang 'thung gi khar steng du shang zang 'dab chags shig shi ba 'chi ba/ /shul rjes sam mal dang lam bdu go dngad zabazad gshin zas sam dad zas sam da ge zas shel me shel chu shel spun shel lta bu'i shel gyi ming shubs gtums sdod/ /shed bu dang shed bdag dang shed las skyes gsum sems can nam gang zag gi ming shed ces pa yid dang stobs dang nyams dang tshangs pa/ /shun pa 164

ni pags pa skogs pa shun lngags kyang snang sham babs dge slong gi rlum por bgo bya'i gos shur bu ska rags kyi khyad par phre'u 'am ska rags tsam la go des bcings pa 'ching ba/ /shes ldan blo ldan mkhas pa dang sems can shin tu ha cang ngam nges par shub pu shub shub bam skad chung ngur smra ba/ /shan pa bshan pa gsod byed shā 'od chu log dang shu ba shis pa shon shugs shes pa shor ba shong ba tshig phrad shing sogs sha rkyang ngo / /(gshad bde bar gshegs pa song ba 'gro ba rtogs pa spangs pa bshis lugs gnas lugs gnas tshul je bzhim du gshegs pa ste za ngas rgyas/ /gshin po 'das po'i ming gshags rtsod pa tha dad shan 'byed pa po dpon nam dbang po gshin po rnams kyi rje bo mthar byed chos rgyal ba/shed gnod byed dgra dang gshed ma dang lha gshin rje gshed/ /bshen rabs bon po'i ston pa gshang rol mo cang dkrol ba 'khrol ba dbu skra mgo skra gnor ba rtsub pa mi 'jam pa/ /gshis ka rang bzhin rgyud ngan pa mi bzang ba g.yul dang mchod pa gshom pa bshams pa grabs byed pa'am sgrig pa gshung ba shub bur smod pa'am lkog kha gtong ba dang bshe ba spyo ba gshe gshe gtong —ba/ /mo gsham rabs chad ma gsha' ma yang dag pa ngo ma lhad med pa yin du gapha' yin gsha' bden gsha' yod gsha' ngo ma bden pa gzhir bzhag pa dang 'thad pa 'os pa rigs pa/ /gshor sgod cig dang yur ba'i gshor dang gsho tshul gyis chu sogs gsho ba bsho ba 'dor ba'am 'bo ba sogs shing gshog pa dang gshags pa gses pa bkas pa gnyis su byed pa/ /thong pa dang gshol mda' rmo spyad bsheg pa phyed pa kha gnyis su byed pa/ la 'jug cing 'dab ma la go ba'i gshog pa 'phur byed sogs gshibs pa gzhib ba/ pa jig pa 'grogs pa/ /brlan pa la rga ba'i gsher ba rlon pa bzha' bre dang 166

phu za gyis gnor ba 'jal ba bshar ba 'phrang lam la gshor za bshar ba re tsā bzhin grab/ byas nas 'gro ba'am 'gro ba tsam yang / /gsham 'ob ma phyi ma mtha' gsham gsal gyi skra lta bu zab sogs kyi gshobs ljongs sam ga rdobs da nga sgang min pa zhing gi sa sog ba ba— pa mnyen ba/ snyi ba 'jam ji dul ba mthun pa gshin po/ /gdang bu nga ma' ba kyong spyong gzhong bu' ma za na bu'ang ༄yi na snyam/ mnyes gshin gshol 'dzin rus kyi gshen gshegs pa gshar ba gsho ba 'di bshos pa'i da lta bar bzhag na 'bob 'khrig pa zas g.yo ba gci bar (rejug bsham ma la sogs gas mi 'phul sha'o/ /(ba mdza' ba'i ba gcugs pa'i grogs sam grogs po dge bad shā bshes bla ma'am legs grogs lha sogs kyi bshos zhal zas sam g.yos zas bshams pa gshom pa sgrig pa b.rad pa/ /jig pa mi dge bshags pa re chags pa mthol ba pyi bshol phyi bsnur phyi 'then le lo bshul ni lam 'jug ngogs bshar ba gshor nga song ba/ /bshum pa bang bshums pa gnyis ngu ba cho nge 'don pa bshal ba sna drud pa dang 'then pa bshud pa 'dar ba phud pa 'thon pa ste ldan pa dang lag pa bshud nas bshags pa gshags pa bkas pa phye ba ga bar ba/ /bsha' tshe bsha' dkar sogs bgo bsha' skad ba bgo ba'i ming ri dwags ri skyes bshar ba gshor ba rngon pa/ /rgyab kyi bshul rgyab gzhung ngam sgal pa bshul sha lta bu pags shun yi ge dpe bshus pa bshu ba bkog pa phud pa ma dpe ltar bkod pa bshan ba rigs ngan shan pas lug bshas pa bsad pa srog—bcad pa/ /me lce la sogs par bshur ba snam bu sogs dngos ma tshig par spu ring dang phyi shun lta bu tshig bcug pa chu dang sbyong sman gyis sgod dang pho ba bshal ba dag par byas pa bkru ba 'khru ba sbyong ba bshang ba dri chen skyag pa gci ba gcin pa bka ba gsho ba bkas pa/ /166

ma khar dang khrims bshig pa 'jig pa gzhig pa 'joms pa sog ze phul gyis bshar ba gshor ba 'phrang lam la bshar ba gshor ba/ /smyug spubs sogs bshabs pa nang drus pa'am bsal ba'am brtol ba bshang ba dbe —don bshad pa 'chad pa brjod pa 'grel ba ste rtsa tshogs slob 'grel rnam rgyas chos bshad lta bu kang bshol ba bshos pa bshul gtam bsher ba bshu ba shad kyis bshad pa sogs bas 'a yul sha'o/ /sasangs pa sad pa spangs pa rgyas pa bye ba rtogs pa sto thub dbang sogs sor mo nas bdun gyi tshad mdzub mo nying lag sen mo slar skyes so tshems rje dang gri so rdza so so btsugs pa sogs/ /sil zhes pa'i sgra snyan par sgrog pa ste rol mo zhig sil sil sil snyan gyi sgra lta bu se mo nu ma gnyis kyi dbus thad du sleb pa'i do shal te do shal phyed pa rgyan cha zhig /tshe la go ba'i grog si dbang po lus shes kyi rten spung ba skyob pa 'tsho ba bsrung zhib 'od spung rigs kyi khyad par te 'od srung chen po lta bu sras bu dang bu mo gnyis ka'am bu la go /srid pa 'khor ba dang rten 'brel gyi gcig dang 'byung bar go sgo gsum drang por spong ba ste phyi nang gi thub pa spol lugs lam yur ba tshugs pa btsugs pa brid pa rung ba'am btub pa skye ba shes bya la srid dpe srid gal srid/ /spod mtshan stod dam srod 'khor gyi dus tshod sa pros sa sribs pa sa rib pa spe nag thab sgod kyi nag dreg sogs srab pa bsrab pa phra ba mthug min/ /srin po 'byung po sha za lus spul po gdon zhig sa spung bu brgya byin gyi glang chen/ /spubs par ram gseng ngam gseb kye ming lam srab 161

srang lam mam khang bar gyi lam dang rgya lam srid dkyus sam khrun du go sribs ring du ba ba gtong ba sring ba'i skul tshig yid spubs bdud dang 'dod chabs kyis sreg pa gdung ba tshig pa thal bar byed pa gring mo phu mo nu mo gnyis kar go gred pa zhen pa mngon par chags pa/ /spu mo ma'i spun zla mo'i ming sri 'u bkur sti'am 'bas phyi thra'u bu chung ngam khye'u'i ming ba dar sri phung sri sogs te gnod byed dam nyams byed kyi don 'dra/ /spe mo srog chags sre mo sreg pa 'dab chags shib/ srin za'u ga pa'am 'ug pa las chung ba'i bya zhig ba/ma 'ug—pa mchod byed/ spru nang sga da/na (1 srog chag — phu mo sro ma shig gi sro ma'am nyi rdul bdun gyi chad srar bu skud pa sra ba mkhregs pa gar ma snying po spro/ /ji srir ji tsam de srid de tsam mam de'i bar ram ring sran ma 'bru'i khyad par srus snye ma'i spus/ /bcen pa nye ba sring ba ring ba ring du gtong ba spring ba skyed pa 'degs pa bsring ba sreg byed sreg pa po me lta bu speg blugs sbyin sreg gi rdzas sam sreg zas dang / /rgyal po'i brid rgyal po'i las sam bya ba mun sribs pa sa sros pa gdags kyi zlas lce ba'i sribs zhes pa sgrib pa mtshan mo sogs rta yi sga chas kha la bskon rgyu'i srab ste srab spyogs/ /srub byed kyi shing ste ri 'big byed lta bu srub byed kyi bag pa ste klu lhag ma can lta bu srub pa po lha dang lha min lta bu 'jal byed kyi khyad par la srang zer te srang mda' mtho dma' lta bu dang rin tshad kyi srang yang / /slob pa'i dpon po slob tu 'jug pa po bla ma blob ma nyan thos dbu slob nya ma che ba pa don du gnyer ba slob sbyong byed pa slob gnyer pa'ang za ba dka' mi na dang gar mi/na/ /bslab gsum sogs la da dung blob dgos pa ste slob bzhin rwa lam du 'jug pa mi slob min pa slo ma zhib ma 'jal byed kyi snad cig dang smyug sog ba kyi slo che1 ste bsdus na bzhes slom zer ba lta bur go blong mo 168

ldom bu dang rngan pa spob pa slangs ba slong mo byed pa/ /spe ba yan lag skyon can gyen du slong ba bslang ba sgreng ba slog pa log nas btang ba'am log tu bcug kyang sdud sgra speb pa 'byor ba rdol ba bzab pa/ /spe tres sman zhig ste zhang zhung gi skad spru gu chang sgod kyi bye brag chung ngu'i ming chu dang ja thang ma ched sla ba/ /kun nas slong ba bsam pa bsam tshul khyer so spe yon sems gya gyu can bsad pa dud 'gro bshas pa'i sto nang gi blo btso/ /zar phyir ram yang ngam bskyar zhing chig phrad slar phyir ram yang ngam bskyar yang rgyan sdud spu ba 'brid pa rdzun pa bslus pa med pa dgag tshig slad ched dam phyir ram phyin chad dam phyi/ /spe'u phyar ba sogs blog pa pags pa'i gos pyi nang blog pa phyi nang sgyur ba phyi nang du bstan pa/ spa nga sdod kyi khyad par lcags kyi sla nga lta bu bsdus na lcags slang 'khur slang la sogs pa'i ming slad rol phyi rol phyi logs phyogs ris su blon pa gtog ba pa 'the ba sdud pa bslan pa skul tshig kyang / /slad ma phyi ma rjes mar go spad phyi rjes nas dug nad kyi ro ma sogs blong ba long ba 'phar ldang byed pa slong rkyen yang / /sra brkyab 'dul ba'i brda ste gtan pa yang zer 'di'i phyag len bod du ma dar bting ba 'dings pa dang srab mo spub pa sre ba sres srung srungs sring pa slod pa spul ba sreg pa sro ba sri ba sris sran pa sril srel ba slongs sogs sa nyid do/ /(gas shegs ra bu gsar be bslab gzhon dang po'i las can gsar bu pa gsar ba so ma dang po gzhon nu bskor nas 'khar gsil dge slong gi phyag mtshan te 'khar ba yin la gsil byed kyang yin zer rgyu 'dra gsor ba skor ba 'phyar ba/ /kha gsag kha gtsang ngam rnyed bkur gyi dzi ra sngon du tshi sha 'jam smra ba ste log 'tsho lnga'i gcig gsog snying po med pa don stong dang bsag —pa gsob snying po med pa spru ba lta bu dang dngos ltar snang ba rdzu gsob 169

lta bu dang drin bsab pa yang 'thad snyam gsad bya gsod pa'i yul gsod pa gsad pa 'gums pa/ /gsab ba sged pa gab pa gsang dgos pa'i sngabs yid skyob sogs snyan gsan 'bebs pa'am zhu ba ni rna bar thos su 'jug pa'am go bar byed pa gsung ngag gam brjod pa rab mchog gsungs pa gsung ba bshad pa skul tshig kyang / /gsob po drang po'am bden pa'i tshig ngag gsol ba zhu ba dri ba gsol ba 'debs pa lhag par don du gnyer ba zhu 'bul byed pa gson pa gsan pa nyan pa thos pa skul tshig kyang / /gser snga zla ba'am rin chen dang po'i mdog kha dog ne'u gsing sgang gi rtswa sngon nam gsing ma gseg ma rdo dum gyo dum la sogs pa'i ming gseb khrod nang dkyil/ /gseb rlig pa can gyi rta dab gsa' gca na gzan zhig de yis gsag ma tshor ba'am mi shes pa gab pa lta bu dang myur ba gsir ba ldad ka'am tal ma'am thogs pa'am thad kar phyin pa'am 'phro ba dang gsir sgra grags te/ /shing gi khyad par gsom thang shing gsor 'jigs spyad rtse non gyis dum bur gsil ba 'thigs pa gshags pa'i don yin zhing sheng sogs bses pa bkas pa bshags pa phye ba skul tshig kyang / /gsas rma dang gsas pho ni bon spyo lha ste don sras mo dang sras yin zhing shi log gam lha 'bab mkhan la yang go gsog pa bsag pa 'jog pa gzhag pa 'dul ba'i gso ga 'jog kyang bsang ba sba ba gzhan gyis go mi nyan pa'i gtam snying gta ma— gsob sbod pa gsang ba skul tshig /gso ras rtswa ras sogs spu bal gsed pa rmel pa 'byed pa gseng spubs bar phrag gi ming gsur dkar dmar spyi gsur lta bu/ /gsus ba grod pa sto ba gso ba rgyas pa skyed pa phan par byed pha /ba gso ba'i zur ched gsol ba bzhes pa sogs dang mnga' 'dod lha gsol yab rga gsun pa sgrogs pa dang 'thon pa rtsam gsud lta bu/ /so gsod pa dal pa 160

bde bar gnas pa lus dang khur po sogs gsig pa 'dar du 'jug pa dkrugs pa 'degs pa dril bu gsil ba 'khrol ba sgra 'byin pa gsum grang shig /skad gsab skab gsang po'am skad kyi gdangs sam 'phang gseg bshab 'khar gsil bseg sa li dpe sdod cig /gson po srog 'tsho ba dang ma nyams pa snyan rna ba gsab po sgra chung ngu yang thos pa gsal po chur ma gson chud mi za bar 'phro lhag bya phyin pa skul tshig kyang / /'od gsal spums cad stong ba'am phyag chen dang 'od snang ngam 'od gsal po nang gses3nang tshan bye brag dri chu gcin pa gsil ba gtong ba gci ba bsal ba /gsal shib 'jigs byed kyi mtshon rtse gcig pa dang rtse gsum pa chud bsam pa chud gson pa'am za ba gsal ba gsad pa gseb gsung ba gnad gsang gseg gsug sogs gab ma phub pa dka/ /(bas she sngo bsabs sngon po dang sngo skya 'bags pa brtsag grib bsabs pa sbyang ba bsal ba spang ba tshogs dang nor bsag pa dang bsags pa gnyis gsog bsgrub pa spungs pa sdud pa/ /dmigs kyis bsalaXb phud pa zur du bkar ba'am bton pa dang bye brag skyon dang dri ma bsal ba sel ba speng ba 'joms pa 'jil ba dbye ba gnod pa bsam bya sems pa'i yul lam brtag bya bab mas pa sems pa bsam pa mnos pa brtags pa/ /bse ko ba rin chen ri dwags gsum gyi khyad par dang bse yab dang bse dri sogs ko bse'i khrab go cha bsod nams dge ba legs spyad dam 'dod khams kyi dge ba'am phar phyin snga ma gsum bsod sgor sa ldom bu slong mo bsogs pa gsog pa bsdus pa/ /che srog bsring ba spes ba bsam blo6mno bsam brtag dpyad drin lan bsab pa dang bsabs pa gnyis gsib ba 'ja'/ ba kha tshang bar byed pa tshab sprud pa/ /yo ba yon po bsrang ba srong ba 161

drang por byed pa nor rdzas bsri ba (dka za'am bsris rme byed pa sri ba rgyab zhe ring por bsrib ba dang bsrings pa ba/nyis sring ba rdzur ba skyar ba gtong za//badri tsam la go ba'i bsu nga ste sna'i yul dang dri zhim yang mtshon de dag bos sna ma sogs bsus pa bsu ba gdan 'dren pa phebs bsu bse ru ri dag kyi dbye ba dang rang rgyal bsad pa gsod pa 'gums pa/ /bsrungs pa srung ba 'tsho ba bsrung bya bsrung ba grung ba'i yul bsreg bya sreg pa 'i yul bsreg pa bsregs pa sreg pa tshig mi/ /bzad pa la go ba'i bsran pa sran ba sra ba brtan pa mi tshugs pa bgro khang khrus sogs sten pa'i khang pa khrus pa sku mnye dril phyi me stan rnams kyi ming la bsro khang zer 'o dang 'o ma bsrungs pa srub pa sgyur ba dkrogs pa bsres pa sdom pa spel ba sre ba bsre ba/ /bsod pa legs pa bzang po 'da' ba'i zas zan bsrel ba 'chang ba spel ba srel ba ring bsrel gdung ngam 'phel gdung bgrings pa sring ba bsring ba skur ba/ —bya ba la go ba'i bsral yin nam mi blo bsral can zhes mchan snang ba blo rtsing blo thabs blo gsal can sogs gang yin brtag rgyu dang sgrib nga gnyis lta bu bsrabs pa srab pa bsrab pa mthug pa min pa dag pa phra ba/ /bsel ba 'jigs skyob kyi skyel ma'am skyel pa po61 ming bso ni bso bso zhes pa'i sgra yi khyad par ngal bsos kyi bu nom thos sras/ /sgod sogs kyi kha bsum ba bsdoms pa sgrog pa btsum pa rjes shul bsubs pa bsub pa phyis pa sgrib pa 'gog pa bser bu rlung ngam dal rlung dang grang mo 'khyag pa bsil ba grang ba drod med pa bsil mo dang skra sogs bzhar ba'am ga rtsad pa/ /lha bsang bsangs mchod dam bsangs gsol grib med par byed pa me bsangs me la shug pa sogs bdugs nas gtsang ma byed pa brtsag pa bsal ba skyo bsangs skyo ba bsal ba'am yal ba 'cham 'cham dab / /blo sems bsrun pa srun pa 162

du'/ ba g.yung ba zhi ba bsam bse 'u sgod drug gi gcig ste khu khrag gnas pa'e sgod sba sbod pa bsre ba pe za 'khri ba 'tshab/ pa lda pu med di gag chig / bsang bsangs dang gtor ma sogs zhabs bsil rkang pa 'khrud pa'i chu'am rkang pa 'khrud pa 'al bsi la la gdong 'khrud pa'i chu'am kha gdong 'khrud pa bgro ba sro ba tsha bar byed pa lde ba/ /bza ra bya slod byed kyi yul la bslad pa bslad pa slod pa lha da bcug pa'am skyon bsres nas ba spru bya skru byed kyi yul lam bslu ba bka'i ba pa slu ba brid pa mgo g.yogs pa/ /ba / slab dra/ slong byed kyi yul lam bslang ba bslang bya 'e snar sogs bslangs pa slong ba slong mo byas pa re nas len pa phyobs rib/ su bza ma pa slon po gtob/sa pa/ /bslab bya slob byeng kyi yul lam zhal ta bsrab pa spru las sam bslab bya ste bslab pa rin po che gsum lta spru byen du bzangs pa slong ba bslangs pa sgreng ba/ /'dod pa la lhag par rwa ngas spyod pa'i ming la bsod nyams zhes bya ste nyams rangs su'ang bshad bslabs pa bsris pa tshad bsal bsad pa bsros pa bsrub pa bsu ba bsrangs pa bsreg pa bsrub pa bser ma bsrul ba bsre ba sogs ba ba 'di bsnyem ba dka/ 1btahral hral rtsing pa'i rnam pa'am gos sogs ral ba'i dbyibs hrul grul spul ba'am zad pa'i tshul lam gos sogs hul po'i dbyibs mig lta byed hreg hreg rig rig lta tshul/ /hwa shang rgya nag gi skad de btsun pa'am ban de hwags bu ram gyi dwangs ma'am kha bun bzang shos sam sha kha ra dab gos kyi hwa gos kyi mtha'am sne/ /rtsab hral 'dod chags shin tu che ba dang spyod pa 163

rtsing po dang kos rtsab ral lam gos hul ha cang hril gyis dril ba hal he du ka ha ha la zags ha nyid do/ //ma.a ka ru shing bdug spos sman kyi khyad ngar shing sha pa yang zer a ka ru zur chag pa ste lci med—kyi don dang a ru ra :/na 'bras bu gsum gyi ‘gcig /thad btsu24 zad mchog 'pha kas sa ma mchog gos sam shun 'bongs te sbyon pa'i khyad par 'di la me tog yod med kyi rigs gnyis yod par mngon ut+pa la steng skyong ngam steng 'thung ste me tog go khyad par sogs/ /yo rgyan au ḍi yā na zur chag pa steng 'phur te nub phyogs kyi yul zhib/ yu ma dbang phyug gi chung ma drag mo ba rnyil rin chen dbang sngon/ /shing thog shing 'bras kyi a za shing sa ha kār ye la'i snyed dab shing e la zhes pa'i 'dab ma'am e la'i 'dab ma cam te klu theg /e n+ya yan ri dwags bye brag pa'am spyo'i byin pa ste gzhan du e tu ya dang e na ya zhes kyang snang a re mdzes e ma ang og sko a nut+ta ra sogs a nyib do/ /bod kyi brda'i bye brag bsal bar byed pa'i tshib re'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgror ma 'es bya ba las/ /sngon 'jug rkyang pa mgo can sogs yi ge'i sbyor ba rgyas par bshad pa ste le'u dang po'i bshad bstan/ / / /da dzi rdam dbye drug pa sogs dang phrad rdzogs tshib/ la sogs pa/ /gces shing nye bar mkho nga 'ga' lgig bldus te sil bur bstar bar bya ba las/ /thob mar zam ba bye drus pa yi sgra/ /kyi rgo gyi 'i ye lnga po da ba zhes kyi sgra'i sbyor tshum ni/ /rjes 'jug da ba dang 'jug shā nga 'jub gi sa 164

dar da drag da yang 'jug dag /thob pa'i mthar kyi sbyar ba dang rjes 'jug ga dang ba la gi mthun zhing / /rjes 'jug na ma ra la bzhi po la gyi spyor ba dang / /ming gzhi'i mtha' rten par byed pa ste rjes 'jug 'a dngos su yod med gang gi mthar yang rung ste 'i thob cing / /de'i mthar tshig gi rkab pa kha skob dgos pa'i tshe yi thob ste rim pa ltar dper brjod na/ /kyi thob dpe khyed kyi rgyab kyi g.yas kyi zar/ /gyur gyi lta bu dang gi thob dpe zag gi byang gi phyobs lta bu/ /gyi thob dpe dpon gyi lam gyi bar gyi sar/ /gzhol gyi lta bu dang 'i thob dpe sa bzhi'i mda'i lta bu dang yi thob dpe bdag de yi dga' yi zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rdzogs tshig gi 'o dang go'u ta ma dang mtshe'u lta bu'i 'u dang dri tshig gi 'am sgra gsum gyi tsheg khyim thob mi thob pa yab / /tshig gi rkab pa kha skob mi skong gis dbye bar bya'o/ /bde'o bya'o la sogs pa'i rdzogs tshig slar bsdu la/ /'o nyid thob cing sbyi bo dga' bo la sogs pa'i/ /mib gi cha la ba byed ma'i wa nyid thob par 'dod do/ /ga sogs kyi mtha' rten yod pa can dang ra mgo sogs brtsegs pa dang / /gi gu sogs kyi gug kyed yod pa cam gyi mthar 'a dngos kyi mtha' rten sbyor ba spang bar bya'o/ /tshig phrad cing zhing shing sogs kyi sbyor tshul la rjes 'jug ga da ba'i rjes su/ /cing sdud pa dang lhag bcas ces ces bya ba'am zer ba dang 'di ltar ce'o slar bsdu—rem ces so ce na zer na dang dri ba lta bu cib skul tshig dang bye brag pa'am zhig gi don/ /nga na ma 'a ra la dang / /mtha' rten 'a dngos su med pa'i rjes dag tu/ /zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig thob kyang kha cig ska cig sogs dmigs bsal yin 'a/ don ni cing sogs ltar rem par sbyar/ /rjes 'jug yang 'jug sa yig gi mthar shing she'o she na shig thob cing sa mthar shes mi legs pas zhes theb pa dmigs bsal du mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bzhed don 166

cing sogs ltar sbyar/ /na ra la gsum gyi rjes su za/ /ja drag thob pa yod pa'i pyir na ra la de gnu ma gyi/ /rjes su zhong sogs lnga po thob mod kyang / /da drag res par thob pa der/ /cing ces za gas lnga ngo sbyor ba legs pa yin te rim bzhin dper brjod na/ /ga la cing sogs thob dpe rtag cing stog ces lhag ce'o/ /su 'dug ce na khyud 'dug cig dze bu ste do na gong bshad ltar 'og ma la yang sbyar/ da la thob dpe rgud cing zad ces med ci'o/ /ci 'chad ce na chos shod cig lta bu/ /ba sgyu/ thob dbe zab ceng thob ces zub ce'o/ /gang rgyab ce na gri rgyob cig lta—bu/ /nga la zhing sogs thob dpe byang zhing drang zhes 'byung zhe'o/ /gang gzub zhe na sems gzung zhig lta bu/ /na la thob dpe snyan zhib che/khas pa dang legs pa la go ba'i 'dzin zhes dkon zhe'o/ /lha yim zhe na don zhib gnyer lta bu/ /ma la thob dpe 'jam zhing ngo zhes 'dzom zhe'o/ /dben nam zhe na nam zhig dben lta bu/ /'a dngos su yod pa la thob dpe dga' zhing bza' zhe gda' zhe'o/ /du ji tsam gda' zhe na 'ga' zhib go lta bu/ / ra la thob dpe dar zhib 'phyur zhes 'gyur 'e'o/ /ci 'phyar zhe na dar chen phyor zhig lta bu/ 1la ma thob dpe 'chol zhing 'tshal zhes 'khrul zhe'o/ /gang 'tshol zhe na chos tshol zhig lta bu/ /'a mtha' rten dngos su meng pa la thob dpe za6zhib bde zhes spro zhe'o/ /ye spra zhe ma ma smra zhig lta bu/ /sa mthar shing sogs thob dpe 'dus shib rtogs shes sam rtogs zhes 'bral bar res zhe'o/ /ci nges she na gtam sbos shig lta bu/ 1da drab/ 'a ci nga sogs legs dpe mkhyen cing 'phral ces brgyan ce'o/ /cis grol ce na grol gyur cig lta bu ste ma/bye nad sogs kyis da drag skad gsar ba cad kyi tshe bsdus kyang don la yod pas cing sogs sbyar ba'o/ /dri ba 'byed sdud dang 166

rngogs tshig slar bsdu'i skabs su sna1 /'a mtha' rten dngos su re da pa dang 'a mthar 'a ste 'am dang 'o thob la/ /mtha' rter ga sogs gzhan gyi mthar ga sogs rab rang la ma dang sna ru sbyar bas gam sogs dang go sogs thob pa'o/ /ja drag can gyi ba ta zhes pa tam dang to thob ste dper brjod na rim pa bzhin/ /'a ma tha' rten dngos su yod med la 'am dang 'o tho pa ni bde 'am bde'o dga' 'am dba'o/ /ga sogs dang go sogs sbyor tshul rtogs sla zhing da drag can la gyurd rtam gyurd ho lha bu'o/ /lhag ma can gyi sgra te ste de gsum gyi sgra sbyor ni/ /rjes 'jug na ra la sa dang da drag gi /rjes su te rkyang dang da mthar de dang / /ga nga ba ma 'a dang ni/ /mtha' rten dngos su med pa'i mthar sa mgo can gyi ste thob pa dber na/ /te'i dpe byon te bskor te nor btsal rte/ /skyengs te sprur te lha bu dang de'i dbe don rme da de lta bu/ /ste'i dpe stog ste btsang ste 'bad pa med par lhan gyis grub ste/ /'jom ste dga' ste sems bde ste lta bu/ /tshig don rdam par dbye ba bdun yod ba las la don gyi/ /tu du ru su'i sgra zhabs kyu can dang ra na la rnams kyi sgra sbyor zla/ /rjes 'jug ga ba dang da drag can gyi mthar byu dang / /ba da ra ma zad ba drug la du dang / /sa 'jug yang 'jug la ba/ dang mtha' rten 'a dngos su med pa dang/ /'a dngos yod kyi mab 'a ru dang kang pa skong mi dgos na ra yang thob ste sbyor ba'i dpe rim pa bzhin brjod na/ /tu'i dpe rtag rtu rab rtu shin tu lta bu dang / /du'i dpe steng du snod du rgyan du tho/ /lam du sprur du 'jal du song lta bu/ /su'i dpe rjes su phyogs su lta bu dang ru ra'i dpe 'di ru 'dir dga' ru dgar ka rjeb lta bu ste na la gnyis ni khyad par la mi stos pas thams cad la ci 167

bder sbyar ro / /tshig snga phyi mtshams spyor ba'am rgyan sdad kyi kyang 'ab pa yab dmas kyi sgra sbyor ni/ /rjes 'jug ga da ba 'jug yang 'jug ge sa nyid dang ni/ /da dag thob pa'i rjes su kung dang / /nga na ma 'a ra la drug gi rjes su yang dang / /mtha' rten 'a dngos su med pa'i ma bar 'ang dang ni/ /tshig gi rkang pa kha skob ba'i tshe yang thob ste dper brjod 'di ltar/ /kyang gi dpe bdag kyang 'bad kub don grub kung / /byas kung rtogs kyang 'on kyang lha bu yang gi dpe ma zung yang / /byon yang nam yang bsa' yang 'ga'ang ni/ /slar yang mjal ya ba lta bu 'ang yang kha skong mi dgos pa dang dgos pa'i dpe blo rang dang bde yab zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ming gi ba pa dang ba sga'i sbyor chu la gyi dbye ba ne/ /ga da na ba ma 8sha dang / /da drag can gyi ma bar pa dab dzi/ /nga 'a ra la dang 'a mtha' rten dngos su med pa'i ba/ /ba phyed war 'bod pa rdams la ba thob cing / /sbyor tshub/ bdad ma thab/ pa las gzhan du ba thob pa'i yul 'ga' zhig la pa nyid sbyar ba legs te dper na/ /pa'i dpe zag pa mer ba phan pa mchog /thob pa dam pa mkhas pa ru/ /gyur ba lta bu ba'i dpe dang ba la dga' ba/ /sprur bar mjal bar spro ba lta bu las/ /gzhan la pa'i dpe lung pa mda' pa'i 'byor pa yis/ /yul pa phu pa tshim sogs la dpyad na ming mtha' 3dren tshul lam sgra sbyor ma nges pas sna tshogs su 'gyur bar snang la 'di dag gi tshig don zhib mo sum rtags las shes par bya'o/ /gcod mtshams su shad thob tshul ni mtha' rten rjes 'jug ga yod pa yi mthar/ /chig shad bya zhing nga yig ma gtogs ba'am bor bsnyed lhag mar/ /shad kyi gong dmas su pyi ma'i tsheg zang bar bya la/ /don mang po grangs su 168

bgrabs pa'i ming gi ni/ /mtshams na tsheg shad de sa dang / chu dang /me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' zhes pa lta bu dab don 'bring dbyed bar chig shad de sdug bsngal bden pa dang / kun 'byung bden pa dang / zhes pa lta bu dab / /don nyung rdzogs tshig thob pa'i mtshams su chig shad de za'o/ sha'o/ zhes pa lta bu/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang pa'i mtha' rnams su nyis shad dang / /lhag pa'i sde tshan rjogs pa'i mtshams kyi/ /sna ru car gyi mthar nyis bad bya bar 'os shing / /tshig don gyi sde tshan chen po rdzogs pa'i mtshams bam po lta bu dang / /le'u dang skabs kyi mtshams lha bur bzhi shad thob bo/ / pod kyi brda'i bye zag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur sprus pa mkhas nga 'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba las/ /dam dbye dang tshig phrad kyi sgra sbyor dang shad thob chul sobs gces pa ste nyer mkho sna tshogs thun mong du bshad pa ste le'u ga nyes pa'i bshad bstan/ /da ji 'phul sngon 'jug dang mtha' rten rjes 'jug dang ra ba 'i mgo 'di dag /med dgos pa la sbyor ba'i 'khrul pa dang yod dgos pa kar zong ba'i 'khrul pa dang / /gang yang rung ba'i gdam nga can la yod med mtha' sacig tu / /'dzin pa'i 'khral pa spong ba 'a tshul byung zad bshad par bya ste/ /'phul la za yab dang ge sar ke 3 ra sib lhan dang / /mngon sum phun sum tshogs pa dang sil sil sum byu sogs la/ /gas 'phul bris na nor ba yin te med par bshad pa'i phyir ro ba/sha' ma dang / /gsags dbyed da dang ba/sham gsar sogs la ba sa 'phul med na nor zhing / /sar pa lta bur ga yod med gang yang rung 169

ngo / /skyil kung dang kar kar sogs la das 'phul med cing / /dgung rba mtshan dgung long khrid kyi/ /dmigs bu dang dmigs pa sogs la med na nor la/ /snyan dbags sobs la da yod rmed gang yang rung ste snyan ngag kyang 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag dar lab dar ma gad mo dang / /so mang gi bo shang dang ser ba sogs la bas 'phul ba spang bar bya zhing / /bser bu skyo bsabs rgya mo dang bal mo bza'/ /phyi bdar dang mdun bdar bdag po sogs la bas 'phul med na nor ba yin la/ /sngo sabs lha bur ba yod med gang yang rung ngo / /tha gru yul gru'am rgya khyon tha ma tshar du dngar/ /tshon rtsi dang nang tshan sogs la mas 'phul ba spab dgos shing / /mthe bo mthe bong mtshe ma sngo sman gyi mtshe/ /khyim mtshes dang mtshan ma mtshe'u sod / de da la ma med na nor la/ /thun mong dang sman tshan sogs la ma sngon du 'jag mi 'jug gang yang rung ngo / /tshong gi dus dang khams dang tshogs pa tshoms/ /phra ma khon 'dzin khro bo khros/ /rim gro phra rma phra ba phongs pa dab / /phyug po dang phangs pa sogs la 6das 'phud sha ba spab la/ —ma brjed 'khob 'khri shing snum gyi 'khur ba dang / /tshul 'chos dang 'phong skyen sogs la 'a mer na nor ba yin zhing / /phrin las phreng ba sogs gdam nga can yin pas 'a yod med gang yab rung ba'i tshul shes par bya'o/ /rjeb/ 'jug la yi ge myu gu lu gu rgyud/ /shākya dang cho ga soṭa la ga'i mthar rten zang bar bya zhing / /phrag dog grub dgu shug pa lta bur ga rmed na nor ba yin no/ / lus mo'i lha nga za nga dang / /sgo nga sogs la nga mthar rten bri pa na nor ba yen la 'on kyang bsnas na pus lhang lcags sgang bya sgong zhes 'byung ba 'di lta bu ga mtha' sogs rigs 'gre btub 170
