pa gong1'og kun la sbyar/ /yi dam lha dang dam bca' yi rang yi dwags dang / /thra 'u dang yi chad sogs la da mtha' rten nor la / /ska cig lha bur da mtha' yod med gab yang rung ngo/ /se mo do la na mtha' rten spang bar bya zhing / /byan mo dang sen mo lta bur na mtha' med na nor/ /lha rigs kyi btsun pa bza' ba byung zas skom gdu bu dang / /le brgan dang sde brgyad sogs la ba mtha' rten nor/ /rgya 'dre 'khrug pa'am rgya'i 'dre kha mchu ra mda' dab / /ra mnye na bza' rtswa mchog grong ku sha'i grong / /rgya mtsho dang skye mched sogs la ma mtha' rten nor//lha rje mdo rgyud nga rgyal can/ /bya chod rdo rje mtha' rten rjes 'jug sogs dang / /lha rten sku rten sogs dang bka' rtags sogs la ra mtha' rten med cing / /dur khrod mdor bsdus dang gsar pa lta bu la ra mtha' med na nor la/ /bder gzhegs zhes pa ltar la don dngos su yod pa'am yang na su ga ta'i sgra ltar bde gshegs zhes rnam dbye med kyang rung la de bzhin du bder bkod sogs ra yod med gang yang rung / /lhan gyi gnyen po gsos sman kha dro legs pa sogs dang / /gzungs grwa za dang sā la sobs la la mtha' rten yod na nor/ /rig sngags gsung rab mkhyen rab dang / /nam 'phang go 'phang /zi 'phang mchog /sngags kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rjogs pa'i rim pa gnyis 'du shes dang / /mkha' spyod dag zhing sogs sa spyod rgyadaka po sog ba do ba/'a gyi 'phreb ba/ /nyam chung nyan/ thag nyam nga ba/ /log rwar stog pa shug par 'dzin pa som nyi the tshom chom nun dang / /cho ga dang so ga sog4 la sa mtha' rten yod na nor zhing / /lhas byin klus byin gdams ngag dang rtogs pa rtags pa la sogs pa/ /mang ngo zhig la sa che4tha' 171

med na nor la/ /dri bzangs rgyud mabs go rims dang / /'khor los sgyur ba zhes phur bus thob kyi rigs pas sa mtha' yod pa'am 'khor lo skor ba dang skad dod gcig pas med kyang rung la de bzhin du lag bzangs— sogs la sa mtha' yod med gab yab rung ste gdam nga can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mgo la klad kor stod kor gdub kor gdu bu gor rgor dab / /pad bor pad+ma 'khor ba ste phyag rgya'i khyad par sogs ban kor nye 'khor 'od kor gyi phreng ba/ /ya za shing gi khyad par dang nyer kor sogs la sa mgo sbyor ba med cing / /dur zig smig rgyu dang smyug ma lda bur sa mgo med na nor ba yin la 'di dag phal cher gyi tshig don gong du rgyas par bshad pa dang sbyar nas shes par bya'o/ /yi ge dang zhal ta dang da lha dang / /la sogs pa bsdu 'os mtha' dag bsdud pa ba dad ces pa lta bu nams la/ /snga phyi'i bar du tsheg mi byed pa ni blun po'i lugs su zad pab/ tsheg bya dgos so/ /de lhar gong du bad sbyor mdo ru bsdus te cung zad tsam bshad pa 'dis/ /mtshon par byas nas yig sbyo ༄ shir tu rgya che ba'i ba/nas rnams gtsug 'a ga las 'byung ba dag kyang shes par bya zhing / —rang rang so so'i brda la rdam par dpyod pa'i rig pas kyang dpyad par bya'o/ /sdeb sbyor mtha' dag pa ni yi ger bris te brjod pas mi lang ngo / /ka'adir legs sbyar gyi mchan 'ga' snang ba de tsam spyos dpyos phyin dka' zheng yi ge yang mthar gyis dogs nas ma bris mod gzhung don dbags ra snye bar mkho bas sgra gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /pod kyi brda'i bye zab gsal bar byed pa'i bstam bcos tsheb le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgro na ma cheb bya ba spas/ /ye ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul pa spong ba bshad pa ste le'u gsum pa'i 172

bshad pa'o// //deng sang gi dus su byis pa blun po'i skye po rams kyi blo la/ /bad dag gi sbyor ba 'di ko brda sprod pa'i lung dang brda la brten pa'i rigs pa gnyis kyis/ /don go ba 'dir rag las pa'i phyir dpyad bar bya ba'i gzhi che mod kyi de las ldog ste chub bar rtsi zhing slob pa'i dka' tshegs la ltos pa med par zhar byung du/ /shes par 'gyur snyam yang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs tha na spring yig tshun gyi rjod byed 'khrul pas brjod bya'i dngos po la mgo go 'khor zhing mobs par snang ngo / /kye ma shes bar bya ba'i pha rol gyi mtha' dpag yas bsam gyis mi khyab cing / /shes bya de dag la re re'i ming gi sgra 'jug pa'i yang / /rgyu mtsham 'dra 'brel sogs dang nges tshig sgra bshad sogs mi shes na/ /shes bya thams cad kyi brda dag pa'i spyor ba thob tshul ji ltar 'byub ste sgra ngon sob/sa la rmongs pa'i phyir ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ste chos don nges tshig sgobs pa yin la rim pa ltar gtsug lag gi rjod byed dang de'i brjod bya dang sgra don nam skad dang mkhyen pa 'di dag ba bad(1 ba legs pa'i blo gros/ /da thob pa dus de thrad du shes bya'i chos ma lus pa kun gyi/ /res pa'i tshib sogs shes pa mim la de yi pyir na/ /shes bya mtha' bas gi sdeb spyor so skye la sogs pa bsna 'u / ba dgeb nus te mi nus so/ /sa dgu pa ma thob pa dag ji/sa shes mi nus mod 'on kung shes bya phyogs re'i brda sbyor dab/ kyang / /'bad pa du ma'i tshul gyis brtag cing btsal bar bya'i btang stoms su mi bya ste/ /rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yi ge'i ts+tsha ra ba rjod byed la 'khyel zhing nor na/ /brjod don dmas su 'a/zul ba 'brung ba smo sa ci zhig dgos pa'i phyir don la nor na nying dgos gnyis ji/ 'thob bo/ /tshul 'ad ni gsung gi rab bka' dang dgongs 'grel ma lus ba'i/ /phyi mo 173

rtsa bar shes pas sngon gyi mkhas pa mang po byon pa dag gi /brda'i gzhung la brten nas rtsom pa po bdag gis kung / /brda'i sbyor ba ston ba 'di nyid kho nar nam tan byas pa yin no/ /sngon byon mkhas pa du mas sbyar bar mdzad pa yi/ /bod kyi bza sprod pa yi bstan bcos la grangs ka mab po zhig snang na yang / /rje byams pa gleng pa'i smra rgyan lta bu 'ga' zhig ni tshig rgyas la skabs kyi dkos pa'i don nyung ba dang / /rje zha lu lo tsā ba'i za ma tog lta bu 'ga' shig ni tshig don gnyis ka ha cang bsdus pa dang / /snar thang lo tsā ba'i brda sbyor lta bu 'ga' jig ni sngon gyi yig cing dang mi mthun pa dang / /stag ston gyi 'od zer brgya pa lta bu 'ga' zhig ste kha cib ni sum rtags kyi gzhung sobs dab 'dal bar snang ste/ /rgyu mtshan de yi phyir tshig tshogs nyung la don rgyas pa sogs dang ldan pa'i/ /legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos 'ji da dpal khang pa bdag gis brtsams par byas so/ /ngag sgron 'di la khungs med par rang gi blo bzo byas pa'i skyon ma mchis te rgyu mtshan ni/ /tshad ldan gyi mkhas pa'i gzhung na gsal ba'i legs bshad la yab dag par brten cing / /gsar rnying gi brda dang gru skad dang pod kyi skad/ /la sogs pa dag zhib mor dpyad de bkod pa'i phyir ro/ /lta ba sogs snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus kyi mi zams ni gnas gnas min rdam par da sgod pa'i blo gros kyi mig de/ /phyob/sa su sprung ba'i ling tog gis bsgribs par byas nas/ /drang zhing gzu por gnas pa'i blo gros bzang po yis tshig don legs par bshad pa dag la/ /mi stog mi dpyod par don mthun med kyang 'jig rten na grags pa gang che'i rjes su 'brang bar byed do/ /mkhas ba'i ngag gi sgron ma'i bstan bcos 'di ko legs par 174

bshad pa'i 'od zer stong phrag dang ldan mod/ /rtsom pa po nyid kyang rnam dpyod kyi blo bzang po'i nor dang ldan par gyur na yang rigs rus dang gzugs byad dang longs spyod 'byor pa nyam chung zhing dman pa bdag gis sprur bar byas pa'i pyir zhes pa rgyu mtshan du bzung ste/ /rab rib lta bu'i blo gros ngan pa can dmas kyis ring du zangs nas blun po mkhas par rlom pa so so'i 'khor gyi tshogs mang zhing 'byor pa rgyas ldan gyi smra sgo nas/ /nyes par bshad pa dper na grin bu'i kha yi 'od dang mtshungs pa la brda sbyor gyi mobs pa'i mun pa de sel ba'i byi ra rgyub par byed do/ /rtsom pa po bdag gis bstan bcos 'dir nan gyis 'bad nas sbyar ba'i bsod nams kun+da ltar dkar ba dang / /phyogs gral gzu bor gnas shing rnam 'byed kyi blo rab tu gsal la 'dod pas don du gnyer ba dang ldan pa ste chos gsum tshang pa'i/ /skyes bu sogs 'ga' zhig la gzhung 'di yis phan pa 'byung srid na/ /de lta bu las byung ba tsā dge ba rnams sems can mtha' dag bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /bod kyi brda'i bye zag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgon ma zhes bya ba 'di dzi//sdom brtson mkhyen pa dang brtse ba'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa byang pa lus srog 'tsho bar mdzad pa'i sman pa karma 'od zer ba'i bsung ngag gis bskul ba'i rkyen byas te/ /de'i ngor shākya'i tog gi rjeb/ 'jug dge slong mtshan ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyabs can snye mas ba'i snge'am dpal sgang ngam dpal khang pa chos mdzad lo tsā ba che/sa bya pas/ /rdam 'phyang gi lo tha skar spyis nya ba ston ka'i zla ba 'bring po'i gral gyi 17 5

tshes brtso lnga la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul karma pa'i lgar chen du legs ba/ra grub cing rdzogs par bgyis pa'o/ /gnas lnga'i gzigs la 'jug na kun mkhyen gyi/ /gling du son zhes zla med ston pas gsungs/ /'dir mchis dgongs 'grel bcas rtogs gangs can pa'i/ /brda sprod la stos 'di yang bsten par 'os/ /sde sgod 'dab brgya phye nas zag pa'i rtsi/ /mkha' ma 4ma 'gro ba yongs kyi myong slad sbyar/ /brda don sbyor ba mi mthun bdag gis nyes/ /'khrul med ston pa bla ma'i drin gyis yin/ /'di yis lung la rmongs sel brjod pa mdzes/ /rtogs pa'i chos don rnam nges rab tu gsal/ /bcom lngan skyes bu tshad mar sgrog pa las/ /ma lus sems can bstan la 'jug par shog /phal cher don med don yod rnam kun tu/ /don yod bshad phyir gzhan la nye sbyor dka'/ /gal te phan na 'di dang gzhan gyi ma/ /rnam mkhyen go 'phang myur du 'thob gyur cig /bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos ngag sgron gyi 'grel pa tshig gsal zhes bya ba 'di/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rgyud du byung ba bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar pa'o/ /༈//sde dge chos rgyal chen po'i lha sras tshe dbang bdud 'dul mchog gis sgra rig gsan skabs 'di ltar rtsom par bkas bskul te/ grub 'phral sras mo g.yu sgron lags nas spar du bsgrubs pa me glang lor spar dpon bla ma dam pa ting 'dzin chos grags kyis zhu dag legs par grub pa 'dis brda sprod chig la mi rmongs shing /gsung rab don gnas 'khrul med rtogs te rgyal bstan gsal bar gyur cigadage'o/ /maṅga li// //176
)ga kag dag sgron gyi shad dgeg sgeg ga )gzha bye)/kun bzang rnam rgyal gyis brtsams/

rab/ /na mo byed ya/ de bod skad du bsgyur na/ na mo ni phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don dang / bab ni sangs rgyas la go ya zhes pa rnam dbye gnyis pa'i la don gyi phrad de don la sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don yin no/ /pod kyi bda'i bye zag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshigs le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgon ma zhes bya ba/ yang dag par gsung ba sangs rgyas la phyab 'tshal lo// // zhes gsungs pa ni/ rgya gar lho phyogs rdo rje gdan 'di dbus spra rtsis zhing de yi byang phyogs bod kyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug pa la sogs pa'i bye brag gam ya rgyal rgyal ba'i gsung rab las 'byung ba'i yi ge de dag gi tshig mtshams sbyor ba rnams gsal zhing go bar byed pa mkhas pa'i gsung gi bstan bcos te sangs rgyas sam mkhas pas bstan pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs de 'phel zhing rgyas par bcos pa'i 'chos skyob gnyis ldan gyi don la go ba de tshigs su bcad nas tshig le'ur byas pa shes bya la mkhas pa'i ngag gi rang bzhin sgron ma'am sgron rma lta bu zhes bya ba'am sgrog pa/ shes bya'i gnas lugs yang dag pa phyin ci ma log par gsung ba po gnyid sad pa ltar ma rig pa'i sprib pa thams cad sangs pa dang / me tog pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa ltar shes bya ma lus pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes khyab nas rgyas pa la sgo gsum gus pas 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don no/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin gser pyi ri 'dra'i sku/brgyad khri bka stong chos za chen po'i gsung / /119

ye shes rgya mtsho gteng mtha' med pa'i bugs/ /thub chen 'gro ba'i bla ma phyag gi gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ bye bo su 'dra lgig gis mthong na'ang skyes spru dam pa kho nar mtshon pa mtshan bzang po so ba nyis dang dpe sprud bzang shā brgyang cu'i gzi byi na rab tu gab la ba gser gyi 'i bo 'dra ba 'i—ska dang / chos kyi phub po brgyad khri bzhi stong ste chos kyi phung po re'i bong tshad ni glang chen sā la rab brtan rgyab khal tu theg nus pa'i snag tsha yis/ chos kyi phung po re 3bri thub pa yin de lta bu'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag rtsol ba dang rtog pa mi/ dgos par 'doms pa ni 'dus byamu thams cad mi rtag pa dang / zag bcas thams cad byig bsngam ba/ chos tham sa cab stong zhing bdab/ med — 1 mya ngan las 'das ba zhi ba bcas chos kyi sdom bzhi sgrob/ byed lha rnga chen po lta spru ba dang / ji lta ji snyed kyi mkhyen rwa /'i me shes te shes rab rgya mtsho lta bu gting dang mtha' med ba ldan ji/'i thugs mnga' pa/ nyon rmangs pa'i dgra bo'i g.yu (sha bkas rgyal thub pa yin snyi ka skyes bu chen po ba pa yin pa lha dang bcas pa rigs drug gi 'gro ba ma spus pa'i bla ma de bzhen gshegs rwa ste ka shā 'khor ba'i gnas su yang nas yang du skye ba bzhes pa dang / de bzhin dī thar ‘4'i gnas su yang nas yang du gshegs pa ni lha 'i dbang po brgya byen pang / tshang sa pa da nga khyab 'jug la sogs pas kyang sprug bya ba'i gnas lin na ga( na spyos ni de bas kyang phyag ji/ bya pa 'jug pa'i gnab mi/na no zhes rngo ngas rgyas bcom lda na 'das kyi sku gsung thug ba kyi yon—tan brjod nas mchod pa ba je da ba dpen da / /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i phung za cig car du/ /180

ska bzab yid mkhar 'gog pa med pa'i gzugs/ / phan bde'i 'od dkar legs bshad bsil zer can/ /'jam mgon smra ba'i zla ba mchog der 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs dang / da lta bcas dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa kun gyi mkhyen pa dang / sems can la thugs brtse ba chen po gcig tu spungs pa'i phung po de gnyis cig car ram dus mnyam du skal pa bzang po dang lda na pa mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi yid nam mkha' dwangs ba de'i ngos la gzhan gang gis kyang 'gog pa'am sgrib pa med par lham mer gsal ba'i gzugs can sgyu ma lta bu dang / 'jig rten gyi khams la phan pa dang bde ba'i 'od dkar po phyogs kun tu spro ba'am ma rig pas tsha bas gzir ba rnams ka legs par bshad pa'i bsil zer mnga' ba can 'jam dbyangs ste nyon mongs pa'i rtsub reg dang bral bas na thugs rgyud 'jam pa dang / gsung yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba kun gyi mgon po dang / ngag smra ba kun gyi nang nas shin tu mdzes pa zla ba lta bu mchog tu gyur pa der sgo gsum gus pas 'dud do zhes rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa yin no/ /me shes sgyu 'phrul mdzes sku'i 'jo sgeg dang / /sgra da zangs rgya mtsho'i rgyud mangs snyan 'gyur gyis/ /snying la zag med bde ster lhag pa'i lha/ /dbyangs can lha mos blo yis mchog sbyin mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ ye shes te shes rab kyi bdag nyid sgyu ma'i mig 'phrul lta bu mdzes shing sdug pa'i sku la brten pa'i rnam 'gyur yid 'jo zhing 181

sgeg pa'i nyams dang / rna ba'i yul gyi sgra dang dbyangs dpag tu med pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'byung gnas dang / rgyud mangs ba pa las byung ba'i sgra snyan cing 'gyur bag dang ldan pa'i khyad par gyis gdul bya sems can mtha' yas pa'i snying la zag pa ste nyon mongs med pa'i bde ster ba mo lhag pa'i lhar 'gyur ba/dbyangs las byung ba can lha'i bu mos shes bya la rab tu rnam par 'byed ba blo yi mchog dam pa sbyin par mdzod cig ces dbyangs can lha mo'i yon tan brjod nas mchod par brjod pa yin no/ / zon med yi ge'i ngo ma tshar snab ba sogs/ /legs bshad 'od brgyas byab phyogs mun gling 'dir/thub bstan gsal mdzad ba ṭa la sogs/ /rgya pod mkhas pa dmas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sngon du med pa'i bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs brtsams pa'i ngo mtshar du snang ba brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos rnam pa brgyad mdzad pa dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab bod skad la bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer brgya phrag gis rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs bod du grags pa ngam pa'i chos dar khyab byung med pa mun pa'i gling lta bu 'dir ston pa shākya thub pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che ste lung sde sgod gsum dang rtog pa bslab pa gsum gsal bar mdzad pa po ba ṭa la sogs rgya dang bod kyi mkhas pa rnams la sems kyi gting nas bkrin dran te sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo zhes slob dpon thon mi dang sngar gyi rgya bod lo paṇa rnams la mchod par brjod pa yin no/ /de ltar gong du mchod par brjod pa'i dgos pa yang / ji skad du/ bstan bcos byed pa'i dam pa yi/ /ston pa la ni mchod brjod bya/ /bstan pa spel phyir dag pa'i tshig /'od la 'a mid pa 182

bzang po mthong / zhes pa ltar rang re bod kyi sngon byon mkhas dbang su 'dra zhig yin rang ba bstan brtsos kyi thog mar lhag pa'i lhar phyag 'tshal ba'i srol yod do/ /blo gros nul zhing sbyangs pa'i mthu chung yang / /tshad ldan mkhas pa'i lebs bshad la brten nas/'khyel pa'i mun chen drung 'byin brda sprod kyi/ /bstan bcos mkhas pa'i ngag sgron rab gsal bya/ —zhes khengs skyung gi sgo nas gsungs pa ni/ dpal khang pa bdag ni skye stobs kyi blo gros mi rdo bar dbang po rtul zhing rig pa la sbyangs pa'i nus pa zhan pas bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu dman pa ltar snang yang tshad ma dang ldan pa khungs ldan gyi mkhas pa thu mi la sogs pa'i sngon byon gyi mkhas pa tsho'i legs bshad rnams yi ge'i sbyor bar brten nas ngag gi sbyor ba dang / 'khrul pa'i mun pa chen po drung nas 'byin pa'am rtsa ba nas med pa brngos nas phan tshun go brda sprod byed kyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron me rab tu gsal bar byed pa 'di brtsam par bya'o/ /zhes rtsom par dam bca' dngos su bstan pa dang / shugs la dgos pa la sogs pa'i chos bzhi bstan pa ni/ bya rog so rtog gi bstan bcos lta bu brjod bya med pa ma yin te/ bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa ces pa brjod bya dang / ma bag mar len pa lta bu dgos ba med pa med pa ma yin te/ ngag gi 'khrul pa'i mun pa chen po drung nas 'byin pa ni dgos pa dang / klu rgyal 'jog po'i gtsug rgyan len pa lta bu'i nying dgos med pa ma yin te/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang bstan bcos rnams bde blag tu rtogs shing mthar thug mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi go 'phangs thob par bya 183

rgyu ni nying dgos dang / byis pa se'u bcu pa'i ngag bzhin 'brel ba med pa ma yin te/ nying dgos de dgos ‘1ra brten dgos rwa dang / dbo/sa pa nge'ang brjod bya la brten dgos pas de dag phyi ma phyi ma snga ma snga ma la 'brel bab na 'brel ba yin no/ /brngod don kā li sum cu la/ /rkyab pa 'phul dang mgo can dang /dbyangs lnga ya ra la ba'i 'dogs/ /rjes 'jug dpe sogs rim pas bstan/ —zhes gsungs pa ni/ 'dir gang brjod par bya ba'i don sdom pa'am phyoṭa gcig tu bsdus par byed na/ kā li ste gsal byed yi ge sum cu tham pa la rkyang pa ste 'phul sngon 'jug dang / mgo can ra mgo la mad sa mgo gsum med pa dang / yang 'phul byed de sngon 'jug ga da ba ma 'a lnga gang rung can ldan pa da nga / mgo la ra la sa gsum yod pa can dang 1 dbyangs nga ro'i rnam pa a i su spe o lnga can dang / / ra la ba bzhi'i smad 'dogs can dang 1 rjes su 'jug pa ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa bcu/ nga 'jug ji ltar 'thob pa'i dpe dang sogs pa dang / phrad rnam dbye'i sbyor ba dang 'khrul ba spyong tshul te rim pas bstan par bya'o/ /184

kakun mkhyen/ shes bya'i rnam pa kun lag mthil nang skyu ru ra'i 'bus bu bzhag pa la gzigs pa ltar gsal thing nger mkhyen pa ste 4mas cad mkhyen pa la goshākya/ shing shā ka'i drung du gnas bca' zhing rig pa bslab pas shākya zhes dang / yang na rgyal po 'phags skyes po'i bu dang bu mo ser skya'i gnas su bcug par bu dang bu mo bsdus pa'am bza' tshang byas par brten phas de 'dra byed phod dam zhes brjong pas shākya la phod pa zhes zer ba dang / nus ldan te stobs dang ldan pa ni ston pa'i rigs yin la mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po'i rgyud pa yin/ mang bkur rgyal po nas zas gtsang bar rgyal po sa ya chig 'bum nyi khri byung bar grags/karma pa/ karma ni legs sbyar gyi skad yin zhing / bod skad du bsgyur na las sam 'phrin las kyi don yin/ pa ni bdag sgra/ka ra/ mngar cha'i khyad par ram bye ma ka ra lta bu la goka tan/ ras dkar zhig la goka shi ka yul gsal ldan gyi ming dang de las thon pa'i ras la'ang ka shi ka zer/nags klung / shing nags mthug po la go ba dang klung ni mthug po'i don yin/chu glung / gtsang po dang rgyug chu lta bu la go 185

bdang/da blo sgyur / chu'i rba rlabs sam glong 'khor la go shāka dud 'gro'i bye brag gam nang gses shig yin/ma/ bdag rtsa ba nas dag pa'am gdod ma nas dag pa'am thog ma nas med pa ste stong pa nyid kyi don la gsungs/ dper na/ ka dag gnas lugs rtoṭa pa'i bla ma la lta bu'o/ /klong yangs/ khong yang ba pa'am rgya che ba dang / yang na dkye rjem che ba'i don/klong du grur/ don rtogs pa'am dbang du gyur pa—sgyum rang ba bang thob pa'i don/ka ku lha ya/ phyogs khyab ste rgya gar du yod pa'i shing zhig la zer /ka dpo/ tshogs can ste lo ma nyi gdugs ltar ther nas skyes pa'i 'ing zhig bka bo/ ba dang / dra/ (spyi sku/nga bka ba nga bod/ka ba gsal byed de gser sha dang cha 'dra ba'i rtswa zhigaku sha sar nyal te rtswa mchog la go ba dang / rtswa ku sha yang zer— de'i rtse mo ha cang phra ba zhig yin/ kun/ ldum lge sha bo me tog dkar po ste/ shin tu mdzes pa'i me tog dkar bo zhig za ming yin/ku mud / sa mos sam sa dga' yang zer te zla bas kha phye ba'i me tog dkar po zhib/ gi mib lin/dka ka rgya skye༅sa kyi shing dang sne rtsa 'am ci zhes pa'i don/ma/ ra we ra/ lag pa'am sor bzhad de re lcag dang mya ngan gyi me ngog dmar po wa go — — sdor bzad zer ba ni lag nga'i sor rma bzhad ba ltar yod rwa/ 8 nga / re rtsi bka ni sman rigs shig ste / nus pas gnyan nad rtsamar da thur du ba 5 /la bar byed /186

ke ta ka shing dang nor bu la go ste gnyis kas chu rnyeg dwangs nus/shing kun/ rlung sman te shing sman tshi ba'i rigs shig yin/ya krob / sngo sman zhig ste nus pas glo tshang sogs la phan/dar ya kan/ zhang zhung gi skad de bdud rtsi'am sman yin so so'i gsang sman dang grangs brtsi rgyu'ang yod pa ni/ dmigs pa skabs kyi dar ya kan dang /bab pa skabs kyi dar ya kan lta bu/ka ped/ shing bal ba pho la go ba dang / ka bed zhes kyang 'bri srol yod/ku ba/ stod nas byung ba'i shing tog thil ba mol go ba dang / 'di'i dbyibs bum pa dang 'dra bas chu sdod kyang byas chog pa zhig yin/kem ba'i 'bras/ gim pa ni dug shing yin zhing de'i 'bras bu mngar la zos na 'chi/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ tsher ma can gyi sman stag tsher la go nus pas rlung tshad dang bad kan skya bo dang glo nad bcas la phan/na rī ke la/ mi mo rtsen te be ta'i 'bras bu la go ba dang stod nas thon/bka da/ bka/ pho rog dang sman zla ba'i bye ma la go ba dang sman zla ba'i bye ma ni dug rigs dgu'i bye brag zhig yin pa dang rgya gar dang lho mon nas thon/da/ ba ba/ gangs ri la go ma/ khyad da// rgya gar gyi yul ci mtshan la gorka ba/ sngar rgya gar shar phyogs su yod pa'i grong khyer mdzod ldan nam rtswa // sha ba dka ba 61na/dka da bka/ rgya gar gyi yul dge ba can la gom da bta/ rgya gar gyi yul ka ma ta la goko(1 shi ka rgya gar skad la ko shi ka yod pa sgra zur phyin pa'i ched sna ru 187

gceg gi dod 'u sbyar ba sngags kyi klog spubs dang / bod skad nyid la'ang mi chung la mi'u thung dang 'dab chags chung ba la byi'u sogs chung ba'i don lta bu la 'jug pa yod pas khyad par shes par bya ste don/ dbang chen ku gul 'ug pa dang / sprul 'dzin rnams la ko shi ka /zhes sogs la 'jug /ka t+yā ya na/ ka ka'i bu ste 'phags pa/ shākya mu no'i dngos slob yin pa da nga / nyan thos mtha' ka'akhor 'dul ba'i mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin pa de nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde bzhi yi gnas brtan sde'i srol gtod mkhan/ka'i spya/ 'thab ldan ma'i bu ste/ lnga sde'i ya rgyal/ lnga sde ni bcom ldan —redas kyis chos kyi 'a11ra lo dang po skor skabs 'khor lnga sde bzang po la go zhing / nge dag ni rta thul dang / rlang pa/ bzang ldan/ ming chen/koṇ+ḍi hūṃ bcas lngad/ /ke'u tshang / brag phug gi ming du godad glang la sogs pa'i ra/ ba ni pags pa la gobakard/ lham gyi kad ni lham gyi rdog pa 'a/ goyungs dkar/ 'bru'i khyad par ram bye bragam/ zad/ kha dog dkar po la gothod le kor/ ha shig ste ri mo dod pa'i rdo dkar la go ba dpa 1 paṇ+ḍi ta zer ba dang / sgod cig zer ba/ rdo sprug zer ba/ gar bu zer ba'ang snang /ku shu/ shing 'a bras kyi khyad par/gur kum/ ku dum sgad zur chag pa ste/ me tog gur kum la go ba dang kha che sha da ma lta bu yod pa/ka ca/ byi da dngos sam rgyu nor dang / dngos po spyi'i ming /188

kun/ spums cad dam tshang ma zhes pa'i don/bsags kyang / rgyu nor sogs bsags pa ni gsog pa'i don/ bsags ni 'das pa ston pa'i tshig /kyang ni rgyan sdud kyi sgra/'bab krol/ 'thab mo ste/ phyogs gnyis phan tshun rtsod pa'am 'thab pa'am 'khrug pa'i don/lung krol rgyu/ phung byed kyi rgyu'am rlag byed kyi rgyu la gokye ma/ zhum pa'am mya ngan nam snying rje'i brda yin/kyi hud/ zu ngan nam sdug bsngal gyi brda/kye ho/ rab bam ngo mtshar bod pa'i brda/ma/ ka dang ka ye ni bod tshig yin/kye kye/ bod tshig lan gnyis smos pa/rkyang krong / dma' sa'am gshong gshong du gokong kong / dma' sa'am gshong gshong du go11ba/ spyod 'a/ sgra krog krog lta bu dang / mi dang rta sogs la krog krog zhes brjod pa ni snying po min pa'i don ba / ba bka / mig sogs kab kab ni mig g.yo tshul dang lus pos kab krab ni 'khrub tshul 'a god go 11ga 11ga mgo bo khyog po'am 'khyog po'i don/krob krong / rtsag tsog gam reng po'i don/kog gis/ myur bas sam glo bur gyi don/ ker langs nas/ lus sogs ke rer langs pa'i don dang / nas ni tshig phrad/ku res/ ku re ni rtsed mo'i don dang / sa ni byed sgra/189

do ker/ thor tshub/sa sam thor cog 'a go ste/ dper na/ mgod rber cob 'di ni mdzes pa la lta—spru/ko sko 'degs/ 6 le ste ma mchu'i 'og ba/ rus 'bur 'a go zhi nga / 'degs pa ni bkyag pa'i don yin pa dang / dus da lta ba'i tshigaku co1 skad che ba'am don med srud cor la gokyal ka rtsed mo'i don yin/klan ka'i rgyu/ rtsod pa'i rgyu la go'on kyang / yin na mang zhes pa'i don/ kyang sgra 'di mi mthun ji 'i rgyan yim lan ban/ 'a na kan ni rgya nag gi skad yin/ don la rngu/ shu ste khang pa'i che4da' yab bam chu skyer zer ba yin /nyen kord/ nye (re kho༄ ram snye 'dabs la gom bad zad bta ma spru mchil pa'am khang byi'u la goco ka spu mdog skya zhing sre bo/ bya mchil pa las byung za pa che shing skad sna tshogs 'byin pa/ gnam la thad kar 'phur das sa 'a thad kar 'bab pa'i 11'u byu/ba/ ba po/ma/ la pid/ rgya mtsho'i gling na gnas pa'i bya skad snyan po zhigakyur kyur skad/ kyur kyur zhes bya'i skad 'byin tshul/shad bdu/ sgog pa la gob ) zug zad ba / brtsang la gom/ba/ lo'i bar chad de lo 'khor bcu ga)sa kyi mtshams su kag re byung ba dper na bcu gsum byis pa'i kag lta—bu/da/ ma/bad / sa bdag gi khyad par la go ba dang / gza' rā tu pha'i bya rog gi mgo la gi kang zer/190

stod kor/ sku stod das sku stod thad kyi rod kor ba/ go/ 'od kor ni nyi zla sogs kyi mthar 'od zer blum bur 'khyil ba la zer/ zad kor yi ge'i steng du klad kor ram thig kor ram rjes su nga ro yod pa dper na/ i saṃ lta bu/klad dan dang / klad kyi don ni gong si don nam steng gi don nam thog ma'i don la go/ dang ni 'byed sdud kyi phrad/ke sha/ 'greng po nyis brtsegs sam rna ru nyis brtse gas la ke sha zer/ dper na/ e lta bu e ke sha can dang / i lta bu o ke sha can zer/ zhabs kyu/ dbyangs u yig mtshon byed kyi rtags (ba )der zhabs kyu zer/lhags kyus btab/ mchil pa'am spyo bas btab pa ni lcags kyus 'dzin pa'i don/kar kaྈ zub langs/ kar kar ni na zug 'angs tshul la gobad kan/ nyes pa gsum gyi gcig ste/ bad kan rmug po lta bu/ nyes pa gsum ni rlung dang cha/khrid pa dang bad kan bcas yin/ bad kan rmug po ni/ nad kyi rang mdog la bstos na rdo ba tegs pa'i 'dus nad nu tsho na byed kyi ming 6ga yin/chu'i ku ya/ nad ba 'i dri—chur brtag skabs gcin pa'i khar chags pa'i 'o ma'i kha spris dang 'dra ba'i dngos po zhig ste la dog dang srab mthug sna tshobs byung ba dang / srab mthug las tsha grang gi nad 'byed pa yin/kan dkag rtsa kung mdzub 'og gi rtsa'am dkyil mdzub 'og gi rtsa pha gobakab kub / 'u sa kyi rtsa'i 'phar tshu ma blug rus kam 1 sha med dus pa rkyang pa la go krang nge / krong nge la go191

skyil kung bcas/ skyil krung ni rdo rje skyil krung lta bu 'dug tshul zhig yin pa bcas/ma dra/ba sa klab mab klab / 'byams klas dang mtha' klas gnyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don dang / mtha' klas pa'am mthas gtugs pa'i don yang yin la ha cang rgya che ba la mtha' med pa'i don no/ /klog kyang / klog pa ni 'don pa'i don te da lta ba ston pa'i tshig/ dper na/dpe cha klog lta bu/ kyang ni rgyan sdud kyi phrad/klag glog pa'i ming tsam yin/ston ka nam dus bzhi'i khyad par/ ston ka zla ba gsum ni bod zla bdun pa dang / brgyad pa dang / dgu pa gsum1 yin/dpyid ka nam dus bzhi'i khyad par/ dpyid ka zla ba gsum ni bod zla dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa gsum yin/gnyis ka'i dus/ nyin dang mtshan gnyis ka'i dus sam gnyi tsa'i dus lta bu/glang chen bal kar/ glang chen ni dud 'gro'i bye brag glang po che zer/ mi/nga gi nom grangs su gnyis 'thung dang / lag ldan yang zer ba dang / thal kar zer ba mdog skya bo dkar shas che ba la zer/ber kas brdungs/ ber ka ni dbyug pa la go zhing brdungs pa ni gzhus pa'i don/ma/ lnga pa/ mi mang po tshogs pa dang / rma bya'i mdongs sgro dang / rgyan cha dang / sa dong la so gas dang / sgra ka lnga pa dang / sham+bha la'i pho brang soṭa la ka lā ‘ka 'jug pa yin/kla klo bcom/ ta zig la sogs pa bcom pa'i don/ spyir kla glo ni yu2 mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa 'am legs nyes bzang ngan gyi blang dor gan pa mi 192

shes pa'i mi blun po la go/ka ba/ gdung ma 'degs byed 'a zer1ka tsa ba klubs/ ka tsa lika ni lha'i gos la go ba dang / glubs pa ni g.yogs pa'i don dang skul tshig ma 'jugakad pa ṇa/ zho yi dong tse/ sngar rgya gar du dngul gyi tshab tu sprud len byed pa'i mgron bu zhig ste/ dngul zho ṭam gyi dod yin/ke ke ru/ sman du 'gro ba'i rdo nor bu ljang ser la gokang ka dur bya ka ka ste/ mgo nag la rgyab dkar ba'i mi ro za ma na gyi bya kang ka la bo/'ji ko 'di ni'am 'di tsho zer ba'i don/klag chor che/ skad cor che ba'am ku co che ba la go keng rus/ sha med rus pa cha tshang la goka li/ ka pā ri'am bde skyong ngam thod pa la goklad pa za/ glad pa kha la za ba'i don/kun nas/ thams cad nas zhes pa'i don/ —kun nu/ thams cad du'am yang dag par gopags kab kob/ pags pa gyong po'am mkhregs po la goku byu'i mgrin/ khu byug gam dpyid kyi pho nya'i mgrin pa la godakabadam/ra da ga tho yig gam them byang la gom dkugs/ gong 'og sogs ma dgrugs pa ni ma 'khrugs pa'i don/ dkruṭa 193

pa ni 'ad 4 pa ston pa'i tshigadabor mdzod dkrogs/ pa1kar ni nor gyi spyi ming dang / mdzod ni dze+e'ajog sa'i khang ba dang / dkor mdzod dkrogs pa ni nor mdzod sgo phye nas mchod sbyin byed pa'am 'jug pa'i don/dkyib sgyur khor/ lha'i dkyil 'khor ram zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu/dkyil du/ dbus su'am thad du zhes pa'i don/dkrong bskyed/ skad cig gis dran rdzogs te rang nyid glo— bur du lha'i zhem par gsal 'debs pa/bdag brdod/ dka' ba 'ji4 khag po la godags rdo thub/ chos sobs la dka' thub spyad pa/dal6lda sprud/ dka' ba spyad pa /dgo/ka chob ji skad du / 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir / mthu ldan phyir dang mcho ga nyid phyir / 'gyur ba ce)da phyir dkon cog nyid/ ces gsungs ma1 ni / bang jig—bang la nor bu rin po che dang chob/ mtshung4 ba'i yon tan ku na ba che/—tshob/sa pa mnga' ba rtsi dkon cog ce sa bya lging 1 rme/tshungs chob kyi pe na te na 1mang bsed nams/ ma bsags pa la snang ba ma na pas snyesgyukang ba dbon pa dang 1/ rang bzhi na gyes kag pa'i chos can ma yin pas dri ma pe —ga ba nga/ nga / rang bzhi na spyi 1rdon skrub pa'i mthu dang lngan pa dang /snye ba gro ba rja ra tra/ kyi bas ma pa dbe ba1za lce lin pas snyi3jig rten — rgyan dang /bde jig ste rwa/sna pa sa 4 cho ba tu jir ma dang / da che par 1bgyur za ) 8nga bkun na cam che/ ka 4na pa rja —5ba so / dkod rdzu ba/ ya ba lha na / sangs ༄kab zad sna cog ba'i ba tshe she bar/ shā cog dang dge 'a ldan ba dkod cob ba nas ba ༄ chor rdo/nga kon rtsag dang shā) pe shen sgyu/cheg gang yang ba / ji rngo/ de rta bas che1dzungs 194

'drin pa yin1dkon/ dkon pa'am dkon mo'i don te dper na/ legs par bshad mkhan shin nyu dkon/ de dag las ni nyan mkhan dkon lta bu/mdog dkar/ kha dog gi khyad par dkar po la mdog dkar zer/dkyel che/ khong yangs pa'i don/spyan dgyas ring / mig dkyus ring ba'i don/dab ma/ phal pa'am rang bzhin pa ste ga rtsa bo min pa/dkor rdzas/ dad jis sam nor gyi spyi ming /dro ma dku/ dri ma dku ba ni dri nga ba'i don dnge / mchi ma dku ba ni mchi ma 'dzag pa'i don/dkos bag nyam thag pa'i don/kun dkris/ nyon mongs la go ste/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gsum la zer/gos kyis dkris/ gos kyis lus dkris pa ni dgri ba'i don/ dgris ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabad ku da/bab / dku gsus pa'i mtshams te sta zur la go ba dang / lus kyi lte ba nas dpyi mgo'i bar gyi cha shas la zer/nga ku kud / grod pa rlum po'am grod pa ril ril la godaku ma stongs/ rked pa ring thung 'tsham pa'i don/ da/na dkyegs/ mkha' la sprin dang du ba sogs dkrigs pa ni 'khrigs pa'i don/ zho dpogs/ zho dkrogs pa ni zho spub pa'i don dang / dgrogs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi chig196

ro' cho dkrol/ sil snyan lta bu'i rol mo dkrol ba ni 'khrol — ka'i don/dkar yol/ dkar po'i yol za/ ste/ btung sgod la gozag dkum/ bcag pa'am dkrums pa'i chab/ grum dum bu/dkyu sar bkyus/ rta sogs rgyug sar rgyug pa'i don/dka' 'grel dka' ba'i don nam dka' ba'i gnas 'grel pa ni bkal ba 'a pe/dkrigs khrag grangs gnas drug cu brtsi— skabs kyi gnas bco brgyad pa la bo/dkan gzar po/ gyen gzar po 4 lophan tshun dkugs/ phan tshun phra mas dkrugs pa ni mi mthun par bzos pa'i don/ dkrugs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabakabam/ shib / bka shis pa ste dge legs kyi don/bkrag mdangs/ bkrag ni mdangs kyi rdon yin/tshon bkra tshon rtsi khra bo la go ba dang / bka ba ni ngo mtshar dang / mdzes pa dang / bsam mi khyab pa'i don la'ang 'jugabakram/ 'grems pa'i don te/ tshong zog bkam pa lta bu/ bkram ni dus 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabakam bsgos/ rgyal po'i bka'am gong rim gyi bka' gnang ba la bka' bsgos pa zer/khrab khab ba/bad bu bkab / gral bkal ba ni khrul 'khri ba'i don dang / khal 196

bkal ba ni rta bong sogs la khal 'gel ba'i don dang / srad bu bkal ba ne+e skud pa 'khal ba'i don/pho nya ston mo 'od sprul bkye/ pho nya bkye ba ni bang chen nam 'phrin skyel ba gtong ba'i don dang / ston mo bkye ba ni gsol tshig gtong ba'i don/'od bkye ba ni 'od 'phro ba'i don/ sprul pa bkye ba ni sprul pa bstan ba'i don/ dgongs pa khral bkral/ dgongs pa bkral ba ni bsam pa'i don go bde bar byas pa'i don dang / khrul bkal ba ni dpya khrul so sor bgos pa'am phye ba'i don/dgongs bcings bkrol/ dgongs pa bkrol ba ni gong dang mtshungs/bcings pa bkrol ba ni mdud pa bkrol ba'am bshig pa'i don/ bkrol ni dus 'angs pa ston byed kyi tshigadri ma bku bkus/ dri ma ste dreg pa chus bkru ba dang bkrus pa gnyis 'khrud pa'i don yin zhing / bkru ba ni dus ma 'ongs pa dang / bkrus pa ni dus 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig yin/bkren cing / bkren pa ni ser sna dang dbul ba la 'jug pa dang / cing ni tshig phrad do/ /bkyes/ bkres pa ni ltogs pa'i don te/ pho ba bkres pa'am yang na bkres skom gnas la lhung lta bu/bkar nas/ bkar ba ni logs su bkar ba'am zur du bton pa la go ba dang / logs su bed spyod byas pa'i don la'ang 'jug pa dang / nas ni chig phrad/bkyigs/ bkyigs pa ni thag pas bsdams pa'am thag pas bcing ba pa lta bu/197

bkyegs ni dus 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigasrog bkums/ srog bkums pa ni 'gums pa'am gsod pa'i don/ bkums ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabarkyangs/ bkrongs pa ni bsad pa'i zhi sa'i tshigabakas sa/ g.yos khang ste thab tshang ngam za khang la gosgod bkang / chu sgod la sogs dgang ba'am kangs pa'i don/bugs dam bkang / dgongs pa dgyes ‘ ra byas pa'am sems khengs su 'jug pa'i don/bsnyen bkur/ zhabs tog dang rim gro'i don te/ dge 'dun la mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur zhu lta bu/bkur sti/ brtsi bkur ram bsnyen bkur gyi don/gong du bkur/ gtsug tu bkur ba'am brtsi ba'i don/ba da/bad ched ba ba / khang pa sogs kyi bzo bkod legs pa'am bka' bkod leṭa ba bka bod/bde sar bkod/ bde ba'i sar bzhag pa'i don/zur bkol/ zur du spyod pa'am zur du bton pa'i don/shing bkug ljon shing 'gugs par byed pa'i don/ bkug ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabakas kang / bkas pa dgab pa'am dum bur gses pa'i don/ shing ni tshig phrad/ba/spyod ba/ tu ba kob las su bar/la ba'am las su spyod pa'am 'khol ba'i don/gnang bkag gnang ba ni bya rung ba dang / bkag pa ni lho mi rung ba'i don te 'dul ba'i brda/198

zan bku bkus sman gyi khu ba bku ba'am bkus ba ni 'don pa'am re byin pa'i don/gos bkab gos dang thog sogs bkab pa'am ga yogs pa'i don/ bkab ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigagazhu bkang / gzhu la mda' sbyar nas 'then pa'i don/rtsa ba bkog shing gi rtsa ba dang shog bu sogs bkog pa ni dgog pa'am bton pa'i don/ bkog ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabaka' drin/ phan btags pa'i don/bka' btags/ bka' btags pa ni khrims bsgrags la go/ bka' blo bde/ bka' blo bde ba ni chos ston gyi tshig la dga' ba'am gros ston gyi chig la dga' ba/bka' bkron/ spyo ba'am gshe gshe btang ba'i don/brgyad bkag spyo ba'am gshe ba'i don la 'jugakhon nu dbon/ 'khon du 'dzin pa la gobakyim bkag 'gro lam bkag pa'am 'gog pa'i don/ bkag ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigaza bkob / pha rol po zhum par byas pa'i don/rgyal pos bkrabs/ rgyal po sogs kyis mang po'i dkyil nas gdams pa'i don/lus bkan/ lus gan rkyal du bstan pa'am kha phyogs gyen du bstan ma la go/ba ba / bab ma/zad/ lag mthil gyen du bstan—rwa1 bshe gobakros nab / bkros pa ni 'dams pa'am gdams pa ste bshad pa'i don te phan par ga dpe1sa pa lta bu'o/ /nab/ ni chig phrad/199

bkri bkro ba ni 'khrid pa'i don te/ thar pa'i lam du bkri ba lta bu/ bkri ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigamado bzags/ sde sdod gsum las ma do sde'i sde sgod bklags pa lta bu ni klog pa'i don yin/ bklags ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigab bod ba ma/bad/ mgo bkad ni skra la go ba dang yi ge'i mgo bkad la gobags kyi bkad/ thag ba kyi sgyur ba la go ba dang / 'ur rdo lhas pa'i bkad lta bu/ba sprul ba'i ngag don med kyi skad cha ste ngag 'khyal la gon/rkang lag mi sogs kyi rkang pa dang lag pa/rka zhing / yur ba ldan pa'i zhing la rka zhing zer/rkang / rkang bzhi yod pa ltar na dud 'gro la go de bzhin du rkang gcig gam kang gnyis lta bu'i grangs brtsi skabs kyi rkang la'ang 'jugarkan/ dkan yang rung ste/ ya rkan nam kha nang gi rkan la gorkub/ mi sogs kyi lus po'i rkub tshos te/ 'phongs la gochom rkun/ rgyu nor sogs gzhan nam bdag pos mi tshor bar 'khyer mkhan la go zhing rku mkhan yang zer/rkyan/ rkyan ni chang dang ja sogs blugs sgod de/ zangs rkyan / gser rkyan/rdza rkyan lta bu/bye rkyal/ rtsam rkyal lam sman rkyal sogs te/ pags pas bzos pa'i dngos po blugs sgod la go200

sku/ ma byin par len pa la rku zer/rkong ba/ pags nad de/ pags par za phrug rgyag pa'i nad cigachig rkyang / gcig rkyang pa yi don/sa rko rkos/ sa dang par 'a sogs pa rko ba'am rkos pa ni 'dru ba'i don te/rko ba ni da lta ba ston byed dang / rkos ni skul tshig gogan rkyan/ gan kyal yang rung ste/ kha sbub min pa/rked/ ked pa ni nu ma dang dpyi gnyis kyi bar la gorkyong / lag pa sogs kyong za ni brkyang pa'i don te/ da lta ba ston byed kyi (1ba/rkon pa 'dzugs/ ༄rnyi'am rgya 'dzugs pa'i don/za mgo yur ba'am chu'i ka mgorkyal rtsed/ chu la rkyal rtsed pa'am rkyal rgyag pa'i don/ri dwags rkyang / drel 'dra ba'i ri dwags shigargyu rkyen/ nyer len gyi rgyu dang / lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen te/ ljang ba lta bu skyes par byed pa'i nyer len gyi rgyu ni sa bon nas de yin pa dang / ljang ba de skyes par rkyen gzhan zhig yod pa ni sa dang lud dang / drod bsher sogs ni lhan cig byed rkyen yin/te/smo ba grub da/ lkog gyur ni mig la sogs pa'i dbang po la mngon sum du ma gyur pa'am mngon gyur min pa la go lkog gyur gyi chos rnams rjes dpag gi rtags la brten rtog dgos/201

smod da / yog ma la gote/ba shad ba / ba lab gi ske nas sha leb 'phyang ba la lkog shal zer1 ngag glugs1 kha skugs pa ste skad cha shod mi shes pa zer/snyedaska chog ska cog zhang gsum ste/ ska ba dpal brtseb/sa dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / zhang ye shes sde bcas gsum ni bod kyi chos rgyal khri srong sde btsan skabs kyi yo tsā ba snyan grags can lin/mi / ba 21zad/ ska la pa dang ldan pa'am las 'phro can te/ bso da nams can ba / kaskar ma/ nam mkha'i rgyu skar spyi'i ming /skag skag ni rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi nang gses skag la go ba dang / rgya tshos la'ang gosku'i1 chos sogs kyi sku ste/ chos sku dang / 'ongs sku dang — sprul skru dang / ngo bo nyid sku sogs la go ba dang / lus sam phung po la zhe sa re tshig tu sku zer/skom/ skem pa ni skam pa'i don dang / skem ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigasnum skung/ snum rtsi lus la skud pa ni byug pa'i no na/skud pa/ skrud pa'i bde rnying la srad bu zer/11bab/ mgron po sogs skye'/ ba'i skul chi ba rang skre ma pa'am sprang bka — lang go skyo ma/ lde gur ma bye/ga skyag phra ma'i don/'i/ba ba / phyi sa'am me gtsang ba la gosprud/ skrud pa ni mi dran pa'am rjad pa'i ngon/ 2( 2

ska rags/ rked chings la goskyer kha/ shing skyer pa'i kha dog gam kha dog ser ka la goskya bo/ dkar po shas che ba la skya bo zer/skyu ru ra/ tsha ba'i yul du skye ba'i shing gi rigs shig yin la sman du 'groskyes bu/ gang zag la go /skyems/ btung ba nyid kyi don la go ba dang / zhal sogs lta bu/skom/ rlan rlon la go /jir/ ro skyur mo'am bro ba skyur mo la goskol/ me btang nas chu sogs skol ba la 'jugagos skon/ gos gyon du bcug pa'am g.yog pa'i don/skyen yang / ldang ba yang ba'am rtsal che ba'i don te/ ldang ba yang ba ni yar langs dus gzugs po yang ba la gojir ba/ dor ba'i don la go ste/ chu la skyur ba'am chu la 'phen pa lta bu/skyo/ sems skyo ba'am nges 'byung ngam yid 'byung skyes pa'i don/ nges 'byung ni/ ji skad du/ gang zhig srid pa'i phun tshogs la/ yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing / nyin mtshan kun tu thar pa don gnyer blo/ byung na de'i tshe nges 'byung skye ba lags/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yid 'byung yang de dang 'dra'o/ /skem byed/ skem pa po ste nyi ma dang me la go ba dang / gdon zhig tu'ang gosku / ba dra snang da/ dge ba'i las sogs la sku pa po goskor ba byed/ gnas skor ba'am mtha' skor ba'am mgo bo skor ba byed pa la go /ji rum/ zas kyi ro gsal byed de/ tshod ma zhig gi ming / 203

thi gang / mtshon gang ngam zan gang gi don/spugs pa/ kha nas mi gtsang ba'i zas skyugs pa'am zas phyir 'dom pa la goskyengs/ kha skyengs pa'am ngo tsha ba'i don/skyigs bu/ g.yig pa'i ming tsam yen/skya zab/ lus kyi me drod nyams pa las byung ba'i pags pa'i mdog skya zhing skrangs pa rbab rbab tu byung ba'i chu nad cig ste/ bad kan skya rbab sta bu/zangs pa/ sbos pa'i don te/ kang lag sogs skrangs pa lta bu/ri skyegs/ ri stegs kyang rung ste bya dang glang chen la go /bza skyar/ bya rngo/thing ril la goskya ga bya skya ga ste mngog nag cing glo dkar po can gyi bya/da/da/ sgra la go /mi'i skad dam chu'i skad lta bu1skra rjen bu/ kong bu'am kong kong gi don te slo ma lta bu la goskam pa/ 'dzi—na sprad de/ gcud gzer 'grim byed kyi skam pa lta bu'o/ /skya ba/ gru'i skya ba'am lung rigs kyi skya bar nas bton zhes pa sta bu'o/ /skyogs/ sgod gzhan la blugs byed de zhu skyogs sa ma chu skyogs lta bā/dge bskos/ dge bar sko ba po ste dgon pa'i nang gi go gnas zhig gi ming /11 zang/ zhabs bro 'khrab pa'i don/ṭa ru skyog ṭa ma ru brdung ba'i don/skud po/ chung ma'i ming po dang sring mo'i bdab po la goskyo sngogs/ 'khrug long ngam rtsod pa zhi zin pa slar slong ba'i don/snyan skyo/ rna ba bsun po byas pa'i don/zab 'jigs pa'am bred pa'i don/rgya skyegs/ shing sman gyi rigs shig ste/ ming gi rnam grangs la rgya tshos sa ma rgya 204

skag kyang zer1 skyes tshal/ skyes mos tshal te/ mis bzos pa'i ldum shing ra ba la goskyer pa/ skyer pa zhes pa shing gi rigs shigad ba / skas ka'am them skas la go 1 ske/ lus po'i ske ste mgul la zer/dgeb/ smos da/ yog ma la gochu skyegs/ kha la skrugs pa'i sngon du byung ba'i chu skyur la go skyes/ shing dang bu sogs skyes pa ni skye ba'i don yin zhing / skyes ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigaskyi g.ya'/ skyi g.ya' ba ni 'jigs snang byung ba'am skrug pa'i don/skyon/ nyes pa'am mtshang la goskyob/ ngan song lta bu'am nyen kha lta bu las skyob pa ni skyabs pa'am spung pa'i don/ skyob ni da lta ba ston byed kyi chigaskyabs 'gro/ skyabs su 'gro ba ste/ re stos 'cha' ba la goskyor/ tshig sogs yang yang bskyar ba'am ldab pa la go ste/ skyor ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshiga'atsho skyob / mas bu 'tsho zhing skyong ba lta bu ni bskyang ba'i don zhing / skyong ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigare skong / re ba skong ba ni bsam pa rdzogs par byas pa'i don/skyin gor/ dbyid de stobs skyed sman gangs sbal sogs la goskogs/ 'thums byed dam shun pa la go ste/ dper na/ yig skogs/ mar skogs lta bu/srab skyobs/ rta'i srab bam srab kyis stogs shing sgyur ba la go206

skyes bzang / rten nam rags bzang po la go rgyal gyi glugs/ rgyal 'gugs byed de rtsed mo'i rgyal 'gugs pa'i don/bya skyebs/ char mi 'bab pa'i brag skyibad dang / khang pa'i mda' yab la'ang da/lgar /kung 1 skar ma mthong ba'i thog khung ste ra ba gsal la'ang goskor tsher/ skabs rer zhes pa'i don/skyid/ bde zhing skyid pa ste/ spro ba'am skyid pa'i don/bzab / ba / mgron po sog ba skyel mkhan la goskyes chen/ skyes bu chen po'am skyes bu na / chog la go'i ba da / rten nam skyes te lag rtags sa ma phyag rten la gosred pa/ kegs sogs mthar skred btang ba'am snyil ba'i dod/ sprod ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigartsa skyoms/ chu la sobs pa spyoms pa ni g.yo bar byed pa'i don/zho spyog zho skrog pa ni zho srub pa'i don/rtsis kyi skyeb bar chad la goji li da/ ji lta ba'am 'u nga 'dren pa'i tshiga'adi ska da/ 'di ltar dang / yin skad dang / zer skad sogs kyi don/kha swong / kha tshang bar byed pam stong cha gsab pa'i don/rgabs/ tshe skabs dang go skabs dang skabs rnyed dang gnas skabs sogs dub ston byed tshigab 11pa / sa gzhi skyong ba ste rgyal po la goglur pel/ khyal ba la go ste/ rtsibs ldebs la zhal ba btang 'dug lta bu/lga ma/ ska ma pa rte rlon pa min pa'i don/206

re zan/ mna' skyel ba'i don/ska cig ska cig ma'am skad cig ma ni yun ha cang thung ba'i dus kyi ming ste/mig 'byed 'dzum gcig byed pa'i tshad dam sel gol to — / ba/ci ga gi yun tshad la god / mgo'i skra'am mgor nyal yang zer/skyes/ skyes shā1 ni shing sogs skye ba'i don la go skyes ni 'das pa ston byed (1 31ba/shing spus/ shing la sogs pa 'dru ba'am gcod pa'i don/bkab skub ba / sbas pa'i don can gyi skungs shig lta bu skul tshig la 'jugam brjed skor/ dbus kyi mtha' nas skor ba/skobs su chud/ gnas sam bar du tshud pa ste bya dka'i skobs su chud lta bu/bdab da ba / rang gi bgo skal lam thob bya/gye mched/ skye khring mched par byed pa ste/ mi ga sogs bcu gnyis ni/ mig dang / rna dang / sna dang / lce dang / 'us dang / yed bcas nang da skye mched drug dang / gzugs dang 1 sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos bcas phyi'i skye mched drug gothugs dam skong / dgongs pa rdzogs/ par byed pa'am mnyes par byed pa'i don/bya skon/ bya 'dzin byed kyi skon pa ste/ rnyi la go(1 bdam/bad/ ko ba'i phye dkar po'am ko ba mnyes ma la goskye tshe'i 'bru/ skye tshe zhes pa 'bru zhig gi ming ste/ rgya nag be kad zur chab pa yin/ 207

skyo ma snga btsan/ phu ma btsug pa'am mi mthun pa bzos pa'i dod/skyil kung / 'dug stangs kyi khyad par zhig ste/ rdo rje skyil grung lta bu/skyod/ skyod pa ni g.yo ba'am 'gro ba'i don la 'jugasku rengs/ skya mda' la gozhal skyin/ zhal ras te gdong pa la gobarka'adod la brkam pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan la brkam pa'am brkams pa de chags pa'i don/ bkam ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshibabasku bya/ ma byin ba ra blangs bya gser la sogs pa la go ba dang / brku sna ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabakus/ ma byin par gser la sogs pa'i dngos po blangs pa ste / dus 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigasra brkyab / 'dul ba'i gzhi bcu bdun las bag yangs dang 'brel ba'i gzhi ste/ gtan pa yang zer la de ni dge slong gi chos gos ma zhig pa sgam snad lta bu'i nang du brkyangs te 'jug pa la sra brkyang zhes zer/lag brkyab / lag pa brkyang ba ni kyong ba'i don/ brkyang ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig brko bya/ par dang sa sogs brko bya'i dngos po la go brko ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabakos/ brkos pa ni ko ba'i don te/ 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig308

bskabyug pa bskya bskus/ snum sogs lus la bsku ba'am bskus pa sna byug pa'i don/ bsku ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig dang / bskus ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigalag bskum bskums/ lag pa sogs bskum pa'am bskums pa ni tshur sdud pa'i don yin/ bskum ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig dang / bskums ni 'das pa ston byed kyi chig yin/'dzin 'gan dbang bskur/ 'phrin cha bskur ba'am 'gan khag bskur ba'am dbang bskur ba ste sprod pa'i don la 'jugachos la bskul/ chod sogs la bskul ba ni dge ba'i las la skul ba'i don nam byed du bcug pa'i don/nor bskyi bskyis/ gser la sogs pa bskyi ba'am bskyis pa ni g.yar ba'i don yin zhing / bskyi ba ni ma 'ongs pa dang / bskyis pa ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabaskyin pa/ skyin tshab la gobaskyal/ bskyal ba ni skyel bab ma 'phen ba 'i don la 'jug bskyal ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigagos bskon/ gos la sogs pa bskon pa'am skon pa ni g.yog pa'i don/bskon ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigarta bskyo na/ rta dang spub sogs la bskyon pa'am skyon pa ni 'jog pa'am 'jug pa'am rgyab pa'i don/ bskyon ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig20mi

bzar nas1 bskyar ba ni skyor ba'am ldab pa'am bzlas pa'i don yin te dper na/ rtsa ba'i tshig yang yang bskyar ba lta bu/ nas ni tshig phrad yin /bzad/ phyir bskrad pa ni phyir skrod pa'am 'don pa'i don/ bskrad ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig gcom skrung / nga rgyal bcag pa'am sgra chung ngur byas pa'i don yin zhing /bskyungs ni 'dor ba'i don yin la 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig yin/zas bskru/ zas bskru ba ni slong ba'i don/bskyed/ bskyed pa ni rgya skyed pa lta bu spel ba'i don la 'jug bskyed ni ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa ston byed kyi chigabaskrun/ dge rtsa dang par sogs bskrun pa'am skrun pa ni gsog pa'am bzheng ba/ pa'am bzo ba'i don/ bskru na ni ma 'ongs dang 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig yin 'das pa la da drag 'thob pa shes dbo/sa so/ /bskal rmes mtsho bshams/ dus kyi bskal pa bar bskal ngo gas kyi mes mtsho dang shing sog pa bskams pa'am skom pa'i don/ bskams ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig bskal pa che chung bar ma yi dus yun jing thung ni1mngon pa mdzod lab / mi'i tshe lo bcu pa nas bzung lo brgya rer lo re 'phel te mi'i tshe lo brgyad khri bzhi stong bar yar 'phel ba'i dus yun la bstal pa chung ba gcig dang / de nas lo brgya rer lo re 'grib ste mi'i tshe lo bcu pa'i bar mar 'grib pa'i dus yun la bskal pha chung ba gcig zer/ de la mi lo khri brgyad brgya so dgu dang dgu stong yod/ bskal pa chung ba ga nyis ka par bskal gcig zer/ de la me lo khri bye ba gci ba ngang sa la drug bdun 'bum dgu khri brgyad stong tham pa yod/ ba'i la ba chung ba brgyad cu tham pa la bsko la pa chen po gcig yen/ de la ci/ pi ci dung byur 2 1ba

drug dang bye ba bdun sa kyi pa gcig 'bum dgu khri gnyis yod/chu bskyil chu sogs kyi sna ma btang bar bskyed ba'am skyel ba ni 'khri' ba'i don/ bskyil ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabaskyams/ chu sogs bskyams pa'am skyom pa ni g.yo bar byed pa'i don yin zhing bskyams ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabaskal don/ yul lam dus sam rang bzhin gyis bka la ba ni lkog gyur ram bar du chod pa'i don yin/ yul gyi bskal ba da/ lha sa nas gzhes ka rtse lta bu lung pa de gnyis kyi bar yul gzhan gyis bar chod pa'6/ lkog tu gyur pa'i don/ dus kyi bskal ba ni/ de ring gi dus nas phyi 'o/ bar lta bu de'i bar dus gzhan gyi bar du chod pa'am lkog tu gyur pa'i don/ rang bzhin gyis bskal ba ni ngo bos bskal ba ste/ bum pa'i rang bzhin dang ka ba'i rang bzhin lta bu de gnyis ngo bo'i thog nas bar chod pa'am lkog tu gyur pa yin/bskubs shing / bskungs pa ni skung ba'am sbas pa'i don bskungs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshiga'ajigs bskyabs/ 'jigs pa bskyabs pa ni skyob pa'i de na te bskyabs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabaskyangs/ drin gyis bskyangs pa ni skyong ba'am 'tsho ba'i don/ bskyangs pa ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigam pho bskyas/ gnas gzhan du 'pho zhing bskyas pa ni bskya ba'am spo ba'i don/ bskyas pa ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigargyang bskyar/ rgyang ring du bskrur ba ni skyur ba'am 'dor ba'i don/ bskyur ni ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa ston byed kyi chig211

bya ba bskyungs/ bya ba bskyungs pha ni skrung ba'am bshol ba ste bya ba nyung ngur btang ba'i don/ bskyung ba sna 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigami bskyod/ mi ni dgag tshig dang / bskyod pa ni skyod pa'am g.yo ba'am 'gro ba'i don/ bskyod ni ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa ston byed kyi chigabaskor ba1 mtha' nas skor ba'am tshig skor ba lta bu sogs kyi den/ bskor ni ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigargyal sar bskos/ rgyal sar bskos pa ni sko ba'am bzhag pa'am byed du 'jug pa'i don/ bskos ni 'das pa ston byed kyi chigaro bska/ zas kyi ro bska ba ste/ a ru ra'i ro lta bu dang / bska sla'i bska ba ste gar ma la gokha bshar 1 kha bskang pa ni kha skong ba'am tshang bar byed pa'i don/ bskang ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigathugs dam bskangs/ dgongs pa skong ba'am rdzogs par byed pa'i don/bskangs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigasems bskyed/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa lta bu'i sems bskyed pa'am skyed pa/ bskyed ni ma 'ongs pa dang / 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigargya bskyed/ rgya khyon bskyed pa ste cher btang ba'i don/brjed pa'i sgyu da/ dran pa med par brjed pa'i don can gyi bskrud pa'am skrud pa/ bskyud ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs ston byed kyi tshig/bdaka bsgyur ba/ go cha'am mtshon skyob byed la go217

khri phrag grangs gnas shig ste stong phug bcu/khrag khrig grangs gnas drug cu'i nang gses kyi gnas gcig gi ming ste/'ther 'bum che ba bcu la khrug khrig gcig zer/khur/ las 'gan sogs khur ba ni 'khur ba'am 'khyer ba'i don/ khur di 'das pa dang skul tshig ston pa'i tshigakhong khro/ khong nas khro ba ste zhe sdang ba'i don/khon 'dzin/ khon tu 'dzin pa ste gnod sems 'chang ba'i don/khro po/ khro ba po ste drag po'i rnam 'gyur can la gokhros/ khro ba'i 'das pa dang skul tshig ston byed kyi tshigakhro dang khrol tshags/ khro ma dang khrol ma'am tshags ma ni bye ma dang rdo sogs tshags byed kyi yo byad la gokhyed/ khrud pa ni gos sogs chu la 'khrud pa'i ming tsam yin/khu bas khyes/ khu ba la sogs pas 'khru ba'i ming dang / 'das pa dang skul tshig ston byed la 'jugakhong/ khong pa tsho'am khong du chud pa la 'jugakhro khong nas sam zhe nas khro ba'am sdang ba'i don/khon 'dzin/ khon du 'dzin pa 'i mi mthun par 'dzin pa' bya/ gnod sems mi gtong ba'i don/khro po/ zhi ba min pa'i khro ba po ste drag po'i rnam 'gyur can la gokhros/ khros ni sdang ba'i don te 'das pa dang skul tshig ston byed kyi tshigakhong /zag khog nang gi zungs khrug la gokhrag khrug khrug nad dam khrug 'khrugs pa'i don/khyeb khrung / bya'i bye brag zhib yin/ ming gi rnam grangs la skya/grin ring dang / 213

mjub nag yang zer/byu/ rigs mthun pa'i tshogs la gochul khrims/ nyes spyod sdom pa sogs kyi tshul dang mthun pa'i khrims bsil ba 'thob pa'am mi dge ba bcu yi nyes spyod thongs pa la gokhris 'jabs/ chings byas pa ltar gnas pa'i don/khrims/ lha chos sam mi chos dang mthun pa'i lugs la khrims zer /khral/ dpya la go tshong la sogs pa'i khrul lta bu/khru gang / 'jal byed kyi tshad de/ ngo ra mo nyer shu rtsa bzhi la khru gang zer/khrun ring / dkyus ring po'i don/khram /ba / ri mo'i khyad par te/ sha sob/sa la khram kha rgyag pa lta bu/bza/ khru bo ste kha dog sna tshogs yod pa la gokhrom/ mi nu nga po dang zog—mang po tshogs pa'i gan la khrom zer/khrod/ gseb bam dkyil la go ste ri yi gseb la gnas pa la ri khrod dang /nags lta spru'i dkyil la nags khrod zer/khri'i steb / gdan khre'i steng lta bu/ sprir khri ni khru gang las mtho ba'i stan la khri zer/bang / gtsug lag khang lta bu ni sde sgod gsu ma 'jog sgyu 'i bang pa la go ba dang / de bzhin chang khang dang za khang lta bu sogs la 'jugakhyim/ mi/ sdod sa'i khang pa sogs ming /khyams/ sgo dang 'khor gyi khyams te bar khyams lta bu/bya /za/ phug ron sogs gsod byed bya'i khyad par khru/ khyis khye ra/ khyis sha sogs khyer ba lta bu/ khyer zhe 'das pa dang / skul chig ston byed kyi chig214

khror ba/ snyim pa gang la khyor ba do'i tshad byed pa lta bu/ snyim pa ni lag pa'i khyor ba gnyis kha sbyar nas byung ba'i tshad/khre/ khre ni 'bru'i bye brag ste/ son btab nas nyin zhag drug cu song mtshams smin thub pa'i 'bru zhigakho ra khor yug mtha' skor la go ste/ pho brang sogs kyi kho ra khor yug lta bu/khron chu/ kan pa'i chu ka gokhrems/ chu sogs thim ba dang 'grems pa'i skul tshig sil khrol/ lcags kyi rol mo la gokhams gsum/ 'dod khams dang / gzugs khams dang / gzub/sa med kyi khams rnam pa gsum ste/ 'dod mas ni/ 'dod pa'i khams 'di'i sems can rnams ni kham zas dang / 'khrig pa la 'dod chags dang bcas shib / 'dod yon lngas 'tsho ba'i phyir dang / sgod kyang 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i sems can gyi gnas yin pas de ltar brjod/ gzugs khams ni/ ri rab kyi steng gi bar snang la gnas bcas pa'i bsam gtan dang po nas bzhi pa'i bar gyi gnas ris rnams te/ dwangs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od lus dang ldan pa dang / 'dod pa las 'dod chags dang bra'/ zhing gzugs la 'dod chabs dang bcas pa'o/ gzugs med khams ni/ nam mkha' mtha' yas nas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi skye mched mu bzhi ste de dag la yib gzugs dwangs pa tsam las rags gzugs med la 'dod chags dang bcas pa'o/ 1khram pa/ ham pa'am rdzun smra mkhan la gokhrem/ khrel ba ni gzhun la stos nas bya ba ngan pa 'dzem pa la zer/215

dur khrod/ ro bzhi yan skyel sa la dur khrod zer/sna khrid/ (kam gyi sna khrid pa'am lam mkhan la gokhyems stod smad/ khrums stod dang khrums smad ni rgyu skar zhig gi ming /khro gnyer/ khong khro ba'i gnyer ma—khu ta/ 'dab chags kyi rigs shigamakhamakhan po/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang las kyi mkhad po la go /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po ni/ gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa/ 'dul ba'i sde sgod las bshad pa'i cho ga la mkhas pa/ nad pa sogs sems can mgon med pa la snying rje khyad par can ldan pa ste khyad chos gsum ldan gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen no/ las kyi mkhan po ni lcags bzo mkhan dang / shing bzo mkhan dang / rdo bzo mkhan lta bu'o/sa mkhar/ sa las byas pa'i mkhar rdzong /mkhrang / mdang ba ni gyong po'am grims pa ste/ mkhregs po'i don/mkhregs/ mkhregs pa ni sra ba'i don/mkhyen/ mkhyen pa ni shes pa'i zhe sa/mkhud spyad/ mkhyud pa'am srus nas spyad pa ste/ gsang ba'i man ngag la godape mkhyad/ dpe cha mkhyud pa ste ser snas chos kyi gnad mi ston pa la go'u mkhan/ skad cha 'dri mkhan nam tshos dngan la gomatsha/ nyer bar mkho ba ste dgos pa'i don/ba da /bab / ma mgal lam ma le la go216

mkhal ma/ lus po'i nang khrol zhig gi ming /mkhur 'dzum/ bzhin gyi mkhur tshos 'dzu pa ste/ da'i la ba'am gad mo bgad pa'i don/mkhas/ mkhas pa ste/ shes bya la mkhas pa'am dran dbang ma gomakhan khrod/ sngo'am rtswa mkhan ba'i khrod 'a zer/mkhos phab1 mkhos ba pa ni sems bde bar gnas pa'i don1snga mkho bzhin/ jir bzhin nam sngar ltar zhes pa'i don/mkha' mnyam/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste dper na/ mkhyen rgya nam mkha' dang mnyam pa lta bu/ nam mkha' la rgyu kar gyi lam yang zer/mkhris nad/ mkhris pa'i nad de/ lus kyi drod khams rgyas po'i tsha ba'i nad la nyes pa'i mkhris pa dang 1 mchin 'dabs mkhris thum skyon du grur pa'i mkhris pa gnyis/med par mkhyen/ med pa ni yod pa'i ldog phyogs dang / mkhyen pa ni shes pa'i zhe sa'i tshigachu mkhris/ rta gdong gi me ste1 sto phyogs rgya mtsho'i nang yod pa'i rgod ma'i me la go / de ma rdo rje'i ri yang zer/mkhrig ma/ lag mgo dang lag ngar gnyis kyi bar du 'brel ba'i tshigs 'a go'akhablo 'khums/ blo 'khums pa ni sems zhum pa'am skrag pa'i don/zhe 'khon/ zhe nas 'khon pa'am bkon pa ste/ sems gting nas 'khon du 'dzin pa'i don/217

'khab zhing / 'khang ba ni sdang ba'am mi dga' ba byed pa'i don te/dper na/ rang gis nor kung gzhan la 'khang ba lta bu/ zhing ni chig phrad/'khu/ 'khu ba ni sdang ba 'a/ ser sna'i don/ma khu nab / 'jigs pa'am 'khyag pa ni grang ba'i don/ nas ni tshig phrad /mtham /rdo khob/ yul mtha— 8 'khob ste/ dam chos sogs med pa'i gnas sam sa cha la go'akhyar zhing / 'khyar ba ni 'khyams pa'am zhig pa'am 'chi ba'i don/ zhing ni tshig phrad/'khyams/ 'khyams pa ni 'phyan pa'i don te/ lu/sa dang sems gang sar 'khyams pa lta bu/ 'khyams ni 'das pa stom/ byed kyi tshigaza/ba bad/ ba ba / rgas pa la go ba'i 'khogs ni na tshod lon song ba'i don/'dabs ba / 'kho sa ka chung ba sna rdus pa chung ba'i don/rkab— 6'di kum/ rkang pa sogs 'khum pa ni rang bzhin gyis skum pa'am 'du ba'i ngon/ba—khrog 'khyog pa ni drang po min shā1'i don/'khror / goms 1— kags 'khyor ba ni mi brtan pa'i don/'khyom/ chu la sogs bstsom pa sto g.yo ba'i don1ma khar ba/ 'khar ba ni lag rten nam 'khar rgyug la bo ba dang / nge bzhi na du chu btung sna da dang / sgod kyi mthil du zab tshig nga lta sprur rgo ba'i bar / yab gu ma sogs 'khril ba ni sbyor bar byed pa'i ngon ba4 go'akhyodas/ shing la 'khris pa'am sprur brje dam chags zin pa la go218

'khud/ / lus la 'khyud pa lta bu sbyor ba'i don/'khrig tshig 'dod pa'i dga' ston gyi tshig la go ba dang / 'khrig ni sprin 'khrig lta bu ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig la go /bag 'khyal/ ngag gam gtam 'khyal ba ni bkyal ba'am 'chal ba'i don/'bab 'khyeg 'thab pa dang 'khrugs pa ni don gcig yin zhing gong 'og 'khrug pa sogs la yang go'akhyel/ 'khrul pa ni nor ba'am g.yo ba'i don la 'jugam khri ba/ shing sogs la 'khri ba'am chags zhen la go'akhye/ 'khru ba ni chu sogs kyis bkru ba'am bshal ba'i don/'khrud/ chus gos sogs 'khrud pa la go'akhri shib / gzhan la 'khri zhing sbyor bar byed pa'i shing ste/ me tog thag 'khyud lta bu'i shing la go/'khyengs/ 'khrungs pa ni skyes pa'i zhe sa'i tshigagadugs 'khyir/ nyi gdugs sogs 'khyir ba ni 'khor ba'i don/ka 'khub/ zhabs bro 'khrub pa'am bro rdung ba'am skrab pa'i don/'khar za 'khrol/ 'khar ba'i rnga 'khrom ba ni dkrol ba'am rdung ba'i don/ 'khar rnga ni ri ste zangs gtso bor byas pa'i lcags rigs 'dres mas bzos pa'i rnga la zer/sems 'khol/ sems chu ltar 'khol ba ni shes pa rnal du mi gnas pa'am tshugs mi zin pa la ra/sems 'khyegs/ sems la sogs pa 'khrugs pa ni 'dzings spya/'i don/'khug po/ mgyogs po dang / mig sngar 'bab pa'am mthun par gokhur 'khur1 khur po 'khur ba ni rdog khris 'khur ba'i don/ 'khur ni da 219

lha ba dang ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi chigakhral ba khri/ dpya khrul 'khri ba'am dpya khrul phog pa'i don/'od 'khyims nyi 'od sogs 'khyims pa ni nyi 'od sogs skor ba'i don/ma khyil1 chu sogs 'khyil ba ni skyil ba'i don/'khor ba/ rang nyid skor mkhan med par 'khor ba ste srid pa sogs mang po la 'jug ste/ srid pa 'khor ba ni sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs ma 'thob kyi bar du lus sems gnyis rigs drug gi sems can la rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba la zer/ de bzhin du ma ṇi lta bu thog mar gzhan gyis skor kyang rjes su rang ngang gis 'khor ba lta bur go'akhren pa/ chags shing zhen pa'i don te/ rgyu nor la 'khren pa lta bu/snyed bas shing / 'khras pa ni chags pa'i don/ shing ni tshig phrad do/ /'khar/ 'khang ba ni zhen pa'i don te/ 'khren pa dang 'khrus ‘4 dang 'khar ba bcas gsum don 'dra ba yin/ma 'ji / ga thag pa sogs kyis ma 'khyig pa ni ma 'ching ba'i don/ ma 'khyig cig rto bu skul tshig la 'jugam 'khyer/ ma 'khur ba'i don/ lham 'khur/ snum du btsos pa'i 'khur ba ste bzhes spro la go'akhur/ 'khur ba ni 'khyer ba'i don/ma 'khyur/ las sne sogs ma 'khyur ba ni ma bskyur ba'am ma brjes pa'i don/pred 'khrims/ bred pa'i 'khrims pa ni 'jigs pa'i don/'bams 'ing / 'khams pa ni dran med du rgyal ba'i don/ shing ni tshig 220

zad/'khun/ nad sogs kyis ngag 'khun pa'am 'khun po'i sgra thon pa ni mi bzod pa'i sgra lta bu/'khor lo 'khod kyang / gser sogs kyi 'khor lo 'khod pa ni bkod pa'am gnas pa'i don/ kyang ni rgyan sdud kyi phrad/'khor bcas/ ga rtsa bo'am rgyal po lta bu la g.yog po'i 'khor dang bzus pa'o zhes pa'i don/'khobs/ 'khobs pa ni khyab pa'am rgya che ba'i don/g.yog rtu 'khul/ g.yog tu 'khul ba ni ma bskul bar g.yog las byed pa'i don/'khol/ g.yog tu 'khol ba ni g.yog tu bkol ba'i don/srad bu 'khal/ skud pa 'khal ba'am bkal ba'i don/'khra sar ma 'khrol/ chags pa'i sar ma 'khyol ba'am ma bskyal ba'am ma son pa'i don/'khrid pa/ lam sogs (ka 'khrid pa ni bkri bar byed pa'i don/'khums/ 'khums pa ni don la sogs pa go ba'am shes pa'am thos pa'i dod/rus kyi 'khon/ rus kyi bye brag sa skya'i gdung la 'khon ces pa'ang mi mthun pa'i don yin/ 'khon rigs ni/ sa skya pa'i gdung rabs kyi rus ming ste/ gnas lha'i rgyud pa g.yang spangs skyes kyis srin po skya rengs khrug med btul nas de'i chung ma g.ya' 'brug si li ma khab tu bzhes pa las sras shig 'khrungs pa srin po dang 'khon pa'i bar du skyes pas 'khon zhes grags/ de nas bzung gdung rgyud la 'khon rigs zer/221

gagrub mas 'a/ grub pa'i mtha'am dpyad pa'i mtha' ste chos lugs kyi lta ba la gogrub thob/ grub pa thob pa ste/ lam rtogs khyad par can mngon du brnyes te mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i gang zab/ la gograngs med/ grangs ka med pa'am yang na grangs gnas shig ste/ grangs gnas drug cu'i mtha' ma grangs med yin/ de bzhin du grangs thebs mi nus pa'i den la'ang 'jugagrol/ 'khor ba lta bu las grol ba ni 'khor ba las thar pa'i don dang /mdud pa lta bu grol ba ni mdud pa zhig pa'i don/ral gri/ mtshon cha'i khyad par la go ste/ gna' rabs kyi 'thab mo byed pa'i lag cha zhigagro ga sheng stag pa'i shun pa la gogril/ shog bu gril ba'am rbab sogs rang bzhin gyis gril ba ste ril ba'i don/grag zhes grag gam grag lo'am grag zer lta bu'i grag la gogrul bum/ gdon zhig ste/ rgya mtsho'i nang du gnas pa'i gnod sbyin gzugs mi'i dbyibs dang 'dra la/ mgo bo srog chags sna tshogs kyi mgo can/ rkang lag gi gru mo dang rna ba'i steng du sha'i ral pa yod pa zhigagrang nad/ grang ba'i nad ni/ lus kyi sa chu'i khams 'phel ba las byung ba'i nad cig la go222

grum bu/ nad cig gi ming ste/ rlan can gyi yul du rgyun ring sdod pa sogs kyis rkyen byas nas tshigaX mig gi chu ser 'phel nas bad kan 'byor byed kyi byed las nyams pas tshig kun chag grum shor ba ltar na ba la zer/grongs/ grongs pa ni shi ba'i don la 'jug mon gru dang nam gru dab spe dab gro bzhin/ 'di bzhi ni nam rngo kha'i rgyu skar gyi bye brag yin no/ /chos grwa chos grwa ni chos ra la go ba dang / grwa zhes pa sde dang zur gyi don yin la 'jug yul mang du yob de/ bla'i grwa bzo grwa chos gos kyi grwaslob grwa grwa pa lta bu sogs ba/ 'jugagral du/ gral ni bang jim du gorim gro/ bskur bsti da nga / zhabs brtan nam sku rim la sogs pa'i ming /grabs/ sta gon nam gra sgrig ste/ dngos gzhi min pa la godzo dab gru/ yul khyon nam lu ba4 la gogru bzhi/ zur bzhi yod pa la gogru kha'i grong gzings kyi kha na'am 'gram na yod pa'i grong ngam khang pa'i tshogs la gogra ma/ shing gra ma ste/ tsher ma can gyi shing rigs shigaspu gri/ spu ga rtsad pa'i gri ste/ ha cang non po yod pa'i don/gru 'dzin ri/ po ta la'i ri ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams sam sgrol ma'i /nas ri/spyad na bsnyed/mad lgam / sngo sman zhig11/ 'bru'i bye brag223

sbang glum/ chang ma btsags gong gi sbang ma'i glum la gogra 'u ba/ snye ma'i gra ma dang sog ma'i phub ma la gogro ma/ spang sogs la skyes pe'i rtswa zhig ste/ rgya gro ma lta bu sogs /mon sran gre'u/ mon yul nas thon pa'i sran ma'i bye bragagrod pa/ gsus pa'am sto ba la gogron can/ gron 'gro can te/ thugs gron dang / snag shog gron du zad lta bu 'gro song ngam chud zos pa'i rdon/grung / grung po ni spung po'i don dang / sa bon grung po'i don/grims/ sku dang rig pa sogs grims pa ni mi lhod pa'i don dang / grin rjes shig lta bu skul tshig kyang yin/gram pa/ chu'i rgyugs shul la gochu grob/ chu grang mo'i nang rtsam pa zhad tsam btab nas mkhris rwa cha ba'i nad la phan par byed pa'i skom gyi bye brag de bzhin chu re gram kyi grog rong g.yang sa la'ang gogre ba/ mgur ram mid pa'i don/11ma ba / grogs po'am rogs sam zla bo gogrib ma/ shing gi grib ma la sogs par gogros gleng / bya ba legs nyes kyi gros byed pa'am gleng ba'am bshad pa'i don/re gron med/ re ba gron du med pa ni re ba chud mi za ba'i don/za rtsi/ ri dwags gla ba'i lte bar yod pa'i rtsi ste sman la 'gro/za jan/ gla ni las byas pa'i rngan pa la zer/glud ltar/ glud ni lus tshab la go ste/ mi glud/ phyugs glud lta ka/ ltar 224

ni mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra/glen/ glen pa ni blang dor gyi gnas mi shes mkhan la go'adzam gling / da zur chags pa ste/ 'dzam bu'i shing yod pa'i gling la zer/glegs bam/ dpe cha sogs khregs ma'i bam po snye po te 'a gogling bu/ rgya gling dang / 'phred gling la sogs pa spyi'i ming /glu/ gzhas la go ba'i thu ste/ rdo rje'i spu lta bu ni bde stong gi nyams snang brjod byar ston pa'i spu'o/ /pho glab / glang thams pho bar babs pa zhigazab shu/ pags nad zhigablog pa'i nad/ bas bldag glog pa zhes pa'i nad de pags nad zhigablo ba/ glo ba ni khog pa'i nang khrol zhig dang / glo ba dga' ba ni yid dga' ba'i don blog 'gog lud ku 'gog pa'am bkog pa'i don/meb mor glebs/ dbyibs leb mor glebs pa ni leb leb bzo ba'am mnan pa'i don/glang chen/ glang po che ste lag ldan dang gnyis 'thung yang zer/blos phab/ glo yis phab pa ste/ gzhogs phab pa ni bde bar gnas pa'i don/ —klod nas/ glod pa ni/ stod po byed pa'am bkrol ba'am btang ba'i don/glab / seng ge glal ba lta bu ni seng ge rnam bsgyings dang kha g.yal ba'am spung chad nas gnyid bro bas glal ba/ yang na rkang lag rkyang shad byed 226

‘ la goblo 'bur/ rtsig pa'am gyang nas zur du 'bur ba'i khang pa'am rtsig pa la bka/slo bur/ nges med dam 'bral du rung ba'i don/ klo jeg mgyogs pa'am glo bur gyi don/blog nam mkha'i glog lta bu rnam gsal lam skad cig 'od kyang zer/ glag ched/ skabs rnyed pa'am skabs 4ba pa'i ngon/lan glan/ bzang ngan gyi lan glan pa ni 'jal ba'i don/lha zad pa glan/ gos kyi lhan pa glan pa ni lhan pa dgab pa'i don sgo chegs/ khang pa 'i spru 'phar la gochos rgos kyi spegs bu'i grwa ches rgas kyi gling gru bkar bca za rngo/'i grwa la zer /gla zar chod ba/ shing sman zhigamadun ma gleng / gtan gye mdun ma sogs gleng ba ni/ gros byed pa'am bshad pa'i don/ —bya glag bya'i khyad ngar glag ces pa 'di lu gu so pa /sa ba/sod mkhan/11bka da / srog chags per ga med la gogrib/ mi gtsang ba'i ngon/grib gnon/ lab pa lha rjeng /bza bzhan/ ste ga nyid khug na 'jibs kag skye ba'i 'khrul snang gi rmi lam ste sngar gad/ na zhig gis byas par jos re dzin pa/grog po/ ri sul la sob/ka/ par gobyu16ched/ lag pa'i gru mo la go2nyu6

ga grum grubs/ dkar yom chag cing grum pa ni dgrum pa'i don grubs zhes snang yang dpyad don grub yin nas med/dngos grub/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang / mchog gi dngos grub tsha bu/zun mong gi dngos grub ni/ rdzas sngags kyi sbyor ba la brten nas snyi pa dang nang pa thun mong du thob pa'i 'bras bu/ thun mong gi dngos grub la brgyad yod de/ ril bu dang / mig sman dang / sa 'og dang / ram gri dang /nam mkhar 'phur dang / mi snang za dang / 'che ba med pa dang / nad 'joms pa bcas so/ mchog gi dngos grub ni/ bla na med pa'i dngos grub ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub la gogru ra 'bebs pa/ char pa 'beb pa'am 'bab pa'i don/grags/ 'jigs rten na grags pa ni khyab ba'i don—sha ba'i tsā dor/ ri dwags sha ba'i kag rā sogs la 'jug pa'i grwa dor ni da la godagadage bsnyen sna gcig spyod pa sogs kyi dge bsnyen te/ so thar ris bdun gyi nang gses/ bslab pa'i gzhi lnga bsrung bar khas len pa'i khyim na gnas pa'i skyes bu/ so thar ris bdun ni/ dge slong pha ma gnyis/ dge tshul pha ma gnyis/ dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis/ dge slob ma bcas bdun no/ bslab pa'i gzhi lnga ni/ srog gcod pa/ ma byin pa len pa/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa/ chang 'thung bcas lnga spangs dgos pa la zer/221

dge tshul/ spang bya bcu spong ba'i dke tshul pha ma ste/ so thar ris bdun gyi nang gses dang / bslab pa'i gzhi bcu spung bar khas len pa'i rab tu byung ba'i skyes bu la go/ bslab pa'i gzhi bcu ni/ glu gar dang rol mo dang rtsed mo'i rig byed gsum dang / phreng ba dang / spos byug pa dang /rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba bcas rgyan gyi rig byed gsum dang / rin po che rgyu bzang po la byas pa ni chen po dang / khru gang yan longs pa ni mthon po dang / phyi dro'i kha zas dang / gser dngul len pa spong ba ste bcu'o/ /dga' dgyes/ sems dga' ba'i zhe sa'i brda la thugs dgyes pa zer/dgod/ dgod pa ni gad mo shor ba'i don/dgung sngon/ gnam sbon po la godagu mi rje gab / gnam gyi ska rags/dgye zhing / dgye ba ni lus rgyab phyogs su dgye ba'am rgyab tu phyogs pa'i don/ zhing ni chig phrad yin/dgu/ shing sogs mdun du dgu ba ni mdun du gug pa'i don/nyin dgub / nyin mo'i dgung dang mtshan mo'i dgung ni dkyil lam phyed kyi don/dge bshes/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen te dge ba'i grogs ngo la goyod dgu bkug yod do cog gam yod tshad dgug pa'am bkug pa/dge spyong / sangs rgyas lta bu ste/ nyon mongs 'joms pa dang / 'khor ba'i ngal ba zhi bar byed pa'i dge chos so thar gyi sdom khrims lhar len ༄ gyis sbyong bar byed mkhan spur 'dod rab byung dge chul slong pho mo spyi'i ming /228

dge 'dun/ dge slong bzhi las mi nyung ba'i tshogs sam thugs dge ba'i 'dun pa las nam yang mi bral bas dge 'dun zer1dgu/ grangs dgu la godagra bcom/ nyon mongs sogs gnod byed kyi dgra bo bcom pa'am med pa bzos pa/dgobs/ dgongs pa ni bsam pa'am bzhed pa la godagrol/ bla ma ma sogs pa'i dgongs pa'i don dgrol ba ni bkrol ba'am bkul ba ste go sla bar byas pa'i don/yi ger dgod/ 'o rgyus sogs yi ger 'god pa ni yi ger bkod pa'i don/dgag sgrub/ mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa ni sun 'byin pa'i don dang /'did pa'i cha sgrab pa/༄snod dgang / chu la sogs pas sgod dgang ba ni bkang ba'i don/ dgang ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi chigadagon pa/ grong las rgyang grags gcig gis chod pa'i dpen gnas sam dge 'dun gnas sa la godabar/ logs su dgar ba ni logs su bkar ba'i don/ dgar ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigadago ba/ ri dwags dgo ba la gopha ba dgo dgo me med du ba ste khrag gcod kyi sman/dgas/ dkar yol sogs dgas pa ni bkas pa'i don/khal dgal/ rta sogs la khal dgal ba ni khal bkal ba'i don/ dgal ba ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig22mi

lha na ba dgab/ gos kyi lhan pa dgab pa ni bkab pa'i don/ dgab ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigadagog shing sogs dgog pa ni bkog pa'i rngon/ dgog ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigaskye dgu 'gro— ba sems can thams cad de/ 'dod pa'i khams las tshe 'phos te khams bsum du skye ba gsum/ gzugs khams las tshe 'phos te kham gsum du skye ba gsum/ gzugs med khams las tshe 'phos te khams gsum du skye ba gsum la zer/dge legs/ dge ba legs pa'i don/dge skub/ bde ba 'byin byed kyi dge ba sgrub pa'am bzang po'i las sgrub pa 'a— bodadagob / dgos pa ste nyer mkho la godagobs mo/ phyi dro'i don/jong dgram/ brtsang bya'i dngos po smar min te dngos po mkho med spus zhan dgram pa ni bkram pa'i don/ dgram ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigadagun dung can du/ chu med pa'i gnas nyid du zhes pa'i don/dgun ka sdod/ dus dgun ka'am dgun kha sdod pa/ bdaka ) ba dab / gnam lo la gobab/bka' bgro bka' bgro ba ni gros byas pa'i rdon/bgro gleng / bgro shi'i gtam gleng ba'am 'chad pa'i don/23(1

bgyi/ bgyi ba ni bya ba'i don/bgyis1 bgyis pa ni byas pa'i don/ gyis shig ni byos shig ces pa'i don no/ /go bkos/ go cha lus la gyon pa'i don/bgegs/ bar chad la gobagrod lam/ 'gro ba'i 'am/bgags/ lam sogs bgags pa ni bkag pa'i don/dus 'gyabs/ dus tshod 'gyangs pa ni phyi stur byas pa'i don/tshod bgam/ tshod bgam pa ni nyams tshod len pa'i don/bgo ba/ dngos po sogs bgo bsha' byas pa'i don/bgos/ gos bgos pa ni gos gyon zin pa'i don/bgres po/ sku bgres po'am bgres pa ni rgan pa'i don/mig bgrad1 mig gnyis bgrad pa ste/ bsgrad pa'am gdangs pa'i don/bgrab preb / bgrang bya'am brtsi bya'i phreng ba/bgrangs/ bgrangs pa ni brtsis pa'i don/bgrus pa'i 'bras/ shun pa'am sbun pa phud pa'i 'bras/bgos/ bgos pa ni bgo bsha' byas pa'i don/gad mo bgad/ gad mo'am ga zha bgad pa ni dgod pa'i don/gom pa bgoms/ rkang pa'i gom pa bgoms pa ni 'gom pa'am gom pa ste spos pa'i don/ bgoms ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig /rnyog ma bgrubs/ chu rnyeg ma dngas bar byas pa'i don/bgo da ba / bgo bya'i skal ba ste rang sgal la go231

mgamago lus ro/gas kyi mgo ba ste/ yan lag mchog gam ga rtsa bo'i don/mgur/ mgur ba ni mgrin pa dang gsung mgur sogs la gomagul/ mgul ba ni lus kyi ske la gom grin/ mgrin pa ni gre ba'am mgur ba la goming/ / mgar ba ni sgyu bzo ba dang / blun po mgar ba lta bu'i rus mgon/ mgon po ni skyob byed la go ste/ nad kyi mgon po em rje lta bu/mgu/ sems mgu ba ni dga' ba'am yi rangs ba'i don/mgal dum/ shing tshig dum la gomagal me/ mag me'i 'khor lo ste/ shing dum mer bsregs nga'i me bskor nas snang ba'i 'khor lo'i dbyibs la go/ dper na mgo bo mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar dkar ba lta bu/ gtor mgron/ gtor ma sogs kyi mgron po ste/ gtor ma ba bul sa'i yul ra go ba dang / mgron po la gsar 'ongs kyang zer/ma sgogs/ mgyogs pa ri myur ba'i don/sa ba ban ba/ ya le la gob che ba / ba/ ma le la go'aga'agro 'gro ba ni spyon pa'i don1 232

'greng / 'greng ba ni langs pa'i don/ma grim/ rgyal khams 'grim pa ste 'gro ba'am myul ba'i don/'grul/ 'grul ba ni lam du 'gro ba'am bskyod pa'i don dang / 'grul pa ste lam du 'grul bzhud byed mkhan gyi spyi ming du'ang go'agyib / 'gying pa ni sgying pa'am 'gying bag gi rnam 'gyur te che nyams ston pa'i don/'gros 'gran/ 'gros ni 'gro tshul la go ba dang / 'gran pa ni sdur ba'i don te/ rta'i 'gros 'gran pa lta bu/ 'grabs/ 'grangs pa ni gang ba'am khengs pa'i don te/ zas kyis sto ba 'grangs ba lta bu/'gengs/ 'gengs pa ni bkang ba'i don te/ sdod nang chu 'gengs lta bu/'gengs ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshiga'agab lam sogs 'gag pa ni bkag pa'i don/'dag 'gog pa bkag pa'i don dang / 'gog ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshiga'agog bden nam nyan thos 'gog pa lta bu/'gags/ 'gags pa ni bkag pa'i don/ 'gas/ dum bur 'gas pa ni bkas pa'i don/ de bzhin du 'gas ni 'ga' zhig gis zhes pa'i don la'ang 'juga'agrib 'grib pa ni/ mi snang ba'am sgrib pa'i don/'gor/ 'gor ba ni yun ring thogs pa'i don/ 'gyes/ 'gyes pa ni so sor 'gyes pa ste/ kha 'bral ba'am gros ba'i don/'grogs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang lhan cig 'grogs pa'am sdeb pa ni 233

snyen pa'i don/dgongs 'grel/ thon mi la sogs pa'i dgongs ‘ 'grel ba ni bkral ba'am go bde bar byas pa'i don/'grol/ bcings pa sogs las 'grol ba ni bkrol ba'i don/ 'grol ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigab1 'gyel ba ni shing sogs rang bzhin gyis sa la 'phyeb/ ba'i ngon dang / bya byed spu mi dad pa'i bya tshig yin/ skyel ka dbril ba'i don te bya byed tha dad pa'i bya tshig yin/'gril/ rdo sogs bab tu rang— bzhin gyis 'gril ba ste lhung ba'i don dang / shog bu sogs rang bzhin gyis 'gril ba ste ril bor dgril ba'i don/ 'gril ni bya byed spu mi dad pa'i bya tshig yin/ sgril ba ni gzhan gyis ril bor bzos pa'am 'thum pa'i don te bya byed tha dad pa'i bya tshig go'agrobs/ 'grongs pa ni 'chi ba'i don te/ mi sogs 'grongs pa'am sgyu ra me 'grongs pa lta bu/'gum/ 'gum pa yang 'chi ba'i don la go/ma gal/ 'gal ba ni mi mthun pa ste/ tha dad gang zhig gzhe mthun mi srid pa la go'agras/ zhe 'gras pa ni zhe sdang ba'am mi dga' ba'i don la go' spyod/ 'gyod pa ste/ sngar byas la 'gyod pa skyes pa sto bu sprus su sems gdung ba'i don/'grol sar/ dben pa'i sar ram kha khu sim po'i gnas la gom rdo gra / 'gram pa ste gdong gi 'gram pa'am ldan pa la go'agul/ 'gul ba ni g.yo ba'i don/234

nor 'bye 'gyed/ nor rdzas 'gye ba'am 'gyed pa ni gtong ba'am sbyin pa'i don/'ban 'khur/ las ka'i 'gan 'khur ba lta bu ni khur 'khur ba'i don/'gong po/ gdon rigs shiga'ago nad/ gzhan la 'go ba'i nad de cham pa sogs/ma rdo ldan ba / 'gos pa ni rang gi nad sogs gzhan la 'gos pa'am sbags pa'am 'byar ba lta bu/'phel 'grib/ 'phel ba ni gong du 'phel ba'am rgyas pa'i don dang / 'grib pa ni nyams pa'am rgud pa'i don/'gyur/ 'gyur ba ni mi brtan pa'i don nam skad 'gyur ba sogs/'gyus/ 'gyus pa ni rgyas pa dang sems 'gyu ba'i don te/ glog dad 'gyus pa'am 'gyu ba ni glog 'od 'phro ba'am rgyas pa'i don/ sems 'gyu ba'am 'gyus pa ni sems mi brtan pa'i don/ mi 'gong / mi 'gong ba ni mi skrag pa'am mi zhum pa'am zil spyis mi gnon pa'i don/ba ma ma rdo gron/ lam gyi 'gron po ste 'grul pa la go 'gron po'am mgron po gang yang rung ngo / /ma ga 'a/ 'ga' zhig gam 'ga' re'am kha cig ste/ 'ga' shas zer ba'i don/'gugs/ lcang ma'i yal ga sogs 'gugs rwa ni bkug pa'i rdon/ 'gugs ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigartsig 'gram/ rtsig pa'i 'gram ni rtsib pa'i gzhi'am rtsib rmang la go ba dang / 'gram ni chu 'gram lta bu chu'i nye 'khor la'ang go235

'grod/ dus deb sogs la 'god pa ni bkod pa'am 'bri ba'i don dang 1khri sogs la 'god pa ni bkod pa'am 'jog pa'i don/ 'god ni—da snye ba ston byed kyi tshigabartsor 'grus/ brtson cing 'grus pa ste dge ba'i las — 'bad pa la zer/'go ma/ thog ma'i don/chu 'grems/ chu bkram pa'i don te1 'grems ni ga lta ba sto na byed kyi (1ba/'grub / don sogs 'grub pa ni grub shā 'i don te/ 'grub ni ba lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigamago ma gems/ mgo bo 'gems pa ni 'jom sa pa'am bkas pa'i don te/seng ges glang chen gyi mgo bo 'gems lha bu/rigs 'gre/ rigs 'gre ba ni ribs pa kha spo ba'i don nam bye mtshung4 su gtong ba'i don te/ dper na/ dngos po yin na mi rtag pa yin pas khyab/ ka ba mi rtag pa yin/ bum pa mi rtag pa yin pa de bzhin gzhan la rigs 'gre lta bu/tshos kyi 'grib/ tshos kyi 'grib ba ni tshos nyes ba'i don/'thab mo 'gyed/ 'thab mo 'gyed pa ni phan tshun 'khrug 4 byed pa'i don/ba/thor po/ blo rgod po ste sna tshogs dran nus sam grung po sogs 'a go236
