rgya mtsho/ rgya ni khyon la go ba dang rgya che ba ni khyon che ba'i don dang / mtsho ni chu'i phung por gorgal pyir/ chu la sogs rgal ba'i phyir ram ched du zhes pa'i don/rgyu/ rgyu ba ni 'gro ba'i don la 'jugagatam rgyud/ gna' bo'i gtam gcig nas gcig tu rgyud pa la go ste/ sngon gyi lo rgyus sogs/phreng rgyud/ phreng ba'i rgyud de phreng thag gam phreng ba brgyud pa la'ang go bya tshig dbang du byas na rgyud ni da lta ba ston byeb kyi tshigargyud mang / rgyud skud mang po can te/ sgra snyan la gosbyod na/ mdzes byed kyi rgyan te/ mgron po khyim gyi rgyan/ rma bya nags kyi rgyan lha bu/bya jod/ bya rgyal rgod po la zer/rgan po/ rgas pa'am bslab pa rgan pa ste/ bgres pa la gorga shi/ rga ba ni na tshod yol ba'i don dang / shi ba ni 'chi ba'i don/zud/ rgud pa ni nyams pa'am zhan du song ba'i don/ba ba blon ba / phas kyi rgol ba'am pha rol gyi rgol ba ni gnod byed la go ba dang / rgol phyir rgol ni gzhung lugs sogs rtsod pa byed skabs rtsod pa byed mkhan dang / lan 'debs pa po la gorgyang 'phen/ yang dag pa'i lta ba las rgyang ring du 'phen pas na rgyang 'phen pa bya zhing / phyi rol pa spums cad la rgyang 'phen pa zer ba dang /khyad par chad mtha' smra ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa la ko mgo la rgyob/ rdo sogs mgo bo la spyob cig lta bu ni snun cig ga ma gzhus shig ces skum tshig ston pa'i tshig 231

sna ba da / rta mo'i ming /rgyud ba / mdun gyi sbyog phyogs su go ba'i rgyab ste lus kyi rgyab lta bu/sgyu kyib / rgyas pa ni rgya che ba'am 'phel ba'am bye ba'am spros pa la go ste / dper na/ gzhung sogs rngu sa par bshad pa lta bu/rgyang ring / rgyang thag ring po la gorgyug rgyug pa ni mgyogs por 'gro ba'i don te/ rta 'di rgyug rtsal che ba la mang lta bu/rgya bo/ gdong la rgya yob pa la rgya bo zer/dka sna da/ mi srun pa'am gtum—po la gophyag rgya phya / dam dang phyag rgya bkar bo pyos dam ni theb tse'am dam phrug ka bo/ ba dang / phyag rgya bshe ni rnab/ 'byor rgyud kyi ka 61 pa'i phyag rgya6 ra zhe la 'byor bzhi ste/ las kyi phyag ku dang / dam sga phyag rgya dang / chos kyi sprug rgya dang / phyag rgya chen po bcas so/ /de bzhin du sta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi ni 'dus byasgyu/ tham1sa cad mi rtag pa dang / zag bcas spum sa cad sdug bsngas ba dang / chos spums cad stong jing bdag med pa/ mya ngan 'a/sa 'das pa zhe ba'o bcad so/ /rgyo/ 'khri/ ga pa'i dngon mi nga yin/rgya ba rgyam tsha/ rgya tsha dang rgya che/ cha gnyis ci tshwa'i khyad par yin/rgyal ba bye/ sto phogs kyi phye3ma phyogs 'gro/'i skabs kyi zas la gorgyugs/ tshad longs min lta ba'i sprugs te/ dpe cha rgyub/ba/ 'in ḍa3 dang /ja lhogs len pa lta bu/rgyu mtshan/ sprub byed dam go byed la zer dper na/ kun/ pa dngos po yin rdzu/'i rgyu mtshan sho da dang lta bu/2 rje8

'i rgyus/ gtam rgyud dam gnas tshul ngo ma byung rabs la go/byeng sgod/ bying ba ni rig pa gsal cha med pa dang / rgod pa ni sems mi gnas par 'phro ba'i don/rgyu/ skyed byed dang 'jog byed kyi rgyu ste/ skyed byed ni rgyu'i mtshan nyid yin zhing / rang 'bras skyed par byed pa'am smin par byed pa'i don/rgyal ba/ bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'am /be thob pa'i don/ bdud bzhi ni/nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ phung po'i bdud1 'chi bdag sga bdud/ lha'i bu'i bdud bcas so/ /rgyud/ rgyud ni rigs rgyud la go ba dang rgyun chags pa'i don te rgyud sde bzhi sobs la 'jug /rgyud sde bzhi ni/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnala'abyor pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud bcas so/ /rgyu / ba / rgyal po ni gtso bo'am glu bdab lha bu—/rgyu skar/ rgyu ba'i skar ma ste/ nam che1ba'i skar 3/ la gorgyal/ rgyal stod dang rgyal sma da de skad mji bye bragashes rgyud/ shes pa'6/ sems kyi sted de cem sa kyi rgyun la gorgyas btab/ khye yis btab pa ste1 rtse/ 'da' ba'i rtags bkod pa'i don nam thel tse rgyab pa'i don/nga rgyal/ khengs ba'am dregs pa ste/ pang nyid khyad du 'phags par rlom zhing gzhan la ma gus pa'i don/rgyud ba/ba / zas la go ba'i rgyags ni bza' bca'i rigs la go ba dang / rigs sogs kyis rgyag pa ste mtho bar se mas pa'i don/ rigs sogs rgyags pa la brgyad yod de/ rigs bzang bab rgyabs pa/ gzugs bzang bas rgyags pa/ lang tsho smin pas rgyags pa/ nad mad pas rgyags pa/ nor 239

mang bas rgyags pa/ dbang yod pas rgyags pa/ bzo rig shes pas rgyags pa/ mang du thos pas rgyags pa bcas so/ /rgya gram1 rdo rje sogs bsgol ma'i ming ngam rtags ku ru kha la gorgyan po/ sho sogs rtsed mo'i rgyan nam rgyal la gorgyan dang rgyal/ rgyan dang rgyal gnyis yang sho sogs rgyab skabs 'thob bya'i dngul sogs la gozun 'khrum/ rgun shing gi 'bras bu/rgya shug shug pa rgya shug ste shing gi khyad par yin/nya rgya/ dol lam rkon pa ste nya 'dzin byed la gorgyu/ rgyu ba ni 'gro ba'i don te/ mtshan mo rgyu ba lta bu/rgyus pa/ lus kyi rgyus pa ste rtsa rgyus dang rgyus skud lta bu/rgyu ma/ khog pa'i nang khrol rgyu ma/lu gu rgyud/ lug phrug rdang du gnas pa ltar rgyud pa ste bar mi chad pa'i don/gru rgyobs/ ko gru la sogs spyongs shig ces pa ni grur spyad dngos sogs bkang ba'am gru nyid cher btang ba'i skul tshig yin/rgyab shing / rgyang byed kyi shing ste lham la sogs bzo skabs cher gtong byed kyi shing yin la rgyang shing zhes pa ltar na rgyang bar byed pa'i don/ge rgyu/ bye ma dang nyi 'od rlung gsum tshogs pa las rgyang ring bye spung du chu 'gro ba lta bu zhig snang yang don la ma grub pa yin/ dper na/ ri dwags kyis smig rgyu 'bab chur 'khrul ba lta bu/rgyun/ chu la sogs pa'i rgyun te bar mi chad pa'i don/ brtson 'grus chu ba'i rgyun ltar byed lta bu/140

rgya lul rgya nag yul kam rgya gar gyi yum la gorgya che/ rgya khyon che ba'i bsdus ming /lto rgyab skyid/ lto gos sam zas gos skyid pa'am 'dzoms pa'i don/rgyal mtshan/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra bo las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma'am rtags te/pho brang dang lha khang sogs kyi thog steng na yod pa'i mchod jis kyi bye brag cigargyal/ dgra bo sogs g.yum las rgyal za snye1 rgyal kha thob pa'i da don/rje lgang ba1 la mgo can gyi snang ba ni gcin sgod gcig pur nges/ de bzhin du ldang ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba la stos te btags pa ni ldang bzhu sogs yod do/ 1 11sgom chen/ sgom pa ni 'dris pa'am goms pa'i don dang / sgom chen ni bsams don yang yang yid la byed pa chen po ste rnal 'byor pa'i ming /11 lgam/ blo gros sgam po ste blo zab pa gzhan gyis tshod dpag byed dka' ba'i don/sgrin po/ mkhas pa dang spyang po'am grung po dang 'gran por gospun/ sgrun pa ni sdur ba'am 'gran pa'i don/ dper na/ blun pos mkhas par sgrun mi nus lta bu/241

bka' / ba / ka' lcags kyi sgrog chings te lcags spug la rgasgyur mo/ dbyibs gor gor te phyi rgyal gyi dngul sgor mo'am rgya nag gi dngul sgor mo lta bur gosgrim zhing / sgrim pa ni rig pa sogs sgrim pa ste mi lhod par byed pa'i don yin/ zhing ni tshig phrad do/ /spyod ba / rdo sogs rbab tu sprul ba 'ad1 shog bu dang ras so gas sgril bka'am ltab dri la byed pa'i don/sgyid skyur/ sgyid pa sprur ba ste lus sems lci zhing bya ba la 'jug 'dod med ‘4'i nad rtags sam stom las byed pa'i don/sgyid lug sgyid pa lugs pa don gyi le lo ste bya ba rla bas chen 'a zhum par byed pa'i don dang / rkang pa'i byed khug la'ang gogyed bu/ thab skyed de thab rdo la gorje ba / shing sigs sa ra byel ba ni stol ba'i rdon/ji rtsal/ spru rtsal drug cu re bzhi ste/ de dag zhib tu dbye na/ snga1 rgya gar — spyi dar ba'i bzo rig gi sgyu rtsam sum cu dang / rol mo'o hūm̐ rtsa rje pa bco 1brgyad dang / glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun dang / gar gyi cha byad da gu bcas so/ /bzo rig 'i/ sgyu rtsal sum cu ni/ yi ge lag rtsal1 grangs/rtsis chen/ thor tshugs/ gom stabs/ lcags kyus sgyur thab ba / ral gri'i thabs/ zhags pa gdab pa/ mda' bo che—'phen pa/ mdun du ba ba/: byer bsnur ba/ bcad pa/ dral ba/ dbug pa/ rgyang nas 'ji ga pa/ sgra peg pa ra 'phog pa/ gnad du 'phog pa/ mi 'tshor bar 'phob ji1/ tshabasache bar 'phog ku4/ mchong ba pa/ gyad kyi 'dzin stangs/ zang / rkyal 1brgal pe1 glang po che'i gnyar 'en pa/ rta la tho dz+wa pa/ shing rta'i bzo 34

spubs/ mda' gzhu'i bzo thabs/ gyad stobs dang bcas sum cu'o/ /rol mo 'i sgyu rtsal bco brgyad ni/ gar dang / bro/ ji bo che/ rdza rnga/za phran/ rnga chen po/ 'khar rnga/ pi wang rgyud gcig pa/ rdza rnga kha gcig pa/ lcags kyi sil khrol/ 'khar ba'i sil khrol/ pe wang rgyud gsum pa/ji spu kun/ sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bstun pa/ pheb rdog rol mo'i sgra/pi wang / gling bu dang bcas bco brgyad do/ /glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun ni/ drug skyes dang / drang srong / sa 'dzin/ bar ma/ lnga ldan/ blo gsal/'khor nyan dang bcas bdun te/ drug skyes rma bya'i skad ltar sgrog/ drang srong ba lang skad kyis rtsom/ sa 'dzin ni ra yi skad/ bar ma khrung khrung sgra sgrog bzhin/ lnga ldan me tog ldan dus su khu byug skad snyan sgrog lta bu/blo gsal rta skad lta bur 'tsher/ 'khor nyan glang po'i sgra lta bu'o/ gar gyi cha byad dgu ni/ sgeg pa dang / dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa bcas de gsum lus kyi nyams gsum dang / drag shul dang / bzhad gad/'jigs rung bcas de gsum ngag gi nyam da gsum dang / snying rje dang /rngam pa/ zhi ba bcas de gsum yid kyi nyams gsum bcas dgu yin no/g.yo sku/ g.yo ni bslu ba'i don dang / sgyu ni sems gya gyu'am thabs kyis rang gi yon tan sgrog pa'i don no/ —ji ma/ mig 3phrul nas snang ba tsam las rang bzhin nam don du med pa la zer/spung / gna' bo'i gtam sogs te/ lha sprung dang bya skrung lta bu/snam sgrom/ shing sogs kyis bzos pa'i snad chung ba la sgam chung dang smyom bu yang zer/ 243

sgro ba/ pags sgod ste/ rta sgro lta bu dang rlig pa la gorkye mo/ ras sogs kyi sdod kyi ming / byu1ga mo/ chung ma'i ma'am zla bo'i ma la gobaka dpa / bya sogs kyi sgo nga ste/ bya 'bras la gosgog thos/ ri'i sgog pa ke ru zos pa'am za ba don/sgregs/ sgregs pa ni khog nang gi dri ngan kha nas gsung pa'am thod ji 'i don/jig sgrib/ sdig pa sna mi dge ba dang / sgrib pa ni shes bya'i gnas lugs de kho na nyid la sgrib par byed pa'am nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'am she sa bya sgrib pa lta bu'o/ /chu sgrol/ chu bo las sgol ba'am rgal bar byed sgyu pa'i don/chos sgra/ chos kyi sgra ngang / chu sogs sgra ste rna ba'i yul/sgrogs/ sgrogs pa ni/ sgra sogs 'byin pa'am klog pa'i don dang 1 sgrogs shig lta bu skal tshig yin/༄bya sgro/ bya yi sgro ste/ gshog pa sogs la yod pa'i spu lta bu/bshar sgros/ skad cha sogs bshad pa'i sgros —sam bshad tshul la— shomachu sgros/ kha yi mchu ste/ kha'i mchu gto la zer/sgrigs/ gral sogs sgrigs pa ste mthun par byed pa'i don/zla ba'i lha rdogs / brang rgyab kyi sgal pa'i tshigs pa la gosgal skyod/ sgul ba ni skyod cing g.yo bar byed pa'i don/za/ sman sga skya dang sga sprug dang sga ser lta bu/sge'u gsher/ sman lha sprug rlon pa la gosgren mo/ gcer bu'am lus la gos med pa'i don/sgo drung / sgo ni khang pa'i sgo'am rnam thar gyi sgo'am sgo gsum ste lus ngag 3 44

yid gsum dang smra ba'i sgo snye kha la go ba sogs kyi don dang / drung ni nye ba'i don no/ /geg mo/ mdzes pa mo'am mdzes ma la goskug skug pa ni ma yong bar du mi 'gro ba'i don te/ phebs skug zhu ba 1 bu1skyid pa/ rkang pa'i gyid par go gos sgab/ lus sogs la gos sgab pa ni 'gebs pha'i don/sgro gu/ dru bu'am sdom byed kyi lung ga la gosgrog sgrog pa ni 'ching ba'i don no/ /dbang sgyur/ dbang du sgyur pa'i don te/ rgyu nor sogs rang la dbang du sgyur ba'i don lta bu/'khor lo sgyur/ gling gcig sam gnyis kyi rgyal po la 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po zer/sprur dre snang da/ kha lo sogs sgyur byed de/ sgyur ba po la golag sgreng / lag pa dang rgyan mtshan sogs sgreng ba ni gyen du slong ba'i don/bzab bkab / zas ni zan sogs la go ba dang / sgong ni ril mor pa byed pa'i don/bu ram sgor/ bu ram dang bzhes spro sogs sgor ba ni brtsas pa'am bskol nas sra bar byed pa'i don/ sgor ni sgar ba'i skul tshig golgar/ gur gyi tshogs la go ste/ stod sgar dang / chos sgar/ dmag sgar chob/ba ba bod—rta da// rta sogs bstad rgyu'i gser dang ko ba sogs kyi sga la zer/sgron me/ snang byed dam sgron ma'i me la gosgrib/ sprib pa ni mi mthong bar byed pa'i don te/ nyi ma sprin pas sgrib pa lta 246

(1'o1 /sped ba/ sngon spye bar gyi rgyal po skya bseng la bu srid skrub ba dang 1ba jigs sde/ ga yul ngo pa brtan pa/ dz+wa gu le/ sa ha de ba ba cas lnga yod pa'i ya rgyal khrib/ yin zhing srid sprub kyi pha ni brgya byen yi/ par grags ngas brgya byin bu 1mang zer/ku ba dpal mgon ba phags ba klu spru ba ste/ zab mo dbu ma 'i lnga ba yi srol 'byed kyi speb dpon zheg dang / rgyan drug ka—chog gnyis kyi ya rgya' bkun1sgrol ma/ 'jigs pa brgyad 'a sa sprol ba'i cha nas btags pa'i yi dam lha mo'i rigs shig ste/ rje btsun sgrol ca 'a gospub/ lhab pa ni sgrub byed dam sgrub thabs (sha go ba dang dus da lta pa ston byed kyi tshigami bar ma sna chub da mna' sgob pa ni mna' skyel ba'i don1 sgrob/sa rdo1 'phrul 'khor sogs kyis 'phe na pa'i rdo dang 'u pa rngo dang me da ba/sa chod/sa ba pe/byung za ga sgyu ga dkas sma da 'ur rdo yod chad gcog pa'am bcag pa'i dz+wa—na dab 1gcog pa ni da ‘lta ba ston byed kyi tshigad sgos/ da cha ze ba'i don/blo sa su/ sger du'am yang sgos brtsem dmigs bsab/ gyi don no/ 1rtsib pa zin/ rtsig pa sgron pa ni rtsig shā kha gso ‘ba'i don dang / lus la rgya che — sgron —4 sob/sgyu la'ang 'jugaspru stebs/ stegs bu dang preg chos ste mdzes pa'i nyam sa 3gyur 'a yo sgab bshobs — sgang pa ni mtho ba'i don yin zhing mdo khams sga — drug 216

lta bu dang / gshongs ni dma' ba'i don yin/ mdo khams sgang drug ni/zal mo sgang / tsha ba sgang 1 smar khams sgang / spyo 'bor sgang / dmar ji sgang / mi/ nyag rab sgab bcas yin/ tsha sgo can/ ba tsha can la zer/sgrob/ 'byung tshugs sam dregs pa'am mi chen gyi tshul jed pa la gosgrom/ gso ba dang khog gam tshugs ste/ sgrom chen nam mgo sgrom lta bu/brgabargal brtag lung dang rig pa'i sgral byed la brten nas gzhan gyi 'dod ༄ pa rnam par brtag pas bkag pa'am sun 'byin pa'o/ /brgal lan/ pha rom pos rang bkag pa'am sun 'byin pa la phar lan btab pa'o / /brgyad cu/ grangs bcu phrag brgyad/brgyad/ grangs brgyad/phreng ba brgya phrag phreng ba brgya spum pa/brgyus/ phreng ba sogs skud par brgyus pa'am brgyu ba/ brgyus pa ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabargyan/ sko sogs la nor bu'i do shal brgyan pa lta bu spras pa'am mtshan pa'i don/chu brgal/ chu brgab ba'am rgal ba ste/ chu las 'grol bar byed pa'i don/brgal ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs ston byed tshiga'o brgyal1 'o ba rgyal ba ni dka' las sam ngal dub kyi don/ཿ47

dran rme da brgyal/ dran pa med par brgyal ba ste/ 'khams ‘4'am rmong sa pa'i don/brgyud pa/ sangs rgyas kyi lung dang bstan pa sogs brgyud pa ste1 bar ma chad pa'am gcig na gcig tu 'brel ba lta bu/lam bgrugs/ lam gyi rgyags lce ste/ brgyags pa'am rgyags pa spyad pa'i don/spyo ba'i brgyar1 spyo ba'am gshe ba'i don gyi brgyad bkag ste/ bka' 1brkun la go ba dang / brgyad pa dang rgyad pa'ang 'thad snya/ma/le zan/ dar dmar po'am gur kum mam tshos dmar po la gogad brgyangs/ gad mo brgyangs pa'am ngar skad bton pa ste/ seng ge'i gad brgyangs lta bu/smra ba'i / brgya/ smra ba'i brgya pa'am gtam brgya pa ni/ rdzun smra ba'am zhal brgya byas pa'am zhal ba rgyas zhal shob gsungs pa'i don/brgyugs shing / brgyugs pa ni chu sogs rgyug pa'i don yin zhing / 'das ‘4 ston byed kyi tshig shing ni tshig phrad do/ /brgyubs pa/ gzhungs pa ste/ sgal tshigs nang gi klad pa'am rnag la gobargyud mar/ bar mi chad par ram bstud mar zhes pa'i don/brgyab/ tho ba la sogs brgyab pa ste/ gzhus pa'i don/bsgabu ram bkar bu ram sogs bskol nas sra bar byed pa'i don te/ bsgar ba ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi chig248

ba༅bas/ bsgrangs pa ni grangs su bcug pa'i don/bsgongs/ bsgongs pa'am sgong ba ni/ ril bu bzos pa'i don dang /bsgongs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigachos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi chos bod du bsgyur ba'am sgyur—ba'i don dang /bsgyur ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigamadog bsgyur/ kha dog bsgyur ba ste/ dkar po dmar por bsgyur ba'am sgyur ba'i don dang / bsgyur ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabaka' bsgo bsgos/ bka' bsgo ba dang bsgos pa ni bsung gnang ba'am slob ston byas pa'i don yin zhing / bsgo ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig dang / bsgos rngo/ ni 'das pa ston byed kyi chig yin/chu bsgral/ chu sogs las bsgral ba'am sgrol ba'i don te/ bsgral ni ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i tshigachos bsgrags/ sangs rgyas gyis gsungs pa'i chos sde sdod gsum la sogs pa bsgrags pa'am sgrog pa ste/ bshad pa'i don/ bsgrags ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigateb 'dzin bsgoms/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin nam bsam gtan bsgoms pa'am sgom pa'i don/ bsgoms ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigamago bsgres/ mgo bzhes pa ni mgo mtshungs par byas pa'i don/rigs bsgres/ rigs bzhes pa ni/ rigs 'gre ba ste/ spyi mtshungs su gtong ba'i don/rgyam mtshan bsgrebs1 nyon mongs pa'i dgra bo las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma ste rgyal mtshan dang / de bzhin ba dan sogs bzangs pa'am sgrong ba ni yar 249

slong ba'i don/ bsgrengs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigab zad ba ba bka dbab / mna' bsgags pa'am sgog pa ni mna' skyel du 1bajug pa'i don/ bskad ba/ 'das pa ston byed kyi tshi—kab ni da bka'i1bkab / lam so/gas spu bsgugs pa'am sgug pa ni ma yong bar bsdad pa'i don dang / bskugs ci 'angs pa ston pa'i tshigaseng be bsgrongs/ seng—ge'i rdzus bzangs pa ni/ 'gying tshug ba/ bstan pa'i don/bka' da da ba/ba bkyi blo ba bzab / gnyis snang sogs kyi bag chabs bsgo ba'am bsgos pa ni4/ phyi gzung ba dang / nang 'dzin pa gnyis su—: nga ba dang /nyi zla dang skra shad sogs mang por snang ba rab rib can gyi ba )sa snang lta bu'i bag chag ba/ bsgo ba'am bsgob pa'i don/ bsgo ba ni ma rings pa ston byed kyi tshig dang bsgob/ pa ni 'das 1zhe stod lced kyi tshigablo ga1sa gcig bzag ba / phyogs gcib tu bzag ba pa'3 sgrig pa ni bzhag pa'i don dang / bsgrigs ni 'das za ston byed kyi tshilabakad bsgobs/ sgon me dang nyi ma'i 'od sogs bsgribs ba 'che sgrib ‘4 ni ma stong bar byed pa'i do shā dab / bsgribs ni 'das pa ston shwed kyi tshig /ji bsgrims/ blo dang rig ba tho/kas bsgrims pa'am sgrim pa ni sem/sa nan tan byas pa'e don / bsgrims dz+wa 'ad ba/ za ston pa'e tshigasrang bu bsgo mas/ ba rnga/ bkams ba 'am ka ma ba ni sgrib/ rgyab pa'i don/bsgrims ni 'das ma ston byed tri tshigabasgrub pa bsgrub bya bab ba pa dang bskrub bya de gnyis sprub shwe da kyi yul lin theng 1 che— 'ongs pa ston rted kyi tshigab ji / ma mi ji ba / skru na par chi/ nus pa'am 'gran par mi nus pa'i don/250

bsgrun ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabasgrin mi phod/ sgrin par mi phod dam 'gran par mi phod pa'i don/ bsgrin ni ma 'ongs ston byed kyi tshigaza ba'i bdang / bya ba'i dkyil lam byed bzhin pa la gobagyel zhing / bskyel ba'am skyel ba ni ril ba'i don te/ bsnyel ni ma 'ongs dang 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigaglu bsgrags/ sgra skad bsgags pa'am sgrog pa ni skad rgyag pa'i don/bsgags ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigartsis kyis bsgyur/ skar rtsis sogs su gnyis kyis gsum bsgyur bas drug lha bu sgyur ba la go bsgyur bya ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i tshig gzhan gyis mi bskul/ gzhan pha rol gyes mi bskul ba'am mi skul ba ni ma brdzi ba'i don/ bskul ni ma 'ongs ba ston byed kyi tshig nor gyis bad / nor spyis bsgang pa ni nor gyis phyug pa'am 'gengs pa'i don/ngalhan dbags snyan pa'i dngags ni snyen ngag ste— mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs pa'i bstan bcos dang / tshig rgyan rig pa'i bstan bcos sogs yin no /mdor na / rna bar snyan cing yid dbang 'phrog pa'i tshig sbyor gyi ngag la snyan dngags sam snyan ngag zer/zil dngar/ bdud rtsi'am sbrang rtsi lta bur go mtshar du dbar/ mtshar du dngar ba ni gral du sgrig pa'i don/251

bser dngul/ gser rin chen dang po dang / dngul rin chen gnyis pa/dngom che/ rtsa chen nam rin thang che ba sogs kyi don/dngos/ dngos po ni 'dus byas dang mi rtag pa sogs la go zhing / 'dus byas zhes pa rgyu rkyen gyis 'dus nas byas pa la zur/dngos med/ dngos po med pa'am 'dus byas su ma grub pa la godangos grub/ ma chog gi dngos grub dang / thun mong gi dngos grub la godangos gzhi/ ma gzhi'am rtsa ba yi don/dngos bshams/ dngos su bshams pa ni dngos su bkam pa'i don yin la dngos po gzhan gi gzigs mor bkram pa'i 'dus ming yang yin/dngos/ ngo ma'am rdzun pa min pa la go ste/ gser dngos red 'dug lta bu/de bzhin du rgyu dngos dang / dngos btags dang / dngos shugs/ dngos meng sogs la godangangs zag dngangs pa'am sngangs pa ni skrag pa'i don/dang na 'ben/ gzhan gyi nor khyer ba phyir mi sbod pa la gobasab chu'i dngo / chu ngogs ba/ma chu kha la gogri yi dngo / gcod byed gri yi dngo ni no la go zhing / rta lcab/ gi dngo ni (reb thag ba4 god dpamanga' ris/ mnga' ris slor gsum ni/ bod yul stod smad bar gsum du phye ba'i stod phyogs kyi spu hreng dang / mang yul/ zangs ba bar gsum skor ga cig dang / zhang zhung dang / khri te stod smad skor gcig le dang /262

'bru sha/ srul te gsum skor gcig yin no/ /mnga' zhabs/ mnga' 'og gam chab 'bangs la gomanga' bang / dbang thang la go ste/ rgyal po'i mnga' thang lta bu/mnga'/ mnga' ba ni yo da pa'am ldan pa'i don/mnga' mdzad mnga' bdag mnga' mdzad dang mnga' bdag ni dbang po'am ga rtsa bo la go ste/ bstan pa'i mnga' mdzad dam mnga' bdag ni/bstan pa'i gtso bo'am dbang po la gomangag gzhug bran g.yog gam pho nya la gomangags/ 'phrin mngags pa ni 'phrin btang ba'i don/mngon sum/ mngon su ma tshad ma ste/ rtog pa dang bral jing gsar du mi bslu ba'i shes pa la zer zhing / dper na/ bum pa 'dzin pa'i dbang po mngon su ma skad cig dang po lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du mngon sum du mthong ba'am mngon sum du thos pa la yang 'jugamangon sprur/ rang mtshan dang yon tan sogs mngon du gyur pa la go zhing /rang mtshan ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa la zer/ dper na/ ka ba dang bum pa lta bu/mngon mtshan/ mngon gsal che ba'am bun skyed la gomangab / bu sgod la god ba / da 11da/ chos lugs kyi byed sgo zhig sto/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las drag po mngon spyod kyi las ste/ drag las so/ /mnga' brnyes/ mnga' brnyes pa ni dbang smob pa'i don te/ rig rtsal la ma 'a brnyes pa lta bu/ mngan mi bgrab / skyon mi brjod pa'i don/263

chos mngon/ dam pa'i chos kyi nang gses mngon pa'i sde sgod de sde snad gsum gyi gcigamangor zhes 1 lha'i mig sogs kyi mngon par shes pa lnga'am drug ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ lha'i mig sga mngod shes1 lha'i rna ba'i cha ngon zhes/sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes gzhan sems 4ku pa'i mngon shes/ zag zad mkhyen pa'i mngon shes bcas so1 /mas par ba'i ro/ bro ba mngar ba'i do / dngar ba yang ba81thugs 'a mnga'/ thugs la mnga' ba ni thugs la yod pa'am ldan pa'i ma gsal ba'am 'dzin pa'i don/rngajom pa/ ri dgas rngon pa po ste/ khyi ra ba'i ming /ja yab/ rnga ma las byas pa'i bsil yab bam rlung yab la go bsgyu / rnga chen po la sogs/ —rje'u/ rnga chung chung ba4 gozam pa'i bkres/ rngam pa zhes pa'i don bkres pa dang chags pa la gozang bab/ rngab pa ni sto gas pa' ma chags pa la goza rma / tsher ma la dga' ba'i dud 'gro zhig gi ming /rje'u/ rnga mo chung ba'am rnga phrug la gorngom brjid/ gzi brjed che ba'am ngo mtshar che ba la gozan 'jigs/ rngam pa ni khro ba'am 'jigs tshul/jo bab can/ pags nad dam za 'phrug nun la go264

dbugs zub/ dbugs dang chang sogs rngub pa ni 'then pa'i dod/zug rngu/ zug gzer ram na zug gtong ba'i don/jod mkhan/ sha dang tshal sogs rngod pa po 'a gozul/ lus rngul ba'i don la yo ba dang / de bzhin du rngul gzan dang /rngul nag lta bu la'ang 'jug jos khyer/ rngo yis khyer ba ni/ ngan shugs sam ham pas khyer ba'i don/dre'u jog rngog stan grum tse la gomi za zad/ —ka sa kyi gla'am byis pa'i rngan pa ste/ gsol ras sta bu/bsgyu/ rnga ma ni mjug ma la go ste/ g.yag gi rnga ma lta bu'o/ /rngog rngog ma ni ze la gomathug zam/ mthug po'i don can gyi rngam ste/ rngams kyang snang /rngo mi thogs/ mi nus pa'am mi phan pa'am ngo mi tsha ba'i don te/ bzang pos las byed par ngan pas rngo mi thogs lta bu/zan chan/ brnya sa thabs sam mi rtsi ba'i don/dka zad/ rtswa sngon po dang btsas ma sogs rnga ba ni brngas pa'am gcod pa'i don/ rnga ba ni dus da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigargyud nub/ mig gi skyo ma'am mig skyag la gorus kyi rngog rus kyi bye brag la 'jug pa'i rngog ste/ rngog lo tsā ba chen po legs pa'i shes rab lta bu/— 11ba/ba da / spyan snga'am klu'i zhal snga nas mdzad ces sam zhal nyid la go /255

spyan za/ mig snga'am drung du yi don te/ slob dpon chen po'i spun sngar 'bul lha bu'o/ /snga zad/ snga so ni mdun nam snga mar go za dang / snga sor yang snab /gsang sngabs/ shes rab stong pa nyid dang / thabs snying rje chen po zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas yid mtshan rtog las skyob par byed pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes te/ gsang zhing sbas pas 'grub la/ sgod min rnams kyi spyod yul min pas gsang sngags zhes bya'o/ /brjod ba ba / sngags 'chang ngam sngags rgyab mkhan la gomangob sngon/ mdog nam mkha' ltar sngon pa gosngon sngo ba ni sngon po'am sngon por byed pa'i don/lnga dre/ nyin phyed tshun du snga dro zer/da jib/ mgo bzhag sa'i sngas mgo la gosprur ba che/ sbur ba che ba ni gnyid sgra che ba la gosnga dus/ snga ma'i dus sam sngon dus la go11 sgyu ba ba / 'khrug long ngam rtsod gleng la gomo na sran/ mon yul gyi sran ma zer/snge(1/ sran chung zhig la go snga phyi/ snga ma dang phyi ma'am sngon rjes kyi don/spun/ sngon nam mdun du gosngo bar byed/ sngo bar byed pa ni/ spe—ka ba'am sbyin pa'am sgyur bar byed pa'i don te/ dper na/ dge ba sbo bar byed pa lta bu ni dge ba spel ba'am dge bar sgyur bar byed pa'i don/mtshang sngog mtshang sngog pa ni skyon sprog pa'i don dang / kha sngog pa la'ang dka266

brngabazan/ brngan pa ni mchod pa'am rngan pa ster ba la yang 'jugabazams/ brngams pa ni brngab pa ste/ stogs pa'am chags pa'i don/btsas ma bzas/ btsas ma brngas pa ni lo tog brngas pa'am ji ba'i don te/ brngas ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabud med bzod/ bud med brngod pa ni bud med sogs 'drid pa'am bslu ba'am mgo bskor gtong ba'i don/rngon pa/ gshor ba'am ri dwags gsod byed la gobadz+ra na— brngon pa ni ri dwags bshar ba'am ri dwags rgyag pa'i don/zang bzubs/ chang la sogs pa brngubs pa ni rngub pa'i don te/brngubs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigab 11spub bsngam/ lus sims kyi sdug bsngal te/ mi bde ba'i don/bstod bsngabs/ bstod pa'i don can gyi bsngags pa ni/ yon tan brjod pa ba ba/ba sngo ba ba ba 11ba / bsngo bya'i dge bas bsngos nga ste/ dge ba sngo ba'i don yin zhing / bsngo ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig dang / bsngos pa ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig yin/nom par bsngos/ rnam par bsngos pa ni sngon por gyur pa'i don/267

bsngog pa/ mtshang nas bsngog pa'am sngog pa sna/ sgron ma bkag pa'i don dang / bsngog ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig15ci spad/ rgyu mtshan nam dgos pa ci'i slad dam ci'i don nam gab gi don zhes pa'i ldan/ci phyir/ gang ji / phyi ra ram ci'i slad da ma ci'i phyir zhes pa'i do na/ldan pa'i can/ ldan ba 'am yo da pa'i rngen ston byed kyi can te/ mig 6na da nga / rgyan can dpa / rgyu can lta bu dang / khyed can sna ka pa drung zer ba'i don/ bdag cab nga cag gam kho bo 6ga gam nga tsho'am rang cab/ dang 'o skol so gas kyi don/ sum cu/ grangs kyi khyad par/drug cu/ grangs kyi khyad par/bdun cu/ grangs kyi khyad par1brgyad cu/ grangs kyi khyad par yin zhing / de bzhi bo 'i byu la sngon 'jug med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ grangs bzhi ngo/ 'di dag rjod pa'i ma ba rjod ba/'i sgra gdangs la sngon 'jug gi byed bka med pas sngon 'jug ma 'thob — min—lhan cig thabs cig lhan cig dang thabs ceg ni chabs ceg ga che/ zu4nyan— po'i don/mab ga bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma sogs dus kyi tshad tsam ste/ pyi rdzogs sna bya ba thung thung zhig byed pa'i dus rdzogs pa zer zhing 1 nge lta bu'i bya 258

rdzo—kas kyi skad cig ma gcig la mig 'byed 'dzum po/cig byed pa'i dus kyi tshad dang / sel gol gcig gi yun tshad yin/ de la dus mtha'i skad cig ma drug cu re lnga yo da/khyed cag khyed tsho dang khyod nug zer ba'i don/de da ba can/ sems ldan nab/ sem/mu cho/da pa la goyod do chob yod tshad dang / shes so/ cog yin no cog sogs gcig kyang ma lus pa'i don/ can ce/ can ka'am phor par gocab cob / sngo ba sogs za pa'i sgra/ co re/ chang sogs co re rngub pa'i sgra'am blug pa'i sgra1ha cang / shin tu'am thal che ba'i don/cas cus/ tshugs thor ba'am mi drang ba'am mi brtan pa'i don/bab col mang / ma brtags pa'am byung rgyal mang ba ste/ bab col gyi gta4 / lta bu ni/ byung rgyal gyi gtam 'a goci ste/ bal te'am ci'i phyir zhes pa'i don/cung zad/ nyung zad kyi don/pyin ci log yang dag pa min pa'am nor ba'i don te/ dkar nag pyin ci log lta bu/ cang shes/ ci yang shes pa ste/ mngon shes la go ste— cang shes rta pho lta bu/cig shob / gcig po'am ngos bzung ba'i ya ste/ mkhas pa'i cig shos mi mags pa dang / legs pa'i gci / shos mi legs pa lta bu/ci nas kyang / gang nas kyang ngam nges —par zhes pa'i don/2rta9

co to/ rtsa to dang co ni skra'i ming /thor cog thor tshugs la gocod pan/ legs sbyar skad cod paṇa ste/ mthon po'i don la go ba dang /dbu rgyan la go ba yin/rgyud bsgyum / ska rags kyi bye brag ste/ khug ma'i go chod pa'i ska rags spugs stong zhig gi ming /be chon/ dbyub/ pa la go ba yin/lha ci smos/ de lta ci smos ste/ ci bshad dam bshad ci dgos zhes pa'i don/ca cho/ ca co'i sgra'i tshogs sam ku co la goba'i dkab / bab col lam mi brtan pa'am gtam nyog —ka gomu cor/ don dang mi 'brel ba'i gtam mam rgyu mtshan ltar snang la go rgyu mtshan ltar snang ni/ rgyu mtshan nga dag pa min pa pa/ rgyu rngo tshan yang dag ltar snang ba la zer/cho 'dri/ ce 'dri ba ni gnod pa'am 'gran ‘ 4'i don/cig car/ dus mnyam gyi don/cam gyis 'jog cam gyis 'jog pa ni/ dal spyis 'jog pa'i donachog pu/ gur chung ba la goca ra re/ bcar ba'i tshul la gomig ce re/ mig ce re lta tshul dang / ce re long lta bu/lan cig lan ma gcig gam tshar gcig gam thengs gcig zer ka4'e don/cis kyab / gang gis kung ngam ci nas lang ngam yul ci ru 3 nga zhes rngo4'i don/260

cir mi rtob blos cir yang mi rtog pa snye/ gang du yang mi sems pa'i don/kha cig 'ga' zhig gam kha shas zer ba'i don/cab mi zhes kyang / gang yang mi shes kyang zer ba'i don/chob / rol mo ste/ dril bu chen po la gocab / bon po'i rol mo gshang la gocang te'u/ ḍa ru chung ba la go ci yang bzung / gang yang brdung ba'i don/cu gang / snyug cu gang ste/ sman sogs la 'gro ba'i snyug ma'i rigs shigacung shi/ cung hūṃ ste/ rdo sman zhig yin/cur jis za/ cur nis ni phye ma'i don yin zhing / za ba ni kha la za ba'i don/ched (1dpa / gcan gzan khyi spyang la gozag ca/ sgra brnyan te/ grog rong nang brag ca 'khor ba lta buci zhig bya/ gang zhig bya dgos med dam mi nus zhes pa'i don/chog rtse/ mdun du bzhag pa'i cog tse la mdun cog ste/ phor za 'jog sa/rjod rgyud/ tho co rtsing po ste/ tho co'i spyod pa'am spyod pa rtsing po la gocung peng za/ cung peng ste/ changs bu'am sbag ril za ba'i don dang / cung peng ltar na thug pa kha la za lta bu/brje ba/ ci zhig gam ci zhig yin nam ji ltar zhes pa'i don/gcagros gcom/ gros bcom pa ni gros byed pa'i don/261

bcub nad/ nad rnying —4 la gogacad bya/ shing lta bu gcod byed kyi yul la go zhing / 6/ 'ongs pa ston pa'i chig ba com da/ gcod pa'am thub pa'am 'dreg pa'am 'gog ba 'am sel ba bcas la 'jug pa dang / da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigad zad ba chub ba ba / khon gcugs pa ni yid mi mthun pa'i don/yed gcugs1 yid gcugs pa ni mdza' ba'am yid mthun pa'i dod/bcen/ gcen po ni spun che bkar ma sngon 'a skyes pa la zer 1 bcung / gcung po ni spun chung ba(rem rjes la skyes pa la zer 1gcud bor/ gcud la bor ba ni gtan la phab pa'am 'dul ba'i don/ba ba ba kyu rjeb / lag pa yon por gcus pa ni spril ba lta bu/gcur phug tu ga cur ba'am 'jur ba ni ba ba'i don/bcun: gcun pa ni 'jun pa ste/ 'dul ba'i don yin/ dper na/ rta ngan gcun nas snying po bzos pa lta bu/snam gcod/ rnam par gcong pa ste/ da gag pa'i don/yongs gcod/ yongs su gcod pa ste/ sprub pa'i don te/ rnam gcod la sprul yin pa bkag na yongs gcod la thag khru sprub pa lta bu ni/ dper — na/ lam steng zhig la thag pa khru khra zhig yo da pa mi zhig gib mthong skabs mi des de ni sbrul ma yin no snyam 14'i blo 'char ba de ni snam gcod la sprul yin pa bkag pa dang / de—ni spru'1 ma mim/ no snyam bo'i blo nge ḍa—char ba dang dus mnyam du thag pa khru khru zhig go snyam pa'i blo de sgyu1 yo nga / gced da spug khru skrub ba zer/'al lce bcud/ /rnge mas dang cha da pa sogs gcod pa'am bcad pa'i don/‘62

gcod ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigag rtsa ba rong / ngam grog la kagacong skad/ gcong nad can gyi skad dam gcong rong gi skad dam skad ngan pa la gogacin pa/ dri chu la zer/ —bci ba/ dri chu'am dri chu gtong ba lta bu la gobartsod bzhin/ the tshom sogs ban rtsad bzhin pa snye/ da sta ba'i don dang 'jal bzhin pa la'ang gogaces med/ gces 'dzin med pa'i don dang / gces spras dang / gal che'am dgos lta bur yang gces 'jug pa yin/gcig gis gcib phan tshun gcig gis gcig la bshad pa lta bu/gcam bu/ brtsas ma'i ngag gam brtsas bstod dam brtsos ma ste/ ngo ma min pa'i skad cha/kha gcang / kha snyan nam kha gsag la go ste/ rang la rnyed pa dang bkur ste yong ched kha snyan bshad pa la gogacugs med gcugs ni mthun pa'i don dang / med ni dgag sgra snye/don mi mthun pa la gogaces/ gces dgos ni gces po'am dga' po byed dgos pa'i don/tshar gachod/ tshar gcod pa ni 'pham par byed pa'am 'joms pa'i don dang / ga cod ni/ da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigabacu gal/ do gal lam khag 'gan gyi don/yid la gcags/ yid la gcags pa ni yid la 'jags pa'i don/sgra gcan/ gza'i ga rtsa bo'am stong pa'i lus can zhig ste/ gza' sgra gcan/263

gcan gzan/ stag gzig sogs la rgal bcan pa/ la tshugs pa'am la'i sho gam pa'am la khrul bsdu mkhan nam la spung mkhan la zagacib tu/ mtha' gcig gam phyogs gcig gam logs shig tu zhes pa'i don/gcal bkram/ gcal du bkum pa ni/ chal mar brda' ba la go/ dper na/ dngos jis rnams gcal du bkram nas ston cig lta bu/grabs kyi bcib grangs kyi khyad par gcig ba lta bu'i gcigaro gcib bu ram dang snang sems sogs ro gcig pa ni khyad med pa'i don te/ bu ram gyi gzugs dang bu ram gyi ro gnyis dbyer du med pa ngo bo gcig la gnas pa la zer/jos gcig dngos po'am rang bzhin gcig pa'am tha mi dad pa la rdzas gcig zer/gcer bu/ sgren mo ste/ lus la gos med pa la gogacog shing sogs gcog pa ste/ da lta ba ston pa'i tshigagaci'u'i sman/ gci'u ni chu sogs 'then gtong byed pa'i sdig spugs sta bu yin la des bshang lam du gtong ba'i sman la zer/bcabartsom ldan/ bdud bzhi bcom pa 'joms shing yon tan drug dang ldan pa sangs rgyas/ bdud bzhi ni/ nyon mongs kyi bdud/ phung po'i bdud/'chi bdag gi bdud/ lha'i bu'i bdud bcas dang / yon tan drug ni/264

dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa/ gzugs phun sum tshogs pa/ grags pa phun sum tshogs pa/ dpal phun sum tshogs pa/ ye kes phun sum tshogs pa/ brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa rnams te bcom ldan 'das kyi che ba'i yon tan drug go/ sangs rgyas ni/ nyon mongs pa ma rig pa'i sgrib pa sangs pas na sangs dang / shes bya la blo pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar rgyas pas na sangs rgyas zer/dgra bcom/ nyon mongs ste/ 'dod chags/ zhe sngang / gte mug sogs kyi dgra bcom pa/ yang na bcom ldan 'das 'khor dgra bcom pa 1 bu/bcas pa/ yod pa'am ldan pa'i don/bcabs pa/ zhabs kyis 'chag sar bcags pa'am mnan pa'am phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas pa/dam bca'/ dam bca' ba/ khas len pa/ bsgrub bya/khrims bca'/ khrims bca' ba/ khrims bzo ba/ khrims bcas pa/bcib ba/ 'ching ba/bcibs/ bcings pa/ bkyigs pa/shib bcad/ shing bcad pa/ shing gcod pa/blan bcir/ brlan gsher bcir ba/ bkar ba/ bcar yang snang /bca' yos bca' bya'i nas kyi yos sogs/bcem/ sos bcem pa/ bcag pa'am blad pa/tshigs bcad/ tshigs su bcad pa/ chigs rkang bzhi sogs/ba 'a gzhi/ bca' ba bzo ba'i gzhi/ bstan brtsos/ mkhas pa'i gsung ngam 'chos skyob kyi cha nas bka' la'ang 'jug /'chos skyob ni/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra bo 'chos pa dang / ngan 206

'gro'i 'jigs pa skyob pa la 'chos skyob zer/bcang ba/ lag tu bcang ba/ 'chang ba/logs bcar/ logs sam zur du bcar ba/ nye bar phyin ba / sku ba6ra ram bcar sogs/bca' lga/ sman sga/bza' bca'/ bza' ba lnga ste/ 'dul ba las gsungs pa'i dus rung gi sman gyi char gtogs pa zhig ste/ sna tshogs 'bras chan dang 1 zan dang /sha dang / phye dang 1 snum khur bcas lnga'o/ /bca' ba lnga ste/ 'jib rten la kha zas su grags pa'i rtsa ba da — sdong bu dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo ma bcas lnga'o/ /bcud ro bcud/ bcud ren/ bcud can lta bu/mig bcar/ dag dang sgong sogs bcar ba btsir ba lta bu/dzir bcir1 phyi rol tu bcil ba/ bton pa'am spangs pa'am bsal ba/chu bcu/ chu bcu ba/ chu 'dren pa'am len par gobacug pa/ las la spur ba/ nang du bcug pa'ang /nor bcal/ nor dang bu lon sogs bcal ba 'jal ba bcal ba ni dus 'das pa/lag bcangs/ ba/ga rdzu/ bcangs pa1 bzung ba/ 'chang ba/ 'dod spyod kyi lag bcang ba/ kyang /chags bcab chags bcag pa1 snam ba chu nang du mnyes pa/bzal/ las ‘/col ba/ las byed du bcug pa dang gtams pa'i bcol ma nga 1bcar ba/ rta ra'i ming /266

rtar bcibs1 rtar 'chib pa/ zhon pa1zhal lce bcad/ zhal lce 'am khrims dang chad pa sogs bcad pa/ gcod pa/tshar bcad/ rgol ba tshar bcad pa/ gcod pa/blos bcal/ blos bcal ba'am 'jal ba/ shes pa'am rngogs pa/bcas rang / bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang / rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba'i don no/ /bcabs/ bcabs pa/ gsangs pa/ 'chab pa/ srus pa/ nyes pa bcabs pa ka nyes pa sbas pa'i don/rdo bcag rdo sogs bcag pa ni dus 'das pa dang gcog pa ni dus da lta ba/shib bcer/ shing sogs bcer ba/ spungs pa/gros bcom/ gros bcom pa ni gros byas pa/ bcam yang snang /bcum/ bcum pa/ chung ngur btang ba/ kha zheng bcum pa ni kha zheng chung du btang ba'i don/bcu/ bzhi bcu/ lnga bcu/ dgu bcu/ brtso lnga/ brtso brgyad bcas ni grabs kyi khyad par/ de rnams brjod pa'i sgra gdangs la sngon 'jug gi byed pa yod pas sngon 'jug bris pa yin no/ /brtsos/ bcos pa/ bzos pa1 phyir bcos/ nad bcos sogs/brtsos bu'i ras/ brtsos ma'i ras/ ras ngo ma min pa/(1gnyen lhag gnyen cing lhug pa/ mi gyong ba/

lhag phran/ yal ga gsar pa/lcang ma/ shing rgya lcang la sogs/byu1ba/ skul byed de tham lcag rta lcag skul lcag sogs/ thal lcag di lag pa'i thal mos rgyab pa'i lcagamago lhogs me tog sogs kyi mgo lcog dud pa/ches lci/ cher lci ba/ yang ba min pa/blo yis sbogs/ blo yis lcogs pa/ khom pa/ nus pa/gnam lcag lce 'bab/ gnam gyi lcags/ thog gam rdo rje'i me/me lce/ me lce gyen du 'bar ba'am g.yo ba lta bu/lceb/ lceb pa/ rang gis rang srob/ 'dor bar byed pa/ chu sogs su lceb pa lta bu/lhab lo can/ gsang bdag gi gnas khyad bar can/ gsang bdag te phyag na rdo rje/lcags ri/ lcags kyi ri bo rgya mtsho'i mtha' nas bskor ba ste khang pa'i lcags ri sogs kyang mtshon/rtsog lcags ri sogs kyi steng du yod pa'i khang chung lta bu/nya sprubs/ nya phyis sam chu nang gi ral pa lta bu'i sngo/sbal spyong / sbal pa lce med/ lcong mo chu'i srog chags/snang ka bya kyung ka'i ming /lce/ ro 'dzin sogs/re'u lhag shog rgyu'i sngo/ lo gnyis skye ba'i rtsi shing yin zhing / rtsa ba la phug gi dbyibs can/lha ba/ sman rtsa ba lnga'i ya rkyam/268

lham ba/ sman nyi dga'/lham/ snam pa sman zhig lag lcibs/ lag pa'i dri ma gzhan la mi 'go bar byed pa'i lag phyis/tsha lcibs/ sgod sogs tsha bas mi 'tshig par byed pa'i ras sogs/sgo lcib ba / sgo yol lam sgo yi lcibs phur sogs/spyan lcibs/ mib/ spags sam mig shel/lham dral/ rtsem ni sring mo/ dral ni ming po/ chos skyong lcam dral/ rtsa lcam dral lam zung /za'i lcang lo/ skra lhas pa'i lcang lo ral pa lta bu dang lcang ma'i lo ma/spru ba/ dud 'gro(re lci ba/ lci bas 'byug lcib mer 'dud lta bu/byu1ba pod/ ska rags shig sba thag sogs lhas ma gru bzhi'i ska rags/srus lcab snye ma'i srus te spus cag kyang snang /sprug lcig ‘4/ brdung ba'am 'jal ba/tshig 'gru lcibs/ tshig gi 'bru ma lcibs pa/ gris/ pa/ bshibs pa/da chem ba/ sgra sgrog tshul lam 'od chags tshul/zal chil/ chu rlabs kyi skra lta bu/ —chos/ rgya gar skad du dharma zhes pa 'dzin pa'i don te shes bya/ chos dang shed bya gzhal bya gzhi grub yul yo/da pa don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so//thob/ nyal 'gro ma/ dal 'gro/ dag byed/zar/ nam mkha'i char pa/ sprin gyis gtor ba'i chu sogs/269

chabs zal 'dod chags dang bral ba/chog ges/ dgra bcom pa sogs rnyed pa'am rgyu nor ji yod kyim chog pa/rung ba'am 'grig par shes pa sems pa ste byed chog mi chog kyang /cho ga cho ga sprub pa'am bya ba byed chu la la sogs pa'i don/ched/ dgos pa'am dmigs bsal te dgos ched dam ched du byad dang /byang chub la ched du 'bad lda thu/thod zad/ ya lad/ 'thab byed kyi 'khrab rmog sogs/mtshon cha/ gri mdung la sogs pa'i ming /cha lugs/ cha byad/dbyeb / chos shig pa ste bcos pa'i skrul tshig yin1byang chub/ byang ba ni dag pa rje dam sbangs pa'am sangs pa/ skrub pa ni rtogs pa' ma rgyas pa'i don/ byang chub gsum ni/ nyan thos kyi byang chub/rang rgyal gyi byang chub/ theg chen gyi byang chub bcas yin/ kag tu chud pa la yang byang chub pa zer/ba ra tshad/ bya ba'i bar du gcod pa bgegs sogs/zam la phob/ cha ma la phob cig tshar chod cig gtan la phob cigarin chen1 rin pa'am gong chen po/ rin po che ste sga ltar na dga' rgyas sam rang rigs kyi gartsa bo'i don/chun po/ 'phreng ba'am bam po/zabs cig spubs cig phyogs cig mnyam du la'ang 'jugachur/ chur cig ces gcur ba dang dul ba'i sku rjem tshig gam chur ba/ dul ba/ chur ba/ shong ba/chu zheb / chu srid dam dkyus zheng kha che chung sogs/270

za mnyam/ cha mnyam pa/ cha mthun pa'am cha mtshungs pa/chem ma ba/ 'od 'bar tshul/ sgra sgrog tshul/chibs pa/ bzhon pa/za/ zung /chibs/ chibs shig ces pa zhon cig la 'jug ste bcibs pa'i skul tshigachogs/ chog ba shig bcags pa dang snam bu bcag pa'i skul tshigasrog chags/ srog dbang chags pa gnas pa'am ldan pa/zab zag chag chag btab pa ste sa la chu gtor nas rdul mi ldang bar byed pa/chal mar brda la/ thang la bkam pa/dbye 'od/ sho dang sngon gong mas sprad pa'i gos shig gi ming dang sngo cho lo/che be che ge mo gang zag gi spyi ming la 'jug pa'i brda/za rkyen/ mthun rkyen/zad/ chad pa— bar ram rgyun chad pa/ zad ba chod/ khrims kyi chad pa bka' nyes lus chad rgyu chad sogs/ cho da cig gcod pa'i skul tshig yin/chub ma/ khyim 'dzin ma'am mdza' mo/chol/ chol cig nor bcol ba dang sems 'chol ba'i skul tshigazang chems/ chab khang dang chang bzi/che chung / rgya sogs che ba ni yangs pa dang chung ba ni nyung ba sta bu/zugs su chud/ thugs su chud pa/ don rtogs pa/ bar du chud pa/gnas su chud pa/ shong ba/mthar tshags1 rim pa/271

zags chogs/ chags su chogs shig bcag pa'i skul tshigachir gyis chi rda/ chir gyis ni bcir tshul/ chi ra cib ni bcer ba'i skul 31ba/chab 'og mnga' 'og chab srid 'og mnga' 'bangs/chom rkun/ chom po jag pa'am rkun ma/ches cher/ shin tu/ thal ches pa lta bu yang /chun/ chun cig /gcun pa dang dul ba'i skul tshigachoms shib bcom pa'i thul tshig dgra choms pa/ dgra da'/ — /chi‘rab shig bcings pa'i skul tshig dang / mdud ching ba// ching 8ga sgrig chings ma/ chi bas byed kyi thag pa lta bu/zab sgo/ khang pa'i sgo/chog chog cig gcog pa 'i skul tshig dang — cho ga bsdus pa'i grong chog sngon chog da chog sogs dang ma chog pa ma tshang ba/tshar chod/ rgol ba tshar chod cig gcod pa'i skul tshigathag chod/ gros sogs kyi ldag chod cig gcod pa'i skul snrog spug chod ba/ nges pa rnyes pa/chug chug cib bcug pa'i skul tshig dang yin du chug yin du rung /cha cho ma chod/ don rtsad ma chod pa/— ha ma go ba1 cha med/ cha rgyus med pa/zas/ chas pa/ song ba/ cha ba/ 'gro ba/ rtsom pa/zan chang / zan ste spags la chang gi ro bro ba yod pa'i kha zas shigam bkab ma zad/ 'bras dang nas sogs kyi chan 'bras sogs btsos pa/chab nas chus/ chab ni chu yi zhe sa'i tshig yin/ chab gtor/ chab bran 272

sogs la'ang 'jug chus shig ni lag gcus pa dang / chu bcu ba'i skul 31bkacha lab / rol mo/ che ba'i zad/ nyal chas sogs/che zhe/ sring mo che ba'am phu mo'i ming /zad ba / cha lugs/cho rigs/ cho 'brang ma'i rus te rigs kyi rdon/ka rjeb ma ba / chu da zos pa/ chud gsan pa/ 'phro brlag phyin pa/da ba ba dka zadang / gzhan la 'go ba'i nad cigad ba dkab bka' shog gam spring yig ga ma shog bu/ba che ba ba / zhal chems/ 'chi khar smras pa'i 'phrin nam skad cha/chig rkyang / gcig rkyang pa/ gcig bu/da ba / chong zhig yid la bcang pa'i skru/la tshigabag zab ba/ba / bag shul lam cung zad chab/sa pa/ gnas pa'am nyal ba/bod skad kyi nges tshig 'di ltar da thad dam dpyad/ sgra ldar na rjes su nyal ba'am gnas pa'i don/cho 'phrul/ rdzu 'phrul la zer zhing sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis thu steg pa'i ston pa dag rngu 'phrul gyes pha ma pa ra byas pa'i dus chen la deng skabs cho 'phrub spon lam chen mo zer/cho re 'don1 ngud mo 'don pa'am ngu 'bod byed par zer/za ga ba/ dbyar dus su sgra dang bcas te cung zad 'phur nus pa'i srog da ba/da ba/ sna zhib/273

mchamachog rma da byung ngam mtho ba'am rab tu goyi bas mchi/ skyabs su mchi ba/ 'gro ba'am yong ba/ mchis pa/ mchod/ mched pa/ bstod pa/ 'bul ba/ bzhes ba / bku ra ba/ma chis mal/ mchis pa ni ga nas pa'i don dang 'du ga pa'am yo da pa'i don yin/ mal ni ga nas kyi don/ mchil mal ni/ yo da pa'i gnab1/ 'dug pa'i gnas la gomachil lham/ dug sbrul gyi mchil ma ni dug sbrul gyi kha chu zer/ rtswa sngon la gos pa las skyob pa'i kang lham la mchil lham zer ba dang / lha ma ste lham spyor komachig rang da thag sog ba kyi sgyu sa gtun/cha chis gu yas gtun/glu mched/ sku las mched rwa— byeb/ shing 'phel ba'i zla po ste spu na zla dang /grogs mched/ rdo rje'i mched po so gas kyang /mar zad/ dpung 'og bam nye 'gra gyi don/mches zab sna chung ma/ba lha tshad/ rgyan pris ma chor pa/ mji sa pa/ gzab ba mchir/ mcho ra po1 ma chor chab) /ma chi ma/ mig chu'am spyan chab/da rngub ba da / kha chu(rem ljags mchil —mtshir nga / khog nang sga mcher pa/ kha mdog sngon po/274

mchin ba/ khog nang gi mchin pa/ ka mdog dmar po/ de gnyis ni don lnga'i nab gses/ don lnga ni/ snying dang / glo ba/ mchin pa1 mcher pa1 mkhal ma'o/ /'dil mchu/ zhal ni kha'i zhe sa'i 8ga mchu ni kha'i mchu gto 'am mchu sgros/kha mchu/ kha'i yas mas kyi mchu gto 'a go yang gzhan zhig ni kha mchu zer na rtsod pa'am 'khrug pa la gobaka' mchid/ 'be' gtam mam spring yig mched ces pa gtam mam bshad pa/mchis/ mchis pa ni yod pa'am song ba/mching bu/ mdog sna tshogs shing ljid med pa'i nor bu phal pa1rgya mtsho'i mcher / rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i mching ni dkyil mam dbus kyi don/rtswa mchog rtswa ku sha 'dzad yi rtse mo/me mched/ me mched pa/ me 'bar ba 'ad 'phel ba/mchi‘sna pa/ byi'u nas zan nam khang byi'u/ 'dab chags bcu gcig pa yi kun/da chob ba / mchongs pa/ rtsal gyis 'phags pa'am 'phar te 3dgro ba/gzhu mchog gzhu yi mchob ma ni rtse mo/ji ma'i mtshan bu/ sgyu ma mkhan te mig 'phrul mkhan spyi slob ma'am slob bu/ra/ gzhung gi dkyus dang nye bar don gsal byed kyi yig chung / mchan bu/216

ba rngub ba ba / / lcags kyu la'ang 'jugamachems/ rigs rus kyi bye brag dang bsam yas mchims phu lta bu1bsgyubaspyod ba kar 'a bad/ chos ( sogs pa mi gzhan la 'chad pa'am bshad/ pa/khrim sa 'cha'/ khrimad/ sogs 'cha 'a ba bca' ba/'chag sar 'chag kabs kyis sam rta sogs 'chag pa'i sa der 'chag pa/bcag ba/ ba/ dpe ra na/ lda ngas rgyas kyis zhabs bcags spyong lta bu ni sang da rgyas phebs myong ba'i rdon/chub4 'chos/ sted pa dang bkur bsti yi don du tshul lam khri3/sa pa zang po de rang dbar 'chos pa'am ba cos pa ste nyen sna ngas 'chos pa— nad 'ches—/ rgyud 'chos pa lta bu/bar ba bam ba / gar 'khrub zin pa/srog 'chad/ srog dbang 'chad pa/ 1dgag pa/ rgyun 'chad rwa cha rkyen 'chang pa/'ji) / 'chi ba/ srog 'do༄ ba dang me mnal ba/'chums la/ 'dod pa la 'chum sa pa chags pa'i don/ga/sa 'am 'a/ gnas 'cha' ba 'dug sa bzo ba/'chel pa zhen pa'i don yin ngar snang /'chur/ 'chur ba/ gnas su gcur ba/bar la pa/ gtad so med pa'am mi brtan pa'am khungs me da pa'i don/shes rab 'cha(ka ba/ tshul khrims 'chal ba/ —da chal po sogs /2 6

'char sgo/ sems kyi 'a ra ba'i sgo/ 'char tshul lam dran tshul/mi 'chags/ mi 'chags pa/ sdig pa mi bshags pa/'am ba/ 'chab pa/ bcabs pa'am sbod pa/nyi 'am ra/ nyi ma 'char ba/ dus chen 'char ba/ sems la 'char ba sogs —shar ba'am yod pa'am 'byung ba ste 'char ka 'char lo sogs/chu 'chor/ chu la sogs pa 'chor ba ni rtel ba'am shor ba'i ngon/las 'chol/ ba/sa ka gzhan la 'chol ba/ bcol ba'am byed du 'jug pa/ nor rdzas 'chol ba yang /'chun/ 'a chun pa/ stobs kyis gcun pa'am bzo lta bzos pa/gros 'choms/ gros 'choms pa/ 'dun gros byed pa/ gros mol byed pa/khas 'che/ kha yis 'che ba/ khas len pa'am zhal bzhes pa/'ching zhags/ 'ching ba/ bcings pa'am 'khyigs byed kyi zhags pa/'am ba 1 'chang ba/ bcang ba'am 'dzin pa/ yid la 'chang ba'am bcang ba lta bu/ba chol/ gtam 'chol ba/ 'khrul ba dang go rim 'khrug pa/ma chus/ 'chus pa/ yo ba'am 'khyog pa/ yid 7ka 'chus sogs/jiji lta/ chos nyid dam gnas tshul ji lta ba/ phyin ci ma log pa'am ji lta ni dpe'i sgro la'ang 'jugaji snyed/ chos can ji snyed pa/ snang tshul ji sted pa/ ji tsam mam spums cad dam ga tshod yod pa/ chos can zer ba ni/ bshad bya'i gzhi 'am dpe 211

'jog sa'i gzhi la go snye 1 dper na/ bum pa chos can/ dngos po yin te/ 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ zhes brjod skabs brjod gzhi bum pa de chos can yin no/ /de ltar gzhan la yang rigs bka bar bya/ji bzhin gzigs/ ji lta ba bzhin yang dag par gzigs pa/ mig gis lta ba'am shes pa/ji ltar/ gang ltar zer za'i don yin la/ skabs 'gar dpe'i sga la'ang 'jugaji grid/ dus ji tsam mam dus tshad 'dri ba/ji skad spru/ ji lta ba'am ji ltar 'di ltar smra/jo jo / jo lags sam phu bo'am gcen po'i do na/jo mo/ btsun cho/'am gsang yum mam gtso mo/dzo rba/ ga rtsa bo ste jo bo shākya mu ni lta bu dang rje'u rigs kyi rje bo'i don yang yin /ja/ ljon/ (red ba cig ste rgya ja bod ja lta bu —je zhig re zhig gam go rim ston pa'i sgra/jag pa/ chod rku na/ rgyu nor 'phrob bcom byed mkhan/ju po 'phangs/ rdob 'phangs pa/ja hong / mdog dmar ser/ja ril/ thod pa'am dpul ba zhig gam ja 'dab ril bur byas pa/je mthor song / rim gyis mtho par gyur pa/ je rgyas ji rgyas/ ji bzang ji bzang sogs/je dang je/ ji gong 6/ ni dang po'i don dang ji rjes ma ni dbyangs kyi rdan yin/ yang je zhes pa ci dang gang sogs ltar spyi khyab kyi sga ste/ ji yod/ji legs/ ji ldan/ ji lta bu sogs la 'jug278

mji mjal 'phrad/ mjal ba ni thug pa'i zhe sa'i tshig ga mo 'phrad khu 'i don/mjing pa/ lus kyi mjing pa/ ske la ka mjug ma/ rnga ma/ lus mjug las mjug mjug bsdu/mje/ pho mtshan nam pho rtags sam 'dom ba 'a 'jugami ma rjed zhing / mi mjed pa bzod pa ste nyon mongs bzod pa'i sems can byung ba'i zhing / yang na/ chos sprub par zhed mi dgos pa'i 'jig rten te sto 'dzam bu'i gling la me mjid zhing zer/'ji'ajig ma/ rtswa'i bye kag te rtswa bzag ma/'ji ba/ 'dam gyi ming /'jim pa/ 'dam gyi ming /'jags/ 'jags pa/ gnas pa'am gcags pa'am brtan pa/ yid la 'jags pa/ khris 'jags pa/'jig rten/ phung spa lnga'am 'khor ba 1 phung po lnga ni/ gzug ba kyi phung po/ tshor ba'i phung po/ 'du byed kyi phung po/ 'du ke kyi phung po/ rna ma pa ra shes pa'i phung po bcas/ 'khor ba ni/ rigs drug gi sems can rnams phan tshun gcig rtsas gcig la brgyud nas snye ba'am 'khor bas 'khor ba zhes zer/27mi

ma dpag ba / 'gag pa'am nyams pa'am bshig pa'am zhig pa'i don/'jigs ba/ skrag pa/ 'joms/ 'joms pa/ bcom pa'am nyams par byed pa/'jus/ 'jus pa/ 'dzin pa'am rgyab pa'am bsdun pa/'job sha dang shing sogs gris 'jog pa/ gzhog pa/ phra mor byed pa/'jar/ 'jar ba/ bcar ba'am nye bar phyin pa/ma jabs/ 'jabs pa/ gab pa'am gsang ba'am ma tshor ba/ma zad rjed / 'ja' ba/ zhum pa/ nyams pa/ zha ba/ rkang lag sogs 'jas pa'am nyams pa'i do na/'jungs/ 'jungs pa/ ser sna'i don/skyon 'jil/ skyon dang dri ma sogs sgyu jil ba/ bcil ba/ sel ba/'joms pa/ med pa bzos pa'i don/ma che ma/ 'jim pa/ mkhas pa/ legs pa/ 'thad pa/ —re jem po yang snang /ma ju6ba / khyi shigakhrag 'jib/ khrug sogs 'jing pa/ che/chub/ 'then pa/zas 'ju/ zas sogs 'ju ba/ zhu ba'am bzhu ba/'jab / 'jang ba/ 'khru ba'am yang na yul 'jang lta bu/'jud mthun/ 'jud pa 'gro bar mthun pa/ smad 'tshong ma/ 'jud mthun ma / smad 'tshong ma/ 'jordo ma 'jol/ gos ring po'i dbyibs sogs/ 'jol ba/ ring ba/(sgyujo la po/'jo speg yid la 'jo ba/ yid 'phrog gam yid la dang ba 'dren sgyu// zheg 280

pa dga' ba 'phel ba'i rnam 'gur/ba 'jog ba/ 'god ba/ sgrub byed/ gsal byed/ gtong ba/ sa la bzhag pa sogs/'jor bu/ tog rtse/ sa bkog byed kyi lag cha/dbyibs 'jong / dbyibs 'jong mo/ 'jong 'jong / sgo nga lta bu/'a nur/ 'jur ba/ gcur ba'i don yin/'jun/ 'jun pa/ gcun pa/lus 'jam/ lus sogs 'jam pa/ mnyen pa/ rtsub po min pa/'job po/ klu rgyal brgyad kyi bye brag klu rgyal 'jog po/mtsho 'jing / mtsho yi 'jing ngam dkyil lam dbus/'jug 'jug pa— zhugs pa/ bcug pa/'ar ma dbyabs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ ye shes me long /lhan 'jebs/ snyan pa la 'jug pa'i 'jebs pa ste yid du 'ong ba dang mdzes pa dang legs pa la yang 'jugamanyam par 'job ting 'dzin sogs la sems mnyam par 'jog pa/gzhag pa/ rang gi sgom bya'i gnas la sems rtse gcig tu bzhag nas sgom pa/blos 'jam/ mngon sum gyi sngo tshad ma dang rjes dpag gi blo tshad mas 'jal ba/ bcal ba/ dpog pa/ mngon sum tshad mas 'jal ba ni dbang po mngon sum la brten nas dpog dgos pa dang / rjes dpag tshad mas 'jal ba ni/ rtags sam rgyu mtshan la brten nas rtog dgos/tshad 'ar la/ ring thung sogs kyi tshad 'jal ba/ t+ta dang bre dang srang 281

sogs kyis 'jab ba bcal ba/'a dod ba 'jo/ 'dod pa 'jo ba/ 'dod pa ster ba/ 'dod pa 'byung ba/ 'o ma 'jo ba la yang 'jugakhrims 'jags/ khri che—sa ji ltar bsgrags pa ltar gnas pa/ma jam ba / rgya nag gong ma'i go sa zhigam jam ched/ ba/zhung shi yig 'phrin sogs skyel ba'i rkang 'gro'i khrul/ yang na yu sha zhig 'ja' bgeg khang ba 'i rtsi ga skyor/ 'degs byed kyi rten/'ja' tshon/ dbang po'i gzhu/ nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon/srad bu'i 'jur/ skud pa la sogs pa'i 'jur pa/ 'jur bu/ 'jur gong / sgrim ches nas mdud pa ltar gyur pa dang 'jur mig kub /spod 'jib / srod dus kyi 'jing / srod dkyil/ srod ni nam stod kyi cha/ ka 'jums/ sha 'jums pa ni sha rid pa dang / sems 'jums pa ni se mas zhu ma pa—sgyum dman par byed pa'i don/rtsa ba / gnye na nam nye 'brel/ rtsa lagathob ba—spyod ba kun za bsta/ thob kyis 'jal ba ni rang la rnyed pa yong phyir gzhan 1ka mngon sum smod pa ste log 'tsho lnga'i gcig 'o/ga 'tsho lnga ni/ tshul —da chos te ma yin yin khul byas nas byung ba dang gcig kha gab ga ste sprel lad bshad nas byung ba dang gnyis/ gzhogs slo nga ste rgyu btang nas byung ba dang gsum/ thob kyis 'jal pa ste dbang yod btang nas 'phrob pa dang bzhi/ rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba ste chung chung phar sprad nas chan po tshur yong spubs byed pa dang lnga'o/ /28‘

ji rje btsun/ gtso bo ste dad sgrol gyi don/rjes 'jug rjes su 'jug pa/ rjes su 'brang ba/zad rje/ phyag mtshan dang pha lam sogs mi phyed pa'i don dang ha cang mkhregs pa'i don/—rjes/ rtags sam shul lam mtshan ma/ kang rjes/ lag rjes sogs/rje dpon/ ga rtsa bo'am dpon po/lha rje/ 'tsho byed dam sman pa/rjed bsnyed 'os/ bkur bsti'am mchod pa'i 'os/sa rjen/ sa rjen pa/ sa rlon nam sa sgren/sha rjen/ sha rjen pa/ sha rlon pa/ sha spren/ rjen pa/ spreb byed sogs med pa'i don/ rjen zhe yang /rje bar/ rkang pa'i ngar ba/dong /jid/ jud pa/ rid pa'am rkud pa/rngod byed/ brjod bya'i don rjod par byed pa/ ming tshig brjod pa/ rjod byed da— lta ba la sngon 'jug med/snying rje/ thugs brtse ba duX kha 'bral bar 'dod pa'i don/ du—kha ni sdug pa sngab ba bka /ba ba ——ba / phyag rjes/ gzhan phan gyi lag rjes sogs/thugs rjes rjes bskyangs/ snying rjes yongs su bskyangs pa'am skyong ba/rje'u'i rigs/ rgya gar gyi rigs rgyud bzhi ru dbye ba'i nang gcigaḥsnye3

rigs rgyud bzhi ni rgyal rigs/ rje'u rigs/ brab/ ze rigs/ dmangs rigs/ti'/ gyi rdzab / til dang nas sogs kyi rja nga pa/ 'bru gsog byed kyi bang ba/ba/spyodabarjed ngas/ mi dran par brjed pa/brjed byed/ brjed ngad kyis rig pa 'khru/ la ba'i nad rigs shig dang /dran pa gtor byed kyi gdon zhigagazi brjid/ gze byin nam 'od dam zil lam nus pa/ba'i da/ brjed pa/ 'bar ba'am mdzes pa/brje brjes/ brje ba dang brjes pa ni bdag gzhan rje ba dang / bzang ngan rje ba so gas/ brje ni ma 'ongs pa dang / brjes ni 'das pa/ rje ni bad jig pa /ma brjed/ ma brjed pa/ dran pas ma bskyud pa/brjod bya/ bshad bya'i don/brjod/ brjod pa/ bshad pa'am gtam gyi ming ste brjod pa mang / gtam mang lta bu'o/ /11bsnyel 11ngab / yu' gyi sngongs/ gnas sam yul sde/ljang bu sgyung ba myu gu'i don/284

ljan jin khrod/ mi gtsang ba nyal nyil khrog ljon shing / ljon pa'i shing / kang 'thung yang zer/ ldid/ lci ba'i don dang lci yang gi ljid lta bu/ sman ljongs/ sman skye ba'i ljongs/ yul lam gnas/ bod smongs la sman ljongs yang zer/ ldang / ljang gu/ kha dog gi khyad par5/ ro 'dzin ldags/ ro drug 'dzin po/ lce la bzug pa'i zhe sa'i tshig ljags/ro drug ni mngar ba/ skyur ba/ kha ba/ bsko ba/ tsha ba/ lan tsā ba bcas/mnyanyams rtogs/ nyams ni/ rang gis nyams su myong cha'am spyong ba'am nus pa'am rang bzhin nam ro ste sgom nyams/ rang nyams/ nyams can/ sgeg nyams sogs/ rtogs pa ni shes pa'i don/nying khu/ yang khu/ khu ba'i yang khu'am khu ba'i khu ba ste nying 'khrul/ nying mag ni yan lag gi yan lag ste lus kyi yan lag rkang lag dang rkang lag yan lag sor mo yin bas de la nying lag zer/nyag gcig nyag ma/ rkang ngam rdog ma/ zegs ma/ skra nyag ma dang rtswa nyag ma ba/cig lta bu/'a ba / nyab pa/ lag pas len pa'am reg ba'am 'dzin pa/ba da / slob ma/nyag mo/ a phyi'am bud med/nyis 'gyur/ nyis ldab/ nyis brgya/ nyis ldan sogs/

nyung / nyung ba/ nyung ngu / nyung zad/spu nya ga spu dang skra sogs nyag ma/ kang ngam rdog ma/nyab btab / ljan ljin/ mi gtsang ba/stan ste/ bab/ nya yi lto za ba/ pū nyi ba dang nya pa sogs/nyam0nyes/ nyam thag cing nyes par gyur pa ste nyes skyon/hon mongs/ kun nas nyon mongs pa ngal bar byed pa ste nyon mongs las skye ba'am tshe'i kun nyon gsum mo/ /kun nyon gsum ni/ nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa/ las kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa/ skye ba'i kun nas ton mongs pa bcas so/ /bstab bad / dka' las sam 'o brgyal/ nyam nga ba/ nyam thag par gonye/ snye ba/ thag ring min pa/ yod pa dang mtshungs pa/nying sha/ bsad pa'i nyin gyi sha'am nye du'i sha'i ming /nyod pa/ zas sam kha nyod pa/nyes 'byung / nyes pa 'byung ba/ skyon 'byung ba/nyen/ spyong ngam nye ba'am mnar ba/nyam drodaka'akhos chung ngam stobs chung / snyam bganyin mtshan/ nyi ldan gyi dus la nyin mo dang zla ldan gyi dus la mtshan mo/btab / nyal ba/ gnyid log pa'am gnas pa/nyams dga'/ nyams su dga' ba/ yid dga' ba'i don/nying dgos/ dgos pa'i yang dgos sam dgos pa'i nang gi dgos pa/ yang na dgos pa'i gtso bo'am ched du bya ba ste gnas skabs kyi dgos pa dang mthar thug gi dgos pa gnyis las mthar thug gi dgos pa ni nying dgos/28/)

nye bar hon/ legs par nyon/ kha ma nyon/ rna bas nyon/blos nyug spo sa kyi dri 'byug pa/lag nya1 'dul ba'i brda chad cig ste/ byin len ma byas par g.yos su spyor ba'i zas la reg pa'o/ ster mkhan med par len pa/nyan thos1 chos sangs rgyas las nyan cing gzhan la thos par byed pa la nyan thos zer zhing theg pa gsum gyi nang tshan nyan thos theg pa zhugs pa'i gang zag nyams/ nyams pa/ mi mthong ba/ rgud pa/ lhung ba/ mnar ba/ mi nus pa/pho nya/ bang chen nam pho mo'i bar du 'gro 'ong byed mkhan pho nya mo sogs/nyi ma/ nyin byed dang nyi ma'i gnyen dang nyi 'od sogs/nyen kor/ nye 'khor du gostan shad nya yi sha/nya ga 'jal byed dam tshad/nyi shu/ grangs ka nyi shu/ nyos/ rin gyis 1 ba dang / nyos shig kyang /nyang tor nges bar/ mtha' gcigachu nyob chu sogs nyog pa/ mi dngas pa/ mi gsal ba/nye reg nye bar reg pa ste khrus kyi khyad par/nya ba / sngar bod kyi nyang zhes pa'i rigs rus shig dab / de sdod yul gyi sa cha'i ming la nyang dang de'i chu klung ma nyang chu zer/nye gnas/ slob dpon gyi nye ba'am drung du gnas pa ste slob ma sogs /nyug rum/ sngar rgyal po'i btsun mo srung mkhan skyes pa cheg phyung pa/nyan da1 nyan cing rna gtod pa/ pho nya sogs/281

nyid/ kho na/ 'ba' zhig nges bzung gi smra'am 8ga phrad de gzhan ldan soṭa gcod pa'i sgra/nyag zan1 mda'/nya rgyas/ zla ba nya gang ba/ brtso lnga'i zla ba lta bu/ba/rtand lung gnyen/ rgyab dpung gi gnyen pa/ rtsa lag ste mgon skyabs/bshes gnyen/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ste/ bla ma dang slob dpon sogs/gnyis/ grangs kyi khyad par/gnyen/ gnyen pa/ phan byed/ nye du/ rtsa lagab/nyam da/ba / gnya' bar dgal ba'i shing / rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing / gnyam shing gang tsam lta bu/gnyer pa/ don nam rdzas gnyer mkhan/khro gnyer/ khro ba'i gnyer ma dang rgas pa'i gnyer ma/ma mam gnyan/ bka' gnyan pa'am po/ bka' btsan pa'am po/gnyan nad gnyan bur sogs kyi nad dang gnyan kha yang /dud 'gro ba nyan/ dud 'gro'i bye brag gnyan zhes pa ri dwags shigaganya' bo/ dpang po/don gnyer/ don du gnyer ba/ 'dun cing 'jug pa'am len pa/gnyan/ rus ming ste/ gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab/gnyags/ gnyags yang rus ming ste/ gnyags khro na ku mā ra/gnyes/ rus ming ste/ gnyos kha rag sgom chung lta bu/288

gnyid/ dbang po nang du sdud pa/ gnyid mthug po log pa lta bu dang nyal ba gnyid kyi ming /gnyen po/ spyong byed dam 'joms byed/ zhi byed/ gnod byed la sogs par 'jug gnya' lhag gnya' ba/ ske'i rgyab cha/ stag pa ni ke rgyab kyi steng cha dang gri stag ltab/ chu/ gnyur1 gnyul ba/ 'tshol ba'am so btsugs pa'am bya ra byed pa/ gnyi gzer/ nyi ma'i zer/gnyig nu lus/ gcig tu lus/gnyong chung / stobs chung ngam srad chung— /gnya' rebs/ lang shor ram dred pa'am gyong ba/gnye che / nang khrol rgyu ma zhiganyag po/ phred kyi kong mo'am shur shur/ba ste/ba/ dma' ba nyid/gnyug ma/ ma bcos pa/ rang bzhin/ gnas lugs/ 'dod ma'am gzhi ma/zhe rtanache nyan ba / gru pa'am skya ba 'dzin pa/thugs mnyes/ thugs mnyes pa/ dgyes pa'am dga' ba/da bab mnyam da/ rna bas sgra mnyan pa/ mnyan bya ma 'ongs pa/ nyan pa/mnyed dang mnyes/ de gnyis 'phur ba/ 'dzoms pa/ rdung ba/ sbrus pa/mnyen par byed pa/280

ba/ mnyen pa / snyi ba/ 'jam pa/ dul ba/ ba nyam da da da/ sngar rgya kar gyi grong khyer chen po drwag gi nang gseb1 zheg bcu dir ston pa lo ster bzhi bzhugs/mi nyam ga 'dig ting nge 'dzin la khums mnyam par gzhag pa'am 'jog pa/sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa/mnyam rmed/ 'dra zad pa/ zla med pa/mtshur ba pa'i ma bka/ mtshungs ji1'i don can gyi mnyam pa/ skyon yo na dang /ring thung / lci yang sogs mnyam pa1ra ma rme/ sman rtsa ba lnga'i ba/cigab nyib ma/shin/ mnyes pa'am snyi zhing gshin pa ste che dza' ba'am grogs/rnya'adam stog 'daka/ dang chu sogs kyi smog ma/ rtog ma/ mi dwangs pa/ mi gsal ba dang / 'dam gyis rto ga pa/snyer ba bkur / rted pa ni nor rdzas dang bkur ba ni mchod pa' ma dam par brtsi ba'i don/ rnyed 14 ni 'thob pa dab 1mang na byung ba la'ang 'jug /ba/sar rnying / gsar pa dang rnying pa/rnyed/ rnyeng shā/'am 'thob pa/ byung ba/da ba/ kha nang gi so'i sha/lhang da/ mi gtsang ba/ rlag mo/blo ba / 'khru pa dang ga ni rnyi'am rgya/rnyi/ ri dwags 'dzin byed kye rgya/kyi90

lhang rnyid/ lcang lo tsha bas rnyid pa/ rlon kyang min par skam shas ldan pa—ma stob/ ma rnyeb pa/ lag pas ma stob pa/ ba rnyil/ rin chen dbang sngon te in+d+ra dī la'i zur chagarkang pa stob / rkang pa dang lag pa rkyong ba'i don/da/da/ 11zad/ sngo sman zhig yin/snying po/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ gtso bo/ sba ba/ rnam g.yeng /— rang bzhin/sba ba ni pho mo'i rtags la zer bas gtso bo'am snying po yin pa dang / rang bzhin ni phyi rol gyi grub mtha' smra bas rdul mun snying stobs gsum cha mnyam pa'i gnas ka bas kyi rtsa ba'i rang bzhin zer ba 'bras bu spums cad kyi rgyu byed pa shi na tu lkog gyur zhig yod pa de snying po'am rang bzhin zer/snyid mo/ pha'i sring mo 'am zhung po'i chung ma'i don/1)bad / nang khrol zhig ba/ ma sems/spu snyob / spu stol ba/ khong khro skyung ba'am khong khro bcag pa/zang snyol/ chang nyal du 'jug pa'am bsnyal ba dang stol cig rto bu/snye1 snye ma/ 'bru dang 'bras bu'i dog pa/phub snyil/ 'bru phung dang ri rtse snyil ba/ 'joms pa/ bshig pa/ zhig pa/skrod pa dang snyil cigatha snyad/ ming ngam shes brjod 'jug pa'i yul lam kun rdzob/ shes brjod 'jug gsum ni/ tha snyad 'jug par byed pa'i chos gsum ste 'di bum pa yin no snyam pa'i shes pa ni btags pa'i shes pa dang / bum pa zhes pa'i 231

sgrar brjod ji1 ni ba rjod pa dang / bum pa yin pa sa chu skrugs ‘ ra byed par rtso ma pa ni 'ju ga pa yin/ kun rdzob ni rdzun ma ka go zhing spu snyad ni rang gi blos btags pa las don du med pas kun rdzob zhes bya'o/ /ji snyed/ ci tsam/de snyed/ de tsam/bstam pa/ sems pa'am rtog pa'am ltar 1snyems/ snyems pa/ pa rgyal la 'jug zhing snyems cig sta bu skul tshig la'ang 'jugablun med/ snyun pa/ na ba/ nad dman pa dang / snyun med ni nad med/snyun cig lta ka skuka tshig la'ang 'jugasnyan shal/ rna rgyan nam rna shal lam snyan dar/mi/ snyi ba/ 'jam pa'am rgya 'am dwags po'i rus/snyoms 'jug cha stoms par 'jug pa dgu sogs mnyam par gzhol ba'o/cha ltoms par 'jug pa dgu ni/ mthar gnas kyi stsoms par 'jug pa dgu ste/ bsam gtan dang po nas 'gog pa'i bar go rim bstar chags su gnas pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang / stoms 'jug bzhi dang / 'gog rngo 'i stoms 'jug ste dgu'o/ /btang snyoms/ chags sdang bde sdug 'du byed mi byed btang ba'am spangs na sa snyom ‘4'am mnyam par byed pa ste bar ma'am spang blangs med pa'am nyon mongs med pa sogan /snyom las/ le lo'i bye brag/ bde bar zhen nas brtson mi nus pa—/bsod snyoms/ mchog dman bar ma'i bso/da nams stoms pa'am mnyam par byed pa/ ldom bu'am sprong mo/23 rta

lhags khrings/ yun nam rgyun ring ba'am byos shig dang snyugs tsha snyug grang yang /snyeg rjes su steg pa/ 'jug pa'am 'gro ba 'am 'brang ba/snyogs snye snyeg pa 'i skul tshig gam grub mtha' stogs pa yang / grub mtha' dkrugs pa'i don/ snying rje/ thugs je 'am cung zad dam snying sdug lta bu'i ming / gzhan du snying rje ni/ nad sogs sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can de dag sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma zung snyam pa ste/ rnam par 'tshe ba'i sems kyi gnyen po'o/ snyim pa/ lag pa'i khyor ba gnyis sa ma rdo kha sbyar nas byung ba'i tshad dam thal mo/stobs/ stobaka shi lag pas stob pa'i skul tshig stom sa la 'jug min dpyad /stes/ snyes pa/ sngas sogs nyal 3phred byed pa/sgon mobs/ nyon mongs sam nyon mongs par byed pa/snyad 'dogs/ skyon nam khag 'dogs pa/ btags pa/rgyal mtshan snyol/ rgyal mtshan sogs sa la bsnyal ba'am stol cig lta bu dang skyel ba/gtam snyan/ gtam rna bar snya da pa'am 'jebs pa/snyigs dus/ snyigs dus ni dus mthar tshe dang bsod nams sogs kyi dwangs ma rim gyis zad de ngan snyigs su lhags pa'i dus/ snyigs ma ni tshigs ma la 'jug pa dang / dus ni rnyeg ma'i dus lta bu la 'jug skud pa snyod/ skud pa phra sbom stoms por byed pa/ ring du gtong ba/293

gtam stod pa/ gtam 'chad pa/ zas stong pa/ zas kha nas ba/ ra 'jug pa'am blad pa/lha ba stogs/ snyang stogs byed ji/ ni/ le lo byed pa'am nyag— nyag spud pa'am rmug pa lta bu yin nab1/sems snyoms sems stoms pa ni/ mnyam par byed pa/ 'khrung / bde bar gnas pa'i don/pa byedagazugs bsnyan/ me long gi gzugs brnyan/ ba rnyan pa'am po/ g.yar ba'am po dang tshab/za brtan/ sgra brnyan yang gong dang 'dra te brag ca la'ang gogazhan la brnyas1 gzhan la brnyab pa/ rngan chan byab pa/ brnyas thab sa/mtsho —'a brtes mnga' brnyes pa ni dbang thob pa'i ngon/phyag brnyan/ lag g.yar ram lag pa'e tshab snye g.yog 'khor/brnya na po/ kab/ra bo'i don/ba chub / brnyas pa/ g.yas pa'am g.yar ba'i don/gos brnyings/ gos la sogs brnyengs ba1 rnying ba/kha bsnyogs/ kha bstogs pa/ kha 'dris pa'i ma lang shor dang / chug rnyagasnab brnyan / sku 'dra'am 'dra cob/brnyan1 brnyad pa/ ga yar ba/294

bsnya —dge bsnyen/ so thar ris bdun gyi nang gses/ bslab pa gzhi lnga bsrung bar khas len pa'i khyim na gnas pa'i skyes bu/ (so thar ris bdun ni gong du ga sde'i nang du gsal/)bsnyen gnas nyin zhag re'i mtha' can du srung ba'i khyim pa'i so thar sdom pa'i bye brag bsnyen gnas kyi spang bya brgyad ni/ srog gcod dang / ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ rdzun smra/ chang 'thung / khri stan ches mtho/ rtsa gar dang dri rgyan/ phyi dro'i kha zas te brgyad spyong ba/bsnyen rdzogs/ dge speng ste/ rdzogs pa ni srung rtogs mthar thug pa'i yon tan yin la/ bsnyen pa ni de dka spur du bsgrub pa la 'jug pas bsnyan par rdzogs ji zhes bya/bsnyem/ bsnyen pa1 bsten pa/ nye bar byas pa/ 'grogs pa/bsnyon can/ bston mkhan1 bston ni mngon sum ba yod pa 'a ham pas me da zer ba ni bston pa yin/bsnyon dor/ —bston dor zer ba ming tsam dang de'i don ni bsto na btsuṭa pa/bsto na hol1 bston tol zer ba ming tsam ste bston pa/ yin pa la min ‘4ra brjod pa dang min pa la yin par brjod pa'o/ /bsnye na rngo/ bsnyen pa dang nye ba'i bsnyen pa bsgrub pa dpa sbob pa che dz+wa po'i yan ba ga bzhi lta bu/bsnyen bkur/ bsnyen bkur ba/ zhabs tog/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur zhu ba sogs/296 —

phre mor ba ji stel/ zhib mor bsnyil ba/ snyel ba/ 'thab pa/gnyam bsnyad/ gtam bsnyad pa/ stod ḍa4/ bshad pa'i don/bsnyams/ bsnya3 sa pa/ sto mas pa/ mnya6 par byas pa/lag pa bsnyal/ lag pa bsnyal ba/ bsnal ba yang snang ste / pa 1ba1ba/ pa'i don/phyir bsnyi(ra/ phyir bsnyil ba/ phyi rol du bskrad pa'am bten pa'i don/da (ra bab mi rten/ mal du bu sogs bsnyal ba/ stol ba/lhang bzer bsnyigs/ lhung bzed che/nga po'i bdams snyigs sa che/ snyig pa/snyigs mar byas pa//bkyib ba bstab bab / lag pa bsnyabs pa'am stob pa/ reg pa/ba'i1ba gzhi/ bsnyung ba ni na za'i je sa'i tshig ste/ nad kyi gzhi—ba'i na/ bsnyun pa/ snyun pa/ na bar 'gyur ba'am na zin pa/brtsengs/ bsnyengs pa/ 'jigs pa/bstel me / bsnyel pa me da pa/ brjed pa med pa/bsgor/ bstor ba/ nyes can stor ba/ rdung ba'am bshig pa/rtsa byad ba'i bas/ sprad dngos snyung du btang ba'am nyung du btang ba/bsnyen sring / dga' nya skyong ba'i ngon/zas bstod zas bstod rwa1/ stod pa/ kha nas lar 'jug pa'i64 blad pa lta bu dang byin pa'am gso ba/skyu bskub ba(1ba/ mtshon gang ngam mtheb tshig sa dkyil ma nas mtheb rtse bar tshon gang snyug pa'am sprugs pa ni 'byug pa'i don/bste mab pa — stems pa/ nga rgyal lam dregs pa/rjes su bsnyegs/ rjes su snyeg ka/ rjes su 'brangs ba/khro gnyer bsnyer/ khong khro nas gdong gi gnyer ma bkas pa'am bstan pa/296

/snate da ra/ sra ba/ dam pa/ drag pa/ shin tu legs par gote si/ gangs ri ti si/tal mar sob 1 de ma thag par song / yang na ma thogs par song /zad ti/ sman gyi khyad par/ sna ma/tang kun/ sngo go stod 'dra zhing dri zhim can/tig ta/ ti ka'i zur chag ste sum tig sogs/ sum cu tig ta ste thang sman gyi rigs/stod ba / tel dkar nag/ til la snum lta bu/tong tong / snye ces pa'i sgra byung na de dang de zer/tog hog )teb ba / ste'u dang me tel te lcags bsregs te rta sogs la rtags rgyag byed/tog rtse/ 'jor bu/ sa rgo byed/dbyug to/ dbyug pa'am phyag mtshan zhig/gtsug tor/ dbu yi gtsug tor/ spyi tor/thor to/ thor tshugs/sbyi tor/ gtsug tor/tog dpal te rtse mo dang phud dang mchog dang rab sogs la 'jug tog zer ba'i ka bzhig kyang /sku tig rin chen zhig mu ka'i sgra nyams pa/2snye1

me tog pad+ma la sogs dang bsod stoms la'ang go ba dang bud med kyi blo mtshan la'ang gorta spru la/ zas shig gam so rtsi ste/ me lhar bstab bya'i gtor ma /'od hog lo thogartsi hog rtswa thogaza ma hob rin chen gyi sdod dam mngar char sgod dam ga'u/ting 'dzin/ teng nge 'dzin pa/ mnyam par 'dzin pa/ rdo rje lta bu/ sems gzhan la ba yo ba med pa/dkon mchog ta la la/ mdo dkon ka/chob/ ta la la/ sgron me'i rdon dang /'phags pa dkon cog ta la la'i gzungs/ting lo/ zan kong / zan nam spag gyi kong bu chung ngur mar ra 6/ sdum gang rung gis gtams pa'i mar me chung chung /tal tsam/ cung zad dam yid tsam/tig tig med/ nges nges med/yon tan/ skyon min pa dge ba/ legs pa/ khe dang lci yang /'bas hog bsnyen bkur ram drin can la phan pa/nan tan do gal la ma nan tar ram brtso na pa/na za) byung da/ khrims kyi chad pa'am chad las1 bal te/ gal srid/ brtag rwa/ mtha' bzung / gal te na/go'u ta ma/ rigs rgyud kyi khyad par ram shākya thub pa/kha hon/ kha 'don gyi ming tsam/kun ba / ta/ kha ta/ bslab spru/ zhal ta ma zhe bran ga yob/nan tar/ bzang po dang nan tan/298

nya zig kla glo'i yul zhig deng skabs kyi yul dbyi lang /ta ming / rgya nag gong ma ta ming lta bu/ ta zhes pa rgya nag gi skad de chen po'i don te khyodang snang /1nya'i si byu/ go ming /pa te zi rgya nag gong ma'i dge rgan/ri ta dben/ yon rgyal rabs chen mo zhes pa'i don/—ta byub / de rnams bzhi po rgya nag gi go sa'i ming / phyi ma ta hung ni dmar po la'ang 'jugatā zad ṇa/ rta babs te gzhal yas khang gi sgo'i phyi na yod pa'i ka ba rgyan can sogs/ te'u shang snye bya shang shang gis bteg pa'i khri/tam bu ra/ sgra snyan nam rgyud mangs/ting / yon chab kyi snad/ltang shag ting shags kyang snang ste rol mo'i bye braganyo ti/ha ba / de gnyis shing gi bye bragatreb pa da / lce ma'i ming / zhang zhung gi skad shang shang te'u/ bya shang shang ni stod mi'i gzugs yin la smad bya yin pa/de'i phru gu'am shang shang chung chung la shang shang te'u zer/te te brdub / brdung bya'i rnga brdung / 'on tang / 'on kyang / yin mod/lib hog mig sprib byed/ mig gi steng du thor pa ling ling tog gi rnam pa ltar byung ba/ 299

bka/dab ba nyam da/ nam gzhan rgyun gyi don/bkyi pa5da ba/tam da/ dmigs yul la gtan du bar gnas pa/ sems gzhan 'a/ ma g.yengs shing nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dang ma 'dres nga1ra rtse gceg tu gnas pa'o/ /gtan tshigs/ gtan du gnas pa las —mi 'da' bar byed pa'i tshigs /dper na/ gtan tshigs yang dag ni/ sprub byed yang dag rtags yang dag/ rgyu mtshan yang dag mang zer/garta ma/ gtam brjod pa/ gtam pa ni bshad pa'i don dang 1 gtam la brjod pa yang zer/gtun bu/ mas gtun chung chu nga /ba po 'a / tang/ lag pa la sogs par gtab pa/ gtod pa/ byin ba bka la ba/ phog pa/ gzir ba/ gtad sna/ dzos sngags kyi sgo nab/ gzhan la gnod byed mthu la'ang go/gtun shing / yas gtun/gtubs/ btubs pa/ dum bur gtubs pa/ 'thub pa/brdung gtab rdung 'tshogagatong gtong ba ni rgyab pa'am sbyin pa'i don/ba/ta ra tshad ba/ legs 'bul lam legs skyes/gtang / gtang pa/ sbyin pa/gte ra mjod/ gter ni 'byung ba/nas sam nges par 'dzin pa dang mdzod ni 30()

nor khang /yobs gnyams/ yongs su gtams ba/ gang ba/ gtams ni/ bcol ba dang gtad pa bshad pa'i don la'ang gogator zan/ gtor ma/ 'byung gtor sogs/gtor/ gtor ba/ 'thor ba/ bkam ba/ kha 'thor du 'jug pa/nor gyi gta' ma/ bu lon len pa'i nor gyi gta' ma/gta' ma dang gteb ba/ gta'1 'di gsum bu lon gyi tshab lta bur bzhag pa'i dngos po/gtan pa med/ sgo gtan nam sgo glegs kyis bkag pa med pa/ —sbyin gtob gtang / sbyin pa/ bar ma chad pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba dang gtang ba gnyis ster ba/ 'dor ba/ glod pa/ rgyab pa/gtum po/ khro rngam can nam gdol pa'i don/zhabs gtugs/ kang ba la spyi bos gtugs pa/ 'dzangs pa/ klas pa/thug pa yang / lha chen gtogs 'dod/ lha dbang phyug chen po'i ming gi rnam grangs/gzhan la ga stod/ gzhan 'a rdzas sogs gtod pa/ gtad pa/'bem la gtod/ mda'i dmigs yul la gtod pa/ gtad pa/ gzir ba/dmigs pa gtod/ bsgom byar dmigs pa gtod pa'am bsam pa gtod pa/ gtad pa/ sems rtse gcig tu sems ba dang gtod cig kyang /gte sprug ma rig pa/ rmongs pa/gtol med/ cha rgyus med pa/ gdeng med pa/ nges pa med pa/ spubs med pa/mtshang nas gtol/ mtshang 'bru ba 'a skyon bton pa/301

zag gtar/ khrug gtar ba/ khrag gtsag pa/ khrag 'don pa /chu gnyigs/ chu ding snyum gtigs pa/ thigs pa/ 'bab tu 'jub pa/che/ da/ba ma/tob/ba / se gol gtogs pa ni/ se rgol rgyab pa'i don/ se gol ni lag pa'i mthe bong dang dkyil mjub gnyis brdar nas byung ba'i sgra/bcol ba'i gnyams/ nor brtsol ba'i don la 'jug pa'i gtams pa dang gdam ba/ pa/grangs kyi gtams/ grangs gnas drug bcu'i khongs kyi grangs bco lnga dang bcu drug pa/ gtams dang gtams chen/sgo gtan/ sgo'i gtan pa/ gdan bu'am sgo 'phar/gtib zab/ ka ting dbus kyi mtha' 'am dkyil/ zab ni dpag dka' ba/mun pa gtibs/ spun pa dang spin sogs gtibs pa/ dkrigs pa/tshogs nga / ga bar bu/ dge 'dun gyi snam sbyar sogs kyi sgod/ dra phad lta bu'i dngos po 'jug sdod/spos gsum/ spos reng sogs gtul ba/ spar ba'am bdug pa/ spos spar ba'i don/ ri bo'i gdas/ che chung gi tshad dam bong /mgo gtums/ mgo bo sogs gtums pa/ g.yogs pa/mtha' gtugs/ mtha' la gtugs pa/ zad pa/ thug pa/ bkag pa/bkar ba/khongs su gtogs/ khongs su gtogs pa/ phyogs su gtogs pa/ 'the ba/da dus pa/ brlan pa/gtan la 'bebs/ don gnad dang mthun par byed pa'i don1 30

sgro btags/ bya sgro mda' la don du med kyang sbyar ba ltar med pa la yod par btags pa/ sbyar ba/ bzhag pa/ 'dogs pa'i ngon/ming btags/ ming btags pa ni brda'am tha snyad sbyar ba/ 'dogs pa/kha btags/ lha reg gam dar/ pham par byas pa/btags/ btags pa/ g.yogs pa/ bcings pa/ brgyan pa/ 'dogs pa/sbyir btab / spyir btang ba/ dmigs bsal ma yin pa/ thun mong du btang ba'am thun mong /blos btang / blo sogs kyis btang ba/ gtong ba/ dor ba/sngags btu btus/ sngags btu ba dang me tog btu ba/ tshad ma kun las btus pa/ mngon pa kun las btus pa/ bslab pa kun las btus pa/mdo kun las btus pa lta bu/ btu ba dang btus pa gnyis 'thu ba'am sdud pa'i don/srol btod/ srol btod pa/ lugs ka btod pa/ btod pa ni gsar bzo 'am gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i rdon/ gdan btib / gdan sa la bting ba/ rmang gzhi bting ba lta bu ni 'dings ba'i don yin zhing bting ba ni 'grems pa'am krong ba'am 'dzugs pa'i don la 'jugs bon btab/ sa bon te myu ku skyed byed kyi rgyu la zer zhing dper na/ nas dang gro lta bu'o/ /btab pa ni 'debs pa'i don dang / lan btab pa lta bu ni lan rgyab pa'i don la'ang gobatang bzung / phar btang ba dang tshur bzung byed pa'i klu zhig/ yang sngar (1 ba/ra gyi ri khrib/ da/ ming 61na/bteg bteg pa ni 'degs pa'i don dang — gyen du slong ba/ rgya mar bteg 303

pa ni 'jal ba'i don dang / 'gro ba'i don du'ang 'juga'/zad ba btab / gsol ba btab pa ni gso / ga ba 'debs pa'i don dang 1 zhu ba phul ba'i don yin/7btud/ btud pa ni 'dud pa'i don dang / snye ma'i mgo bo btud pa lta bu sna dgu ba'am thur du kug pa'i don yin/ de bzhin du phyag 'tshal ba ni gus btud pa'i don no/ /ba btab / ba bod/ tha ga pa ste 'thag thags mkhan gyi 'thag sprad kyi bye brag/'thag sha'i so la zer/blo kyib btab/ rgyas btab pa/ rtags kyis mtshan pa'am thel rtses gnan pa1 bza' btung / bza' bya'am bza' ba/ zas lta bu dang btung ni/ btung bya'am btung ba/ skom dang rlon gyi don la gob chub/ btub pa/ bla'am rung ba dang gtubs pa'i don yin jib / bla'am rung ba ni thub pa'i don ste/ dper na/ rta la brgon bla lta bu ni/ rta la bzhon thub zer ba'i don/byu1 ba bsta ba/ba / spu btogs pa/ me tog btogs pa/ 'thog pa'am 'then nas tha dad du byed pa'i don/rgyu ‘bste/zad/ rtsa ba sogs bton pa/ 'don pa/ 'byin pa/ bkog pa/ bkol ba sogs don gcig 61na/bab bka' ba / gro phye mar btags pa'am 'thag pa/ thag btags pa'am 'thag pa/ba tub / btul ba ni las su bkol ba'am las su rung ba dang phom par byas pa/ 'dul ba ni btul ba'i da lta ba/mgrin pa bteg mgrin pa btegs pa ni sgreng ba dang 'degs pa'i don/ 304

ste/mi rtag mi ni dgag sgra'i tshig dang rtag pa ni brtan pa'i don dang / 'gyur ba med pa/ rgyun du gnas pa/ mi nyams pa/ rang bzhin/ zad med/ rgyun mi chad/ mnyam nyid te de rnams 'jig pa med pa'i don/rtab rtab/ brel brel tshabs tshabs dang skrag tshul/ rtab rtab po yang sbyar/dbab rtul/ dbang po rtul ba/ rig pa mi no ba'i don/ brtul po dang rtul gnyis kar 'jugartags/ skyos ma/ mtshan ma/ rgya'am thel tse/ sgrub byed/ mtshon byed/ shes byed bcas kyi don la 'jugami rtog mi rtog pa/ ye shes te sems can spums cad kyi rgyud la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i stong gsal gyi rig pa/ gnyid kyi shes pa/ dbang po'i shes pa sogs te mi sems pa'i don/yid rton/ yid rton pa/ cha 'jog pa'am yid ches pa'i don dang / yid brtan pa'i don no/ /rtog ldan/ rtog pa ni dpyod pa'am dpyad pa'i don dang / ldan pa ni yod pa'i don/rtogs/ rtogs pa ni shes pa'am sems la nges pa'i rdon/rtag rtu/ dus rtag tu/ rtag par/ rgyun par yi don/rta/ mngon brjod la mgyogs 'gro zer/rte'u/ rta phrug gam rta chung ngu /skyes rting / skyes pa rteng ma/ rjes che'am phyi ma'i don/306

rtol gog glang dang ma dzo mo 'dus pa'i be'u/ rtol pho'/ rto04 mo zer ba/rting la/ rkang pa'i phyi rting ngam rting pa/rtod pas bcings/ rta la sogs pa 'dogs byed la rtong 1 zer ba dang bcings pa ni 'ching ba'i don/ rtod spug dang rtod thur sogs kyang ngo / /zad rta/ sman gyi bye brag te1 thang blon gyi rigs shiganyams rtas/ nyams rtas pa/ shed mo rgyas pa/gnas su rtol/ gnas su rtol ba/ gnas su slebs pa/ gnas su 'byor ba/ rnag rtol ba la'ang 'jugamong rtul/ blun po/rtul phod/ snying stobs che ba'am pha rol gnon pa/rten/ rten ba/zhi/ yan lag can te dper na / mi'i gzugs po ni yan kar ga can dang / rkang lag lta bu yan lag/ de bzhin du gnas pa'i don la'ang 'jug pa dang skyos ma ste lag rtags sam phyag rten la'ang 'jug pa ma zad rten ni skyabs kyi don yang yin/rten 'brel/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ste stong nyid/ yod pa zer ba shes bya zer ba'i don dang gcig pa yin zheng rtag pa dang mi rtag pa thams cad la khyab pa yin/ dngos po la de bas khyab pa yin/ rten 'brel ni rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus pa la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung ba dang phan tshun gcig la gcig stos gyis med na mi 'byung ba'i 'bras bu la zer/ dper na/sems can su yin rung skye ba med na 'chi ba zer ba mi 'byung ba dang / che ba zer ba med na/ chung ba zer ba med pa lta bu yin/mchod rten brgyad1 bde gshegs mchod rten/ byang chub mchod rten/ chos 'khor sgyu chod rten/ lha 'bab chos 'khor mchod rten/ cho 'phrul mchod 30kyi

rten/ lha 'bab mchod rten/ dbyen rlum mchod rted/ rnam rgyal mchod rten/ myang 'das mchod rten bcas de rnams la rgyal ba'i mchod rten cha brgyad ces grags/ mchod rten de rnams re res ston pa'i mdzad pa gtso che ba re mtshon no/ /rta babs/ tā ra ṇa ste/ pho brang gi phyi rol tu rta las babs sa'i mtshams kyi sgo lta bu/bya ma rta/ bya yang ma yin la rta yang min pa'i rgyur 'gro ste pho nya'am bang chen nam 'phrin skyel ba/rta thul/ brtsam ldan 'das kyi 'khor lnga sde bzang po ste/ ke sna spyo dang / rta thul/ rlangs pa1 ming chen/ bzang ldan bcas kyi ya rgyal/sgyurta dbyangs/ sngar rgya gar gyi phyi rol pa'i slob dpon yin pa dang phyis su nang pa'i slob dpon gyur skabs mtshan la slob dpon dpa' bo zer/rtog ge ba/ rtog pa po 'am dpyod mkhan nam phyi rol pa'i rig pa smra ba po dang / rtog ge sde lnga 'bar ba ni/ phyi rol ba'i grub mtha' smra ba ste/grangs can pa/ rgyang 'phen pa/ bye brag pa/ rig pa can pa/ gcer pu pa'o/ /mi gtsang nug mi gtsang ba la grags pa'i rtug pa ste/ skyag pa dang rtug dri la 'jug—(1spyod ba / zhed11/ lto ba'am grod pas 'gro ba ste sbyol gyi ming yin zhing / brang 'gro dang sto 'gro dang 'khyog 'gro sogs kyang 'jugami 1
