lhag pa/ sko rgyab kyi steng cha ste/ ltag khung yang zer/de lta bu/ de ltar dang mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra/41 ma byed/ sto bas phye ba'am lto bas 'gro bas bdag gi khyad bar shā4 go ba'i sgraste1 klu dang spru la goste/ ba / lus kyi dbus cha dang sa cha sogs kyi dkyig lam gzhi che:ba bo ma ka/ṭa bka dkalhad mo/ gzigs rma ste ltad mo'i zhe sa'i tshigalha/ lta ba ni mi ka gos blta ba'am yang na lnga ba zhes pa ni grub ched tha' so so'i lta ba'am bzhed pa mi 'dra ba ste/ phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' ku ba'i lta ba dang / nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i lta ba lta bu/ste/ ba/ grod pa'am pho ba'am mngal lam dkyi' gyi don/ste/ ‘ steb / lto chas kyis sam zas kyis sam bza' bya yis/snyir gyis bkab / ltem gyis bkang ba'i tshul ni rab tu ga shā /ldam dngab pa'i don/bur lhab / bu ram gyi ltang dang / mar gyi ltang / tshos kyi ltang lnga bu/ stong zhes rkyal pa'am sgod/'grang ltogs/ 'grang ba rgyags pa'i don dang / bkre rga nga/ ge stogs pa'e don/da ba/ dus kyi khyad par ram sprur ba/ dus 'das pa/ ma ngongs za/da ste/ pa ste bu/da sa/ stos shig/ lta bar byos/ stos pa zhu ba dang phan tshun gceg la gcig stos pa/ ring por stos nas thung thung lta bu'o/ /ltar snang / rgyu mtshan ltar snang lta bu ni/ rgyu mtshan dngos sam yo ma ltar du 30 3

snang ba'am mngon yang don du rgyu mtshan yang dag min pa la zer/ltab chod/ sun 'byin ltar snang te sun 'byin yang dag min pa/jig mthob grub mtha'i lta ba phyin ci lo ga pa/'ing ba/ lhung bar byed pa ste/ nyung ba sde lnga sogs stung ba sde lnga ni/so spur gyi dgag pa'i bslab bya lhung ba sde lnga yin zhing de dag ni pham pa dang / lhag ma/ lhung byed/ sor bshags/ nyes byas kyi sde bcas lnga'o/ /lha rje ba pa zad/ ltas ngan pa'am mtshan ma ngan pa'am rtags ngan pa ste mi legs pa'i don/ lha ci smos/ chos lta zhog srid kyang mi shes zhes pa'i lta lta bu dang ci smos ni bshad ma dgos pa red zer ba'i don/lteng rkyas/ shākya thub pa'i nye 'khor gnas brtan 'od spung gcen gcung gsu34 gyi bgres pa stong rngus 'od spung ni mu stogs pa'i grub mtha' dor 4 sa —ka ku thub pa'i zhabs la gtugs te nyan thos su gyur ba yin/ khong gi pe/tshan la snyeng ka rgyas pa'ang zer/steng mad char chu 'khyil ba'i gshong bu/—lhom bye ba gang / lter gyib/ gang pa/ rab tu gang ba/re— rnye ba/ re ba'am blo stos pa dang gtad pa/lha sgyur ga ja lta rgog byu bsnang red lta bu ja phar zhog chu yang med zer ba yin/mdar li sto nga mda' yi stong ka ni gzhu rgyud dang sbyar rgyu'i kha/ltar sta ra/ dbyibs nar nar zhig dang ma'i mngal du bdun phrag gsum gyi phru shu 'i gam/sa skabs shigalte che/ rkyang / ste3/ sgyung re zug te/ mi/ brtan pa'am ma tho ba dang dma' ba'i don/309

staston ba/ bstan bya ma 'ongs pa/ ston pa da lta ba/ bstan pa 'das pa'i tshig/ston pa po'i don 'a'ang 'jug te/ lam ston pa po lha bu/bzhugs stang sa/ bzhugs pa'i stangs ka ni 'dug tshul lam sdod tshul/bkur ste stobs/ bkur ba'i yul du sti ba'am gnas par byed pa ste mchod pa stobs shig/ byin cig rol cig byos shig lta bu/stes dbang / stes sam stabs legs/ stes dbang du byung ba ni rtsol ba mi dgos par rang bzhin du byung ba/sku stegs/ chos lugs thad phyi nang gnyis su dbye ba'i spru rol pa thams cad la byu stegs pa/ byad stems/ ngan sngags kyi mthu gtad dam dmod mo/snyed bsnye/ mi gnod dam mi skyon/lha stangs/ mig gis lta stangs sam lta tshul/me stag me tsha tsha'am me tshag dang lo khams me stag/ /stegs/ stegs bu/ gtor ma 'jog sa'i stegs bu'am rkub 'jog sa'i stegs bu lta bu sogs/sta gon 'og grabs sam gra sgrig dngos gzhi min pa/stong grogs/ phan pa 'i rogs/sha stag 'ba' zhig/ kho na/ de kho na/ de 'ba' zhig lta bu'i don dang /rkyang rkyang yang 'thad/gcogs stegs/ zur mig 'jo sgeg mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur la go ste/310

sgeg nyams ldan pa'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur lta bu'o/ / stangs stabs/ gom pa 'dor tshul lam gom pa spo tshul dang / lus po'i stangs stabs ni lus po'i byed stangs/ sor mo'i stangs stabs ni mdzub mo'i byed stangs lta bu'o/ /sta zur/ dku'am dpyi mgo ste lus po'i smad kyi cha shas shig dpyi 'go yang 'jugaston/ mig la ston pa'am bstan pa'i don la go ston pa ni dus da lta ba'i tshigastag shing stag pa'am shing gro ga ste shun pa'am spags pa can gyi shing /ba khrod/ stug po/ mthug po/ sra ba/ gar ma bcas la go ste/ dper na/shing nags stug po'am mthug po lta bu dang / mnyen pa min pa ha cang mkhregs pa'i don dang sla min gar ma yi don la 'jug khrod ni dbus sam dkyil la gostobs cam/ nus pa'am shugs ldan pa'am yod pa la go ba dang / ye shes can te ye shes yod pa'i don la gostag gcan gzan zhig ste/ sder mo ha cang no ba'i sems nun zhig yin/dgra sta/ dgra bo 'joms byed kyi sta re/sta re/ shing gcod byed kyi lag cha/ste'u/ sta re chung ba'am tel pa ste/ shing bzo bas bed spyod gtong ba'i lag cha'i ming / stor/ stor ba/ 'bor ba'am rlag pa'i don/star zhun/ shing star bu'i zhun ma ste/ sman star thog gi khaṇ+ḍa/ khaṇ+ḍa ni legs sbyar gyi skad yin zhing dum bu zer/ sman gang zhig chur bskol nas khu ba gdus pa'i dwangs ma gar por gyur pa la zer/311

star ga star ka'ang zer te/ shing 'bras shig la go ba'i ming /ston mo/ dga' ston te/ mig gi dga' ston lta bu mig gi ston mo dang /gsol ston te gsol tshig gi ston mo lta bu/ster/ ster ba/ sbyin pa/ sprad pa'i don/stod 1 lus la sogs ba 'i stod ni dkyil yan chad la grags/ lung pa stod smad dang gzhung lugs kyi stod cha dang smad cha'i stod yang de ltar yin/stan/ stan ni gdan la go zhing / stan la bzhugs ni gdan la bzhugs zer ba'i don/11/ mo mtshan nam bud med kyi mtshan ma/ma ston/ ma ni dgag sgra'i tshig dang / ston pa'i bye brag ste/ dge rgan sten pa'am ston cig lta bu ni dge rgan dang 'grogs pa'i don/ sten cig yang snang /ston dpyid/ ston ka dang dpyid ka gnyis dus kyi khyad par/ ston ka'i ston la da drag yod pa yin pas phyi ma'i ming mtha' yang pho 'dren pa ni rtags mtshungs 'dren pa yin no/ /gab stong / bang ba ni 'phel ba'am gtams pa'am skyes pa'i don dang /stong pa ni 'grib pa'am 'bri ba'am nyam pa'i don te/ zla ba gang ba ni tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar zla ba 'phel ba'i don dang zla ba stong pa ni tshes bcu drug nas tshes sum cu'i bar zla ba 'grib pa'i don no/ /ya stags/ mdos yas dang stags ni grong tshig —mdos zer ba ni/ bem po'i chos kyi mchod sbyin zhig ste/ ya stags ni/ lha la mchod pa 'bul rgyu dab / mas stags ni/ gdon bgebs rnams la sbyin pa gtong rgyu/stob / stob phrag brgya tsho bcu/ grangs ka zhig312

—stem byed/ stim pa'am 'thim du 'jug par byed pa dper na/ chu sa la stim pa'am chu sa la 'thim lta bu /da stod/ so zing ba/ so thags mi bzang ba/ kha nang gi so gral sgrig po med pa'i don/stor khub / mi gtsang ba'am khrus chu sogs 'bab pa'i khung bu1stang zil/ dngul rdo/ sman gyi rigs/da bas gcig gom 'gros gcig pa/ lhan cig pa/ stabs cig pa/ chabs cig pa bcas don gcig /de bzhin du stabs bder 'bul rgyu la stabs 'bul dang / stabs ka ni thabs dang tshul lo/ /star brgyus/ mu tig sogs star du brgyu ba'am phreng bar brgyu ba/ brgyus pa /steng / steng ma/ thog ka gong dang bla sogs mtho ba'i don/stong pa/ chu zom stong pa/ khang pa stong pa lta bu snad nang du dngos po gzhan med pa'i don/rtsong nyir/ stong pa nyid/ chos sam shes bya thams cad rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang med pas rang bzhin stong pa'am med pa nyid yin pas stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad phan tshun gceg la gcig stos pa'am rten nas 'byung bas rten 'byung zer/brtabartag dpyad/ brtag pa dang dpyad pa gnyis rtog dpyod de 'jal ba'i don/gnas brtan/ yul gyi gnas su brtan pa ni gnas pa'i don dang phyir mi 313

log pa'am mi ldog pa'i don/ bslab pa'i gnas su brtan pa ni bslab bya gang yin pa de la slob sbyong byas nas sdod pa'i gnas de la brtan pa'am gnas pa'i don/ de'ang phyir mi ldog pa yin/kun brtags/ blos bzhag pa gnyis snang lta bu/ ngo bo nyid gsum gyi gcig te/ ngo bo nyid gsum ni/ kun tu brtags pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid/ yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid de gsum mo/ /gzhan dbang gyi ngo bo nyid dang yongs grub kyi ngo bo nyid ma yin pa'i rtog pas brtags pa la kun brtags zer zhing bdag 'dzin kun brtab/sa lta bu/yid brtan/ yid rton pa'am yid ches pa/ yid brtan po/brtad pa/ glo bu ra ba'i dus skabs/ snang med brtad pa zhig la byes nas 'grul pa 'byor pa lta bu/brtul 'ugs/ bya ba snga ma bsdus pa'am spangs nas phyi ma la zhugs pa ste tha mal gyi spyod pa brtul ba'am spang ba nas thun mong min pa'i spyod pa la zhuṭa pa brtul zhugs zer/brtan/ brtan ji po/ brtan pa/ byang chub sems sam 'gyur ldog med pa/spubs brtol/ sgo nga la sogs pa'i sbubs brtol ba/ rtol ba/ i khung brtol ba ni bshangs pa'i don/brtun pa/ brtson pa/ rtun pa yang 'thad/ brtun pa drag po skyes lta bu/sbyi brtol/ phod pa'am ngo tsha med pa/ dper na/ spyi brtol las ngan 'go brtsams lta bu ni ngo tsha med pa'i las ngan 'go brtsams zhes pa'i don/brtabs/ brtabs pa— 'jigs pa/ rtab pa/ skrag pa'i don /yongs 'du sa brtol/ shing dpag bsam gyi sdong po zer zhing / dpag bsam shing de 'i rtsa ba dpag tshad lnga bcu thur du zug pa sa 'og la gnas 314

pa dang / rted pa dpag tshad brgya 'phags pa sa steng la gnas pa da / rtse mo yal ga dang lo 'dab dpag tshad brgya lnga cu ste mtha' bskor du dpag tshad bzhi brgya lnga bcu yod pa lha yul gnas zhes phyi rol pa'i rig pa rnams kyis bzhag pa las nang pa'i grub mtha' smra bas shing dpag bsam —sdong po de 'dra zhig yod par khas mi len/ 'on kyang snyan dngags kyi tshig rgyan la spud chog pa yin/brtag pa/ rgyud kyi dum bu brtag pa gnyis pa ni/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa las cung zad bsdus pa 'bum phrag lnga pa dang / de las kyang btus pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/brtag pa brgyad ni/ sa gzhi brtag pa/ rin po che brtag pa/ gos brtag pa/ ljon shing brtag pa/ rta brtag pa/ glang po che brtag pa/ skyes pa brtag pa/ bud med brtag pa'o/ / brtul/ brtul ba/ rtul ba/ 'dul ba'i don/brten pa/ rten gyi cig shos la gobarten/ brten pa/ rten pa/ gnas pa/ ltos pa/ 'grogs pa sogs kyi don/phur bus brtos/ phur bas brtod pa/ rtod pa/ bcings pa'i don/balhabaltos sa/ bstos pa/ stos pa'i sa/ thub dbang dang pha sogs/ dper na— chos thub dbang la bstos nas byung bas na thub dbang ni chos kyi ltos sa dang / bu pha la bltos te byung bas na/ pha ni bu'i bstos sa'o/ /bltos chos/ ltos pa chos ste/ slob ma ni dge rban la bstos nas byung bas 316

na/ slob ma ni dge rgan gyi bstos chos dang / bu ni pha la bstos te byung bas na/ bu ni pha'i bltos chos so/ /ba lha rung / blta bar 'os pa1ba lha ba / mig gis bltas pa/ lta ba/bsta bya/ mig gi blta bya'i yul/sku ba lhams/ sku bltams pa ni skyes pa'i don dang / jing bu bltams pa ni rjing bu gang ba'i don/gos ba lha ba/ gos dang gdan/ gzan la sogs bltab pa/ steb pa/ ltab pa/nyis ltab/ sum ltab byed pa/bstabasti stang6/ ma chod pa'am gus pa'i don/nge bstud pa/ mthud pa'am 'dud du 'jug pa'am brgyud pa/ bar chad du ma bcug ‘ / bstud ma/ brgyud ma zhes pa'i don/bste gnas/ bsti ba/ ngal gso ba'i gnas/ rgyun du gnas pa'i yul/gnas chen sogs la 'jugab stang pa1 bstar ba/ star ba/ lag len bstar ba lta bu/thub bstan/ shukya thub pa'i bstan pa'am thub dbang gi bstan pa ste/ dam pa'i chos/bstun/ bstun pa/ stun pa/ mthun par byed pa'i don/bstor 'os/ bsngags par 'os pa/ 'phang ste/ khri 'phang lta bu bstod pa la 'jug par 'os/316

bsten/ bsten pa/ sten ji/ dge rgan bsten pa lta bu/bstang ba/ phan pa'am mgon grogs bcas pa la 'jugabastan ba chos/ don med kyi bstan bcos rtsis pas khyon bstan bcos dgu yod pa ni/ don med don log don dang ldan/ thos rtsod grub pa lhur len dang / ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug brngol sbongs/ bstan brtsos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ zhes don med pa'i brton brtsos dang gcig don phyin ci log tu bstan pa'i bstan bcos dang gnyis/ don dang ldad pa'i bstan bcos dang gsum/ thos pa kho na don du gnyer ba'i bstan bcos dang bzhi/ rtsod pa kho na don du gnyer ba'i bstan bcos dang lnga/ grub pa lhur len pa'i bstan brtsos dang drug/ ngan sems dang g.yo sgyu'i bstan bcos dang bdun/ ba rtse ba dang bral ba'i bstan bcos dang brgyad/ sdug bsngal spongs ba'i bstan bcos dang dgu bcas so/ /de dag las don med kyi bstan bcos dang / don log pa'i bstan bcos/ thos pa kho na'i bstan ba~Xs/ rtsod pa kho na'i bstan bcos/ ngan g.yo'i bstan bcos/ brtse bral gyi bstan bcos drug ni bral ba'am dor bar bya rgyu dang / grub pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos dang / don dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dang /sdug bsngal spongs ba'i bstan brtsos gsum ni 'dod pa'am dgos par bya ba'i don no/ /bstan/ bstan pa/ ston pa/ bshad pa la 'jugathag bskungs/ thag ring po dang gos ring po la sogs nye ba'am thung du btang ba'i don/sna bstad/ blo'am gdong sna bstad pa ni kha phyogs pa'am gtad pa sogs kyi don/317

'gro zas bstad/ 'gro ba'i grabs byed pa'am 'gro ba'i grabs gshom pa/rta la sga bstad pa ni/ rta la sga rgyag pa/bsteng tshig rtsub tshig gam 'phya smod kyi tshig bstem pa/ stim pa/ gnyis med du bsre bar byed pa'i don dang / thim pa'i don la'ang 'jugami bste/bas/ mi bstongs pa/ mi phan pa/ mi stong /bstir med/ ngal gsor med pa/ mnar med/mngon bstod/ mngon par bstod pa/ mngon par bsngags pa'am mngon par dga' ba/byin len bstabs/ byin len te gang byin pa de nyid len pa dang / bstabs ni 'bul ba'am ster ba'i don no/ /zabathun mong / spyi'am thun mong ni sger min pa/thu po/ rgan pa'am gtso bo dang phu bo la gob gru che/ yul gru'am rgya khyon che ba/thu mi/ ba ṭa'i rus/ thon mi zhes pa snye mo thon gyi mi yin nga dang ribs rgyud thu yin pas thu mi zhes bsdus pa'i ming 'dra/thor cog dang thor tshugs/ de gnyis ni do ker dang mgo skra ga ste ga tor lta bur gotha ma/ dman pa'am phyi ma dang chung ngu'i don/ba na/ ma mthar/ dper na/ mi lta ci/ tha na dud 'gros kyang shes lta bu/318

jig jig lham gyi sgra/bur/ gyen min za/ thur ma la'ang 'jugatha mal/ phal pa/ rang bzhin/mazamatho ris/ mtho ba/ mthon po'i ris sam mthon po'i phyogs/ mtho ris ni lha yul la'ang gomathong / mi ka gis rig pa/ mthong lam ni/ lam lnga'i nang gses/ kam par grol ba'i 'jug ngogs gang rdeg de kho na nyid sngar ma mthong ba gsar du che/thong zhing 'phags pa'i sar phyin pa dang / chos nyid ji lta ba bdag med mngon sum du rtogs shing chos can ji snyed pa'i don yang ci rigs par rtogs pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun bsgoms pas/ spang bya mthong spa nga gi nyon mongs pa da che/bshe rtsad nas bcom pa'i tshul gyis sgong zhing / 'ji gas pa lnga dang bral zhing yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs thob par byed pa'i 'a ma mo mthar thug mtha'i char thug pa/ mtha' la reg pa/nus mthu/ nus 'a 'i dom/ can gyi mthu ste/ stobs dang ngan sngags/mthun/ yid mthun pa/ yi da mtshungs pa/ yid gcugs za/ mthun pa'i don/mi mthun/ mthun pa'i sdog phyogs/lag mthil/ lag pa'i mthil dang / sgod sog ba kyi mthil/ mthil ni/ sto ba'am 'og ge cha'am dkyil lam gzhi lta bu yin/mthe bong / lag pa'i sor rma sbom shos/319

mje'u chung / lag pa'i sor mo phra shos /mthon ga mthon mthib / mthon ga mthon ka mthing ga 'di gsum ni sngon po'am sngo ba ste/ ming mtha' ci rigs drang jing / mthing kha lta bu la mtheng gi kha dog bsdus kung 'gal ba med la tshul 'di rigs mthun kun la spyod/mthang gros/ dge 'dun pa'i smad gos shig ste/ sham thabs/ chos gos rnam gsum gyi ya rgyal/ smad gos sogs gyon pa/mthug mthug pa/ mthug po/ stug po/ srab po min pa/mthar gyis/ rim gyis te/ mthar gyib ba 'i sbyor ba lta bu/rta mthur/ rta'i mthur mgo /mthur thagamatho gang / sor mo bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang gang ba ni kha tshang ba/mthud/ mu mthud pa/ bar sprel ba/ mi 'chad par byed pa/mtho 'tshams/ mtho 'tshams pa/ 'gran pa'am gnod pa byed pa'i don/mtho btsams pa yang 'jugamathol bshags/ mthol ba mi gsang bar smra ba ste sdig pa bshags pa—sgyum 'chag pa/mtho yor/ mi 'greng pa'am mi langs pa lta bu'i sa rdo brtsegs pa'i tho po/rgya mthongs/ rgya cher mthong ba'i gnas sam dkyil/ khang pa'i rgya mthong ba/ ste/ khang pa'i dbus kyi gseng yangs/mtha' 'phob/ yul dbus kyi mtha' la 'khob pa ste/ mi med pa'i lung stong ngam yang na chos dar myong med pa'i sa cha la yul 'khob ces zer/mtha'/ don drug la 'jug pa/ mtha' drug gi bshad pa/ drang dan bshad pa/nges don bshad pa/ sgra ji bzhin bshad pa/ sgra ji bzhin min ji/ bshad 320

pa/ dgongs pa can bshad pa/ dgongs pa can min pa bshad pa'o/ /de bzhin du rtag chad kyi mtha' sogs ste/ rtag mtha' ni/ chos spums cad rang ngos nas bden par grub par lta ba ni rtag mtha' dang / chad mtha' ni/ thams cad med par smra ba'i mtha' ste chad mtha'o/ /mthib ril/ chu bya zhig gi ming /mthing kha/ mthing gi kha dog ste sngon po dang mthing kha zhes bsdus pa'i tshig go /'aza'abab mo/ 'khrug par go zhing 'thab pa la'ang 'jugam thon/ 'thon pa/ bton pa'am 'gro ba/ mgo 'thon pa/ phyir 'thon khar phyag 'tshal ba la 'thon phyag lta bu dang 'byung ba'i don yang yin/grogs su 'thams/ grogs su 'thams pa/ rta sogs su 'thams pa ni 'khyud pa'i don dang / 'dzin pa'am bdag byed pa/ shi sbar 'thams pa ni/ 'chi skabs rgyu nor sogs lag pas dam por 'dzin pa la zer/sprun 'thibs/ sprin 'thibs pa ni/ sprin 'khrigs pa'i don dang / rig pa 'thibs pa ni/ rig pa mi gsal ba'i don/chu 'thor/ chu 'thor ba ni chu gtor nas 'thor ba dang / rgyu nor 'thor ba ni rgyu nor bor ba'am kha 'thor ba'i don/'thor 'thung / lha la 'bul rgyu'i yon chab/ 'thor zhing 'thung ba ni khrus shigablo bum/ blo 'thum pa ni rig pa mi gsal ba/ lus 'thum pa ni gos sogs 321

kyis lus po gtums pa'i don/mgo 'thoms/ mgo bo 'khor ba1 mi shes pa'i don/du ba 'thul/ du ba'am dud pa 'thul ba ni 'phyur ba'i don dang / du ba gtul ba ni du ba gtong ba'i don/ sha lta bu brtsas nas tshos pa la 'thul ba 'jugasra 'bas/ sra ba'i don can gyi 'thas pa ni mkhregs pa'i don dang / shin tu zhen pa/'bems nan/ nan tan gyi don dang / 'thems pa mi 'phyug ḍa4/ chad lhag spong ba/ kha tshang ba/ mnan pa/ma 'di zad/ 'than po ni brtan po'am nan ngo /chu 'thungs/ chu 'thungs pa/ sprang rtsi 'thungs pa/ ja 'thungs pa/ 'o ma 'thungs pa sogs ni btung ba'i don yin la 'thung yang 'thad1sha nas 'ben/ sha nas 'then pa/ spu nas 'then pa ni tshur 'dren pa'i dan dang / tshan gyis 'khrid pa lta bu'i don yin/ma chub ga me tog 'thog pa/ spu 'thog pa/ btogs pa'am bkog pa'i don/smod tshig 'jing slad/ smod pa'i tshig dang 'thing slad gnyis don gceg ste /skyon 'dzugs pa'i tshig gam 'phya smod kyi tshiga'aben pa/ rngub pa'am 'thung ba/ 'jo ga pa/ phyir 'then pa la 'ju ka'athad/ 'thad pa zer ba ni rigs pa'am 'os pa'am rung ba'am 'dod pa'i don yin ste/ de ni 'thad zhe na de ni 'os zer ro/ /zas 'a ma thu 'dibs/ zas sogs (sha 'du cha rgyab pa'am btu ba/ 'grig pa/tshogs pa/ 'the ba'i don/phye mor 'thag phye mor 'thag pa ni zhib mor btags pa'i don dang /322

'joms pa'i don dang / thags 'jig pa la 'jug pa dang / rang 'thag lta bu'i ming la'ang 'jugazha 'pheb / zha ba ni yan lag nyams pa'i don dang / 'theng po ni gyol po ste/kang pa ring thung mi mnyam pas 'theng nas 'gro mkhan la zer/ zha zhing 'theng ba yang zer/mal gos 'theb/ mal gos ni nyal chas la zer zhing 'theb pa ni lhag po dang lhag pa la zer/'thum/ 'thum pa ni gtums pa'am g.yogs pa'i don/ dum bur 'thub/ dum bur 'thub pa ni/ dum bur gtubs pa dang / tshal bar gtubs pa/ sil bur gtong ba'i don/dgazhan dring mi 'jog gang zag ste gdags gzhi phung po bzhi'am lnga tshoṭa pa la brten nas btags pa'i lus can de la skye bu zer/ pe lta bu'i skyes bu gzhan gyi dring zhes pa tshul lam 'dren pa'am lugs la re ltos mi 'jog pa ste gzhan la rag ma las pa'i don/bka' drin/ sku drin/ phan btags pa'am byas pa/dran/ dran pa/ mi brjed pa'i sems pa/ yid la dran pa lta bu/dril bu/ rol cha zhig /dril bu che ba/ dril bu chung ba sna tshogs yod/dri mchog dri sna'i yul/ dri la dbye na/ rang bzhin gyis 'byung ba'i dri dang /sbyar nas 'byung ba'i dri gnyis yod de/ gong ma ni tsan dan gyi dri lta bu dang / 'og ma ni sgos kyi dri lta bu'o/ /de gnyis re re la'ang dri zhim pa 323

dang / dri mi zhim pa gnyis re yod cing tsan dan dri lta bu ni dri mchog dang dri bzang po yin no/ / de bzhin kha che skyes ste/ gur kum gyi dri ni dri bzang po yin/dra ba dra byed/ dgon pa'i nang gi mchod rdzas shig ste/ mchod rdzas rgyan phreng nar dpyangs khug pa can dang / mched rdzas rgyan phreng nar dpyangs khug pa phyed can/dka byed/ zhogs ji1/phyi dro/ dgong dro'am dgong mo'i don/dri/ dri ba/ zhu ba/ gtam 'dri ba'i ming tsam/dris lan/ dris pa'i lan/ zhus na/ dri ba byas pa'i lan/zad ba dkan/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'angs kyis gdul bya la dming ba/ nas cho sa drang don gyi thog nas gsungs pa gcig dang / nges don kye thog nas gsungs pa gnyis mab/ drang don ni bdul bya 'ga' zhig za༅ don nam bstan pa la kha drang bar bya ba'i don can gyi gsung ste/ nged ngon min pa'o/ /g.yung drung / 'gyur ba med pa'i don dang / rtag pa ste 'jig rgyu med ba'i don dang / bku shis pa'i mtshan ris sam rtabs1drab spong / lus ngag yid gsum ba yo spru med par drang por srong ba ste/dka' ba spred thub pa sogs/drug grangs ka zhigakhrims dral/ khrims dral ba ni khrims 'jig pa'am med pa ngo pa ba'i do na dang / ngo tsha dral ba ni ngo tsha 'joms pa'i don/ chu dral ba ni chu raka ba'i don/324

lham dral/ rtsem mo ste/ sring mo'i zhe sa dang dral po ste/ gcen po'am ming po/ zas drabs/ zas thub pa la sogs drangs pa/ drang ba/ 'brim pa'am 'dren pa'i don/drobs/ drongs shig ces ba drang ba'i skul tshig/ nges pa drongs pa ni nges ba rnyed pa'i don/ de bzhin du zhing la chu drongs shig lta bu chu 'dren pa'i don/ drang po/ bshan po/ mi 'khyog ba/ bden pa'i don/ mda' ltar drang po/skad cha drang po lta bu/ shing drung / shing gi drung ni shing gi rtsa ba dang / zhabs kyi drung ni nye ba'i don nam 'gram du'ang 'jug ste zhe sa'i brda/ drung 'khor te/ srur bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi go gnas shig drung yig ste/ dpon chen gyi yi ge 'bri mkhan/ spun mched kyi drung bcas la 'jugadrel/ dud 'gro'i rigs shig ste/ dre'am dre'u/dre'u jog stan khru bo ni gdan khru khru dang / par tang ste/ drel gyi ze dang 'dra ba'i gdan te rngog stan grum tse yang zer/mon dre dang smin drug de gnyis rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ya rgyal/ba 11ba ba dka/ ma dros pa ni mi dro'am bsil ba ste/ klu'i rgyal po zhig yin de gnas pa'i mtsho la ma dros mtsho'am mtsho ma pham yang zer de ni bod kyi ste/da khub ba spyod/dreg nad/ dreg pa ni nad kyi khyad par ram nang gses/ ——ba ba / nag po chags pa'i dri ma ste lus kyi dreg pa dang / gos kyi dreg pa sta bu dang / ljan ldin te/ mi gtsang ba/326

dri ma/ dreg pa'am dri nag dang / nyon mongs sab— skyon la'ang 'jugakha drag kha drag pa/ /ba mkhas pa'am kha btsan pa 'a/ go ba dang / drag zhan gnyis kyi drag la'ang 'jug de bzhin du sku drag te mi drag la 'jug pa bsten1drag shul/ drag po'i shul dang ldan pa ste/ khro ba'i dam 'gyur la zer/ lus kyi drag shul dang ngag gi drag shul lta bu'o/ /sa la zu da/ sa la gzan nam kos sogs drud pa'am 'drud pa/ spyor nas 'then ba'am 'phul ba lta bu dang / mo mtshan la pho mtshan drud pa'am 'byed pa/ sbyar nas 'then pa'am 'phul ba lta bu'o/drod/ dron mo/ bsil drod de bsil ba drod pa/dro ba/ tsha ba/ dros pa/ gnam gshis dro ba rte bu bsil po'am grang mo min pa'i don/zad rtsad dran/ zan dron mo ni sgag tsha po/ zas dron mo ni sto dro po'am tsha po/g.yos zan te brdzis zin pa'i srugadril/ snye1la ba/ sgong ba ste ril ril byed pa/ sgril ba/ sdeb pa'ad ltab pa'i don dred lngags/ gcan gzan dred rmang gi pags pa ste 'dir gzhi dred mong zhes med na pags pa zhes 'bri ba las la mgo ldan pa'i lngags bris na nor ba dang / ya nga rnam dbye drug pa'i sga yo da pa dred mong gi pags pa lta 4bu ba4 yang la mgo ldan pa'i lngags ni 'bri srol med/ kam dbye drug pa'i sgra che da na la che go can thob pa dper na/ stag lngags/ gzig lngags lha bu'o/ /dras/ dras pa/ gri dang sog 'i/ sogs tus shing 'dra ba'am gshags ji// 'dra 326

ba/ dros shig lta bu/ yang na/ ras 'dra ba'am dras nas gos 'tshem lta bu/drubs/ drubs pa/ 'tshem pa'i don te/ gos chen dras nas snam sbya ra drubs lta bu'am rma kha gso ba'i don la'ang 'jugadres ma/ thag pa sogs bya rung ba'i rtswa zhig ste/ rtswa dres ma/drags/ thag sa drags pa/ thag pas sdom pa'am drogs shig sdom shig dang / yang thal che ba'i don la'ang 'jug ste—/ smra ba mang drag da na yag po ye yod lta bu dang / las ngan byed drags na mtha' ma 'di ltar 'ongs lta bu la'ang 'jugadred po/ gyong po'am ma 'dul ba/ chos dred de/ chos shes kyang nyams len mi byed par sems gyong du song ba'am chos kyis rgyud ma 'thul ba/ zhabs dred lta bu'o/ /dru bu/ sgro gu'i don te/ skud pa'i gru gu'am spun gyi sgro gu'am dru bu'o/ /dra ba/ skud pa 'brel ba'i sdod de/ nya rgya lta bu dang / dra phad/ sgyu dra ste/sgyu 'phrul dra ba ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa zhig dra mig ste/ khang pa'i sge'u khung gi dra mig lta bu dang / rtog pa'i dra ba ste/ dam rtog gi 'ching rgya'am the tshom la zer/drangs/ zhing la chu drangs pa'am 'dren pa/dril bsgrags/ dril chen bsgrags pa/ khrims bsgrags pa/ khyab bsgags byas pa'i don/dra ma/ mkhas pa/ ya rabs/ phul tu phyin pa/ legs pa'i don/gnas su drongs/ gnas su 'dren pa'i skul tshig gam tshogs pa'i don/dregs ba1 kangs pa'am dregs pa/ rgyags pa/ nga rgyal gyi don/321

drung phyung / drung nas phyung ba ste/ rtsa ba nas bton pa'am rtsad nas bton pa/ rtsa ba nas med pa bzos pa'i don/ sun phyung ni sun 'byin pa'i don dang yid phyung ni skyo ba skyed pa'i don/kha yi drog kha skyid pa/ 'tshengs pa ni dod pa 'tshengs pa lta bu dang / tshim pa ni yid tshim pa'am dga' ba'i don/ spyir drog zhes pa glo kur du byung ba'i bza' btung ngam longs spyod kyi don du gond drag nad drag pa/ nad las grol ba'am spur ba'i don/dwa phrug pha ma chung dus nas kha bral ba'i phrug gu /dwa ba'i 'gru/ dwa ba sman zhig dang rgya gro ma lta bu zhig ka go ba'i 'bru ste 'bras bu/bab bdaka drag ba / thal ba'i don can gyi drags pa ste/ bshad drags pa/ tshe drags pa/ chung drags pa— mang drags pa/ nyung drags pa lta bu/gdabadug ba med/ nyi ma sgrib byed dang char pa sgrib byed kyi gdugs med pa/gdong pa/ bzhin ras/ kha mdun/ ngo gdong yang zer/gdugs/ nyin par/ nyi ma/ nyin byed/ khri gdugs sogs nyi ma'i ming gi rnam grangs la gogadubs/ gdungs pa/ nyi byed kyis gdungs pa'am gdung pa ni/ tsha bas mi bzod pa byed pa'am tsha bas mnar ba'i don/ gdungs nga ni mnar ba'i don yin/bdon lhar/ gdon ni mi ma yin pa'i gnod byed mkhan/ ltar ni dpe'i sgra/328

gdug pa/ ma rungs pa dang mi bzad pa'i don te/ sems can gdug pa can lta bu ni/ sems can ma rung khog bcangs byed mkhan/gdol ba/ rgya gar gyi rigs rgyud kyi nang tshan dmangs rigs ni rigs rgyud dman pa zhig yin la de'i nang nas kyang gdol pa rigs ni de bas rigs rgyud dman pa zhig gogadul/ gdul ba/ btul ba'i ma 'ongs pa/ dper na/ gdal bya sems can de dag 'dul byed ston pas btul ba lta bu/gdams ngag gdams bya'i ngag ste/ phan pa'i ngag gam bslab bya'i ngag go/ gsal gdab/ gsal gdab pa ni/ yang yang bskyar ba'am skyor nas brjed du mi 'jug pa'i don/ gdab sna btab pa'i ma 'ongs pa/gding ba/ dge tshul slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum gyi gcig ste/gnas mal bskyab pa'i phyir du gnang zhing / tshad ni srid du khru gsum dang / zheng du khru do sor drug yod pa'i rab byung gi stan gyi bye brag mal chas sogs gding ba ni bting ba'i ma 'ongs pa/gdan/ stan dang gdan bu dang / gdan 'dren te/ ched du 'bod pa'i zhe sa'i tshig dang / gdan sa ste/ bla rabs rim par byung ba'i dgon pa/gdu bu/ lag pa dang kang pa/ dpung par 'dogs byed kyi gdu bu ste/ mdzes rgyan zhig yin1 rgya gar du kang lag dpung pa bcas par gdu bu 'dogs sro yod kyang bod la lag par ma gtogs gdu bu 'dogs srol med/gdang / gos la sogs pa 'gel sa'am dpyang spug ste/ steng nas thur du btang ba'i thag pa/ de bzhin du 'dre gdang sogs/ gdung ma/ ka ba'i gdeg bya/ khang pa'i gdung ma rto bu/gdags/ gdags pa ni btags pa'i ma 'ongs pa/ dper na/ ming gdags 329

bya gang yin pa btags pa'am 'dogs pa dang / rta sogs gdags bya dang 'do gas byed/ btags pa lta bu dus gsum gyi khyad par1 gdung / gdung ni rigs rus sam 'phel gdung ste skyes bu dam pa'i gdung rus las byung ba'i ring bsrel/skad gdangs/ skad kyi gdangs dang sgra'i gdangs ni dbyangs la ze ra /skas kyi gdang / 'dzeg pa'i skas kyi gdang bu/ skas rim mam sha them yang zer/gdub brgyud/ rus pa'i zhe sa dang brgyud ba4 ni bar mi chad pa'i rdon/gdung 'dzin/ gdung 'dzin pa ni rus 'dzin pa'am rigs 'dzin pa po'am 'tshob pa po/ba/yu ba ba bdab / gsol ba gdab pa/ bdag cag la dgongs nu gsol bar zhu ba 'ab/ bdag cag ston ba khyed kyis 'di ltar yong ba gnang rogs zhes smon lam gdab pa'am 'debs ‘4/gza na / gdon pa ni bton pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i tshig phyir gdon bya: 'don byed/ bton pa lta bu/gnyer gdams/ gnyer ba dang gdams pa gnyis gnyer gtad byed pa ste1 spyi rdzas sogs srung mkhan du bskos pa/bsgyu ba ba ba che sa/ bcol ba gdams pa gnyis gtams pa la go ste/ don gnad mngags pa'am bco(sha ba'i don/rnyed la ba/du/ rnyed pa ste nor la 'du ba ni/ rgyu nor 'a sem sa zhen cing chaṭa pa'i ngon dang / gdu ni gar po'i byed pa'i rdan la dang 'jug ste/ thug ‘/ gdu ba ni thub/ pa gar po byed ji1'i don/ming gdags/ ming gdags pa ni tha snyad gdags pa'am brda sbyar ba la go33(1

gdags pa ni btags pa'i ma 'ongs pa/lhan gdangs/ snyun ni nad kyi zhe sa dang gdangs pa ni drag pa'i rdon/sa bon gdab/ sa bon ni myu gu lta bu skyeb byed la zer zhing gdab pa ni btab pa'i ma 'ongs pa/ dper na/ zhing la sa bon gdab lta bu 'debs pa'i don la 'jugakha gdabs/ kha dang sgo sogs gdangs pa ni phye ba'i don dang / gcan gzan sogs kyi sbar mo gdangs pa ni sbar mo bgrad pa'i don/mtshon gdengs/ mtshon cha gri me mda' sogs gdengs pa ni 'phyar ba'i don dang / mda' 'ben la gzas pa lta bu mda' 'ben la gtad pa'i don/gdon mi za/ gdon mi za ba ni the tshom ci yang med pa'i don dang / 'di rang du nges pa zhes pa'i don/da gdod/ da gzod de/ da lta lta bu'i rjes kyi dus la go ba dang / gzhi nas zhes par go ba ste/ mi 'di bzang po yin pa da gzod shes byung lta bu/da / sa gdab / bde bar gnas pa'am stom las ste/ le lo'i bye brag bde bar zhen nas brtson mi nus pa/gdeb / nges pa'am sbobs pa/ tshad dang yid brtan/ rgyu mtshan dang rtsis sogs 'a 'jug ste/ de ltar brjod pa'i gdeng nga la yod dang / sbobs pa nga la yod/ rgyu mtshan nga la yod/ rtsis nga la yod/ yid brtan nga la yod lta bu'o/ /thob gda'/ thob pa ni rnyed pa'am nor dang gda' ni 'dug gam yod pa'am mngon pa'o/ /331

gdos ba / grwa'i rna ba 'a/ gru'i rlung g.yo ra te gru'i dar po che ni gu'i steng du 'dzugs pa'i rlung 'phog byed kyi ras chen/bud gdar/ thud gdar ma/ mar dang phyur—ba lhan du 1bsres nas bzos pa'i thud gru bzhi lta bu/ mar gdar ma yang yod/srab la gdeg srang ni 'jal byed kyi chad la go zhib gdeg pa no brteg pa re ma 'ongs pa/ 'jal ba'i don no/ —gdags pa'i bstan bcos/ mngon pa sde bdun spyi gcig ste/ cho/'u 'ag ka pyi bus brtsams pa'am bsdus pa1/ mngon pa sde bdun sna/ ba/ cad yod par smra ba'i bstan bcos ga rtsa bo bdun te/ ye shes la 'jug/ pa dang /rab tu byed pa1/ rnam shes kyi tshob/sa/ chod kyi phung po 1 gdags pa'i3 bstan bcos/ 'gro ba'i nom grangs/ /bams kyi tshogs bcas bdun no 1 /gdam nga byed/ 'dam ka byed/ dpeng na/ sngon 'jug sgyu/'am 'a ka nyis bdam nga yin lta bu de gnyis gang 'jug kyang 'grig pa'i don/gdengs can/ gdengs ka can ste/ klu'i spyel po/ gdeng da can ni spru da ba 'ang go ba yin/gdub bya/ gdul bya sems can nam rta lta bu 'dul ba'am ba tul ba/bdan ba ba/bdab/ba 1 'dre srin sogs dam la gdags pa'am btags pa/ba/zhab/ pa/bkab ba/dab / gnas lugs dang yongs grags/ rgya khyab tu dar ba/ gdal zhes ba'ang khyab pa'i don/ba/dod nas/ gdod ma nas zhes pa thob/ ma nas zhes pa'i don/gdags gzhi zal/ ming gdags bya'i gzhi gnas te/ bdag gi phung po lnga lta bu bral med pa/ phung po lnga ni/ gzugs kyi phung po/ cher ba'i phung 332

po/ 'du byed kyi phung po/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po'o/ /gdags gzhi phung po che lnga po tshogs pa'i lus can de la gang zag ces ming btags pa'o/ /gdabs can kun ra/ sngar rgya gar gyi khyim bdag gdangs can zhes pa ni ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sbyin bdag yin la des phul ba'i kun dga' ra bsnyibadabadag nga'am nged dang / spu mi dad kyi gcig/ rang bzhin dbang ba/bden/ bden pa/ rnal ma/ ngo ma/ mi bslu ba/ drang po bcas kyi don/bdud/ 'chi byed/ gnod byed/ bar chad/bdun/ grangs gnas shig/mdun du bdar/ mdun du bdar ba1 mdun gyi phyogs nyid du gral bsgrigs pa/bde1 bde ba/ skyid pa/ dga' ba/ sim ba/bdo/ bdo ba/ dar ba dang 'phel ba'i don/zas bda'/ zas bda' ba/ thug pa la sogs kyi zas ro zhim pa/bdug spos bdug me la bdug rgyu'i spos bdug pa/ bdug bya dang /bdug byed pa/bda' ded/ bda' ba ded pa gnyis rang gi rjes la gzhan gyis 'ded pa'am ded pa'i ming tsam yin/bdag po/ rgyu nor sogs bdag pa po/ dbang ba po/ ba/rtsa bo/333

ba bdape ma/ spru smon bang hru brjes sogs/ bang ba pe zub—ma ded pa / rang —pa— 8za ba 3 —di pa'i kyi rjed ka /bdas zhe / ba da tsā ༅ 1 ded —zin pa'i 1 den /ma de 'a / ka rtsa kab/ ༅ 1 za de snar ra4/ ba zang bar ram legan/ par pa—1she gas pa—ni so nga ba rem rtogs ba ste / rnam rwa/ tha che1sa cad mkhyen pa /shā( —ka (1shā la 8da ba de zhing snye 3 — —1 /dz+wa sko nga snyi ba—zugs4 / — ma1 ba de zheng — tsu po ṭa — sgyu1 1 1shā tre snye dpeb 31 — rwa sgyud je rā 4 4 pa —da / ba de ) rngo4 rje she po ( ma dpa— / si skru ba / ji che— — mi ca/ — shā 4 6 rnga sha da‘— 1 3bkun ra rngo 4— hūṃ za ma khu pa dka dz+wa na snyi (1 rku bdubs gzhu ni na da' sta dz+wa 1sha zer kang / dab tsa ni bkug ka sgyur ma ba—1— nga ba'i don snyi1bad4 pa / sgyu ste / ka' ma — 6da rngo snye dpa 1 cor dzis la so'i shes pa1'i mi nga / skre3 shā shā pe— da ra snye skyem bla / ge — das skye —she bya/ ku3'i rnga na 'a 1 bdar ba rdo ka na ba —bad / / ba'i ba shog pa / yod ka'am 'dug pa snyib kar ba'i ba snye ka na rdzo ba ba den pa da (za — do na dam ba de na — 'i shā / de bshi sa 'a/ 3 shā — snyed— dī rdo/ba— da thad de si — sor 1sgyu thed tshul mi 'dra ba re yo da — rdu— ra ku pe ka ba sgo rdzu ༷ 1 shā4 ṭā— snye do na dam ni ngo ma ci do na yin / ba den rwa1 za snye rde / ka ma 1sgyu ste 'a ba den pa / sdag—ba snga la ba dza 'e ba / 'gog bden / la cha/ — ka den co /3 ༄ bdud rtsi/ 'ji — —4 ba rjams byeb kyi rdza ba te / ni zhe 'chi ba / 'chi che da kya nga ze1re 1pye zo ra bar ra/ phye 3 hūṃ tud ༷ rma —rje do da 3 na la / tsa ldan sogan dar ba‘shā rdzu shā ba rdar na sa bye che/ra bye1da pa / pya ba bdang/ ) pā ga dpe rte mi nga bka— / da — lda6gas phyag shi nga bad rngo ka / /ba nga 1da / —pe kang— ste spru 1ba/ ba dar yang ka1nga byed— pa /33 1

phyi par ra/ phyi ba'i ming ngam/ cog tse'i steng gi rdul sogs phyi zhing bdar ba lda bu/mab mda'/ nyag phran nam lung pa'i mdo la mda' zer ba dang / phe ma dang / mda' tshad ma ste/ che—nga'i ring thung —— tshad nab / bzos pa'i dpe cha la dpe cha ma nga sna 'a tshad ma zer/ de bzhin dka/ ba 4'i ska ra mad3—zab—ba shā1 3 'jugabadub / mtshon cha zhib/ ste/ 'phang gdung rto bu ni phar 'phangs hūṃ tshur 'a then byed kyi spug ba btags pa zhig yi/na/mde'u 1 mda' chung ba'am me mda' sogs kyi mdel/lam ma do/ lam bzhi mdo dang su ma che—do sta bu 'dzoms pa dang / 'gag pa /gnad ka'i don/ da zad ba / nu/dos yas stags ni/ mchod sbyin/ lha la ka3chod pa 'bul ba/mdun/ drung du dang sbun dang nye ba'i don/ na bdab sa / rma bya'i gdongs lta bu sgro thig dang / dpral ba'i thi1sha le/da rngod ba kha do ga gam tshos gzhi la gon dngab / bkug mdang ba / tshon sogs kyi ba grag ba/ma gzi byin/mdor bsdus/ nyung ngur bsdad ba/ pa/ sdud pa/ rgyas pa min pa/mjo/ sdom pa nyung ngur bsdus pa'i don dkri ba/ mdo sde ste/ sdi sgod ba/sum gyi gcig che do phyogs ni sngags dang mde gnyis (snas che/do— yi phyogs la mdo phyogs dang / mdo dang lngab/sa zung du 'bre1ka ba'i bstan pa mdo sru ṭa 336

zung 'brel gyi bstan pa zer/mdangs/ kha sang / mdangs dgongs/ mdang zhes bris na'ang 'thad/mdong gsol/ ngo dga'am sprel lad dam bstod pa'am 'dun pa la 'jugar mda'/ rogs sam dpung la gomadud ba/ mdud pa bcings pa/ gos mdud pa ni 'thud pa'i don dang /mdud pa bor ba ni mdud pa rgyab pa'i don/'daspru ban 'da' 'das/ mya ngan ni sdug bsngal la go zhing de las thar ba'am 'grol ba la 'da' ba'am 'das pa zer ba dang / 'chi ba zad pa ni 'chi ba med pa'i don la'ang 'jug phyi ma 'das zer ba ni dus gsum gyi nang tshan dus 'das pa la'ang 'juga'adun pa/ 'dun pa can lta bu ni don gnyer nun nam 'dod pa can la go'adud/ gus pas 'dud pa'am gus pas btud pa ni phyag bya ba'i don dang /brtsi bkur byas pa'i don la'ang /ma dam khrod/ 'dam pa/ 'jim pa/ 'dam las skyes pa la 'dam skyes ste/ me tog pad+ma lta bu/ 'dam khrod ni 'dam gyi dbus su zhes pa'i don/'dur 'dur/ dar brel stoms par rgyug tshul lam 'gro tshul/'dong zhing 'dug 'dong pa/ ni 'gro ba'i ming yin zhing zer ba'i don/'dug pa ni/ yod pa'am sdod pa'am gnas pa' mngon pa'i don1'dom dus/ sgra 'dom pa ni sgra slob pa'i don dang bya ba 'dom pa ni bya ba stod pa'i don dus ni tshe skabs yin/ de bzhin du grangs sogs phyogs 336

gcig tu tshogs pa'am 'dzom pa la 'dom pa zer/rjes 'ded/ rjes su 'ded pa/ bda' ba'i skul tshigagasol 'debs/ gsol ba 'debs pa'am gdab pa/ zhu 'bum byed pa'i don/'don/ gri shub nas 'don pa'am bton pa lta bu dang / 'ag nas 'don pa sogs/lha 'dre/ mi ma yin/ phan 'dogs mkhan gyi rigs shig 'a lha dang / gnod skyel mkhan gyi rigs shig la 'dre zhes so/ 'byung po yang zer/shang 'drud/ shing sogs sa ma 'drud pa'am drud pa/khung bu 'dru/ khung bu ste bu ga'am i khung 'dru ba/ drus pa/ rgo ba'am sngog pa'am rtol ba/'du byed/ 'as sam lus po'i rtsol ba la go zhing / 'du byed kyi phung po dang don gcig/ dngos po sogs/'dus byas/ rgyu dang rkyen gnyis kyis 'dus shing byas pa ste/ mi rtag pa/dngos po/ rgyu 'bras sogs don gcig 'dus byas yin na mi rtag pa yin pas khyab/ 'dus byas yin na dngos po dang rgyu 'bras yin pas khyab pa yin no/ /'dres ma/ 'dres pa'i ming tsam/ 'dre ba/ chu dang 'o ma mnyam du 'dre ba'am 'dus pa/ de bzhin du/ tshigs bcad dang tshigs lhug 'dres ma'am spel ma'o/ /'dra/ mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra dang / mnyam pa dang / dras pa'i don/'drul pa/ rul ba'i don/gnyam 'dri/ gtam 'dri ba/ gleng mo 'dri ba/ dris pa/ dri ba byed pa/337

mi ge 'dri1 (me ge — dka 1 ba ni 'bri bab bris rtu 1 gzhan 1 bsgyu dri‘ da kar/ 'drad 1 ni slu ba(4 ma mgo sto 8 gtong ba'i don (3/ 'jug cing theb pa'i do na snyi cing ni tshig phrad do/ 1 /kar ba / 'i dra rdo bo/ khri/ myo 3rje dpeb4 btsu ni khri ma'i che da shā1 pa chad1sa—ba'i kad dka dang — chu 'dra'1 ba di ste paṃ cor — ka sa bsnying jing lug pa'i don :dang 1 ngo tsa zu 'i dra ba: 'a :1 1— rngo— rngod she 1— rtsa — — )— / — shā—rme ka — rwa 1 — ḍa / nga 'i dod 1 gro ba da rngon ma dzad pa/ sro za1 za /pa 1sa 'doྈ— ba sna / sro ga sogs blob4 btang ba'i don dang snyinyo sgyu— rla bzhe1 pa — rti spru 3 dod1 ‘— nya 11nga sgyu 3'i ngo na dang / brtse ge sa lta ba 'a— ka'i pa rngo1 dzi — 1)rngo — ma 'che1 ba dzab /— shā re don dab 1 dor pa ya 1 rā—rtsed pa sna / bdar ba / ( —khyab ba na ༄ ba ka po — — jaྈ ba / 'dzi— tha ba /snye 'byed ga/ pa rjekarma ba brta —— bka gad rngo 4 — / da rda mi — 4 — tsa rngo 4te bka ba / ce tu sa da lta ba'i tshid sgyu dzod/ ba—di zhes kag sngo — ‘pe chig dang bad ji 0 / cho na 'a ji — pa— ches— rtsi 3mi rnge ba ma ḍa rtad 1dz+wa 5 dz+wa zo 1 —1 rdo cwa zhe ra— —ka —༄ na /—dad da / ba do da zhe 4 ba khas da sgyu pa'i chib1 ji(nga / ‘r+sha do'i rngo——ni —6gas shā —dpa / dga' ba da sgyu — mo shā — pa snyed 'ju1 shā snying du pa'i 'ab/ ba(ra ka1 zhi na pa'i ji —/ka pa snabs kyi—'dul byed pa sta ba— smo— 5 /ba3 pa rngo 1 brngo zab/ dang / sna sgod —/hūṃ kyi gyi gci lda ste / 'a bye ge ba'i re ji rdo da yen 'di / / —ka dul/ 'dul sbyo nga kir1 'dul ma ni rta dang dz+wa— nga po sogs ka tub— po ka6 —4 ka shā ngo bzo pe pas 1dī1 —pa1 tu —rwa ba'i sa ga bye —— ka snyi(1—nga/ ma rngu rdo 'dam rdu'i ri nga /shā ༄1dab—da pa / / 'i nga —rdo ka pa— kyi 4 6 (nga shā 1—sho / 6 ༄— go—kar ba yogs/ 1re 1dab gsho rdzu dang 1 ka ‘ 'i gro za/ chog sa ste / spru spyi'i bsab nge / 1 3 (3

'du1 'du ba ni 'dus pa'am tshogs pa'i do na/ri 'dabs/ ri bo'i ngogs sam logs ste/ 'dab kyang 'thad/ma zad ba ba / ba gshin po'am sa le gas par—ma/kar bad dka/ skyo ma1sgyum sgags sam zan/'dab 'ang/ga pa/ lces 'dag pa'am ldag pa da nga / 'dam bag la yang 'jug/blo 'drog blo gzhan la g.yeng bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su glo bur stad sgra chen po thos skabs 'drog pa lta bu—dang / rta sogs 'drog pa/ dogs nas 'dzur ba/ dkrogs pa/ khur drags pa/nabs 'dred/ zhabs ni rkang pa'i the sa dang / 'dred pa ni/ rdob stabs shor ba lta bu/ dred pa mang /'drad cing / 'drad pa'ad4 drad pa'am brdar ba/ se na rmas 'drud pa/ cing ni tshig phrad/'drud/ 'drud pa/ drwas pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i tshiba'adred/ pa/ 'dren pa po/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sta bus gdu la bya'am drang bya se mas can 'khor ba las 'dren ba 'am drangs pa/spyod ba rten zad che pa / chos 'doms ba ni/ chos ston pa'am 3chad pa' che slob ku 'i don dang / gdams pa'ang 'jugadabe 'dun/ gong dang 'dra/ 'dus/ 'dus pa ni 'du ba'am tshogs pa'i don/ma za med/ bltas bzo med pa'am blang dor pyi—gnad mi shes za ste/ glen pa lta bu//bzad chad ba/ pho mtshan nam gsang ba/nas su go'adom gab / 'dom ba gang ste/ khru bzhe'i tshad1 gzhu 'dom gang yang zer/339

gang ba ni kha tshang ba'i don/ma dog ba / ming la sogs pa 'dogs pa'am gdags pa ni btags pa'i don/'dod chags/ 'dod pa chags pa'i yul ni mdzes shing yid du 'ongs ba de yin la der chags par byed mkhan blo de ni 'dod chags yin/'du shes/ bsam pa'am tshad mar 'dzin pa ste/ pha bu'i bar gyi 'du shes dang / dge rgan dang slob ma'i 'du shes lta bu/'du 'dzi/ bsam blo g.yeng sa'i yul te/ mi mang po tshogs sa dang glu gar la sogs sgra sgrog sa lta bu la go ba dang chung ma la'ang go'adris/ 'dris pa/ goms pa/ rgyun du 'grogs pa/'dreg mkhan/ skra 'dreg pa/ gcod pa/ bzhar ba'i mkhan po'am byed ngo/'deb / 'deng ba/ 'gro ba'am gzhan du gtong ba/ phyir ni dgos pa gsal byed tshiga'ado rta/ 'do ba zhes pa rta la go ba'i don /'dam/ 'dam pa/ 'dam ka byed pa/'das po/ 'jig rten 'di las 'das pa po ste/ gshin po dang 'chi po'i don/ma dad/ 'dad pa ni sems la 'phreng ba'am chags sems/'khor 'dab/ nye 'khor ram nye du bcas kyi don/'dums/ 'dums pa/ mthun pa/ tshogs pa/ 'grig pa/ sdom pa/ 'dun yang snang /ming 'dogs/ ming btags pa'i don dang / bla dwags ni/ rang gi dngos ming ma yin pa'i nom grangs sam btags mib /chu 'dal1 chu la sogs pa 'dal ba ni/ dal ba/ dal po'i bya tshig 340

skyo ma 'dal/ skyo ma dang snag tsha 'dal ba ni khyab pa dang / dal gyis 'gro ba/'dag zal/ khrus rdzas sam 'dag byed kyi rdzas ste yi mi lta bu/go 'dun/ gang mos dang sna tshogs kyi don la gode ma 'drog di ma thag gam de blo 'drog ma song /dri ma 'dag nyon mongs pa'i dri ma sogs 'dag pa'am dag pa'am sbyong ba/med par bzo ba/rdagrob kal/ grong gis khyab pa'am grong khyer mthar grong thar thor ram ljongs/thog jib1 thog rdib pa ni thog nas lhung ba dang / ha yang sogs mthil rdib pa ni phyi nas nang du 'bur ba lta bu/da/ rje/ rdo ba'i rje bo ste/ pha lam la sogs pa'i ming dang / ha cang mkhregs pa'i rang bzhin can/nul/ rdul spabs te bud med kyi zla mtshan dang / phyi rol gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i nang gses grangs can pas khas len pa'i yon tan gsum gyi gcigayon tan gsum ni/ rdul dang mun pa dang snying stobs gsum mo/ rdo rje'i rdul ni gnam lcags te thog la gordo/ rdo ba/ sped byed de rdo dang smad 'tshong mar goje'u/ rde'u chung ngu dang rdo chung ngu la go ba dang / nad kyi khyad par dang rtsis byed rdel la gordog ngo / rdog ma/ ril bu'am gong bu/ nyab ma/ 'bru rdog ngo/ gcig lta bu /jeg kyang / rdog pa ni rdung ba'am rgyab pa'i don dang / bcug pa dang 'dres 341

pa sogs kyi don/ kyang sgra mi ba na ji/'i rgyan/15bkabs/ rdugs po/ thogs pa'i don dang thabs rdugs po lta bu/zung 'tshog nyes can lta bur rdung rdeg dang / rnga sogs brdung ba dang /ro'1 mo sog ba/ dkrol ba dang / gri sogs snyun pa dang / ༅/ sogs gtubs pa dang / bro sogs 'khrub pa dang / pags pa sogs mnyed pa da nga / tho ba sog /sa rgyang1 rngo ba 6sa la 13ju ga gophe ga ldab/ ting sha bkas —ba—po/ che tsam— spye ri' mo zhig dang lag pa rdeb ba 'i ming tsam1 pheb rdo—pe kung sna za /za lang jeb/ ngo 'a po sbub chal rdeb rwa—1 bkrol ku/ sprug ‘sna 1 rgya— pa'i do dz+wa/blo jeg glo bur dang mgyogs po'i don ( 'jugakab snyed tshal/ rda ba ceng ra chal ba/ gta‘da med du (dgyel ba'am rngo rab /po rdab pa— (6 zag rdzos/ lus po rdob ni lus po gtos san1 bongs tshod che ba— byed spyod ba / glo sna sto ba la go shāka dang — rdol ba ni 1 rtol ba/ 'then pa1 brdol mji den—dbu ba rdzas/ dbu ka4 — ste/ chu la sogs pa'i sbu ba rdos pa'am 1 na ba / 11ba1‘she pa 1 gri rdor / gri sigs rdor ba sna / no —ba dan ‘41 bkan nas 'drud pa —— ma brdaraku 1 rdor ceb kyang /rdol chos / hūṃ nga cho4— kun/ spyod rtsing ste / spyod pa ngan po//rdodzi snyed ba ka— prib / na che ma khab ba khri nga ba'am 1༄sto bang ba4 ma yo ba ste / spru bye'i ming 343

dang khyad par khyung la go ba yin/'brug ldir/ 'brug la sgra brgya pa'ang zer/ ldir ba ni/ sgra 'byin ba1'am sdir skad sgrog pa/ldab ldib shad/ mi gsal ba'am gas nga po med pa'i skad/lda ldi/ khang pa'i thog la dpyang nga'i mchod rdzas kyi bye bragalde mig sgo lcags 'byed byed/21na/ yod ji/ 'i don can gyi ldan pa/ bcas pa/ mthun pa/ 'grogs pa la'ang 'jugad zad 14ba mgo mjug log pa'am phyin ci log pa/ bsnye ldir/ bum pa lta bu lto ba ldir ba/ 'bur ba'am ltug pa'am rgya che ba'i don dang / grod 4 ldir ba ni/ 'bur ba'i don/sprur ldur/ sha so kunas shin tu chos pa 'am tshos drags nas sil bur gyur ba'am ldur ldur du kyur pa/ldug phor pa'i nang du ja ldug pa lta bu blug pa'i don dang / am phrag nang dngul dī ga ba lta bu bcu— ka pa'i don la 'jugaseng sdeb / shing seng ldeng dang sman zhig ste/ nus pas khrug ngan dang chu ser skom/lde3da ldem/ mnyen snyu ga gam ba yo tshul zhig lder bza/ 'jim bzo'i don/te/ba / ba / logs dang leb ma/ shog bu'i ldebs dang / gyang gi ldebs lta spru/sngong ros/ tshon nam sman zhig ste/ nub pas rmen bu skrangs pa dang rma rul ba ba na/bas sgyurd lnga/ma / dri sogs kyi shugan ba1ma nus pa ldang za'am 'thul ba'am lang 343

ba'i don/lde gu sman sogs ldir ba'i skyo ma'am bag zan sla ba lta bu/'jug sdog 'jug ni/ rjes su 'jug pa/ 'gro ba'am len pa'i don dang /ldog pa ni/ 'dor ba'am mi mthun pa/ log pa'am med pa'i don/ dper na/ bya ba'i 'jug ldog ma nor ba byed lta bu ni/ bya ba'i spang blangs ma nor ba byed ces pa'i don/ljob skyen/ ldob pa'am ldobs ni slob pa/ lob pa'am goms pa/ ma shes pa noms bslabs nas ldob pa/ skyen pa ni sprur ba ste/ shes par sla ba/phyir mi lhog phyir mi ldog pa ni slar mi log pa'am brtan pa'i don/skom sprud/ skom ni chu dang ja sogs kyi rlon la zer ba dang / ldud pa ni blud pa'am sbyin pa'am ster ba'i don/ched lde/ me lde ba ni me sro ba'am tsha bar byed pa'i don dang / nyi ma lde ba ni/nyi ma sro ba'am tsha bar byed pa'i don/mib gi lde/ dpal sde/ skyid lde/ 'od lde/ khri srong lde'u btsan sogs/ de rnams ming la 'jug pa'i lde/ldum ra/ lhum bu ste sngo'am tshal gyi ra ba/ tshal zhing dang skyes tshal lta bu'i ming /spum bu/ rtswa sngon nam sne'u/ sne'u ni za bar rung ba'i sngo zhig/ldab lhob/ mnyen pa'am snyi ba'i don la 'jugabacom ldan/ bcom ldan 'dad te/ sangs rgyas rnam 'dren bzhi pa/ldem dgongs/ sdem po ni mnyen po dang 'khyog po'i don/ dgongs pa ni bsam pa'i don dang / mtha' drug gi gcig ste/ mtha' drug ni/ drang don bshad pa/ nges don bshad pa/ sgra ji bzhin bshad pa/ sgra ji bzhin 344

min pa bshad pa/ dgongs pa can bshad pa/ dgongs pa can min pa bshad pa'o/ /dris lan ldon/ gzhan gyis dris pa'i lan ldon pa ni/ 'an 'jal ba'am lan 'debs pa'i don/bskyar ldab/ bskyar ba dang ldab pa gnyis ni/ yang yang dang zlos pa'i don/nyis ldab/ nyis 'gyur/ sum ldab/ ldab log sogs/ lhag ma ldas/ lto la sogs pa lhag ma'am lhag po dang ldas pa ni/ lus pa'i don/ldan ba/ kha'i 'gram pa dang mdan pa zhes bris kyang rung /dka ldeg so sdeg pa ni/ g.yo ba'am blad pa/ za ba'i don yin/ tshems ni/so'i zhe sa/mig kyang lhobs/ mig la lta byed zer zhing ldongs pa ni long ba'am mdongs kyang rung / kyang ni tshig phrad/ de'u ldang / ni'u ni na tshod chung ngu ngam na tshod/ ldang ni mnyam pa ste/ na mnyam/ na zla'o/ / — sdom bu/ bsod stoms la go/ ldom bu ba ni/ bsod stoms pa zer/stan las ldab / stan las ldang ba ni/ gdan las lang pa'i don/ldang tshad/ bstan bcos ldang tshad ni/ bstan bcos kha tshang ba'am kha long ba dang / gos ldang tshad ni/ gos kha tshang ba'am kha long ba'i don/sdazhe ldang / zhe nas sdang ba ni gting nas sdang ba/ khro ba'am gnod ba/346

bsnab spyod ba sdang ba'i mig ste/ mig log sdig ba ma dzub/ sdigs mo ste 'jigs skul byed pa'i mdzub mo'am sor mo/sdib sdig pa ni gshe ba dang 'jigs su 'jug pa/ 'ben la sdig pa ni/'ben la gzir ba/da/zad ba / dpa' po min pa'am snying stobs chung ba/ba bzu sturtog las 8ge ba bsags pa'i 'bras bu bde ba dang / las sdig pa bsags pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsrul/ bde sdug ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi bsdub ming dang skyid sdub/ —yang ngo / /dge sngeg dge ba ste/ legs sprad bcu ni/ lus kyi sgo nas srog ma gcod pa dang / ma byin len mi byed pa/ mi tshang ba— spyod mi byed pa ste gsum dang /ngab/ gi sgo nas 1 bden pa/za da smra ba/ phra che/ mi byed ji// tshig 'jam por smra ba/ ngab mi 'chal ba ste bzhi dang / yid kyi sgo nas gzhan gyi nor la chaṭa sred mi byed pa dang / gzhan 'a— gnod sem mi skyed pa/ log lta mi byed pa ste gsum bcas khyon bcu'o/ sdig pa ste/ mi dge ba bcu sna1 legs tre ba bcu po de dab ka sdog phyogs ku/ /sgom / pan pa sdom/ pa/ ngan pa sgo nga ba/ de bzhin du sdom ni1 sdud pa/ sre ba/ 'ching ba/ sdom tshib/ lta bu la'ang 'jugadrung1/ gtib ngam the ba/nga nga/kyi(sha da1zus sogs kyi don/sprad ba za / yal ga gyes pa'i rten nam ljon za'i rtsa ba/ sgob yu / sdob po skrub ba'i ngon /rja / che nga ngo (— shā tsho bas4 sam t+ta myo/sa dang / ra sde dang ga6ma—sde dzi lda ngang — lde bka ste—/ nor gyi sde dab / (re dod— nga 'i sde/ chos kyi sde/ 1 pa pa'i sde bcas so1 /346

srog dang sgo zhing / tshe srog dang sdo ba ste/ brje ba dang sdur ba'i don snye srog blos gtong ba'i don no/ /zhing ni tshig phrad/lde tshan/ dum bu'am bam po ste/ dum bu dang pa'o lta bu dang / bam po gnyis pa'o lha bu dpe cha'i gzhung gi mtshams 'jog byed kyi ming / de bzhin tsho ste khag la'ang gorjeb/ sdeb pa ni/ mnyam du sbyor ba'am gcig tu sdom pa'am lhan du 'grogs pa'am cha sgrig pa lta bu ni/ dper na tshigs mang po lhan cis tu sdeb nas brjod pa tshigs bcad lta bu sdeb sbyor gyi lugs so/ /spog zags/ srog dbang chags pa'am srog dbang yod pa'i don te/ sem ldan chung ba'i bye brag/ 'bu srin lta bu/bsdom/ mang po phyogs gcig tu sdom pa'am ba rgya byed mkhan te/ 'bu sdom la zer/jig sdig ba dngos—te/ sdig pa rwa tsa dang sdig srin mi/ sman la 'gro ba'i 11ba/ da ba/sa shib/sner mo rdo/ gcan gzan sogs kyi sen mo/ no ba ni non po'i don/11ma pa/ so thar gyi sdom pa dang / byang sems kyi sdom pa dang / sngags kyi sdom pa ste sdom pa gsum dang / sdom pa ni spong ba dang spyod pa dang mi gda' baྈ bye༄da ba 'i don te/ nyes spyod sdom pa ni nyes spyod sgong ba lta bu'o/sdom/ bsrung bya'i sdom pa ste— dge slong gi sdom pa dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa sogs/sdod gnas/ 'dug gnas te1 khyim lta bu/bsdig da/ sdod pa ni/ sa la bsdad pa dang / khyim 1ka gnas pa dang / gdan la sdod cig lta bu/ 347

rjeb spyor/ snyan dngags/ mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis/ zlos gar bcas rig gnas chung ba lnga'i gcig dang / rig byed kyi yan lag drug gi sdeb sbyor te/ bslab pa cho ga lung ston dang / nges tshig skar dpyad thos pa dang / sdeb sbyor rnam par sems pa ni/ rig byed yan lag drug zhes bshad/ces bslab pa ni/ a la sob/sa pa'i yi ge rnams kyi gnas dang byed pa'i rtsol ba 'a sogs pa ston pa'i gzhung / cho ga ni/ mchod sbyin byed par gtan la phab pa'i gzhung / lung ston ni/ brda sprod pa ston pa'i gzhung /nges tshig ni/ yi ge glo bur ba dang yi ge go ldog pa la sogs pa'i nges pa'i don bshad pa/ skar dpyad thos pa ni/ gza' bdun rtsis pa'i bstan bcos la sogs pa'i rtsis kyi bsta1 bcos/ sdeb sbyor ni/ tshigs bcad byed lugs ston pa'i gzhung /mdzes spug mdzes pa'i don can gyi sdug pa ste/ yid du 'ongs ba la go zhing / dper na mdzes sdug ldan pa'i yul ljongs lta bu/ sdug gu zhes bris na'ang mdzes pa'i don no/ /nor sogs rtsad/ rgyu nor dang chos la sogs pa phyogs gcig tu sdud pa'am bsdu ba ni/ gsog 'jog byas pa'i don te/ rgyu nor ni bang mdzod nang du sdud pa'am bsdu ba dang / chos ni rang gi mid pa nang du sdud pa'am bsdu ba lta bu/ sdud pa ni sdom pa'am tshogs par byas pa'i don yang yin/spum pa/ khyim mam khang par 'jug — mchod sdong / mchod pa'i rten dang mchod sbyin gyi phyugs 'dogs pa'i ka ba/spum bus bskor/ sdum bu ni khang chung la go zhing / chu jing de'i mtha' sdum bus bskor 'dug lta bu/rjer ma/ sgod spyad kyi khyad par ste/ rag gi sder ma/ dkar yol gyi sder ma/348

dngul gyi sder ma lta bu zas blugs sgod/thug sdor/ thug pa'am skyo tsha la gdab rgyu'i sdor te/ sha dang tshil la sogs pa'o/ /lag pas sdom/ lag pa la sor mo lnga pa'am yan lag lnga pa yang zer/ sdom pa 'dzin pa'i don te lag pas bzung ba'am 'dzin pa'o/ /bka' sdod/ rgyal ba'i bka' gsung la sdod pa'am gnas pa'i chos skyong sobs/ chos skyong ni/ bstan pa'i chos tshul bzhin skyong bar mdzad pa'i dam tshig la gnas pa'i spung ma zhigarnge smod/ sde sgod gsum ste/ 'dul ba'i sde sgod/ mngon pa'i sde sdod/ mdo sde'i sde sgod bcas gsum mo/ 'dul ba'i sde snad ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i brjod bya ga rtsa bor bstan pa'i gzhung dang / mngon pa'i sdo sdod ni/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i brjod bya gtso bor bstan pa'i gzhung dang / mdo sde'i sde sgod ni/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'i brjod bya gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung yin no/ /de ltar sde sgod gsum ni bslab pa gsum gyi khongs su bsdu'o/ /mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi kabs rgya gar bsgyur ba'i chos rnams sbyis su dbye ba phye bde ba'i ched du mdo sde'i mdo sdod kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i gzhung thams zud la mchod brjod ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo zhes dang / 'dul ba'i sde sdod kyi khongs su gtob/sa pa'i gzhung spums cad kyi mchod brjod ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes dang /mngon pa'i sde snad kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i gzhung spums cad kyi mchod brjod la/ 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal zhes bkas bcad de gtan la phab bo/ /34mi

brdagri bdar/ gri dang mdung 'a sogs pa'i mtshon cha bad ra nas rdon por brngos rdzu dka sgyu na/brdeg 'chos/ bzag cing 'tshos pa / brdung zhing brtsos rje 41 ra gyel pa'am1lhung ba'i don/brtsang spru/ brdung bar bya ba'i gzhi ste/ nyes can lta bu/brdungs/ rdung ba'i 'das pa'i tshigs/ rtag pha'am gzhus pa/ba brda da/ kha brdar ba/ gtam mang bshad pa/ dper na kha brdar glod nas ma sdod par de las slob sbyong byeb 1snye bu/ don med pa'i skad cha mab po bshad ba la kha brdar ba zer1da brdol/ bla bo brdol ba'am gtam brdob ba ni byung rgya' du zod 1 pa ste bab col ba ma gnyid gtam lta bu / ༅ nas gang thon bshad pa'i gtam sgyur 14tshal brdab/ chal mar bdeb ‘4 ni/ snyam ba/ ngor brdab ba 'am brdabs pa1 ste rdeb pa'i don dang / cha lang ste 1 sprug cha' brdab pa—ni/ spug cha ba dkrol ba'i don yin/ brdabs dang rdeb pa/za bzub / rnga brdung ba ni rnga la ba/byug pa snun pa'am dbyug pas rdung ba'i da rngo/pro brdung / bro ni lus kyi gar stabs shig ste/ bro brdung ba ni dngas mi bzhe) ma 'ongs pa'i tshig dang bro 'khrub pa'i don/ rga rbud brda/ go byed la 3jug pa'i brda ste1 las brda byed pa dpa /360

zhugs brda byed pa lta bu/zal mar brdal/ chal mar brdal ba'am rdal ba ni/ thang la bkram pa'am khyab par byed pa'i don yin/ brdal ni rdal ba'i ma 'ongs pa'i tshigabardul ba/ g.yab mo ste/ 'di ru shog ces brda gtong ba'i dar cha dang lag pa sogs brdul ba'am g.yob pa ste 'gugs brda byas pa/ de bzhin du btul ba'i don la'ang 'jugabardeb brdeg pa ni rdeg pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i tshig te/ rgyag pa'am rdung ba'i don/blda bldabs nas/ ba ldabs pa ste/ bskyar ba/ ldab pa ni yang yang bzlas pa'am skyor ba'i don/ nas ni lhag bcas kyi sgra'o/ /ba bsnab/ ba / ldag pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i tshig /lces 'byog pa'am lces ldag pa/ khyi yis chu lces ldag lta bu/bldeg cing / bldeg pa ni/ sha la so bldeg pa'am ldeg pa/ cing ni tshig phrad/ bsdabasdu bya/ chos kyi nang don dang gser dngul la sogs pa'i nor ni bsda bya ༄dang / bsdu ba'i gzhi/bka / bsdu ba ni/ btu ba'i don/351

bsdus/ bsdus pa ni btus pa'am phyogs gcig sdom pa'am sdud pa'i don/ba spur nas/ bsdur ba/ mnyam par byed pa'am 'gran pa'am brdzun pa ste/mtho 'tsham par byed pa'i don/ nas ni lhag bcas kyi sgra/bsnad/ brdod pa/ sdod pa'am 'dug pa ni/ gdan sogs la bsdad pa'i don/nyes bsnams/ nyes spyod ste/ sdig pa la sogs pa'i bya ba ngan pa bsdams pa ni sdom pa'am spangs pa'i don/bsdoms nas/ grangs la sogs pa bsdoms pa'am sdom pa ni phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i don/ nas ni lhag bcas kyi sgra/spog bsdos/ srog dang bsdos pa ste/ rang gi srog la 'phang med kyis gzhan gyi nus pa la 'gran pa'am sdur ba/'og brdogs/ 'og grab sam sta gon ni gra sgrig la go zhing dngos gzhi min pa/nyer bsdogs/ nye bar bsdogs pa ni nye bar brtsams pa'am sta gon dang /bsam gzugs kyi sngon 'gro ste/ bsam gtan dang / gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin ma thob gong gi sa rang rang sga dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob byed kyi thabs sam sta gon du gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zer/gzhan la ba jigs/ gzhan dgra ba'am nyes can la bsdigs pa ni/ sdig pa'am gshe ba ste 'jigs skul byas pa'i don dang / 'ben lta bu la bkaṭa pa ni/ 'ben la gzas pa'i don/grogs dang bsdongs/ grogs ste rogs pa dang bsdongs pa ni/ 'grogs pa dang mnyam du 'gro ba'am sdong ba ste mnyam du gshibs pa'i don/352

brjebs/ bsdebs pa ni lhan du sdob pa'am mnyam du sbyor ba sogs/sna bag brdogs/ ba lang 'a sogs pa'i sna la btags— pa'i spug pa dang spun dog gru gu sogs bsdogs pa ni bsdus pa'am dril ba/ brtsams pa'am sdogartapa'i don/'gal brtsam/ 'gal ba ste/ spu dad du yin pa gang zhig gzhi mthun du med pa de la 'gal ba zer zhing / dper na/ ka ba dang bum pa lta bu de gnyis spu dad yin pa gang zhig la ka ba yang yin pa bum pa yang yin pa'i dngos po med pas gzhi mthun med pa'o/ /skabs de'i 'gal ba ni phan tshuka gnyis po'i yid mi mthun par byed pa lta bu la go zhing de mthun par byed pa'am chings sgrig pa'am gros byed pa la bsdum pa'am thum par byed ces pa'i don no/ /naphan gnod/ phan pa ni bde bar byed pa'i don dang gnod pa ni mi bde bar byed pa'i don ste/ nad sogs kyis mnar ba lta bu/gnas mabs/ gnas pa ni yod pa'i don dang 'dug pa'i don/ skabs ni go'am tshul lam thabs sam dus te/ gnas tshul dang 'phral ma'am mthar thug min pa dang gnas spubs dang gnas dus sogs ni rgyun ring min pa'i don no/ /gnang bkag gnang ba ni ster ba'am sgrub pa'am bkag pa ni dgag pa ste/byed du mi rung ba'i don/gnad/ gnad gsang ni/ gtar ga'i dmigs dang / me btsa'i gsang lta bu 363

lus kyi rtsa gnad dang rgyus med pa'i gsang dmigs/ de bzhin du gal che sa'am gnad du thug sa lta bu dang / gnad ka ni snying po'i don dang /don gnad dang lus ba/nad de gzugs po'i gnas yod sa ste bu la 'jug/bcod da sbyi'i kyi / gdon na/ lha'i bye brag lha 'dre'i rigs/shad ma da ba dka'adi ba / gnag ni nor ram 'bri g.yag spyi'i ming la thob pa dab—phyugs ni dud 'gro rta 'u ba / sogs spri'i ming ngo / /gnam rje ltard/ gnam ni rgyu skar gyi lam dang ltar ni mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi 11/'di dab gnag pa ni kha dog nab/ po la go ba dang / nag po'i spru ba ste bya ba ngan pa la zer/gnas brtan/ gnas brtan bcu drug ste/ dka ku thub pas ba snan pa gnyer du gtar pa1 'i da shra ‘bcom pa btsu byeg ba ze ra / de dag ni / yan 5ga 'byung / ba/ pham bka1 nags na gnab / dus lngan/ rdo rje cho ku spru/ ‘4 shing sgyu(/ gser gyi 'e(hūṃ/ lha ra dī ja bdaka —— ldan / ba ka la rje sna — ba/dun 'dzi ka 1 bkam phran bstan1 bha ྈ tī dza bsod sgo mas len/ la4/ chen (— stan/ klu'i pre / sbod byed— / rmi phyer rwa— ste 0cu drug gnas brtan 'od — spungs— shā rtsa po ni / shā1hūṃ thub ḍa— 'i nya na thos te 'a/bo— bcu'i nang tsha 5 lgib / ste/ sbyang da pa'i yon tan che chob tu gyur rnga— jig da / ma ngon pa / ) sde sdod kyi bka' 0sdu dang po byed ma—ban ga rtsa bo/nyer 4/zas / nye baྈsgyu ba/nab nu/ 1 gan— du sdo8 shā —snyi / thab/ snyer yo 8 ba / khu—/nab kyi slob ma/ khris su yod pa'i ngon snyi bkan bad ba da / pyo me 'dus ba1ḍa ma—mdza1ka po 'dug sa'i kang pa ste khyem 1tsha go/354

gnas/ gnas pa/ sdod pa/ yod pa/ brten pa/ mi 'gyur ba/ 'os pa bcas kyi don/gnod byed/ gzhan la 'tshe bar byed mkhan nam gzhan rlag pa ste/ 'joms par byed mkhan/ zil gnon/ gzi brjid kyi 'og tu gnon pa mnan pa'am zhum par byed pa/gna' mi/ sngon ma'i mi'am snga ma'i mi/ smra zhing don rga ba'i gang zag ni mi'i mtshan nyid do/ /gnubs/ rus shig ste/ gtsang rin spungs khul gyi lung pa zhig dang der gnas pa'i yab 'bangs rus drug nang gi rus ming gcigazhi gnas/ byib rgod de/ shes pa mi/ gsal zhing sems gzhan la g.yo ba de zhi ba'am med par bzos nas dge ba'i dmigs la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa ste bsam gtan la gnas pa sogs/gnas 'gyur/ sngar gyi gnas skabs dor nas gzhan du 'gyur ba ste/ chu stog ma dwangs pa lta bu ni sngar rnyeg ma'i gnas skabs dor nas da lta dwangs par 'gyur ba dang / gnas yongs gyur pa ya nga zer/gnas lugs rtogs/ don la gnas pa'i lugs ka gshis lugs/ ngo ma/ gnas tshul yang zer te/ chos rnams kyi ba/nas lugs phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa lta bu dang / stong pa nyid rtogs pa lta bu/ gnangs gzhes/ gnangs gi sang gi phyi nyin dang / gzhes ka gnangs kyi phyi nyin/ gnam ru/ gzhu 'ji mda' sta da zer/rkab pa gnon/ zhabs kyis gnon pa/ mnan pa'i don dang kha gnon pa/365

log tu gnon pa/ rnam par gnon pa lta bu dang / rnam gnon zhes pa lcags 'brug lo la'ang gozhe gnong / zhe ste gting nas gnong ba'am nongs pa ni/ skyon gyis zhum pa'am 'gyod pa'am nongs khur ba la zer/ gting nas ngo tsha ba/gnad gcod/ rang bzhin gyis 'chi skabs rlung dang / gsod dus mtshon chas lus kyi rtsa dmas gcod pa/gnad ngan len/ gnas ngan pa len pa ni/ skye gnas mi legs par skye ba'am da sta sdug bsngal bar byed pa'i gzhi yin pas na gnas dang slar sdug bsngal phyi ma 'dren pas na ngan len dang / sgo gsum gyi gnas ngan len las su mi rung ba'am yul can phyin ci log gong nas gong du bskyed pa'i nus pa sems rgyud la gnas pa'i bag chags lta bu/gnod gnas/ gnod pa'i gnas yul lam dzasto la ste/ gnod sbyin nam nor lha'i rigs/mnamanal gzim/ gnyid log pa'i zhe sa'i tshigamana' ma/ bu'i chung ma'am bag ma/'og cu mnan/ 'og tu mnan pa'am gnon pa ste/ mi mtho bar byed pa/mnab rtsal/ kha zas sam bza' chas/dri mnam/ dri ni sna'i yul dang mnam pa ni sgom pa'i don dang / dri bro ba/dri dku ba lta bu/mnar med/ mnar ba ni gzir ba'i don dang de las lhag pa'i sdug bsngal 366

med pas na mnar med ces dmyal khams bco brgyad las tsha dmyal brgyad kyi nang gses shig ste/ lcags khyim 'bar ba'i nang du gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams kyis lcags bsregs kyi so' pa spungs pa'i khrod du ba ba'i sems can grangs med pa bcug nas/ me dang lus gnyis med du bsreg pa dang / khro chu 'khol ma khar blugs pa sogs sdug bsngal ya nga ba myong dgos pa'o/ /de lta bu gnas pa'i sems can la dmyal ba mnar med la gnas pa'i sems can zer/ mnar sems/ kun nas gzhan la mnar ba'am 'tshe ba'am gnod par byed pa'i sems sam bsam pa de la mnar sems zer/zas mnog zas la sogs pa mnog pa ni zhim pa'i don dang / gya nom pa'am mang po'i don la 'jugamanog chub / ka spogs sam phan pa chung ngu/ gnog chung bya ba lta bu phan pa chung ngu 'i las kamanol rigs/ mnol ba ni grib bam mi gtsang ba'i don dang / rigs ni rgyud dam gras la go ste/ mi gtsang ba'i rgyud/ mi gtsang ba'i gras lta bu/ de bzhin du mnol ri zhes pa ri rtseg gam ri grib can la gomana' bskyal/ mna' bskyal ba/ bro bor ba/ sgog pa don gcigan bza' mnabs/ na bza' ni gos kyi zhe sa ste/ lha'i gos la lha'i na bza' lta bu'o/ /mnabs pa ni mnab pa'am gyon pa'am gon pa ste gsol ba'i don/mno bsam/ mno ba dang bsam pa gnyis don gcig ste/ bsam blo gtong ba'am bsam blo'i don/mnos/ mnos pa/ mno ba/ bsam pa'o don dang / de bzhin du slob sbyong 367

byed pa'i go da bas mnos sbying lta bu thob pa'i don dang 1 bslab bya dbad du mnob/ pa yi lha bu len pa'i don 1ka'ang 'jugachedarnam shes/ rnam ba ra shes pa ste/ se ma bad kum shes— rnga/1no na po— da pa rngo po tu la po mi na sgyu ni sgyu ྈ—ga pa no na po dang—rib1/ pa sprang za rgago ba dang / pro sogs zon po sna rno ba'i don la go snan po ni no shā 'i rgong /rnal sgyuraspru ra/ rdel mar 'di byor ba'am ga thug mar 3rngu ra pa ba ༄ sbyor za ni /sgom ba/ ting che 'dzen thabs — shed zung 'jub ste / yang sgyug pa'i ba tsho dbang du gyur ba/rams/ mang chi ga ste / sgyu༄ ngab rku da dz+wa par dang 1 sims can rnams lta bu/ldan tshwa 'di snam ‘/—ra rngo ga pa/ kun rtog sims kyi 'chang tshul — rnam 8bye rte ga pa/ nyo na mo nga3 bcas la gortsam grangs / rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba'am rnam pa dang ming don gyi nod bkang na— sob/sa/rom pa mab snam grang da dang che—dzes pa dang rnam 'gyur dang rang bzhin dang mi rtag ba 'i na ma pa sogs/ mang ba sna nyung ngu min pa/ ro gza/ga rna ba ni sgra 'dzen rem nyid byed dam (mam rtsag la zer zhib de'i gshog pa'am shad ba ma ste/ 'jig ba so ga sa kyi rna chas gshog ba lte —spru'am snyan gshog kang zer1rtse no1 rtse mo no ba mi rtse mo non po'i don dang — rtse cho thes gra mab kyi mngon 368

brjod du dang po'i don la 'jugazal ma'i don/ rnal ma ni/ gnyug ma dang bden pa dang ngo ma'i don dang /yang dag pa la go ba dang / don ni brjod bya sigs la phokhub rna1 yan lag gi kha dog brgyad yod pa'i nang gses gcig ste/ yan lag gi kha dog brgyad ni/ sprin dang du ba rdul dang khug rna snang ba dang mun pa grib ma dang nyi ma'i 'o8 zer bcas min / khug rna'i kha dog ni/lho bur te sprug pa dang / du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu zhig yin /rdab khrab rnag ces pa khrug rul nas dkar por ngo nga ba/snyed snang zang ma zhing ste lo tog skye ba'i sa gzhi'i 'ing ma ni/ chus khyab pa'i ched du mu'am sa dang du 'thon rdzu4 ste dod zhing chu ma/ tsheg phrad rnam par/ tshig phrad kyi bye brag rtsam par ni yong da su zhe/ pa ste/dab/ pa ra dag rnam par bshad pa1 rnam ba4 sna༄ dzi lda pa lta bu'o/ //sna—snar ma zon jibs/ 'di gsum rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi bye bragad ba ma / yi ge 'bri byed kyi rdzas la go ba dang/ snag gi tsha bo ni/ ma phyogs kyi /nyen tshan rgogasprur/ snyu 8 ba ni 'dul ba'am sdur rdzur byed pa ste zhi pa mor 'jig pa'i don/lha nga ba / gsal ba1 skrub pa/ rtsa:ngon pa/ yul mthong ba dang 'cha ra tshu' la zo/gas mang por 'jug dper na mig la sna nga ji ba ni mib1 la gsal ba'am 'char ba'i don lta bu sogs/sna che ba ba / sna kha—tha dad dam dbye ba du ma tshogs pa'am 'dus pa sto/ 'dra 36༷

min sna tshogs yod lta bu/sna yi/ sna ni sgom byed de sna khung la zer ba dang / skud pa'i sna ni skud pa'i thog ma dang / khab kyi sna ni khab kyi rtse yi don/ yi ni tshig phrad/snabs/ sna'i lud pa'am zag chu/ mi gtsang ba/snam bu/ zheng chung la dkyus ring ba'i bal gyi 'thag pa'i rgyu cha zhig ste/ gos sogs bzo byed la 'dod pa'i snam bu'o/snam sprur/ snam phran sbyar ba'i gos te/ chos gos rnam gsum gyi gcig /chos gos rnam gsum ni/ snam sbyar/ bla gos/ mthang gos gsum mo/ /snal ma/ gos kyi rgyu'am snam bu'i spun nam skud pa'i don/sne/ skud pa'i sne mo skud pa'i rtse mo dang / las kyi sne khrid pa ni las kyi 'go khrid pa dang / chu'i sne ni chu'i thog ma dang ri'i sne ni ri'i zur bcas la gobar snang / gnam sa'i bar gyi snang ba mthong ba/ bar snang du 'phur lta bu/snang gsal/ snang ba dang gsal ba gnyis mun pa med pa'am 'od chags pa'i don dang / sgron ma'am sgron me'i don/lham/ 'gru mar te/ yungs dkar nag sogs 'bru ba mir ba las byung ba'i mar dang / rtsi mar te/ rtswa dang sngo sdum sogs rtsi thog gi bcud nungs pa'i phyugs rigs las byung ba'i mar/ de bzhin du mdog mi skya ba sgyum sang seng med pa la snum pa'am snyum po zhes zer/dri smom/ dri sdom pa ni dri tshor ba'i don dang / mtshon sgom pa ni mtshon thogs pa'i don te/ dper na/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi phyag g.yas par nyon mongs 'joms byed kyi mtshon ral gri sgom pa ni thogs pa'i don no/ /lam sna1 mam ston mkhan nam sna khrid par go 360

sna bo/ ga rtsa bo dang thog mar ngang dpon po'i don la go snag dbon/ snag ni sngar bod kyi rus rgyud shig dang nye du zhig dang dbon po ni spun nam tsha bo la gosnab / yod dam mngon nam gsal ba'i don/lhar snab/ yang dag pa lta bur snang ba'am mthong ba ste/ dngos min pa'am yang dag min pa ni/ dper na/ mngon sum yang dag min pa la mngon sum ltar snang dang / rjes dpag yang dag min pa 'a rjes dpag ltar snang dang / sprub ngag yang dag min pa la skrub ngag ltar snang dang / sun 'byin yang dag min pa la sun 'byin ltar snang bcas pa lta bu/sna da bad / sna kha'am rigs mang po1spreld/ 'chol ba'am go rim su mi gnas pa dang / 'phred dam logs ba ba/smod/ sdod spyad dang sgod du rung mi rung lta bu ni/ dper na/ rna ba mi gtod sgod kha spub pa lta bu skyon dang / yid la mi 'dzin sdod zhabs rdol sta bu'i skyon dang / nyon mongs dang 'dres sgod dug can lta bu ldan pa'i slob ma ni sgod du mi rung ba yin de las gcig shos ni sgod du rung ba lta bu'o/ /lug snam/ btsag gam rdo zhig dang / yug gam bubs tshang ba'i snam bu/snam phran/ snam spyor gyi snam phran nam snam bu chung ba/spyod da / dzā snye'am dzā ka'i me tog dzā ti ni skye ldan te rtsi blon gyi rigs shig yin/ de bzhin du sna ma ni srin shing la 'jug snye/ shing sman gyi rigs shig yin/ sne'u/ sngo'am sngo dri 'gags sel ba dang rtse chung / 361

snang da pa ra/ rtsa/sa pa13ma skyon zhugs ba sna da za 'i ming tsam dang kar1sa pa'i ngo sna 1 ser sna/ dam du 'dzin pa'am 'jung dge pa'i don te 1 gtong —sgyu di mi phod pa'isnase che1pa1 1 ba /rdo sdom zug/ ka/ba skong ngang spyon ( sgyu — ste / dper1 na / slob phrub ma cha pa pa4ྈ sgo sna ka 'a debs ji1 ste ngu /chen sgyu dged snyum sa shig ni sgom pa'i sdi4 1 tshag dpe tsā na / phyag ka5 rab/ gri snye rngo ( kun bsnams pa ni 'khyer ba'i)che— bkunas ba bam ‘ba'i ma —0 mi (4 sa 1 rgyab kyi snam logs khyu ba kyi don ya—go—ba'i snam lo tsa ka kyi ka rgyab bsgyu rnga 3 —pag che zur spyi don /ka—/ bsta ba bza3za sems/ bzheb pa ni chab —sgyu ba 3 bde kun no ra pa 5rdog 61 8 'dzo (1 shā4 'i sems— sa ma bsam pa / ka da che— pa ba hūṃ yi na‘ gzu/sa gcib/—11 na /lto rdo za bldan/ zas sogs la nan ta she1 byed pab che/ sgyu snye— bab la byed ba tsā rdon 3 phyo1rdo bkar ba / / bdangs pa ni rtsa ba za gas dzis gre bar 'gags — ka 6sgyu mi shā)— —rwa ka sgyu 3 ku t+ta1 bu /bar shā — bka'/ pa zad par dka( 1sgyu ༄6 bas ma par dka3da —3'am mi hūṃ sa gu — shā—do na 1 bsna ga brnag pa shi bzod ba 34— bas3stu bka'i ma dran pa'i don she / yid — ka brnag lha bu /mdu na du ba sdur/ bsnyu — sna 'a zhe ka—rwa— da ba 1 'dren rngo—'i no 31 dī 1 mdun rngo rngo ke do pa 'am tshur 'dren pa lha bu/36 3

zas pa'i brdogs/ sa la sogs sbas pa'i don can gyi brdogs pa ni gab pa'i don/res gzung brnam/ sum cu pa'i gzhung skabs bshad pa'i ni sgra'i 'jug yul te/ nges gzung la 'jug pa'i brnan pa ni dmigs su gzung ba'am logs su dgar ba'am bkar ba'i don/ dper na/ blo bzang ni slob phrug nang nas sbyangs 'bras legs shos lin lta bu/bsnagand bsnun/ gnad du bsnun pa ni gsang du snun pa'am rdeg pa ste/gnad che sar gzhus pa'i don/ mtshon bsnun/ mtshon cha bsnun pa ni lag cha sdun pa'i don te/ rgyab pa'i don/ dper na/ gri bsnun pa lta bu/nu ma bsnun/ nu ma bsnun pa ni 'o 'dzin nam nu zho snyun pa'am nu ru 'jug ba 'am blud pa'i don/bsnyel bsdubs/ srol ka'am lugs bsnyubardo pa ni snub pa'am nyams pa'am nub par byas pa'i don/gong 'og bkar/ ltag 'og bsgor ba'am sdor ba nor du 'jub/ pa'am dkrugs pa'am brje ba lta bu'i don yin/bsgol/ bsgol ba'am sdol ba ni brje ba dang phan tshun nam bla 'og rim min du sbyor ba'am rtseb pa/ seng ge mjing bsgol dang rdo rje rgya gram lta bu sgol mar byas pa/mtshon bam mas/ mtshon cha'am lag cha bsnams pa ni thogs pa'am khyer 363

ba'am bzung ba'i don yin zhing / sgom pa dus da lta ba'i tshig godu sa bsnar/ dus phyi bsnur byas pa'am dzi bshol byas pa ni1 nar 'gyangs su btang ba'i don dang / snga bsnur byas pa ni nye ru btang ba'i don/zhib mor brtsar/ zhing par bsnur ba/ snag tsha sogs snur ba'i don/mjug bsnar/ mjug ma'am rnga ma bsnar ba'am snar ba ni brkyang pa'i don/dri bsnams/ sna'i gzung bya bsnams pa'am sgom pa ni dri bro bar byas pa'i don yin/ bsgoms kyang mthong /dem nem bsnems/ zhem zhem ni snem pa'i tshul dang bsnems pa ni snem pa'i 'das tshig dang mnan pa'am zhem zhem byas pa/mang du bsnan/ mang po dang yang yang du kha bsnan pa ni sdon pa'am sgon ma bcug pa'i don/ de bzhin du 'dres pa'am bsres pa'am legs par gob smos/ bsgos pa ni ba jis pa'am mnyed pa'am 'phur ba'am sbrus pa'i don te/ pags pa bsgos lta bu pags pa mnyed pa'i don no/ /sgo ba ni bsgos pa'i dus da 1 ba'i tshigababang pa/ pang pa'am thu ba ma pang bu 'jug lha bu ste/ phru gu pang du len lta bu/par bu/ sgod kyi bye blog ste/ mar par dang zhag par/ snyug ma'i par bu lta bu/spu wab 'ji na/ sgra snyan nam rgyud mangs 'dzin pa/ 'chang pa'i don/gcig lu/ grogs med pa/ rkyang pa/ 'ba' zhig kho na/ reng por go364

bar/ ri mo 'bri byed dam tshon 'byug byed la gob tra bris/ pa nu ni shing gi lo ma'am ri mo pa nu pros pa/ ri mo pa nu ni bkra shis pa mtshon byed/ dpal phe'u dang cha 'dra'i ri mo/bu ku/ mda' yab dang lan kan te rgya nag skad/ don la khang pa'i nya rgyab bam chu skyor 'a zer ba dang gen rgya yang zer/bu kud/ 'dab chags shig ste/ bu pu khu shud kyi bsdus tshigabur gyis lur/ 'phur tshul lam 'phur ba'am nam mkha' la 'gro ba/kun dī ka/ gdugs dkar ram chu skyes ste/ me tog pad+ma la 'jugadzi ba ling / pi tha 'i zhes rgya gar rked zur ga pa ste/ grog ma dang dbyibs mdog 'dra ba'i sman zhig yin pas grog sman yang zer/pa shi/ bod kyi btsun pa rgya nag tu phyin te chos bshad nas thob pa'i go ming zhig /pa shig zer ba sog skad yin/ don la slob dpon nam dge rgan zer/bza/ me tog pad+ma/ ming gi rnam grangs la 'phyo ba'am4'dam skyes sam chu skyes sam 'dab yangs sogs mang du yod/ba ba ldan/ shing rgya skyegs sam ke shu ka bal sha yang zer/lus btsugs/ pus mo ni sgyid khug gi mdun cha ste/ pus mo'i tshigs sa la btsugs pa'am pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs pa'am 'dzugs pa/pog por/ pog ni spos kyi don dang por ni phor pa'i don te spod blugs sdod/ga lur/ ka thur gyi sgra zur chag pa ste/ dri ngad ha cang ldang ba'i sman zhiganus can dang ga bur yang zer/ 'thul ba ni dri ldang ba'i don/ba zad ma/ dpe cha sogs spar zin pa'i dngos po la par ma dang / par zhes pa 3༷6

'dra ba dang srur ba'i ming tsam mtshon pa'i sgra ste/ bu 'di pā la nas bar rgyab pa zhig 'dug lta bu/po ti/ glegs bam ste/ pusta ka zur chag gi sgra/ po te che ba re la shog grangs lnga brgya tsam dang / po sta 'bring ba re la shog grangs bzhi brgya tsam dang /po dī chung ba re sa shog grangs nyis brgya nas sum brgya'i bar yod1bsna ta/ blo gros dang 'grogs pa rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i dbang po/rig pa'i gnas lnga ni/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ nang rig pa bcas lnga'o/ /ze prog sgo lcags kyi ze ma'i rtse dang ze ba'i rtse yin snyam/prog zhu/ dbu rgyan dang / rtse zhwa/ prog ces pa rtse la grags/ dper na/jo bo la prog zhu bsgron lta bu ni/ jo bo la dbu rgyan bsgron pa'i don/'og pag ska rags kyi rgyan nam ked par 'phyang ba'i tshar tshar/lur khang / pur ni ro'am gdung gi don/ de 'jig sa'i khang pa la pur khang ngam zo khang da nga / gdung khang / sreg khang zer/par tang / dre'u rngog ste/ mtha' sne dre'u yi ze rngog dang 'dra ba'i gdan/de la grum ze dang stan khru bo yang zer/po ṭa la/ rgya gar gyi skad de ri bo gru 'dzin zer/ sgra nyams nas po ta la zer/ 'di ni sgrol ma'i gnas ri zhig dang dmar po ri ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams yin/lu sa la/ sman 'o su'am bsod nam dpal 'dzoms zer ba'i sngo zhigalu shel rtse/ sman zhig ste/ nus pas skyug pa gcod pa dang bad kan tsha ba sel/ de sna bya zas dang khru da byed chog pa'i rtswa zhig yin/pa sangs/ pa lu sangs ste gza' bdun gyi gcig gza' bdun ni/ gza' 366

zla ba/ gza' mig dmar/ gza' lhag ba/ gza' phur bu/ gza' pa sangs/ gza' spen pa/ gza' nyi ma'o/ 1za phab/ pra phab pa ni pra se na 'bebs pa ste/ rdzas sngags sogs kyi sbyor ba la brten nas lkog gyur gsal bar ston ba/ mo btab pa yang zer/spru bdu/ sngo gling 'bru gsum gyi bye brag ste/ sngo sman rigs shig yin nus pas pho ba'i tshad pa dang / mchin tshad/ glo tshad bcas sel/pags pa/ shing gi pags pa'am shun pa'am skogs pa lta bu dang / gzig gi pags pa lta bu sogs/lag pod/ lag tshab/ lag pa g.yar ba/ phan tshun sa ka'i rogs re mos byed pa'i ming tsam/ dper na/ kha sngon khong gis nga la las rogs byas byung bas de ring ngas khong la lag pod slog dgos yod lta bu/po thos kyab / po zos pa ni ji ltar thogs pa'am re ltar thogs pa 'am ji tsam 'gor ba'i don yin/ dper na/ re ltar thogs kyang lan bdun pa lta bu ni rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas la rigs nas rigs su skye ba re ltar thogs pa'am ji ltar thogs kung skye ba lan nam thengs bdun pa thogs nas dgra brtsom pa'i go 'phang thob pa/ kyang ni sdud sgra yin/par gyis 'phar/ par gyis te/ 'phar tshul dang 'phar ba ni 'phag pa'i don1bdabadabag tshad/ rgyang grags brgyad kyi tshad la dpag tshad gcig yin/ rgyang graṭa gcig la 'dom pa lnga brgya yin/ dpag tshad ni reng thung 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi mtho shos yin/ dpag ni 'jal ba'i don ma'ang go361

rjes dpag rtags mthong 'brel ba nges pa'i rjes su lkog gyur dpag pam 'jal ba'am nges pa'am rtogs par byed pa ste/ dper na/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / chu skyar las ni chur ces bzhin/ lta bu ni du ba'i rtags la brten nas me yod pa shes pa lta bu dang chu skyar lding ba'i rtags la brten nas chu yod par shes pa lta bu yin/ de ni rjes dpag la brten nas rtoṭa pa yin/bkyi pa/ dra// lkog gyur gyi gzhal bya/ dam bca'/ rtags kyi yul/ bsgrub bya/rtogs bya dang gzhal bya tsam la 'jugadapog dpog pa ni 'jal ba'am nges par rtogs par byed pa'i don/ dpog bzhin pa ni 'jal bzhin pa/rgyal po'i dpya khral/ sa gzhi skyong ba zer ba ni rgyal po'i ming gi rnam grangs yin dpya zhes pa ni khrul gyi don yin lag dpyar yang 'gyur snang /dpyang thag dpyang pa ni 'phyang ba ste/ thur du btang ba/ dpyongs byed thag pa la sogs thur du dpyang pa'am 'phyang ba/ dpyangs pa/dpag med/ dpag pa tshad dam gzhal du med pa/ gzhal du ma mchis pa/ 'jal du med pa'i don/dmag dpung / g.yul gyi dpung tshogs sam rgyal byed/da lung bu chung / rkang thang gi dmag rkang dmagadaper na/ don nam dpe can gyi dpe'am dper brjod dam bkod na nges bzung ngam dmigs kyis 'byed pa'i don/dbe zad/ dpe dang phal cher 'brel ba'i byad gzugs yin nam snyam ste dpyad/ don la sangs rgyas shukya thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog sogs dpe byad brgyad cu la go sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad brgyad tsu ni/ thub pa'i sen 368

mo zangs mdog dang / /mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams/ /thum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang / /rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med/ /long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang / /seng ge glang chen bya dang ni/ /khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang / /mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khrim bag chags//byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham/ /gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku/ /mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /sku yi kho mag yangs shing bzang / /gom stoms bdang spyan gnyis ni/ /dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dab / /sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang / /shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang / /yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang / /gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang / /dku thum skabs phyin ma rnyengs dang / /phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni/ /zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang / /kun nas lta na sdug pa dang //kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni/ /spe ba gnag bag med pa dang / /phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang / /phyag ris mdangs yangs zab ring dang / /zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang / /mchu ni jim pa ltar dmar dang / /ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang / /dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang / /gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba thum/ /rdo dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang / /byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang //mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni/ /spyan yangs pa dang ji ma stug/ /pad ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang / /smin tshugs ring dang 'jam pa dang / /snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang / /phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang / /nyams pa rnam par sgangs pa dang //dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang //dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang / /dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang / /stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings dang //mi shor dri zhim skyes bu yi//yid di 'phrog par byed pa dang / /dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang 369

por bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ji ltar byung zhe na/ 'du byed spums cad la 'dod chags dang bral ba nyid kyis sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bu nyid dang / sems cad thams cad la phan ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa nyid kyis sen mo mdog sdum pa nyid dang / rigs kyi mchog 'as skyes pas sen mo mtho ba nyid dang / tshul kha da ma smo ba med pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams rlud— pa nyid dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams rgyas pa nyid dang / yang dag par mthar gyis zhugs pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams byin gyis phra ba nyid dang / lu sa la sogs pa'i las dang 'tsho ba rab tu bsrungs pa nyid kyis rtsa mi mngon pa nyid dang / nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa grol ba nyid kyis rtsa mdud ba med nga nyid dang / shin tu sbas pa'i chos kyi blo gros can nyid kyis long bu mi mngon pa nyid dang / bgrod dka' ba'i gnad thams cad las skye bo sgrol bar mdzad pa nyid kyis zhabs mi mnyam pa med pa nyid dang / mi zil gyis gnon pa la mkhas pa nyid kyis seng ge'i stabs su gshegs pa nyid dang / nam mkha' la gshegs par mkhas pa nyid kyis ngang pa'i stabs su gshegs pa nyid dang / skyes bu'i khyu che/chog la mkhas pa nyid kyis khyu mchog gi stabs su gshegs pa nyid dang / skor phyogs kyi lam dang mthun par gshegs pa nyid kyis g.yas phyogs su ldos cing gshegs pa nyid dang / mdzes par mabs pa nyed kyis mdzes par gshegs pa nyid dang / rtag tu sems gya gyu mi mnga' ba nyid kyis mi yo bar gshegs pa nyid dang / yon tan lang dag par brjod par mdzad pa nyid kyis sku 'khril bag chags pa nyid dang / sdig pa'i chos dang ma 'bags pa nyid kyis sku byi do ra byas pa lta bu nyid dang / gdul bya dang 'tsham pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis sku rim par 'tsham pa 370
