nyid dang / sku ma sogs pa kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba'i phyir sku rnam par dag pa nyid dang / thugs thugs rje can gyi phyir sku 'jam pa nyid dang / thugs rnam par dag pa'i phyir sku rnam par dag pa nyid dang / chos gdul ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir mtshan rdzogs pa nyid dang / yangs shing mdzes pa'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyir sku'i kho lag yangs shing bzang ba nyid dang /thams cad la thugs stoms pa'i phyir gom pa stoms pa nyid dang / rnam par dag pa'i chos ston pa'i phyir spyan rnam par dag pa nyid dang / chos go sla ba ston pa'i phyir sku shin tu gzhon sha can nyid dang / thugs rtag tu ma thum pa'i phyir sku zhum pa med pa nyid dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par 'phags pa'i phyir sku rgyas pa nyid dang / yang srid pa zad pa nyid kyis sku shin tu grims pa nyid dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba shin tu rnam par phye ba ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis yan lag dang nying lag shin tu rnam par 'byes pa nyid dang / tshig gi don shin tu rnam par dag pa ston pas gziṭa pa rab rib med cing kam par dag pa nyid dang / slob ma tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par gyur pa nyid kyis dku thum pa nyid dang / 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma sbags pa nyid kyis dku skabs phyin pa nyid dang / nga rgyal gyi 'gying bag bcom pa nyid kyis dku ma stongs pa nyid dang / chos zad pa rnam nga ra zlog pa nyid kyis phyal phyang nge ba nyid dang / chos zab mo rtogs pa nyid kyis ste ba zab pa nyid dang / slob ma mthun par 'dzin par 'gyur ba nyid kyis lte ba g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba nyid dang / 'khor kun nas mdzes par gyur pa nyid kyis kun nas mdzes pa nyid dang / thugs gtsang ba nyid kyis kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba nyid dang / dus ma yin pa'i chos 'dul ba dang bral ba nyid kyis sku la spe ba dang gnag bag med pa nyid dang / lus 371

la sogs pa'i zo bdog bde ba 'thob pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag shing bal ltar shin tu 'jam pa nyid dang / mdangs yod pa'i dge sbyong chan po rnyes pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo mdangs yod pa nyid dang / chos zab ma la gnas pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo zab pa nyid dang / phyi rjes su yang dag par yongs su dag pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo ring ba nyid dang / bslab pa rab tu mang po kun ston—par mdzad pa nyid kyis zhal ha cang mi ring ba nyid dang / 'jig rten thams cad gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar rtogs pa nyid kyis mchu 'im pa ltar dmar ba nyid dang / tshig 'jam po 'dul ba nyid kyis lngags mnyen pa nyid dang / yon tan 'thad pa mang ba nyid kyis ljags srab pa nyidadang / chos 'dul ba byis pa'i skye bo chags pa can gyis gting dpag dka' ba nyid kyis ljags dmar ba nyid dang / bsnyengs pa thams cad mi mnga' ba nyid kyis 'brug gi sgra dang ldan pa nyid dang / snyan pa la sogs pa gsung pa nyid kyis gsung snyan cing mnyen la 'jam pa nyid dang / srid pa kun tu sbyor ba bsdams pa nyid kyis mche ba thum pa nyid dang / skye bo gdu' dka' ba 'dul bar mdzad pa nyid kyis mche ba no ba nyid dang /chos 'dul ba shin tu dkar ba nyid kyis mche ba dkar ba nyid dang / mnyam pa'i sa la gnas pa nyid kyis che mnyam pa nyid dang / mthar gyi mngon par rtogs pa la yang dag par rab tu ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis mche ba byin gyis phra ba nyid dang / shes rab mchog la gnas pa nyid kyis shangs mtho ba nyid dang / skye bo gtsang ma phun sum tshogs pa nyid kyis shangs gtsang ba nyid dang / chos shin tu rgya che ba'i phyir spyan yangs pa nyid dang / sems can gyi tshogs drangs pa nyid kyis ji ma snyug pa nyid 312

dang / 'gro ba gzhon nu mthams nud mngos bar mgu ba nyid kyis spyon dkar nag 'byes shing pad+ma'i 'dab ma rangs pa lta bu nyid dang / rtag tu sbyi rjes su gzigs pa nyid kyis smin tshugs ring ba nyid dang / chos 'dul ba 'jam po la mkhas pa nyid kyis smin ka'ajam pa nyid dang / thugs kyi rgyud dge bas brlan pa nyid kyis smin stum pa nyid dang / kun tu skyon gzigs pa nyid kyis smin ma'i spu mnyam pa nyid dab/ mchog tu gnod pa bzlog par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag ring zhing rgyas pa nyid dang / 'dod chags la sogs pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba nyid kyis snyan mnyam pa nyid dang / sems can thams cad kyi rgyud ma nyams par mdzad pa nyid kyis snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams pa nyid dang / lta bas byas pa spums cad kyis gzhan du mi 'gyur ba nyid kyis dpral ba legs par 'byes pa nyid dang /smra ba spums cad 'joms par mdzad pa nyid kyis dpral ba dbyes che ba nyid dang / smon lam ldams cad yongs su rdzogs ba nyid kyis dbu shin tu rgyas pa nyid dang / yul gyi dga' ba bzlog par mdzad pa nyid kyis dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa nyid dang / mthong ba dang sgom pas spang bar bya ba'i bag la nyal spangs pa'i phyir dbu skra stug pa nyid dang / bstan pa blo 'jam pos yongs su shes pa nyid kyis dbu skra 'jam pa nyid dang / zugs 'dod chags la sogs pas ma 'khrugs pa nyid kyis dbu skra ma 'dzings pa nyid dang / rtag tu tshig mi rtsub pa nyid kyis dbu skra mi gshor ba nyid dang /byang chub kyi yan lag gi me tog bkram pa nyid kyis da bu skra dri zhim pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad du mdzes par gyur pa nyid kyis phyag dang zhabs dpal gyi be'u dang bka shis g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan pa yin no/ /dpe za/ glegs bam dang yig cha/ glog deb sogs la go373

dpen/ dpen pa/ mkho ba/ yid du 'ongs ba phangs pa/dam da rgyud/ rnam par spyod pa ni khyad 'phags kyi shes rab dang rnam pa ra dpyad pa/rtoka da rgyud/ rtog pa dang dpyod ba gnyi blos 'jal ba tsam mam rtsing zhi kyi khyad kyang yod/brtag dpyad/ brtag pa dpyad pa gnyis gzha' ba dang rtog dpyod kyi yul lam bya las dang gcig tu rtel na ming tsam yin pa gong 'og la rigs bzu dgos/rje dpon/ rje bo ni gtso bo'i don dang gzhon nu gdong drug ste/ — lhadabang phyug gi bu chung ba lha'i dmag dpon la go zhing dpon po ni dbang byed po la zer/11ba dpon/ slob pa'am klog pa'i dpon po ni bla ma dang dge rgan la go ba yin/sems dpa' che/ sems ni bsam pa'i don dang dpa' ni dpa' ba/ mi ldog pa/ snying stobs brtan pa la go ba dang che ba ni chen po ste rgyal sras sogs/ dper na/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' lta bu/bdabying dub / dpyid kyi thig le ni sa bon nam khu ba la go ba dang / dpyid dus ni dus kyi khyad par/ dpyid ka yang zer/dpral ba/ smin me'i steng gi ngos sam thod par godapyi ma so sta zur ྈma dku dpyi dang nu ma'i bar zer ba lta bu/da sprangs/ dpyongs pa ni dpyang ba'am 'phyang ba'i don te/ dgon pa'i nang gi gdung ma'i ngos dra phyed dpyang 'dug lta bu dang dpyongs shig lta bu skul tshig go374

shing nga da lung bcad/ dge slong ma'i nu ma sgrib byed kyi gos phu bcad/dpung rgyan/ lus kyi dpung pa mdzes byed kyi rgyan zhig/ dpung gdub lta bu/dar dpyabs/ dar gos thur du dpyangs pa ni gdung ma sogs pa'i rgyan cha zhigadapangs ma bo/ dpangs zhes ba mtho dman gyi tshad dam 'phang ngam mtho tshad la godapag bsam shing / lha'i ljon shing ngam yongs 'du'i shing /dpa' bo/ snying stobs can nam sdar ma min pa'i don/dpa' ba/ spro ba 'phel ba'am snying stobs brtan pa'i don/dpang po/ che bzhi ste bden rdzun 'byed pa'i dpang po'i ming ngam gnya' bo ste khag theg la godapod/ yi ge sogs dpod pa/ rang gis smos nas gzhan la 'bri ru 'jug pa/ rgan lags kyis de ring tshig gsar dpod bris btang gnang song lta bu/gso dpyad/ sman khong du btang nas nad gso bar byed pa dang / dpyad ni thur ma sogs kyis rtsad phyi nas 'dren pa'am phyir 'don pa'am 'byin par byed pa ste/ gso ba rig pa/dpyis pyin/ dpyis ni gting ngam mtha' dang phyin pa ni son pa'am thon pa'i don te/ mthar phyin pa'am gting thon pa lta bu/dpyas mi ma dogs/ gzhan la 'phya smod mi byas pa'am skyon mi btags ḍa4'i don/dpal ldan/ ji skad du/ dpal mo dbyangs cad blo dang sde gsum gyi/ /phun sum tshogs dang 'byor pa mdzes pa dang / /'tshog chas 'jigs med 376

tshal dang 'bags pa dang / /bdud rtsi rnams la dpal zhes rab tu grags//zhes gsungs te/ dpal zhes grags yul ni/ dpal mo/ dbyangs can/blo/ sde gsum/ phun sum tshogs pa/ 'byor pa/ mdzeb pa/ 'tshog chas1'jigs med/ tshal/ 'phags pa/ bdud rtsi bcas yin/ dpal mo zhes pa bud med mchog la zer ba dang / dbyangs can ni sgra gdangs snyan po can/ blo ni sheb rab dang / sde bsum ni/ 'dod yon gyi sde dang / nor gyi sde/ chos kyi sde'o/ /phun sum tshogs ni bkra shis pa dang / 'byor pa 'i longs spyod dang / mdzes pa ni yid du 'ongs pa/ 'tshog chas ni 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang / 'jigs med ni snying stobs can dang / tshal ni nags tshal dang skyed tshal dang / 'phags pa ni phul du byung ba/ bdud rtsi ni 'chi ba med pa'i sman no/ /ldan zhes yod pa 'i don/dpang lo/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ rab byung lnga pa'i nang byung ba'i bod kyi lo tsā ba snyan grags can zhig11pha spad/ pha bu'am khu/spun zla/ sku mched/ nye du /spang bya/ dor bya'am gzhom bya'am sbyang bya'am spong byed kyi yul lam skyur bya ste/ med par bzo yas kyi gzhispangs/ spangs pa ni dor ba'i don dang spangs zin dus 'das pa/sprab po/ dbul po'am med po'i ming /rngod pa ched/ lag pa'i spar ba changs pa lta bu dang sbar mo'i don/376

spa dbyug spa ni shing gi bye brag yin la sba yang zer/ dbyug pa 'khar bzadon/ sba dbyug kyang zer/ lus po 'khyor byed kyi 'khar ba sba dbyugazad/ sprad pa'am sprod pa'am ster ba'am gtad pa'i don/ sprad nas 'phros 'dug lta bu/spos/ bdug pa byug pa sogs kyi spos/ dri zhim tsan dan las bzos pa'i sbos lta bu/jin/ sdin pa la chu 'dzin yang zer/ blo spros/ 'od sogs spro ba'am spros pa ni 'od sogs 'phro ba'am gtong ba'am rgyas par byed pa'i don yin/ spro ba ni dus da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i bya tshig dang / spros pa ni dus 'das pa dang skul tshig gnyis la 'jugalobs spyod/ longs pa'am tshang bar spyod pa'am spyad pa/ 'dod yon nam 'byor pa'i ming yang yin/ ltad mo sogs ni mig gi longs spyod te/'dod yon dang / rgyu nor la longs spyod te/ 'byor pa yin/sgyud/ spyod pa ni spyad pa/ 'jug pa/ nyams su myong ba/ brtul zhugs/bya ba byed tshul/ bslab pa'i don dang / ya rabs kyi spyod pa dang ma rabs kyi spyod pa lta bu la'ang 'jugazab spos/ bdug spos ral pa can zhig ste/ sman rigs shig yin/ nus pas dug tshad dang / snying nad tsha bas lus skrangs pa bcas la phan/zar spor/ srur ba dang sgor ba me sogs 'bar du 'jug pa/ snga ma spar ni dus 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i bya tshig dang / spru ma spor sna dus da lta ba dang skul tshig ste/ 'di ltar mag len nyer spyod dang bstun nas rigs bsgre/spen/ spen ma ni/ rtsi shing zhig te/ lha khang sogs kyi thog steng du rtsig byed 371

kyi shing / phyag ma yang byed/sbyil/ spyil bo/ rtswa sogs kyi khang ba'am spyil bu/ rtswa yi khang chung la go/spro/ spro ba ni/ yid dga' 1 lus po skyid pa/ nyi ma sogs dro ba'am tsha ba/ dge ba'i bya ba la brtson pa lta bu/spen tog gser dngul las bzos pa'i bud med kyi mgo rgyan/ yang shing spen ma las bzod pa'i lha tshugs shig la'ang gospug rin chen zhig ste/ chab rong lo stong lon na spug tu 'gyur bar bshad snyam/ rin chen mchog spud pa/ rgyan cha sogs lus la spud pa ni brgyan pa'am spras pa'i rdon/spa/ spa ba ni/ mdzes pa'am brjed chags pa'i don/gnas spar/ go gnas dang rin gong sogs mtho bar spar ba'am spor ba ni 'phar du 'jug pa/ bteg pa1 'dren pa/ par brgyab pa/ spel ba'i don yin/bya spur/ 'dab chags dang shog bu spur ba ni 'phur du 'jug pa/ lding bar byed pa'i don no/ /spur bya ma 'ongs pa dang / spur byed nga lha ba/spur zin 'das pa/ spur cig ces pa lta bu bya tshig dus gsum gzugs mi 'gyur ba kun la sbyar/gzhan du zags/ gnas gzhan du spags pa ni gnas gzhan du 'phag du 'jug pa'am 'phar du 'jug pa'i don dang / gnas gzhan du gtong ba'i don/mgo spu/ mgo las skyes pa'i spu ni skra la zer zhing / kha spu dang ba spu sogs kyi spu la'ang /sprug sprub rdul sogs sprug tshul lam sprug pa'i ming tsam/378

thags kyi spun/ spugs kyi rgyu la sbyar rgyu'i spun nam snal ma'am skud ba1/spe'u/ lcags ri'i phyogs mtshams kyi mkhar ram khang chung ngam sdong po'i ming /gces sprus/ gces po'am rtsis chen nam snying sdug gi don/spyad dngos/ spyad bya'i dngos po'am ka ca'am nor gyi spyi ming /spel/ spel ba ni 'phel du 'jug pa ste/ bstan pa gong du spel lta bu dang /skyed pa ni bod kyi rig gnas dar spel btang lta bu rgya skyed pa dang / 'di ni sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du spel pa'o lta bu ni sbyar ba'i don dang /tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug spel ba ni mnyam du bsre ba'i don no/ /spa ma/ shug pa lta bu'i shing zhigabyu1 da / spru nag ma ni sngo sman zhigab ba / me lcags las me len pa'i spra ba/ jis mgo spra ba'i me tog ltar dkar zer ba dze bu/spungs/ spungs pa'am spungs pa/ du ma gcig tu phung por byas pa/ du ma ni gnyis yan yod pa la du ma dang du ma spungs pa la phung po zer/ sdom pa'am spungs pa dang / bcer ba'am phon por spungs pa/spra chal/ 'do med dam gtad so med pa/ nga shor te rgan po spra chal lang ba lta bu/spod/ zas kyi bro ba skyed byed dam sha sman te/ sga pi/zho jis/ zho dang 'o ma dang chu sogs kyi spris kha'am spris ma/ kha'i zhag lha bu/zags/ spags ba bsres pa'am bsgos pa ste/ spags ma dang spags gnyis spags nas za ba lta bu/ spags ma ni spags dang mnyam du za ba'i zas/'bab mo sprud smod/ phan tshun 'khrug 'dzing sprad pa dang sprod pa gnyis 379

sbyor ba'am thug pa'am rgyab tu 'jug pa/smyos/ spyos pa'am spyo ba ni/ gshe ba'am gshe gshe btang ba'am bsdigs pa'am 'jigs snang skul ba'i don/jigs/ sprugs pa ni/ gzhan du brdzangs pa'am bskrad pa'am gzhan du phud ba'i don/spyi'i thun mong bka — ger min pa/ gzhan du phyi rol gyi grub mtha' smra ba grangs can pas spyi ni gtso bo yin/ des 'bras bu thams cad kyi rgyu byed pa shin tu lkog gyur zhig yod ces zer/bkas/ bye brag gam sger gyi don/ dper ma/ mkha' sding ni spru spyi'i ming yin la sgos su khyung gi ming yin no lta bu/spel ma/ re mos sam 'dres ma ste/ rgya skad dang bod skad spel ma ma shod cig lta bu/'dzin sprung springs/ 'phrin cha'am 'phrin yig spring pa'am springs pa gnyis skur ba/ sring ba/ 'bri ba/ 'gro ba/mun sprul/ rmongs mun gyi sprul pa bskyed pa ste/ rang bzo lha bu/spob ba/ spong ba pa ni/ sgong ba po'am sgom pa po sgong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo lta bu/spongs shig spongs ba'i skul tshigaspyod pa/ spyod pa pa ni/ phyi rol spu stegs pa'i bye brag rgyal dpog pa yang dzar/ des mchod sbyin kho nas tshangs pa lta spru'i mtho ris kyi go 'phang thob pa yod par 'dod la sdug bsngas nye bar zhi ba'i thar pa med par 'dong do/ /tshur spyon/ tshur 'byon nam byon ni dus gsum gzugs gcig snyam/ don 380

la tshur shog ces dang tshur phebs ces pa'i don/dka' spyad/ dka' ba'i las spyad pa'am spyod pa1chos spyod/ yi ge 'bri ba dang sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang sems bskyed sogs bcu tshan gsum lta bu ni dang po yi ge 'bri ba la sogs pa bcu ni/ gsung rab kyi yi ge 'bri ba dang / mchod pa 'bul ba/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ chos nyan pa/ 'dzin pa/ klog pa/ 'chad ba/ kha ton du bya ba/ chos kyi don sems ba/ chos kyi don sgo ma pa bcas bcu'o/ /gnyis pa sbyin pa'i phar phyin la sogs pa bcu ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin ba/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ spubs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'o/ /gsum pa sems bskyed sogs pa bcu ni/ sems bskyed pa/ gdams ngaganges 'byed yan lag rigs/ dmigs pa/ ched du bya ba dang / go sprub/'jug sgrub/ tshogs sgrub/ nges 'byung skrub pa bcu bcas khyon bcu yi tshan pa gsum yod do/ /spor/ spyor ba ni mang du spel ba'i don/spros bral/ spros pa dgag pa sogs dang mtshan ma dang rtog pa sogs dang bral ba spangs pa/ tshad mar mi 'dzin pa dang stong nyid dam chos nyid la gospul pa/ sbyin pa'am stob pa/ bskyed pa'am 'phrul du 'jug pa'i don/ de bzhin du mchog gi sprul sku ste/ gdul bya thun mong ba'i snang ngor mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan te 'gro ba gdul ba'i sku'i rnam par sprul pa'o/ 381

gza' spen ba/ gza' bdun gyi nang gses shigagos spo/ gos sbo ba ni gyon pa brje ba'i don dang / gnas spo ba ni/gnas gzhan la sgyur ba'i don dang / rigs pa spo ba ni/ rigs pa gzhan ka sgyur ba'am bsgro ba'i don/chu por sbyibs/ chu bor gru shan sogs spyings pa'am spying ba ni/ bying du bcur pa'i don/ chu yi gting du bcug pa/za mil/ jing rtsi'i ro'am snyigs ma dang / lhung bzed glon byed dang lcags g.ya' len byed/sbyin/ shing dang shog bu sogs 'byor byed kyi jis shig ste/ kha sprin lta bu/khe spogs/ ṣe la 'jug pa'i sbogs te/ rgyal kha dang skyed bogs 'don pa/dre ke/ gcan gzan zhigabasgyu/ sprel che ba/ mi ni spra yi brgyud pa yin lta bu/che/(1/ spre g.yo byed/ ba las spra chung ba la spre'u zer ba yod/ sprung po/ grung po'am sgrin po'i ming / blun po min pa/spobs bas dge gdeng tshod ste/ de star bshad pa'i spobs pa'am gdeng nga la yod sta bu dang / mi 'jigs pa'i don la'ang 'jug pa dang / sngon ma thos pa'i chos don rtogs nas bskal bar bshad kyang mi zad par byed pas dge ba ste legs spyad/snyed spyom/ mi ni dgag tshig dang spyom pa ni ngom pa'am bdag nyid sgrog pa'am spyoms pa ste/ gzhan gyi snang ngor 'phyar 'phyar byed pa'i don1 spyi blugs/ dge slong gi chab bum ril ba ste chu blugs sgod/kha sprub/ kha 'og tu bstan pa/ lhung bzed kha spub pa/rgyan gyis zas/ lus la rgyan dang dpal gyis sprad pa'am mtshan pa'am brgyan 382

ba'am spud pa'i don1sbyi bo/ spyi gtsug gam mgo bo'am rtse mo'i don/nul sprugs/ rdul can gyi gos sogs sprug sprug byas pa/rdul khri zabs/ rdul gyi don la thob pa'i spabs rdul chags pa/ rna spabs ni/ rna ba'i skyags pa/spyod pa/ sgo gsum ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa byed lugs/spa bkong / spa bkong ba/ zhum par byas pa/ri yi spo/ ri yi rtse mo'am mtho ba'am rtse'i spung ngam rmang 'gram yang yin snyam/ mig gi spyan/ mig gi don nam mig gi zhe sa'i tshig ste spyan nam 'dren byed/spyan pa ni lta rtog mkhan nam gnyer pa lta bu/sga stag lgags/ stag gi pags pa ste/ 'dir gzhi stag lta bu dang ma 'brel ba'am med pa dang / rnam dbye drug pa'i sgra yod na pa rkyang pa 'bri dgos pa dang gal te rnam dbye drug pa'i sgra med na la mgo ldan pa'i lngags dang ma 'brel ba ni pags pa lta bu dang / mi lngags snying lngags la sogs lta bu/phaphang pa/ pang ba'am ngos dang thu bar gophun tshogs/ phun sum tshogs pa'am dpal dang legs pa dge ba tshogs 383

pa'i don/phun tshugs shing / phun tshogs gzhi tshugs pa'am zug pa ni/ gzhi chags pa'i don/ shing ni tshig phrad/ de bzhin shing ni rkang 'thung ste/ chu rkang pa nas 'thung bas rkang 'thung zhes pa dang / yang phun zhes ring thung 'jal byed tshad kyi khyad par te/ phun gang ni sor mo phyed kyi tshad yin/ phun ni rgya nag skad yin deng skabs bod skad du skar ma zer/(1 gu/ na phra ba'i byis pa/phrad/ phrad pa ni mjal ba'am thug pa'i don la go ba dang sprad pa ni phan tshun 'thab mo sprad pa lta bu ni thug pa'i don dang 'phrad par yang 'jugazul phran/ dngos po la che chung gi tshad dbye skabs chung shos ni rdul phra rab lin jing rdul phra rab bdun la rdul phran gcig yin pa dang / rdul phran bdun la lcags rdul gcig lcags rdul bdun la chu rdul gcig /chu rdul bdun ma ri bong gi spu rtse na gnas pa'i rdul gcig ring pong gi spu rtse na gnas pa'i rdul bdun la lug gi spu'i rtse na gnas pa'i rdu'/ gcigalug gi spu'i rtse na gnas pa'i rdul bdun la glang gi spu rtse na gnas pa'i rdul gcig glang gi spu rtse na gnas pa'i rdul bdun la nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi rdul gcig bcas de lta dbye yi yod/ phran zhes pa bdag dang gyi na'i don la 'jug pa dang / phran bu ni chung chung nam cung zad kyi don—phra/ phra ba ni zab pa dang zhib pa'i don dang / phra mo ni chung chung gi don dang sbom po min pa la go zab pa'i don la go ba ste/ rig lam phra mo 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod lta bu ni rig lam gting zab mo 'byed nga'i rnam dpyod lta bu/ba kyi sbyo 1 ba / ba grangs gnas kyi ming ste/ brgya phrag kha shas sogs dang phrag zhes 384

pa tsho'i don dang stong phrag khri phrag sogs la'ang 'jugaphyang / 'phyang ba'i ming tsam snye/ thur du phyang ba/ zhe la nor bu'i do shal phyang ba'am 'phyang ba lta bu/spul/ phrul pa ni 'phrul pa'i ming ngam thur du phyang zhing phrul ba'i rgyan/ rna la rin chen gyi rgyan cha 'od chem mer phrul 'dug lta bu/phyal/ grod pa'i zhe mu /phyang re / phyang nge ba/ 'phyang tshul lam 'jol le ba/ ring por 'dzar ba'i rnam pa/ ba lang gi zhe la lkog shal phyang nge ba lta bu/phyug po/ phyug pa po ste/ nor can nam rgyu can nam 'byor ldan gyi don dang 'byor pa yod pa'i don/pyir/ dgos pa gsal byed kyi phrad de/ ched dam phyir ram slad dam don bcas bzhi 'dra'o/ /phyogs bcu/ phyogs chos ste/ tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung gi ming tshig shig yin 'di ni rtags gsal gyi sbyor ba 'god pa'i tshul dang po/ de sgrab kyi ༄shes 'dod chos can skyon med kyi 'god tshul mthun par yod pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa la zer/ de la chos can dang de tshogs pa'i bsgrub bya'am dam bca' sogs zer/ phyogs bcu ni/ shar sto nub byang bzhi dang mtshams bzhi dang steng dang 'og bsnan pas bcu'o/ /phyin/ phyin pa ni 'gro ba'am song ba'am son pa dang thob pa'i don ma'ang 'jugaphyag dar/ phyag snyigs sam gad snyigs la go ste/ phyag dar khrod lha bu ni gad snyigs kyi khrod zer ba'i don/phyi sa/ dri chen nam bshang ba'i ming ste/ skyag pa/ mi gtsang ba1386

phre ma/ zhib tu btags sman dang gro zhib 'a/—sogs /bye/ rtsam pa dang phye ma ste zhib mo'i don la 'jugad/ mkhan/ ga rtsa bo'am mo dpal te/ mo 'debs mkhan la gophongs pa/ dbul ba/ nyams thag pa'i don te/ rgyu nor phongs pa ni rgyu nor med pa'i don/pying rul/ phying ba ni ma btags pa'i gos/ phying zhwa dang phying dmar/phying pa'i lham lta bu/ rul ba ni 'dul ba'am rnying ba'i don /phyar/ phyar ba ni/ gdengs pa/ gzas pa/ brtsams pa/ 'phyar ba'i rdon/dper na/ ral gri gdengs pa'am ral gri gzas pa ni phyar ba'i ngon phyi bdar/ rdul sogs phye zhing phan tshun bdar ba'am ming com ste/ cog tse'i steng du phyi bdar rgyab lta bu/phyis/ phyes pa ni/ phyi ba'i ras dum gyis cog tse dang ri mo la kags phyis pa'am dag par byas ba 'am dbyi ba'i don/ phyis shig kyang zer/phyags ma/ rdul dang gad snyigs sogs phyag byed kyi dngos po/phyags/ 'phyag pa'am gad rgyag pa'i don—nam phyed/ mtshan phyed/ dgung phyed ka phyed ma/byen gtong / 'og rlung ngam rtug dri gtong ba'am btang ba/phyi rdo/ phyi rdo 'phongs ni phyi ba'i rdo dang phyi rgyab kyi rdo phang ba'am 'phen pa'i ming /dbang phyug dbang da/sa phyug pa ste lha che na dbang phyug lta bu dang rgyar po'am ga rtsa bo'am mgon po la godabugs phyub / dbugs phyung ba ni sems gso btang ba'am gnas srur ba lta bu ni dper na rgyal pos dbugs phyung ba yin lta bu dang — dbugs 386

bton pa tsam ni kha dang sna nas dbugs 'byin pa'am bton pa'i don/sgo zu/ khang pa'i sgo la sogs pa phye ba dang / srol phye ba ni srol gtod pa'am srol brtsams pa'i don dang / phye ba ni/ phral ba dang bkrol ba la'ang 'jugazags lham/ rkang pa la gyon rgyu'i lham mchil lham ste/ dug sbrul gyi kha chu'i dug spung byed kyi rab byung gi lham/zan tshegs/ chung nga'am nyung nga'i don dang lung phran tshegs ni 'dul lung sde bzhi'i gcig 'dul lung sde bzhi ni/ lung rnam 'byed/ lung gzhi/spung zhu ba/ lung phran tshegs bcas yin/speng ba/ go rims bstar ba'i gral lta bu/ phreng ba brgyud pa lta bu dang / byu ru'i phreng ba dang tsan dan gyi phreng ba sogs/phrogs/ sbogs pa ni phrog pa'am len pa tshar gcod pa'i don/ phrogs shig /dbang cha 'phrog pa'am rgyu nor sbog pa ni len pa'i don nam bzung ba'i don/za men/ lha'i g.yog 'gor ram gdon te mi ma yin zhig/ 5 men gyi skad cha la 'jog byed mi nyan lta bu/phrin las/ las ka dang mdzad pa'am bya ba sogs kyi don/ 'di lo khyed phrin las rgyas po byung song lta bu ni mdzad pa rgyas po byung song zer ba'i don/sa phyod che/ sa phyod che ba ni dper na/ rlangs 'khor ni rta'i nus par dpa ṭa na sa phyod che ba yod lta bu dang thos bsam sgom pas sa phyod che ba gzhan dang mi 'dra lta bu ni dka' tshegs chung la don chen po sgrub pa'i ming ngam sleb che ba'i don/phyugs/ dud 'gro'i bye brag rta dang ba phyugs la sogs pa'i ming /381

spru ma/ bud med la sogs pa'i mngal gyi bu sgod dam sha ma la zer1phye ma leb/ me lcer lcebs pa'i srog chags ste/ kang pa drug dang gshog pa bzhi yod pa'i 'bu/phru ba/ sgod rdza ma'am ji'u ste ji ma chung ba'am khog ma'i ming /pyir phyung / phyi rol tu'am phyi ru 'byin pa'am bton pa'i don dang bkar ba dang bkol ba bskyed pa'ang 'jugaphyag gis/ lag pa' ba sor mo lnga pa'am yan lag lnga pa'i don/ phyag gis di lag gis zhes pa'i don/ phyor/ dar cha la sogs 'phyar ba'i skul tshig te/ phyor cig lta bu/smin zag smin ma'i phrag ni mig gi smin ma gnyis kyi mtshams dang / mche ba'i phrag ni mche ba gnyis kyi mtshams lta bu/phyag 'tshal/ phyag 'tshal ba ni 'dud pa'i don te/ sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo sta bu/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis phyag byas pa'i don/nyin mtshan phyad/ nyin dang mtshan mo'i dus phyad pa ni rgyun pa dang rtag pa/phyad par ni rgyun du'am rtag tu zhes pa'i don/za ma/ dbyen nam skyo ma'am mi mthun par byed pa'i tshig ste/ phan chun bar la phra ma ma bcug lta bu/phrag dog gzhan gyi rgyu nor dang mdzes pa phun sum tshogs pa mi dga' ba'i sems/phrab pa/ dpung mtshams kyi cha ste/ phrag par khur lta bu dang / phrag gong la bzhag lta bu/ zal/ phral ba ni kha 'phul ba'am dbye ba phye ba'am spu dad du byed pa'i don/phyin zad/ phan chad dang slad kyi cha'am rjes ma'i don de/ da phyin chad 388

spebs ma yong lta bu/yid phyung / sems phyung ba ni mi dga' ba'am skyo ba bskyed pa'am yid byung ba'i don de/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la yid byung skyes song lta bu ni 'jig rten bya ba la snying po mi 'dug snyam nas sems nang skyo ba bskyed pa/sun ci pyin/ rang gis rang la sun 'byin pa'am skyon bton pa dang /gzhan la sun ci nus 'byin pa'am skyon ci nus bton pa/pyi 'brang / phyi 'brang ba ni rjes su snyeg pa'i don/ /pyir/ phyi ru'am rgyab tu/ phyir log lta bu slar ram yang log pa'i don/phyogs/ phyogs pa ni kha bstan pa dang gzhol ba'am 'jug pa'i rdon te/ rnam dkar gyi las la gzhol ba ni rnam dkar gyi las la 'jug pa'am phyogs pa'i don/ phyin ci log phyin ci log pa ni nor ba dang go log pa/ mi bden ba—'i don te/ lta ba phyin ci log pa lta bu ni lta ba nor ba'i don/mi pham/ mi pham pa/ rgyal ba/ rgyal tshab gsum ni rgyal ba byams pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ tshig phrad/ tshig phan tshun phrad pa sbyor ba ste/ slar bsdu sogs/ slar bsdu ni/go ngo do no bo mo 'o ro so to bcas bcu yod pa dang / de bzhin sum cu pa'i skabs bshad pa'i phrad rang dbang can dang gzhan dbang can la sogs ni tshig phrad yin no/rnam dbye byed/ tshig dang don rnam par dbye ba 'byed pa'am tha dad par byed pa dper na/ rnam dbye dang po lta bu la mtshon na/ ka ba zhes pa rnam dbye dang po yin zhing des tshig don gnyis kas ka ba ma yin pa'i dngos po thams cad las rnam par dbye ba 'byed pa yin no/ /de ltar rnam dbye tha 389

dag ma nor ba'am ma 'dres par phyed pa ni rtogs pa'am ngos 'dzin pa'i don/dru ma/ dmag sgar ram pho brang gi don/ ri yi steng na phru ma btab lta bu/phyar g.yeng / phyar ba'am 'phyar ba ni rgod pa sems mi gnas pa'i don dang g.yeng ba ni sems gang sar song ba'i don te rnam g.yeng ka zer/ slob sbyong skubs su sems phyar g.yeng ma byed cig sta bu/'phagazhan la 'phya 'phyas/ gzhan skyon can la 'phya ba'am 'phyas pa ni smos pa'am skyon brjod pa'am dpya ba'am smad ra gtong ba'i don/ 'phya ba ni ma 'ongs pa'i tshig dang 'phyas pa ni 'das pa'i tshig go/'od 'phro 'phros/ 'od 'phro ba ni 'od 'gyed pa'am 'od 'tsher ba'i don dang / sems 'phro ba ni sems gzhan la g.yeng ba'i don/ 'phros ni 'das tshiga'aphyi pa/ sa khung du sdod pa'i srog chags shig gi ming /'phye po/ rkang pa med par lto ba sogs kyis 'gro mkhan/dus pe 'phyis/ dus tshod 'phyi ba ni dus tshod 'gyang pa'am 'gor ba'i don/ 'phyis pa 'das pa'i tshigarnam 'phrul/ rnam par 'phrul ba ni sprul ba'am g.yo ba'am 'gyur ba'i don te/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul lta bu ni 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa la goji 'phrul/ sgyu ma'i mig 'phrul nam rnam 'gyur ram snang cha dang / sprul 390

pa'am sgyu dra ste sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis rdzas sngags la brten nas mig 'phrul ston pa lta bu dang / yid shes sgyu 'phrul mdzes sku'i 'jo sgeg lta bu ni sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa lta bu'i sta na sdug pa'i sku yi rnam 'gyur ram snang cha la go ba yin no/ / mda' 'phen/ mda' yi ming gi rnam grangs sgro ldan yang zer/ 'phen pa ni 'phangs pa'i don/'phangs/ 'phangs pa ni skyel ba'am skrur ba'am rdeg pa dang / rgyab pa'am 'phang ba'am rlag pa'i don/ me sgrogs 'phangs lta bu ni me skyogs kyi rdzas mdel 'phangs pa'am gnas gzhan la skyel ba'am skyur ba la sogs pa'i don/nam 'phab / nam mkha'i 'phang mthon po/khri 'phang / gdan mthon po'am steng /go 'phang / go sa'am go gnas mthon po/ dbu 'phang yang zer/'phrog 'phrog pa ni dngos po la sogs pa gzhan gyi lag nas phrogs pa lta bu/'phrog ni ma 'ongs pa'i tshig dang / 'phrog byed ni lha khyab 'jug dang ba rkya byin gnyis la'ang go/ phrogs ni dus 'das pa'i tshig yin/mtsho 'phyur/ rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'phyur ba dang / me phung gi dud pa'am du ba 'phyur ba dang / chu yi spu ba 'phyur ba lta bu'i don/dub 'phyur/ grangs gnas shig ste/ bye ba bcu la dung 'phyur gcigalam 'phyug 'phyugs/ lam mam 'jug ngogs ste bya ba'i 'jug sgo 'phyug pa'am 'phyugs pa ni nor ba'am 'dzol ba'i don/ 'chugs kyang 'thad/snying 'phyo/ snying ni don gyi rgyal po'am sems kyi don la go ba dang / 'phyo ba ni g.yo ba'am mi bde ba'i don/391

'phyon ma/ bud med smad 'tshong ma'am 'jud mthun ma yang zer/phye 'phyar/ phye ni rtsam pa sogs dang spun pa ste/ snying po med pa'am rdzun ‘she la go/ 'phyar ba ni rlung la bstan pa'am bkag pa'am brkyang ba'i rdon te/rtsam pa sogs lhag par 'phyar ba'am phyar ba'i don/'phangs/ 'phangs pa ni 'phen pa'i 'das tshig ste/ mda' 'phangs pa lta bu dang / 'phangs bstod dang 'phangs smad kyang / de bzhin du slob sbyong gi dus tshod 'phro brlag phyin na 'phangs pa la ang zhes pa lta bu chud zos pa'i don la 'jug/'phongs/ 'phongs tshos ste/ rkab g.yas g.yon 'bur po gnyis kyi ming dang ༄ba tshos dang tshang ra yang zer ba rkub kyi ming /'phag 'phag gyen du 'phag tshul yang yang 'phag pa ste/ sgo lo sa steng du 'phag pa lta bu/mgo zum 'phur/ mi sogs kyi mgo bo 'phur ba dang ras kyi thum po la sogs 'phur ba ni mnyed pa'i don dang bya sogs 'phur ba ni nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i don/'phong gis/ 'phong ni mda'am mda' rig dang / 'phong dpyad ste/ mda' rtsal gyi yo byad dang 'phong skyen ni mda' rtsal la go zhing 'phongs skyen sna lnga ni/ rgyang nas phog pa/ sgra drag par phog pa/ gnad du phog pa/ mi tsho ra bar phog pa/ tshabs che bar phog pa bcas lnga'o/ /gis ni byed sgra/gzhan 'pham/ pha rol lam gzhan 'pham pa'am pham pa ni glags rnyed pa'am gtor thub pa'i don dang / 'joms thub pa'i don/'phal ka 'greg 'phal ka ni ri mo'i don dang shing sogs sbyor mtshams kyi kha la'ang go ste/ pang leb gtes kyi 'phal ka 'grig pa'am sgrig pa'i don1 3 92

'phyan zhing / sems sogs 'phyan pa ni dbang med du 'khyams pa'am yan pa ste sems g.yeng ba'i don/ zhing ni tshig phrad/ma phyo lding / nam mkha' la bya sogs 'phyo ba ni g.yo ba'i don dang lding ba ni sding lding byed pa'i don/dar 'phyar/ dar bo che sogs 'phyar ba'am phyar ba ni slong ba'i don/ 'phyar ba ma 'ongs pa dang da lta ba'i tshig dang / phyar ni 'das tshiga'aphral/ 'phral ma ni myur ba/ de ma thag glo bur te 'phral du song lta bu/ma dzin/ gzhan la bskur ba'i gtam ma lon te/ 'phrin yig dang 'phrin pa lta bu/'phrod/ 'phrod pa ni sprod pa ste/ skad cha ra 'phrod song lta bu skad cha mthun pa'i don dang / sman 'di lus por 'phrod byung lta bu lus por phan pa'i don no/ /'chi 'phras/ shi sdug gam mya ngan te/ 'chi 'phras rgyag pa lta bu ni 'chi khar na tsha ma bzod par rkang lag 'khrub pa'am 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa'i don/sems la 'phreng / sems la 'phreng ba ni snying la 'dzin pa'i don te ma brjed par dran pa'am yid la chags pa'i don dang / bgrang 'phreng ni grangs rtsis byed kyi phreng ba/'phral ba/ gdong gi dpral ba dang so sor phral ba/ spu dad du dbye ba'i don/ za 'phyings/ skra dang bal sogs dam du 'brel ba'am phying pa ltar gyur pa/phyag dar 'phyag phyags snyigs sam gad snyigs 'phyag pa'am phyag pa ni byi dor te gtsang sbra byas pa'i don /'phyang / 'phyang ba ni thur du dpyang pa'i don te/ mchu thur du 'phyang ba'am 393

rna thur du 'phyang ba lta bu/'bye ba/ 'gro ba'i don te/ lto 'phye sta bu sto ba'am brang sogs kyis 'gro ba'i don dang / bgrad kyang yin snyam/bzab ba / bla ma ni/ yon tan gong na med pas gong ma'am steng ma dang / yon tan gyi khungs gtugs sar gyur bas phyi ma dang / yon tan slob par byed mkhan yin pas slob dpon yang yin pa dang drin lci ba'i sgo nas bla ma la lci ba yang zer/bla na gong na'am gong ma na sogs/ yon tan bla na ma mchis pa lta bu ni yon tan gong na ma mchis pa'i don/bla bre mchod rdzas sam thog yol bre ba ste/ bla res kyang zer ba ni jo bo la sob/sa pa'i dbu steng du yod pa'i thog yol/ gnam rgyan yang zer/rjas/ bres ba ni phan tshun sprel ba'am sbras pa/byams pa/ gzhan bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa'am phon 'dod pa1 mdza' ba la go ba ni/ chung 'dris byam sa pa'i zhal ras lta bu dang / rgyal ba mi pham pa ni rgyal ba byams pa la gobyar byur/ mthu dang gnod pa dang skru ngan dang ltas ngan sogs byur bur gang tshul/byabs pa/ thur du 'then pa'am 'og tu 'dren pa dang / seb3 ba dang dor ba'i don la'ang 'jug ste/ thal rdul sogs phyes ras kyis byabs pa lta bu thal rdul sel ba'am dor ba'i don/394

byer ba/ bros pa'am kha 'thor ba'am song ba ste khyab pa'i don/ze/ 'jal byed de/ bre bo che/ bre kha la sogs pa yi don/bye ma/ phye ma dang chu bo ga ba'i bye ma sogs/zabs ba/ 'brab pa'am gtor ba'am sdun pa/ rgyab pa/ 'ju ba ste/ ka ba'i don/byang / sdig pa byang ba ni spangs pa'am med pa bzo ba'i don dang / byang chub pa ste khog tu chub nas spyongs pa'am mkhas pa'i don yin/ 'byongs shig sto bu skul tshig ste dag par byos 1 bu/zan g.yog bran tu bkol byed dam g.yog tu bkol byed pho mo/byes/ gzhi min pa dang / phyogs byes ba sogs/byon/ byon pa ni 'byon pa'am phebs pa'am spebs pa'am byung ba sogs— kyi don/byug ba/ kum la sogs pa'i 'byug rdzas/byin/ byin pa ni sbyin pa'am ster ba'am gnang ba'i don/byis pa/ shed ma bye ba ste/ lo gcig nas brgyad bar phru gu dang skye 'phags ste/ so so skye bo dang 'phags pa'i bar dang mkhas blun ste/ mkhas pa dang blun po'i bar dang / rgan gzhon gyi zlas phye ba'i byis pa ni phru gu/ so so skye bo/ thun po sogs yin/bya ra/ lta rtog gam spyan pa'am mel tshe'i ming / bya ba/ dgos pa'am las ka dang / mdzad pa dang bya ba'i las lta bu/byos/ byos shig ste/ gyis shig dang / thugs shig ces pa'i skul tshigazam ze/ bā rgyu ṇa yi zur chag pa ste/ tshangs pa'i bu rgyud rigs bzhi'i gcigatshangs pa'i bu rgyud rigs bzhi ni/ rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ bram ze 3༷6

rigs/ dmangs rigs so/ /zag ri/ brag gi ri bo dang brag zhun dang brag skyibs lta bu'i don/byang / shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi'i gcigabyol1 byol ba ni 'dzur ba'am yol ba/ 'byol ba dang byol cig lta bu ni/lam byol nas phyin pa lta bu dang / lam dog sa nas tshur byol ba lta bu'o/bya/ 'dab chags spyi'i ming dang / bya zhes bod kyi sa cha'i ming zhig dang /dus ming zhig byi'u bya chung ba'am bya phrugabyi ba/ lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dang po/ lo 'khor bcu gnyis ni/ byi ba dang glang / stag yos6 'brug sprul/ rta/ lug sprel/ bya/ khyi/phag bcas so/ /byi la/ zhi mi ste byi ba'am mi tsi'i dgra/byad/ ngo'am gdob dang bzhin la go ba dang / yo byad dang cha—byad sogs la go dbyibad tshugs ni/ rnam pa'i don/byol song / dud 'gro spyi'i ming dang thogs med du 'gro ba'i rdon/zab 'gro brang gis 'gro ba ste sbrul la sogs pa'i ming /zang / lus kyi mthong ga'am brang khog dang / de bzhin gzhan pho brang dang bla brang sogs la'ang 'jugabyi' byil/ bshud pa'am shad par tshul lam dbyibs ste/ lag pas sma ra byil byil byed bzhin skad cha bshad pa lta bu/bla gab/ steng ngam thog g.yogs/ khang pa steng g.yogs kyi don/bla gos/ steng ngam stod gos ste/ dge tshul slong gnyis kas nyin mor bgo ba'i stod gos ser po zhig yin/ deng skabs yongs grags su chos gos zer/396

grus/ thus pa'am blu ba ni rin gyis nyos pa'i don yin zhing blus shig sta bu sku tshig yin/bla/ bla ni rung ba'am bzod pa'am chog pa'i don te/ dper na/ gzhan la bde skyid byung na rang la sdug sngal byung yang bla lta bu dang / chos kyi don du phan pa'i bya ba tshang ma byed bla sta bu/blun po/ blun po sems med lta bu'am rmongs pa dang blang dor mi shes mkhan la zer/'dam byib / 'dam nang bying ba dang chur bying ba ni nub pa'am spyings pa'i don/blo/ blo gros ni rig pa dang shes rab kyi don/ blong blo ba / blong blong po ni rtab rtab po'ang tshabs tshabs po dang / mi bde ba'am rig pa mi gsal ba'i don/bro nad/ bro zhes pa nad kyi ming ste/ bro 'tshal ba ni na ba'i don/babs zal/ sprub byed dam thabs bral ba'am 'bral ba ste/ spubs med pa'i don/ bral ba ni 'phral ba'am spangs pa'i don la'ang 'jugaka bor/ bro bor ba ni mna' bskyal ba'am sgog pa'i don/11ba / bros pa ni 'bros pa'am 'khyus pa'i don yin/ bros shig lta bu skul dkab/ byan mo/ g.yog mo'am thug tshod ma ste/ bud med kyi ma byan la zer/byi bo/ byi byed po ste/ gzhan gyi chung ma la spyod mkhan nam 'chal po la zer ba dang / byi mo ni rang la khyo ga yod bzhin du khyo ga gzhan dang dga' mgur byed mkhan gyi bud med dang / byi phrug ni pha ngos bzung med pa'i bu phrug gam byi ba'i phrug gu/397

ra nga byar chud/ rang dbang thob pa'am rang dbang du gyur pa'i don / dkag mkham/ mda' mkhan dang gar mkhan gyi ngon/bro gar/ zhabs bro dang zlos gar la gobye ba/ grangs shig ste sa ya bcu dang / me to ga gi 'dab ma bye ba lta bu rgyas pa'i don dang 1 bye ba ni sbal ba'i don la'ang 'jug gobal/ brel ba ni dal khom med pa'i don/zas da / bad/ /ba'i so yis blad pa ni ldad pa'am 'cha' ba'am bcem pa'i don/chu sprub/ chu blud pa'am chang blud pa ni ldud pa'am ster ba'i don —bsgyub ba / zas thug pa la sigs brims pa'am 'brim pa ni ster ba'am 'dren pa'i din dang / brims sheg lta bu skul tshigabrod/ brod pa ni dga' ba dang rtse ba'am brod po'am rtsed mo'am dga' po'i don/bya na/ bya 4na yi zur chab ste1 thug pa' tshod ma ste spags dang mnyam du za yas kyi tshod ma/yo byad/ spyad dngos ste 'tsho ba'i yo byad dam bed spyod gdang yas kyi dngos po/byur bu/ gang tshul lam phyur bu ste/ bang mdzod nang 'bru rig ba byur bur gtams 'dug lta bu/blugs/ blugs pa'am blug pa ni bcug pa'am ldugs pa'am 'jug pa'i don/blugs shib/ lta bu skul tshigar byid/ stobs skyed sman zhig tu 'gro ba'i srog chags 'ig ste/ de'i rnam grangs du ma yod cing / gangs sbal ni sman nus rab dang / skyin gor ni 'bring tsam/ rtsangs pa ni tha ma yin/398

ro bro/ ro bro ni bro ba myong ba'i don dang dri bro ni dri tshor ba'i don/ rgod bro ba ni bzhad gad sogs rtsed mo'i don la goza— ba/ byi ba lta bu'i sems can te/ ab ra'am a bra dang / rdza bra/ brag bra bcas rigs gsum yod/drun/ lud dam skyag pa ste/ bya brun ni bya skyag la zer/dong drubs/ khung sogs su brubs pa'am brub pa ni nang du bcug pa mi thar byed pa'i don/ brungs shig ni skul tshigachu drug chu bo brug pa ni chu 'o rgyas pa dang gang ba'i don/dru ba tsha/ bru ba ni stob/sa pa'am bkres pa'i don/da/sa byer/ gyon gos sogs byer ba ni dmun pa'am zhan pa dang ngan pa'i don yin/ gos byed ltar na/ tshem bu pa ste gos 'tshem mkhan la gobartso blo rjeg tshos sam khrus brtsa blag mkhan te tshos rgyag mkhan dang khrus rgyag mkhan la da/da/ba spyod ba ba / ba ba / gos sogs kyis byibs pa ni g.yogs pa'am bkab pa'i don/bla tshe/ bla ni gnyan po'am gnad dam rten nam rtsa ba'i don dang tshe ni bla'i don srog yin/ mi la sogs pa'i bla srog tshe gsum zhes pa'i bsdus ming /byab bu/ brjed byang chung ba'am kha ming ngam kha byang dang / mdzad 'gyur shing byang lta bur gob dab/ tshon ser po zhigabyugs/ byugs pa ni bskus pa'i don te/ tshon 'byug pa'am snum byugs shig lta bu skul chigakhas blangs/ khas len pa'i don dang khas blang ba'i don/ lag pas blang ba 399

ni lag gis len pa'am sprub pa'am 'jug pa'i rdon te1 khas bshad pa lag len du 'khyol gyi 'dug lta bu/bla babs/ brjod bde ba'am rung thabs dang bde blag dang sla ba dang glo bur gyi don/ dper na/ bla spubs su byub ba las ched du byas pa min lta bu/sa blas khyer1 sa steng ngam sa las 'phags pa'i steng ngam sa dang ma 'brel ba'i par snang / so bla ni sa gsum gyi ya rgyal zhig ste/ sa 'og /sa steng /sa bla lta bu'o/ 1khyer ba ni khur ba'i don/blo brid/ blo brid pa'am rig pa 'brid pa ni bslus pa'i don te/ mgo skor bslu brid ma gtong lta bu/bla dwags/ ming gi rnam grangs sam ming btags pa'am thogs pa'i don/yi ger bris/ nang don gang yin pa de yi ger bris pa'am bkod pa dang /yul ljongs mdzes po de ri mor bri ba'am bris shig ni skul tshigaspu byi/ spu byi ba ni gzhan gyis ma btog kyang rang bzhin du bud pa dang skra byi ba'ang de bzhin no/ /ri mo byi ba ni gzhan gyis ma phyis rang bzhin du zub pa'i don/cha byad/ cha lugs ste/ lung pa so so'i cha lugs mi 'dra lta bu/gzi byin/ gzi brjid dam zil dang nus pa la gobri bri ba ni nyams pa'am 'grib pa dang 'brid pa'i don te/ mtsho kha bri ba lta bu ni mtsho yi gting thung du phyin pa'i don/byi bzhin dang za nye/ de gnyis rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi nang gses/zad/ bra bo ni 'bru rigs kyi nang gses rgya bra sogs/bye byo/ phye byo'am 'byo ba ni rtsam pa dang gro zhib la sogs pa blug pa'i don400

dang / chang 'byo ba ni chang blugs pa'i don1byug ris/ gral lam go rim/bya ba/ bgyis pa'am zer ba'i ming ste/ sum cu pa bya ba dang / rtags 'jug pa bya ba lta bu/ de bzhin du bya ba ni las ka'i don yang yin te/ kha nyung tsam shod bya ba mang tsam byed lta bu/bye zag spyi dang bye brag gnyis su dbye ba'i bye brag ste/ nang gses/ khyad par gsal ba la gorgyal blon/ rgyal po sa skyong ste sa gzhi skyong mkhan dang / blon po ni/ gros byed po'am mdun na 'don gyi don/blo mig blo gros kyi mig gam shes rab kyi mig spyan ni mig gi zhe sa/bde blag bya sla ba'am dka' tshegs med pa'i don te/ gzhung lugs rnams bde blag tu rtogs song lta bu dka' tshegs med par rtogs pa'i don/byed/ byed pa ni/ bya ba sogs bgyis pa'am byed pa'i don/ byed pa'i las la byed las zer/blang dor/ blang ba ni len pa'i don dang dor ba ni 'dor ba'am spang ba'i don te/ legs nyes kyi blang dor la ma 'chugs cig lta bu/blon 'debs/ blon 'debs pa ni zur nas gros 'debs pa'am gros ston pa'i don/za bo/ gtam mam brjod pa'am skad cha la zer/rab byub / khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba ste/ btsun pa'am btsun ma rnams so/ /de bzhin lo rgan drug cu'i skor gcig gi ming ngo / /za bregs/ skra bregs pa dang kha spu bregs pa'am 'breg pa ni gcod pa'am bzhar ba'i don/401

zu da ba blags/ rna ba ste nyan byed la zer zhing rna ba blags pa ni rna ba gtod pa'am nyan pa'i rdon dang — blogs shig dang 1na cig lta bu skul tshigs/31 da/ba bzab dkab / zas gos ngan ngon te spu ma(ka lam dman pa'i don dang —gyi na te cung zad dam phran bu'i don/sgyu che bda'/'ad/ gnang sprin na ma gzengs bstod kyi sted cha—sgyum rngan pa'i don/ zho sha yang rngan pa'i don no/ /4 byin/ byin pa ni ster ba'am sbyin—0'i don/ smad da bla / sman gyi bla ma 'ad/ sman gyi rgyal po ste1 sabs rgyas sman bla lta bu'i zug66na dra/ma thobang ba/ nyon mongs thams cad byang ba'am sgangs pa dang / yon tan kams cad khong du chu ba ba 'am rto gas pa la byang chub zer ba dang / de bzhin rab gis spyang bya'i gnas gang yin pa de la byang nas shes pa'am boms cha chen po yod pa la byang skrub pa zer/ dper na/ khong gi shing bza'i lag rtsam la sprung chub pa lceg yod lta bu/zab zad che / bad/ bla na med pa ni gong na med pa'am gong na ma mchis pa'i don/byin rlabs/ gzi byin gyis rlab ba/ pa'am rlob pa ni nus ldan du bsgyur ba'am nus pa 'jug par byed pa'am thon par byeb pa'i don/byu ru/ rin chen dmar po ste1 byi ru ma nga zer/bdabakadabyen/ dbyen pa ni mi mthun pa'am phra ma dbye ba'i meng 1dbye zal/ dbye ba ni phye ba'i don te bye brag tu dbye ba'am khyad par dbye 402

ba/ bral ba ni spangs pa'i don/chos dbyibs/ chos rnams kyi dbyings ste/ rang bzhin dang khams dang 'dzin byed 'byung gnas ni stong pa nyid kyi don/dbyibs/ gzugs kyi khyad par dang ring thung sogs/dbyer med/ dbye ba byar med pa/ spu mi ngad pa/ gcig pa/ chu dang 'o ma lta bu dbyer med pa lta bu dang / bu ram gyi gzub shes dang bu ram gyi ro gnyis dbyer med pa lha bu/dbu ma dang dbung dang dbus/ gsum/ ni dkyil ma dang bar pa dang dbu ma ni rtag pa'i mtha' dpa chad pa'i mtha' gnyis gang rung la mi g.yo bar dbus su gnas ba sa na dbu ma zhes brjod/ dbus na mo yang dkyil gyi don/dbyu gu/ chu tshod dang shing bu dang dbyug pa chung ba ste/ nyi tshod lta byed kyi shing bu/dbyig pa dang dbyug pa/ de gnyis ber ka'i ming dang / snga ma dbyig pa ni brda rnying /dbyugs/ dbyugs pa'am dbyug pa ni skyur ba'am 'phen pa'am snun pa'i din dang dor ba'i don/ yang 'jug med pa'i dbyug ni da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i tshig dang dbyugs shig lta bu skul tshigajib dbol/ jing bu'i chu dbol ba ni chu btang ba'am 'chor ba'am rtol ba'i don dang shor ba'i don/chu dpo/ chu dbo ba'am 'bru dbo ba ni pho ba'am 'bo ba ste/ bshos pa'i don/ da/zad ma bdab/ skur ma'i khyad par la 'jug pa'i dbo ste/ dbo zla ba lta bu ni 403

zla ba gnyis pa/pyir dbyung / phyir dbyung ba ni phyir phyung ba'am phyir 'byin pa'am phyir bton pa'i rdon/bsnan dbyub / sun dbyung ba ni skyon bton pa'i don/ mtshon gyis dbug mtshon cha dang lcags gzer jo bas kyis dbu sha pa ni i khung sogs phug pa'am 'bugs pa ste/ rtol ba'i don/ da yul ngo/ dbu(ka ba po ni bkre na po dang med po ste/ sprang po la go1 no ra—gyis dbul na sprang— po dang rig gnas kyis da bul na gren pa ste bu/‘dbugs dbyung / kha ngang sna'i rlung (shā bu dbyung ba'am phyung ba dang 'byin pa ni dbugs btang ba'i don/ nor mi dbrog rgyu nor 'a rngo gas ‘3'i spyad dngos mi 'phrog pa'am rtse / 'jom ba/ pa'i don/ mi ni dgag sgra'i tshig tshon dbyi tshon rtsi dbyi ba da za li ge dbyi ba ka 'byid pa'am phyis pa'i ma dag par byed pa dang sub shā1'i don/da ji ba/ che / 'jam po la sigs par— go ste/ tshon rtsi lta bu 'jam po 'a4 dbyig mo/dbyig dbyig dbur tshul lam 'jam 'jam mam byil byil byed pa'i sgra'i khyad par ci / na/dbur/ dbur ba ni 'jam por byed rwa1 dang 'khrud pa'i don te/ sman dbur ba lta bu/dpon po/ tsha bo ste/ bu'i bu la go ba ni pha las bu byung / bu las tsha bo byung / tsha bo las yang tsha byung lta bu'o/ /sku mched rtsis pa'i don1dbyangs1 gdangs sam nga ro la go ste/ 'jam dbyangs dang / dbyangs can 404

ma lta bu'o/ /dbul/ dbul ba ni/ skabs re bya tshig la song zhing rgyal po la nor sogs dbul bya/ 'bul byed phul lta bu dbul bya ni dus ma 'ongs pa ston byed du 'jug pa yin/ lha la zhal zas dbul lta bu lha la mchod par byas pa'i don no/ /sma mi dbab/ sma ni dma' ba'am dman pa dang zhan pa'i don/ mi ni dgag tshig dang / dbab pa ni 'bebs pa'am 'bab tu 'jug pa dang bab pa'i don yin pa sprel na sma 'bebs mi byed pa'i don no/ /dbyig gnyen/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa ste/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi ya rgyal/ mngon pa'i gzhung 'grel byed po/dbu/ dbu ni mgo dang rtse mo dang gong ma dang ga rtsa bo sogs kyi don dang /bstan bcos la sogs gzhung dngos dbu tshugs song lta bu 'go tshugs pa'i don dang / bya ba'i dbu ni las ka'i 'go dang / lus kyi dbu zhabs ni gzugs po'i mgo dang rkang pa'i zhe sa yin no/ /gdugs dbub/ nyi gdugs dbub pa/ gur dbub pa/ thog dbub pa ni 'bubs pa'am phub pa dang bkab pa'i don yin/ dbub ni ma 'ongs pa ston pa bya tshig go /dbang bskyar/ dbang skar ba ni byed du rung ba'i dbang sprad pa/pa byin/ gzi byin nam gzi brjid dang / byin rlabs lta bu sogs la 'jugadabab/ dbab pa ni 'bebs pa'i ma 'ongs pa bya tshigagatan la dbab/ gtan la dbab pa'am 'beb pa'am phab pa ni/ don la gnas par byed pa'i don no/ /lub dbog bar ma chad pa'i lung dbog pa'am 'bogs pa dang / phog pa'am mnod pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung phog pa'am len pa'i don/406

dbog bya ma 'ongs pa'i tshig yin no/ /khur dbog khur dbog pa ni/ nor la sogs sbyin pa'am gtad pa'am bzhag pa'i don/ de'i dbog kyang ma 'ong ba pa ston byed kyi tshigadaben/ dben pa ni bab/ mtha' dang / mi g.yo ba dang / stong pa ste1 dben pa'i sar ngam 'ben pa'i gnas su lta—bu ni skad sgra gang yang med zhing kha khu sim po'i gnas kyi don/dbral/ dbra(ka ba'am 'phral ba 'ab phral ba ni ral du 'jug pa'i don te/gos dang shog bu sogs dbral ba lta bu/bdabang phyug u ma'i bdab/ po'am u ma'i khyo bo/dbab ldar/ dbang ba ni mnga' ba'i don dang ldan pa yang yod pa'i don te/ dbang can zer/ mngon brjod du dbang lngan ni byang shar gyi—mtshams la go ba yin ‘dbang thang / nga 'a thang ngam kha rje la go dbang shugs chen po la dbang thang chen po lta bu dang / ba rje dbang thang tshang ma tshur thob song lta bu/dbyar/ dbyar kha ni dus bzhi'i ya rgyal dang / dbyar gnas ni1 dbyar zla gsum gyi ring la dge tshul slong rnams kyes khyod tshams las 'das te skya rengs 'char bar mi bya ba'i dam bca'i gnas su 'brel ba dang / dge 'dun nang du 'khrug long mi bya ba dang / thos pa sogs la brtson pa dang /gtsub lab/ khang ral grum bcos shā/ sogs kyi da ma bca' bzung nas dbyar khas len pa'o/ /dbyar rnga ni/ 'brug skad de dbyar gyi rnga gsang ba nga zer/dbang za/ dbang bya la dbang ba po nyi shu rtsa gnyis ste/ mig gi dbang po no ba'i ba bang po/ sna'i dbang po/ lce'i dbang po/ lub kyi dbang po bcas dbang ngo gzugs can lnga'i steng yid kyi da0nga po dang srog gi dbang 406

po bsnan pas rten gyi dbang po bdun dang / pho mo so sor rtog pa'i rten can du byed pa'i dbang po gnyis ste/ pho dbang dang mo dbang gnyis ni rten can gyi dbang po dang / lus kyi tshor ba bde sdug gnyis dang / yid kyi tshor ba bde sdug gnyis/ tshor ba btang stoms bcas tshor ba'i dbang po lnga/ dad pa dang / brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab ste lnga ni rnam byang gi dbang po lnga dang / kun shes byed pa'i dbang po dang / kun shes pa'i dbang po dang / kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po bcas zag— med kyi dbang po gsum bsnan pas dbang po nyer gnyis byung / mi'i dab po ni rgyal po la go ba yin no/ /dbyig mab / nor mang po'am rin po che mang po'i don/dpral dbyes che/ gdong gi dpul ba la sogs khyon che ba'am rgya che —ba'i don1 dbam rlab ba / shā rlabs la godabu ba/ spu ba lagoskyon gyis dbags/ skyon gyis dbags pa dang mar gyis dbags pa ni/skyon gyis 'a pags pa'am bsgos pa'am bsres pa ni ngan pa dang brtsag pa chags pa'i don dang / mar gyis 'bags pa ni/ spags sogs la mar 'dre sa pa'am bsres pa'i do na/ dbags pa ma 'ongs pa'i bya tshig yin zhing 'das pa la 'jug min dpyad/dbre brtsog dbre ba ni btsog pa'am dam ba'am mi ga tsang ba dang gyong po la 'jugakha dbri/ ba/ dbri ba ni kha 'brid pa'am phri ba ste/ dma' bar byed pa'i don/dbri ba ni ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i bya tshig zhes 8da'i dba'/ gus pa'i ngon can gyi dba' ni lags so zhes pa'i don/407

dbal ni sha nyams rtse drod hog dbal ni sha nyams pa dang rtse mo dang zur dang drod dang tog la 'jug pa/ dper na/ rta'i dbal lta bu ni rta shed mo nyams pa'i don dang / phur pa'i dbal lta bu ni phur pa'i rtse mo'am zur gyi don dang / me'i dbal ni me'i drod kyi don dang / rgyal mtshan gyi dbal ni rgyal mtshan gyi tog gi don yin no/ /zha nye'i dbyar 'dab/ sgod stegs byed dam zha nye las bzos pa'i dge slong ma'i lhung bzed kyi stegs bu/'barab 'byams 'byams klas/ rab tu 'byams pa dang 'byams klas pa gnyis mtha' klas pa'am mang po'i don la 'jug rab 'byams thes pa don gzhan la go ba zhig ste/ lha ldan rab 'byams pa sna sngar lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbus su dam bca' bzhag nas ang grangs su tshud pa'i dge bshes shig yin la lha rams pa yang zer/'byung bzhi/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi ste/ sa chu me rlung bzhi la zer/'khrug mngon brjod du dbyar rnga dang sprin sgra zer/ 'brug zer ba ni gtam rgyud las byung ba'i dud 'gro ngo mtshar can zhig ste gtum 'brug gi 'gyur rdo lta bu'o/ /'bral med/ kha 'bral du med pa'am bral du med pa/'brel/ 'brel ba ni phan tshun sprel ba'am sbyor ba'am mthun pa'i don dang /spun lta bu nye 'brel gi don/ 'gal 'brel ni tshad ma'i gzhung 'u gas nang gi rnam bzhag gcig ste/ rig lam 'bring ba'i dang po 'gal 'brel gyi rnam 408

bzhag lha bu/'bras bu/ bskyed bya ni 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid yin la gzhag bya dang don dang dgos pa dngos po rnams ni 'bras bu dang don gcig go dper na/las ka de ltar byas nas 'bras bu gang byung lta bu la don gang byung dang /dgos pa gang byung ces pa lta bu/ 'bras bu yin na dngos po yin pas khyab pa yin no/ /'gru1 nas dang gro sogs dang 'bru ma'am rdog ma'am tshugs ste/ yi ge'i 'bru la yi ge'i 'bru ma'ang zer/'bring po/ bar ma'am dkyil la go'adam 'bying / 'dam la 'bying ba ni 'dam pa bying ba'am nub pa'i don dang / chu la 'bying ba ni chu la bying ba'am nub pa'i don/'drum nad/ 'brum pa ni nad kyi khyad par te/ 'brum dkar dang 'brum nag lta bu/ 'brum dkar ni 'brum nad yang ba dang / 'brum nag ni 'brum nad lci ba'o/ /'byang / 'byang ba ni nyes pa la sogs byang ba med pa bzo ba'i don dang /yon tan sogs byang ba ni sbyangs pa'am slob pa'i don dang / sman btang nas khog pa byang du bcug pa ni lto ba 'khru ba'am dag par byed pa'i don 11/ /'brog dben pa dang dgon pa'i don dang 'brog pa'i yul la 'brog yul zhes zer ba lta bu/'bri/ mo phyugs che gras dang gnag gi khyad par/'brong / ri dwags g.yag rgod/rus kyi 'brom1 ngus kyi bye brag gcig la grags pa'i 'brom ni1 stod lung 403

phu'i 'brog pa'i rigs rus theb ste/ 'gro che/ yī da sa 'dzin za bka' gdams pa'i srol gtod rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas so/ / dbyung 'gyur/ 'byung bar 'gyur ba ste/ ma 'ongs pa'am skye 'gyur gyi 11na/ tshe ma /byed da/ tshe 'byid pa ni/ 'tsho ba dang tshe mgo 'thon pa'am skyel ba'am tshe phyid pa ste/ tshe 'khyol ba'i don1 dper na/ gzhan don kho na'i don du mi tshe phyed na de ni bzang po'o lta bu/'drid pa'i 'byid/ 'drid pa'i don la 3byid pa 'thob cing dbyi ba'am byes pa'am sub pa'i don yang yin/bo ma bab / skra sogs 'bal ba ste 'dzing ba pa rnam ba/ gcod pa'am bshig pa'i don/rdo dpeb ba ta da / legs pa'am yang dag bsnyed ma chos mthun gyi gtam ( ka 'bel gtam zer/ de bzhin du 'bel btam ni rdon gcig rtsal du bton te bshad pa min paྈ bshad bya'i dam grangs sna tshobs pa nas speb ba tre ga dka la zer/ 'bel mchid ni phan tshun lhag por bshab pa'i gta6/ (sgyu/ zer/༄spyod /ba/ sgo 'bye ba ni sgo bye ba'i don dang / srol 'bye ba ni lam sro' bye ba'am gtod pa'i rdon dang / me tog bye ba ni me tog rgyas ji1'i don/'byed/ 'byed pa ni phye ba'i don dang / mdza' brtse'i mthun ba / ka me bad gyis 'byed song lha bu dbye ba'i don dang bral pa'am 'phral ba 'che/ 4joms pa'i ngon me tog 'byed pa lta bu ni me tog la stes pa'i rdon/'bras zan/ brtsas pa'i 'bras la zer/lces 'byog lce'am ro 'dzin spyis 'byog pa ni ldag pa'am dag ba 'i don/khyis lce yis chu ldag lta bu sgyu4 10

zang bsgo/ chang 'byo ba dang phye 'byo ba ni snad gcig nas gcig tu blugs pa'am byos pa'i don/'byangs/ 'byangs pa ni dag pa'am lto ba khru ba'i don dang / chu la sbangs pa'ang yin snyam/'jam ston/ 'brom gyi rus 'dzin dge bshes ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas te bsdus ming du 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sam 'brom ston pa zer/'byon dus/ 'byon pa ni byon pa'am phebs pa'am byung ba'i don/ dper na/ring nas brtse ba'i lha mo da tshur byon lta bu'o/ dus ni tshe skabs yin/'bros shing / 'bros pa ka bros pa'am 'khyud pa'i don dang / shing ni chig phrad yin no/ /bzang / rjes su 'brang ba ni rjes su 'gro ba'am snyeg pa'am 'brangs ba'i don yin la rjes su 'jug pa'i don yang yin/ 'brang ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi bya tshiga'adrub khub / 'brub pa ni sbas pa'am bcug pa'i don te/ mi gson por sa la 'brub pa lta bu/ khung ni dong ngam i khung la gokha 'byed/ me tog sogs bzhad kha 'byed pa ni kha byed pa'am kha phye ba'i don yin la kha dbye ba ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshiga'abyol zhib / 'byol ba ni/ lam sogs byol ba'am 'jur ba'i don rte/g.yo/la ba'i don yin/ zhing ni tshib/ phra da do/ /'byer/ 'byer ba ni/ byer ba'am thor ba'i don dang / nyams pa dang 'bros pa'am 'gro ba'i don ba 'ang 'jugamatshang 'bru'i tshig mtshang 'bru ba'am 'dru ba ni mtshang brus pa'i ming tshig 411

ste/ skyon sngog pa'i don/'byin/ drungs nas 'byin pa ni/ rtsa ba nas 'don pa'am phyung ba ste med pa bzo ba'i don/tshon 'byug tshon rtsi 'byug pa'am snum sogs 'byug pa ni/ skud pa'am byugs pa'i don/'byongs/ sgrib pa sogs byang ba'am dag par byed pa'i skul tshigakha 'bri/ mtsho kha 'bri ba ni/ 'grib pa'am dman pa'am dma' bar byed pa dang / nyams pa'i don/ dgun dus su mtsho 'bri ba lta bu/'drub/ 'brub pa ni 'phel ba'am rgyas pa dang 'khol ba'i don la 'jugabrubs kyang 'thad snyam/sprur ba'i 'byar/ sbyar ba'i don ston pa ma 'byar ba 'jug mod/ 'byar ni byed pa po gzhan—dngos su 'brel med pas rang bzhin gyis 'bur ba la go ste/ gos la rdul 'byar lta bu gzhan su zhig gis sbyar mkhan med par rang bzhin du 'byar ba yin no/ /gong gi sbyar ni byed po gzhan dngos su zhubs pa'i bya chig yin te/ yi ge sbyar sta bu/'byung po/ 'byung ba po ste/ 'byung bzhi'i khams las grub pa'i gzugs can srog chags dang / khyad par gdon gyi rib/sa dang / skye ba po'i don/'byor pa/ longs spyod la go ba dang / lag tu 'byor ba ni lag tu son pa dang thob pa'i don/jikhri zad/ khyi sogs rbad pa ni/ rbod pa'am 'gyed pa'am gtong ba'am skul 412

ba'am mngag pa yi don1 dper na/ ri dwags la khyi rbad pa lta bu/zab sgril/ rdo sogs rbab tu sgril ba'am 'gril ba/ thur du lhung ba'i don/kha zad che/ kha bshad dam kha sgrom che ba'i don te/ 'ur shob dang kha shob lta bu/ za klong / chu'i rba rlabs sam dba' klong ste/ chu 'khor bzhin du gting du nub pa'i klong 'khor/da/ zab ba / bad kan gyi dbye ba zhig ste/ lus kyi me drod nyams pa sogs las byung ba'i pags mdog skya zhing skrangs pa rbab rbab tu 'byung ba'i chu nad cigabo zad rngod/ skra dang bal sogs 'phyings pa'i tshul lam phying ba ltar gyur pa/rngod ma skyel/ ngan sngags mkhan gyis mthu byad ste/ mthu dang dmod mo btang ba'i don dang / than ltas skyel ba'i don/shākaspu ba/ chu'i spu ba'am dbu ba/ji ba / ske la yod pa'i sha lhag te g.yang lnga da byur lnga gnyis yod/g.yang lnga ni lus la mi gnod pa'i ske'i lnga ba/ byur lnga ni god ka'am bka mi shis pa yong ba'i lnga ba yin no/ /11 —skyabar sbyin1 rgyu nor 'a/ sogs pa sbyin pa'am byin pa ni gzhan la rin mi dgos 413

par ster ba'i don/gnod byen/ gdon zhig ste/ mi min lha 'dre'i rigs/sbyin bdag sbyin pa'i bdag po'am yon bdag ste/ sbyin pa gtong ba po la zer/blon/ sgron pa ni grogs 'bod pa/ bcol ba dang 'gugs pa'i don sgron cig lta bu skul tshigasprun pa/ 'bru sogs kyi shun pa'am skogs te/ snying po med pa/sbabs/ sbangs ni rta'i skyag pa la zer zhing lud kyi don/sbang ma/ sbang glum mam glum gyi bcud phyungs zin pa'i snyigs martesbangs/ chu sogs pha sbangs pa'am sbang pa ste/ rlon par byas pa'i don sbangs pa ni 'das tshigasbug phug gam nang ngam sbug ma'am nang ma ste/ khang pa spug la yod lta bu ni1bang pa nang ma'i nang la yod ces pa'i don no/ /nor sba sbas spos sped/ rgyu nor sogs gter du'am sa 'og ka sba bya ste ma 'ongs pa'i tshig dang / sbas zin pa ste 'das ba'i tshig dang / sbos shig ni skul tshig dang / sbod byed de dus da lta ba'i tshig—yin la rdon ni skung ba'am gsang ba'am srung ba'i don/nyis zag nyis sprel gyi don dang sum sbrag ni sum sprel gyi don dang / rkyang pa dang sbrag ma lta bu/za 'bubs/ sbra ni sbra gur gyi bsdus ming yin te/ sbra dkar dang sbra nag lta bu ni 'brog pa'i sdod gnas sam tshang gi ming / sbra dbubs ni da lta ba ston byed kyi bya tshig te/ dbub bya/ 'bubs byed / phub lha bu1ljel nas/ sbrel ni sbyor ba 'jiX sdeb pa'am 'brel ba'i don te/ zung du sprel 414

lta bu gnyis lhan du sbyor ba'am sdeb pa'i don/ nas ni lhag bcas so/ /sprur/ sbyar ba'am sbyor ba ni sdeb pa'i don/spres nas/ sbres pa ni 'khyags pa'am grang ba'i don/ nas ni lhag bcas/spur ma/ rtsi shing chung chung ngam rtswa snyigs sam gzan snyigs dang / spu rdul sogs nyal nyil du spungs pa'i ri gas/rme sbar spor/ rma dang sgron me sogs sbar ba dang sbor ba gnyis sbor ba 'ab ra ba spor cig kyang / zhes sbar ba ni 'das pa dang ma dngas pa 'jug pa dang / sbor ba ni da lta ba'i tshig dang / sbor cig ni skul chig yin/chus sprus/ chu sogs kyis sprub pa'am bsgos pa ste g.yos pa'am bkrus pa'i don/zas sprus/ zas sprus ḍa4'ji— zan sprus pa ni spags g.yos pa'am brdzis pa'i don/zugs bcig zoms/ phyobs gcig tu'am logs shig tu sboms zhes pa la bya tshig gzhan sbom dang sbams 'byung ba ltar na sboms ni skul tshig yin pa blo la gzung la don sboms zhes pa ni sdom pa'am sdud pa'am sre bar byed pa'i don yin/sprum ma/ mngal ldan ma'am she sbyor ma ste/ mngal chags pa'i bud med dam 'khrig pa spyo da par dga' ba'i bud med/lto spos/ sto ba sbos pa'am mgo sbos pa ni skrangs pa'am gang ba'i don/srog chags je/ srog chags kyi khyad par spre ste/ gcan gzan dbre yang zer/ de'i khyeb kyi spu dog ser po dang sto'i spu dog dkar ba/ nyin mor yib nas sdod pa dang mtshan mo phyir thon yong ba'i sems can zhigaphyag spal/ brtsan khang ngam brtsan dong /416

grob spur/ 'bu grog ma/sbal pa/ chu nang sdod pa'i sems can chung ba'i gras/ ming gi rnam grangs la lce med yang zer/11ba / ming ba'i rnam grangs la mig thos kang zer/grogs sbran/ ra mda' sbran pa ste/ dpung rogs sam zla bo 'tshol ba'i don/spungs skyed/ spungs pa ni rig pa grims pa'i don dang / skyed pa ni rgyaskyed pa'am spel ba'i don/ dper na stobs skyed pa'am 'bad pa skyed pa lta bu/spud pa/ 'bud byeb me chas la sogs pa'i ming ste/ ra sprags las bzos pa'i me gtong ba'i yo byad yin/spubs/ nang ngam khog stong gi don ste/ me tog pad+ma'i sbubs dang smyug ma'i sbubs lta bu/sbyig mo/ sgren mo'am gcer bur gosbyig cing / sbyig pa'am 'dred pa'am 'byid pa ste/ 'dam la rkang pa sbyig song lta bu rkang pa 'dred pa'i don/ cing ni tshig phrad/spe ga shed tshad pa'am dbyug res byed pa'i ming /spyor/ sbyar ba'i don/ da lta ba'i bya tshig ston byed yin/sprug tshe/ spug pa ni sha skam pa'am rid pa'i don/ tshe ni dus ston byed yin/lus sprud/ kang pa sbrid pa ste/ kang pa sbrid na 'ja' zhing 'gro mi nus pa lha bu/za 'khar/ sba ni shing gi bye brag yin zhing des bzos pa'i 3khar ba la sba dbyug zer ba dang sba yis bzos lcag tshan ra sba lcag zer/4 6

spom/ sbom pa ni phra po min pa dang / rags pa dang sdom pa la zer/sha zang / sha la 'khor ba'i sbrang bu/zang ma/ sbrang ma'i ming gi rnam grangs la ra yig gnyi pa dang kang drug kyang zer/sbrang dang zags/ sbrang ma'i rtsi me tog gi bcud dang sbrags rngo 'am sbrag pa ste sprel ba'i don/sped byed/ mngon brjod du rdo la sped byed dang brda rnying du gor ma zer/gzhan du smad 'tshong ma la'ang sbod byed zer/gser zam/ gser sogs kyi sbram bu gru bzhi lta bu'am lhad med dang lci ba'am bzang ba/sa le sbram/ gser la rin chen dang po yang zer/ gser sa le sbram dang zangs sa le sbram ni spud tshad dag pa'i don/11zad ba/ las sogs dngos gzhi ma byas gong gi gra 'grig de la sngon 'gro'am sbyor ba zer ba dang / de bzhin du rtsod pa byed pa'i skabs so so'i skrub byed kyi sbyor ba yang dag la rigs pa mang dag yang zer ba dang / sbyor ba ni thabs dang sbyar ba dang / rnal 'byor dang sgom pa'am sdeb pa'am 'khrig po bcas don mang por go ba yin/sprung bya/ nyon mongs spang bya'am 'dag bya dang / yi ge sogs bslab bya la'ang go/spyong byed/ nyon mongs sogs sbong byed dam 'dag byed dang / las dang yi ge sogs slob byed la'ang gosprungs/ sgrib pa sob/sa sbyangs pa ni spangs pa'am dag pa'i don dang / yon tan sogs sbyangs pa ni bslabs pa'i don/411

bdad sbrib / sangs rgyas shākya thub zu/ sogs la gogaso spyob / zla dus tshes grangs nges can zhig la dge tshul slong gis lhung bshags sdom byed dam/ khyim dzo/sa sdo ma pa bsrungs te dge ba gso zhing sdig pa sbyong bar byed pa'i cho ga zhig la gso sbyong zer/ gso sbyong yan kar ga brgyad pa ni/ 'tshe dang gcig chem kun dang gnyis/ 'khrig pa dang gsum1 brdzun—dang bzhi / chang dang lnga— dus min gyi zas dang drugamal stan mtho po dang bdu na/ gru dang gar dang phreng ba'i khyad par dang bcas brgyad ni spong ba/ dgos pa yin no / /ma da ba da 1 lus sogs gtsang ba'am dag za'am grib ma med pa'i don /sbyor/ sbyo ra ba ni sbyar ba'i da lta ba'i pya chib dang sbyor cig lnga bu skul tshig la 'juga'adom sa kyi sba ba/ sba bya ste pho rtabs la zer/cad ro phyags/ ro ni dus mtshan srog bral ba'i lus khu/ go ba dang — chu gas pa ni rul ‘ 'i lda na te/ ro rul nas 'dam bag ltar chags pa lta bu/myab rgyo ga lngan ljin nam re btsang ba'am nyal nyil te1 mi gsal ba/zad ba/bad rgyu/bab/ nags tshal sogs su sprul pa'am gnyul ba'am 'tshol ba'am rgyu ba'i rdon/myur/ sprur ba ni mgyogs pa'i don/nyams byong / ro nyams su myong ba'am bro ba myong ba ste/ lcang ba'am tshor bka'i don/418

myu gu/ bsar skyes dzong pa'i ming ste/ nas myug sogs lta bu/ro rtsang / ro mngar ba dang skyur ba sogs myang ba'am spyong 5 ni bro ba'i don/rgyos/ myos pa ni bzi ba'am dga' ba'i don te/ chang gis nyos pa ni chang gis bzi ba dang / 'dod chags kyis nyos pa ni chags pas dga' ba'i don/mub 'das/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni thar pa'am nges par song ba'i don/myang sprung / gug gag gam 'gro tshul zhibargyu/ba/ rgyu/ba/ khyag khyug gam 'gul tshul dang / 'tshol tshol lam dmyugs tshul la gozu ngan/ sems kyi sdug bsnga' lam mi bde ba/mya bam/ dgun dung ngam chu med pa'i sa cha mya ngam thang lta bu/dmadamag g.yu'/ lam tshogs dag gi ming /nyes dmigs/ nyes pa'am mi dge ba'i 'bras bu/dmangs rin nas/ sngar rgya gar gyi rigs brgyud bzhi'i ya gyal te rib/sa brgyud bzhi ni/ rgyal rigs/ rje bo'i rigs/ bram ze rigs/ dmams rigs so/ dmangs rigs ni rigs brgyud dman pa yin/dman/ dman pa ni spu ma dang spu shal dma' ba phri ba'am med pa'i don/dme po/ rus bcig pa gsod res byed mkhan gyi skyes pa/da skus dang / mig med pa'am ldongs ba'am long ba/dmigs bu med/ dmigs bu ni long khrid pa'am long sna 'khrid che/khan gyi 419

don/ meb pa ni dgag sgra/ba/lu rgod/ gyong po dang gtum po ste/ bya ba chung ngu'i rkyen kyis khro chog chogab chu/ da mu rdzing ste/ lus skrangs shing chu bsags nas jing bu'i nang chus le/ bzhe/ pa lha ra gyu8 pa'i chu nad ciga'adred kun dmu/ 'dre srin gyi khyad par 'a4 'jug pa'i da mu ni gdon zhig dang chu nad kyi bdag po/blo dmu na/ blo dmun pa ni rib pa blun pa dang rig pa mi gas3 ba la rga/da chu sa byung / tshi chad pa dang spro ba shi ba'am yi chad pa'am sun pa1'i don/bu ga'i dmig bu ga'i don can spyi dmig ni khung bu'am i khung la bo//gtsang dme/ gtsang ba ni dag pa'i don dang / dme ba ni dbre ba'am brtsag pa'i don/'dzum dmul/ 'dzum dmul ba ni cung zad rgod pa'am rgod pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / 'dzum dmul dmul yang /dmigs pa gtod/ dmigs bya dang dmigs byed dang mthong ba'i don dang / bsam pa'i don dang / sgom pa'i don dang / gnad sbong ba sogs la 'jug ste/ dper na/ ma 'ongs kyi mdun lam la dmigs nas da lta slob sbyong la hur brtson byed lta bu dang / dmigs bya gang yin pa de la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni sgom pa'am bsam pa gtod pa yin/lag dar ra/ lag pas khag khur ba dang bshan pa la go ste/ mi gsod lag dmar ba lta bu/kha dmar/ khas khag khur ba dang / 'gan dang kha gsal ste/ rtsis pa'i bab ba/ 'bras legs nyes ci 'gyur gsal kha ston pa'i ma 'ongs lung bsnganal zer/ kha dmar gdags snye/ sman pas nad pa la nad 'di yin dang 420

'tsho 'chi 'di 'ong zhes gsab/ bar lung ston pa'am thag gcad pa'i don/kha dog dmar/ mdog dmar ba'am mtshab/ mdog lta bu/nyams dmas/ nyams shing dmas pa ni rgud pa'am 'greb pa'am nyag phra ba'i don/dmod btsugs dmod pa 'dor/ dmod pa btsugs pa dang dmod pa 'dor ba gnyis smon lam ngan pa 'debs pa'am dmod mo byed pa'am bden pa bdar ba ste/ gzhan la gnod byed kyi tshig ngo ma brjod pa'i don/ba ba/ chags pa'am dga' ba med pa ste ngan song gsum gyi nang tshan gcig dmyal ba la tsha dmyal brgyad dang / grang dmyal brgyad dang / nyi tshe ba dang nyi 'khor bcas khyon dmyal khams bco brgyad yod/gnas dma'/ gnas dma' ba ni/ sdod gnas sogs dman pa'am dma' mo'i don dang / go sa dma' ba ni/ go sa'i gnas 'bab dma' ba'am dman pa'i don/dmigs bsal/ dmigs kyis bsal ba ni/ spyir btang ma yin pa'am logs su bkar ba'am nges gzung gi don dang / dmigs kyis lce ba'i don te/ dper na/ dbang po skyon can la dmigs bsal gyi lta rtog byed/lta bu'o/ /byug myug dmyugs/ myug myug byed pa ni lus kyi 'gul tshul zhig dang dmyugs pa ni bcug pa'am 'dzul ba'am 'thon pa'am 'tshol ba'i don bcas la 'jug ste/ myug myug byas nas 'tshol ba'i don/dmirmad byung / rmad du byung ba'am ngo mtshar ram phul du byung ba'i don/421

rtsags 'dzin/ rmugs ldan nam gnod sbyin gyi bye brab dza sto ra ste nor lha/mi lam gnyid kyi 'khrul snang ste gnas skabs bzhi'i gceg gnas skabs bzhi ni/ lus la rtsa rlung thig le rdzogs 74sa gnas skabs bzhi 'byung ste1de gsum gyi rang ngo ma shes shing gzung 'dzin du zhen pa'i dbang las tshogs drug mi gsal bar kun gzhi la bsdus pa gnyid 'thug po'i gnab1 skabs dang / de las yid 'du byed dang bcas pa rmi 'a/ma gyi gnas skabs dang / tshogs drug yul la 'jug pa tha mab gyi dus te sad pa'i dbab pang 1de las 'pho ba'i bag chags nya che sa su myong ba stoms 'ju ba/ gi gnas skabs te bzhi'o/ rmang lam yang zer/ /spyod ba / rmis pa'am rmi ba ni gzil lam 'byung ba'am rmi lam sku4thong ba'i don/che bar zad ba / rtsa ba'am gzhi'am 'gram gyi don te/ khang ba yi tho po brtsegs par 'og gi rtsig cheng brtan pa dgos lta bu/ nas ni tshig phrad/blo blos1 / rmo bo dang rmos pa gnyis rmod pa'i don te/ zhing gi phru slog pa'am rmon pa brgyab pa (ka zer/mon rda ra/ rmon pa ni rmo ba'i ming tsam dang dor ni cha'am zung gi don te/rmon dor ni rmon pa rgyag byed mdzo sogs cha sbrel gyi ming 1blob sa/ rmongs pa ci gti spug gam mgo 'thoms pa'am bdag lha mi shes pa ste/ chos kyi bdag dang gang zag gi bdag gang yang ma shes pa'i skye bo/ rgyo / ba/sa/ rmugs pa ni yid tshugs pa'am rig pa mi gsal ba'am byings pa'i rnam grangs kyang yin la rmugs pa ni gdon zhig la'ang gokhyis zlur/ khyis rmuྈ ba ni rus pa la sos bcem pa'i don bang / ril bu rmur ba ni so sa bcag nas bldad pa'am 'cha' ba'am mur ba'i do na1tshugs/ rmugs pa ni so 'debs pa'am rgyag pa'i don te gzhan la gnod 422

pa'i ming /rma/ lhan skyes kyi rma dang gsar byung gi rma gnyis las lhan skyes kyi rma ni/nad dang lhan cig tu 'byung ba'i rma la zer ba dang / gas ra byung gi rma ni glo bur du byung ba'i rma la zer/ bu ga dang skyon la'ang rma zhes zer te/dper na/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rma med pa lha bu skyon med pa'i don dang /sgrob tse de'i thod pang la rma gcig kyang med lha bu bu ga med pa'i don dang / de bzhin rma rus rgyud la go ba ste/ rma rin chen mchog ni khri srong sde btsan skabs sad mi bdun gyi gcigarmen pa/ tshil la yod pa'i sha nag dang rma shul dang rmen bu yang zer/rta zig rta sogs kyi rkang lag gi rā rmig pa'am rgya dngul rta rmig pa lta bu/sga yid rmeng da/ sga chas te/ rnga mar bskon bya/smobs bu/ blun po'am gsang gnas kyi spu la gomig med/ rmig med ni gtan nas med pa'am gtan med ste/ ming tsam med pa'i don/ dper na/ dgra bo rmi ga med du btang ba lta bu ni dgra bo'i ming tsam med pa bzos pa'i don/sun pa'i sprus/ sun pa'i don can gyi rmyas pa ni skyo ba'am mtsher ba'am yi chad pa'i don/ser rme/ ser sna'am 'jungs pa'i don te/ gtong bar mi phod pa/bzas rme/ sri ba'am phri ba'am nyung du gtong ba ste/ ser sna byed pa lta bu/ngo mtshar rmad/ ngo mtshar la go ba'i rmad ni rmad du byung ba dang rmad po che lta bu/spyod ched/ a phyi dang ma phyi dang rgan mo snye/ a ma'i a ma/bkyib snye ba/ bal sogs rmel ba ni bal gsed pa dang / 'khal ba yang yin 423

snyam/dris pa'i zas/ dris pa'i don can gyi rmas pa ni/ rmed 4'ab rmad pa'am gtam 3dri ba dang shī ba'i don/rma bya/ bya'i regs ste/ che/ngon brjod du mdongs mtha' can zer/khan ba rmya/ kha che/sa stse ba ni/ kha che sa nyag pa'am rid pa'am nyams ‘ 'i don dang 1 da7ka' ra rdo) ba ba'i don/bya kyung byed/ gar ram kye nga shad ste/ rkang lab/ sogs kyong shad byas pa la bya rkyang byas pa zer/byed 'a mgo rmog da go cha spyi'am mtshon ras skyob byed dam mtshon cha 'gog byed kyi zhwa mo/dbu blog mgo la gyon byed rmog te/ mtshon 'gog byed/15smam/ nge 1da gso byed kyi rdzas dang / sgod de sha sman zas kyi bro ba skyed byed/smar pa lha rje'am 'tsho byed dam gso ba po ste/ em che la zer/ba/tam smra sprob / gta ma mchid pa'am gtam smra ba'am smras pa ste skad cha bshad pa'i don/ sgros shig sna skul chigasmig rgyu/ nyi ma tsha ba'i dus rgyang ring bye thang skya bo nas chu 'go ba lta bu'i 'khrul snang zhib/ ste/ ri dwabs sred ji/ la smig rgyu chu ltar snang ba/smab rum/ mun rum gyi don dang / smag ni mun pa dang sman zhigazob min smar/ zong min pa ste dngos po phal pa min pa'i don ḍa/ go zhing zong min smar zhes pa gser dang dngul sogs ba go424

sman ljongs/ sman skye ba'i yul lam ljongs/ bod sbyongs la ming gi rnam grangs su sman ljongs yang zer/sug spel/ snyu spyo la zur chag pa ye la phu mo ste/ rtsi sman gyi rigs shig yin zhing de'i nus pas mkhal ma'i drod dang nus pa nyams pa gso ba dang / pho ba'i me drod skyes/spug shad/ shing gi khyad par ram bye brag zhig ste sman la 'gro/jig ma/ shing gi bye brag zhig ste/ smyug rtsi cu gang dong lta bu ni/ cu gang rigs gsum gyi nang tshan ldum rar 'dzugs pa'i smyug ma'i rigs shig gi rkang las byung ba'i sman/spyi gu/ snyu gu ste yi ge sogs 'bri byed dam thug chung ni thu gu chung chung gi don/sbyib ma/ shing smyug ma'i ming gzhan/smor/ smin pa ni tshos pa'am thul ba'am spyad rung ngam gzags rung ste/ shing 'bras smin pa'am na tshod smin pa lta bu/tshe smad/ tshe smad ni mi tshe'i smad cha dang / khog smad ni khog pa'i smad cha dang / sku smad ni lus kyi smad cha dang / lam smad ni lam gyi smad cha dang /grong smad ni grong 'dabs sam grong gi smad cha la go ste/ de dag ni stod la ltos nas smad zhes thogs pa'o/ /sma phab/ sma phab pa ni sma 'bebs pa'am skyon brjod pa'i don te/ gzhan la sma phab pa la rang la yon tan ldan dgos lta bu/zad ra/ stod ra min pa'am smod pa'i ming tsam dang brnyas thabs/smod/ smod pa ni smad pa'am 'phya ba'i don dang dma' bar byed pa'i don/mgo sprung / mgo sogs sding ba ni mgo sogs ring po'am dbyibs 'jong 426

mo'i don/da/ba / smrang za ni smra ba'am gsang ba'i tshib/ /spe sngags/ sdug skad dam 'o dod de/ sdug bsngal ba'i tshig spras/ smras pa ni smra ba'am bshad pa'i don/sprun ka byed/ gnyen ka ste bag ma gtong len gyi thabs pa shem gnyen sprig ge thabs byed pa'am bgyid pa'i don/car sprug mdob/ ja hong ngam dmar ser te1 bya ngur pa'i mdog de bzhin du dmar ser mdog can gyi chos gos la ngur sprig zer1 ram smin/ mi dge ba'i las kyis rnam rngo4ྈ smin ba ni 'brab/ ku spyo yi ming tsam dang / 'bras bu lnga'i nang gses gcig yin/ 'bras bu lnga sna/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ bdag po'i 'bras bu/ bye da bu byed pa'i 'bu4 ba / kam smin gyi 'bras bu/ bral ba'i 'bras bu bcas so/ — smob ci dgos/ smos pa ci zhig dgos te/ bshad mi dgos khyas ba1'i den/sprung gnas/ sprung bar gnas pa ste/ chos kyi dka3 thub byed pab ma lhog ba skom du gnas pa'i don/dus sprur/ dus tshod sprur ni sprur ba'am sprur bcub pa'i don 11zad ba / smyo mkhan nam sems rnal du mi gnas pa'i mi/ mi smyon pa la rtsod pa ma byed lta bu/ de bzhin dud 'gro la'ang shes pa rnal du mi gnab/ pa'ang yod de/ khyi smyon pa dang / glang chen smyun pa lta bu'o/ /rjod/ smyo ba'am smyos pa ste/ sems rnal du mi gnas pa—sgyum 'khrul ba'i don/spyod da ma drin/ grogs po'am blo brlug gam 'dris che ba'i grogs/dri med/ dri rmang/ pa ste dag pa'am gtsang ba'i don dang / dri pred ltar na gtam 'dri ba'i don du bshad kyang de la dre rmed 'thad snyam bhe dpyad/426

smon lam/ rang gi 'dod pa'i don la smon cing 'dun pa'i ming tsam yin te/dper na/ yab yum gnyis sku gzugs bde thang yong ba'i smon 'a ma bdebs lta bu/sman/ sman pa zhes pa phan pa'i don 6na la'ang 'jug ste/ dper na/ sman par gyur cig dang / phad par gyur cig lta bu/smin drug smal po smin drug bu/ 'di gsum skar ma'i khyad par/spe ba/ lus kyi spe ba ste/ sha thig sha'i 'dzer pa yang zer/spug rtsi/ sprug po'i rtsi ste/ 'bri sob gam ri tshos la zer/kha dog rmug mdog rmyag po'am rgya rmug lta bu/sma ra/ kha spu la zer/smin ma/ mig steng gi spu/ snum la 'jam pa'i smin ma lta bu/ smin ma la smin 'a khyog yang zer/sme sha can/ smo can te/ lus la spe ba'i sha tshan yod mkhan/ sngar rgya gar du rigs ngan 'a brtsi/rtsis kyi spe ba/ nag rtsis kyi spe ba gcig dkar dgu sogs yod de/ gcig dkar sman gyi me long dang / gnyis nag bdud kyi me long / gsum mthing mtsho yi me long 0 bzhi ljang klu li me long / lnga ser dgra lha'i me long /drug dkar rgyal po'i me long / bdun dmar btsan gyi me long / brgyad dkar yul lha'i me long / dgu sprug g.yang gi me long bcas so/ /de rnams khams la sbyar na/ dkar gsum lcags/ nag mthing chu/ bzhi ljang shing / lnga ser sa/ dmar myog me'o/ /427

tsatsab tsub mi bya/ tshab tshub bam mi brtan pa'i don te/ bya 1ka chen po ba 3 dus tsab tsub mi bya lta bu'o/ /tshog rtsag pu tsog pu'am 'dug stangs shigatsan dan/ tsan+dan gyi sgra zur chag pa ste/ dri zhim bka'i shing rig she shib tan 1ming gi rnam grangs la tshim byed dang 'bar byed ngang / che/ — ya skyes dri'i snying po sogs zer/rtso—ta/ a sra'i khyad par ro sprur shas can gyi shing /tsam pa ka me tog zhig ge ming dang dze rgya gaྈ gye grong khyer jib/ gi mi yin/ tsaspra ka sgra zur chag nas tsam ‘ ka jes brjod/zad stan zad/ bya kong ma ste/ ming gi kun/ gra ba/ la sreg pa'am mig mdzes kya zer zhing zla ba'i bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i bya khrig yin/rtsi ti mo/ byi'u ma bya chung zhigabyed sgyu / bya ni tso ste 'dab chags lce gnyis pa yang zer/de tsam/ de tsam pa ni de snyed pa tsam/ zheb/ pa tshad 'dzin dang nges gzub gi rje//zad sgyu ba/ ba ba/ba / de 'dra'am de ci 'dra yin nam mam de ci 3dra red zhes pa 'i don dang / 'di tsug ni 'di gang yin nam zhes pa'i don sog ba/rtse ne/ ce re'am 'dug tshul te sems mi g.yo bar brtan po ra bdug tshul/rtse re/ skad tser tser/zad dpa bab/ gnas tsa ri la sdod mkhan/ ba ni bdag sgra/428

tsā ru/ bza' ba'am lha bshos ste/ lha'i zhal zas sam gtor ma chung chung dang / mdzes pa'i don/tsa na ka sran ma chung chung zhigatsug tsug kha nas tsug tsug zer ba'i sgra/gtsagatsug tor/ spyi tor ram thor tshugs la go sbyi gtsug gtsug tor dang mgo bo'am rtse mo/ba/tsang khang / dri gtsang khang ngam 'du khang gi sbug khang /gtsang / gtsang ba ni dag pa'am btsog pa med pa'i don/ ༄mi gcigs spyod pa/ mi rigs pa'am mi 'os pa'i spyod pa byed tshul/gtsug lag khang / sde sdod gsum mam rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'jog sa'i gnas sam khang pa/ga rtsod rus/ ri dwags shig gi ming / rus ni rus pa'am ru'am rwa co la zer/gces/ gtses pa ni 'tshe bar byas pa'am gzir bar byas pa ste/ gnod par bya ba'i don/ga rtser bas gces/ gtser ba ni mi rigs pa byed pa'am 'tshe ba'am gnod par byed pa'i don yin zhing des gtses pa ni sun par byas pa'i don dang /gtses shig lta bu skul tshig yin/ mche gzugs/ mche ba gtsigs pa ni mche ba sprig pa'am sbyor ba'am rtseg pa'i don te/ dper na/ stag gis mche gtsigs sder bgrad byed kyang 429

bdag ni mi 'jigs lta bu/gtsub shing / gtsub byed kyi shing ste/ brdar nas me 'don byed yas mas kyi shing /gcub gtan/ gtsub bya'i gtan gyi shing ste/ 'brad rdar byed sa'i mal gdan gyi shing / gtsubs/ gtsubs pa ni gtsub pa'am brdar ba'am 'drud pa/sgyum skyod pa'i don/ba bo/ rang bzhin dang spyi khyab dang rje bo dang / gnad dang mgon po dang snying po bcas kyi don yin zhing de'i nang nas rang bzhin zer ba ni/phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i grangs can pas shes bya nyi shu rtsa lnga'i nang nas spyi zer ba de ni gtso bo yin zer ba dang rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gnyis las rang bzhin yin zer/ rang bzhin ni rgyu la ngos bzung ba dang rnam 'gyur ni 'bras bur ngos bzung ba'o/ /gtsigs che/ gces spras chen po byas pa'am rtsa ba chen po byas ji1'i don/bdab ba dbya/ khrag sogs phyi ra gtsag byed kyi mtshon chung ngam gtar spyad/'di rgyud ba / ba / gtsags pa ni khrug 'a1 sogs gshags pa'am gtar ba'am bkas pa'am bton pa'i do na/gtsang phyob/ba / chu chen nam dbus kyi gcig shos sam dag pa'i phyogs te/dbus gtsang gnyis su dbye ba'i gtsang gi phyogs/gtsang chu/ gtsang po'i chu bo/bkabakabatsan/ btsan pa ni/ ldag pa med ba'am 'da' bar mi byed pa' ma 'gyur mi 430

nus pa dang / dbang ba'am gnyan pa'am btsan po'i don yin zhing /btsan pa po'am btsan pa'i ming ste/ rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po dang srong btsan snyam po lta bu'o/ rgyal po de dag gi bka' shin tu btsan pa skye bo gzhan sus kyang ldog thabs bral bas na btsan pa zhes brjod do/ /bka' btsan/ bka' 'am gsung btsan po ni 'da' bar mi nus pa'am gnyan pa ste 'gyur du med pa 'i don /jong btsan/ rdzong btsan po'am mkhar btsan po ni bgrod dka' ba'am 'gyur mi nus pa'am gzhan gyis brlag par khag pa'i don/btsun mo/ rje mo ste rgyal po'i chung mar gobu btsas/ phrug gu btsas pa'am btsa' ba ni skyes pa'am 'khrungs pa'i don dang / btsas pa ni dus 'das pa ston byed yin/gru btsas/ gru btsas sam gzings btsas dang ko btsas ni/ gru gla'am ko gla ste gru 'am ko ba phud pa'i rngan pa'am yon nam rin/btsab / btsal ba ni 'tshol ba'am gnyul ba ste brtag pa'i don/ba bzu da ba / gtso bo'am khrims ldan te grwa pa spyi dang bye brag thams cad kyi mtshan nam zhe sa'i brda/ mig btsum sa/ mig btsums pa'am kha btsums pa ni 'dzums pa'am zum du 'jug nga 'i don/ btsums ni dus 'das pa ston byed/ba ra/ brtson gyi ra ba ni nyes can pa 'jug sa'i khang pa ste btson khang 11 / / btsud/ btsud ba ni 'dzub ba'i ma nang du bcug pa'i don/gos brtsems/ gyon pa btsams pa ni 'tshem pa'am drubs pa ste btsem pa'i don/ btsems ni dus 'das pa ston byed/431
