btsag sa tshos sam sa tshon dmar po ste/ dgon pa sogs kyi gyang la byug byed kyi sa tshon/bzad kyis ba tsos/ btsod las byung ba'i tshos dmar gyis snam bu sogs ba rtsas pa ste/ ma dog sprur ba'i don/ de bzhin sha la sogs pa brtsas pa ni smin par byas shā/'i don dang / gser brtsos pa na bser bzhud pa'i don dpen zhing 'che da pa ni sha dang tshal sig pa da smin par byed pa/btsan dug dug ha cang che ba'i rtswa ldum re gas shig yin/ las sgon byas rjes sman du 'gro ba ste/ sman pong nab dang bong gser/ bong dmar dang bong dkar sogs/tshags kyis btsags/ 'tshag byed kyis btsags pa ni/ 'tshag pa'i don te/dngas snyigs phye ba la gobartsir/ bkar ba'am 'tshir ba ni phyung ba'am bar du btsir ba'i don te/za—da ba/ btsir nas snum 'don pa dze bu/btsam shes khyer/ lcags sogs btsa' sa khyer ba ni ga ma' rgya pa pa ste/ lcags rigs bzha' tshan phog nas chags pa'i bar 'a ser zhiga'aphags bcob nag 'bags la sogs ba go ba'i btsog pa ste/ mi gtsang ba'am dbre ba'i don/ba bza rlabaka ba ba bzug/ tshos sam khrus mkhan te/ tshos rgyag mkhan nam tshos pa bka pe/mtho btsams/ mtho btsams pa'am mtho 'tsham sa pa ni rtsa 'dri ba'am 'gran pa'am gnod pa'i don te/ ba/zhan la 'gran zla byed pa'am gnod pa byedapa'i don/jeg ba tshog rdeg pa la go ba'i ba tsog pa'am 'tshog pa ste / rdung ba'am gzhus 432

pa'am nyes gtag gtong ba'i don/brtsog po jeg rdo ba dang sgyug bro bo dang mi legs pa'am ngan pa'i don dang pho brtsag ni rgod po dang / gyong po'i don/ rdeg pa ni rdung ba'i don/btsan rgod/ btsan ni 'dre'i khyad par dang rgod ni rgod pa'am gyong po'i don te mi ma yin gyi bye brag cigabatsan babs/ thabs btsan pa'am dbang shed la go ste/ nyams chung lag nas btsan thabs kyis 'phrog kyis 'phrog pa lta bu dang de bzhin glo bur gyi don la'ang go ste/ mi ngan khag cig btsan thabs su spebs byung lta bu'o/ /gser brtso ma/ gser bzhu btum byas pa'am lhad med kyi zhun ma ste/ btso ma'i gser zer/ gser la rin chen dang po yang zer/srol btsugs/ lugs srol lam lam srol gsar du btsugs pa'am 'dzugs pa ni gsar du gtod pa'am phye ba'i don te/ rje tsong kha pa ni ri bo dge lugs pa'i srol btsugs pa'am 'dzugs mkhan yin lta bu/shing btsugs/ shing gi ming gzhan rkang 'thung yang zer te/ lcang ma dang sbyar pa la sogs btsugs pa'am 'dzugs pa ni btab pa'am 'debs pa'i don yin pa dang / dar chen btsugs pa ni yar slong ba'i don yin/btsugs ni 'das pa'i tshigasgog brtsong / sgog pa'i ming gzhan la ke'u zer ba dang / btsong gi ming gzhan la kun dong yang zer/ de gnyis sto chas kyi bro ba skyed byed yin/gzhan du btsong ni dngos po sogs btsong pa'am 'tshong ba la'ang go ste/brtsang ba ni 'tshong ba'i ma 'ongs ston byed kyi tshig yin/brtsongs/ btsongs pa ni brtsang ba'am 'tshong ba'i 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig 433

ste/ dngos po sogs btsongs zin lta bu'o/ /btsad po/ rgyar po'i ming gi rnam grangs la btsad po yang zer/btsas ma/ lo tog brnga bya ste 'tsho skyong byas pa'i don 'dra ba ni smin zin bsdus chog gi lo tog la gortsartsa lag gnyen nam nye 'brel lam nye du la go/rtsa/ rtsa ba ni gzhi ma'am drung dang sdong po'i 'og cha dang shod dang skyed byed dang gtsigs dang gnad dang sdom sogs la 'jugartse/ rtse mo ni mchog ma dang mgo dang steng ma dang gong ma dang phul byung dang rab la go/tshon rtsi/ mdog sgyur byed dam ri mo 'bri byed kyi rdzas/dkang / rtsing ba ni zhib po min pa'i rags pa dang / sbom pa'am rtsing po'am rtsing ge'i don/ spyod pa rtsing po ni kun spyod ngan pa'i don/rtsi mar/ rtswa dang sngo ldum sogs rtsi tog gi bcud myangs pa'i phyugs rigs las byung ba'i mar/rtsi shab / rtswa dang shing sogs skye dngos sam 'bras bu can gyi shing /rtsi thog ka'am sngo'i 'bras bu/dka/ sngo'am gzan pa/'bab rtsod/ 'khrug rtsod dam rtsod pa'am 'thab pa'am mi mthun par sma ba'am rgol ba'i don/rtsed mo/ rtsed ma rol rtsed kyi don/434

rtse rtses rtsen/ rol rtsed sogs rtse ba ni rtses pa'i rdon dang / rtses shig lha bu skul tshig yin/ rtsen pa yang rol ba'am rtsed mo rtses pa'i don/lngas rtsen/ lngas rtsen pa ni mi spyi'am byang phyogs cang lo can gyi zhing khams /sum rtsen/ sum rtsen pa ni lha yul lam skabs gsum pa yang zer ba dang /lha la yang godakas1 grangs sam rtsis rig rtsis mkhan/ rtsis pa'am rtsis pa po/rtsib ma/ lus kyi rtsib ma ste/ glo g.yas g.yon gyi rus thur lta bu'i ming /rtsa rgyus/ lus kyi rtsa dang rgyus pa ste/ rtsa la dbu ma dang ro ma rkyang ma bcas gsum yod pa dang / rgyus pa ni sha'i nang gi rgyus pa la go rtsid pa/ 'bri g.yag gi lus zhol spu ring / 'brong gi rtsid pa'am g.yag gi rtsid pa lta bu/ tsub/ rtsub pa ni mi 'jam pa'am skya ba'am gyong ba'am yid du mi 'ong ba ste rtsub mo'i don /kha rtsab / grong tshig la kha sang ngam khar sang yang zer/rtse rgod/ rtse zhing rgod pa ste/ gad mo dang lhan cig rtsed mo rtsed pa'i bag yangs/ gzhon nu'i dus su rtse rgod kho nas dus bskyal ba 'di 'chug 'dug lta bu/ de bzhin rtse rgod ni lha 'bangs dang g.yob po la'ang gortsam rin/ rtsam pa'i rin pa'am gong / rtseg rtseg pa ni spar ba'am rtseg rtseg byed pa'i don/rtsabs/ gcod pa'am cod rtse sogs mi 'gul bar byed pa'i shing lta bu yin snyam/rtsad gcod/ rtsa ba zhib gcod byas pa'i don dang rtsa ba'am rjes gcod pa'i 436

don te/ gnas tshul 'di ltar byung rkyen rtsad gcod lta bu'o/tsher ma'i rtsang / chos lugs pas gtor zor la 'dzugs rgyu'i tsher ma can gyi shing phra zhing rtse no ba zhigastobs rtsal/ stobs la bo ba'i rtsal ni pha rol gnon pa'i bya ba'am lus sem sa kyi shugs la go/'bad rtsol/ 'bad pa rtsol ba gnyis brtson pa'i don dang lus po'i 'du byed dang brtsal ba ḍa4 gortsom pa rtsom/ bya ba'am mgo 'jug pa'am gsung rtsom brtsam pa'am sbyor ba'i don/zho rtsabs/ zho sogs rtsabs ni rtsi'am ro rtsi la bortsab mo/ chang 'dra ba'i skom mam btung ba zhig ste/ 'dul ba las bshad pa'i bcas ldan dge slong gis longs spyad du rung ba 'bras khre sogs brtsas nas phab ma btab par mnan pa'i khu ba'o/ /ser rtsa'i gos/ ser po'i mdog 'dzin gyi rtsa ba sprum sta bus btsos pa'i gos sam gyon pa ste/ lha'i shing las byung ba 'i gos/rtsig pa/ rtsig skyabs sam rtsig bzhin pa'i don/rtsig mkhan/ rtsig pa po ste rdo bzo lta bu/'khor lo'i rtsibs/ 'khor lo dang gdugs la sogs pa'i rtsibs ni rkang ngam thur ma lta bu'am 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi lcags ri'am mtha' skor/rtsangs pa/ skyin gor gyi bye brag rmig pa'am yan lag gi rlub lnga'i gcig ste/yan lag rlung lnga ni/ klu'i rlung sa khams/ rus sbal gyi rlung rlung khams/rtsangs pa'i rlung me khams/ lhas byin gyi rlung chu khams/ nor rgyal gyi rlung sa khams so/ /rmig pa ni rtsangs pa kha ral la zer zhing de la rmigs pa zhes 436

kyang snang /srog rtsol/ rlung ste tha dad du phral ba yang snang /rgyudabaka' stsal/ bka' stsal ba ni gsung gnang ba'i don/dngos grub stsal/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang mchog gi dngos grub stsal ba ni sbyin pa'am gnang ba'i don/11ba / byin cig lta bu skul tshig gam sbyin pa'i don /sbyin pa stsab ba dzod/ sbyin pa stsal ba ni sbyin pa'am gtang bar bgyi ba'am bya ba'i don/bgyid du stsal/ bgyid du stsal ba ni byed du bcug pa'am las la spyor ba'i don/rtsal du gsol/ gnang ba'am sbyin par mdzod dam zhu zhes ya'i don yin la dus gsum gyi tshe stsal zhes 'byung zhing sngon 'jug sbyar na 'das pa dang ma 'ongs par go ba ma zad bsal ba'i don yang ston bya bar stsal ba sogs/brtsabartson 'grus/ brtson pa ni 'grus pa'am 'bad pa'i don/snying brtse/ snying brtse ba ni snying po ltar brtse ba ste snying rje'i brtse ba can/ brtse ldan nam snying rje can/brtsad cib / brtsad pa ni rtsod pa'am brgal ba rtsad ba6da pa la 'jug /437

cing ni tshig phrad/brtsam4 bya/ bstan—bcos rdo ma bya ba'am bya ba'i gzhi/brtsam ba sgyu/ brtsams pa ni rtsom pa'am sbyar ba'am byas pa'i don/ shā rtsams pa 'das pa'i tshig khab brtsegs/ khang pa brtsegs pa ni thog brtsegs can gyi khang pa lta bu dang / yi ke brtsegs pa ni mgo can yod pa'i yi ge dang sngags yig lta bu/ rtseg pa ni gcig steng du gcig bzhag pa la zur/brtsigs shing — rtsig pa steng nas steng du jig pa lta bur go dgos1 shing ni tshig phrad/brtsi bya/ grangs sogs bgrang ka' yon tan che ba la bkur bya'am brtsi bya lta busnyibartsis/ brtsis pa ni rtsi ba'am bgrangs pa'am rtsis pa'am skor ba'am bkur ba'i don/ za brtse/ kha'i so sogs brtse ba ni mi bzod pa ste/ lcags drad dra da byas pa las so brtse ba lta bu/ha cang brtsebs pa'i gos/ gos shin tu brtsengs pa'am bstungs pa'am 'jol ba min pa'i don te/ dper na/ chu yi nang gos thung brla bar brtsengs pa'am brjes nas 'gro ba lta bu/dkanags tshal/ shing nags kyi tshal lam nags ma ste/ rang byung gi kang nags stug por go dper na/ nags tshal stug po'i khrod na gcan gzan mang 438

lta bu/skyed tshal/ dga' tshal lam ldum dang 'bras shing gi ra ba dang / shing nags tsam yang ste/ mis bzes pa'i shing sna 'i ra ba'am me tog gi ldum ra ma godaper na/ skyed tshal ma dzes pa'i sgang la/ byi'u chung gsung skad snyan ba lta bu/tshi gu 'bras bu'i nang gi rus pa'am kham bu'i tshi gu lta bu'i ming /tshigs/ mtshams sam bar gcod byed de yi ge'i tshigs gcod pa'am bcad pa lta bu dang / smyug ma'i tshigs dang rkang lag gi tshigs lta bur 'jug pa ma zad/ mes chigs nas snyigs mar 'gyur lta bu dang mes tshigs pa'i tshigs ma lta bu'i don la 'jugachogs pa/ tshogs pa ni 'dus pa'am phung po'am sde pa'i don —te/ mi sogs mang po 'dus pa la tshogs pa zer ba dang / 'bru sogs mang po 'dus pa'am tshogs pa'am 'bru'i phung po zer ba dang / dge 'dun pa bzhi 'dus pa'am tshogs pa la dge 'dun bzhi sde gcig zer ba dang / gsal byed ka kha ga nga bzhi tshogs pa'am 'dus pa la gsal byed kyi sde pa gcig bcas lta bu/zhe tshan/ le tshan nam chos tshan nam las tshan don tshan sogs don 'dra ste/gtam rgyud sogs kyi le tshan dang po'am sde tshan dang po'am don tshan dang po lta bu dang / chos kyi dpe cha'i tshan pa'am sde tshan lta bu dang / las tshan ni las ka'i tshan pa ste las gnas kyi sde tshan la go ba yin/ de bzhin tshan ni dum bu dang tsho/ khag tshan pa bcas la go ba dang drod kyi tshan ste drod tshad la go ba dang / shed kyi tshan pa shed shugs la go ba yin no/ /lus sab tsho/ lus kyi lang tsho ste/ na tshod lon pa'i don nam na tshod smin 43khye

pa'i don/tshon rtsi/ tshon nam mdog sgyur byed kyi rdzas/phra tshom/ rin po che'i phra yi tshom bu ni phra mang po'i don dang / 'bru'i tshom bu ni 'bru'i phung po la bo/ ba dang / lha'i tshoms bu ni lha mang po yod pa don/de bzhin tshom bu ni tshogs chung ngam tshan pa la'ang gotshar du dngar/ tshar du dngar ba ni gral 'grig pa'i don/the tshom/ blo ce gnyis sam som nyi'i don/tsham zams/ 'jig tshul lam 'jig pa'i don/'ju byed tshwa/ 'ju byed la go ba'i tshwa ni/ zas kyi ro'am bro ba skyed byed soṭa te/ tshwa zhes tshig grogs med pa'i rkyang pa la smad 'dogs wa zur dgos shing rgya tsha zhes pa lta bu'i tshig grogs sbyar na wa zur med paྈ phyag len mdzad la 'on kyang la tshwa la yod pa mang ngo / /khang pa'i choms/ khang pa spri dang bye brag la go ba'i tshoms ste/ sprer khang pa che ba de la tshoms zhes 'bod pa dang / bye brag tu mjal phrad gnang sa'i tshoms chen dang / gsol ston bshams sa'i tshoms chen lta bu/mtsha ngo mtshar/ rmad byung ngam khyad mtshar gyi don te/ jo bo'i sku 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i ngo mtshar chen po zhig 'dug lta bu rmad du byung ba'i don dang /mi 'di'i byed stangs 'di ngo mtshar chen po zhig byung lta bu ni khyad mtshar ram ya mtshan chen po zhig byung zer ba'i don /mtshan1 sangs rgyas kyi mtshad ma bzang po mtshon byed so gnyis ni/ phyag 440

zhabs 'khor los mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs/ phyag ngang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel ba dang / phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags/'di yi sku ni mdun dag mtho ba dang / sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang / zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs/ byin pa ye na ya'i 'dra phyag ring mdzes/ 'doms kyi sba ba spubs su nub pa'i mchogapags pa gser mdog bags ka srab pa dang / spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang / zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge 'dra/ 'di yi dpung pa'i mgo rlum thal gong rgyas/ 'di la ro mi zhim pa ro mchog snang / sku ni spyo gro bha ltar chu zheng gab/ gtsug tor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang / tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems/shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thags bzang dang / grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang / spyan ni mthon mthing spyan ji ba mchog sga/ 'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ zhes gsungs so/ /mtshan bzang so gnyis de dag ji ltar khyeng zhe na/ bla ma rnams la skyel ba dang bsu ba la sogs pas phyag dang zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa nyid dang / sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la brtan pa nyid kyis rus sbal bzhin du zhabs shin tu gnas pa nyid dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi bsten pas phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar dra bas 'brel ba nyid dang / bza' ba dang bca' ba la sogs pa gya nom pa byin pas phyag dang zhabs 'jam shing gzhon sha chags pa nyid dang / bldag pa la sogs pa shin tu gya nom pa byin pas phyag dang zhabs pang thal gong dang ltag pa'i phyogs mtho ba'i phyir mdun mtho ba nyid dang / gsad par bya ba las spur pa byus pas sor mo ring ba nyid dang / 'tsho ba ma phan btags pa 441

nyid kyib rtis nga pa yangs pa nyid dang / srog gcod pa spangs pa nyid kyis kau/ che zhing drab ba nyid dang / dbe ba'i chos yang nag par blangs pas zhung ba kho/nga bu mi mjon pa nyid dang / dge ba pa pab 8ba/ zar blangs — pre' ba sna skru'i spu kyen du phyogs ji/ nyid dang / rig pa dang bzo la rngo bas pa tsas nga/ra byas te byin pas dzin pa ri zwags e na ya'i lha bu dang 1 cor bdob pa la slong ba po'i skye rba phye ra ma ga rngas ba 1sa phyag ring zhing mdze 4 ‘4 nyid dang / skye bo thams cad tshang ba/ par sprud pa kyi snang dag par len/—du 'jug pa dang — gsang ba'i gsang tshig bsrungs rwa—sa 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa nyid dang / gding ba gya nom pa byin pas mdog gser 'dra ba nyid dang / lang bzang la sogs pa dam pa byin pas pags pa 'jam pa nyid dang / 'du 'dzi la sogs pa yongs su spangs pas spu re re nas g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba nyid dang / skye bo bla ma spums cad gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pas zhal mdzod spus brgyan pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad du kha drag gi tshig gis khyad du ma bsad pas ro stod seng ge'i 'dra ba nyid dang / snyan par smra ba dang legs par smra ba'i rjes su mthun par byas pas dpung mgo shin tu skrum pa nyid dang / sman la sogs pa byin pas thal gong rgyas pa nyid dang / skye bo nad 'i g.yog byas pas ro bro ba'i mchog mkhyen pa nyid dang / nags tshal dang kun dga' ra ba la soṭa pa byed pa yang dag par len du bcug bas shing nu gro dha ltar chu zheng gab pa nyid da / gtsug lag khang la sogs pa lhag par byin pas dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa nyid dang / 'jam po la sogs pa gsungs pas ljags ring ba nyid dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can la dam pa'i chos go bar byas pas tshangs pa'i dbyangs nyid dang / tshig kyal ba 442

srung41 pas 'gram pa seng ge 'dra ba nyid dang / skye bo thams cad la bkur ba la sogs/ pas tshem ba/ dka ba nyid dang — 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa nyid kyis tshems thag bzang ba nyid dang / bde na nga'i tshig kun tu sprad pas tshems thags bzang ba nyid dang — phra ma'i tshig spangs pas tshems bzhi bcu mnga' ba nyid dang / sems can thams cad la bu gcig ḍa4 dang 'dra ba bltas pas spyan mthon mthing nyid dang / khong khro ba la sogs pa med par bltas pas rdzi ma ba'i lta bu nyid do/ zhes rgyu grub pas mtshan grub bo zhes so// // (dpe byad brgyad cu ni pa sde'i skabs su bshad zin)ma spyod/ chu gter ram rgya mtsho sogs/ mtshe'u/ mtsho chung ba'am jing bu lta bu/mtshe ma/ mngal gcig nas dus mnyam du skyes pa'i bu/da dmab ba bcas da/ tshigs mtshams bcad pa'am 'bral ba ma mtshams bcad pa'am bar mtshams bcad pa ni phye ba'am gcod pa'i don yin zhing /mtshams che chung sbyor lta bu/mtshan tha/zhi/ mtshan nyid rten pa' ma 'brel ba'i gzhi ste/ mtshan nyid kyi bye brag gam mtshon bya'i khyad par ra ma dpe dang mtshon byar yang 'jug pa ni/dper na/ don byed nus pa dngos po'i mtshan nyid yin/ de'i mtshan gzhi zhog zer na/ bum pa/ ka ba/ sgrog tse/ rku ba stegs sog ba dngos po'i rigs tshang ma bzhag chogamatshan nyid/ mtshon byed dang go byed dang mtshan ma dang rtab/sa dang rgyu ston byed bcas yin te/ dper na/ don byed rdus pa zhes pa ni dngos po mtshon byed dam go byed dam dngos po'i mtshan nyid kyang yim pa dang / sto ldir zhwabs zhum chu skyor gyi don byed nus pa ni bum pa mtshon byed dam go byed 443

dam bum pa'i mtshan nyid kyang yin/ de bzhin gzhan du'ang de ltar rigs bsgro/mtshon za/ go bya'am rtegs bya'am bstan bya'i don yin te/ gdungs 'degs kyi don byed nus pa ni mtshan nyid yin pa dang de'i mtshon bya zhog zer na/ka ba/ zhes bzhag dgos pa lta bu/ ka ba ni gdung 'degs kyi don byed nus pa'i mtshon bya yin no/ /mtshan ma / mi nor ba'i rtags sam rgyu'am rang bzhin dang lhas spros pa go ste/gzhan dang mi nor ba'i ched du mtshan ma'am rtags rgyag pa lta spru dang /lo leb/sa yong ba'i rgyu ston pa'am rang bzhin ston pa'am mtshan ma ston pa lta bu dang / mi legan sha pa yong ltas ston pa'am rgyu ston pa'am mtshan ma ston pa lta bu'o/ /mtshan/ mtshan byed dam rtogs byed dam ston byed dam dpe sogs kyi don/ cung zad mtshan ltar na sprad pa'i don/phyogs mar sna mab / phyogs kyi mtshams ni shar dang lho'i mtshams lta bu dang / dus kyi mtshams ni nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i mtshams lta bu'o/skyor mtshang / skyon la go ba'i mtshang ni nyes pa'i don yin zhing de ni bcab bya'am sbas bya nongs pa/mtshan mo/ nyin nub pa nas tho rengs bar dus la zer zhing / ming gi rnam grangs la bya bral dang mun pa can dang nyal dus sogs zer/mtshar/ mtshar ba ni mdzes pa dang ya mtshan dang rtsed mo'i don la 'jugamatshur ston/ mtshur ni rus kyi khyad par te/ mar pa lo tsā ba'i slob ma grags can mtshur ston dbang rdor lta bu/kha mtshul/ kha'i mtshul pa ni kha'i nang ngos dang / sna'i mtshul pa ni sna'i 444

nang ngos la gomatshal/ tshon dmar zhig ste/ rgya mtshal sogs/mtshubs/ mtshungs pa ni 'dra ba'am mnyam pa'i don/rgyal mtshan/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra bo las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma ste/ ba dan nam mchod rdzas shigamatsha' mes/ gcan gzan 'phar ba'i ming rta mtsha' lu/ rta dmar rting dkar la go ba dang / mtsha' lu ni khyim bya de pho dmar po la'ang gomatshar spug mtshar ba ni mdzes pa dang skye mched ma 'dres par gsal ba'am mtshar po'am mdzes po'am khyad mtshar po'i don dang sdug pa ni mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba'i don/khyim mtshes/ khyim rogs sam shag mtshes sam sdum mtshes ste grong pa la go /mtsher/ mtshe sdum sman rigs shigamatshan/ sngo sman zhig ste mtshan dmar lta bu/ gso ba rig pa'i gzhung du tshan yang snang /mtshams med/ skye ba gzhan gyis bar mtshams gcad du med par dmyal ba mnar med du skye ba'i las te/ pha bsad pa sogs lnga dang nye ba lnga/pha bsad pa sogs lnga ni/ pha gsod pa/ ma gsod pa/ dgra bcom pa gso da pa/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ngan sems kyis khrug 'byin pa ste lnga'o/ /nye ba lnga ni/— dgra bcom pa la 'dod log spyod pa/ byang sems nges gnas gsod pa/ slob pa'i dge 'dun gsod pa/ dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo 'phrog pa/ mchod rten bshig pa ste lnga'o/ /de bzhin mtshams med ni sa cha mtshams med pa lta bu la yang 446

bod zab dpen/mcher/ mtsher za ni sun pa'am lab/ byed par mi spro ba'am skyo ba'i don te/ slob sbyong byed pa ra mtsher ‘/'a ma sun snang skyes pa lta bu/ 3tsher yang 'a zad/dur mtshed/ dur ba/nab ste/ ro sped sa'am mer sreg ba/ la go zhing dur du bcug pa ni ro sba sa pa'i don/da brje'i da/ pha mes sam bon lugs kyi bla'am srog sga bcud/mtshon cha/ gri dang rtse mdab la sogs pa'i ming /ba ba che ma na/ phyag la pa snam bya ste1 'jam dbyangs kyi phyag 1ka ral gri dpa / spyan ra sa gzigs kyi phyab/ sa pad+ma bsnams pa lta bu/ma tshog mar 'phyar skra mtshan sa nas gyen du sor bzhi'i thad dang /spyi bor yang go 'phyar ba ni ga dang da/ pa'i don/ mib bo mtshan/ mi 'a gi don ston pa'i mtshan ni mngon brngod dang spras shā1'i mtshan dang / zhe sa'i brda/(sna46 blo 'tsha bas/ blo 'tshabs pa ni sems 'tshabs pa'i don dang / rtab pa 'am brel pa'am 'jigs ba 'i rdan/byung ‘ram bka chu dang ja sog ba/ 'chag pa—rem btsags pa ni dngab snyig ) phye ba'i don/mab du 'a tshangs/ nang du ma ra dz+wa5 par 'tshangs pa'am btsangs pa ni dbang shed lta bus 'dzul ba'am 'jug pa dang brlams pa'i don/ — lug 446

tshang nang spyang ke 'tshangs pa lta bu/tel 'tshir/ tel dang snum 'tshir ba'am btsir ba ste/ bkar ba'i don dang / zhum par byed par don 8nga 'don par byed pa'i—don/ dper na khyi zan gyang zur du 'tshir ba'am bkar ba ni zhum par byeng pa dang / pad ba/ 'tshir ba ni snum 'don par byed pa'i don/ mes 'tshig mes yis 'tshig pa'am tshig pa ni sreg pa'i don/du ba 'tshubs/ du ba'am dud pa 'tshubs pa ni du ba 'phyur ba'i don dang tshab tshub byed pa/zas 'tshed/ zas 'tshed pa ni zas brtso ba'am smin par byed pa'i don dang / gos 'tshed pa ni gos la tshos rgyab nas mdog sgyur bar byed pa'i don dang / gser 'tshed pa ni gser btso sbyang byas pa'i don/byugs 'tsho/ lus 'tsho ba'am srog 'tsho ba ni gso ba'am gson por gnas pa'i don/'tsho byed/ sman pa'i ming gi rnam grangs yin zhing / 'tsho byed dang skyong byed/ gso byed dang lha rje sogs yang zer/'tshengs/ 'tshengs pa ni yid tshim pa'am dga' ba la yid 'tshengs pa dang /gzhan las rgyal ba byed pa la zhan las 'tshengs pa lta bu/3tshe med/ 'tshe ba med pa ste gnod pa med pa'am gtse ba med pa'i don dang nye zho med pa ni nye ring med pa'i don no/ /'tshag ba zar / 'tshag pa lus kyi nyams brjid pa'am sha rgyags pa'i don/bzang pa ni legs pa'i don te/ lus 'tshag bzang po lta bu/'tshal ma 'tshal/ 'tshal ma ni zas sam za ma'i don 'tshal ba ni za ba'am bzhes pa'i don dang 'tshal cig 1 bu kyil tshig dang / 'tshal ni shes pa 447

shes sogs la'ang 'jug ste/ 'di ni lha'am 'dre yin cha ma 'tshal lta bu ma shes pa'i don dang / dka dbye dang tshig phrad 'jug stangs legs par 'tshal ba lta bu shes pa'i don no/ /spyod ra ma byed ba / nor 'tshol ba'am/ sems 'tshol ba sogs ni btsal ba'am gtsol ba'am rtsad gcod ḍa4 ste/ brtag pa'i don/phyugs 'tsho/ dud 'gro ba lang dang rta la sogs 'tsho ba'am brtsa ba ni skyong ba'i don/'tshog chas/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad dam nyer mkho/'tshong / 'tshong ba ni brtsang ba'am tshong rgyab pa'i don/bdeg 'tshog brdeg pa la go ba'i 'tshog pa ni brtsag pa'am rdung ba'i don/ngal 'cho/ ngal 'tsho ba'am dub 'tsho ba ni ngal gas ba'am mnyel gso ba'i don/'od 'tsher sgab / nyi ma'i 'od sogs 'tsher ba ni 'od 'bar ba'am bkag thon pa'i don dang / rta skad 'tsher ba ni rta skad sgrog pa'i don dang /las la 'cher ba ni las la sun snang skye ba'i don/ zhing ni tshig phrad/blo dab 'tsham pa/ yid dang 'tsham pa'i don dang yid mthun pa'i don la go zhing 'tshams pa ni ran pa la goskyin pa 'tshab/ skyin pa ste dngos po sogs g.yar ba'i tshab la go ba dang 'tshab pa ni bsab pa'am 'jal ba'i don yin/gdung 'tshob/ gdung ni rigs rus la go ba dang 'tshob pa ni 'dzin pa'i don te/ ribs rus 'dzin pa la bo/'tshang rgya/ 'tshang khye ba ni sangs rgyas pa'am byang chub pa'i don/longs pa'i 'tshar/ yongs pa'i don can pyi 'tshar ba ni cher skye ba'am 448

'phel ba dang skyed 'thon pa ste/ gzugs po 'tshar ba 'a myu gu 'tshar ba lta bu cher skye ba'am 'phel ba'i don/phyag 'tshal shes/ phyag 'tshal ba'am btsal ba ni gus pas 'dud pa'i don te/ phyag 'tshal shes ni gus pas 'dud pa shes pa la gochog pa'i 'tshal/ chog pa'am 'grig pa la go ba'i 'tshal ba ni 'dod pa dang dgos par yang 'jug te/ sdug bsngal las myur du thar bar 'tshal lags lta bu 'dod pa 'jug pa dang / de don thugs 'ja gas 'tshal sta bu dgos pa 'jug pa yin no/ /'dzom pa'i 'tshag 'dzom pa'i don la 'tshag 'jug ste/ gsog pa dang 'dzem pa dang gnyer ba dang rgyas par yang go—bkadza rab rdza yis bzos pa'i bum pa sogs sgod chung chung la godza lab / gtum po'am dred po ste/ spyod pa rtsing po la godza bo shib / mdzo mo shing ste/ shing sman gyi rigs shigadza ya can/ dza ya ni rgyal ba'am mi pham pa'i don dang can ni ldan pa'i don yin/zug bkadaba' mdzabs/ dpa' ba'i don can gyi mdzangs pa ni snying stobs che ba'i don te/ dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i gling rje ge sar lta bu/449

bcu za/ mdza' ba po'am grogs po(sgyum zla bo'i ming /bab mdzob / nor sogs dang rngo 'jug ba/'i khang pa ste/ 'bru yi bang mdzong dang rin po che'i bang mdzod lta bu 8nga dkor mdzong dang rngo4dzad khang ( 4nga zer/ba jed ba / skya/dzes ba1 ni mtshar bo'am legs pa'am mthun pa'am spud ba'i don/gnod mdzes gnod 0 la go ba'i mdzes rwa/ ste/ khro bo gnod mdzes kyang /ba byu1ba ched/ rkang lag gi mdzub mo ste sor mo la go zhing sdigs mdzub ni gzhan (ka 'jigs skul byed par ston pa'i mdzub mo/ma dzod spu dkar/ sangs rgyas kyi smin phrag na yod pa'i spu dkar po ste mchan bzang gi ya gyal gcigamadzo rta/ che1dzo ni glang dang 'bri'am/ g.yag dang ba mo 'dus pa las byung ba'i phyugs rigs shig rta ni mgyogs 'gro/mdzer pa/ sha 'bur ram sha'i gzer bu/mdze nad/ klu nad dam tsi ti dz+wa la ste/ chu ser nag po dang gnyan srin pad+ma ta gnyis 'doms pa la rgyab rten klus byas par grags pa'i lus kyi gnas kun ma rung ba dul myag ltar 'gyur ba'i nad do/ /mdzol bu/ ri dwags sogs 'dzin byed kyi rgya dang / smad 'tshong ma'i bu la gob zadang da ba / bya ba'am las sam 'phrin las kyi don/mdzod/ mdzod cig lha bu ni byos shig dang gyis shig ces pa'i skrul tshig de bzhin mdzod ni/ nor mdzod dang tshig mdzod dang mdzod khang sogs la'ang goya rabs mdzabs/ ya rabs la go ba'i mdzangs pa ni/ ma rabs min pa'am kun spyod legs pa dang / mkhas pa dang dam pa sogs la go460

'dza'adzings pa/ gzhan pha rol dang 'dzings pa ni/ 'dzing pa'am 'khrugs pa ste rtsod pa'i don dang / skud nga'i sne mo sogs 'dzings pa ni phan tshun 'dres pa'am 'khrugs pa'i ngo na/gos 'dzar/ gos gzan (ka sogs pa 'dzar ba ni thur du 'phyang ba'am ring ba'am 'jol ba'i don/lag pas 'dzin/ lag pa la ming gzhan sug pa'ang zer te lag pas dngos po 'dzin pa ni gzung ba'i don dang 1 'dzin pa ni zhen pa'am gces pa yin zhing 'dzin pa yul can la go'adzag 'dzag pa ni zag pa'am 'bab pa'am lhud ba'am 'thon pa'i don yin/'dzir ba/ bkar ba'am 'dzag pa'i rdon te/ jing nas chu 'dzir gyi 'dug lta bu/snod 'dzed/ sdod spyad 'dzed ‘4'am bzed pa snye/ sdod kyi kha gyen du bstan pa'i don/'dzem/ 'dzem pa ni mi 'jug pa'am ngo tsha ba'am bag med mi byed pa'am rtsi ba'am dogs pa byas pa bcas la go spyir 'dzem pa ni gzhan la stos nas ngo tsha shes pa yin te/ dper na/ spyod ngan 'di ltar byas na gzhan gyis rang la 'phya mi yong ngam snyad/ ‘ de lta bu ni gzhan la rtsi ba'am gtam ngan yong ba'i dogs pa byas ba'o/ /'dzur zhib / 'dzur ba ni bzur ba'am 'byol pa'am mi 'jug pa ste/ g.yo' ba'i don/ dper na/ nyen kha las 'dzur lta bu ni nyen khar mi 'jug 461

pa'am g.yol ba'i don no/ /lging ni tshig phrad do/ /sgor 'dzul/ khang pa'i sgo dang khung bu sogs la 'dzul ba ni 'jug pa'am zul ba'i don/'dzeg skas/ 'dzeg pa'am 'dzegs pa ni gyen du 'gro ba'i don te/ 'dzeg pa ni da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi bya tshig 'dzeg skas ni them skas 4/ma ya gad sa go'adzugs/ shing sogs 'dzugs pa'am btsugs pa ni gzugs pa'i don te/'dzugs ni da lta ba ston byed dang / btsugs ni 'das pa ston byed dang /gzugs ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed yin no/ /bzhin 'dzum/ bzhin ras 'dzum pa ri dmul ba'am ngo dkar ston pa ste/cung zad dgod pa'i don/'dzin pa/ dbang lag ste dbang po dang lag pa la go ba ni/ mig gi dbang pos 'dzin pa'am yid kyi dbang ngo sa 'dzin pa'am lag pas 'dzin pa lta bu dang / sngo 'dzin pa ni/ kha stod spang la skye ba'i bong nga nag po me tog dkar shas can 'char ba zhig snod du 'dzud/ sgod nang du 'dzud pa ni btsud pa'am blug pa'am bcug pa'i don/'dzam gling / 'dzam bu'i shing gis mtshan pa'i gling ste/ dzaspu zur chag pa'i don/'dzom/ mnyam du 'dzom pa'am tshogs pa ste 'dus pa'i don dang / kha tshang ba/ 'dzom po'am 'dzoms po sogs/nor 'dzangs 'dzad/ nor rdzas sogs 'dzangs pa dang 'dzad pa gnyis ni zad pa'am god pa'am gtugs pa'i don/ 62

'dzab bzlas/ 'jab ni legs sbyar gyi skad dka'i zur chag pa ste bzlas pa'am brjod pa'i don te/ sngags bzlas pa lta bu/mad 'dzer/ skad 'dzer ba ni skad 'dzer 'dzer ram tser tser byed pa ste/gre ba ha cang 'dzer bas skad ji bzhin mi thon pa'i don/ de bzhin 'dzer ni/ zer ba'am smra ba'i don la'ang 'jug ste/ 'di ltar 'dzer ba bdag gis thos lta bu ni 'di ltar zer ba'am smra ba bdag gis thos zhes ba'i don/nor ba'i 'jom/ nor ba'i don can gyi 'dzol ba ni 'khrul ba'i don te/ ra dang lug 'dzol ba lta bu dang / 'gro lam 'dzol ba lta bu/'du 'ji/ g.yeng sa'i yul lam rnam g.yeng la go ste/ mi mang po 'dzoms nas zing cha yod pa'i sa cha lta bu la 'du 'dzi'i yul zer/chud 'dza'/ chud 'dza' ba'am chud za ba dang zos pa ste 'phro brlag phyin pa'i don/ dper na/ byas pa chud mi 'dza' ba byed lta bu/rdo yi 'dzengs/ rdo'i chigs sam rdo'i bye brag la go'akhyegs pa'i 'jig 'dzog 'khrugs pa'am rim pa 'chol ba'i 'dzag ge 'dzog ge ste/ dngos po sogs drag zhan mnyam du 'dres nas lha bzo med ba'i don/ bsgyu kur rtsob/ kun tu rdzob pa ste/ yang dag pa'i gnas lugs la sgrib par byed pa'am rdzun pa'am snang ba'am tha snyad ste/ don ngo mar med pa1la yod pa ltar byung ba dper na/ rta zer ba'i tha snyad de mis dud 'gro la btags pa 453

tsam las don la dud 'gro 'di lta bu skyes pa'i skabs nas nga yi ming la rta zer ba yin zhes med pa yin pas de la rdzun pa zer/ de bzhin tha snye da thams cad rdzun pa'am kun rdzob yin no/ /rdzun/ rdzun pa ni drang po min pa'am mi bden pa ste/ lod pa'i tshig sgu ba can gyi don/ job (1ba/ tsab tsub sam g.yo zol la gotsu ji/ phyugs gnag gi ji bo ste/ skyong byed dam 'tsho byed sta bu'i ming jongs/ skyes sam skal ba'am rngan pa ste/ 'bul za sogs su goji(1 ka spyod da/ rdzi'u ni ji ma chung ba'am rdzi bo chung ba la go zhing byin pa ni snyer ba'i don/dzib bu/ phal che ba mis bcos pa'i ma tshe'ur go ba dang / rang bzhin du chags pa'i rdzing bu yang yod do/ /rdzus skyes/ rdzus te skyes pa ste/ pad+ma sogs su skyes pa/ skye gnas bzhi'i gcig skye gnas bzhi ni/ mngal nas skyes pa/ drod gsher las skyes pa/rdzus te skyes pa/ sgong nga sa skyes pa'o/ /'dam rdzab job/ 'dam rwa/ rdzab rdzob ste/ me gtsang ba'am lngan ljin/ji phyogs/ rlung gi phyogs bam ngos te rlung rgyu ba'i phyobs/zab che / rdo sgod ste/ ji kab la sigs pa'i meng /bu ji/ bu 'tsho mkhan nam phru gu lta mkhan te/ byis pa'i g.yo sha byed mkhan/rdzi med/ rgyang ring po nas dri tshor byed med pa/ ji ni rig shes la go dper na/ khyi der ji yag po 'dub lta bu/rjod ba / mig lngags kyi mtha' na yod pa'i spru /464

zin pa'i rdzogs/ zin pa'i don can gyi rdzogs pa ni tshar ba dang zad pa'i don/mkhar rdzong / mkhar la go ba'i rdzong ni/ bgrod dka' ba'i khang pa dang /brag rdzong sogs la gonor snas/ ka ca'am spyad dngos kyi don/ rdzas zhes pa dngos po spyir go ba dang bye brag tu me mda'i rdzas dang / 'bar rdzas sogs la'ang 'jugardzu 'phrul/ khyad gzhi sems kyi 'phen pa'i lus chos ni rdzu ba dang / khyad chos lus kyi spyod pa sems chos ni 'phrul ba ste/ lus po'i smad nas me 'bar ba dang stod nas chu 'bab pa sogs/rdzogs sangs rgyas/ rdzogs pa ni legs pa'i cha thams cad gang ba'am tshang ba'i don dang / sangs rgyas ni yang dag par sangs rgyas pa shākya thub pa sta bu/ brngogazhan gyis mi ba ji/— gzhan pha rol gyis mi thub pa'am mi tshugs pa'am mi gnod pa'i don/ dper na/ 'bu srin sogs rkang pas mi brji lta bu ni kang pas mi ji ba'am mi gnod pa'i don/ ba ji ni bya tshig ma 'ongs pa ston byed/khro por brdzus/ khro bo sogs par brdzus pa ni/ rdzu ba'am sgyur ba ste/ ma yin pa la yin pa ltar byas pa'i don/ brdzus pa ni 'das pa ston pa'i bya tshigaral pa gyen du brtses/ skra'i ral pa sogs gyen du brjes pa'am gyen du 465

slong ba'i don/sgob/ chag ba bzab / srog chags 'bu sogs ba jib/ pa ni mnan pa'am ji ba dang glebs pa don/zan brjis/ sgags bzas ‘4'i don te/ bsgos pa'am mnyes pa'am rdzi ba'am g.yos pa bcas la 'jug bzas ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigaka / ba gsan ba bza ba / yul gzhan so gas su brdzangs pa'am mngag pa'am btang ba'am bskur ba'i don/zhe wa skyes/ sems can wa ste/ ming gi rnam grangs la wa mo dang / sa myos zer/ba 'dang / bya ma byi'am so dang gshog pa gnyis ldan gyi sems can zhigachu'i wa/ chu 'gro ba'i wa ste/ khang pa sogs thog steng du yod pa'i chu 'khrid nus kyi brus ba4'i shing ngam rdo la zer/ wa kha yang zer/'gi'u wang / glang chen sogs las 'byung ba'i sman rdzas brgyad kyi gcig ste/sman rdzas brgyad ni/ rin po che'i sman/ sa'i sman/ rdo'i sman/ shing gi sman/ rtsi'i sman/ thang gi sman/ sngo'i sman/ srog chags kyi sman bcas so/ /yab 'dang / sgra snyan nam bkar la go'adzum wab wab / 'dzum dmul dmul rgod pa'i rnam 'gyur/yid ba 'dib ched/ sems la gsal ba'am 'char ba'i tshul lam rnam 'gyur bka bodawab long / rna rgyan nam rna long ste/ gser gyi wang long dang rab/ gi wang long lta bu/3456

wa nya lug ras dkar po zhig dang / sman spung phrom dkar po la wa ta zer/snyenazha 14/ yan lag nyams pa'am zha ba po'i don/zhwa mo — mgo'i zhwa ste/ zhu yang zer/ba/kunamanyam bzhab ting nge 'dzin la mnyam pa'am mtshungs par gzhag pa'am 'jog pa ste/ rjes thob kyi gcig shos/ rjes thob ni mnyam par bzhag pa las ldang ba'i skabs la zer/gzhal bya/ shes bya'am 'jal byed kyi yul/ shes zu dang gzhal bya dang gzhi grub dang yul dang chos dang yod pa rnams don gcig yin/gzhal med khang / tshad dam rin gyis gzhal du med pa'i khang pa ste/gzhal yas khang ngam lha'i khang bzang lta bu/kun gzhi/ kun gyi gzhi ma ste/ rtsa ba'am rten nam sa bon nam gnas sam rgyud dang khams sogs kyi don dang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni/ rnam she sa tshogs brgyad kyi nang gses ste/ ma bsgribs lung ma bstan pa'i gtso bo'i rnam shes gang zhig bag chags kyi bgo gzhir gyur pa rnam smin dang sa bon thams cad kyi rten du gyur cing don gyi ngo bo rig pa la zer/dam gzhag rnam par gzhag pa snye/ tshul lam lugs 'jog pa'i don/ dper 467

na/ brda sprod kyi rnam gzhag lta bu ni yi ge'i phrad dang rnam 'bye po gas ji ltar 'jug lugs sam 'jug tshul bshad pa dang / snyan ngag gi rnam gzhag lta bu ni tshig rgyan ji ltar sprod lugs bshad pa dang / de bzhin du dgag sgrab kyi rnam gzhag sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /༄nam gzhag gtan/ dus gtan nam rgyun pa'i don/gzhon nu/ na phra'am gzhon pa ste/ lo na bcu drug la slebs pa'i gzhon nu lta bu/gzhung bzang / gzhung bzang po'am khog bzang po'am zo bzang po ni legs pa ste/ rang bzhin bzang po'i don/gzha' tshon/ nam mkha'i 'ja' tshod gyi brda rnying /gzhu/ gnam ru'am mda' stan te bzung bya'i don 'dra/ dper na mda' gzhu rna za'i bar du bkang lta bu/gzhogs slob / zur gyis slong ba ste/ gzhan gyi rdzas 'thob par bya ba'i phyir de la bsngags pa byed pa la go zhing log 'tsho lnga'i nang gi gcig yog 'tsho lnga ni/ tshul 'chos dang / kha gsag gzhogs slong / thob kyis 'jal ba/ rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba ste lnga'o/ /bdud gzhom/ bdud gzhom pa dang / dgra bo gzhom pa/ nad gzhom pa ni 'joms pa'am tshar gcod pa'ad sel ba ste/ med pa bzos pa'i don/gzhom ni dus ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigablo gzhobs/ sbo ni lus kyi brang khog dang lto ba'i ngos la go ba dang gzhogs ni glo'am ngos sam zur sogs kyang go ste/ gzhogs slog nas nyal ba lda bu/gnas gzhi/ gnas la go ba'i gzhi'am rten te bslab gzhi bcu bdun de/468

rab byung gi gzhi/ gso sbyong gi gzhi/ dbyar gnas pa'i gzhi/ dgag dbye'i gzhi/ sra brkyang gi gzhi/ gos kyi gzhi/ ko pags kyi gzhi/ sman gyi gzhi/ las kyi gzhi/ phyir brtsos kyi gzhe/ dus dang dus ma yin pa bsdus pa'i gzhi/ sa gzhan na gnas pa spyod pa'i gzhi/ yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi/ las bye ba'i gzhi/ 'khor lo dbye ba'i gzhi/ rtsod pa'i gzhi/gnas mal gyi gzhi bcas so/ /gzhobaXpa/ sgod spyad de/ ka to ra sta bu/g.yab gzhi/ yan lag tshang ba'i pags pa la gogazhan/ pha rol lam spu dad dam bdag min pa'i don la go ba dang / rtags 'jug skabs bdag gzhan gnyis su dbye ba'i gzhan ni bya las la gomangag gzhug mngag tu gzhug bya snye/ pho nya dang bran g.yog la gokhu ba gzhib/ shing tog la sogs pa'i khu ba'am nu ma gzhib pa ni 'jib pa'i don yin/ gzhib ni bya tshig ma 'ongs pa ston byed do/ /gzhol/ gzhol ba ni 'bab pa'am 'jug pa'am 'du ba'am thug pa'i don te/ rta las gzhol ba lta bu ni rta las 'bab pa'i don dang / slob sbyong la gzhol ba lta bu slob sbyong 'jug pa'i don dang / chu phran jims cad rgya mtshor gzhol lta bu ni rgya mtshor 'du ba'i don nam rgya mtshor thug pa'i don no/ / gzha' gsang / g.yung drung ngam rtag pa'am mi 'gyur ba'am 'phrid las kyi don/gzhongs/ yul ljongs la golcag gis ba'u/ sba lcag sogs gi gzhu ba ste/ snyun za'am rgyab pa ma gzung ba'i don/469

gzhi grub/ gzhi grub dang yul dang gzhal bya dang shes bya sogs don gcig yin/ smos ma dgos pa don grub pa/gzhung lugs/ bstan bcos sogs kyi lugs ka'am bstan bcos sogs kyi tshig don bshad lugs la zer/brtab gzhag brtag pa la 'jug pa'i gzhig pa ni dpyad pa'i don dang /bshig pa'am bcom pa'i don la 'jug pa dang / rjes gzhig ni/ bskyed rim sgom skabs lha'i gzhal yas khang 'od gsal du bsdus pa'i rjes su rang lus 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i jim pa la gogazhug gzhug pa ni bcug pa'am byed du 'jug pa'i don/ gzhug ni 'jug pa'i ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabazhogs/ lus kyi ngos sam gzhogs ni phyed kyi don/nad gzhi/ nad kyi gzhi ma ste zhe sa'i tshig la bsnyung gzhi zer/gzhang 'drum gshang ni smad dam 'doms dang bshang lam 'a ko zhing /bshang lam gyi nang sor bzhi tsam na yod pa'i bur nad la ga cung 'brum zer/gzhil/ gzhil ba ni 'jil ba'am bcil ba'i don/ dper na/ lus la mtshon phog nas khreg gzhil ba lta bu ni khrug 'jil ba'am khrug 'don pa zer/gzhil ni 'jil ba'i ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigagazhar yang / nam yang ngam slar yang zhes pa'i don/gzhur med/ 'jur ba med pa'am gzhom pa med pa'i don/yid gzhungs/ blo gsal lam 'dzin rtsal che ba'am mkhas pa'am drang po'i don la 'jug gzhob/ gzhob pa ni 'tshig pa'i non te/ bal rwa spub gzhob lta bu ni bal 460

dang rā co la sogs thab la gzhob pa'i don/ 'tshig dri kha ba'am gzhob dri kha ba lta bu/ba cheb ma/ sa zhing ngam sgos gzhis sa pha gzhis sogs kyi don/glu gzhas/ glu dang gzhas gnyis don gcig ste/ gzhas gtong ba'am klu len pa/'tsho zhing gzhes/ gson por bsdad pa'am bzhugs pa'i don/dran pa nye bar gzhag dran pa ni mi brjed pa dang nye bar bzhag pa ni 'jog pa'i don te/ chos kyi mtshan nyid ji lta ba bzhin ma nor bar shes pa de nyid rtse gcig tu 'jog pa la zer/bsgrigs pa'i bzhibs/ bsgrigs pa'i don la go ba'i gzhing ba/ pa ni/gshibs pa'am sdeb pa la gogazhen bskul/ legs pa'am phan pa la bskul ba ste/ gzhen 'debs sam dran bskul sogs la gonang gzhug nang du 'jug pa'am bcug pa'i don/ gzhug ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabazhabazhag zin/ gnas su bzhag zin ni gnas su 'jog zin pa'am tshar ba'i don/ bzhag ni dus 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabazhad gad/ gzhad pa ni bgad pa'am dgod pa'i don dang gad mo ni bzhad mo'am bzhad gad dang ga zha la zer/bzhad dkar/ bzhad ni bya'i khyad par ngang pa la go zhing dkar ni kha dog 461

dkar po'i don te/ ngang pa dkar po zhes pa'i don/ba'i/ grangs ka'i ming /ba 'bas nas/ bzhabs pa ni 'jabs pa'i don dang / ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i tshig nas ni tshig phrad/bo bshar/ sgra bzhar ba'am spu bzhar ba ni bregs pa'am bcad pa'i don/bzhams bsgo byed/ 'jam por byas te bslab bya byed pa ste/ 'dul ba'i brda'am dran bskul/gso' bzhi'i/ bsnyen rdzogs sprub pa sogs la gsol ba lan gcig dang 1las dngos tshar gsum yod/ de la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las zer la 'dul ba'i brda/dgongs bzhed/ dgongs pa la go ba'i bzhed pa ni/ bsam pa'am 'dod pa'am 'thad pa la zer/de bzhin nyid/ chos nyib dam yang dag gam mtha' ste/ spros pa dang bral ba'i chos ba/bying so/ /bzhengs/ bzhengs pa ni/ gdan steng nas bzangs pa ni yar langs pa'am ldang ba'i don dang / mchod rten sogs bzhengs pa ni bskrun pa'i don no/ /bzhugs bzhugs pa ni bsdad pa'am yod pa'am gnas pa'i don/'byon bzhud/ 'byon pa la go ba'i bzhud pa ni 'jud pa'am phebs pa'am song ba ste/ nyi ma bzhud pa lta bu nyi ma 'jud pa'am song ba'i don/bzhon pa/ theg pa dang rta la sogs pa/zhon/ zhon pa ni 'chib pa'i don/ 'chib pa zer ba zhon pa'i zhe sa'i tshigabazhon ma/ 'o ma bzho rgyu yod pa'i ba phyugs dang mdzo mo sogs la zer/bzho bzhos/ bldo ba dang brgos pa gnyis 'jo ba'i don te/ bzho ni ma 462

'ongs ston byed dang / bzhos ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig yin no/ /brlan bzha'/ brlan pa la go ba'i bzha' ba ni gsher ba'am bzher ba'i don te/ sa cha 'di bzha' tshan chen po 'dug lta bu dang / gro zhib 'dir zha 'dug lta bu brlan yod pa'i don no/ /bzhogs/ shing sogs la sta re bsnun nas bzhogs pa ni 'jog pa'am chung du btang ba'i don/ bzhogs ni dus 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigag yog bzhun/ g.yog bzhun pa ni g.yog regs pa'am yid du 'ong ba'i don/ kha la nyan pa'i g.yog po las ka bskul bde ba lta bu dang / nor bzhun pa ni nor legs pa'am yid du 'ong ba'i don/mar bzhu/ mar khu bzhu ba'am bzhus pa'am slo/la ba'am 'ju ba'i don/bzhur nas/ bzhur ba ni dwangs snyigs phye ba'am gud du bton pa sogs/nas ni lhag bcas kyi phrad/bzhes/ bzhes pa ni za ba'am gyon pa'am len pa'am 'thung ba sogs don mang po'i zhe sa'i brda ste/ gsol tshig bzhes pa lta bu za ba'i don dang /na bda' bzhes pa lta bu gyon pa'i don dang / phyag na bzhes pa lta bu len pa'i don dang / gsol ja bzhes pa lta bu 'thung ba'i don no/ /bzhin ras/ bzhin ras sam zhal ras ni gdong gi zhe sa'i tshigame bzhi gro byi bzhin/ me bzhi dang gro bzhin dang byi bzhin gsum skar ma'i khyad par ram nang gses/'di bzhin/ 'di bzhin dang ji bzhin dang de bzhin lta bu 'dra ba yin/de gsum dpe'i sgra/khur bzhes/ khur bzhes pa ni 'gan len pa'am sdom pa ste/ 'gan 'khyer ba'i dod/463

dpang che ba'i/ dpang po la 'jug pa'i che bzhi ni gnya' bo ste/ phyogs gnyis dbar du bden rdzun shan 'byed byed mi la zer/ de'i bzhi no grangs kyi bzhe min par bshad/bzhi mnyan// bshang shā ka'i ming ste mi gca nga ba'am skyag pa la gob 'dig nang khrol rgyu ma zhig ste/ rgyu ma bcu/ga sgor mo/bzazwa tshod/ zwa tshod ni sngo tshod tsher lngan zhig ste/ zwa po yang zer/me zad/ mi zad pa ni mi 'dzad pa'am zad mi shes pa'i don/bzhan kyi ma 11/ gzhan mchob dman kun la zlo ba'am bzla ba ste/ 'chad pa'am smra ba'am bshad pa'i don/ blo ba ni dus da lta ba ston byeb kyi tshigasngags zlos/ rig sngags ste/ lha'i 'phrin las dang thugs rdo rje shes rab kyi cha ga rtsa bor sprub pa'i sngags te bud med kyi gzugs dbyibs kyi lha dang /de ston pa'i sgra dpa phyag rgya la so gas ni rig sngags zeྈ ba dang / de bzhen du spran ras gzibs kyi gzungs sngags yi ge drug sogs zlos pa ni bzla ba'am skor ba'am ya nga yang brjod pa'i ngon yin zhing blos shig ces pa skul chib yin/ zlos pa ni dus da lta ba ston pa'i tshigazlos gar/ blos gar ni rig gnas chung ba lnga'i nang gi gcig ste/ rig gnas chung ba lnga ni/ snyan ngag/ mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsib 1 zlos gar bcas so/ /de bzhin gar 'khrub pa'i ming la'ang zlos gar zer/zla ba/ zla ba'i ming gi rnam grangs la ku mud gnyen dang / bsil zer can /464

'od dkar can/ cha gter/ rgyu skar bdag po sogs mang du yodakespum/ rlum po ni dbyibs kyi khyad par te gor gor dang ril ril dang thum pa'i don/zla gam/ zla ba phyed kyi dbyibs dang / grwa pa'i tshogs gos shigazlas dbye/ zlab1 dbye ba ni/ grogs kyis phye ba bsdu ba drug gis gcig blas drangs pa ste/ bar gyi rnam dbye rnams bsdus nas mthar rnam dbye gcig gi sbyar ba la zer/ dper na/ nyi ma zla ba nor bu'i 'od lta bu/blog pa/ bzlog pa'am log tu 'jug pa ste/ bzang ngan go bzlog pa lta bu/zla grogs/ grogs po'i mi mched po'am spun zla/lo zla/ lo ni dus shig dang zla ba ni zhag sum cu'i ming /mya ngan zlo/ mya ngan las zlo ba ni sems sdug las bzla ba'am 'da' ru 'jug pa'am sgrol ba'i don/bskyar ba'i zlos/ bskyar ba'i don can spyi zlos pa ni don gcig yang yang 'chad pa'am ldab pa'i don/ gong du bshad zin pa'i don sgar yang 'chad pa la zlos skyon zer zhing nyes brtseb/sa byung ba lta bu/gzagacar gzan/ sder mo ldan pa'i sems can stag dang dom dang dred mong lta bu/gzig gcan gzan gzig gi ming /bzubs brnyan/ sku 'dra'am snang brnyan sna kogazib/sa/ gzigs pa ni lta ba'am shes pa'am 'tsho ba 'ad/ dgongs pa'i 466

don/ de bzhin nyo ba'i don la'ang go ste/ lham cha gcig gzigs 'dug lta bu/gza' skar/ gza' shi nyi ma dang zla ba sogs kyi gza' dang skar ni bra nye la sogs pa'i rgyu skar nyer bdun gyi skar ma la go'od gzar/ 'od zer ram snang ba'am gsal ba'i don/gzi brjid/ gzi byin nam bkag mdangs sam zil la go/gzi/ rin po che'i rigs shig ste/ nor bu khru bo zhig yin la sman du 'gro/nus pa'am zil lam 'od kyang zer/rngul gzan/ bge slong gi rngul nag len par byed pa'i gzan ste/ yo byadabacu gsum gyi gcig yo byad bcu gsum ni/ rab tu byung ba rnams la lus 'tsho ba'i ched du 'chang bar gnang ba'i rung ba tshad ldan gyi gos yin de la/ snam sbyar dang / bla gos/ mthang gos/ shams thabs/ shams thabs kyi gzan/ rngul gzan/ rngun gzan gyi gzan/ gdong phyis/ rnag gzan/ g.yan dgab/ skra gzed/ gding ba/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen te bcu gsum mo/ /phrag par gzed cing / phrag pa dang sgod lta bur gzed pa'am 'dzed pa ni bzed pa 'i don te/ ras phad nang 'bru gzed pa lta bu/ cing ni tsheg phrad/gzar/ gzar ba ni 'gel ba'am bkar ba'am dpyang ba'i don te/ stod gos phrag par gzar lta bu/gzong / shing dang rdo sogs rko byed kyi yo sprad cig gi ming /gzeb/ gzeb ni gur dang / sprug mas bslas pa'i gzeb ste/ slo ma lta bu/gzer bu/ lcags gzer chung ba/gzugs/ shing sob/sa gzugs bya/ 'dzugs byed/ bcu gas pa/ tshug rad 466

shig lta bu dus gsum gyi khyad par ste/ gzugs ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigagazegs ma/ zeg da ma'am nyar ma'am zer ma'am nyag ma ste/ phra ba'i dngos po/ dper na/ chu'i gzegs ma lta bu ni chu'i thigs pa'am chu rdul/gzegs zan/ zas kyi zegs ma'am zas kyi lhag ma za zhing 'tsho bar byed pa'am brtul zhugs la spyod mkhan zhig ste/ phyi rol gyi grub mtha' 'ji na pa'i nang gses bye brag pa'i ston pa'am drang srong zhigagazir ba/ mnar ba'am gtod pa'am snun pa'am skyen par go ste/ sdug bsngal gyis gzir lta bu sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i don dang / 'ben la gzir ba ni 'phen la kha gtod pa'am snun pa'i don/gzas/ gzas pa ni brdeg par brtsams pa'am chas pa'am gtad pa'i don te/ gzhan la rdung brdeg byed par gzas pa lta bu ni rdung brdeg byed pa'i bya ba brtsams pa/ mda' 'ben la gzas pa ni mda' 'ben la kha gtad pa'i don/da gzod/ da gdod dam da tsam te/ gzhi nas dang / rjes su'am phyis nas zhes pa'i don/drin gzo/ drin gzo ba ni byas pa'am bka' drin gzo ba'am 'jal ba'am gso ba'i don/chud mi gzon/ chud mi gzon pa ni chud mi za ba'am chab mi 'tshal ba'i don te/ don med 'phro brlag ma phyin pa'i don/ gzu lums/ rang bzo'am bab col te/ gzu lum du smra ba ni bab col lam ma brtag par bshad pa/gzung 'dzin/ gzung ba ni yul lam gzhal bya ste/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/467

ro/ reg bya/ chos bcas drug la zer ba dang / 'dzin pa da yu la can nam 'jal byed la go ste/ se mas ka zer ro/ / de bzhin du gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis bzung ba'i don la'ang go ste/ lag pas dngos po bzung ba'am don li da la bzung ba'am 'dzin pa lta bu la 'a gogazeb cha chung / gnyod ka ste nus pa'i don go ba dang bzod brngo/na gyi don la'ang go ste/ gzeg cha chung ba ni nus pa chung ba'am bzod bsran chung ba bka pe/zug gzer/ na zug btang ba'am gzer spru rgyab pa/gzem/ gzem pa ni 'dzem pa'i den te/ bya ba ngan pa la gzem pa lha bu ni bya ba ngan pa la 'dzem pa'i rdan yen zhing 'dzem pa'i da lta ba ston pa'i 'bri srol gzhan zhigagazim mal/ gzim pa ni mnal ba'am ka snyeng dam gnyid rog pa'i zhe sa 'i brda yin pa dang / mal ne nyal sa'am gnas mal gyi don/ de bzhin gzim shag lta bu khyim tshang ge zhe sa'i bka1gzud/ gzud pa ni bsngod pa ste btsug pa'i don/ dper na/ nyes can pa rnams brtsan rar gzud dgos lta bu btsud pa'am bcug pa'i don yin zhing / gzud ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabaze ma/ gze ma ra mgo zer ba'i tsher ma la go zhib rtsa ba lnga'i nang tsha na/gzang ring / rtse no zhing ring ba ste/ tsher ma gzang ring lta bu tsher che/ rtse no zhing ring ba'i don/bzan/ ba/zan pa ba/nod pa'am gtses pa'am zad pa ste gzam/ po'i don/dper na/ skad cha 'di ltar bshad na yid ra gzan po 'dug lta bu yid 'a gnod pa'am gces pa'i don dang / phru gu 'di'i gos gzan pa ang 468

lta bu zad pa'i don no/ de bzhin du rta drel sogs la ster rgyu'i rtswa dang sog ma la'ang gzan pa zer/gru bzibs/ gru la go ba'i gzings ni/ chu sogs las sgrol byed dang / grujings sam gru gzings gnyis ka 'bri srol yod/sha gzug sha khog gcig dum bu bzhi la btang ba'i cha gcig la zer/ sha gzug gcig dang / sha gzug gnyis lta bu/zas kyi gzan/ zas kyi don la go ba'i gzan ni zan nam spag ste/ rtsam pa ba jis pa'i gong bu/ )phying gzar/ phying pa'i gzar ram srin bal gyi gzar te/ phying pa'i gdan nam stan dang / srin bal gyi gdan nam stan la gogazar bu/ skyogs sam blugs byed ste/ thug pa blug byed gzar bu sta bu/dga' spugs gzar/ dgang ba'i gzar bu dang blugs pa'i gzar bu gnyis ni sbyin sreg gi mdzad sgo'i skabs bed spyod pa'i ༈da spyad kyi ming yin/gzengs bstod/ gzengs su bstod pa'am mtho bar byed pa ste/ bsngags brjod da gzigs bzos la gogazi mdangs/ gzi ni mdangs sam stobs sogs la go ste/ nor bu'i gzi 'od lta bu mdangs sam bkrag chen po'i don dang / rgyal pa'i gzi brjid lta bu stobs chen po la gog thod ma'i dus/ gdod ma'i dus sam thog ma'i dus zer ba'i don/ri gzar/ ri gzar po ni gyen dam po'am bgrod dka' ba'i don/gzugs mo/ byi thur can te/ sgang gzugs sam ze mo la go de bzhin gzugs ni lus po sogs la'ang go46snye

gzar bag dpyang ba'i thag pa'am gos kyi gdang bu ste/ yo byad 'gel sa'i lung kagagazungs thag tshem bu'i gzungs thag dang bum pa'i gzungs thag ste/ sngab/sa chog bum sgrub sogs ka dgos pa yo byad cigagazab ba / gzabs pa ni gzob pa ste/ bag zon byed pa'am rig pa sgrim pa'i don la go ba dang / gzabs sprod lta bu rgyan gos la go ba dang / gzabs gzabs byed lta bu la'ang gobazags/ gzags pa ni 'dzag pa'am lhung ba'i don/ gzungs spobs/ gzungs ni sngar smos pa'i chos don mi brjed par 'dzin pa dang / sgobs ni zad mi zhes par 'chad nus pa ste/ thogs pa med par bshad pa la zer/gzubs sngags/ lha'i sku dang gsung rdo rje gtso bor sgrub byed bde stong yi ger shar ba'i sngags te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs sngags yi ge drug ma sogs/thugs gzu bo/ blo gzu bo ste/ drang po'am phyogs ris su mi lhung ba'i don/bsgo ba rnar ga zon/ bslab bya chud gzon pa ste/ mi nyan pa'i don/ba / zadabaza' ba/ bza' 5'am spyad bya/bzad bzas/ bza' ba'am bzas pa gnyis ni za ba'am bzhes pa'am spyod pa'am gnod pa'i don/bu rmed bza'/ bud med la go ba'i bza' ni mo'i don te/ rgya bza' 470

dang bal bza' lta bu/bza' mi/ khyo shug la gobazi zhing / bzi ba ni chang dang a rag sogs btung nas ra bzi ba'am yang na 'dod chags kyis bzi ba ni 'dod chags kyis sems byus pa'i don/ zhing ni tshig phrad do/ /ma zu/ brlugs pa ni/ gtam sogs bzugs pa lta bu dris pa'am smas pa'am zhus pa'i don yin pa dang / dkar yol nang chu brlugs pa lta bu chu blugs pa'i don yin/ ma ni dgag sgra yin/na bza'/ gos kyi zhe sa'i tshigabazang po/ legs pa'am dge ba'am phan pa'am bzang ba la golag pas bzung / sug pas 'dzin pa'am 'chang ba'i don/ba tho bo/ bzo rig shes mkhan nam bzo byed dam bzo pa la go ste/ lcags bzo ba dang / shing bzo ba dang / rdo bzo ba lta bu spyi'i ming /lhang bzed/ dge slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum nang gi gcig ste/slong phor yang zer/ bzed zhal/ zhag sogs blugs sgod yin zhing / ming gi rnam grangs la mchil sgod dang chol zangs yang zer/bzed/ bzed pa ni sgod sogs kha 'dzed pa'am gzed pa'i don/bze chung bze re chung ba ste/ bzod bsran med pa'am bzod bsran chung ba nyam chung ngam gnyod chung gi don dang / bze re che ba ni bzod bsran che ba'i don/mi bzad/ ma rungs pa'am ha cang drag shul lam tshabs che ba sogs la golas la bzur/ las sam bya ba la bzur ba ni bzur ba'am gzur ba ste/411

las la g.yol ba'i don/bzod pa/ bsran pa'am nus pa'am theg pa'am khro ba spong ba'i rdon yin/dper na/ slob spyong byed skabs lto gos la dka' ngal ga tshod byung yang bzod pa lta bu/tshogs bsgoms/ tshogs gnyis ste bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye zhes kyi tshogs gnyis bzlums pa'am bsdus pa'am dril pa/ mthun par byas pa ste/ skal pa mang po'i tshogs brlums pa'am rlabs chen gyi dge ba'i las bsags pa'i don/ sngags bzla bzlas/ gzungs sngags sogs bzla ba'am bzlas ba gnyis yang yang bskyar ba'am zlos pa'i don/mi bzlog mi bsgyur ba'am phyir ldog tu me 'jug pa'am mi zlog pa'i don/g.yul bzlog g.yul bzlog pa sna dmag zlog pa'am dmag bkag pa'am ldog tu 'jug pa'am log par byas pa'i don/phya ngan bzla/ mya ngan las bzla ba'am zlo ba'am bzlas pa ste/ zu ngan las sgrol ba'i don/ bzla ni ma 'ongs ston byed kyi tshigagacig nu bar/ phyogs gcig tu du ma'am mang po brlums pa'am sdom pa ste bsdus pa'i don no/ /shā 'obs/ phyi nas nang du 'ongs pa lta bu la 'juga'ong / 'bru ma bton pa'i ston thog la zer zhing / 'ong skor lta bu dbyar dus kyi zhing pa'i dus chen zhig472

'o skol/ bdag cag gam rang cag zer ba'i don/'on ba/ rna ba 'on pa ste/ sgra 31sa mi thub pa/'ug ba/ nyin mo mig long ba'i bya zhiga'on cig byon gcig dang / byin cig 'khyer shog zer ba'i don/'os pa/ rung ba'am 'thad pa'i don te/ 'di ni ngas bya 'os pa zhig red lta bu/dka'i ba / bod kyi lho kha'i sa gnas shig sga ming ngam bya 'ol ba'i kha dog gam kham naga'ud po che/ ha cang thal che ba'i gtam/'og ma/ steng ma yin pa'am steng gi gcig shos/'on tang / 'on te dang 'on kyang dang 'on tang gsum don 'dra/dka da / ba phyugs sogs brgos pa'i 'o ma/'obs/ dong ngam sa shur la go ste/ chu 'gro su'i 'obs lta bu/'od zer/ nyi ma dang me la sogs par 'od zer/'od da/ sdug bsngal gyi skad la zer/ nad kyis mnar nas mi bzod pa'i 'o dod 'bod pa lta bu/ba mi rab / yi rang ba ni gzhan gyis byas pa la dga' ba'am dga' ba tsam ste1gzhan gyis bya ba bzang po bsgrubs par mos pa byung ba'i dod/chub zad/ yi chad pa ni chi chad pa'am yi myug pa ste/ sems skyo ba'am zhum pa'i don/413

yi dwags/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro ste ngan song gsum gyi gcigamada' yab/ khang pa'i pu shu ste/ khang pa'i chu skyor la go mda' g.yab kyang zer/za yab/ rnga mas bzos pa'i yab ste/ rlung yab bam bsil yab la go rnga g.yab kyang zer/ba/ba g.yor mo/ gdos pa'am gru gzings kyi dar po che la go ste/ gru gzings kyi rlung g.yor la gogayo g.yos/ g.yo ba dang g.yos pa gnyis ni dar rlung gis g.yo ba'am g.yos pa ni 'grul ba'am bskyod pa'i don dang / mi brtan pa'i g.yo ba'am g.yos pa ni 'gyur ba'i don dang / g.yo bshad pa'i gtam ni drang po min pa 'khyog po'i don dang / spag sogs g.yo ba'am g.yos pa ni srug ba ji ba'i don la 'jug pa dang / ba yos shib lta bu skul tshig la'ang 'jug gogayab mo/ g.yab g.yug gam g.yob pa'i ming tsam ste/ lag pas g.yab g.yug rgyab nas tshur shog ces ba 'i brda bstan pa la zer/g.yabs/ g.yabs pa ni g.yob pa'i dus 'das pa ston pa'i tshigagayor po/ lung pa'am yul gyi bye brag ste/ bod kyi lho kha'i grwa spru dang grwa nang gi sa khul gyi ming /g.yub za/ 'dris pa3ma za 'drog pa'am brling ba ste / mi dab 'dris pa'i ri dwag ba /474

gsan ba dgab/ g.yan pa ni/ g.ya' nad dam za phrug gi nad/ g.yan pa dgab pa ni g.yan pa 'gebs pa'i gos ste/ g.yan pa'i nad can gyis sha la sbyar nas spyon par bya ba dge slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum gyi nang tshan g.yan dgab la zer/g.yang sa/ lhung sa'am sa gzar po la gomi g.yo/ mi g.yo ba ni rlung sogs kyis mi g.yo ba lta bu mi bskyod pa'i don dang / spag mi g.yo ba lta bu spag mi brji ba'i don/g.yung drung / rtag pa dang 'gyur med dang bgra shis pa mtshon byed kyi ri mo zhib/g.yang / dpal lam phun tshogs ste/ dpal 'byor dang / phun sum tshogs pa'i ka'am bcud dang bsod nams la gogayel med/ sems gzhan la g.yel ba med ba'am las rdon sogs la g.yel ba med pa lta bu ni brtson 'grus ldan pa'am stom las dang g.yeng ba med pa'i don/g.yur za/ g.yur du za ba ni lo 'bras rgyas nas thur du 'phyang ba dang smin pa'i don te/ 'di lo zhing nang du ston thog g.yur du za ba 'dug lta bu dang / kham sdong 'dir 'bras bu g.yur du za ba byung 'dug lta bu/zas g.yo g.yos/ zas rgyu ma la g.yo ba dang g.yos pa gnyis ni spus pa'am btsos pa'am sbyar ba'i don te/ g.yos zas sam sbyar zas lta bu/gsab gzhi/ g.yang gi gzhi ma ste/ yan lag ldan pa'i pags pa la zer pa dper na/ srog chags kyi mgo sug gi pags pa cha tshang yod pa'i pags gdan lta bu/ba/yob/ ba/44ba/ba / g.yog pa dang g.yogs pa gnyis ni/ lus po sogs la 476

gos shā bu bkab pa'am gtums pa'am bskon pa'i don yin zhing / phyi ma g.yogs ni g.yogs shig ces skul tshig ka'ang 'jug pa yin/ga mer ma/ sgod bam sman zhig ste/ nus pas rtsa kha 'byed pa dang / srin nad gco da/ zas 'ju ba sogs la phan/ sto chas kyi bro ba skyed byed sha sman yab yin no/ /ba yigs pa/ skyigs bu byed pa ste/ ig sgra thon pa'am g.yig pa —g.yi lngags/ g.yi ni gzugs dbyibs phal cher gzig dang 'dra ba'i gcan gzan zhig yin zhi de'i pags pa la g.yi lngab/sa zer/g.yar nas/ g.yar ba ni g.yas pa'am brnyan pa ste/ bun lon g.yar ba'am kha g.yar za lta bu/ nas ni lhag bcas kyi sgra/g.yab g.yug lag pas ga mab mo'am g.yab cing g.yug pa ni tshur 'bod pa'i brda bstan pa la gogayob/ g.yo/ba pa ni g.yabs pa'am lag pa so gas krab grab byed pa'i don/ba/yon ma/ ga yon can ma'am 'phyon ma'am ga yon mig ma ste/ bud med mdzes ma la golog g.yem/ log par g.yem pa ni 'dod pa ste/ 'dod log dang g.yem ma sogs kyi don/ dper na/ gzhan spyo chung mar byed pa dang / rang gi chung ma sprum mar 'khrig pa lta bu/ba yeb ba/ sems rgod pa'am 'phro ba 'cha/ skyod pa ni sems g.yeng ba'i don te/ sems le lo 'phen pa'am rna ma par g.yeng ba ni zhes pa gci pa/ tu mi gnas pa'i don/g.yengs/ g.yengs shig lta bu skul tshigab ma' rbo ga reg nas gad mo slong ba'am ga ga tshil te i mi lu gu byed pa 4 ‘6

dang / gsa' ri las skyes pa'i sgog pa la g.ya' sgog zer1skyi gsa'/ skyi ga ma' ba ni 'jigs pa'am skrag pa'i don te/ ba spu bu ga za ba yi 'jigs snang byung ba/ lhags g.ya'/ lcags sogs kyi g.ya'am btsa' ste/ brlan dang 'phrad skabs glo bur du byung ba'i dri ma nag nogagayu/ rin chen drug dmar dang drug dkar/g.yung mo/ sngar rgya gar gyi bshan pa'i rigs kyi bud med la zer zhing rigs ngan zhig yin pa dang g.yung po ni pho rigs ngan la gogayo sgyu/ g.yo thabs sam slu ba'am gya gyu ste/ rang skyon sru zhing gzhan ma mgo skor gtong ba'i bsam sbyor zhigagayer bag —rgod bag gam g.yeng bag gam snang g.yel ste/ sems 'phangs mtho ba'am bzhad gad che ba'am snang sa che ba'i don/g.yag dud 'gro'i khyad par te/ g.yag dang 'bri bshos pa las skyes pa'i pho phyugs/ba yas ga chen/ g.yas phyogs dang g.yon phyogs/g.yul sprod/ dmag gam 'khrug pa 'gyed pa'am 'thab tu 'jug pa'i don/g.yul las/ dmag las sam thog las ste/ g.yul kha'i snye ma brdung bsal gyi las la'ang gogayog las ka'am bya ba dang g.yog rgyug pa dang / bran khol gyi don te/ nad pa'i g.yog gam phru gu g.yog lta bu/mig g.yor/ zla ba gcig la zla ba gnyis snang ba lta bu'am grim ma ste/ sgyu ma'i dpe/kha ba/ba ba / kha g.yal ba ni glal ba ste/ kha gdangs pa'i don/411

ba yar dza tsha/ g.yar ngo tsha ba ni kha skyengs pa'am zhal ngo tsha ba'i ngon/ba yar khral/ ngo khul lam kha khrar te/ mi gzhan gyi ngo ma bzlog par phyas pa'i las kagayar dam/ dam bca'am zhal bzhes la gogayar khams/ sku khams sam khams g.yar zhes pa kha gdong mdun sogs kyi zhe sa'i tshig dang zhe sa'i tshig tsam yang yod pas skabs phyed dgos/snang g.yel/ yul gyi snang ba la g.yel ba ste/ g.yeng ba dang / ga mer bag dang sa yangs pa'i don/ sge'u khung dang rab gsal lha bu/g.yer kha/ dril bu chung chung la go dper na/ rta la g.yer kha 'dogs lta bu/rar lug ra dang thu/ba gnyis dud dgro'i khyad par yin zhing lug la bal ldan yang zer/ra co/ mgo skyes kyi ru/ glang gi da co dang / 'ug gi rwa co lta bu/rdul du rlog rdul ni rdul phran lda bu chung ngu'i don yin zhing rlog pa ni brlag pa'am (re jom pa'am 'thag po'i don yin/mngon blom/ mngon par rlom ba ni mngon pa'i nga rgyal rte/ rang la yon tan med bzhin du yod snyam pa'i sems khengs pa'am nga rgyal lam nga rgya' ba bka bodablom se mas/ chags pa'am nga rgyal ba'am ma yin pa la yin par 'dzin pa'i sems te/ rang nyid mkhas pa ma yin bzhin du mkhas par rlom pa lta bu/418

byin rlabs/ bla ma sogs kyi byin rlabs ni rlob pa'i ming tsam ste/ lhag gnas sam rab gnas dang nus pa 'jug pa'i don yin/chobs/ rlobs shig lta bu ni byin gyis rlob pa'i skul tshigachon ba/ gsher ba'am brlan pa la go chu lta bu ni brlan zhing gsher ba yin/rlag byed/ gnod byed dang 'joms byed dang stor byed la go'adoms kyi blog gsang gnas kyi rlig pa ste/ sgro ba 'bras bu la gorlabs chen/ bya ba rgya chen nam thabs chen nam phyod chen po'i don/ mdzad pa rlabs chen lta bu/dba' rlangs/ chu'i rba rlabs sam mtsho'i rba rlabs lta bur gorlangs pa/ tsha drod las skyes pa ste/ sa'i rlangs pa'am kha'i rlangs pa sogs lta bu/rlung / 'byung ba bzhi'i ya gyal zhig 'byung ba bzhi ni/ sa chu me rlung bzhi'o/ /yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi mtshan nyid yin/ rlung gi ming gzhan la g.yo byed dang skyod byed ces kyang zer/rlam khyer/ ham pas 'khyer ba'i don/khrag rlangs/ khrug gi drod rlangs sam khrug rdogarlan blon zab / gsher ba'am skom mam btung ba ste/ chang dang chu sogs la zer/ rlan pa dang rlon pa don 'dra ba yin/zad ba/ spyod/ rnyang ma'am skyag pa sla po la gorlugs ba/ zas ma zhu bar 'og nas 'thon pa ste/ bshal ba lta bur godaper na/ grod khog rlugs pa ni grod khog bshal ba'i don no/ /khub bu'i rlubs/ khung bu'i don can gyi rlubs ni/ bu ga'am i khung 479

dang / dong dang dma' sar godud 'gro'i jid bu/ dud 'gro re'u la sogs pa'i pags pa sbubs bshus byas pa la rbed bu zer zhing grod chung ngam pags khug la yang 'jug par mngon/brlabacom bzag slob dpon yon ta na 'od kyi yul te/ slob dpon yon tan 'od ni/ sngar rgya gar gyi 'dul ba'i slob dpon zhig ste/ yul bcom brlag gi bram ze'i rigs kyi khyem zhig tu 'khrungs shing / gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen bshes gnyen du bsten nas sde sgod gsum dang lhag par 'dul ba la mkhas par gyur te/ 'dul ba rang las mkhas par grags pa'i slob dpon zhig yin no/ /tshig brlang / tshig brlang po ni tshig rtsub po'i don dang / spyod pa brlang po ni spyod pa rtsing po'am spyong po'i don/brlag bya/ dgra bo ni brlag bya—sgyum gzhom bya dang / nor ni brlag bya'am stor bya lta bu ni bya tshig ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i tshig dang / rlag pa ni da lta ba ston pa'i tshig rlog ni skul tshig go/brla sha/ lus kyi brla yi sha ste/ rkang pa'i pus mo yan chad dang tshang ra man chad kyi sha der brla sha zer/chus bzan/ chus brlan pa'am mchil mas brlan pa ni/ rlon pa3ma gsher bar byas pa'i don/480

ya ma bzla/ chu shing ltar snying po med ba'am mi bden pa'i don/blo ba grogs la blo brlug pa ni/ yid gcugs pa dang / zums mthun pa'am grogs po yang /brtan ba'i ba / brtan pa la go ba'i bzang ba ni/ 'gyur meng dang za ba dang gyi ba dang / tshugs ba dang 1 dum ba/ zab pa bcas kyi don la 'jugabyin gyis brlabs/ byin gyis brlabs pa ni1 lhag par gnas pa ste— rab gnas byas pa ma go ba dang nus pa 'jug pa'i don yin/ brlabs ni dus 'das pa ston pa'i tshig dang / rlob ni dus da lta ba ston pa'i tshig gogadon gyis bzlams/ gdon da brlams pa ni/ mi ma yin mi'i khog par zhugs nas smyo ba'i don/ de bzhin du 'dod pas brlam pa ni/'dod chags kyis myos pa'i don dang / 'jigs pas brlam pa ni/ 'jiṭa snang gis bla chad pa lta bu bsam rgyu dang dran rgyu med pa chags pa dang /zu ngan brlam pa ni/ sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i don/'ab / lu ba ni gos kyi bye brag ste/ bal gos srab dkar sogs chags su ma bcags pa'i snam bu spu can la golug dud 'gro'i bye brag snye/ ra dang lug lta bu/lugs/ lugs ni srol dang tshul la go zhing / chos kyi lugs dang / srid kyi lugs lta bu/lang / lang ba ni ldang ba'i don te/ gdan nas lang lta bu gdan nas ldang 481

ba'i rdan no/ /ba ba ba 1 langs ba ci lang ba'i dus 'das rngo4 ston byed kyi tshigazad ba / long ba ni mig ldong pa'am/ mig dbang shor nas mthong mi thub pa yi don/'i kyib ba / longs shig lta bu ni/ dngos po sogs len pa'i skul tshig gam/gdan nas longs lta bu lang ba'i skul tshig la 'jugab ba/ 'a ga zhes pa ni skar ma lag ste/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi ya rgyal zhig dang / de bzhin du mi gcig gis bdag skul byed pa'i rta drel bcu re'am bdun re la rta drel lag gcig zer ba yin/lags/ lags ni yin nar/ red kyi zhe sa'i tshig de ltar lags lta bu dang 1de bzhin ming gi rjes su 'jug rnga ni gus zhabs byas pa'i don ste / rgan tshe dbang lags dang / rdo rje lags sogs lta bu/ log log pa ni slar yong ba'i don te/ phar phyin nas tshur lob/ byung lta bu/dbab/ba / logs ni ngos kyi don te/ gyang gi logs la lta bu dang / nag pang bi logs la lta bu ngos kyi don— no/ /de ltar la rkyang pa las ched kyang ma nga 'jug yod med kyi khyad par kes dgos so/ /stonashab/ nyi ma shaྈ ba'i phyogs dang / nyi ma 'char za'i ngon/shing bar/ shing snyir za/nga 'thung kyi pa pa zer ba dang shing khar ne shing gi steng du zhes shā/'i den1 shang shang / 'dab chags shang rdo/nga ste/ stod bya dang sma da 4'i rtsa/ma pa'i 482

gshog pa can/shi/ shi ba ni 'chi ba'i don/shul/ rjes sam mal dang lam du go dper na/ phebs pa'i shul lha bu rjes sam rtags la go ba dang / pha shul bus 'dzin lta bu mal lam tshab tu goXb dang / mkhas pa gshegs shul du 'gro lta bu rjes sam lam du goshid zan/ gshin zas sam dad zas sam dge zas la gozhel/ me shel dang chu shel dang spyan shel lta bu'i shel gyi ming /shubs/ gtums sgod te/ gri shubs dang / khab shubs/ lag shubs sogs/shed bu shed bdag zhes las skyes/ shed bu dang / shed bdag dang /—shes las skyes gsum sems can nam gang zag gi ming / shed ces pa yid dang stobs dang nyams dang tshangs pa la goshun bags/ shun pa ni pags pa'am skogs pa'i don te/ shing gi shun pa'am 'bru yi shun pa lta bu'o/ /shun lngags kyang snang /sham thabs/ dge slong gi rlum bor bgo bya'i gos ste/ srid du khru lnga dang /zheng du khru do yod pa rab byung gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum nang tshan shigashur bus bcings/ shur bu ni ska rags kyi khyad par phre'u 'am ska rags tsam la go ba dang / des bcings pa ni 'ching ba'i don/ste/ba ldan/ blo ldan nam mkhas pa la go ba dang / shes pa da ldan pa ni sems can spyi la goshin nu/ ha cang ngam nges par gyi don/ shub pur spru/ shub shub bam skad chung ngur smra ba'am bshad pa/483

shar nga / bshan pa ste/ mi dpa phyugs sogs gsod par byed mkhan la zer/shā 'od1 chu rog gam 'od pa la gogashab re gshegs/ lam bde ba byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa 'a1 brten nas 'bras bu bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar gshegs pa'am song ba'am 'gro ba la zer zhing / yon tan spums cad rtogs pa dang nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa ste/ sangs rgyas la gogashis lugs/ gnas lugs sam gnas tshul la gode bzhen gzhegs/ 'khor ba'i gnas su yang nas mang du gshegs pa dang de bzhin du spur pa'i gnas su yang nas yang du gshegs pas na de bzhin gshegs pa ces zer te/ sangs rgyas la gogashin po/ 'das po la go ste/ gshin po'i na bza' lta bu 'das po'i gos la go de bzhin du gshin po ni 'jam po dang dul ba'i don la'ang go ste/ sa rgyu gshin po lta bu dang / sems rgyud gshin po lta bu'o/ /gshags 'byed/ gshags 'byed pa ni/ rtso da pa so gas tha dab byed pa1sgyum shan 'byed pa'i don/ gshags 'byed pa po ni dpon nam dbang po la go/gshin rje/ gshin po rnams kyi rje bo ste/ mthar byed dam gshin rje chos (1ba /gshed/ gnod byed dam dgra'am gshed ma lta bu la go ba dang / lha gshin rje gshed ni/ 'jigs byed go zhing bla med pha rgyud kyi yi dam zhigagazhen rabs/ bon po'i chos lugs kyi ston pa'i ming /484

bshab dgrol/ bon po'i rol mo cang dkrol ba'am 'khrol ba/dbu bo gshor/ dbu skra gshor ba ni mgo'i skra rtsub pa'am mi 'jam pa'i don/gshis ban/ gshis ka ngan pa ste/ rang bzhin ngan pa'am rgyud ngan pa la go/g.yul gshom/ g.yul gshom pa ni dmag rgyag pa'i grabs byed pa dang /mchod pa gshom pa ni lha'i zhal zas sgrig ba4'i don/ gshom ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshig dang / bshams ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabashung / gshung ba ni/ shub bur smod pa'am lkog kha gtong ba'i don/gshe/ gshe ba ni/ spyo ba'am gshe gshe gtong ba'i don/mo gsham1 rabs chad ma ste/ phru gu mi skye ba'i bud med la gogasha' ma/ yang dag pa'am ngo ma'am lhad med pa'i don/yin du gsha'/ yin gsha' dang / bden gsha'/ yod gsha' 1 bu ni ngo ma'am bden pa gzhir bzhag pa dang 'thad pa'am 'os pa'am rigs pa'i don no/ /gshor/ sgod cig la go ba dang / yur ba la brda rnying du gshor zer/chu gsho shib / chu sogs gsho ba ni 'dor ba'am 'bo ba la go shing ni tshig phrad rdo / /gshog bshags/ gshog pa dang gshags pa ni gses pa'am bkas pa ste gnyis su byed pa'i don/ dper na/ shing gshog pa'am shing gshags pa lta bu ni shing gses pa'i don yin zhing / gshog ni dus da lta ba ston byed kyi tshig dang / gshags pa ni dus 'das pa ston pa'i tshig gothong gshol/ zhing rmo spyad la zer ba dang / gshol mda' ltar na thong gshol gyi yu ba'i shing la zer/486

gsheg cing / gsheg pa ni phyed pa' ca/ kha gnyis su byed pa la (rejugadaper na/ shing gsheg pa lta bu/ shing gshog pa'i 'bri srol gzhan zhigacing ni tshig phrad/'dab gshog 'dab ma gshog pa ste/ 'phur byed sogs te/ bya yi gshog pa lta bu/bshibs/ gshibs pa ni gzhibs ‘ 'am sgrig pa'am 'grogs pa'i ngon/dper na/ nga tsho phyi rgyal ba'i mi dang lo gcig gshibs rngo4 yin lta bu/brlan gsher/ brlan pa la go ba'i gsher ba ni rlon pa'am bzha' tshan la go ste/ brlan zhing gsher ba chu'i mtshan nyid lta bu/bres gshor/ bre dang phul gyis gshor ba ni 'jal ba'am bshar ba'i don/bre ni pod du 'bru sogs 'jal byed kyi tshad yin zhing khal pyi nyi shu tham pa'i cha gcig yin/ phul ni bre gang gi drug cha gcig yin/ gshor ka dus da lta ba ston pa'i bya tshig yin no/ /'phrab la gshor/ 'phrang lam la gshor ba'am bshar ba ste/ re re bzhin gral byas nas 'gro ba'am 'gro ba tsam la yang go' / dka / 'og ma'am phyi ma'am mtha' dang / gsham gsal gyi sgra lta bu/spang gshob sa/ sgang la sogs pa'i gshongs ste/ ljongs sam gzhongs kyi don/ sgang min pa la gozhing sa gshin/ zhing gi sa rgyu gshin pa ste/ mnyen pa'am snyi ba'am 'jam pa'i don la go de bzhin du thugs snang gshin po lnga bu/ thugs rgyud 'jam po'am dul ba'am mthun pa'i don1gdang bu/ sa gzhi sogs dma' ba'am kong kong ngam kyong rkung gi don dang /gzhong bu'am skun bu ste/ shing sgod gzhong pa chung chung lta bu1486

bshamadza' bshes/ mdza' ba'i bshes pa ste/ yid gcugs pa'i grogs sam grogs po la godage bshes/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen te/ lam ma nor bar ston pa'i bla ma'am slob dpon nam legs pa'i grogs po la golha bshos/ lha'i zhal zas sam g.yos zas la go gtor ma la sogs pa/bshams/ bshams pa'am gshom pa ni sprig pa'am bkod pa'i don te/mchod pa bshams pa'am gshom pa lta bu'o/ bshams ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig dang / gshom ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigasdig bshags/ sdig pa ste mi dge ba'i las bshags pa'am 'chags pa ni mthol ba'am sel ba'i don/phyi bshol/ phyi bsnur ram phyi 'then la go ba dang / le lo la'ang 'jugadaper na/ sngon bskyod las phyi bshol bya rgyu med lta bu/bshul lam/ 'gro sa'i lam mam 'jug ngogs la go ste/ mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs lta bu ni mkhas pa'i bshul lam zhes pa'i don/bshar/ bshar ba'am gshor ba ni song ba'i don/bshum bshums/ bshum pa dang bshums pa gnyis ni ngu ba'am cho nge 'don pa'i zhe sa'i brda/ bshum ni ma 'ongs ston byed kyi tshig dang / bshums—ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabashal drud/ bshal ba ni drud pa dang 'then pa'i don/bshud/ bshud pa ni 'dar ba'am phud pa'am 'thon pa ste/ ldan pa'am 'gram 487

pa bshud pa lta bu dang / lag pa bshud pa lta bu ni brda ra ba'am 'khyags sbos thebs pa sogs la gobashags/ bshags pa ni gshags pa 'am bkas pa'am phye ba3ma gtar ba'i don te/ rdo dang shing bshags pa lta bu gshog pa'i 'das tshigabasha' tshe/ zha nye la go zhing bsha' dka ra ni zha nye dkar po dang / bsha' tshe nag po ni zha nye nag po la gobago bsha'/ skal ba bgo ba'i ming ste/ las ka bgo bsha' rgyab pa lta bu/ri dwags bshar/ ri dwags ste/ ri skyes yang zer zhing bshar ba'am gshor ba ni rngon pa'i don yin/rgyab bshu' / rgyab kyi bshul te/ rgyab gzhung ngam sgal pa la go ba dang /bshul sha ste/ rgyab gzhung gi sha'am brla'i sha la gopags bshus/ shing la sogs pa'i pags pa'am shun pa bshus pa ni/ bshu ba'am bkog pa'am phud pa'i don dang / yi ge dang ri mo sogs kyi dpe bshus pa ni/ ma dpe ltar bkod pa'i don/ bshus ni dus 'das pa ston pa'i tshig dang / shus cig sta bu skul tshig yin no/ /bshan bas bshas/ bshan pa ste/ rigs ngan pa la go zhing bshas po ni srog bcad pa'i don te/ bshan pas lug la sogs pa bsad pa'i don no/mer bshur/ me lce la sogs par bshur ba ni/ snam bu sogs dngos ma tshig par spu ring dang phyi shun lta bu chig bcug pa la zer/chus bshal/ chus sgod sogs bka' ba ni dreg pa sogs dag par byas pa'am bkru ba'am 'khru ba'i ngon dang / sbyong sman te bshal sman gyis pho ba'ibashal ba ni/ pho ba'i nang sto chas rnams bshal bar byed pa'i don/bshang gci/ bshang ba ni dri chen nam skyag pa la go ba dang / gci ba ni 488

gcin pa la go ba yin/bsho/ bsho ba ni chu sogs gsho ba'am bshos pa'i don te/ bsho ba ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig dang / gsho ni da lta ba ston byed kyi tshigabashos pa 'das pa ston byed kyi tshig yin no/ /mkhar bshig mkhar te ri'i steng du brtsigs pa'i khang pa bshig pa ni 'jig pa'am gzhig pa'am 'joms par byas pa'i don dang / khrims bshig pa ni khrims med par bzos pa'am gzhig pa'i don/pres bshar/ bre dang phul ni 'jal byed kyi tshad la go ba dang bshar ba ni 'jal ba'i don yin/'phrang la bshor/ 'phrang lam la bshar ba ni gshor ba'am phyin pa'am song ba'i don/spubs bshangs/ snyug ma'i spubs sogs bshangs pa ni nang drus pa'am bsal ba'am brtol ba'am bshang ba'i don/dpe bshad/ dpe bshad pa'am don bshad pa ni/ 'chad pa'am brjod pa'am 'grel ba ste/ dpe bshad na don go lta bu'o/ /sasangs rgyas/ ma rig pa'i gnyid las sangs pa'am sad pa dang / shes bya la blo pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar rgyas pa'am bye bas na sangs rgyas zhes dang /yang na/ sgrib gnyis kyi spun pa sangs shing mkhyen pa gnyis kyi snang ba rgyas pa na sangs rgyas zhes ston pa thub pa'i dbang ngo/ sogs la gosor mo/ nas bdun la sor mo gcig ces nas bdun gyi tshad yin zhing /489

mdzub mo dang nying lag kyang zer/sen mo/ rkang lag gi mdzub mo'i sen mo ste/ slar skyes yang zer/so/ so'i zhe sa la tshems dang / de bzhin gri'i no la so yang zer ba dang /rdza khog mer bsregs nas so btang ba lta bu dang / so btsugs pa ste/gsang ba'i sgo nas myul zhib byed mi bzhag pa'i don/ da ba brtend/ sil zhes pa'i sgra snyan par sgrog pa ste/ rol mo zhig la gosil sil/ sil snyan gyi sgra ste/ g.yer kha'i sgra dang / dril bu'i sgra lta bu/se mo do/ nu ma gnyis kyi dbus thad du sleb pa'i do shal te/ do shal byed pabakan zug tre / ba du kun/tshe srog tshe la go ba'i srog gi dbang po ste/ lus dang shes ba gnyib/ kyi rten la zer— spub zhing / srung ba ni skyob pa'am 'u sa bde bar 'tsho ba yong ched gnod 'tshe 'gog pa la go zhing srung ni dus da lta ba ston pa'i bya tshig dang /bsrung ni dus ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i bya tshig go zhing ni chib phrad do/ /'od srung / rigs kyi khyad 1kar te/ 'od spung chen po lta bu/ dad spung che na po ni shākya thub pa'i nyan thos zhig yin/sras / rigs ma sho ba'i rgyud kyi bu la sras dang bu mo la sras rma zer/srid pa/ srid pa ni 'a/bor ba la go ste/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba myang 'das lta bu dang / srid pa ni rten 'bred ma bcu gnyis kyi gcig ma na/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis ni/ ma rig ja/'i rten 'brer / 'du byed kyi rten 'brer/rnam shes kyi rten 'brel/ ming gzub/sa lce rten 'bre' / skye 3 ched kyi rten 'bre1ya// reg pa'i rten 'brel/ tshor ba'i rten 'brel/ sred pa'i rte zha 'byed / len pa'i rten 'brel/ drid ba'i rten 'bre' / skye ba'i rten 'brel /49)

rga shi'i rten 'brel bcas yin/ srid pa ni/ 'byung bar yang go ste/'jig rten khams 'dir gang dang gang srid pa'am 'byung ba yin lta bu'o/drang spob / sgo gsum te lus ngag yid gsum drang por srong ba ste/ phyi pa'am nang pa'i thub pa sogs la gosrol tshugs/ srol te/ lugs dang lam sogs la go dper na/ yon tan bsla ba pa'i srol tshugs pa/ chos kyi srol sngogs pa lta bu lugs sam lam 'dzub/sa pa'i don/srid/ srid pa ni rung ba'am btub pa'am skye ba'i don te/ shes bya la srid lta bu shes bya la rung ba'am btub pa'i don dang / dpe srid lta bu dpe la srid pa zhes pa'i don dang / gal srid lta bu brtag pa mtha' bzung gi (1ba/srod dus/ mtshan stod dam srid 'khor gyi dus tshod la zer/sa sros/ sa sribs pa'am sa rib pa'i don/sre nag thab dang thab sdod kyi nag dreg sogs/srab/ srab pa ste/ bsrab pa'am phra ba mthug po min pa/khrin po/ 'byung po'am sha za la golus srul/ lus srul po ni gdon zhigs spung bu/ brgya byin gyi glang chen/srubs/ bar ram gseng ngam gseb kyi ming /ba'i ba bsnang / srang lam mam khang pa'i bar gyi lam dang rgya lam la gosrid/ dkyus sam khrun du gosprungs/ ring du skur ba'am gtong ba'am sring pa'i sku' tshig dper na/ yi ge srings ba lta bu/491

yid srubs/ bdud dang 'dod lha la gogreg 'dod chags la sogs pas sreg pa ni/ yid gdung baྈ kas pa'i don dang / me sogs kyis sreg pa ni tshig pa'am thal bar byas pa'i don/sring mo/ phu mo dang nu mo gnyis kar gogred sred pa ni zhen pa'am mjon par chags pa'i ngon/sru rma/ ma'i spun bud med kyi rigs la godaka (1/ bkur sti'am zhabs phyi la go ste/ dge rgan dang pha ma la sre zhu leg 4 bar zhus lta bu/khri'u bu chung ngam khye'u'i ming ste/ mi'i phru gusri/ sri ni gdon 'dre'i rigs shig ste/ dar sri lta bu ni mi dar ma shi ba'i sbo dang / phung sri ni phung bar byed pa'i gdon 'dre zhig yi na/ sri ni gnod byed dang 8mas byed kyi rdon 'dra/sre mo/ srog chags sre mo ste/ ne'u le la gobaka'/ ba / 'dab chags shig ste/ nags bseb na gnas pa'i bya zhigasrin bya/ 'ug pa' che/ 'ug pa las chung ba'i bya zhigab / chu la gnas pa'i sram mam brag la gnas pa'i sram ste/ srog chags shig gi ming / ming gi dab4 grangs la 'ug pa mtshod byed dang / chu yi spre'u/chu'i byi ba sogs zer/thran bu/ phyi nang gi srin bu ste/ srog chags phra mo la go zhing / mig dbang rags pas mthong mi thub pa/spo ma/ shig gi sbo ma la go zheng / che chung ni nyi rdul bdun gyi tshad/srar bu/ skud pa la gosra/ sra ba ni gyong po dang mkhreb/sa po dang / gar ma dang snying po sogs la bo1ba ba

ji thrad/ sba tsam ste/ dper na/ ji srid bde ba ma thob bar lta bu ni dus ji tsam ring la bde ba ma thob pa'i bar zhes pa'i don/ de srid/ de tsam mam de'i bar dang de'i ring zer ba'i don te/ dper na/de srid 'bad brtson byed kyi yin lta bu'o/ /sran ma/ 'bru'i khyad par te/ rgya sran ma dang / bod sran ma lta bu'o/spub / snye ma'i srus ste/ smin la khad pa'i gro nas kyi 'bya rdog gsar pa 'a gobasnyen sprub / bsnyen pa nye ba'i don dang / sring ni ring ba'am jing du gtong ba'i don te/ bsnyen sring zhes pa nye ring gtong ba'i don/ dper na/ bsnyen sring med pa'i byams skyong yod pa zhu lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du— sring ni/ yi ge sogs sring pa ni spring pa'am bskur ba'i don dang / phru gu sogs sring pa ni skyed sring byas pa'i don dang / khur po sogs sring pa ni 'degs pa'i don sogs la 'jug go/sreg byed/ sreg pa po'am me lta bu la gospeg blugs/ sbyin sreg gi rdzas sam greg zas la gorgyal srid/ rgyal po'i srid ste/ rgyal po'i las sam bya ba la gobasnyen grib ba / mun sribs pa ni sa sros pa'am gdags kyi zlas phye ba'i sribs zhes pa sgrib pa'am mtshan mo sogs la gorta yi srab/ kha la bskon rgyu'i srab ste/ rta drel sogs kha g.yas g.yon du skyog byed der srab dang / 'dogs byed kyi thag pa la srab skyog zer/srub shing / spub byed kyi shing ste/ ri 'jig byed lta bu/ba / bsgyu bab/ srub byed kyi thag pa ste/ klu lhag ma can lta bu shen/ klu lhag ma can ni klu'i rgyal po'i bye brag zhig yin/ srub pa po lha dang lha min lta bur go de bzhin srub thag ni/ 'o ma sogs spub byed kyi spub shing 'then 403

thag la'ang go'ajal byed srang / 'jal byed kyi khyad par srang snye/ deng skabs lci yang 'jal byed ni srang bcu la rgya ma gang yin/ dper na/ skye bo ngan pa srang mda' bzhin/ cung zad tsam gyis mtho dmar gur lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du sngon ma ring tshad la'ang srang 'jal ba yod/spob dpon/ slong pa'i dpon po'am slob tu 'jug pa po'am bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dge rgan sogs la go51ba ma/ nyan thos sam dbu slob bam nya ma la goblob gnyer/ slob pa don du gnyer ba la go zhing slob sbyong byas pa'i don dang / slob gnyer pa ma'ang 'jugazug/ sla ba ni/ dka' ba min pa las sla ba lta bu dang / ga8 po min pa sla ba lta bu la 'jugaspob pa/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang / lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dang / lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa bcas bslab pa gsum sogs la da dung slob dgos pa ste/ slob bzhin pa'am mam du 'jug bzhin pa ni mi slob pa min pa la goblo ma/ zhib ma'am 'jal byed kyi snad cig dang / smyug ma sogs kyi bzos pa'i slo ma ste/ bsdus na bzhes slom zer ba lta bur goslong mo/ bsod stoms dang ldom bu dang rngan pa la go ste/ slong mo slong ba lta bu ni bsod stoms slong ba'am rngan pa slong ba la go de bzhin du slong mo ni bud med slong ba po la goblong / slang pa ni bsod stsoms sogs/ smangs pa'am slong mo byed pa'i don/spe ba/ man lag skyon can te/ mig rkug spyog dang / rkang pa spyog krog lta bha/ 494

gyen du slong / skra sogs gyen du slong ba'am bslang ba ni sgrong ba'i don/slog kyab / slog pa ni log nas btang ba'am log tu bcug pa'i don te/jim pa mgo rting slog pa'am bzang ngan phyin ci slog lta bu/ kyang ni sdud sgra/ speb/ speb pa ni 'byor ba'am rtol ba'am bsleb pa'i don te/ 'di ring yi ge zhig sleb byung lta bu 'byor ba'i don dang / nga tsho yang sa cha gzhin zhig la rtol song lta bu sa cha gzhan zhig bsleb pa'i don no/ /spe tres/ sman zhig yin de'i nus pa sa rlung tshad dang / rims tshad/ dreg grum/ tshad rnying byer ba/ tsha ba ma smin pa sogs la phan/ gle tres zer ba zhang zhung gi skad yin/spu gu/ chang sgod kyi bye brag chung ngu'i ming ste/ rdza sgod chung ba zhigachu spa mo/ chu dang ja thang sogs sla mo ni sla ba'i don/kun blo/dpa / kun nas slong ba ste/ bsam pa'am bsam tshul khyer so la godaper na/ bya ba gang byas kyang dang thog bsam pa'i kun slong yag po 'khyer lta bu/che/ spyod kyi/ sems gya gyu can nam drang po min pa la go/bsad pa'i slo/ dud 'gro phyugs sogs bsad pa'am bshas pa'i sto nang gi slo'am btso ste/ grod pa'i nang du chags pa'i rtswa gzan gyi ro ma la go/spar zhing / slar ni phyir ram yang ngam bskyar du zhes pa'i don te/ slar spebs byung lta bu ni phyir slebs byung dang / yang slebs byung dang /bskyar du slebs byung zhes pa'i don no/ /zhing ni tshig phrad do/ /slar yang / slar ni gong dang mtshungs ka yang ni tshig phrad yin/spu med/ slu ba ni 'brid pa'am rdzun pa'am bslus pa'i don la go zhing med ni 436
