dgag tshig yin te/ blu ba med pa ni ngo ma'i don la gospad/ ched dang / phyir dang / slad dang / don bcas bzhi ngo ni dgos pa gsal byed kyi phrad dang / de bzhin du slad ni phyin chad dam phyi yi don la'ang 'jug pa yin no/ /spe'u/ ra spu sogs las btag ba/ pa'i phyar ba'am mal khebs la goslob pa/ lug chen gyi pags pas bzos pa'i gos la gophyi nang blog phyi nang slog pa ni phyi nang du sgyur ba'am phyi nang du bstan pa la go ste/ dper na/ pags rtsag —phyi nang slog nas gyon lta bu'o/ /sla nga / sgod kyi khyad par lcags kyi sla nga lta bu bsdus na lcags glang dang /'khur slang la sogs pa'i ming /slad rol/ phyi rol lam phyi lobs kyi don/phyogs su slon/ phyogs ris su slon pa ni/ phyogs ris su gtogs pa'am 'the ba'am sdud pa'i don yin/ bslan pa ni skul tshigasbad ma/ phyi ma'am rjes mar gomad nas/ phyi nas sam rjes nas zer ba'i don/dug ro slong / dug nad kyi ro ma sogs slong ba ni long ba'am 'phar ldang byed pa'i don/sra brkyang bting / 'dul ba'i brda ste/ dge slong gi chos bos ma zhig pa sgam sgod lta bu'i nang du brkyangs te da jug pa la sra brkyang zer la gtan pa yang zer/ 'di'i phyag len bod du ma dar ba yin/ bting ba ni 'dings ba'i don/496

ba/ba gsar bu/ bsar pa'am bslab gzhon nam dang po'i las can nam gsar bu pa ste/ slob sbyong la thog mar zhugs pa'i slob ma lta bu/gsar/ gsar ba ni/ so ma dang dang po dang gzhon nu sogs kyi don te/gos so ma lta bu ni gos gsar pa'i don dang / las dang po ba lta bu las la thog mar zhugs pa'i mi dang / pho gsar dang mo gsar lta bu gzhon nul go 'khar gsil/ dge slong gi phyag mtshan te/ bsod stoms sogs la phebs skabs 'khar ba yin la gsil bar byed pa'i gsil byed kyang yin zer rgyu 'dra/gsor/ gsor ba ni/ skor ba'am 'phyar ba'i don te/ mtshon cha gsor ba lta bu mtshon cha lag gis btegs nas skor ba byas pa'am nam mkha' 'phyar ba'i don/kha gsag kha gtsang ngam rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i ched du sngon du sprel lad dam tshig 'ja sogs smras pa ste/ log 'tsho lnga'i gcig log 'tsho lnga gong du ja sde'i skabs bshad zin/gsog gsob/ gsog dang gsob ni snying po med pa'am don stong chu'i lhu ba lta bu dang / dngos ma yin bzhin du dngos ltar snang ba sku gsob lta bu dang / de bzhin du drin gsob pa ni drin bsab pa'i don la yang 'jugagasad bya/ gsod par bya ba'i yul ste/ mi ngan lta bu/ gsad bya ma 497

'ongs pa/gsod/ gsod pa ni gsad pa'am 'gums pa ste/ mi ngan khrims sar gsod pa lta bu dus da lta ba'i bya tshigagasang sngags/ shes rab stong pa nyid dang thabs snying rje chen po zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas yid mtshan rtog las skyob par byed pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes te/ gsang zhing sbas pas 'grub la gosnyan gsan/ snyan gsan zhu ba'am snyan gsan 'bebs pa ni/ rna bar thos su 'jug pa'am go bar byed pa'i don —te/ gong rim la snyan gsad zhu lta bu'o/ snyan gsan dang snyan seng gnyis don 'dra/gsung rab/ gsung ni ngag gam brjod pa la go ba dang / rab ni mchog la go ste/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab lta bu dang / bla ma'i gsung rab lta bu'o/ /gsungs/ gsungs pa ni gsung pa'am bshad pa'i do na te/ slob sbyong la hur brtson byed gsungs kyi 'dug lta bu bshad zin 'das pa la 'jug pa dang /hur brtson byed dgos zhes gsungs shig lta bu skul tshig la'ang 'jug pa yin/gsong po'i tshig drang po'am bden pa'i tshig gam ngag la gogasol/ gsol ba ni zhu ba'am dri ba'i don te/ dper na/ nyams chung bdag la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol lta bu ni rang gi re ba rgyal po sogs la zhu ba 'bul ba'i don dang / bya ba bzang ngan ji ltar yong min gsol ba ni/gtam dri ba'i don du 'jug pa yin no/ / gsol 'debs/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ lhag par don du gnyer ba'am zhu 'bul byed pa'i don te/ pha ma gnyis po sku khams gsal thang yong ba'i gso/la 'debs byas pa lta bu'o/ /498

gson/ gson pa ni gsan pa ste/ rna bas nyan pa'am thos pa'i don yin la gson cig lta bu skul tshig yin/ dper na/ rna ba ma g.yengs lan cig bdag la gson lta bu'o/ /gser mdog gser ni sa 'og nas thon pa'i rin chen zhig yin zhing / de yi ming gi rnam grangs la rin chen dang po dang / sa zla ba yang zer/mdog ni kha dog la goge'u gseb / spang gi rtswa sngon nam gsing ma la go dper na/ byang gi ni'u gseng yangs pa'i snyeng / dkar nag lug khyu rtse dgar rol lta bu/gseg ma/ rdo dum bur song ba'am gyo ma ste rdza dum bur song ba'i ming ste/bye ma lta bu/ba seb/ khrod dam nang ngam dkyil gyi don la go ste/ nags kyi gseb na gcan gzan gnas lta bu nags kyi khrod dam nags kyi nang dang / nags kyi dkyil zhes pa'i don/ de bzhin du grong gi gseb dang / mi tshogs kyi gseb lta bu'o/ /gseb/ 'bras bu ma phyung ba'i rta'am rlig pa can gyi rta ste/ pha sbyor byed ched kyi rta gseb lta bu/gsa'/ gcan gzan zhig ste/ g.yi dang 'dra ba 'a de las cung zad chung ba'i sems can/gsag ma tshor ba'am mi shes pa'am gab pa lta bus myur bar 'gro ba ste/ mi ga na gyis ma tshor bar gsag ges phyin song lta bu/ba/sir/ gsir—ba ni thad ka'am tal ma'am ma thogs pa'am thad kar phyin pa'am 'phro ba'i don te/ nam mkha' nas te 'od dang / glog 'od gsir bar 'phro ba lta bu thogs pa med par 'phro ba'i don/ de bzhin du sgra'i 499

khyad par la'ang 'jug ste/ nags gseb kyi 'bu'i gsir sgra lha bu'o/ /shib gsom/ shing gi khyad par la go ba'i gsom ni/ thang shing la zer/gsor gyis/ gsor ni 'bigs spyad rtse non zhig ste/ shing badz+ra bas shing la i khung 'jigs byed kyi sbar gsor lta bu dang / rdo bshags pas rdo la i khung 'jigs byed 'jigs gsor lta bu/ gyis ni byed pa'i sgra/gsil zhing / gsil ba ni rdo dang shing pha sogs pa bshags pa'am dum bur btang ba'i don/ zhing ni tshig phrad do/ /gses/ ba/ses pa ni bkas pa'am 'gas pa'i don te/ rdo sogs dum bur gses pa lta bu dang / bshags pa'i don la'ang go ba ma zad/ so sor phye ba'am gse ba'i skul tshig la'ang 'jugagasas mo/ gsas mo dang gsas pho ni bon gyi lha ste/ don sras mo dang sras yin zhing shi log gam 'das log la go ba dang / lha 'bab mkhan la yang gogasog 'jog gsog pa bsag pa'i don pang / 'jog pa ni bzhag pa'i don te/ bang mdzod nang rgyu nor gsog 'jog byas pa lta bu dang / 'dul ba'i gsog 'jog lta bu ni/ gsog 'jog byas pa za ba'i ltung byed la gogasang btam/ gsang ba'am sba ba'am gzhan gyis go mi nyan pa'i gtam la gsang gtam mam snying gtam/gsong / gsong shig ces pa sbod pa'am gsang ba'i skul tshig gso ras/ gso ma rā blos bzos pa'i ras phad la gso ras sam rtswa ras zer/spru gses/ spu gses pa'am bal gses pa lta bu ni/ rmel pa'am 'byed pa'i don te/ skud pa 'khal ba la sngon du bal rmil dgos lta bu gses dgos 500

zhis pa'i don no/ /gseb / spubs dang bar dang phrag gi ming ste/ rdo'i gseng lta bu rdo'i srubs la go ba dang / dgung gseng lta bu ngal gso ba'i bar dang phrag gi don/gsur/ bar ngo ba rnams la sbyin rgyu dkar gsum dmar gsum bsres pa'i rtsam pa mer bsregs pa'i dud pa 'a zer/ba / snyed snab ba / grod pa'am sto ba la gogaso phyir/ gso ba ste/ lus po gso ba lta bu lus po'i sha rgyas par byed pa'am sha skyed par byed pa'i don dang / kha gso ba'i don la yang 'jugaphyir ni dgos pa gsal byed kyi phrad do/ /gsol/ gsol ba ni bzhes pa sogs kyi don la 'jug ste/ gser khrir mnga' gsol lta bu dang / na bza' gsol ba lta bu'o/ de bzhin du lha gsol ba lta bu ni mchod par byas pa'i don co/ /gsub/ gsud pa sgrogs pa dang 'thon pa ni/ khog nang na zas ma zhu ba'i rkyen gyib/ zas dri ngan pa sgra dang bcas pa kha nas sgrogs pa'am 'thon pa'i don dang / rtsam pa'i rtsam gsud lta bu yang goso gsod/ so gsod pa ni dal ba'am bde bar gnas pa'i don/lus gsig lus dang khur po sogs gsig pa ni/ 'dar du 'jug pa'am dkrugs pa'am 'degs par byed pa'i don/dril gsil/ dril bu gsil ba ni drir bu 'khrol ba'am dril bu'i sgra 'byin pa'i don/gas / ma/ grangs ka gsum ka goskad gsang / skad gsang po'am skad kyi gdangs sam 'phang mtho po la gogaseg gshang / dge slong bsod sto mas ma phebs skabs phyag mtshan te/601

'a/bar ba/ri ba ba da/gseg ka li/ smyug ma dang ras sogs bzags nas bod lugs kyi dpe 1 rejug sgod cigab/zad zad zad/ srog 'tsho ba'am srog gnas pa ste / srog dbang ma nyams ba shā gson po zer/snyan gsab / snyan gsang po ni rna ba gsab po'i don te/ spyo byung chung 3 ba gsal por thos pa zer/chud ma gson/ chud mi za ba'am don med 'phro lhag—ma phyin ji/'i don te / chud ma gson cig lta bu skub/ tshig yin/dkad gsas/ thams cad stong pa'am phyag chen te/ bsam ga da—/ gnyis ḍa4ji gnas ris gong ma pha go pa dang / de bzhin du nyi ma'i 'od snang ngam zu 'od gsal po la'ang 'juganang gses/ nang tshan nam bye brag la go ste/ don tshan dang po( ) na nga gsem gsu ma pa lda bu'o/ /dre chu za /sil/ gcin pa gtong ba—sgyum gci pa'am bsal ba'i don1gsal shing / 'begs byed kyi mtshon rtse gcib/ pa dang rtse gsum1 pa ste/ mi'i gus kyi 'og sgo nas yar 'jigs byed kyi khrims shing zhigachud gsan/ chud gsan pa ni/ chud ba/son pa'am chud za ba ste da phro brlag song ba'i don/bsasngo bas ngas/ kha dog gi khyad par te/ sngon rngo/ dang sngo skyar go 60 3

'bags bsangs/ 'bags pa ni btsog pa'am grib sogs la go ba dang /bsangs pa ni sbyang ba'am bsal ba'am spang pa ste/ med pa bzos pa'i don no/ /bsangs ni 'das pa ston pa'i tshigatshogs bsag bsags/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa'am bsags pa ni dge ba gsog pa'i don dang / nor bsag pa'am bsags pa ni/ dngos po gser dngul sogs gsog pa'i don no / /bsag pa ni ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i chig dang / bsags pa ni 'das pa ston pa'i tshig yin/ de bzhin du gsog pa'am bsgrub pa'am gcig tu spungs pa'am gcig tu sdud pa'i don yang yin no/ /dmigs bsal/ dmigs kyis bsal ba ste/ mang po'i nang nas logs su phud pa'am zur du bkar ba'am bton pa la go ba yin/ dper na/ slob phrug nang nas bka shis ni dmigs bsal yin lta bu dang / gtso bo dang dmigs bsal lta bu dmigs bsal ni bye brag la'ang goskyon bsal/ skyon bsal ba'am dri ma ngan pa sogs bsal ba ni/ sil ba'am spong ba'am 'joms pa'am 'jil ba'am dbye ba gnod pa ste/ med pa bzo ba'i don/ bsal ba ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed tshig dang / 'das pa la da drag 'thob/bsam bya/ sems pa'i yul la/ brtag bya la gobasams/ bsams pa ni sems pa'am bsam pa'am mnos pa'am brtags pa ste/ bsam blo 'khor zin pa go bsams ni dus 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabase khrab/ tshon rtsi btang ba'i ras dang ko ba sogs ste/ ras bse dang ko bse lta bu dang / ko bses bzos pa'i khrub la bse khrub zer/ de bzhin 503

du bse yab lta bu sman rigs shig dang / bse dri zhes pa mchan 'og rmen bu'i rgyud du gnas pa'i bse rag zhes pa'i srin bu 'phel ba 'a sa byung ba'i dri ngan la gobasod nams/ dge ba'am le bshes spyad dam 'dod khams kyi dge ba sogs la go ba dang / phar phyin snga ma gsum ste/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang / tshul khrims kyi phar phyin/ bzod pa'i phar phyin bcas gsum ni bsod nams kyi tshogs yin no/ /bsod stoms/ ldom bu'am slong mo la gobasogs/ gsog pa'am bsdus pa'am spungs pa'i don la go ste/ rgyu nor bso/gas pa lta bu'o/ bsogs ni 'das pa'i don ston byed kyi tshigatshe bzang / che bsring ba ni srog spel ba'am ring du song ba'i don/bsam blo/ mno bsam mam sems kyi 'char sgo la godṛ bsab bas bas/ drin lan bsab pa dang bsabs pa gnyis gsob pa'ang 'jal ba'i don yin/ de bzhin du grangs la sigs pa ma tshang bar bsab pa'am bsabs pa ni kha tshang bar byed pa'i don dang / tshab sprod pa la'ang go/ bsab ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig dang / bsabs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigayo bsrang / yo bsrang ba ni yon po'am 'khyog po srong bar byed pa ste/ drang po ra byed pa'i don/nor bsri/ nor rdzas bsri ba ni 'phri ba'am bsris rme ste ser stsa byed pa'i don dang / bsri tshags byas pa'i don la 'jugargyang bgrib bzangs/ rgyang ring por bsring ba dang bsrings pa gnyis ni skur ba'am skrur ba'am gtong ba'i don te/ yi ge bsring pa ni yi ge skur 604

ba'am gtong ba'i don dang / rdo la sogs bsring pa ni skyur ba'i don no/bsring ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshig dang / bsrings ni 'das pa ston pa'i tshigadri bsung / dri tsam la go ba'i bsung ste/ sna'i yul dang dri zhim yang mtshon no/ /dper na/ me tog gi dri bsung gang sar 'thul lta bu/bsus/ bla ma dang sku mgron sogs bsus pa ni bsu ba'am gdan 'dren pa'am phebs bsu zhu ba'i don/bse ru/ ri dwags bse ru la go ba dang / ming gi rnam grangs la gcig pur gnas pa dang / rwa gcig pa yang zer/ da bzhin du bse ru ni rang rgyal la'ang go zhing / rang rgyal ni chos lugs kyi ming tshig shig ste/ srid pa tha ma'i tshe slob dpon la ma stos par rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos nyid brtags nas gang zag gi bdag med dang tshos kyi bdag med phyed tsam rtegs te rang byang chub mngon du brnyes pa'i dgra bcom pa la zer/bsad/ bsad pa ni gsod pa'am 'gums pa'i don/ bsad ni 'das dang ma 'ongs kyi bya tshig gnyis kar 'jugabasrungs pa/ lus srog lta bu bsrungs pa ni srung pa'am 'tsho ba'i don/bsrungs ni 'das pa ston pa'i tshigabasrung bya/ bsrung ba'am srung bar bya ba'i yul te/ ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabasreg bya/ sreg par bya ba'i yub lam bsreg pa ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi chigabasregs/ bsregs pa ni sreg pa'am tshig pa'i don te/ 'das pa ston byed chig605

bzod bsran/ bzod pa la go ba'i bsran pa ni sran pa'am sra ba'am brtan pa'am tshugs pa'i do na la go ste/ gzhan gyis rang la mi dga'i rnam 'gyur ga tshod bsta na kyang bzod bsran byed kyi yin lta bu/bsro khang / khrus sogs sten pa'i khang pa ste/ dge slong rnams khrus dang / sku mnye/ dril phyis/ me dang stan sogs zag bya lnga la bsten nas thu/sa bsros te rngul nag 'don pa'i tsha rlangs yod pa'i khang pa la zer/zho bsrubs/ zho dang 'o ma bsrubs pa ni spub pa'am sgyur ba'am dkrogs pa'i don dang / bsrubs ni dus 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabasres/ bsres pa ni sdom pa'am spel ba'am sre ba'am bsre ba'i don te/bzang ngan bsres pa lta bu gcig tu sdom pa'i don dang / tshig bcad dang tshig lhag bsres pa ni spel ba'i don no/ /bsres ni 'das pa ston byed kyi ༄tshig yen/ bsod pa'i zas/ legs ba 'am bzang ba'am 'da' ba'i zas nam zan gyi don te/ zas bsod pa dang zas zhim po la gobasrel/ bsrel ba ni 'chang ba'am 'dzin pa'am sped ma pa'am srel ba'i don/ring bsrel/ gdung ngam 'phel gdung la gobasrings/ bsrings pa ni sring ba'am bsring ba ste/ skur ba'i don/ bsrings ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshigabya ba'i bsral/ bya ba la go ba'i bsral yin nam mi blo bsral can zhes mchan snang ba ni blo rtsing ngam blo thabs sam blo gsal can sogs gang yin brtag rgyu /sgrib pa bsrabs/ nyon mongs kyi sgrib pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis po bsrabs pa ni dag par byed pa'i don dang / bsrabs ni 'das pa ston 606

byed kyi tshigabasel ba/ 'jigs skyob kyi skyed ma'/ skyel pa po'i ming ste/ nyen kha yod pa'i lam la srung skyel byas pa'i don/bso sgra/ bso bso zhes pa'i sgra yi khyad par te / ke ki bso bso lta bu sngar bon po'i brda zhig da lta bod kyi grub ma tha' ris med la dar ba'i sgra zhib/bal bsos bu/ ngal bsos kyi bu steX/ rnam thos sras la bokha bsum/ sgod sogs kyi kha bsum pa ni kha bsdoms pa'am sgrog pa'am btsum pa'i don/rjes bsubs/ rjes shul bsubs pa ni bsub pa'am phyis pa'am sgrib pa'am 'gog pa'i don/ bsubs ni 'das ba ston —byed kyi tshigabaser bu/ rlung ngam dal rlung dang grang mo'/ 'khyag pa la gobasil/ bsil ba ni grang ba'am drod med pa'am bsil mo la go ba dang /dbu skra bsil ba lta bu skra bzhar ba'am gcod pa'i don la 'jugalha bsang / bsangs mchod dam bsangs gso3 ba ni/ grib med par byed pa'i don/me bsangs/ me bsangs ni me la shāg pa sogs bdugs nas gtsang ma byed pa'am btsog pa dang dri ngan bsal ba'am med—par byed pa'i don/skyo bsangs/ skyo ba bsangs pa ni skyo ba bsal ba'am skyo ba yal bar byed pa ste yid bde bar byed pa'i don dang / bsangs pa ni 'cham 'cham byas pa la'ang goblo bsrun/ blo bsrun pa ni sems bgru/na pa'am srun pa ste/ sems dul ba'am g.yung ba'am bzang ba'am zhi ba'i) don /507

bsam bse'u/ sgod drug gi gcig ste/ khu khrug gnas pa'i stsod la zer /sgod drug ni1 pho ba dang rgyu ma dang long ga dang mkhris thum dang sgang ba dang bsam bse3 bcas so / bsam bse'u ye byed las ni lus la chabs pa'i sa bon khams dkar dam ra gtong ba dang / lus kyi sto bas bcud spel bar byed pa lin no/ /sba bgri med/ sba pa ni nor sogs sbed pa'i don da nga / bsri ba ni sri ba'am 'phri ba'am 'tshag pa ste/ nor sogs ser sna'am gron chung byas pa'i don/med ni dgag tshig yin/ bsdus na rgyu nor sogs la sbod ba 'am ser sna sobs med pa 'i rdon/bsang btor/ bsang dud dang gtor bshos mnyam 'bul gyi bsdus tshig (pen/zhabs bsil/ rkang pa 'khrud pa'i chu'am rkang ba 'khrud pa'i ce sa'i brnga/bsro/ bsro ba ni me dang nyi ma la sogs sro ba ste/ tsha bar byed pa'am lde bar byed pa'am bsros pa'i don/ bsro ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabaslad bya/ slod byed kyi yul lam bslad pa ni/ lhad dam skyon gtong byed kyi yul la go bsla da bya ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i tshigabazad/ bslad pa ni lhad bcug pa'am skyon bsres pa'i don rte/ gser la rag gi lhad bcug pa lta bu/ brla da zin 'daka pa ston pa'i tshibab spru bya/ slu byed kyi yul lam bslu ba ste / rdzun dang mgo skor gto nga byed kyi yul la go/ brlu bya ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i tshigabaslus/ bslus ba ste/ slu ba'am brid ‘4'am mgo g.yo4/sgyu ‘ 'i rdon/ mi gzhan la rdzun spras nas mgo skor btang ba lta bu ma bslu sa pa zer/ bslus pa ni ‘'das ba ston byed kyi tshig608

bslang bya/ slong byed kyi yul lam bslang ba ni/ len bya'i dngos po'am yu' la go/ bslang bya ni ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i tshiganor bzangs/ nor la sogs pa bslangs pa ni/ slong ba'am slong mo byas pa ste/ gzhan la re pa zhus nas len pa'i don/ bslangs pa ni 'das pa ston pa'i tshigaphyogs su bslan/ phyogs ris su bslan pa'am slon pa ni/ phyogs ris su gtogs pa'i don/ bslan pa ni ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i tshigabaslab bya/ slob byed kyi yul rig gnas dang las sogs la go ba dang / de bzhin brla ba bya ni zha ta'am kha ta sto slo ba ston la —nga 4 bslab ni dus ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi tshigabaza ba nga / bya las sam bslab bya yul te/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang / lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dang / lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa bcas bslab pa rin po che gsum lta bu/gyen du bsgangs/ ka ba sogs gyen du bslangs pa ni slong ba'am sgreng ba'i don no/ bslangs ni 'das pa ston byed kyi tshiga'adod pa'i bsod nyams/ 'dod pa la lhag par longs spyod pa'i ming la bsod nyams zhes bya ste/ nyams rangs su'ang bshad do/ /ha khya' hral/ rtsid pa'i rnam pa'am gos sogs ral ba'i dbyibs la gohrul hrul/ spul ba'am zad pa'i tshu' lam gos sogs hul po'am rab— pa'i dbyibs la go509

mig grig hreg mig ni lta byed la go ba dang mig hrig hrib/ ni mig rig rig ste / lta tshul zhib/ sta phab / rgya kag gi skad de btsun pa'am ban de zhes pa'i don/hwabs / bu ྈma gyi dwangs ma 'ji kha bun bzang shos sam sha kha ra mang zer/1— /rkya— shāka bka/ gos kyi mtha' 'am sne la gortsab hral/ 'dod chags shin tu che ba ste/ btsun tshugs nyams te spyod rngo1 ba nga byung byed ma khan la go ba'i smod tshig lin/ de bzhin du spyod pa rtsing po la rtsab sdo1'a1 dang / gos byul po la gos rtsab hral zhes kya brjod//skaza ma/ pa 'i / shing bdub/ spyos ste/ sman gyi khyad par yin zhing shing sha pa ma nga ze— / ka ka ru ni a gu ru yi sga zung chag pa ste/ lci med kyi don no/ /ched ru ra / sman 'this bu gsum gyi gcig ste 'bras bu gsu— ni/ a ru ra dang / ba ngu ra dang / skyu tu ra'o/ / dz+wa —— dkar — mcho ga 'a‘4ba/sa san/ mchog yos sam shun 'gongs te/ sbyon pa'i khya ༄ ji4ra yin 'di ba/ me tob/ yod med kyi rigs gnyis yod par mngon/lus la za to ga u rngul (sha bo/ zhing ming gi rnam grangs la steng skyong ngam steng 'thung ya nga ze ra/yo rgyan/ oṃ shā ༄ sna ka za zu ra chab/ ste steng 'phur ram 'phur 'gro zer ba 8 nga / sngar rgya ba/ra nub rngugs kyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti byon pa'i yul la yu ka u rgan ze 8 /yu za 1 lha dpang phyub/ che ba po'i chu — 4/() ma drag mo la go 610

ba rnyil/ rin chen dbang sngon te/ rdo nor bu'i rigs sngon po zhigashib thog a za/ shing 'bras a mra ste/ shing sa ha ka ra la ko ba ni/ a mra sdong po la 'o ma'i chu drangs nas skyed bsrings pa 'a sa byung ba'i a ma'i 'bras bu dri zhim la khyad par du 'phags pa zhigaye la'i 'dab/ shing e la zhes pa'i 'dab ma'am e ba'i 'dab ma can ni klu zhig la go.e nu yan/ ri dwags bye brag pa'am spyi'i byin pa ste/ ri dwabs shā ba la go ba dang / gzhan du e spyo ya dang / e na ya zhes 'bri srol kyang snang /phe'u gnyis pa rnam dbye'i sbyor ba bshad pa/da ni rnam dbye phrad la sogs/ /gces bsdus sil bur bstan pa las/ /thog mar dam dbye drug pa yi/ /kyi gi gyi 'i yi dmas ni/ /da ba sa dang da drag dag /thob ma bar kyi ngang ga nga gi/ /rngo ma ra ba ba'i/ po gyi/ /mtha' rten med mthar 'i thob cing / /rkang ba skong tshe yi ste dper/ /khrod kyi rgyab kyi g.yas kyi char/ /gyur gyi zag gi byab gi phyogs1 /611

dpon gyi lam gyi bar gyi sar/ ke gzhol gyi sa gzhi'i bdag de yi/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ da ni rnam dbye drug pa sogs dang phrad rjogs tshig la sogs pa gces shing nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig bsdus te sil bur bstan pa— bya ba las/ thog mar rnam dbye drug pa yi sgra/ kyi gi gyi 'i yi lnga po rnams kyi sgra'i sbyor tshul ni/ rjes 'jug da ba dang / rjes 'jug dang ka/nga 'jug yang yin pa'i sa dang da drag dab/ thob pa'i mthar rnam dbye drug pa'i sgra kyi sbyar ba dang / rjes 'jug ga dang nga gnyis kyi rjes la rnam dbye drug pa'i sgra gi sbyar na mthun zhing / rjes 'ju ga na ma ra la bzhi po yi mthar rnam dbye drug pa'i sgra pyi sbyar ba dang / ming gzhi'i mtha' rten par byed pa ste/ rjes 'jug 'a dngos su yod med gang gi mthar yang rung ba ba/ 'i thob cing / de'i mthar tshig gi rkang pa kha skong dgos ba/'i tshe yi thob ste/ rim pa ltar dper brjod na/ kam dbye drug pa'i sgra kyi thob pa'i dpe ni/ khyod kyi/ rgyab kyi/ g.ya kyi char/phyogs kyi/ gyurd kyi lta bu dang / dz+wa ma dbye drug pa'i sgra gi thob pa'i dpe ni/brag gi/ byang gi phyob/sa lta bu dang—/ rnam dbye drug pa'i sgra gyi thob pa'i dpe ni/ dpon gyi/ lam gyi/ bar gyi sa/ gzhol gyi lta bu dang / rnam dbye drug pa'i sgra 'i thob pa'i dpe ni/ sa gzhi'i/ mda'i/ me'i lta bu dang / rnam dbye drug pa'i sgra yi thob pa'i dpe ni/ bdag de yi/ dag rjed yi/ bya yi/ nya yi zhes ji1 lta bu'o/ /mdza (1 ma ma byu1 zig /byem yang / /rkang pa skob mi skong gis dbye/ /ba ba ba / /da bab bod ba/ba rjod ba/ba spyod 'a/ bab/ /612

'o nyid sbyi bo la sogs ba'i/ /ming la ba byed wa nyid du/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rdzogs tshig gi 'o dang go'u ta ma dang / mtshe'u lta bu'i 'u dang / dri tshig la 'jug pa'i 'am sgra de gsum tsheg khyim gcig gi nang du thob pa dang mi thob pa yang / chig gi rkang pa kha skong mi skong gis dbye bar bya'o/ /de ni tshigs bcad byed pa'i dus su tshig rkang gcig gi nang du tshig chad lhag gi gnas tshul byung tshe/ tshig gi rkang pa kha skong ba ni tshig khyim gcig las logs su phye ba da / tshig gi rkang pa kha mi skong ba ni tshig khyim gcig la mnyam du 'jog pa yin/ bde'o/ /bya'o la sogs pa'i rdzogs tshig gam slar bsdu la 'o nyid thob cing / spyo bo dang dga' bo la sogs pa'i ming gi cha la ba phyed ma'i wa nyed thob par 'dod do/ /mtha'adi rten can dang brtsegs ba dang / 1gugaXkyed can zu/thar 'a mtha' spang / /zhes gsungs te/ rjes 'jug ga sogs kyi mtha' rten yod pa can deng / mgo can ra mgo sogs brtsegs pa dang / dbyangs gi gu sogs kyi gug kyed yod pa can gyi mthar 'a dngos kyi mtha' rten sbyor ba spang par bya'o/ /dper na/ ngag khang / nad/ phan/ khab/ sam/ shar/ nyal/ ngas lta bu dang / rka/ lda/ snga lnga bu dang / mi/ chu/ me/ kho lta bu la 'a mtha' spang dgos kyang ming gzhi rkyang pa la sngon 'jug yod pa la 'a mtha' nges par zhugs dgos pa ste/ dper na/ da ka'/ dga'/ mtha'/ mkha'/ bda'/ bsha'/'ba'/ 'ga' lta bu sogs la 'a mtha' med na 'ga' zhig go ba log sprub la 'gro ba dang / ra ga' zhig glog tu med pas nges par du gnad 'ji shes par 613

pya dgos so/tshog phrad sha da ba'i rjes su/ / cing ces ce'o ce na cib /nga na ma 'a ra la dab / /mtha' rten med pa'e rjes jag byu/ 1 'ing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig /sa mthar shing the'o phe na shig / ra ra 'a gsum rjes su ni/ / da drag thob phyir re gsu ma gyi/ /rjes su zhing sogs lnga zab kyang / /da drab/ nges par thob pa rer/ 1cing sogs lnga po lebs te nga/per/ /rtab cib rtog ces lhag ce'o/ /su 'dug ce na khyod 'dug /rgud cib zad ceb/ re da ce'o/ /ci 'chad ce na chos shod cib /zab cing thob ces nub ce'o/ /gab rgyab ce na gri rgyob cig /byab zhing drang zhes 'byung zhe'o/ /gang gzung zhe ma sems bzung zhig /lhan zhing 'dzin zhes dkon zhe'o/ /lha yin zhe na don zhig gnyer/ 1514

'jam zhing zams zhes 'dzom zhe'o/ /dben nam zhe na nam zhig dben/ /dga' zhing bza' zhes gda' zhe'o/ /du gda' zhe na 'ga' zhig go /dar zhing 'phyur zhes 'grur zhe'o/ /ci 'phyab zhe na dar phyor zhig /'chol zhing 'tshal zhes 'khyel zhe'o/ / gang tshol zhe na chos tshol zhig /za zhing bde zhes spyo zhe'o/ /ched spru che/ na ba 51 cheb/ /'dus shing 'bral bar res she'o/ /ci res she na gtam spros shig /mkhyen cib 'phral ces brgyan ce'o/ /cis grol ce na grol sprur cig /ces gsungs pa ni/ tshig phrad cing zhing shing sogs kyi sbyor tshul bstan pa la/ rjes 'jug ga da ba'i rjes su tshig phrad cing sbyar na des sdud ji/'i don dang lhag bcas kyi rdan bstan pa dang / tshig phrad ces sbyar na ces bya ba'am zer ba'am 'di ltar zhes pa'i don bstan pa dang / tshig phrad ce'o sbyar na slar bsdud ma ces so zhes pa'i don bstan pa dang / tshig phrad ce na sbyar na zer na dang dri ba lta bu la go ba dang / tshig phrad cig sbyar na skul tshig dang bye brag pa'am zhig gi don bstan cho/ /rje pa 'jug nga ma 'a ra la dang / mtha' rten 'a dngos su med pa'i rjes dag tu/ tshig phrad zhing zheb zhe'o zhe na zhig thob pa yin/ 'on kyang kha cig 616

dang ska cib sogs lha bu la dmib/sa bsal yin la tshig phrad jeng ba/bas de pag sbyor tshul gyi dz+wa na ni gong du brjod pa'i cing la sogs nga'i tshig phrad lta8 rim bka byas nas ji ra dgos so/1 1rjes 'jug ga che/ yang 'jug/ sa yig gi ma thar1 tshig phrad shib—she1 rtswa she na shig thob cing / rjes 'jug sa mthar chig phrad shes sprar na mi le0kas pas jed thob pa dmib/sa bsal du mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gi4 bzhed pa yin/ de ltar rjes 'ju‘ka sa yig gi mthar spyir shing so bshes thob kung shes lta bu meng gzhi sha yig mi/ rjes— su sa ma tha' yod pa'i tshig phrad de sbyor skabs sbyor tshu 8 thad co/ra 'khrul gang 6 5tsho med na'ang glog pa pos shes pa'i shes dang nor nyen che na po yod stabs/ dmigs bas la du khyes bris na legs so/ tshig phrad shing sogs de rnams ngon du sbyor tshul ni/ gong gi tshig phrad cing la sog ba pa'i rim pa ltar sbyar dbo/ba so/ /rjes 'jug na ra la gsum gyi rjes su ni/ da drag thob pa yo da pa'i lce na ra la de gsu ma gyi rjes su spyir zhing la sogs pa'i tshig phrad lnga po de dag thob mod kyang / da drag nges par thong der/ tshig phrad cing sogs lnga po sbyor ba na legs pa yin te/ nges par du sbyor dgos so/ /gong gsal tshig phrad de dag 'jug tshul rim bzhin dper brjod na/rjes 'jug ga la cing sogs thob pa4'i dpe ni/ rtag cing / rtog ces/ lhab ce'o/ /spu 'dug ce na/ khyod 'dug ces lta bu don gong la bshad pa ltar 'og ma la yang sbyar/ rjes 'jug da la cing sogs thob pa'i dpe ni/ rgud cing /zad ces/ che/da ce'o/ /ci 'chad ce na/ chos shod cig lta bu dang / rjes 'jug ba'i rjes su tshig phrad cing sogs thob pa dper na/ zab cing / thob ces nub ce'o/ /gang rgyab ce na/ gri spyob cig lta bu dang / rjeb 'jug nga la 516

tshig phrad zhing sogs smob pa'i dpe ni/ byang zhing / drang zhes/ 'byung zhe'o/gang gzung zhe na/ sems gzung zhig lta bu dang / rjes 'jug na dang la gnyis la tshig phrad zhing sogs thob pa'i dpe ni/ snyan zhing lta bu dang / /mkhas pa dang legs pa la go ba'i 'dzin zhes lta bu dang / dkon zhe'o/ lha yin zhe na/don zhig gnyeྈ lta bu dang / rjes 'jug ma yi rjes la tshig phrad zhing sogs thob pa'i dpe ni/ 'jam zhing / dom zhes/ 'dzom zhe'o/ /dpen nam zhe na/nam zhig dben lta bu dang / rjes 'jug 'a dngos su yod pa lta bu la chig phrad zhing sog ba— thob pa'i dpe ni/ dga' zhing / bza' zhes/ gda' zhe'o/ /du gda' zhe na'am ji tsam gda' zhe na/ 'ga' zhig go lta bu dang / rjes 'jug ra la tshig phrad zhing sogs thob pa'i dpe ni/ dar zhing / 'phyur zhes/ 'gyur zhe'o/ /ci 'phyar zhe na/ dar chen phyor zhig lta bu dang / rjes 'jug la la tshig phrad zhing sogs thob pa'i dpe ni/ 3chol zhing / 'chal zhes/ 'khrul zhe'o/ /gang 'tshol zhe na/ chos tshol zhig lta bu dang / rjes 'jug 'a mtha' rten dngos su med pa la tshig phrad zhing sogs thob pa'i dpe ni/ za zhing / bde zhes/ spro zhe'o/ /e smra zhe na/ ma smra zhig lta bu'o/ /rjes 'jug sa mthar tshig phrad shing sogs thob pa'i dpe ni/ 'dus shing / spyir rtogs shes thob kyang 'dir dmig bsal du rtogs zhes dang / 'bral bar nges she'o/ /ci shes she na/ gtam sbos shig lta bu dang / rjes 'jug gi mthar yang 'jug da drag yod pa la tshig phrad cing sogs sbyar na legs pa'i dpe ni/ mkhyend cing / 'phrald ces/ brgyand ce'o/ /cis grold ce na/ grol gyurd cig lta bu ste/ mkhyend sogs kyis da drag skad gsar bcad kyi tshe bsdus te deng skabs 'bri srol med kyang don la 'di ltar yod pa shes dgos pas tshig phrad cing sogs sbyar na legs pa'o/ /617

dri dang jogs tshig skabs su da/ /mab 'a rten med dang 'a mthar 'a/ /mtha' rten gzhan mthar rab rang la'o/ /da drag can mthar ta ste dper/ /bde 'am bde'o dga' 'am dga'o/ /gyurd tam gyurd to lta bu 'o1 /zhes gsungs pa ni/ dri ba dang 'byed sdud dang rdzogs tshig gam slarabasdu'i skabs su ni/ 'a mtha' rten dngos su meng pa dang / 'a mtha' rten dngos su yod pa'i mthar 'a ste/ tshig phrad 'am dang 'o thob la/ mtha' rten nam rjes 'jug ga sogs gzhan gyi mthar tshig ga sogs la rjes 'jug ma dang dbyangs kyi bzhi pa rna ru spyor bas gam sogs dang / go sogs thob pa'o/ /yang 'jug da drag can gyi mthar ta zhes pa tshig phrad tam dang / to thob ste/ de dag dper brjod rim pa bzhin bkod na/ —sgyu spu' rten dngos su med pa la tshig phud 'am dang 'o thob pa'i dpe ni/ bde sgyum/ bde'o lta bu dang / 'a mtha' rten dngos su yod pa la tshig phrad 'am dang 'o thob pa'i dpe ni/ dga' 'am/ dga'o lta bu'o/ /de bzhin tshig phrad gam sogs dang go sogs sbyor tshul rtogs sla ste/ tshig phrad gam sogs thob pa dper na/ 'jug gam/ byung ngam/bshad dam/ yin nam/ lab bam/ gyur ram/ phel lam/ byas sam lta bu yin pa dang / tshig phrad go sogs thob pa dper na/ 'jug go/ byung ngo / /bshad do/ /yin no/ /lab bo/ /gyur ro/ /'phel lo/ /byas so lta bu rnams ni gong gi rjes 'jug gang yin pa bstun nas de dang mthun pa'i tshig phrad sbyor dgos so/ /da drag can gyi mthar chig phrad tam dang te thob ste/ dper na/ gyurd 618

tam/ gyurd to lta bu'o/ / lhag ma can gyi te ste de/ /na ra la sa da drag gi /rjes su te rkyab da mthar de/ /ga nga ba ma 'a dang ni/ /mtha' rten med ma bar sa ste dber1 /byon te bskor te nor btsal te/ 1skyengs te gyur te don med de//rtog ste gtsang ste lhan grub ste/ /'dzom ste dga' ste sems bde ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ lhag ma can gyi sgra te ste de gsum gyi sgra sbyor ni/rjes 'jug na ra la sa dang da drag gi rjes su tshig phrad te rkyang pa dang / rjes 'jug da yi mthar tshig phrad de sbyar dgos pa dang / rjes 'jug ga nga ba ma 'a dang ni/ mtha' rten nam rjes 'jug 'a yig dngos su med pa'i mthar sa mgo can gyi tshig phrad ste thob pa yin pas de dag rim bzhin dper brjod na/ tshig phrad te sbyor ba'i dpe ni/ byon te/ bskor te/ nor btsal te/ skyengs te/gyurd te lta bu dang / tshig phrad de sbyor ba'i dpe ni/ don med de/ bshad de/ bzhad de lta bu dang / tshig phrad ste sbyor ba'i dpe ni/ rtog ste/ gtsang snye/ 'bad pa med par nyun gyis grub snye/ 'dzom ste/ dga' ste/ sems bde ste lta bu'o/ /dam dbye bdun ba la don gyi/ /519

tu du ru su'i zhabs kyu da/ /ga ba da drag can mthar tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ 1sa su mtha' rten med pa dang / /'a mtha' ru ste dpe rim bzhin/ /rtag tu rab tu shin tu dab / /steng du sdod du rgyun du zo/ /lam du myur du 'jal du song / /rjes su 'di ru dga' ru chug /bod kyi yi ger tshig do na rnam pa tha dad par dbye ba la na nga gses khag bdun yod pa las 'dir rnam dbye gnyis pa la don gyi phrad tu du byu su bcas zhabs kyu can gyi phrad bzhi dang / ra na la gsum bcas bsnan pas khyon bdun yod pa de dmas kyi sgra sbyor byed tshul ni/ rjes 'jug ga ba dang nga drag can gyi mthar phrad tu 'jug pa dang / rjes 'jug nga da na ma ra la drug gi mthar phrad du 'jug pa dang / rjes 'jug sa'am yang 'jug sa yi mthar phrad su 'jug pa dang / mtha' rten 'a dngos su med pa dang / 'a dngos su yo ba pa'i mthar phrad ru dang tshig rkang pa skong mi dgos na phrad ra yang thob ste/ de dag sbyor ba'i dpe ri6/ pa bzhin brjod na/ phrad tu 'jug pa'i dpe ni/ rtag tu/ rab tu/ 'in tu lta bu dang / phrad du 'jug pa'i dpe ni/ steng du/ stod du/rgyun du zo/ la che1 du/ sprur du/ 'jal du song lta bu dang / phrad su 'jug pa 'i dpe ni/ rjeb/ nu / phyogs su lta bu dang / phrad ra dang ru 'thug pa'i dpe ni/'dir/ 'a shar lta bu ni tshig kha skong mi dgos pa'i ra dang / 'di rā/ 'ga' nu lta bu tshig kha skong dgos pa'i snabs 'jug pa yin/ de bzhin du chig phrad 630

na la gnyis ni rjes 'jug gi khyad par la mi stos pas thams cad la ci bder spyor ro/ /mtshams spyor kyang 'ang yab nams ji/ /ga da ba sa nyid dang ni/ /da drag thob pa'i rjes su kyang / /nga na ma 'a ra la yang / /mtha' rten med mthar 'ang dang ni/ /rkang pa skong tshe yang ste dber/ /bdag kung 'bad kyang don grub kyang / /byas kyab 'on kyang ma byung yang / /byon yang nam yang 'ga' yab ni/ /sba ra yang mjal yang blon ba bde yang / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ chig snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba'am rgyan sdad kyi kyang ༄ yang 'ang rnams kyi sgra sbyor ni/ rjes 'jug ga da ba sa dang yang 'jug sa nyid dang ni/ da drag thob pa'i rjes su phud kyang thob pa dang / nga na ma 'a ra la drug che/ rjes su phrad yang thob pa dang / mtha' rten 'a dngos su med pa'i mthar phrad 'ang dang ni/ tshig gi rkang— pa kha skong ba'i tshe phrad yang thob ste dper brjod na/ phrad kyang thob pa'i dpe ni/ bdag kyang / 'bad kyang / don grub kyang / byas kyang / rtogs kyang / 'on kyang lta bu yang gi dpe ma byung yang / blor yang mjal yang lta bu 'ang yang kha skong mi dgos pa dang dgos pa'i dpe blo'ang dang bde yang zhes pa lta bu'o/ /621

ming mtha'i pa ba'i dbye ba ni/ 1ga da na ba ma sa dang / /da drag can mthar pa dang ji/ 1nga 'a ra la mtha' med ma ba'i/ /ba phyid war 'a pod rnams la ba /gzhan la pa nyid sprur te dper/ 1zag pa med pa phan pa mchog 1thob pa dam pa mkhas pa ru/ /gyur ba dang ba la dga' ba/ /myur bar mjal bar spro ba las/ /lub pa mda' pa'i 'byor pa yis/ 1yul pa lu pa tshims sogs dpyad/ /ming gi mtha—'i pa dang ba sgra'i sbyor tshul gyi dbye ba ni/ ga da na ba ma sa dang / da drag can gyi mthar pa dang ni/ nga 'a ra la dang 'a mtha' rten dngos su med pa'i mtha'i ba phyed war 'bod pa rnams la ba thob cing / sbyor tshul bshad ma thag pa las gzhan du ba thob pa'i yul 'ga' zhig la pa nyid spyor ba legs te dper na/ pa 'jug tshul gyi dpe ni/ zag pa/ med pa/ phan pa mchog tho ba pa/ dam pa/ mkhas pa ru/ gyur ba lta bu'i dpe dang / ba 'jug tshul gyi dpe ni/ dang ba la/ dga' ba/ sprur bar/ mjal bar/ spro ba lta bu las gzhan la pa'i dpe ni/ lung pa/ mda' pa/ 'byor pa/ yul pa/ phu pa tshims sogs la dpyad na/ de dag ni ming mtha' 'dren tshul lam sgra sbyor ma nges pas sna tshogs su 'gyur bar snang la 'di dag gi tshig den zhib mo sum rtags kyi gzhung las ka sa pa ra bya'o/ /52 2

yi ge'i shad 'bri tshu' bshad ba/gachod mtshams mtha' rten ga yi ma bar/ /chig shad nga yig ma gtogs pa'i/ /shad gong dmas su phyi tsheg zang / 1don mang bgrangs pa'i mib gi ni/ /mtshams dang don 'bring 'byed pa dab / /don nyung rjogs tshig mtshams chig shad/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i kang mtha' dang / /lhag pa'i rje tshan rdzogs mtshams kyi/ 1sna ru can mthar nyis shad bya/ /lde tshan chen po rdzogs mtshams dang / /le'u mtshams lha bur bzhi shad thob/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ tshig gi gcod mtshams su ye ge'i shad thob tshul brjod na de'ang dbu can gyi dbang du ni/ mtha' rten rjes 'jug ga yod pa'i mthar chig shad bya 'ing rjes 'jug nga yig ma gtogs pa'i rjes 'jug gzhan lhag mar shad kyi gong rnams su phyi ma'i tsheg spang bar bya la don mang po grangs su bgrangs pa'i ming gi ni mtshams na tsheg shad de dper na/ sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' zhes pa lta bu 'bri rgyu dang / don 'bring 'byed par chig shad de dper na/ sdug bsngam bden pa dang / kun 'byung bden pa dang / 'gog pa'i bden pa dang / lam gyi bden pa/ zhes pa lta bu dang / don nyung rdzogs tshig thob pa'i mtshams su chig shad de dper na/523

za'o sha'o/ je/sa pa lha bu/ tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang pa'i ma po rjams su stis shad dang / lhug pa'i sde tshan dzab/sa pa'i mtshams kyi sna ru can gyi mthar nyis shad bya pa ra 'os 'ing / chig rdon gyi sde tshan chen po rdzogs/ pa'i ma bo che4dz+wa4 bam po lta bu dang / le'u dang skabs kyi mtshams lta bur bzhi ༅da thob bo/ /bod kyi brda'i bye prag gsam bar byed pa'i bstan brtsos chib/ le'ur byas nga mkhab/ pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba las1 rnam dbye dang tshig phrab kyi sgra sbyor dang shad thob tshul sogs gced4 pa ste nyer mkho sna tshogs thun mong du bshad pa ste/ we'u gnyis pa'i bshad pa'o/ / //sngon 'jug job mi thob bshad pa/da ni 'phul dang mtha' rten mgo/ /ces da ba 11zad bdab chub da ba spyodang pa / /gdam nga can la mtha' gcig nu/ /'dzin pa'i 'khul spong cung zad bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ da ni 'phum te sbon 'jug lnga dang / mtha' rten te rjes 'jug bcu po dang / ra la sa'i mgo can gsum po 'di dag brjod pa'i sgra gdangs la med dgos pa la sbyor ba'i 'khrul pa dang / brjod pa'i sgra gdangs la yod dgos pa la sgong ba'i 'khrul pa dang / gang ya nga rung ba'i gdam nga can la yod med mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa zhems sgong dgos pa'i tshul cung zad bshad par bya ste/za yab ge sar sil lhar dang / /mngon sum phun su ma chogs sogs la/ / 52sgyu1

gas 'phul nor ro gsha' ma dang / /gshags byed sogs la med na nor/ /sar pa lha bur gang yang rung / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ dper na/ rnga yab dang / ge sar dang / sil snyan dang / mngon sum dang / phun sum tshogs lta bu sogs la sngon 'jug ga mi thob cing / gal te rnga g.yab dang / ge gsar/ gsil snyan/ mngon gsum/phun gsum tshogs zhes sngon 'jug ga bris na nor ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du gsha' ma dang / gshags byed/ gsham gsal sogs la sngon 'jug ga med na nor ba yin/ sar pa lta bu sngon 'jug ga yod med gang yang rung ngo / —skyil kub sogs la das 'phul med/ 1dgung lo mtshan dgung long khrid kyi/ /dmigs bu sogs la med na nor/ /snyan dngags sogs la gab yab rung / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ skyil krung dang / kar kar sogs la sngon 'jug da mi thob pa la skyil dkrung dang / dkar dkar zhes sngon 'jug da bris na nor ba yin/ dgung lo dang / mtshan dgung / long khrid kyi dmigs bu sogs la sngon 'jug da thob kyi gal te ma bris nor ba yin/ snyan dngags lta bu sogs la sngon 'jug da yod me da gang yang rung ste snyan ngag kyang 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag dar lag dar gad mo dang / /smra sha da sogs la bas 'phul zang / /bser bu skyo bsangs rgya mo bza'/ 1626

phyi bdar sogs la med na nor/ /sngo sangs lta bur gang yang rub / /jes gsungs pa ni/ phyag dar dang / lag dar ma dang / gad mo dang / so mang gi skra shad dpa / ser ba sogs lta bu brjod pa'i sgra gdangs la sngon 'jug ba mi thob pas spang bar bya zhing / bser bu dang / skyo bsangs dang / rgya mo bza' dang / bal mo bza' dang / phyi bdar dang / mdun bdar dang / bdag po sogs la sngon 'jug ba med na nor ba yin la sngo sang sa lta bur sngon 'jug ba yod med gang yang rung ste sngo bsangs yang 'thad do/ /tha gru tha ma mtshar du mngar/ /tshon rtsi sogs la mas 'phul srang / /mthe bo mtshe ma sngo smar mtshe/ /khyim mtshes sogs6la med na nor/ /thun mong sogs la gab yab rung / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ yul gru'am rgya khyon la go ba'i tha gru dang / ka ma dang / tshar du dngar/ tshon rtsi dang / nang tshan sogs la sngon 'jug mas 'phul ba spang dgos shing / mthe bo dang / mtshe ma dang / sngo sman gyi mtshe dang / khyim mtshes dang / che/tshan ma dang / mtshe'u sogs la sngon 'jug ma mi bris na nor la/ thung mong dang / sman tshan lta bu sogs la sngon 'jug thob spru thob ba —nga yang rung ngo / /tshong 'dus khams jang tshogs pa tshoms/ /za ma khon 'dzin khro bo khros/ /626

rim gro phra mo phobs pa dang / /phyub po sob/sa la 'as 'phul zang / /mtha' 'kho/ ba 'khri/ shing 'a/ ra ba dang / /tshul 'chos sogs la med na nor/ /phrin las phreng sobs gang yang rung / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ tshong 'dus dang / khams dang / tshogs pa dang /tshoms dang / phra ma dang / khon 'dzin dang / khro bo dang / khros dang / rim gro dang / phra mo dang / phongs pa dang / phyug po dang / phangs pa lta bu sogs la sngon 'jug (shā mi thob pas sgang dgos la/ mtha' 'khob dang / 'khri shing dang / 'khur ba dang / tshul 'chos dang / 'phongs rkyen lta bu sogs la sngon 'jug 'a med na nor ba yin pas nges par 'bri dgos shing / phren las dang /phreng ba lta bu sogs la gdam nga can yin pas sngon 'jug 'a yod med gang yang rung ba'i tshul shes par bya'o// //rjes 'jug blob ka thob bshad pa/yi ge byu gu lu gu rgyud/ /shākya sogs la ga mtha' sba nga / /phrag dog phrug gur med na no ra / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ ye ge dang / spru gu dang / lu gu rgyud dang /shākya dang / che ga sogs la rjes 'jug ga yig zhugs na nor bar gyur pas nges par sgang dgos pa dang / phrag ngog dang / phrug gu dang / shug pa lta bu rjes 'jug ga med na nor ba yin pas nges par 'bri dgos/527

pus mo'i lha nga a ba dab / /sgo nga sogs la nga mtha' nor/ / zhes gsungs pa ni/ pus mo'i lha nga ngang / sla nga dang / sbo nga sogs la rjes 'jug nga bris na nor ba yin pas ngeb/ par srung dgos/ 'on kyang tshib bsdus sprus na pus lhang lta bu dang / lcags slang lta bu dang / bya sgo nga ka bu sogs 'byung na rjes 'jug nga yig spyar dgos pa ni shes dgos pas 3de lta bu gong 'og kun la rigs 'gre bar bya/yid bdaka yid zad ba yid bdab/ba bdang / /da/ (1 sog ba snyer da mabs rdo zad ra/ /skad cis lta bur gab 2/nga rung / zhes gsungs pa ni 1 yi ngam bang / 6/ pa—nga dang 1 shā dwags dang 1pre zhu dang / yi chad sogs la rjes 'jug da bris na no1 ba yin pab༄ nges— —ra sgang dgos/ 'on kyang ska cib ti bur rjas re rngub/ da yo/da me da kang ya nga rung ste/ ska da cig ces kyang 3thad/de/ ched spyod bka zad na zad rjed lnga / ba / /byan mo lta bur rmed na snar /zhes gsung ba/ pa ni/ se mo do lta bu la rjes 'jug na bris na nor ngas nges par sgang bar bya zhing / byan mo dang / sen rma lta bur rjab ge 'a zug nazad na nor ba yin/lha btsun bza' bdung gdu bu dang / /628

le bdam sags la ba mtha' nor/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ lha btsun dang / bza' btung / gdu bu dang /le brgan dang / sde brgyad sogs la rjes 'jug ba bris na nor ba yin pas nges par spang dgos/ /'ga' zhig gi ngag rgyun du lha btsun la lhab btsun tu smra ba dang / bza' btung la bzab btung du smra ba dag ni phal cher rjes kyi sngon 'jug ba de gong gi ming gzhi dang lhan du sdeb nas rjod pa yin snyam/ de ltar dpe mang po zhig snang ba la dpyad par bya'o/ /rgya 'dre kha mchu ra mda' dang / 1ra mnye na bza' rtswa ma chob grong / /rgya mtsho sogs la ma mtha' nor/ /thes gdangs ji ni/ rgya 'dre dang / kha mchu dang / ra mda' dang /ra zu/nye dang / na bza' ba/nga / rtsa mchog grong dang / rgya mtsho dang / skye mched sogs la rjes 'jug ma pres na nor ba yin pas nges par spang dgos/de'ang rjab kyi sngon 'jug de gong gi ming gzhi la sdeb nas rjod par snyam/ 'on kyang de 'ba'i dpe thams cad 'a khyab pa min/lha rje mdo rgyur nga rgyal can/ /bya rgod rdo rje mtha' rten dang / /lha rten sogs la ra mtha' med/ /dur khrod mdor bsdus ra med nor/ /bzher gshegs sogs la gang yang rung / /zhes gsungs ba ni/ lha rje dang / mdo rgyud dang / nga rgya' can dang /629

bya rgod dang / rdo rje dang / mtha' rten dang / lha rten dang / bka' rtabs sogs la rjes 'jub ra bris na nor bas nges par sgang dgos pa dang / dur khrod dang / mdor bsdus dang / gsar pa lha bu la rjes 'jug ra ma zhugs na nor ba yin la/ bder gshebs zhes pa lhar la don dngos su yod pa'am yang na su ga —ta'i sgra —ltar bde gshegs zheb/ rnam dbye med kyang rung la/ de bzhin du bder bkod rto bu sogs la ra yod med gang yang rung ngo / /blun gyi gso sa sman kha dro dang / /za za sogs la la mtha' rtsod ra/ /zhes gsung4/ pa ni/ snyun gyi gsos sman dang / kha dro dang / grwa rnga sogs la rjes 'jug la yig mi thob pas nges par spang dgos la bris na nor ba yin/rig sngags gsung rab mkhyen rab dab / /nam 'phang ko 'phang khri 'phang mchog/bgyed rim jogs rim 'du shes dang / / mkha' spyod sa spyod do sha la 'phreb / /nyam chung nyam bag nyam nga ba/ /log stob som nye chom rgan dab / /cho ga sogs la sa ma tha' nor/ /lhas byin klus byin bdams ngag sogs/ / mab pa zhig 6pa med ra nor/ /dri zangs rgyud ma ngas pho rims dang / /530

'khor los sgyur sogs gab yab rub / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rig sngags dang / gsung rab dang / mkhyen rab dang / nam 'phang dang / go 'phang dang / khri 'phang mchog dang / bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim dang / 'du shes dang / mkha' spyod dang / sa spyod dang /do shal gyi 'phreng dang / nyam chung dang / nyam thag dang / nyam nga ba dang /log rtog dang / som nyi dang / chom rkun dang / cho ga sogs la rjes 'jug gam yang 'jug sa bris na nor ba yin pas nges par spang dgos pa dang / lhas byin dang / klus byin dang / gdams ngag dang / rtogs pa dang / rtabs pa sogs mang po zhig la rjes 'jug gam yang 'jug sa ma bris nor ba yin pas nges par 'bri dgos la/ dri bzang dang / rgyud mangs dang / go rims dang /'khor los sgyur ba sogs rjes 'jug sa mtha' yod med gang yang rung ste gdam nga can yin pa'i phyir ro/ 1 zad kor stod kor gdub kor dab / 1pad kor than kor 'od kor phreng / /ya za sogs la sa mgo med/ /ngur zig smig rgyur med na nor/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ sa mgo can thob mi thob ste/ klad kor dang / stod kor dang / gdu kor dang / pad kor dang / 'od kor phreng dang / a ka dang / nyer kor sogs la sa mgo sbyor ba med pas nges par srung dgos ḍa/ dang / ngur sprig dang / smig rgyu dang / sprug ma sogs lta bur sa mgo med na nor ba yin la 'di dag phal cher gyi tshig don gong du rgyas par bshad ba dang spyor nas shes par bya'o/ /6 31

ye ge zhal ta da lha dang / /'a sogs tha dar ces rnams la/ /bar tsheg mi byer blun po'i lugs1 /zhes gsungs pa ni/ yi be ngang 1 ka' ta dang / da lta dang / la so/gas pa ba 'os mtha' dag bsdus pa dang / tha dad ces (ka lta bu rnams la sba phye'i bar du tsheg mi byed pa ni skye bo blun po'i lugs su zad pas nges kur du tsheg bya dgos so/ /de lhar mdo tsam bshad pa 'dis /mtshon nas shin tu rgya che'i ba nas/ /rang rang rnam dpyod rig pas dpyad/ /mtha' dag yi ger brjod mi lang / /zhes/ gsungs pa ni/ de ltar gong du brda yi sbyor tshul mngo hūṃ bsdus te cung zad tsam ba4shed pa 'dis mtshon par byas nas ye ge'i sbyor ba 'in tu rgya che ba'i gnas rnams gtsug lag las 'byung ba dag kyang shes par bya zheng /rang rang so so'i brda la rnam par dpyod pa'i rig ‘zhes kyang dpyad par spru'o/ /sdeb sbyor mtha' dag pa ni yi ger—bris te brjod pas mi lang ngo / zhes bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas nga mabs pa'i ngag gi sgron ma thes bya ba las/ yi ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul pa sgong ba bshad pa ste le'u gsum pa'i bshad pa'o//jeng sang byis pa'i skye bo rnams/ /brda dag 'ji ko 'u nga rigs kyis/ /632

dpyad gzhi chung zheng tshegs med du/ /shes snyam 'khrul pas mgo go zangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ deng sang gi dus su byis pa ltar blun pa'i skye bo rnams kyi blo la brda dag gi sbyor ba 'di ko brda sprod pa'i lung dang brda la brten pa'i rigs pa gnyis kyis don go ba 'dir rag mas pa'i phyir dpyad par bya ba'i gzhi che mod kyi/ de las ldog ste chung bar rtsi zhing slob pa'i dka' tshegs la stos pa med par zhar byung ngam zhor du shes par 'gyur snyam yang /'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs dang tha na spring yig tshun gyi brjod byed 'khrul pas brjod bya'i dngos po la mgo bo 'khor zhing rmongs par snang ngo / 1zhes pa'i don no/ /kye ma shes bya pha mtha' yas/ /de dag re re'i ming gi yang / /rgyu mtshan res tshig mi shes na/ /brda dag spyor ba ji lhar byung / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ kye ma shes par bya ba'i pha rol gyi gnas mtha' med pa'am dpag tu yas pa bsam spyis mi khyab cing / shes bya de dag la re re'i ming gi sgra 'jug pa'i yang rgyu mtshan ci zhig la stos nas byung ba ni 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa'am 'brel ba rgyu mtshan byas pa dang / 'dod rgyal lam yang na rjes sgrab yin min sogs dang / nges tshig dang sgra bshad sogs mi shes na ༄shes bya thams cad kyi brda dag pa'i sbyor ba thob tshul ji ltar 'byung ste sgra don sogs la rmongs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /633

so so rig bzhi sa dgu pa/ /ma thob de grid chos kun gyi/ /res tshig shes min de yi phyir/ 1mtha' dag sdeb spyor su yis shes/ 1zhes gsungs pa ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ste/ chos so so yang dag par rig pa dang / don so so yang dag par rig pa/ nges tshig so so yang dag par rig pa/ sbobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa bcas yin la jim pa ltar gtsug lag gi rjod byed dang / de'i brjod bya dang / sgra don nam skad dang mkhyen pa 'di dag sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros ma thob pa yi bar gyi dus de srid du shes bya'i chos ma lus pa kun gyi nges pa'i tshig sogs shes pa min la de yi phyir na/ shes bya mtha' dag gi sdeb sbyor ni so si skye bo'am mi phal pa su yes shes nus te mi nus so/ zhes ba'i don no/ /'on kyang phyogs re'i brda dag kyang / /'bad pa du mas btsal bar bya/ 1yi ge'i sprur ba la 'khral na/ /don rnams 'khrul pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ sa dgu pa ma thob pa dag gis shes mi nus mod/'on kyang shes bya phyogs re'i brda sbyor dag kyang 'bad pa du ma'i tshu(ka gyis brtag cing btsal bar bya ba las btang stoms su mi bya ste/ rgyu mtshan ni 'di ltar te yi ge'i sbyor ba dang rjod byed tshig sogs la 'khrul zhing nor na brjod ngon rlab / sa su 'khrul pa 'byung ba smos ci dgos pa'i phyir don la nor na gnas skabs dgos pa dang / mthar thug gi nying dgos gnyis mi 'thob bo/ /zhes 63

pa'i don no/ /'di ji gsub rab ma lus ba'i/ /pyi mor shes pas mkhas mab ge/ /gzhub la brten nas bdag bi/sa kyang / /'di nyid kho nar nan tan byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ tshul 'di sna gsung rab kyi bka' dang dgongs 'grel ma lus pa'i phyi mo'am rtsa bar shes pas sngon gyi mkhas ba mang po byon pa dag gi brda'i gzhung khungs btsun rnams la brten nas rtsom pa po bdag gis kyang brda'i sbyor ba ston pa 'di nyid kho nar nan tan byas pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /mkhas pa du ma sa mdzad pa yi/ /brda yi bstan bcos grangs mang yang / /'ga' zhig tshig rgyas dgos don khung / /'ga' zhig gnyis ka ha cang bsdus/ /'ga' zhig yig rnying dab mi mthun/ /'ga' zhig sum rtags sogs dab 'gal/ /de pyir tshig nyub don rgyas pa'i/ /legs bshad 'ad ni bdag gis byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ sngon byon mkhas pa du mas sbyar ba'am mdzad ba'i bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos la grangs mang po zhig snang yang / rje byams pa gling pa'i smra rgyan lta bu 'ga' zhig ni tshig rgyas la skabs kyi dgos pa'i don 636

nyung ba dang 1 rje zha spu lo tsā ba'i za ma tog lta bu 'ga' zheg ni tshig don gnyis ka ha cang bsdus pa dang sna nge kang 'o tsā ba'i brda sbyor lta bu 'ga' zhig ni sngon gyi 6)ga rnyeng dang mi mthun pa dang / stag ston gyi 'od— zer brgya pa dzi thu 'ga' zhig ni sum rtags kyi gzhung sogs dang 'gal bar sna nga ste/ rgyu mtsham de yi phyir tshig tshogs nyung la don rgyas pa sogs dang ldan pa'i legs par bshad pa'i bstan brtsas 'di ni dpa la khang pa bdag gis brtsams ba ra byas so/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /'ji la rab bza ma mchis te/ /tshad ldan gzhung la yang dag ba chen/ /gsar rnying brda dang rgya bod skad/ /la zabs zhib mor dpyad de bkod/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ ngag sgron 'di snyer khungs med par rang gis pho tshong byas shā—1'i skyon ma mchis te rgyu mtshan ni/ tshad ldan gyi mabs — bo gzhung na ba/sal ba'i 'gas bshad la yang ngab/ par brten ceng / gsar rnying gi brdo dang / rgya gar sud dang bod kyi skad la sogs pa dag zhib mor dab da de ngo1kod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i don no/snyigs ma'i mi rnams rnam dpyod mib /rbubs byi nga ling hog bos bsgribs nas /bzu bo'i blo yis che gas bshad la/ /'i sgog grags nga 'i rjes su 'brang / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ tshe'i dī/gas ma dang / nyon mongs snyigs ma dab /5 3()

sems can snyigs ma dang / dus kyi snyigs ma dang / lta ba snyigs ma lnga bdo bldam dar ba'i dus kyi mi rnams ni gnas dang gnas min pa la zhem par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi mig de phyogs su lhung ba'i ling tog gis bsgribs par byas nas/ drang zhing gzu bor gnas pa'i blo gros bzang po yis tshig don legs par bshad pa dag la mi rtog pa'am mi dpyod par don mthun med kyang 'jib rten na grags pa gang che ba'i rjes su 'brang bar byed do/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /mkhas pa'i ngag sga sgron ma 'ad ko legs bshad 'od zer stong ldan mod/ /blo nor ldan yab rigs gzugs longs spyod nyam chung bdag gis sprur ba'i phyir/ /rab rib blo ngan rnams kyis spangs nas blun po 'khor mang 'byor ldan gyi/ /nyes bshad srin bu'i kha yi 'od la zlangs pa'i mun pa sel phyir rgyug/ces gsungs pa ni/ mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya'i bstan bcos 'di ko legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer stong phrag dang ldan mod/ rtsom ji1 po nyid kyang rnam dpyod kyi blo bzang po'i nor dang ldan par gyur na yang rigs rus dang / gzugs byad dang / longs spyod dam 'byor pa nyam chung zhing dman pa bdag gis sbyar bar byas pa'i phyir zhes pa rgyu mtshan du bzung ste/ rab rib lta bu'i blo gros ngan pa can rnams kyis ring du spangs nab// blun po mkhas par rlom nga so so'i 'khor gyi tshob/sa mang zhing 'byor pa rgyas ldan gyi smra sgo nas nyes bshad byung ba dper na/ srin bu'i kha yi 'od dang mtshungs ‘ la brda sbyor gyi 537

rmongs pa'i spun pa de sel ba'i rgyug par byed do/ /zhes pa'i don sgo/ /bdag gis 'jir 'bad bsod nams rang / /gzur gnas blo bsal don gnyer pa/ /'ga' la 'di yis phan srid na/ 1de yi dge ba byang chub bsngo/ 1zhes gsungs pa ni/ rtsom pa po bdag gis bstan bcos 'dzir nan gyis 'bad nas sbyar ba'i bsod nams me tog kun+da stor dkar ba dang / phyogs gral gzu bor gnas shing nom 'byed kyi blo rab tu gsal la 'dod pas don du gnyer ba dang ldan pa ste blo gsal ba dang / shes 'dod dang / bla mar kus pa bcas chos gsum tshang ba'i skyes bu sogs 'ga' zhig la gzhung 'dis phan rwa1 'byung srid na/ de lta bu las byung ba yi da ge ba rnams sems can mtha' dag bla na med ji1'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don/ bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sdom brtson mkhyen pa dang brtse ba'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa byang pa lus srog 'tsho bar mdzad pa'i sman pa ba 'od zer ba'i gsung gis bskal ba'i rkyen byas te/ de'i ngor shākya'i tog ༄gi rjes 'jug dge slong mtshan ngag dbang chos kyi rgyu mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde'am dpal sgang ngam dpal khang pa chos mdzad lo tsā ba zhes byas bas rnam 'phyang gi lo tha skar nya ba ston ka'i zla ba 'bring po'i gral gyi tshes bco lnga la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul karma pa'i sgaྈ chen du legs par grub cing rdzogs par bgyis pa'o/ /maṅgal/ /638

smras pa/mkhas mang rgod po gshegs pa'i shul lam du/ /nyam chung byi'u sa bgrod nus ma yin yang / /'di ltar cung zad ngal ba byas pa 'dis/ /rang mnyam kun la phan pa'i don yod sems/ /'on kyang kho bo'i skyes sbyangs dman pa'i phyir/ /'di la 'gal 'khrul cha tshogs ci mchis pa/gzur gnas blo gros can gyis sel mdzad nas/ /bde dag rmongs pa'i spun pa sangs gyur cig / dge legs 'phel// //539
